sanskrit_iast: oṃ mahan me voco bhargo me voco yaśo me vocaḥ stomaṃ me voco bhuktiṃ me vocaḥ sarvaṃ me vocas tan māvatu tan māviśatu tena bhukṣiṣīya
meaning: ओं महन् मे वोचो भर्गो मे वोचो यशो मे वोचः स्तोमं मे वोचो भुक्तिं मे वोचः सर्वं मे वोचस् तन् मावतु तन् माविशतु तेन भुक्षिषीय
text_mt: Om! Speak great things for me, speak splendor for me, speak glory for me, speak the stoma for me, speak enjoyment for me, speak all for me. May that protect me, may that enter me, may I enjoy through that.

sanskrit_iast: devo devam etu somaḥ somam etv ṛtasya pathā
meaning: देवो देवम् एतु सोमः सोमम् एत्व् ऋतस्य पथा
text_mt: May the god Soma go to the god, may Soma go to Soma by the path of cosmic order,

sanskrit_iast: vihāya dauṣkṛtyam
meaning: विहाय दौष्कृत्यम्

sanskrit_iast: badvā nāmasi sṛtiḥ somasaraṇī somaṃ gameyam
meaning: बद्वा नामसि सृतिः सोमसरणी सोमं गमेयम्
text_mt: Badvā is your name; [you are] the track, the Soma-pathway; may I go to Soma.

sanskrit_iast: pitaro bhūḥ pitaro bhūḥ pitaro bhūḥ
meaning: पितरो भूः पितरो भूः पितरो भूः
text_mt: Fathers, the earth! Fathers, the earth! Fathers, the earth!

sanskrit_iast: nṛmaṇa ūrdhvabharasaṃ tvordhvabharā dṛśeyam
meaning: नृमण ऊर्ध्वभरसं त्वोर्ध्वभरा दृशेयम्
text_mt: O Nṛmaṇa, bearer of what is aloft, may I, bearing aloft, see you.

sanskrit_iast: mṛdā śithirā devānāṃ tīrthaṃ vedir asi mā mā hiṃsīḥ
meaning: मृदा शिथिरा देवानां तीर्थं वेदिर् असि मा मा हिंसीः
text_mt: Gracious, pliable, the crossing of the gods, you are the vedi; do not harm me.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ śiro 'si yaśodhā yaśo mayi dhehi
meaning: विष्णोः शिरो ऽसि यशोधा यशो मयि धेहि
text_mt: You are the head of Viṣṇu, the bestower of glory; bestow glory in me.

sanskrit_iast: iṣa ūrja āyuṣe varcase ca
meaning: इष ऊर्ज आयुषे वर्चसे च
text_mt: For sap, for strength, for life, and for splendour.

sanskrit_iast: yunajmi te pṛthivīm agninā saha yunajmi vācaṃ saha sūryeṇa yukto vāto 'ntarikṣeṇa te saha yuktās tisro vimṛjaḥ sūryasya
meaning: युनज्मि ते पृथिवीम् अग्निना सह युनज्मि वाचं सह सूर्येण युक्तो वातो ऽन्तरिक्षेण ते सह युक्तास् तिस्रो विमृजः सूर्यस्य
text_mt: I yoke the earth for you together with Agni; I yoke speech together with the sun; the wind is yoked with the intermediate space together with you; yoked are the three purifiers of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtasya sadane sīdāmi
meaning: ऋतस्य सदने सीदामि

sanskrit_iast: ṛtapātram asi
meaning: ऋतपात्रम् असि

sanskrit_iast: vānaspatyo 'si bārhaspatyo 'si prājāpatyo 'si prajāpater mūrdhāsy atyāyupātram asīdam ahaṃ māṃ prāñcaṃ prohāmi tejase brahmavarcasāya
meaning: वानस्पत्यो ऽसि बार्हस्पत्यो ऽसि प्राजापत्यो ऽसि प्रजापतेर् मूर्धास्य् अत्यायुपात्रम् असीदम् अहं मां प्राञ्चं प्रोहामि तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसाय
text_mt: You belong to Vanaspati; you belong to Bṛhaspati; you belong to Prajāpati; you are the head of Prajāpati; you are the vessel that surpasses life. Here I urge myself forward for fiery energy, for brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: maruto napāto 'pāṅkṣayāḥ parvatānāṅkakubhaḥ śyenā ajirā endraṃ vagnunā vahata ghoṣeṇāmīvāṃ cātayadhvaṃ yuktāstha vahata
meaning: मरुतो नपातो ऽपाङ्क्षयाः पर्वतानाङ्ककुभः श्येना अजिरा एन्द्रं वग्नुना वहत घोषेणामीवां चातयध्वं युक्तास्थ वहत
text_mt: Maruts, sons, dwelling in the waters, peaks of the mountains, swift falcons, bring Indra here with a sound, with a cry drive away disease; you are yoked, bear [him].

sanskrit_iast: idam aham amuṃ yajamānaṃ paśuṣv adhy ūhāmi paśuṣu ca māṃ brahmavarcase ca
meaning: इदम् अहम् अमुं यजमानं पशुष्व् अध्य् ऊहामि पशुषु च मां ब्रह्मवर्चसे च
text_mt: Here I place that sacrificer upon cattle, and myself upon cattle and upon brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: vasavas tvā gāyatreṇa chandasā saṃ mṛjantu rudrās tvā traiṣṭubhena chandasā saṃ mṛjantv ādityās tvā jāgatena chandasā saṃ mṛjantu
meaning: वसवस् त्वा गायत्रेण छन्दसा सं मृजन्तु रुद्रास् त्वा त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा सं मृजन्त्व् आदित्यास् त्वा जागतेन छन्दसा सं मृजन्तु
text_mt: May the Vasus wipe you down with the gāyatrī metre; may the Rudras wipe you down with the triṣṭubh metre; may the Ādityas wipe you down with the jagatī metre.

sanskrit_iast: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate prabhur gātrāṇi pary eṣi viśvato 'taptatanūr na tad āmo aśnute śṛtāsa id vahantaḥ saṃ tad āśataḥ
meaning: पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रभुर् गात्राणि पर्य् एषि विश्वतो ऽतप्ततनूर् न तद् आमो अश्नुते शृतास इद् वहन्तः सं तद् आशतः
text_mt: Your filter is spread out, O Brahmaṇaspati; being the lord, you encompass its limbs on all sides; one whose body is not heated, [one who is] raw, does not attain that; only those who are cooked, carrying it, have reached it.

sanskrit_iast: praśukraitu devīmanīṣāsmad rathaḥ sutaṣṭo na vājy āyuṣe me pacasva varcase me pavasva viduḥ pṛthivyā divo janitrāc chṛṇvantv āpo 'dhaḥ kṣarantīḥ somehodgāya mām āyuṣe mama brahmavarcasāya yajamānasyarddhyā amuṣya rājyāya
meaning: प्रशुक्रैतु देवीमनीषास्मद् रथः सुतष्टो न वाज्य् आयुषे मे पचस्व वर्चसे मे पवस्व विदुः पृथिव्या दिवो जनित्राच् छृण्वन्त्व् आपो ऽधः क्षरन्तीः सोमेहोद्गाय माम् आयुषे मम ब्रह्मवर्चसाय यजमानस्यर्द्ध्या अमुष्य राज्याय
text_mt: May the bright, divine thought come forth from us like a well-fashioned, swift chariot; clarify yourself for my life, purify yourself for my splendour; the knowers know from the earth, from heaven the mother; may the waters flowing downwards hear; chant here, O Soma, for my life, for my brahminical lustre, for the prosperity of the sacrificer, for that one's realm.

sanskrit_iast: vekurānāmāsi juṣṭā devebhyo namo vāce namo vācas pataye devi vāg yat te vāco madhumat tasmin mā dhāḥ sarasvatyai svāhā
meaning: वेकुरानामासि जुष्टा देवेभ्यो नमो वाचे नमो वाचस् पतये देवि वाग् यत् ते वाचो मधुमत् तस्मिन् मा धाः सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा
text_mt: Vekurā is your name, beloved by the gods; homage to speech, homage to the lord of speech; O divine Speech, what is honeyed of your speech, in that place me; to Sarasvatī svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: sūryo mā divyābhyo nāṣṭrābhyaḥ pātu vāyur antarikṣābhyo 'gniḥ pārthivābhyaḥ svāhā
meaning: सूर्यो मा दिव्याभ्यो नाष्ट्राभ्यः पातु वायुर् अन्तरिक्षाभ्यो ऽग्निः पार्थिवाभ्यः स्वाहा
text_mt: May the sun protect me from the celestial ruinous spirits, Vāyu from those of the intermediate space, Agni from those of the earth, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: yo 'dya saumyo vadho 'ghāyūnām udīrate viṣūkuhasya dhanvanāpa tān varuṇo 'pa dhamatu
meaning: यो ऽद्य सौम्यो वधो ऽघायूनाम् उदीरते विषूकुहस्य धन्वनाप तान् वरुणो ऽप धमतु
text_mt: Whatever Soma-related destruction by the malevolent arises today, may Varuṇa blow them away with the bow of Viṣūkuha.

sanskrit_iast: yo ma ātmā yā me prajā ye me paśavas tair ahaṃ mano vācaṃ pra sīdāmi
meaning: यो म आत्मा या मे प्रजा ये मे पशवस् तैर् अहं मनो वाचं प्र सीदामि
text_mt: What is my self, what is my offspring, what are my cattle—with these I settle mind and speech.

sanskrit_iast: agnes tejasendrasyendriyeṇa sūryasya varcasā bṛhaspatis tvā yunaktu devebhyaḥ prāṇāyāgnir yunaktu tapasā somaṃ yajñāya voḍhave dadhātv indra indriyaṃ satyāḥ kāmā yajamānasya santu
meaning: अग्नेस् तेजसेन्द्रस्येन्द्रियेण सूर्यस्य वर्चसा बृहस्पतिस् त्वा युनक्तु देवेभ्यः प्राणायाग्निर् युनक्तु तपसा सोमं यज्ञाय वोढवे दधात्व् इन्द्र इन्द्रियं सत्याः कामा यजमानस्य सन्तु
text_mt: With the fiery energy of Agni, with the power of Indra, with the splendour of the sun, may Bṛhaspati yoke you for the gods, for the in-breath; may Agni yoke Soma with ascetic heat to carry the sacrifice; may Indra bestow virile power; may the desires of the sacrificer be true.

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ kariṣyāmy annaṃ praviṣyāmy annaṃ janayiṣyāmi
meaning: अन्नं करिष्याम्य् अन्नं प्रविष्याम्य् अन्नं जनयिष्यामि
text_mt: I shall make food, I shall enter food, I shall produce food.

sanskrit_iast: annam akaram annam abhūd annam ajījanam
meaning: अन्नम् अकरम् अन्नम् अभूद् अन्नम् अजीजनम्
text_mt: I have made food, food has come to be, I have produced food.

sanskrit_iast: śyeno 'si gāyatracchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃ pārayā mā stotrasya stotraṃ gamyād indravanto vanemahi bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam
meaning: श्येनो ऽसि गायत्रच्छन्दा अनु त्वा रभे स्वस्ति मा सं पारया मा स्तोत्रस्य स्तोत्रं गम्याद् इन्द्रवन्तो वनेमहि भक्षीमहि प्रजाम् इषम्
text_mt: You are a falcon, having the gāyatrī metre; I take hold of you; take me safely across; may the chant of praise go to the chant of praise; having Indra, may we win, may we enjoy offspring and nourishment.

sanskrit_iast: saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tapobhir aganmahi manasā saṃ śivena saṃ vijñānena manasaś ca satyair yathā vo 'haṃ cārutamaṃ vadānīndro vo dṛśe bhūyāsaṃ sūryaś cakṣuṣe vātaḥ prāṇāya somo gandhāya brahma kṣatrāya
meaning: सं वर्चसा पयसा सं तपोभिर् अगन्महि मनसा सं शिवेन सं विज्ञानेन मनसश् च सत्यैर् यथा वो ऽहं चारुतमं वदानीन्द्रो वो दृशे भूयासं सूर्यश् चक्षुषे वातः प्राणाय सोमो गन्धाय ब्रह्म क्षत्राय
text_mt: Together with splendour, with milk, together with ascetic heat have we come, with an auspicious mind, together with discernment and with the truths of the mind; that I may speak what is dearest to you, may I become Indra for your sight, the sun for [your] eye, the wind for [your] breath, Soma for [your] fragrance, the Brahman for the kṣatra.

sanskrit_iast: namo gandharvāya viṣvag vādine varcodhā asi varco mayi dhehi
meaning: नमो गन्धर्वाय विष्वग् वादिने वर्चोधा असि वर्चो मयि धेहि
text_mt: Homage to the Gandharva who speaks everywhere; you are the bestower of splendour, bestow splendour in me.

sanskrit_iast: adhvanām adhvapate svasti me 'dyāsmin devayāne pathi bhūyāt
meaning: अध्वनाम् अध्वपते स्वस्ति मे ऽद्यास्मिन् देवयाने पथि भूयात्
text_mt: O lord of the pathways of pathways, may there be well-being for me today on this path travelled by the gods.

sanskrit_iast: samrāḍ asi kṛśānuḥ
meaning: सम्राड् असि कृशानुः

sanskrit_iast: tutho 'si janadhāyo nabho 'si pratakvāsaṃmṛṣṭo 'si havyasūdanaḥ
meaning: तुथो ऽसि जनधायो नभो ऽसि प्रतक्वासंमृष्टो ऽसि हव्यसूदनः
text_mt: You are Tutha, the supporter of people; you are Nabhas, the swift runner; you are cleansed, the preparer of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: vibur asi pravāhaṇaḥ
meaning: विबुर् असि प्रवाहणः

sanskrit_iast: vahnir asi havyavāhanaḥ
meaning: वह्निर् असि हव्यवाहनः
text_mt: You are Vahni, the bearer of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: śvātro 'si pracetāḥ
meaning: श्वात्रो ऽसि प्रचेताः

sanskrit_iast: tutho 'si viśvavedā uśig asi kavir aṅghārir asi bambhārir avasyur asi duvasvān
meaning: तुथो ऽसि विश्ववेदा उशिग् असि कविर् अङ्घारिर् असि बम्भारिर् अवस्युर् असि दुवस्वान्
text_mt: You are Tutha, knowing all; you are Uśig, the sage; you are Aṅghāri; you are Bambhāri; you are seeking help, attentive.

sanskrit_iast: śundhyur asi mārjālīyaḥ
meaning: शुन्ध्युर् असि मार्जालीयः
text_mt: You are the cleanser, the Mārjālīya.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtadhāmāsi svarjyotiḥ
meaning: ऋतधामासि स्वर्ज्योतिः
text_mt: You are of cosmic order's abode, the light of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: samudro 'si viśvavyacāḥ
meaning: समुद्रो ऽसि विश्वव्यचाः
text_mt: You are the ocean, all-embracing.

sanskrit_iast: ahir asi budhnyaḥ
meaning: अहिर् असि बुध्न्यः

sanskrit_iast: ajo 'sy ekapāt
meaning: अजो ऽस्य् एकपात्

sanskrit_iast: sagarā asi budhnyaḥ
meaning: सगरा असि बुध्न्यः

sanskrit_iast: kavyo 'si kavyavāhanaḥ
meaning: कव्यो ऽसि कव्यवाहनः

sanskrit_iast: pāta māgnayo raudreṇānīkena piṣṭata mā namo vo 'stu mā mā hiṃsiṣṭa
meaning: पात माग्नयो रौद्रेणानीकेन पिष्टत मा नमो वो ऽस्तु मा मा हिंसिष्ट
text_mt: Protect me, O fires, with your Rudra-like troop; do not grind me down; homage be to you; do not harm me.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtasya dvārau stho mā mā saṃ tāptam
meaning: ऋतस्य द्वारौ स्थो मा मा सं ताप्तम्
text_mt: You two are the doors of cosmic order; do not burn me.

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ sakhibhyaḥ pūrvasadbhyo namo parasadbhyaḥ
meaning: नमः सखिभ्यः पूर्वसद्भ्यो नमो परसद्भ्यः
text_mt: Homage to the comrades sitting before; homage to those sitting behind.

sanskrit_iast: śyeno nṛcakṣā agneṣ ṭvā cakṣuṣāva paśyāmi
meaning: श्येनो नृचक्षा अग्नेष् ट्वा चक्षुषाव पश्यामि
text_mt: A falcon looking on men, with the eye of Agni I look down upon you.

sanskrit_iast: indav indrapītasya ta indriyāvato gāyatracchandasaḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
meaning: इन्दव् इन्द्रपीतस्य त इन्द्रियावतो गायत्रच्छन्दसः सर्वगणस्य सर्वगण उपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि
text_mt: O drop, drunk by Indra, full of power, having the gāyatrī metre, possessing the whole troop, invited, with the whole troop I consume of you who are invited.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaḥ sapta ṛṣīn upa tiṣṭhasvendrapīto vācas pate saptartvijo 'bhyuc chrayasva juṣasva lokam mārvāg ava gāḥ
meaning: ऊर्ध्वः सप्त ऋषीन् उप तिष्ठस्वेन्द्रपीतो वाचस् पते सप्तर्त्विजो ऽभ्युच् छ्रयस्व जुषस्व लोकम् मार्वाग् अव गाः
text_mt: Stand upright before the seven sages; drunk by Indra, O lord of speech, rise up towards the seven priests; enjoy the world; do not sink down below.

sanskrit_iast: soma rārandhi no hṛdi pitā no 'si mama tan mā mā hiṃsīḥ
meaning: सोम रारन्धि नो हृदि पिता नो ऽसि मम तन् मा मा हिंसीः
text_mt: O Soma, take delight in our heart; you are our father, mine; therefore do not harm me.

sanskrit_iast: soma gīrbhiṣ ṭvā vayaṃ vardhayāmo vācovidaḥ sumṛḍīko na ā viśa
meaning: सोम गीर्भिष् ट्वा वयं वर्धयामो वाचोविदः सुमृडीको न आ विश
text_mt: O Soma, with songs we strengthen you, finders of speech; being very gracious, enter into us.

sanskrit_iast: ā pyāyasva sam etu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṃgathe
meaning: आ प्यायस्व सम् एतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् | भवा वाजस्य संगथे
text_mt: Swell up, may your virile power assemble from all sides, O Soma; / be [present] in the gathering of the prize.

sanskrit_iast: avamais ta ūrdhvais te kāvyais te pitṛbhir bhakṣitasya madhumato nārāśaṃsasya sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
meaning: अवमैस् त ऊर्ध्वैस् ते काव्यैस् ते पितृभिर् भक्षितस्य मधुमतो नाराशंसस्य सर्वगणस्य सर्वगण उपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि
text_mt: Consumed by your lowest, by your highest, by your poet-fathers, sweet, belonging to Narāśaṁsa, having the whole troop, invited, with the whole troop I consume of you who are invited.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣāyai varṇena tapaso rūpeṇa manaso mahimnā vāco vibhūtyā prajāpatis tvā yunaktu prajābhyo 'pānāya
meaning: दीक्षायै वर्णेन तपसो रूपेण मनसो महिम्ना वाचो विभूत्या प्रजापतिस् त्वा युनक्तु प्रजाभ्यो ऽपानाय
text_mt: By the color of consecration, by the form of ascetic heat, by the greatness of the mind, by the power of speech, may Prajāpati yoke you for offspring, for the out-breath.

sanskrit_iast: vāyur yunaktu manasā stomaṃ yajñāya voḍhave dadhātv indra indriyaṃ satyāḥ kāmā yajamānasya santu
meaning: वायुर् युनक्तु मनसा स्तोमं यज्ञाय वोढवे दधात्व् इन्द्र इन्द्रियं सत्याः कामा यजमानस्य सन्तु
text_mt: May Vāyu yoke the stoma with the mind to carry the sacrifice; may Indra bestow virile power; may the desires of the sacrificer be true.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣako 'si triṣṭupchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃ pārayā mā stotrasya stotraṃ gamyād indravanto vanemahi bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam
meaning: वृषको ऽसि त्रिष्टुप्छन्दा अनु त्वा रभे स्वस्ति मा सं पारया मा स्तोत्रस्य स्तोत्रं गम्याद् इन्द्रवन्तो वनेमहि भक्षीमहि प्रजाम् इषम्
text_mt: You are a vigorous bull, having the triṣṭubh metre; I take hold of you; take me safely across; may the chant of praise go to the chant of praise; having Indra, may we win, may we enjoy offspring and nourishment.

sanskrit_iast: indav indrapītasya ta indriyāvato triṣṭupchandasaḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
meaning: इन्दव् इन्द्रपीतस्य त इन्द्रियावतो त्रिष्टुप्छन्दसः सर्वगणस्य सर्वगण उपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि
text_mt: O drop, drunk by Indra, full of power, having the triṣṭubh metre, possessing the whole troop, invited, with the whole troop I consume of you who are invited.

sanskrit_iast: sūryo yunaktu vācā stomaṃ yajñāya voḍhave dadhātv indra indriyaṃ satyāḥ kāmā yajamānasya santu
meaning: सूर्यो युनक्तु वाचा स्तोमं यज्ञाय वोढवे दधात्व् इन्द्र इन्द्रियं सत्याः कामा यजमानस्य सन्तु
text_mt: May the sun yoke the stoma with speech to carry the sacrifice; may Indra bestow virile power; may the desires of the sacrificer be true.

sanskrit_iast: svaro 'si gayo 'si jagacchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃ pārayā mā stotrasya stotraṃ gamyād indravanto vanemahi bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam
meaning: स्वरो ऽसि गयो ऽसि जगच्छन्दा अनु त्वा रभे स्वस्ति मा सं पारया मा स्तोत्रस्य स्तोत्रं गम्याद् इन्द्रवन्तो वनेमहि भक्षीमहि प्रजाम् इषम्
text_mt: You are sound, you are wealth, having the jagatī metre; I take hold of you; take me safely across; may the chant of praise go to the chant of praise; having Indra, may we win, may we enjoy offspring and nourishment.

sanskrit_iast: indav indrapītasya ta indriyāvato triṣṭupchandasaḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
meaning: इन्दव् इन्द्रपीतस्य त इन्द्रियावतो त्रिष्टुप्छन्दसः सर्वगणस्य सर्वगण उपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि
text_mt: O drop, drunk by Indra, full of power, having the triṣṭubh metre, possessing the whole troop, invited, with the whole troop I consume of you who are invited.

sanskrit_iast: āyur me prāṇo mano 'si me prāṇa āyupatnyām ṛci yan me mano yamaṃ gataṃ yad vā me aparāgataṃ rājñā somena tad vayaṃ punar asmāsu dadhnasi
meaning: आयुर् मे प्राणो मनो ऽसि मे प्राण आयुपत्न्याम् ऋचि यन् मे मनो यमं गतं यद् वा मे अपरागतं राज्ञा सोमेन तद् वयं पुनर् अस्मासु दध्नसि
text_mt: Life is my breath; mind are you, my breath; in the life-protecting verse, what mind of mine has gone to Yama, or what of mine has departed, that we place back in ourselves through King Soma.

sanskrit_iast: yan me yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ mano jagāma dūragās tan ma āvartayā punar jīvātave na martave 'tho ariṣṭatātaye
meaning: यन् मे यमं वैवस्वतं मनो जगाम दूरगास् तन् म आवर्तया पुनर् जीवातवे न मर्तवे ऽथो अरिष्टतातये
text_mt: What mind of mine has gone far away to Yama, son of Vivasvat, turn that back to me, so that I may live and not die, and for security from harm.

sanskrit_iast: yenāhy ājim ajayad vicakṣya yena śyenaṃ śakunaṃ suparṇaṃ yad āhuś cakṣur aditāv anantaṃ somo nṛcakṣā mayi tad dadhātu
meaning: येनाह्य् आजिम् अजयद् विचक्ष्य येन श्येनं शकुनं सुपर्णं यद् आहुश् चक्षुर् अदिताव् अनन्तं सोमो नृचक्षा मयि तद् दधातु
text_mt: By which [eye] having seen he won the race, by which [eye] the hawk, the well-winged bird [sees], what endless eye they speak of in Aditi, may Soma, who watches men, place that in me.

sanskrit_iast: aindraṃ saho 'sarji tasya ta indav indrapītasyendriyāvato 'nuṣṭupchandaso harivataḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
meaning: ऐन्द्रं सहो ऽसर्जि तस्य त इन्दव् इन्द्रपीतस्येन्द्रियावतो ऽनुष्टुप्छन्दसो हरिवतः सर्वगणस्य सर्वगण उपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि
text_mt: Indra's power has been released. Of thee, O drop, drunk by Indra, endowed with vital power, having the anuṣṭubh metre, accompanied by the bays, together with thy whole host, summoned together with my whole host, I consume.

sanskrit_iast: indav indrapītasya ta indriyāvato 'nuṣṭupchandasaḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
meaning: इन्दव् इन्द्रपीतस्य त इन्द्रियावतो ऽनुष्टुप्छन्दसः सर्वगणस्य सर्वगण उपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि
text_mt: O drop, of thee, drunk by Indra, endowed with vital power, having the anuṣṭubh metre, together with thy whole host, summoned together with my whole host, I consume.

sanskrit_iast: stutasya stutam asy ūrjasvat payasvad ā mā stotrasya strotraṃ gamyād indravanto vanemahi bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam
meaning: स्तुतस्य स्तुतम् अस्य् ऊर्जस्वत् पयस्वद् आ मा स्तोत्रस्य स्त्रोत्रं गम्याद् इन्द्रवन्तो वनेमहि भक्षीमहि प्रजाम् इषम्
text_mt: Thou art the praised of what is praised, full of vigor, full of sap. May the chant of praise come to me. Possessed of Indra may we win, may we partake of offspring and nourishment.

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭayajuṣas te deva soma stutastomasya śastokthasya tirohnyasya yo 'śvasanir gosanir bhakṣas tasyopahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
meaning: इष्टयजुषस् ते देव सोम स्तुतस्तोमस्य शस्तोक्थस्य तिरोह्न्यस्य यो ऽश्वसनिर् गोसनिर् भक्षस् तस्योपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि
text_mt: Of thee, O divine Soma, whose yajus has been offered, whose stoma has been chanted, whose śastra has been recited, who art of yesterday, the portion which wins horses and cattle, summoned of that [portion], I consume.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtasya tvā deva stomapade viṣṇor dhāmāni vi muñcāmy etat tvaṃ deva stomān avakaram agann aśīmahi vayaṃ pratiṣṭhām
meaning: ऋतस्य त्वा देव स्तोमपदे विष्णोर् धामानि वि मुञ्चाम्य् एतत् त्वं देव स्तोमान् अवकरम् अगन्न् अशीमहि वयं प्रतिष्ठाम्
text_mt: On the step of the stoma of cosmic order, O god, I unloose the abodes of Viṣṇu. Thou, O god, hast reached the litter of the stomas; may we attain a firm support.

sanskrit_iast: somehānu mehi soma saha sadasa indriyeṇa
meaning: सोमेहानु मेहि सोम सह सदस इन्द्रियेण
text_mt: O Soma, follow me here; O Soma, together with the vital power of the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: subhūr asi śreṣṭho raśmir devānāṃ saṃsad devānāṃ yātur yayā tanvā brahma jinvasi tayā mā jinva tayā mā janaya prakāśaṃ mā kuru
meaning: सुभूर् असि श्रेष्ठो रश्मिर् देवानां संसद् देवानां यातुर् यया तन्वा ब्रह्म जिन्वसि तया मा जिन्व तया मा जनय प्रकाशं मा कुरु
text_mt: Thou art well-existent, the best beam of the gods, the assembly of the gods, the invader. With that body wherewith thou quickenest the sacred word, quicken me; with that bring me forth; make me conspicuous.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ puṣpam asy oṣadhīnāṃ rasa indrasya priyatamaṃ haviḥ svāhā
meaning: अपां पुष्पम् अस्य् ओषधीनां रस इन्द्रस्य प्रियतमं हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: Thou art the flower of the waters, the sap of the plants, the oblation dearest to Indra, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: hāriyojanasya te deva someṣṭayajuṣaḥ stutastomasya śastokthasya yo 'śvasanir gosanir bhakṣas tasyopahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
meaning: हारियोजनस्य ते देव सोमेष्टयजुषः स्तुतस्तोमस्य शस्तोक्थस्य यो ऽश्वसनिर् गोसनिर् भक्षस् तस्योपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि
text_mt: Of thee, O divine Soma, belonging to the Hāriyojana [graha], whose yajus has been offered, whose stoma has been chanted, whose śastra has been recited, the portion which wins horses and cattle, summoned of that [portion], I consume.

sanskrit_iast: devakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi pitṛkṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi manuṣyakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asy asmatkṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi yad divā ca naktaṃ cainaś cakṛma tasyāvayajanam asi yat svapantaś ca jāgrataś cainaś cakṛma tasyāvayajanam asi yad vidvāṃsaś cāvidvāṃsaś cainaś cakṛma tasyāvayajanam asy enasa enasāvayajanam asi
meaning: देवकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि पितृकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि मनुष्यकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् अस्य् अस्मत्कृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि यद् दिवा च नक्तं चैनश् चकृम तस्यावयजनम् असि यत् स्वपन्तश् च जाग्रतश् चैनश् चकृम तस्यावयजनम् असि यद् विद्वांसश् चाविद्वांसश् चैनश् चकृम तस्यावयजनम् अस्य् एनस एनसावयजनम् असि
text_mt: Thou art the expiation of sin committed against the gods; thou art the expiation of sin committed against the fathers; thou art the expiation of sin committed against men; thou art the expiation of sin committed by ourselves; what sin we have committed by day and by night, of that thou art the expiation; what sin we have committed sleeping and waking, of that thou art the expiation; what sin we have committed knowing and unknowing, of that thou art the expiation; of sin after sin thou art the expiation.

sanskrit_iast: apsu ghautasya te deva soma nṛbhiḥ sutasya
meaning: अप्सु घौतस्य ते देव सोम नृभिः सुतस्य
text_mt: Of thee, washed in the waters, O divine Soma, pressed by men,

sanskrit_iast: madhumantaṃ bhakṣaṃ karomi
meaning: मधुमन्तं भक्षं करोमि
text_mt: I make a sweet draught.

sanskrit_iast: sam adbhya oṣadhībhyaḥ
meaning: सम् अद्भ्य ओषधीभ्यः
text_mt: Together from waters, from plants,

sanskrit_iast: kāmakāmaṃ ma ā vartaya
meaning: कामकामं म आ वर्तय

sanskrit_iast: ūrg asy ūrjam mayi dhehi
meaning: ऊर्ग् अस्य् ऊर्जम् मयि धेहि
text_mt: Thou art vigor; place vigor in me.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇa somapīthe me jāgṛhi
meaning: प्राण सोमपीथे मे जागृहि
text_mt: O breath, watch over me at the Soma-drinking.

sanskrit_iast: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇor aśvasya vājinaḥ | surabhi no mukhā karat pra na āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
meaning: दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषं जिष्णोर् अश्वस्य वाजिनः | सुरभि नो मुखा करत् प्र न आयूंषि तारिषत्
text_mt: I have commemorated Dadhikravan, the victorious, swift courser; / may he make our mouths fragrant, may he prolong our spans of life.

sanskrit_iast: aśvo 'sy atyo 'si mayo 'si hayo 'si vājy asi saptir arvāg si vṛṣāsi
meaning: अश्वो ऽस्य् अत्यो ऽसि मयो ऽसि हयो ऽसि वाज्य् असि सप्तिर् अर्वाग् सि वृषासि
text_mt: Thou art a horse, thou art a courser, thou art pleasure, thou art a steed, thou art a racer, thou art a swift runner, thou art an impetuous steed, thou art a stallion.

sanskrit_iast: ādityānāṃ patmānv ihi namas te 'stu mā mā hiṃsīḥ
meaning: आदित्यानां पत्मान्व् इहि नमस् ते ऽस्तु मा मा हिंसीः
text_mt: Follow the course of the Ādityas. Homage be to thee; do not injure me.

sanskrit_iast: vāyoṣ ṭvā tejasā prati gṛhṇāmi nakṣatrāṇāṃ tvāṃ rūpeṇa prati gṛhṇāmi sūryasya tvā varcasā prati gṛhṇāmi
meaning: वायोष् ट्वा तेजसा प्रति गृह्णामि नक्षत्राणां त्वां रूपेण प्रति गृह्णामि सूर्यस्य त्वा वर्चसा प्रति गृह्णामि
text_mt: I accept thee with the fiery energy of Vāyu; I accept thee with the form of the constellations; I accept thee with the splendor of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: rathantaram asi vāmadevyam asi bṛhad asi
meaning: रथन्तरम् असि वामदेव्यम् असि बृहद् असि
text_mt: Thou art Rathantara, thou art Vāmadevya, thou art Bṛhat.

sanskrit_iast: aṅkānyaṅkū abhito rathaṃ yau dhvāntaṃ vātāgram abhisaṃcaratau dūre hetir indriyavān patatrī te no 'gnayaḥ paprayaḥ pārayantu
meaning: अङ्कान्यङ्कू अभितो रथं यौ ध्वान्तं वाताग्रम् अभिसंचरतौ दूरे हेतिर् इन्द्रियवान् पतत्री ते नो ऽग्नयः पप्रयः पारयन्तु
text_mt: The two curved [parts of the yoke] on both sides of the chariot, which traverse the darkness, the tip of the wind; whose missile is far off, endowed with vital power, winged—may those fires, furthering us, carry us across.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaraḥ pratnathā nākam ā ruha divaḥ pṛṣṭhe mandamānaḥ sumanmabhiḥ sapūrvavaj jantave dhanāḥ samānam ayman pary eti jāgṛviḥ
meaning: वैश्वानरः प्रत्नथा नाकम् आ रुह दिवः पृष्ठे मन्दमानः सुमन्मभिः सपूर्ववज् जन्तवे धनाः समानम् अय्मन् पर्य् एति जागृविः
text_mt: Vaiśvānara has mounted the firmament as of old, exulting on the back of heaven together with those of good thoughts; as of old, giving wealth to the creature, watchful he goes around the common path.

sanskrit_iast: gidaiṣa te ratha eṣa vām aśvinā ratho 'riṣṭo viśvabheṣajaḥ
meaning: गिदैष ते रथ एष वाम् अश्विना रथो ऽरिष्टो विश्वभेषजः
text_mt: […] this is your chariot; this chariot of you two, O Aśvins, is unharmed, having all remedies.

sanskrit_iast: kṛśāno savyān ā yaccha
meaning: कृशानो सव्यान् आ यच्छ

sanskrit_iast: dāsāno dakṣiṇān ava gṛhāṇa
meaning: दासानो दक्षिणान् अव गृहाण
text_mt: O Dāsānu, hold back the right [horses].

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prati gṛhṇāmi
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां प्रति गृह्णामि
text_mt: At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I accept thee.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe varuṇāyāśvaṃ tenāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
meaning: वरुणस् त्वा नयतु देवि दक्षिणे वरुणायाश्वं तेनामृतत्वम् अशीय वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे
text_mt: May Varuṇa lead thee, O divine sacrificial gift, as a horse to Varuṇa; through that may I attain immortality. May there be life-vigor to the giver, joy to me the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe rudrāya gāṃ tayāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
meaning: वरुणस् त्वा नयतु देवि दक्षिणे रुद्राय गां तयामृतत्वम् अशीय वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे
text_mt: May Varuṇa lead thee, O divine sacrificial gift, as a cow to Rudra; through that may I attain immortality. May there be life-vigor to the giver, joy to me the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe 'gnaye 'jam
meaning: वरुणस् त्वा नयतु देवि दक्षिणे ऽग्नये ऽजम्
text_mt: May Varuṇa lead thee, O divine sacrificial gift, as a he-goat to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye hiraṇyam
meaning: अग्नये हिरण्यम्

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomābhyām ajān mayāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
meaning: अग्नीषोमाभ्याम् अजान् मयामृतत्वम् अशीय वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे
text_mt: [...] he-goats to Agni and Soma; through that may I attain immortality. May there be life-vigor to the giver, joy to me the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: annasyānnapatiḥ prādād anamīvasya śuṣmiṇo namo viśvajanasya kṣāmāya bhuñjati mā mā hiṃsīḥ
meaning: अन्नस्यान्नपतिः प्रादाद् अनमीवस्य शुष्मिणो नमो विश्वजनस्य क्षामाय भुञ्जति मा मा हिंसीः
text_mt: The lord of food has given of the food, disease-free and vigorous. Homage to the earth belonging to all people; enjoying, do not injure me.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe tvaṣṭre 'viṃ tayāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
meaning: वरुणस् त्वा नयतु देवि दक्षिणे त्वष्ट्रे ऽविं तयामृतत्वम् अशीय वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे
text_mt: May Varuṇa lead thee, O divine sacrificial gift, as a sheep to Tvaṣṭṛ; through that may I attain immortality. May there be life-vigor to the giver, joy to me the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: gnās tvā 'kṛntann apaso 'tanvata vayitryo 'vayan
meaning: ग्नास् त्वा ऽकृन्तन्न् अपसो ऽतन्वत वयित्र्यो ऽवयन्
text_mt: The divine wives cut thee out, the active women stretched [thee], the weavers wove [thee].

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe bṛhaspataye vāsas tenāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigṛhītre
meaning: वरुणस् त्वा नयतु देवि दक्षिणे बृहस्पतये वासस् तेनामृतत्वम् अशीय वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यं प्रतिगृहीत्रे
text_mt: May Varuṇa lead thee, O divine sacrificial gift, as a garment to Bṛhaspati; through that may I attain immortality. May there be life-vigor to the giver, joy to me the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe uttānāyāṅgirasāyāprāṇat tenāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
meaning: वरुणस् त्वा नयतु देवि दक्षिणे उत्तानायाङ्गिरसायाप्राणत् तेनामृतत्वम् अशीय वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे
text_mt: May Varuṇa lead thee, O divine sacrificial gift, as an inanimate object to Uttāna Āṅgirasa; through that may I attain immortality. May there be life-vigor to the giver, joy to me the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe pūṣṇa uṣṭram
meaning: वरुणस् त्वा नयतु देवि दक्षिणे पूष्ण उष्ट्रम्
text_mt: May Varuṇa lead thee, O divine sacrificial gift, as a camel to Pūṣan.

sanskrit_iast: vāyave mṛgaṃ tenāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
meaning: वायवे मृगं तेनामृतत्वम् अशीय वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे
text_mt: [...] as a wild animal to Vāyu; through that may I attain immortality. May there be life-vigor to the giver, joy to me the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: jāpataye hastinaṃ prajāpataye varāhaṃ prajāpataye vrīhiyavāṃs tair amṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
meaning: जापतये हस्तिनं प्रजापतये वराहं प्रजापतये व्रीहियवांस् तैर् अमृतत्वम् अशीय वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे
text_mt: [...] as an elephant to Prajāpati, as a boar to Prajāpati, as rice and barley to Prajāpati; through them may I attain immortality. May there be life-vigor to the giver, joy to me the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe kṣetrapataye tilamāṣās tair amṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
meaning: वरुणस् त्वा नयतु देवि दक्षिणे क्षेत्रपतये तिलमाषास् तैर् अमृतत्वम् अशीय वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे
text_mt: May Varuṇa lead thee, O divine sacrificial gift, as sesame and beans to the Lord of the Field; through them may I attain immortality. May there be life-vigor to the giver, joy to me the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe savitre 'śvataraṃ vāśvatarīṃ vā tayāmṛtatvam aśīya vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
meaning: वरुणस् त्वा नयतु देवि दक्षिणे सवित्रे ऽश्वतरं वाश्वतरीं वा तयामृतत्वम् अशीय वयो दात्रे भूयान् मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे
text_mt: May Varuṇa lead thee, O divine sacrificial gift, as a male mule or a female mule to Savitṛ; through that may I attain immortality. May there be life-vigor to the giver, joy to me the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: ka idaṃ kasmā adāt kāmaḥ kāmāyādāt kāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigrahītā kāmaḥ samudram āviśat kāmena tvā prati gṛhṇāmi kāmaitat te
meaning: क इदं कस्मा अदात् कामः कामायादात् कामो दाता कामः प्रतिग्रहीता कामः समुद्रम् आविशत् कामेन त्वा प्रति गृह्णामि कामैतत् ते
text_mt: Who has given this to whom? Desire has given to Desire. Desire is the giver, Desire is the receiver. Desire has entered the ocean. With Desire I accept thee. O Desire, this is thine.

sanskrit_iast: raśmir asi kṣayāya tvā kṣayaṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: रश्मिर् असि क्षयाय त्वा क्षयं जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: Thou art a ray; for dwelling [I take] thee; quicken dwelling. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: pretir asi dharmaṇe tvā dharmaṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: प्रेतिर् असि धर्मणे त्वा धर्मं जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: Thou art progress; for order [I take] thee; quicken order. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: anvitir asi dive tvā divaṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: अन्वितिर् असि दिवे त्वा दिवं जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: Thou art sequence; for the sky [I take] thee; quicken the sky. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: saṃdhir asy antarikṣāya tvāntarikṣaṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: संधिर् अस्य् अन्तरिक्षाय त्वान्तरिक्षं जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: Thou art junction; for the intermediate space [I take] thee; quicken the intermediate space. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: pratidhir asi pṛthivyai tvā pṛthivīṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: प्रतिधिर् असि पृथिव्यै त्वा पृथिवीं जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: Thou art support; for the earth [I take] thee; quicken the earth. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṭambho 'si vṛṣṭyai tvā vṛṣṭiṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: विष्टम्भो ऽसि वृष्ट्यै त्वा वृष्टिं जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: Thou art prop; for rain [I take] thee; quicken rain. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: prāco 'sy ahne tvāhar jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: प्राचो ऽस्य् अह्ने त्वाहर् जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: Thou art forward-stretching; for day [I take] thee; quicken the day. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: anvāsi rātryai rātriṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: अन्वासि रात्र्यै रात्रिं जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: Thou art continuous; for night [I take] thee; quicken the night. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: uśig asi vasubhyas tvā vasūn jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: उशिग् असि वसुभ्यस् त्वा वसून् जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: Thou art willing; for the Vasus [I take] thee; quicken the Vasus. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: praketo 'si rudrebhyas tvā rudrān jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: प्रकेतो ऽसि रुद्रेभ्यस् त्वा रुद्रान् जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are the forewarning; for the Rudras [I take] you; invigorate the Rudras! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: sudītir asy ādityebhyas tvādityān jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: सुदीतिर् अस्य् आदित्येभ्यस् त्वादित्यान् जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are bright radiance; for the Ādityas [I take] you; invigorate the Ādityas! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: ojo 'si pitṛbhyas tvā pitṝn jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: ओजो ऽसि पितृभ्यस् त्वा पितॄन् जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are vigour; for the Fathers [I take] you; invigorate the Fathers! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: tantur asi prajābhyas tvā prajā jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: तन्तुर् असि प्रजाभ्यस् त्वा प्रजा जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are the thread; for offspring [I take] you; invigorate offspring! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: rodasy asy oṣadhībhyas tvauṣadhīr jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: रोदस्य् अस्य् ओषधीभ्यस् त्वौषधीर् जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are heaven and earth; for the plants [I take] you; invigorate the plants! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: pṛtanāṣāḍ asi paśubhyas tvā paśūn jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: पृतनाषाड् असि पशुभ्यस् त्वा पशून् जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are victorious in battle; for cattle [I take] you; invigorate cattle! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: abhijid asi yuktagrāvendrāya tvendraṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: अभिजिद् असि युक्तग्रावेन्द्राय त्वेन्द्रं जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are the conqueror; with pressing stones prepared, for Indra [I take] you; invigorate Indra! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: adhipatir asi prāṇāya tvā prāṇān jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: अधिपतिर् असि प्राणाय त्वा प्राणान् जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are the overlord; for the in-breath [I take] you; invigorate the out-breaths! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: dharuṇo 'sy apānāya tvāpānān jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: धरुणो ऽस्य् अपानाय त्वापानान् जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are the supporter; for the out-breath [I take] you; invigorate the out-breaths! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: saṃsarpo 'si cakṣuṣe tvā cakṣur jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: संसर्पो ऽसि चक्षुषे त्वा चक्षुर् जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are gliding forward; for sight [I take] you; invigorate sight! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: vayodhā asi kṣetrāya tvā kṣetraṃ jinva savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: वयोधा असि क्षेत्राय त्वा क्षेत्रं जिन्व सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are the bestower of strength; for the field [I take] you; invigorate the field! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd asi trivṛte tvā savṛd asi savṛte tvā pravṛd asi pravṛte tvānuvṛd asy anuvṛte tvā savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: त्रिवृद् असि त्रिवृते त्वा सवृद् असि सवृते त्वा प्रवृद् असि प्रवृते त्वानुवृद् अस्य् अनुवृते त्वा सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are the ninefold [stoma]; for the ninefold [stoma, I take] you. You are rolling along; for rolling along [I take] you. You are rolling forward; for rolling forward [I take] you. You are rolling after; for rolling after [I take] you. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: niroho 'si nirohāya tvā saṃroho 'si saṃrohāya tvā praroho 'si prarohāya tvānuroho 'sy anurohāya tvā savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: निरोहो ऽसि निरोहाय त्वा संरोहो ऽसि संरोहाय त्वा प्ररोहो ऽसि प्ररोहाय त्वानुरोहो ऽस्य् अनुरोहाय त्वा सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are climbing down; for climbing down [I take] you. You are climbing together; for climbing together [I take] you. You are growing forth; for growing forth [I take] you. You are climbing after; for climbing after [I take] you. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: vasuko 'si vasyaṣṭir asi veṣaśrīr asi savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: वसुको ऽसि वस्यष्टिर् असि वेषश्रीर् असि सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are rich in goods; you are the reaching of better fortune; you are splendor of dress. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: ākramo 'sy ākramāya tvā saṃkramo 'si saṃkramāya tvotkramo 'sy utkramāya tvotkrāntir asy utkrāntyai tvā savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta
meaning: आक्रमो ऽस्य् आक्रमाय त्वा संक्रमो ऽसि संक्रमाय त्वोत्क्रमो ऽस्य् उत्क्रमाय त्वोत्क्रान्तिर् अस्य् उत्क्रान्त्यै त्वा सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत
text_mt: "You are stepping toward; for stepping toward [I take] you. You are stepping together; for stepping together [I take] you. You are stepping upward; for stepping upward [I take] you. You are upward stepping; for upward stepping [I take] you. Impelled by Savitṛ, chant for Bṛhaspati!"

sanskrit_iast: tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa prathamayā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa madhyamayā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa uttamayodyatī trivṛto viṣṭutiḥ
meaning: तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स प्रथमया तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स मध्यमया तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स उत्तमयोद्यती त्रिवृतो विष्टुतिः
text_mt: He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; he [chants] with the first. He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; he [chants] with the middle one. He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; he [chants] with the last one. This is the rising-up form of the ninefold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: jyeṣṭho jyaiṣṭhineya stuvīta
meaning: ज्येष्ठो ज्यैष्ठिनेय स्तुवीत
text_mt: An eldest son born of the eldest wife should chant [with it].

sanskrit_iast: agrād agraṃ rohaty abhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāmantyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva
meaning: अग्राद् अग्रं रोहत्य् अभिक्रामन्ती विष्टुतिर् अभिक्रामन्त्या एवाभिक्रान्तेन हि यज्ञस्यर्ध्नोति तस्माद् एतया स्तोतव्यम् ऋद्ध्या एव
text_mt: He mounts from peak to peak. It is an advancing stoma-form, and through an advancing one [he mounts], for through an advance he succeeds in the sacrifice; therefore, one should chant with this one for success alone.

sanskrit_iast: pāpavasīyaso vidhṛtir vipāpmanā vartate ya etayā stute nāvagato 'pa rudhyate nāparuddho 'va gacchati | na śreyāṃsaṃ pāpīyān abhyā rohati na janatā janatām abhy eti nānyo 'nyasya prajā ā dadate yathākṣetraṃ kalpante | avarṣukas tu parjanyo bhavatīme hi lokās tṛcas tān hiṅkāreṇa vy eti
meaning: पापवसीयसो विधृतिर् विपाप्मना वर्तते य एतया स्तुते नावगतो ऽप रुध्यते नापरुद्धो ऽव गच्छति | न श्रेयांसं पापीयान् अभ्या रोहति न जनता जनताम् अभ्य् एति नान्यो ऽन्यस्य प्रजा आ ददते यथाक्षेत्रं कल्पन्ते | अवर्षुकस् तु पर्जन्यो भवतीमे हि लोकास् तृचस् तान् हिङ्कारेण व्य् एति
text_mt: It is a separation of the worse from the better; he who chants with this one turns away from evil. One who has returned is not expelled, nor does one who is expelled return. A worse [man] does not mount over a better; people do not encroach upon people; they do not take away one another's offspring; they stay properly placed according to their land. Parjanya, however, becomes non-raining, for these worlds are the triplet, and he separates them by the utterance of 'hiṅ'.

sanskrit_iast: eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā trivṛto viṣṭutiḥ prati tiṣṭhati ya etayā stute
meaning: एषा वै प्रतिष्ठिता त्रिवृतो विष्टुतिः प्रति तिष्ठति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: This indeed is the firmly established form of the ninefold stoma; he who chants with this one becomes firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhis tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhis tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhiḥ parivartinī triviṣṭutiḥ
meaning: तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पराचीभिस् तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पराचीभिस् तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पराचीभिः परिवर्तिनी त्रिविष्टुतिः
text_mt: He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; he [chants] with them straight forward. He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; he [chants] with them straight forward. He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; he [chants] with them straight forward. This is the revolving form of the ninefold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: praparīvartam āpnoti ya etayā stute saṃtatā viṣṭutiḥ prāṇo 'pāno vyānas ta ṛcas tān hiṅkāreṇa saṃ tanoti | sarvam āyur eti na purāyuṣaḥ pra mīyate ya etayā stute varṣukaḥ parjanyo bhavatīme hi lokās tṛcas tān hiṅkāreṇa saṃ dadhāti
meaning: प्रपरीवर्तम् आप्नोति य एतया स्तुते संतता विष्टुतिः प्राणो ऽपानो व्यानस् त ऋचस् तान् हिङ्कारेण सं तनोति | सर्वम् आयुर् एति न पुरायुषः प्र मीयते य एतया स्तुते वर्षुकः पर्जन्यो भवतीमे हि लोकास् तृचस् तान् हिङ्कारेण सं दधाति
text_mt: He who chants with this one attains continuous rotation. It is a continuous stoma-form. The in-breath, out-breath, and diffused breath—these are the verses; he connects them continuously by the utterance of 'hiṅ'. He attains full life; he does not die before his full lifespan, he who chants with this one. Parjanya becomes rain-bestowing, for these worlds are the triplet; he unites them by the utterance of 'hiṅ'.

sanskrit_iast: ślakṣṇeva tu vā īśvarā paśūn nirmṛjaḥ saiṣā ca parācota śreyān bhavaty uta yādṛṅ eva tādṛṅ net tu pāpīyān
meaning: श्लक्ष्णेव तु वा ईश्वरा पशून् निर्मृजः सैषा च पराचोत श्रेयान् भवत्य् उत यादृङ् एव तादृङ् नेत् तु पापीयान्
text_mt: Smooth, as it were, it is capable of wiping away cattle. And this one is straight forward; both he becomes better, and just as he is, so [he remains]; he does not become worse.

sanskrit_iast: tām etāṃ bhāllavaya upāsate tasmāt te pratigṛṇantaḥ parīvartān na cyavante
meaning: ताम् एतां भाल्लवय उपासते तस्मात् ते प्रतिगृणन्तः परीवर्तान् न च्यवन्ते
text_mt: This is the one which the Bhāllavis revere; therefore, when responding, they do not fall away from the recurring turns.

sanskrit_iast: tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhis tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti yā madhyamā sā prathamā yottamā sā madhyamā yā prathamā sottamā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti yottamā sā prathamā yā prathamā sā madhyamā yā madhyamā sottamā kulāyinī trivṛto viṣṭutiḥ
meaning: तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पराचीभिस् तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति या मध्यमा सा प्रथमा योत्तमा सा मध्यमा या प्रथमा सोत्तमा तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति योत्तमा सा प्रथमा या प्रथमा सा मध्यमा या मध्यमा सोत्तमा कुलायिनी त्रिवृतो विष्टुतिः
text_mt: He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; he [chants] with them straight forward. He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; that which is the middle is the first, that which is the last is the middle, that which is the first is the last. He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; that which is the last is the first, that which is the first is the middle, that which is the middle is the last. This is the nest-like form of the ninefold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: prajākāmo vā paśukāmo vā stuvīta vai kulānāyapaśavaḥ kulāyaṃ kulāyam eva bhavati
meaning: प्रजाकामो वा पशुकामो वा स्तुवीत वै कुलानायपशवः कुलायं कुलायम् एव भवति
text_mt: One who desires offspring or who desires cattle should chant [with it]. Cattle indeed are nest-like; nest upon nest comes into being.

sanskrit_iast: etām evānujāvarāya kuryād etāsām evāgraṃ pariyatīnāṃ prajānā agraṃ pary eti
meaning: एताम् एवानुजावराय कुर्याद् एतासाम् एवाग्रं परियतीनां प्रजाना अग्रं पर्य् एति
text_mt: For an after-born [son] he should use this very one; of these offspring who go around to the front, he goes around to the front.

sanskrit_iast: etām eva bahubhyo yajamānebhyaḥ kuryāt yat sarvā agriyā bhavanti sarvā madhye sarvā uttamāḥ sarvān evainān samāvadbhājaḥ karoti nānyo 'nyam apa ghnate sarve samāvadindriyā bhavanti
meaning: एताम् एव बहुभ्यो यजमानेभ्यः कुर्यात् यत् सर्वा अग्रिया भवन्ति सर्वा मध्ये सर्वा उत्तमाः सर्वान् एवैनान् समावद्भाजः करोति नान्यो ऽन्यम् अप घ्नते सर्वे समावदिन्द्रिया भवन्ति
text_mt: He should use this very one for many sacrificers. Since all [verses] become the foremost, all in the middle, and all the last, he makes all of these [sacrificers] share equally. They do not strike one another down; all become equal in power.

sanskrit_iast: varṣukaḥ parjanyo bhavatīme hi lokās tṛcas tān hiṅkāreṇa vyati ṣajati
meaning: वर्षुकः पर्जन्यो भवतीमे हि लोकास् तृचस् तान् हिङ्कारेण व्यति षजति
text_mt: Parjanya becomes rain-bestowing, for these worlds are the triplet; he interlinks them by the utterance of 'hiṅ'.

sanskrit_iast: pāpavasīyasaṃ tu bhavati
meaning: पापवसीयसं तु भवति
text_mt: There comes to be, however, a confusion of worse and better.

sanskrit_iast: adharottaram apāvagato rudhyateva gacchaty aparuddhaḥ pāpīyān śreyāṃsam abhyā rohati janatā janatām abhy ety anyo 'nyasya prajā ā dadate na yathākṣetraṃ kalpante
meaning: अधरोत्तरम् अपावगतो रुध्यतेव गच्छत्य् अपरुद्धः पापीयान् श्रेयांसम् अभ्या रोहति जनता जनताम् अभ्य् एत्य् अन्यो ऽन्यस्य प्रजा आ ददते न यथाक्षेत्रं कल्पन्ते
text_mt: An inversion [takes place]: one who has returned is expelled; one who was expelled returns; a worse [man] mounts over a better; people encroach upon people; they take away one another's offspring; they do not stay properly placed according to their land.

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa ekayā pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ pañcapañcinī pañcapañcadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ
meaning: पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकया स एकया पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स एकया पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स एकया स तिसृभिः पञ्चपञ्चिनी पञ्चपञ्चदशस्य विष्टुतिः
text_mt: He utters 'hiṅ' for five [verses]; he [chants] with three, with one, with one. He utters 'hiṅ' for five [verses]; he [chants] with one, with three, with one. He utters 'hiṅ' for five [verses]; he [chants] with one, with one, with three. This is the five-by-five form of the fifteenfold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: pāṅktaḥ puruṣaḥ pāṅktāt paśavas tayā puruṣaṃ ca paśūṃś cāpnoti vajro vai pancapaśo yat pañca pañca vyūhati vajram eva tad vy ūhati śāntyā eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā pañcadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ prati tiṣṭhati ya etayā stute
meaning: पाङ्क्तः पुरुषः पाङ्क्तात् पशवस् तया पुरुषं च पशूंश् चाप्नोति वज्रो वै पन्चपशो यत् पञ्च पञ्च व्यूहति वज्रम् एव तद् व्य् ऊहति शान्त्या एषा वै प्रतिष्ठिता पञ्चदशस्य विष्टुतिः प्रति तिष्ठति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: Man is fivefold; cattle are fivefold; through it, he attains both man and cattle. A thunderbolt indeed is the five-by-five; when he distributes them by fives, he distributes the thunderbolt for appeasement. This indeed is the firmly established form of the fifteenfold stoma; he who chants with this one becomes firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhiḥ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhis
meaning: पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकया तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पराचीभिः सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिस्
text_mt: He utters 'hiṅ' for five [verses]; he [chants] with three, with one. He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; he [chants] with them straight forward. He utters 'hiṅ' for seven [verses]; he [chants] with one, with three, with three.

sanskrit_iast: trīn stomān prativihitā brahmavarcasakāmaḥ stuvīta
meaning: त्रीन् स्तोमान् प्रतिविहिता ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः स्तुवीत
text_mt: One who desires brahminical lustre should chant [with this form], arranged corresponding to three stomas:

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhiḥ pañcadaśaṃ tisṛbhis trivṛtaṃ saptabhiḥ saptadaśam
meaning: पञ्चभिः पञ्चदशं तिसृभिस् त्रिवृतं सप्तभिः सप्तदशम्
text_mt: with five [verses, corresponding to] the fifteenfold stoma, with three to the ninefold stoma, with seven to the seventeenfold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: vīryaṃ vai stomā vīryam eva tad ekadhā samūhate brahmavarcasyāvaruddhyai tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati ya etayā stute
meaning: वीर्यं वै स्तोमा वीर्यम् एव तद् एकधा समूहते ब्रह्मवर्चस्यावरुद्ध्यै तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: The stomas are valour; he thus gathers valour into one place for the acquisition of brahminical lustre. Full of splendour and full of brahminical lustre becomes he who chants with this one.

sanskrit_iast: tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhiḥ pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir udyatī pañcadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ
meaning: तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पराचीभिः पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स एकया सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिर् उद्यती पञ्चदशस्य विष्टुतिः
text_mt: He utters 'hiṅ' for three [verses]; he [chants] with them straight forward. He utters 'hiṅ' for five [verses]; he [chants] with one, with three, with one. He utters 'hiṅ' for seven [verses]; he [chants] with one, with three, with three. This is the rising-up form of the fifteenfold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: etayā vai devāḥ svargaṃl lokam āyan svargakāmaḥ stuvīta svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: एतया वै देवाः स्वर्गंल् लोकम् आयन् स्वर्गकामः स्तुवीत स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: By this one, indeed, the gods went to the world of heaven. One who desires heaven should chant [with it] for the attainment of the world of heaven. Having chanted, he does not fall away from the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: abhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāmantyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva
meaning: अभिक्रामन्ती विष्टुतिर् अभिक्रामन्त्या एवाभिक्रान्तेन हि यज्ञस्यर्ध्नोति तस्माद् एतया स्तोतव्यम् ऋद्ध्या एव
text_mt: It is an advancing stoma-form, and through an advancing one [he mounts], for through an advance he succeeds in the sacrifice; therefore, one should chant with this one for success alone.

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa ekayā pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir daśasaptā saptadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ
meaning: पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकया स एकया पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स एकया सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिर् दशसप्ता सप्तदशस्य विष्टुतिः
text_mt: He utters the sound hiṅ for five [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with one, he with one. He utters the sound hiṅ for five [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with one. He utters the sound hiṅ for seven [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with three. [This is] the daśasaptā variety of the seventeenfold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: etayā vai devā asurān aty akrāmann ati pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ krāmati ya etayā stute
meaning: एतया वै देवा असुरान् अत्य् अक्रामन्न् अति पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं क्रामति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: By this [variety], indeed, the gods overcame the Asuras. He who chants with this overcomes the evil rival.

sanskrit_iast: abhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāmantyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva
meaning: अभिक्रामन्ती विष्टुतिर् अभिक्रामन्त्या एवाभिक्रान्तेन हि यज्ञस्यर्ध्नोति तस्माद् एतया स्तोतव्यम् ऋद्ध्या एव
text_mt: It is an advancing variety, for stepping forth; for through advancing one prospers in the sacrifice. Therefore one should chant with this, only for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: garbhiṇī viṣṭutiḥ pa prajayā pra paśubhir jāyate ya etayā stute
meaning: गर्भिणी विष्टुतिः प प्रजया प्र पशुभिर् जायते य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: It is a pregnant variety. He is propagated with offspring and with cattle, whoever chants with this.

sanskrit_iast: viḍ vai saptadaśas tasyā rājā garbho viśa eva tad rājānaṃ garbhaṃ karoti
meaning: विड् वै सप्तदशस् तस्या राजा गर्भो विश एव तद् राजानं गर्भं करोति
text_mt: The seventeenfold stoma is the people; the king is its embryo. He thereby makes the king the embryo of the people.

sanskrit_iast: nāvagato 'pa rudhyate nāparuddho 'va gacchati
meaning: नावगतो ऽप रुध्यते नापरुद्धो ऽव गच्छति
text_mt: The one who is in power is not expelled; the one who is expelled does not return to power.

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ vai saptadaśo yat sapta madhye bhavanti pañca pañcābhito 'nnam eva tan madhyato dhīyate 'naśanāyuko yajamāno bhavaty anaśanāyukāḥ prajāḥ
meaning: अन्नं वै सप्तदशो यत् सप्त मध्ये भवन्ति पञ्च पञ्चाभितो ऽन्नम् एव तन् मध्यतो धीयते ऽनशनायुको यजमानो भवत्य् अनशनायुकाः प्रजाः
text_mt: The seventeenfold stoma is food. In that there are seven in the middle and five on each side, food is thereby placed in the middle. The sacrificer becomes free from hunger, and his offspring become free from hunger.

sanskrit_iast: vairājo vai puruṣaḥ sapta grāmyāḥ paśavo yad daśapūrvā bhavanti saptottamā yajamānam eva tat paśuṣu prati ṣṭhāpayati
meaning: वैराजो वै पुरुषः सप्त ग्राम्याः पशवो यद् दशपूर्वा भवन्ति सप्तोत्तमा यजमानम् एव तत् पशुषु प्रति ष्ठापयति
text_mt: Man is connected with the virāj; there are seven domestic cattle. In that ten are first and seven are last, he thereby establishes the sacrificer among cattle.

sanskrit_iast: eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā saptadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ prati tiṣṭhati ya etayā stute
meaning: एषा वै प्रतिष्ठिता सप्तदशस्य विष्टुतिः प्रति तिष्ठति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: This is a firmly established variety of the seventeenfold stoma. He who chants with this becomes firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa eva vyūhaḥ saptaikamadhyā
meaning: एष एव व्यूहः सप्तैकमध्या
text_mt: This is the arrangement: seven [verses], one [in the] middle.

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇo vā āyatanaṃ prathamā kṣatrasya madhyamā viśa uttamā yat prathamā bhūyiṣṭhā bhājayati brahmaṇy eva tad ojo vīryaṃ dadhāti brahmaṇa eva tat kṣatraṃ ca viśaṃ cānuge karoti kṣatrasyāsya prakāśo bhavati ya etayā stute
meaning: ब्रह्मणो वा आयतनं प्रथमा क्षत्रस्य मध्यमा विश उत्तमा यत् प्रथमा भूयिष्ठा भाजयति ब्रह्मण्य् एव तद् ओजो वीर्यं दधाति ब्रह्मण एव तत् क्षत्रं च विशं चानुगे करोति क्षत्रस्यास्य प्रकाशो भवति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: The domain of the priesthood is the first [paryāya], of the nobility the middle, of the people the last. In that he makes the first [paryāya] share the most, he thereby places vigour and valour in the priesthood; he thereby makes nobility and the people follow the priesthood. He who chants with this becomes renowned for nobility.

sanskrit_iast: tām etāṃ trikharvā upāsate tasmāt te spardhamānā na vlīyante
meaning: ताम् एतां त्रिखर्वा उपासते तस्मात् ते स्पर्धमाना न व्लीयन्ते
text_mt: The Trikharvas attend upon this [variety]; therefore, though competing, they are not crushed.

sanskrit_iast: saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti parācībhiḥ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ saptāsthitā
meaning: सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स एकया तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति पराचीभिः सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः सप्तास्थिता
text_mt: He utters the sound hiṅ for seven [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with three, he with one. He utters the sound hiṅ for three [verses]: straight through. He utters the sound hiṅ for seven [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with three. [This is] the saptāsthitā [variety].

sanskrit_iast: bhrātṛvyaṃ stuvīta yathā saptāsthitena matyena samī karoty evaṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ pra rujati
meaning: भ्रातृव्यं स्तुवीत यथा सप्तास्थितेन मत्येन समी करोत्य् एवं पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं प्र रुजति
text_mt: One who has a rival should chant [with this]. Just as one makes [the field] even with a seven-fold roller, so does he crush the evil rival.

sanskrit_iast: etām eva bahubhyo yajamānebhyaḥ kuryād yaḥ prathamo hiṅkāraḥ sa prathamāyā yattāṃ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti tena sā sapta bhajate yat saptaiva madhye sapadyante tena sā sapta bhajate ya uttamo hiṅkāraḥ sa uttamayā yattāṃ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti tena sā sapta bhajate sarvān evainān samāvadbhājaḥ karoti nānyo 'nyam apa ghnate samāvadindriyā bhavanti
meaning: एताम् एव बहुभ्यो यजमानेभ्यः कुर्याद् यः प्रथमो हिङ्कारः स प्रथमाया यत्तां सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति तेन सा सप्त भजते यत् सप्तैव मध्ये सपद्यन्ते तेन सा सप्त भजते य उत्तमो हिङ्कारः स उत्तमया यत्तां सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति तेन सा सप्त भजते सर्वान् एवैनान् समावद्भाजः करोति नान्यो ऽन्यम् अप घ्नते समावदिन्द्रिया भवन्ति
text_mt: He should perform this very [variety] for many sacrificers. The first hiṅkāra is directed toward the first [paryāya]; he utters the sound hiṅ for seven, thereby it receives seven. In that seven are accomplished in the middle, thereby it receives seven. The last hiṅkāra is directed toward the last [paryāya]; he utters the sound hiṅ for seven, thereby it receives seven. He makes all of them have an equal share. They do not strike one another down; they become equal in vital power.

sanskrit_iast: tām etām abhipratāriṇa upāsate tasmāt ta ojiṣṭhāsvānām
meaning: ताम् एताम् अभिप्रतारिण उपासते तस्मात् त ओजिष्ठास्वानाम्
text_mt: The Abhipratārins attend upon this [variety]; therefore they are the most vigorous among their kin.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa eva vyūha ubhayaḥ saptaikamadhyā nirmadhyā
meaning: एष एव व्यूह उभयः सप्तैकमध्या निर्मध्या
text_mt: This is both arrangements: seven [verses] with one in the middle, and void of middle.

sanskrit_iast: ānujāvara stuvītāloko vā eṣa yad ānujāvaro yat saptaprathamāḥ saptottamās tisro madhye tryakṣaraḥ puruṣo lokam evāsmai tan madhyataḥ karoti tasmiṃl loke prati tiṣṭhati
meaning: आनुजावर स्तुवीतालोको वा एष यद् आनुजावरो यत् सप्तप्रथमाः सप्तोत्तमास् तिस्रो मध्ये त्र्यक्षरः पुरुषो लोकम् एवास्मै तन् मध्यतः करोति तस्मिंल् लोके प्रति तिष्ठति
text_mt: A successor-less person should chant [with this]. A successor-less person is indeed one without a world. In that there are seven first and seven last, and three in the middle—man is of three syllables—he thereby makes a world for him in the middle. He becomes firmly established in that world.

sanskrit_iast: etām eva prajākāmāya kuryān madhyato vā eṣa saṃrūḍho yaḥ prajāṃ na vindate lokam evāsmai taṃ madhyataḥ karoti taṃ lokaṃ prajayā ca paśubhiś cānu pra jāyate
meaning: एताम् एव प्रजाकामाय कुर्यान् मध्यतो वा एष संरूढो यः प्रजां न विन्दते लोकम् एवास्मै तं मध्यतः करोति तं लोकं प्रजया च पशुभिश् चानु प्र जायते
text_mt: He should perform this very [variety] for one who desires offspring. He who does not obtain offspring is grown over in the middle; he thereby makes a world for him in the middle. He propagates into that world with offspring and cattle.

sanskrit_iast: etām evāparuddharājanyāya kuryād viḍ vai saptadaśas tasyā rājā garbho viśa eva tad rājānaṃ nir hanty apāvagato 'pa rudhyate 'va gacchaty aparuddhaḥ
meaning: एताम् एवापरुद्धराजन्याय कुर्याद् विड् वै सप्तदशस् तस्या राजा गर्भो विश एव तद् राजानं निर् हन्त्य् अपावगतो ऽप रुध्यते ऽव गच्छत्य् अपरुद्धः
text_mt: He should perform this very [variety] for an expelled noble. The seventeenfold stoma is the people; the king is its embryo. He thereby drives out the king from the people. The one who is in power is expelled; the one who was expelled returns to power.

sanskrit_iast: etām evābhicaryamāṇāya kuryāt prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim eva madhyattaḥ pra viśanty astṛtyai
meaning: एताम् एवाभिचर्यमाणाय कुर्यात् प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजापतिम् एव मध्यत्तः प्र विशन्त्य् अस्तृत्यै
text_mt: He should perform this very [variety] for one who is being bewitched. Prajāpati is the seventeenfold stoma. They enter into Prajāpati from the middle, for invincibility.

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa ekayā tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhir navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ
meaning: पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकया स एकया तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पराचीभिर् नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः
text_mt: He utters the sound hiṅ for five [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with one, he with one. He utters the sound hiṅ for three [verses]: straight through. He utters the sound hiṅ for nine [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with three, he with three.

sanskrit_iast: caturastomān prativihitā brahmavarcasakāmāḥ stuvīta pañcabhiḥ pañcadaśaṃ tisṛbhis trivṛtaṃ navabhis triṇavaṃ svayaṃ saptadaśaḥ sampanno vīryaṃ vai stomā vīryam eva tad ekadhā samūhate brahmavarcasyāvaruddhyai tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati ya etayā stute
meaning: चतुरस्तोमान् प्रतिविहिता ब्रह्मवर्चसकामाः स्तुवीत पञ्चभिः पञ्चदशं तिसृभिस् त्रिवृतं नवभिस् त्रिणवं स्वयं सप्तदशः सम्पन्नो वीर्यं वै स्तोमा वीर्यम् एव तद् एकधा समूहते ब्रह्मवर्चस्यावरुद्ध्यै तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: Those who desire brahminical lustre should chant [with this variety], in which four stomas are arranged: with five the fifteenfold stoma, with three the ninefold stoma, with nine the twenty-seven-fold stoma; it is itself the seventeenfold stoma fulfilled. The stomas are valour; he thereby gathers valour together into one, for the acquisition of brahminical lustre. He who chants with this becomes full of splendour and endowed with brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhiḥ pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir udyatīsaptadaśasya viṣṭutiḥ
meaning: तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पराचीभिः पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स एकया नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिर् उद्यतीसप्तदशस्य विष्टुतिः
text_mt: He utters the sound hiṅ for three [verses]: straight through. He utters the sound hiṅ for five [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with one. He utters the sound hiṅ for nine [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with three, he with three. [This is] the ascending variety of the seventeenfold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: etayā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyan svargakāmaḥ stuvīta svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvāno 'bhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāntyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva
meaning: एतया वै देवाः स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् स्वर्गकामः स्तुवीत स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानो ऽभिक्रामन्ती विष्टुतिर् अभिक्रान्त्या एवाभिक्रान्तेन हि यज्ञस्यर्ध्नोति तस्माद् एतया स्तोतव्यम् ऋद्ध्या एव
text_mt: By this [variety], indeed, the gods went to the heavenly world. One who desires heaven should chant [with it], for the attainment of the heavenly world. Having chanted, he does not fall from the heavenly world. It is an advancing variety, for stepping forth; for through advancing one prospers in the sacrifice. Therefore one should chant with this, only for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa ekayā sa tisṛbhir bhastrāvācīnabilā
meaning: सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स एकया पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स एकया पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स एकया स तिसृभिर् भस्त्रावाचीनबिला
text_mt: He utters the sound hiṅ for seven [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with three, he with one. He utters the sound hiṅ for five [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with one. He utters the sound hiṅ for five [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with one, he with three. [This is] the bellows with its mouth turned downward.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dviṣyāt tasya kuryād yathāvācīnabilayā bhastrayā pradhūnuyād evaṃ yajamānasya paśūn pradhūnoty apakrāmantī viṣṭutis tayā yajamānasya paśavo 'pakrāmanti pāpīyān bhavati ya etayā stute
meaning: यं द्विष्यात् तस्य कुर्याद् यथावाचीनबिलया भस्त्रया प्रधूनुयाद् एवं यजमानस्य पशून् प्रधूनोत्य् अपक्रामन्ती विष्टुतिस् तया यजमानस्य पशवो ऽपक्रामन्ति पापीयान् भवति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: He should perform it for [the rival] whom he hates. Just as one would shake out with a bellows whose mouth is turned downward, so he shakes out the cattle of the sacrificer. It is a departing variety; by it the cattle of the sacrificer depart. He who chants with this becomes worse off.

sanskrit_iast: saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ saptasaptiny ekaviṃśasya viṣsṭutiḥ
meaning: सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स एकया सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकया स तिसृभिः सप्तसप्तिन्य् एकविंशस्य विष्स्टुतिः
text_mt: He utters the sound hiṅ for seven [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with three, he with one. He utters the sound hiṅ for seven [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with three. He utters the sound hiṅ for seven [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with one, he with three. [This is] the saptasaptinī variety of the twenty-one-fold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: sapta grāmyāḥ paśavas tān etayā spṛṇoti sapta śirasi prāṇāḥ prāṇā indriyāṇīndriyāṇy evaitayāpnoti
meaning: सप्त ग्राम्याः पशवस् तान् एतया स्पृणोति सप्त शिरसि प्राणाः प्राणा इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियाण्य् एवैतयाप्नोति
text_mt: There are seven domestic cattle: these he wins by this [variety]. There are seven vital breaths in the head; the vital breaths are the senses; the senses he indeed attains by this [variety].

sanskrit_iast: eṣā vai pratiṣthitaikaviṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute
meaning: एषा वै प्रतिष्थितैकविंशस्य विष्टुतिः प्रतितिष्ठति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: This is a firmly established variety of the twenty-one-fold stoma. He who chants with this becomes firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa ekayā saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir udyaty ekaviṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ
meaning: पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकया स एकया सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिर् नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिर् उद्यत्य् एकविंशस्य विष्टुतिः
text_mt: He utters the sound hiṅ for five [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with one, he with one. He utters the sound hiṅ for seven [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with three. He utters the sound hiṅ for nine [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with three, he with three. [This is] the ascending variety of the twenty-one-fold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: etayā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyan svargakāmaḥ stuvīta svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvāno 'bhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāntyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva
meaning: एतया वै देवाः स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् स्वर्गकामः स्तुवीत स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानो ऽभिक्रामन्ती विष्टुतिर् अभिक्रान्त्या एवाभिक्रान्तेन हि यज्ञस्यर्ध्नोति तस्माद् एतया स्तोतव्यम् ऋद्ध्या एव
text_mt: By this [variety], indeed, the gods went to the heavenly world. One who desires heaven should chant [with it], for the attainment of the heavenly world. Having chanted, he does not fall from the heavenly world. It is an advancing variety, for stepping forth; for through advancing one prospers in the sacrifice. Therefore one should chant with this, only for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: saiṣā trivṛt prāyaṇā trivṛd udayanā yat trivṛd bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati navaitā ekaviṃśasyottamā bhavanti prāṇā vai trivṛt prāṇān eva tad ubhayato dadhāti tasmād ayam ardhabhāgavāk prāṇa uttareṣāṃ prāṇānāṃ sarvam āyur eti na purāyuṣaḥ pramīyate ya etayā stute
meaning: सैषा त्रिवृत् प्रायणा त्रिवृद् उदयना यत् त्रिवृद् बहिष्पवमानं भवति नवैता एकविंशस्योत्तमा भवन्ति प्राणा वै त्रिवृत् प्राणान् एव तद् उभयतो दधाति तस्माद् अयम् अर्धभागवाक् प्राण उत्तरेषां प्राणानां सर्वम् आयुर् एति न पुरायुषः प्रमीयते य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: This same [viṣṭuti] has a ninefold stoma as beginning and a ninefold stoma as end. When the Bahiṣpavamāna is ninefold, these last nine [verses] are of the twenty-one-fold stoma. The breath-channels are indeed ninefold; thus he places the breath-channels at both ends. Therefore, this central breath-channel […] receives a half-share of the other breath-channels. He reaches a full life; he does not die before his full lifespan, who praises with this [viṣṭuti].

sanskrit_iast: tām etāṃ kradviṣa upāsate tasmāt te sarvam āyur yanti
meaning: ताम् एतां क्रद्विष उपासते तस्मात् ते सर्वम् आयुर् यन्ति
text_mt: This is what the Kradviṣas observe; therefore they reach a full life.

sanskrit_iast: navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ pañcabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ pratiṣṭutiḥ
meaning: नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः पञ्चभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स एकया सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकया स तिसृभिः प्रतिष्टुतिः
text_mt: He produces the sound hiṅ for nine [verses]: with three, with three, with three; he produces the sound hiṅ for five: with one, with three, with one; he produces the sound hiṅ for seven: with three, with one, with three. [This is] the Pratiṣṭuti.

sanskrit_iast: navabhis trivṛtaṃ pratiṣṭauti pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcadaśaṃ saptabhiḥ saptadaśaṃ svayam ekaviṃśaḥ saṃpannaḥ
meaning: नवभिस् त्रिवृतं प्रतिष्टौति पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः पञ्चदशं सप्तभिः सप्तदशं स्वयम् एकविंशः संपन्नः
text_mt: With nine, he responds to the ninefold stoma; with five [and] five, to the fifteenfold stoma; with seven [and seven], to the seventeenfold stoma. The twenty-one-fold stoma is fulfilled by itself.

sanskrit_iast: sa eva stomā yajñaṃ vahanti tān uttame stotre saṃtarpayati yathānaḍuho vāśvān vāśvatarān vohuṣaḥ saṃtarpayed evam etad uttame stotre stomān saṃtarpayati tṛpyati prajayā paśubhir ya etayā stute
meaning: स एव स्तोमा यज्ञं वहन्ति तान् उत्तमे स्तोत्रे संतर्पयति यथानडुहो वाश्वान् वाश्वतरान् वोहुषः संतर्पयेद् एवम् एतद् उत्तमे स्तोत्रे स्तोमान् संतर्पयति तृप्यति प्रजया पशुभिर् य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: It is the stomas that carry the sacrifice; he satisfies them in the highest chant of praise. Just as one would satisfy draft-oxen or horses or mules that have carried [a load], so he satisfies the stomas in the highest chant of praise. He who praises with this [viṣṭuti] becomes satisfied with offspring and cattle.

sanskrit_iast: etām eva purodhākāmāya kuryād brahma vai trivṛt kṣatram ekaviṃśo yat trivṛtaikaviṃśaṃ pratipadyate brahma tat kṣatrasya purastān nidadhāti gacchati purodhāṃ na purodhāyāś cyavate ya etayā stute
meaning: एताम् एव पुरोधाकामाय कुर्याद् ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् क्षत्रम् एकविंशो यत् त्रिवृतैकविंशं प्रतिपद्यते ब्रह्म तत् क्षत्रस्य पुरस्तान् निदधाति गच्छति पुरोधां न पुरोधायाश् च्यवते य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: He should perform this very [viṣṭuti] for one desirous of the domestic priesthood. The priesthood is the ninefold stoma, the nobility is the twenty-one-fold stoma; in that he begins the twenty-one-fold stoma with the ninefold, he places the priesthood in front of the nobility. He attains the domestic priesthood; he does not fall from the domestic priesthood, who praises with this [viṣṭuti].

sanskrit_iast: tām etāṃ prāvāhaṇya upāsate tasmāt te purodhāyā na cyavanta
meaning: ताम् एतां प्रावाहण्य उपासते तस्मात् ते पुरोधाया न च्यवन्त
text_mt: This is what the Prāvāhaṇyas observe; therefore they do not fall from the domestic priesthood.

sanskrit_iast: navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhis tisṛbhyo hiṅ karoti sa parācībhir navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sūrmy ubhayata ādīptā
meaning: नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिस् तिसृभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पराचीभिर् नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः सूर्म्य् उभयत आदीप्ता
text_mt: He produces the sound hiṅ for nine [verses]: with three, with three, with three; he produces the sound hiṅ for three: with straight-forward [verses]; he produces the sound hiṅ for nine: with three, with three, with three. [This is] the flaming tube, ignited at both ends.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavarcasakāmaḥ stuvīta tejo vai trivṛt tryakṣaraḥ puruṣo yat trivṛtāv abhito bhavatas tisro madhye yathā hi hiraṇyaṃ niṣṭaped evam enaṃ trivṛtau niṣṭapatas tejase brahmavarcasāya
meaning: ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः स्तुवीत तेजो वै त्रिवृत् त्र्यक्षरः पुरुषो यत् त्रिवृताव् अभितो भवतस् तिस्रो मध्ये यथा हि हिरण्यं निष्टपेद् एवम् एनं त्रिवृतौ निष्टपतस् तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसाय
text_mt: One desirous of brahminical lustre should praise with it. Splendour is the ninefold stoma; man consists of three syllables. Because two ninefold stomas are on both sides and three [verses] are in the middle, just as one would burn gold clean, so these two ninefold stomas burn him clean for splendour, for brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: apaśavy eva tu vā īśvarā paśūn nirdahaḥ kilāsattvān nūbhayamati hi niṣṭapataḥ
meaning: अपशव्य् एव तु वा ईश्वरा पशून् निर्दहः किलासत्त्वान् नूभयमति हि निष्टपतः
text_mt: However, it is not conducive to cattle; it is capable of burning up the cattle, because through the state of spots [from leprosy], as it were, the two [ends] burn him exceedingly.

sanskrit_iast: etām evābhiśasyamānāya kuryāc chamalaṃ vā etam ṛcchati yam aślīlā vāg ṛcchati yaivainam asāv aślīlaṃ vāg vadati tām asya trivṛtau niṣṭapatas tejasvī bhavati ya etayā stute
meaning: एताम् एवाभिशस्यमानाय कुर्याच् छमलं वा एतम् ऋच्छति यम् अश्लीला वाग् ऋच्छति यैवैनम् असाव् अश्लीलं वाग् वदति ताम् अस्य त्रिवृतौ निष्टपतस् तेजस्वी भवति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: He should perform this very [viṣṭuti] for one being defamed. Impurity indeed reaches him whom an ugly voice reaches. Whatever ugly voice speaks ill of him, that the two ninefold stomas burn clean from him. He becomes splendid, who praises with this [viṣṭuti].

sanskrit_iast: navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhiḥ sa ekayā navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhir navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa pañcabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
meaning: नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स पञ्चभिः स एकया नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स पञ्चभिर् नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पञ्चभिः स एकया स तिसृभिः
text_mt: He produces the sound hiṅ for nine [verses]: with three, with five, with one; he produces the sound hiṅ for nine: with one, with three, with five; he produces the sound hiṅ for nine: with five, with one, with three.

sanskrit_iast: vajro vai triṇavo vajram eva tad vyūhati śāntyai
meaning: वज्रो वै त्रिणवो वज्रम् एव तद् व्यूहति शान्त्यै
text_mt: The thrice-ninefold stoma is a thunderbolt; he thus distributes the thunderbolt for appeasement.

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhir vihitaikā paricarā pāṅktāḥ paśavo yajamānaḥ paricarā yat pañcabhir vidadhāty ekā paricarā bhavati yajamānam eva tat paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayaty eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā triṇavasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute
meaning: पञ्चभिर् विहितैका परिचरा पाङ्क्ताः पशवो यजमानः परिचरा यत् पञ्चभिर् विदधात्य् एका परिचरा भवति यजमानम् एव तत् पशुषु प्रतिष्ठापयत्य् एषा वै प्रतिष्ठिता त्रिणवस्य विष्टुतिः प्रतितिष्ठति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: One is arranged with five, one is an attendant verse. Cattle are fivefold; the sacrificer is the attendant verse. Because he arranges with five, there is one attendant verse: he thereby firmly establishes the sacrificer among cattle. This is indeed the firmly established viṣṭuti of the thrice-ninefold stoma. He who praises with this [viṣṭuti] becomes firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa pañcabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir udyatī triṇavasya viṣṭutiḥ
meaning: सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकया नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स पञ्चभिर् एकादशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पञ्चभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिर् उद्यती त्रिणवस्य विष्टुतिः
text_mt: He produces the sound hiṅ for seven [verses]: with three, with one; he produces the sound hiṅ for nine: with one, with three, with five; he produces the sound hiṅ for eleven: with five, with three, with three. [This is] the rising viṣṭuti of the thrice-ninefold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: etayā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyan svargakāmaḥ stuvīta svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvāno 'bhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāntyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva
meaning: एतया वै देवाः स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् स्वर्गकामः स्तुवीत स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानो ऽभिक्रामन्ती विष्टुतिर् अभिक्रान्त्या एवाभिक्रान्तेन हि यज्ञस्यर्ध्नोति तस्माद् एतया स्तोतव्यम् ऋद्ध्या एव
text_mt: By this, indeed, the gods went to the heavenly world. One desirous of heaven should praise [with it], for the attainment of the heavenly world. Having praised, he does not fall from the heavenly world. It is the advancing viṣṭuti, for advancing; for through what advances, one prospers in the sacrifice. Therefore one should praise with this, for prosperity alone.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa saptabhiḥ sa ekayaikādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa saptabhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa saptabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
meaning: एकादशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स सप्तभिः स एकयैकादशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स सप्तभिर् एकादशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स सप्तभिः स एकया स तिसृभिः
text_mt: He produces the sound hiṅ for eleven [verses]: with three, with seven, with one; he produces the sound hiṅ for eleven: with one, with three, with seven; he produces the sound hiṅ for eleven: with seven, with one, with three.

sanskrit_iast: anto vai trayastriṃśaḥ paramo vai trayastriṃśa stomānāṃ saptabhir vihitaikā paricarā sapta grāmyāḥ paśavo yajamānaḥ paricarā yat saptabhir vidadhāty ekā paricarā bhavati yajamānam eva tad antataḥ paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayaty eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā trayastriṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute
