meaning: अन्तो वै त्रयस्त्रिंशः परमो वै त्रयस्त्रिंश स्तोमानां सप्तभिर् विहितैका परिचरा सप्त ग्राम्याः पशवो यजमानः परिचरा यत् सप्तभिर् विदधात्य् एका परिचरा भवति यजमानम् एव तद् अन्ततः पशुषु प्रतिष्ठापयत्य् एषा वै प्रतिष्ठिता त्रयस्त्रिंशस्य विष्टुतिः प्रतितिष्ठति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: The thirty-three-fold stoma is the end; the thirty-three-fold stoma is the highest of the stomas. One is arranged with seven; there is one attendant verse. Domestic cattle are seven; the sacrificer is the attendant verse. Because he arranges with seven, there is one attendant verse: he thereby firmly establishes the sacrificer in the end among cattle. This is indeed the firmly established viṣṭuti of the thirty-three-fold stoma. He who praises with this [viṣṭuti] becomes firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhiḥ sa tisṛbhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa pañcabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir nedīyaḥsaṃkramā
meaning: एकादशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स पञ्चभिः स तिसृभिर् एकादशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स पञ्चभिर् एकादशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पञ्चभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिर् नेदीयःसंक्रमा
text_mt: He produces the sound hiṅ for eleven [verses]: with three, with five, with three; he produces the sound hiṅ for eleven: with three, with three, with five; he produces the sound hiṅ for eleven: with five, with three, with three. [This is] the viṣṭuti with steps closer together.

sanskrit_iast: anto vai trayastriṃśo yathā mahāvṛkṣasyāgraṃ sṛptvā nedīyaḥsaṃkramāt saṃkrāmaty evam etan nedīyaḥsaṃkramayā nedīyaḥsaṃkramāt saṃkrāmati
meaning: अन्तो वै त्रयस्त्रिंशो यथा महावृक्षस्याग्रं सृप्त्वा नेदीयःसंक्रमात् संक्रामत्य् एवम् एतन् नेदीयःसंक्रमया नेदीयःसंक्रमात् संक्रामति
text_mt: The thirty-three-fold stoma is the end. Just as one, having crawled to the top of a great tree, crosses over by steps that are closer together, so by this [viṣṭuti] which has steps closer together he crosses over by steps that are closer together.

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhir vihitās tisraḥ paricarāḥ pāṅktāḥ paśava etāvān puruṣo yadātmā prajā jāyā yat pañcabhir vidadhāti tisraḥ paricarā bhavanti yajamānam eva tat paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayati paśumān bhavati ya etayā stute
meaning: पञ्चभिर् विहितास् तिस्रः परिचराः पाङ्क्ताः पशव एतावान् पुरुषो यदात्मा प्रजा जाया यत् पञ्चभिर् विदधाति तिस्रः परिचरा भवन्ति यजमानम् एव तत् पशुषु प्रतिष्ठापयति पशुमान् भवति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: Three attendant verses are arranged with five. Cattle are fivefold; the person is of such an extent as himself, offspring, and wife. Because he arranges with five, there are three attendant verses: he thereby firmly establishes the sacrificer among cattle. He who praises with this [viṣṭuti] becomes rich in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhiḥ sa ekayaikādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa saptabhis trayodaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa saptabhiḥ sa tisṛbhir udyatī trayastriṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ
meaning: नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स पञ्चभिः स एकयैकादशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स सप्तभिस् त्रयोदशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स सप्तभिः स तिसृभिर् उद्यती त्रयस्त्रिंशस्य विष्टुतिः
text_mt: He produces the sound hiṅ for nine [verses]: with three, with five, with one; he produces the sound hiṅ for eleven: with one, with three, with seven; he produces the sound hiṅ for thirteen: with seven, with three, [with three]. [This is] the rising viṣṭuti of the thirty-three-fold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: etayā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyan svargakāmaḥ stuvīta svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvāno 'grād agraṃ rohaty abhikrāmantī viṣṭutir abhikrāntyā evābhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti tasmād etayā stotavyam ṛddhyā eva
meaning: एतया वै देवाः स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् स्वर्गकामः स्तुवीत स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानो ऽग्राद् अग्रं रोहत्य् अभिक्रामन्ती विष्टुतिर् अभिक्रान्त्या एवाभिक्रान्तेन हि यज्ञस्यर्ध्नोति तस्माद् एतया स्तोतव्यम् ऋद्ध्या एव
text_mt: By this, indeed, the gods went to the heavenly world. One desirous of heaven should praise [with it], for the attainment of the heavenly world. Having praised, he does not fall from the heavenly world; he climbs from peak to peak. It is the advancing viṣṭuti, for advancing; for through what advances, one prospers in the sacrifice. Therefore one should praise with this, for prosperity alone.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhiḥ sa pañcabhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa pañcabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir navabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ pratyavarohiṇītrayastriṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ
meaning: त्रयोदशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स पञ्चभिः स पञ्चभिर् एकादशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पञ्चभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिर् नवभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः प्रत्यवरोहिणीत्रयस्त्रिंशस्य विष्टुतिः
text_mt: He produces the sound hiṅ for thirteen [verses]: with three, with five, with five; he produces the sound hiṅ for eleven: with five, with three, with three; he produces the sound hiṅ for nine: with three, with three, with three. [This is] the descending viṣṭuti of the thirty-three-fold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: yathā mahāvṛkṣasyāgraṃ sṛptvā śākhāyāḥ śākhām ālambham upāvarohed evam etayemaṃ lokam upāvarohati pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: यथा महावृक्षस्याग्रं सृप्त्वा शाखायाः शाखाम् आलम्भम् उपावरोहेद् एवम् एतयेमं लोकम् उपावरोहति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: Just as one, having crawled to the top of a great tree, would climb down grasping branch by branch, so by this he climbs down to this world, for firm establishment.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtā praiti trivṛtodeti prāṇā vai trivṛt prāṇenaiva praiti prāṇam abhyudeti sarvam āyur eti na purāyuṣaḥ pramīyate ya etayā stute
meaning: त्रिवृता प्रैति त्रिवृतोदेति प्राणा वै त्रिवृत् प्राणेनैव प्रैति प्राणम् अभ्युदेति सर्वम् आयुर् एति न पुरायुषः प्रमीयते य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: He starts out with a ninefold stoma; he concludes with a ninefold stoma. The breath-channels are indeed ninefold; he starts out with breath, he concludes towards breath. He reaches a full life; he does not die before his full lifespan, who praises with this [viṣṭuti].

sanskrit_iast: tām etāṃ karadviṣa upāsate tasmāt te sarvam āyur yanti
meaning: ताम् एतां करद्विष उपासते तस्मात् ते सर्वम् आयुर् यन्ति
text_mt: This is what the Karadviṣas observe; therefore they reach a full life.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa pañcabhir ekādaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa pañcabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ saptabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
meaning: पञ्चदशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स पञ्चभिर् एकादशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स पञ्चभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः सप्तभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकया स तिसृभिः
text_mt: He utters the syllable hiṅ for fifteen [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with five; he utters the syllable hiṅ for eleven [verses]: he [chants] with five, he with three, he with three; he utters the syllable hiṅ for seven [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with one, he with three.

sanskrit_iast: yo vai trayastriṃśam ekaviṃśe pratiṣṭhitaṃ veda pratitiṣṭhati pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśaḥ stomānāṃ yad etāḥ sapta trayastriṃśasyottamā bhavanti saptavidhaikaviṃśasya viṣṭutir ekaviṃśa eva tat trayastriṃśaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute
meaning: यो वै त्रयस्त्रिंशम् एकविंशे प्रतिष्ठितं वेद प्रतितिष्ठति प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंशः स्तोमानां यद् एताः सप्त त्रयस्त्रिंशस्योत्तमा भवन्ति सप्तविधैकविंशस्य विष्टुतिर् एकविंश एव तत् त्रयस्त्रिंशं प्रतिष्ठापयति प्रतितिष्ठति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: He who knows the thirty-three-fold stoma established in the twenty-one-fold stoma gets a firm footing. The twenty-one-fold stoma is the firm footing of the stomas. Because these seven [verses] are the last of the thirty-three-fold stoma, and the form of the twenty-one-fold stoma consists of seven divisions, he thereby establishes the thirty-three-fold stoma in the twenty-one-fold stoma. He who praises with this [viṣṭuti] gets a firm footing.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭābhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa catasṛbhiḥ sa ekayāṣṭābhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa catasṛbhir aṣṭābhyo hiṅ karoti sa catasṛbhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
meaning: अष्टाभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स चतसृभिः स एकयाष्टाभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स चतसृभिर् अष्टाभ्यो हिङ् करोति स चतसृभिः स एकया स तिसृभिः
text_mt: He utters the syllable hiṅ for eight [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with four, he with one; he utters the syllable hiṅ for eight [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with four; he utters the syllable hiṅ for eight [verses]: he [chants] with four, he with one, he with three.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai chandogā yad aṣṭābhyo 'ṣṭābhyo hiṅ karoti aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavaḥ śaphaśas tat paśūn āpnoti
meaning: पशवो वै छन्दोगा यद् अष्टाभ्यो ऽष्टाभ्यो हिङ् करोति अष्टाशफाः पशवः शफशस् तत् पशून् आप्नोति
text_mt: Cattle indeed are [dear to] the Chandogas. In that he utters the syllable hiṅ for eight [verses] each time, cattle have eight hoofs; he thereby obtains cattle hoof by hoof.

sanskrit_iast: catasṛbhir vihitaikā paricarā catuṣpādāḥ paśavo yajamānaḥ paricarā yac catasṛbhir vidadhāty ekā paricarā bhavati yajamānam eva tat paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayaty eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā caturviṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute
meaning: चतसृभिर् विहितैका परिचरा चतुष्पादाः पशवो यजमानः परिचरा यच् चतसृभिर् विदधात्य् एका परिचरा भवति यजमानम् एव तत् पशुषु प्रतिष्ठापयत्य् एषा वै प्रतिष्ठिता चतुर्विंशस्य विष्टुतिः प्रतितिष्ठति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: It is arranged with four [verses]; one is a surplus [verse]. Cattle are four-footed; the sacrificer is the surplus one. In that he arranges [it] with four, [and] one is a surplus [verse], he thereby establishes the sacrificer among cattle. This indeed is the firmly established viṣṭuti of the twenty-four-fold stoma. He who praises with this [viṣṭuti] gets a firm footing.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā caturdaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa daśabhiḥ pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
meaning: पञ्चदशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकादशभिः स एकया चतुर्दशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स दशभिः पञ्चदशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकादशभिः स एकया स तिसृभिः
text_mt: He utters the syllable hiṅ for fifteen [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with eleven, he with one; he utters the syllable hiṅ for fourteen [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with ten; he utters the syllable hiṅ for fifteen [verses]: he [chants] with eleven, he with one, he with three.

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇo vā āyatanaṃ prathamā kṣatrasya madhyamā viśa uttamā yat pañcadaśinyau pūrve bhavataś caturdaśottamā brahmaṇi caiva tat kṣatre caujo vīryaṃ dadhāti brahmaṇe caiva tat kṣatrāya ca viśam anugāṃ karoti kṣatrasyevāsya prakāśo bhavati ya etayā stute
meaning: ब्रह्मणो वा आयतनं प्रथमा क्षत्रस्य मध्यमा विश उत्तमा यत् पञ्चदशिन्यौ पूर्वे भवतश् चतुर्दशोत्तमा ब्रह्मणि चैव तत् क्षत्रे चौजो वीर्यं दधाति ब्रह्मणे चैव तत् क्षत्राय च विशम् अनुगां करोति क्षत्रस्येवास्य प्रकाशो भवति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: The first [round] is the domain of the brahmin; the middle one of the kṣatra; the last one of the people. In that the first two consist of fifteen [verses] and the last of fourteen, he thereby places vigour and valour in the brahmin and in the kṣatra, and makes the people subordinate to the brahmin and to the kṣatra. Like the brilliance of a kṣatra is his brilliance who praises with this [viṣṭuti].

sanskrit_iast: astomā vā ete yac chandogā ayujo hi stomā yugmanti chandāṃsi yad eṣā yujinī catuścatvāriṃśasya viṣṭutis tenāstomāḥ
meaning: अस्तोमा वा एते यच् छन्दोगा अयुजो हि स्तोमा युग्मन्ति छन्दांसि यद् एषा युजिनी चतुश्चत्वारिंशस्य विष्टुतिस् तेनास्तोमाः
text_mt: These Chandogas are indeed without stoma, for the stomas are uneven-numbered, while the metres are even-numbered. In that this is an even-numbered viṣṭuti of the forty-four-fold stoma, thereby they are not without stoma.

sanskrit_iast: eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā catuścatvāriṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhait ya etayā stute
meaning: एषा वै प्रतिष्ठिता चतुश्चत्वारिंशस्य विष्टुतिः प्रतितिष्ठैत् य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: This indeed is the firmly established viṣṭuti of the forty-four-fold stoma. He who praises with this [viṣṭuti] gets a firm footing.

sanskrit_iast: caturdaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa daśabhiḥ sa ekayā pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekādaśabhiḥ pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhir nirmadhyā
meaning: चतुर्दशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स दशभिः स एकया पञ्चदशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स एकादशभिः पञ्चदशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकादशभिः स एकया स तिसृभिर् निर्मध्या
text_mt: He utters the syllable hiṅ for fourteen [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with ten, he with one; he utters the syllable hiṅ for fifteen [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with eleven; he utters the syllable hiṅ for fifteen [verses]: he [chants] with eleven, he with one, he with three. [This is] the hollow-middle [viṣṭuti].

sanskrit_iast: astīva vā ayaṃ loko 'stīvāsau chidram ivedam antarikṣaṃ yad eṣā nirmadhyā bhavatīmān eva lokān anu prajāyate pra prajayā pra paśubhir jāyate ya etayā stute
meaning: अस्तीव वा अयं लोको ऽस्तीवासौ छिद्रम् इवेदम् अन्तरिक्षं यद् एषा निर्मध्या भवतीमान् एव लोकान् अनु प्रजायते प्र प्रजया प्र पशुभिर् जायते य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: This world is, as it were, [solid]; that [world] is, as it were, [solid]; this intermediate region is, as it were, a gap. In that this [viṣṭuti] is hollow-middle, he is propagated after these worlds; he is propagated with offspring and with cattle, who praises with this [viṣṭuti].

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā pañcadaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa ekādaśabhiḥ caturdaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa daśabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
meaning: पञ्चदशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स एकादशभिः स एकया पञ्चदशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स एकादशभिः चतुर्दशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स दशभिः स एकया स तिसृभिः
text_mt: He utters the syllable hiṅ for fifteen [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with eleven, he with one; he utters the syllable hiṅ for fifteen [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with eleven; he utters the syllable hiṅ for fourteen [verses]: he [chants] with ten, he with one, he with three.

sanskrit_iast: ājyānāṃ prathamā pṛṣṭhānāṃ dvitīyokthānāṃ tṛtīyā
meaning: आज्यानां प्रथमा पृष्ठानां द्वितीयोक्थानां तृतीया
text_mt: The first [round belongs] to the ājyastotras, the second to the pṛṣṭhas, the third to the ukthastotras.

sanskrit_iast: yājyānāṃ sā hotur yā pṛṣṭhānāṃ sā maitrāvaruṇasya yokthānāṃ sā brāhmaṇācchaṃsino yaiva hotuḥ sācchāvākasya yā pṛṣṭhānāṃ sahotur yokthānāṃ sā maitrāvaruṇasya yājyānāṃ sā brāhmaṇācchaṃsino yaiva hotuḥ sācchāvākasya yokthānāṃ sā hotur yājyānāṃ sā maitrāvaruṇasya yā pṛṣṭhānāṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsino yaiva hotuḥ sācchāvākasya sarvā ājyeṣu sarvāḥ pṛṣtheṣu sarvā uktheṣu
meaning: याज्यानां सा होतुर् या पृष्ठानां सा मैत्रावरुणस्य योक्थानां सा ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनो यैव होतुः साच्छावाकस्य या पृष्ठानां सहोतुर् योक्थानां सा मैत्रावरुणस्य याज्यानां सा ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनो यैव होतुः साच्छावाकस्य योक्थानां सा होतुर् याज्यानां सा मैत्रावरुणस्य या पृष्ठानां ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनो यैव होतुः साच्छावाकस्य सर्वा आज्येषु सर्वाः पृष्थेषु सर्वा उक्थेषु
text_mt: That which belongs to the ājyastotras belongs to the hotṛ; that which belongs to the pṛṣṭhas to the maitrāvaruṇa; that which belongs to the ukthastotras to the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; that which belongs to the hotṛ belongs to the acchāvāka; that which belongs to the pṛṣṭhas belongs to the hotṛ; that which belongs to the ukthastotras to the maitrāvaruṇa; that which belongs to the ājyastotras to the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; that which belongs to the hotṛ belongs to the acchāvāka; that which belongs to the ukthastotras belongs to the hotṛ; that which belongs to the ājyastotras to the maitrāvaruṇa; that which belongs to the pṛṣṭhas to the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; that which belongs to the hotṛ belongs to the acchāvāka. All [rounds are applied] in the ājyastotras, all in the pṛṣṭhas, all in the ukthastotras.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai samīṣantī yad eṣā sarvāṇi savanāny anusaṃcaraty anusavanam evainaṃ paśubhiḥ samardhayati paśuman bhavati ya etayā stute
meaning: पशवो वै समीषन्ती यद् एषा सर्वाणि सवनान्य् अनुसंचरत्य् अनुसवनम् एवैनं पशुभिः समर्धयति पशुमन् भवति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: The cattle indeed are gliding along. In that this [viṣṭuti] moves through all the soma pressings, it prospers him with cattle at each soma pressing. He becomes rich in cattle who praises with this [viṣṭuti].

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa dvadaśabhiḥ sa ekayā ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ sa dvādaśabhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa dvādaśabhiḥ sa ekayā sa tisṛbhiḥ
meaning: षोडशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स द्वदशभिः स एकया षोडशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स एकया स तिसृभिः स द्वादशभिः षोडशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स द्वादशभिः स एकया स तिसृभिः
text_mt: He utters the syllable hiṅ for sixteen [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with twelve, he with one; he utters the syllable hiṅ for sixteen [verses]: he [chants] with one, he with three, he with twelve; he utters the syllable hiṅ for sixteen [verses]: he [chants] with twelve, he with one, he with three.

sanskrit_iast: anto vā aṣṭācatvāriṃśaḥ paśavaś chandogā yat ṣoḍaśabhyaḥ ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti ṣoḍaśakalāḥ paśavaḥ kalāśas tat paśūn āpnoti
meaning: अन्तो वा अष्टाचत्वारिंशः पशवश् छन्दोगा यत् षोडशभ्यः षोडशभ्यो हिङ् करोति षोडशकलाः पशवः कलाशस् तत् पशून् आप्नोति
text_mt: The forty-eight-fold stoma is the end. Cattle are [dear to] the Chandogas. In that he utters the syllable hiṅ for sixteen [verses] each time, cattle possess sixteen parts; he thereby obtains cattle part by part.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśabhir vihitaikā paricarā dvādaśamāsās saṃvvatsaro yajamānaḥ paricarā yad dvādaśabhir vidadhāty ekā paricarā bhavati yajamānam eva tad antatas saṃvvatsare paśuṣu pratiṣṭhāpayaty eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitāṣṭācatvāriṃśasya viṣṭutiḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya etayā stute
meaning: द्वादशभिर् विहितैका परिचरा द्वादशमासास् संव्वत्सरो यजमानः परिचरा यद् द्वादशभिर् विदधात्य् एका परिचरा भवति यजमानम् एव तद् अन्ततस् संव्वत्सरे पशुषु प्रतिष्ठापयत्य् एषा वै प्रतिष्ठिताष्टाचत्वारिंशस्य विष्टुतिः प्रतितिष्ठति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: It is arranged with twelve [verses]; one is a surplus [verse]. The year has twelve months; the sacrificer is the surplus one. In that he arranges [it] with twelve, [and] one is a surplus [verse], he thereby establishes the sacrificer in the end in the year [and] among cattle. This indeed is the firmly established viṣṭuti of the forty-eight-fold stoma. He who praises with this [viṣṭuti] gets a firm footing.

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa daśabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa daśabhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhyo hiṅ karoti sa daśabhiḥ sa tisṛbhiḥ sa tisṛbhir nedīyaḥsaṃkramā
meaning: षोडशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स दशभिः स तिसृभिः षोडशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिः स दशभिः षोडशभ्यो हिङ् करोति स दशभिः स तिसृभिः स तिसृभिर् नेदीयःसंक्रमा
text_mt: He utters the syllable hiṅ for sixteen [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with ten, he with three; he utters the syllable hiṅ for sixteen [verses]: he [chants] with three, he with three, he with ten; he utters the syllable hiṅ for sixteen [verses]: he [chants] with ten, he with three, he with three. [This is] the nearer-stepping [viṣṭuti].

sanskrit_iast: anto vā aṣṭācatvāriṃśo yathā mahāvṛkṣasyāgraṃ sṛptvā nedīyaḥsaṃkramāt saṃkrāmaty evam etan nedīyaḥsaṃkramayā nedīyaḥsaṃkramāt saṃkrāmati
meaning: अन्तो वा अष्टाचत्वारिंशो यथा महावृक्षस्याग्रं सृप्त्वा नेदीयःसंक्रमात् संक्रामत्य् एवम् एतन् नेदीयःसंक्रमया नेदीयःसंक्रमात् संक्रामति
text_mt: The forty-eight-fold stoma is the end. Just as, having crept to the top of a great tree, one steps across from a nearer step, so by this nearer-stepping [viṣṭuti] he steps across from a nearer step.

sanskrit_iast: daśabhir vihitā tisraḥ paricarā daśākṣarā virāḍ etāvān puruṣo yad ātmā prajā jāyā yad daśabhir vidadhātt tisraḥ paricarā bhavanti yajamānam eva tad virājy annādye 'ntataḥ pratiṣṭhāpayaty annādo bhavati ya etayā stute
meaning: दशभिर् विहिता तिस्रः परिचरा दशाक्षरा विराड् एतावान् पुरुषो यद् आत्मा प्रजा जाया यद् दशभिर् विदधात्त् तिस्रः परिचरा भवन्ति यजमानम् एव तद् विराज्य् अन्नाद्ये ऽन्ततः प्रतिष्ठापयत्य् अन्नादो भवति य एतया स्तुते
text_mt: It is arranged with ten [verses]; three are surplus [verses]. The virāj has ten syllables. Of such extent is man, [consisting of] self, offspring, and wife. In that he arranges [it] with ten, [and] there are three surplus [verses], he thereby establishes the sacrificer in the end in the virāj, in food. An eater of food becomes he who praises with this [viṣṭuti].

sanskrit_iast: gāvo vā etat sattram āsata tāsāṃ daśasu māssu śṛṅgaṇy ajāyanta tā abruvannarāḥ smottiṣṭhāmopaśā no 'jñateti tā udatiṣṭhan
meaning: गावो वा एतत् सत्त्रम् आसत तासां दशसु मास्सु शृङ्गण्य् अजायन्त ता अब्रुवन्नराः स्मोत्तिष्ठामोपशा नो ऽज्ञतेति ता उदतिष्ठन्
text_mt: The cows indeed performed this sacrificial session. In the tenth month, horns grew upon them. They said: 'We have attained [our wish]; let us rise up, our desire has been fulfilled.' They rose up.

sanskrit_iast: tāsāṃ tv evābruvann āsāmahā evemau dvādaśau māsau saṃsaṃvvatsaram āpayāmeti tāsāṃ dvādaśasu māḥsu śṛṅgāṇi prāvartanta tāḥ sarvam annādyam āpnuvaṃs tā etās tūparās tasmāt tāḥ sarvān dvādaśamāsaḥ prerate sarvaṃ hi tā annādyam āpnuvan
meaning: तासां त्व् एवाब्रुवन्न् आसामहा एवेमौ द्वादशौ मासौ संसंव्वत्सरम् आपयामेति तासां द्वादशसु माःसु शृङ्गाणि प्रावर्तन्त ताः सर्वम् अन्नाद्यम् आप्नुवंस् ता एतास् तूपरास् तस्मात् ताः सर्वान् द्वादशमासः प्रेरते सर्वं हि ता अन्नाद्यम् आप्नुवन्
text_mt:
Some of them, however, said: 'Let us sit through these two months to complete twelve months, [and] attain the full year.' In their twelfth month, horns dropped off; they obtained all food. These are the hornless [cows]. Therefore they go forth throughout all twelve months, for they obtained all food.

He obtains all food who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: sarvam annādyam āpnoti ya evaṃv veda
meaning: सर्वम् अन्नाद्यम् आप्नोति य एवंव् वेद

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vā idam eka āsīt so 'kāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti sa etam atirātram apaśyat tam āharat tenāhorātre prājanayat
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वा इदम् एक आसीत् सो ऽकामयत बहु स्यां प्रजायेयेति स एतम् अतिरात्रम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरत् तेनाहोरात्रे प्राजनयत्
text_mt: Prajāpati indeed was here alone. He desired: 'May I be manifold, may I be reproduced.' He saw this atirātra; he took it; through it he generated day and night.

sanskrit_iast: yad eṣo 'tirātro bhavaty ahorātre eva prajanayanty ahorātrayoḥ pratitiṣṭhanty etāvān vāva saṃvvatsaro yad ahas ca rātriś cāhorātrābhyām eva tat saṃvvatsaram āpnuvanti
meaning: यद् एषो ऽतिरात्रो भवत्य् अहोरात्रे एव प्रजनयन्त्य् अहोरात्रयोः प्रतितिष्ठन्त्य् एतावान् वाव संव्वत्सरो यद् अहस् च रात्रिश् चाहोरात्राभ्याम् एव तत् संव्वत्सरम् आप्नुवन्ति
text_mt: In that this atirātra takes place, they generate day and night; they get a firm footing in day and night. Of such extent is the year: day and night; by means of day and night they obtain the year.

sanskrit_iast: yaj jyotiṣṭomo bhavati yajñamukhaṃ tad ṛdhnuvanti yad uktho yajñakrator anantarayāya yad rātriḥ sarvasyāptyai
meaning: यज् ज्योतिष्टोमो भवति यज्ञमुखं तद् ऋध्नुवन्ति यद् उक्थो यज्ञक्रतोर् अनन्तरयाय यद् रात्रिः सर्वस्याप्त्यै
text_mt: In that it is a Jyotiṣṭoma, they thereby cause the opening of the sacrifice to prosper; in that [it has] the ukthastotra, for the non-interruption of the sacrificial rite; in that [it has] the night [service], for the attainment of everything.

sanskrit_iast: sa etān stomān apaśyat jyotir gaur aur itīme vai lokā ete stomā ayam eva jyotir ayaṃ madhyamo gaur asāv uttama āyuḥ
meaning: स एतान् स्तोमान् अपश्यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् और् इतीमे वै लोका एते स्तोमा अयम् एव ज्योतिर् अयं मध्यमो गौर् असाव् उत्तम आयुः
text_mt: He saw these stomas: Jyotis, Go, and Āyus. These worlds indeed are these stomas: this [earthly world] is Jyotis, this intermediate [world] is Go, and that highest one is Āyus.

sanskrit_iast: yad ete stomā bhavantīmān eva lokān prajanayanty eṣu lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: यद् एते स्तोमा भवन्तीमान् एव लोकान् प्रजनयन्त्य् एषु लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: When there are these stomas, they generate these worlds and find firm support in these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: sa etaṃ tryahaṃ punaḥ prāyauṅkta tena ṣaḍahena ṣaṭkratūn prājanayat
meaning: स एतं त्र्यहं पुनः प्रायौङ्क्त तेन षडहेन षट्क्रतून् प्राजनयत्
text_mt: He employed this three-day period again; by that six-day period he generated six ritual seasons.

sanskrit_iast: yad eṣa ṣaḍaho bhavati ṛtūn eva prajanayanti ṛtuṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: यद् एष षडहो भवति ऋतून् एव प्रजनयन्ति ऋतुषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: When there is this six-day period, they generate the seasons and find firm support in the seasons.

sanskrit_iast: sa etaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ punaḥ prāyuṅkta tābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ṣaḍahābhyāṃ dvādaśamasaḥ prājanayat
meaning: स एतं षडहं पुनः प्रायुङ्क्त ताभ्यां द्वाभ्यां षडहाभ्यां द्वादशमसः प्राजनयत्
text_mt: He employed this six-day period again; by those two six-day periods he generated the twelve months.

sanskrit_iast: yad etau ṣaḍahau bhavato māsān eva prajanayanti māseṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: यद् एतौ षडहौ भवतो मासान् एव प्रजनयन्ति मासेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: When there are these two six-day periods, they generate the months and find firm support in the months.

sanskrit_iast: sa etau dvau ṣaḍahau punaḥ prayuṅkta taiś caturbhiḥ ṣaḍahaiś caturviṃśatim ardhamāsān prājanayat
meaning: स एतौ द्वौ षडहौ पुनः प्रयुङ्क्त तैश् चतुर्भिः षडहैश् चतुर्विंशतिम् अर्धमासान् प्राजनयत्
text_mt: He employed these two six-day periods again; by those four six-day periods he generated the twenty-four half-months.

sanskrit_iast: yad ete catvāraḥ ṣaḍahā bhavanty ardhamāsān eva prajanayanty ardhamāseṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: यद् एते चत्वारः षडहा भवन्त्य् अर्धमासान् एव प्रजनयन्त्य् अर्धमासेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: When there are these four six-day periods, they generate the half-months and find firm support in the half-months.

sanskrit_iast: sa idaṃ bhuvanaṃ prajanayitva pṛṣṭhyena ṣaḍahena vīryam ātmany adhatta
meaning: स इदं भुवनं प्रजनयित्व पृष्ठ्येन षडहेन वीर्यम् आत्मन्य् अधत्त
text_mt: Having generated this world of living beings, he deposited virility within himself by means of the Pṛṣṭhya six-day period.

sanskrit_iast: yad eṣaḥ pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati vīrya evāntataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: यद् एषः पृष्ठ्यः षडहो भवति वीर्य एवान्ततः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: When there is this Pṛṣṭhya six-day period, they find firm support in virility at the end.

sanskrit_iast: tena māsān saṃvvatsaraṃ prājanayad yad eṣa māso bhavati saṃvvatsaram eva prajanayanti saṃvvatsare pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: तेन मासान् संव्वत्सरं प्राजनयद् यद् एष मासो भवति संव्वत्सरम् एव प्रजनयन्ति संव्वत्सरे प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: By that [month] he generated the year [composed of] months. When there is this month, they generate the year and find firm support in the year.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyam etad ahar bhavati
meaning: प्रायणीयम् एतद् अहर् भवति
text_mt: This day is the opening day.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyena vā ahnā devāḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ prāyan yat prāyaṃs tat prāyaṇīyasya prāyaṇīyatvam
meaning: प्रायणीयेन वा अह्ना देवाः स्वर्गं लोकं प्रायन् यत् प्रायंस् तत् प्रायणीयस्य प्रायणीयत्वम्
text_mt: By means of the opening day, indeed, the gods went to the heavenly world; that they went (prāyan) is the reason why the opening day (prāyaṇīya) is so named.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt prāyaṇīyasyāhna ṛtvijā bhavitavyam etad dhi svargasya lokasya nediṣṭhaṃ ya etasyartviṅ na bhavati hīyate svargāl lokāt
meaning: तस्मात् प्रायणीयस्याह्न ऋत्विजा भवितव्यम् एतद् धि स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य नेदिष्ठं य एतस्यर्त्विङ् न भवति हीयते स्वर्गाल् लोकात्
text_mt: Therefore one should be an officiating priest of the opening day, for this is nearest to the heavenly world; whoever is not an officiating priest of this [day] falls short of the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśaṃ bhavati
meaning: चतुर्विंशं भवति

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī teja eva brahmavarcasam ārabhya prayanti
meaning: चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा गायत्री तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं गायत्री तेज एव ब्रह्मवर्चसम् आरभ्य प्रयन्ति
text_mt: The gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables; the gāyatrī is fiery splendour and brahminical lustre. Grasping hold of fiery splendour and brahminical lustre, they proceed.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśaṃ bhavati caturviṃśo vai saṃvvatsaraḥ sākṣād eva saṃvvatsaram ārabhante
meaning: चतुर्विंशं भवति चतुर्विंशो वै संव्वत्सरः साक्षाद् एव संव्वत्सरम् आरभन्ते
text_mt: It is a twenty-four-fold [day]; the year indeed has twenty-four [half-months]. Directly do they take hold of the year.

sanskrit_iast: yāvatyaś caturviṃśasyokthasya stotrīyās tāvatyaḥ saṃvvatsarasya rātrayaḥ stotrīyābhir eva tat saṃvvatsaram āpnuvanti
meaning: यावत्यश् चतुर्विंशस्योक्थस्य स्तोत्रीयास् तावत्यः संव्वत्सरस्य रात्रयः स्तोत्रीयाभिर् एव तत् संव्वत्सरम् आप्नुवन्ति
text_mt: As many stoma verses as belong to the uktha of the twenty-four-fold [day], so many are the nights of the year; by the stoma verses they obtain the year.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśastotrāṇi bhavanti pañcadaśārdhamāsasya rātrayo 'rdhamāsaśa eva tat saṃvvatsaram āpnuvanti
meaning: पञ्चदशस्तोत्राणि भवन्ति पञ्चदशार्धमासस्य रात्रयो ऽर्धमासश एव तत् संव्वत्सरम् आप्नुवन्ति
text_mt: There are fifteen chants of praise; fifteen are the nights of a half-month. Half-month by half-month do they obtain the year.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśa stotrāṇi pañcadaśaśastrāṇi samāso māsaśa eva tat saṃvvatsaram āpnuvanti
meaning: पञ्चदश स्तोत्राणि पञ्चदशशस्त्राणि समासो मासश एव तत् संव्वत्सरम् आप्नुवन्ति
text_mt: There are fifteen chants of praise and fifteen recitations: together [they are thirty]; month by month do they obtain the year.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur īrma iva vā eṣā hotrā yad acchāvākyā yad acchāvākam anusaṃtiṣṭhata īśvarermā bhavitor iti yady ukthaṃ smātraikakubhañcodvaṃśīyañcāntataḥ pratiṣṭhāpye vīryaṃ vā ete samanī vīrya evāntataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: तद् आहुर् ईर्म इव वा एषा होत्रा यद् अच्छावाक्या यद् अच्छावाकम् अनुसंतिष्ठत ईश्वरेर्मा भवितोर् इति यद्य् उक्थं स्मात्रैककुभञ्चोद्वंशीयञ्चान्ततः प्रतिष्ठाप्ये वीर्यं वा एते समनी वीर्य एवान्ततः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'This Hotṛ's office belonging to the acchāvāka is as it were crippled; if it concludes after the acchāvāka, it is liable to become crippled.' If there is an uktha [rite], then the Aikakubha and the Udvaṁśīya should be established at the end; these two sāmans are virility; in virility they find firm support at the end.

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhur agniṣṭomam eva kāryam eṣa vai yajñaḥ svargyo yad agniṣṭoma ūrdhvo hi hotāram anusaṃtiṣṭhate
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुर् अग्निष्टोमम् एव कार्यम् एष वै यज्ञः स्वर्ग्यो यद् अग्निष्टोम ऊर्ध्वो हि होतारम् अनुसंतिष्ठते
text_mt: Now, however, they say: 'The Agniṣṭoma alone should be performed; this sacrifice which is the Agniṣṭoma leads to heaven, for it concludes standing upright after the hotṛ.'

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśastotrāṇy agniṣṭomo dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvvatsaras tena saṃvvatsarasaṃmito dvādaśa stotraṇi dvādaśa śastrāṇi tac caturviṃśatiś caturviṃśatir ardhamāsāḥ saṃvvatsaras tena saṃvvatsarasaṃmitaḥ
meaning: द्वादशस्तोत्राण्य् अग्निष्टोमो द्वादश मासाः संव्वत्सरस् तेन संव्वत्सरसंमितो द्वादश स्तोत्रणि द्वादश शस्त्राणि तच् चतुर्विंशतिश् चतुर्विंशतिर् अर्धमासाः संव्वत्सरस् तेन संव्वत्सरसंमितः
text_mt: The Agniṣṭoma has twelve chants of praise; twelve are the months of the year; thereby it is commensurate with the year. There are twelve chants of praise and twelve recitations; that makes twenty-four; twenty-four are the half-months of the year; thereby it is commensurate with the year.

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhur uktham eva kāryam ahnaḥ samṛddhyai
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुर् उक्थम् एव कार्यम् अह्नः समृद्ध्यै
text_mt: Now, however, they say: 'The Ukthya alone should be performed for the prosperity of the day.'

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi rūpāṇi kriyante sarvaṃ hy etāhnāpyate
meaning: सर्वाणि रूपाणि क्रियन्ते सर्वं ह्य् एताह्नाप्यते
text_mt: All forms are performed, for everything is obtained through this day.

sanskrit_iast: pavante vājasātaye somāḥ sahasrapājasa iti sahasravatī pratipat kāryā
meaning: पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजस इति सहस्रवती प्रतिपत् कार्या
text_mt: 'The Somas purify themselves for the winning of booty, they of thousandfold strength'—[with this verse] containing the word 'thousand' the introductory verse should be made.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvvatsarasya rūpaṃ sarvan evainān etayā punāti sarvān abhivadati
meaning: संव्वत्सरस्य रूपं सर्वन् एवैनान् एतया पुनाति सर्वान् अभिवदति
text_mt: It is the form of the year; by this he purifies all of them, he addresses all of them.

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhuḥ pavasva vāco agriya ity eva kāryā mukhaṃ vā etat saṃvvatsarasya yad vāco 'graṃ mukhata eva tat saṃvvatsaram ārabhante
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुः पवस्व वाचो अग्रिय इत्य् एव कार्या मुखं वा एतत् संव्वत्सरस्य यद् वाचो ऽग्रं मुखत एव तत् संव्वत्सरम् आरभन्ते
text_mt: Now, however, they say: 'Purify thyself, O first of speech' alone should be made [the introductory verse]. What is the tip of speech is the head of the year; from the head do they begin the year.

sanskrit_iast: mithunam iva vā eṣā vyāhṛtiḥ pavasveti puṃso rūpaṃ vāca iti striyāḥ someti puṃso rūpaṃ citrābhir iti striyā mithunam evaibhyo yajñamukhe dadhāti prajananāya
meaning: मिथुनम् इव वा एषा व्याहृतिः पवस्वेति पुंसो रूपं वाच इति स्त्रियाः सोमेति पुंसो रूपं चित्राभिर् इति स्त्रिया मिथुनम् एवैभ्यो यज्ञमुखे दधाति प्रजननाय
text_mt: This utterance is indeed like a pairing: 'Purify thyself' is the form of the male, 'of speech' is of the female; 'O Soma' is the form of the male, 'with bright [rays]' is of the female. A pairing does he place for them at the opening of the sacrifice for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: agne yuṅkṣvā hi ye taveti jarābodhīyam agniṣṭoma sāma kāryaṃ yuktenaiva saṃvvatsareṇa prayanti caturviṃśatyakṣarāsu bhavati caturviṃśasya rūpam
meaning: अग्ने युङ्क्ष्वा हि ये तवेति जराबोधीयम् अग्निष्टोम साम कार्यं युक्तेनैव संव्वत्सरेण प्रयन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरासु भवति चतुर्विंशस्य रूपम्
text_mt: 'O Agni, yoke those which are thine'—on this [triplet] the Jārabodhīya should be made the Agniṣṭoma-sāman; with a yoked year they proceed. It is on [verses of] twenty-four syllables; it is the form of the twenty-four-fold [day].

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhur yajñāyajñīyam eva kāryam
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुर् यज्ञायज्ञीयम् एव कार्यम्
text_mt: Now, however, they say: 'The Yajñāyajñīya alone should be performed.'

sanskrit_iast: panthā vai yajñāyajñīyaṃ patha eva tan na yanti
meaning: पन्था वै यज्ञायज्ञीयं पथ एव तन् न यन्ति
text_mt: The Yajñāyajñīya is the path; from the path they do not deviate.

sanskrit_iast: abhīvarto brahmasāma bhavati
meaning: अभीवर्तो ब्रह्मसाम भवति
text_mt: The Abhīvarta is the chant of the Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: abhīvartena vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam abhyavartanta yad abhīvarto brahmasāma bhavati svargasya lokasyābhivṛttyai
meaning: अभीवर्तेन वै देवाः स्वर्गं लोकम् अभ्यवर्तन्त यद् अभीवर्तो ब्रह्मसाम भवति स्वर्गस्य लोकस्याभिवृत्त्यै
text_mt: By the Abhīvarta, indeed, the gods turned towards the heavenly world; when the Abhīvarta is the chant of the Brahman, it is for the attainment of the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: ekākṣaraṇidhano bhavaty ekākṣarā vai vāg vācaiva tad ārabhya svargaṃ lokaṃ yanti
meaning: एकाक्षरणिधनो भवत्य् एकाक्षरा वै वाग् वाचैव तद् आरभ्य स्वर्गं लोकं यन्ति
text_mt: It has a one-syllable cadence; one-syllable indeed is speech. Taking hold of speech, they go to the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: sāmneto yanty ṛcā punar āyanti
meaning: साम्नेतो यन्त्य् ऋचा पुनर् आयन्ति
text_mt: With the sāman they go from here; with the ṛc they come back.

sanskrit_iast: sāma vai asau loka ṛg ayaṃ yad itaḥ sāmnā yanti svargaṃ lokam ārabhya yanti yad ṛcā punar āyanty asmin loke pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: साम वै असौ लोक ऋग् अयं यद् इतः साम्ना यन्ति स्वर्गं लोकम् आरभ्य यन्ति यद् ऋचा पुनर् आयन्त्य् अस्मिन् लोके प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: The sāman is yonder world; the ṛc is this one. When they go from here with the sāman, they go taking hold of the heavenly world; when they come back with the ṛc, they find firm support in this world.

sanskrit_iast: yat sāmāvasṛjeyur ava svargāl lokāt padyeran yad ṛcam anusṛjeyur naśyeyur asmāl lokāt
meaning: यत् सामावसृजेयुर् अव स्वर्गाल् लोकात् पद्येरन् यद् ऋचम् अनुसृजेयुर् नश्येयुर् अस्माल् लोकात्
text_mt: If they were to let go of the sāman, they would fall away from the heavenly world; if they were to leave behind the ṛc, they would be lost from this world.

sanskrit_iast: samānaṃ sāma bhavaty anyo 'nyaḥ pragātho 'nyad anyad dhi citram adhvānam avagacchann eti
meaning: समानं साम भवत्य् अन्यो ऽन्यः प्रगाथो ऽन्यद् अन्यद् धि चित्रम् अध्वानम् अवगच्छन्न् एति
text_mt: The sāman is the same, but the pragmatic strophe is different each time; for one traversing a path comes upon one variety after another.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣā vā eṣa retodhā yad abhīvartaḥ pragātheṣu reto dadhad eti yad itaḥ samānaṃ sāma bhavaty anyo 'nyaḥ pragātho reta eva tad dadhati yat parastāt samānaḥ pragātho bhavaty anyad anyat sāma reta eva tad dhitaṃ prajanayanti
meaning: वृषा वा एष रेतोधा यद् अभीवर्तः प्रगाथेषु रेतो दधद् एति यद् इतः समानं साम भवत्य् अन्यो ऽन्यः प्रगाथो रेत एव तद् दधति यत् परस्तात् समानः प्रगाथो भवत्य् अन्यद् अन्यत् साम रेत एव तद् धितं प्रजनयन्ति
text_mt: The Abhīvarta is a bull, an implanter of seed; it goes on implanting seed in the pragmatic strophes. When from here the sāman is the same and the pragmatic strophe is different, they deposit seed; when on the other side the pragmatic strophe is the same and the sāman is different, they bring forth the deposited seed.

sanskrit_iast: sāmnetaḥ pragāthāṃ dugdhe pragāthena parastāt sāmāni dugdhe salomatvāya
meaning: साम्नेतः प्रगाथां दुग्धे प्रगाथेन परस्तात् सामानि दुग्धे सलोमत्वाय
text_mt: From here he milks the pragmatic strophes by means of the sāman; on the other side he milks the sāmans by means of the pragmatic strophe, for the sake of uniformity.

sanskrit_iast: yo vā adhvānaṃ punar nivartayanti nainaṃ te gacchanti ye 'punar nivartaṃ yanti te gacchati
meaning: यो वा अध्वानं पुनर् निवर्तयन्ति नैनं ते गच्छन्ति ये ऽपुनर् निवर्तं यन्ति ते गच्छति
text_mt: Those who turn back along the path do not reach it; those who go without turning back reach it.

sanskrit_iast: ya āstutaṃ kurvate yathā dugdhām upasīded evaṃ tat
meaning: य आस्तुतं कुर्वते यथा दुग्धाम् उपसीदेद् एवं तत्
text_mt: Those who chant what has been praised are as one who would sit down by a cow already milked.

sanskrit_iast: ye nāstutaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayante tam abhyaśnuvate
meaning: ये नास्तुतं यं कामं कामयन्ते तम् अभ्यश्नुवते
text_mt: Those who chant what has not been praised obtain whatever desire they desire.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti yātayāmāḥ saṃvvatsarā3 ayātayāmā3 iti te nāyātayāmeti vaktavyaṃ punar anyāni stotrāṇi nivartanta ūrdhvam eva brahmasāmaiti
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति यातयामाः संव्वत्सरा3 अयातयामा3 इति ते नायातयामेति वक्तव्यं पुनर् अन्यानि स्तोत्राणि निवर्तन्त ऊर्ध्वम् एव ब्रह्मसामैति
text_mt: The theological debaters ask: 'Are the years exhausted, or are they unexhausted?' One should answer them: 'Unexhausted.' The other chants of praise turn back again, but the chant of the Brahman goes ever upward.

sanskrit_iast: pañcasu māḥsu bārhatāḥ pragāthā āpyante
meaning: पञ्चसु माःसु बार्हताः प्रगाथा आप्यन्ते
text_mt: In five months the bṛhatī-like pragmatic strophes are exhausted.

sanskrit_iast: teṣv āpteṣu chandasī saṃyujyaitavyam
meaning: तेष्व् आप्तेषु छन्दसी संयुज्यैतव्यम्
text_mt: When they are exhausted, one should proceed having combined two metres.

sanskrit_iast: tisra uṣṇihaḥ syur ekā gāyatrī tās tisro bṛhatyo bhavanti
meaning: तिस्र उष्णिहः स्युर् एका गायत्री तास् तिस्रो बृहत्यो भवन्ति
text_mt: There should be three uṣṇihs and one gāyatrī; these become three bṛhatīs.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhuḥ saṃśara iva vā eṣa cchandasāṃ yad dve chandasī saṃyuñjantīti
meaning: तद् आहुः संशर इव वा एष च्छन्दसां यद् द्वे छन्दसी संयुञ्जन्तीति
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'It is like a shattering of the metres when they combine two metres.'

sanskrit_iast: catur uttarair eva cchandobhir etavyam
meaning: चतुर् उत्तरैर् एव च्छन्दोभिर् एतव्यम्
text_mt: One should proceed only with metres increasing by four [syllables].

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai caturuttarāṇi cchandasāṃsi paśubhir eva tat svargaṃ lokam ākramam ānayanti
meaning: पशवो वै चतुरुत्तराणि च्छन्दसांसि पशुभिर् एव तत् स्वर्गं लोकम् आक्रमम् आनयन्ति
text_mt: Cattle are the metres that increase by four [syllables]; by means of cattle they lead an ascent to the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: ekaṃ gāyatrīm ekāham upeyur ekāmuṣṇiham ekāham ekām anuṣṭubham ekāhaṃ bṛhatyā pañcamāsa iyuḥ paṅktim ekāham upeyus triṣṭubhā ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsam īyuḥ śvo viṣuvān bhaviteti jagatīm upeyuḥ
meaning: एकं गायत्रीम् एकाहम् उपेयुर् एकामुष्णिहम् एकाहम् एकाम् अनुष्टुभम् एकाहं बृहत्या पञ्चमास इयुः पङ्क्तिम् एकाहम् उपेयुस् त्रिष्टुभा षष्ठं मासम् ईयुः श्वो विषुवान् भवितेति जगतीम् उपेयुः
text_mt: They should perform one one-day rite in the gāyatrī, one one-day rite in the uṣṇih, one one-day rite in the anuṣṭubh; they should go through the fifth month with the bṛhatī; they should perform one one-day rite in the paṅkti; they should go through the sixth month with the triṣṭubh; with the thought, 'Tomorrow the Viṣuvant will be,' they should perform [the one-day rite] in the jagatī.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur anavakḷptāni vā etāni cchandāṃsi madhyandine bṛhatyā caiva triṣṭubhā caitavyam
meaning: तद् आहुर् अनवकॢप्तानि वा एतानि च्छन्दांसि मध्यन्दिने बृहत्या चैव त्रिष्टुभा चैतव्यम्
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'These metres are unsuitable at the midday [service]; one should proceed with the bṛhatī and the triṣṭubh alone.'

sanskrit_iast: ete vai chandasī vīryavatī ete pratyakṣaṃ madhyandinasya rūpam
meaning: एते वै छन्दसी वीर्यवती एते प्रत्यक्षं मध्यन्दिनस्य रूपम्
text_mt: These two metres are indeed full of vigour; these are the visible form of the midday [service].

sanskrit_iast: rathantare 'hani bṛhatī kāryaitad vai rathantarasya svam āyatanaṃ yad bṛhatī sva eva tad āyatane rathantaraṃ pratitiṣṭhati bārhate 'hani triṣṭup kāryaitad vai bṛhataḥ svam āyatanaṃ yat triṣṭup sva eva tad āyatane bṛhadrathantare pratitiṣṭhantī itaḥ
meaning: रथन्तरे ऽहनि बृहती कार्यैतद् वै रथन्तरस्य स्वम् आयतनं यद् बृहती स्व एव तद् आयतने रथन्तरं प्रतितिष्ठति बार्हते ऽहनि त्रिष्टुप् कार्यैतद् वै बृहतः स्वम् आयतनं यत् त्रिष्टुप् स्व एव तद् आयतने बृहद्रथन्तरे प्रतितिष्ठन्ती इतः
text_mt: On a Rathantara day, the bṛhatī is to be used. The bṛhatī is indeed the own abode of the Rathantara; thus the Rathantara is established in its own abode. On a Bārhata day, the triṣṭubh is to be used. The triṣṭubh is indeed the own abode of the Bṛhat; thus the Bṛhat and the Rathantara proceed from here, being established in their own abode.

sanskrit_iast: trayastriṃśatā pragāthair etavyaṃ trayastriṃśad devatā devatāsv eva pratitiṣṭhanto yanti caturviṃśatyaitavyaṃ caturviṃśatir ardhamāsāḥ saṃvvatsaraḥ saṃvvatsara eva pratitiṣṭhanto yanti dvādaśabhir etavyaṃ dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvvatsaraḥ saṃvvatsara eva pratitiṣṭhanto yanti ṣaḍbhir etavyaṃ ṣaḍ ṛtava ṛtuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanto yanti caturbhir etavyaṃ catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanto yanti tribhir etavyaṃ traya ime lokā eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanto yanti dvābhyām etavyaṃ dvipād yajamānaḥ svargasya lokasyākrāntyā anyenānyena hi padā puruṣaḥ pratitiṣṭhann eti
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिंशता प्रगाथैर् एतव्यं त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवता देवतास्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यैतव्यं चतुर्विंशतिर् अर्धमासाः संव्वत्सरः संव्वत्सर एव प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति द्वादशभिर् एतव्यं द्वादश मासाः संव्वत्सरः संव्वत्सर एव प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति षड्भिर् एतव्यं षड् ऋतव ऋतुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति चतुर्भिर् एतव्यं चतुष्पादाः पशवः पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति त्रिभिर् एतव्यं त्रय इमे लोका एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति द्वाभ्याम् एतव्यं द्विपाद् यजमानः स्वर्गस्य लोकस्याक्रान्त्या अन्येनान्येन हि पदा पुरुषः प्रतितिष्ठन्न् एति
text_mt: One should proceed with thirty-three pragāthas: thirty-three are the deities; being established in the deities, they proceed. One should proceed with twenty-four: twenty-four are the half-months, the year; being established in the year, they proceed. One should proceed with twelve: twelve are the months, the year; being established in the year, they proceed. One should proceed with six: six are the seasons; being established in the seasons, they proceed. One should proceed with four: four-footed are cattle; being established in cattle, they proceed. One should proceed with three: three are these worlds; being established in these worlds, they proceed. One should proceed with two: two-footed is the sacrificer, for the attainment of the world of heaven; for with one foot after another a man proceeds, establishing himself.

sanskrit_iast: svarasāmāna ete bhavante
meaning: स्वरसामान एते भवन्ते
text_mt: These Svarasāmans take place.

sanskrit_iast: svarbhānur vā āsur ādityaṃ tamasāvidhyat taṃ devāḥ svarair aspṛṇvan yat svarasāmāno bhavanty ādityasya spṛtyai
meaning: स्वर्भानुर् वा आसुर् आदित्यं तमसाविध्यत् तं देवाः स्वरैर् अस्पृण्वन् यत् स्वरसामानो भवन्त्य् आदित्यस्य स्पृत्यै
text_mt: Svarbhānu, the Asura, pierced the sun with darkness; the gods delivered him with the svara [chants]. That the Svarasāmans take place is for the deliverance of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: parair vai devā ādityaṃ svargaṃ lokam apārayan yad aparayaṃs tat parāṇāṃ paratvaṃ
meaning: परैर् वै देवा आदित्यं स्वर्गं लोकम् अपारयन् यद् अपरयंस् तत् पराणां परत्वं
text_mt: With the Paras the gods conveyed the sun across to the world of heaven; because they conveyed him across, that is the cross-conveying nature of the Paras.

sanskrit_iast: pārayanty enaṃ parāṇi ya evaṃv veda
meaning: पारयन्त्य् एनं पराणि य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: The Paras convey him across who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśā bhavanti
meaning: सप्तदशा भवन्ति

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim evopayanti
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजापतिम् एवोपयन्ति
text_mt: Prajāpati is seventeenfold; it is Prajāpati whom they undertake.

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭup chandaso bhavanty ānuṣṭubho vai prajāpatiḥ sākṣād eva prajāpatim ārabhante
meaning: अनुष्टुप् छन्दसो भवन्त्य् आनुष्टुभो वै प्रजापतिः साक्षाद् एव प्रजापतिम् आरभन्ते
text_mt: They are of the anuṣṭubh metre; Prajāpati is related to the anuṣṭubh; they grasp Prajāpati visibly.

sanskrit_iast: trayaḥ purastāt trayaḥ parastād bhavanti
meaning: त्रयः पुरस्तात् त्रयः परस्ताद् भवन्ति
text_mt: Three are before, three are after.

sanskrit_iast: devā vā ādityasya svargāl lokād avapādād abibhayus tam etaiḥ stomaiḥ saptadaśair adṛṃhan yad ete stomābhavanty ādityasya dhṛtyai
meaning: देवा वा आदित्यस्य स्वर्गाल् लोकाद् अवपादाद् अबिभयुस् तम् एतैः स्तोमैः सप्तदशैर् अदृंहन् यद् एते स्तोमाभवन्त्य् आदित्यस्य धृत्यै
text_mt: The gods were afraid of the sun falling down from the world of heaven; they braced him with these seventeenfold stomas. That these stomas take place is for the firm holding of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: catustriṃśā bhavanti varṣma vai catustriṃśo varṣmaṇaivainaṃ saṃmimate
meaning: चतुस्त्रिंशा भवन्ति वर्ष्म वै चतुस्त्रिंशो वर्ष्मणैवैनं संमिमते
text_mt: They are thirty-four-fold; the thirty-four-fold [stoma] is the summit; with the summit they measure him out.

sanskrit_iast: tasya parācīnātipādād abibhayus taṃ sarvaiḥ stomaiḥ paryārṣan viśvajidabhijidbhyāṃ vīryaṃ vā etau stomau vīryeṇaiva tad ādityaṃ paryuṣanti dhṛtyai
meaning: तस्य पराचीनातिपादाद् अबिभयुस् तं सर्वैः स्तोमैः पर्यार्षन् विश्वजिदभिजिद्भ्यां वीर्यं वा एतौ स्तोमौ वीर्येणैव तद् आदित्यं पर्युषन्ति धृत्यै
text_mt: They were afraid of his falling past further on; they hemmed him in with all the stomas, with the Viśvajit and the Abhijit. These two stomas are vigour; with vigour they hem in the sun for firm holding,

sanskrit_iast: anavapādāyānatipādāya
meaning: अनवपादायानतिपादाय
text_mt: so that he does not fall down, so that he does not fall past.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhuḥ kartapraskanda iva vā eṣa yat trayastriṃśataḥ saptadaśam upayantīti pṛṣṭhyo 'ntaraḥ kāryaḥ
meaning: तद् आहुः कर्तप्रस्कन्द इव वा एष यत् त्रयस्त्रिंशतः सप्तदशम् उपयन्तीति पृष्ठ्यो ऽन्तरः कार्यः
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'It is like leaping into a pit when they go from the thirty-three-fold to the seventeenfold [stoma].' A Pṛṣṭhya [six-day period] should be introduced between.

sanskrit_iast: tasya yat saptadaśam ahas tad uttamaṃ kāryaṃ salomatvāya
meaning: तस्य यत् सप्तदशम् अहस् तद् उत्तमं कार्यं सलोमत्वाय
text_mt: Its day that is seventeenfold should be made the last, for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur udaraṃ vā eṣa stomānāṃ yat saptadaśo yat saptadaśaṃ madhyato nirhareyur aśanāyavaḥ prajāḥ syur aśanāyavaḥ sattriṇaḥ
meaning: तद् आहुर् उदरं वा एष स्तोमानां यत् सप्तदशो यत् सप्तदशं मध्यतो निर्हरेयुर् अशनायवः प्रजाः स्युर् अशनायवः सत्त्रिणः
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'The seventeenfold is the belly of the stomas; if they were to extract the seventeenfold from the middle, the creatures would be hungry, the performers of the sacrificial session would be hungry.'

sanskrit_iast: trayastriṃśād eva saptadaśa upetyo varṣma vai trayastriṃśo varṣma saptadaśo varṣmaṇa eva tad varṣmābhisaṃkrāmanti
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिंशाद् एव सप्तदश उपेत्यो वर्ष्म वै त्रयस्त्रिंशो वर्ष्म सप्तदशो वर्ष्मण एव तद् वर्ष्माभिसंक्रामन्ति
text_mt: Directly from the thirty-three-fold the seventeenfold should be undertaken. The thirty-three-fold is the summit; the seventeenfold is the summit; from the summit to the summit they step across.

sanskrit_iast: nānāhur ukthāḥ kāryā3 iti yady ukthāḥ syuḥ
meaning: नानाहुर् उक्थाः कार्या3 इति यद्य् उक्थाः स्युः
text_mt: They say variously: 'Should ukthas be performed?' If there should be ukthas:

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vā ukthāni śāntiḥ paśavaḥ śāntenaiva tad viṣuvantam upayanti
meaning: पशवो वा उक्थानि शान्तिः पशवः शान्तेनैव तद् विषुवन्तम् उपयन्ति
text_mt: Ukthas are cattle, cattle are appeasement; through what is appeased they undertake the Viṣuvant.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur vivīvadham iva vā etad yad agniṣṭomo viṣuvān agniṣṭomau viśvajidabhijitāv athetara ukthāḥ syur iti
meaning: तद् आहुर् विवीवधम् इव वा एतद् यद् अग्निष्टोमो विषुवान् अग्निष्टोमौ विश्वजिदभिजिताव् अथेतर उक्थाः स्युर् इति
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'It would be like a yoke if the Viṣuvant is an agniṣṭoma, the Viśvajit and Abhijit are agniṣṭomas, and the others were ukthyas.'

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomā eva sarve kāryāḥ
meaning: अग्निष्टोमा एव सर्वे कार्याः
text_mt: All should be performed as agniṣṭomas alone.

sanskrit_iast: vīryaṃ vā agniṣṭomo vīrya eva madhyataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti nava saṃstutā bhavanti nava prāṇāḥ praṇeṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: वीर्यं वा अग्निष्टोमो वीर्य एव मध्यतः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति नव संस्तुता भवन्ति नव प्राणाः प्रणेष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: The agniṣṭoma is vigour; in vigour they establish themselves in the middle. Nine [stotras] are chanted; nine are the vital breaths; in the vital breaths they establish themselves.

sanskrit_iast: viṣuvān eṣa bhavati
meaning: विषुवान् एष भवति

sanskrit_iast: devaloko vā eṣa yad viṣuvān devaokam eva tad abhyārohanti
meaning: देवलोको वा एष यद् विषुवान् देवओकम् एव तद् अभ्यारोहन्ति
text_mt: The Viṣuvant is the world of the gods; thus they ascend to the world of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśo bhavaty ekaviṃśo vā asya bhuvanasyāditya ādityalokam eva tad abhyārohanti
meaning: एकविंशो भवत्य् एकविंशो वा अस्य भुवनस्यादित्य आदित्यलोकम् एव तद् अभ्यारोहन्ति
text_mt: It is twenty-one-fold; the sun of this world is twenty-one-fold; thus they ascend to the world of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ
meaning: द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंशः
text_mt: Twelve months, five seasons, three are these worlds: yonder sun is the twenty-first.

sanskrit_iast: madhyata eva yajñasya pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: मध्यत एव यज्ञस्य प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: In the middle of the sacrifice they establish themselves.

sanskrit_iast: vāyo śukro ayāmi ta iti śukravatī pratipad bhavaty ādityasya rūpam
meaning: वायो शुक्रो अयामि त इति शुक्रवती प्रतिपद् भवत्य् आदित्यस्य रूपम्
text_mt: 'O Vāyu, the bright [Soma] has been offered to thee'—such is the introductory verse containing the word 'bright'; it is the form of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: vāyur vā etaṃ devatānām ānaśe 'nuṣṭup chandasaṃ yad ato 'nyā pratipat syāt pradahet
meaning: वायुर् वा एतं देवतानाम् आनशे ऽनुष्टुप् छन्दसं यद् अतो ऽन्या प्रतिपत् स्यात् प्रदहेत्
text_mt: Vāyu, of the deities, attained this [sun] who is of the anuṣṭubh metre; if there were an introductory verse other than this, it would burn up.

sanskrit_iast: yanti vā ete prāṇādityāhur ye gāyatryāḥ pratipado yantīti yad vayavyā bhavanti tena prāṇān na yanti prāṇo hi vāyuḥ
meaning: यन्ति वा एते प्राणादित्याहुर् ये गायत्र्याः प्रतिपदो यन्तीति यद् वयव्या भवन्ति तेन प्राणान् न यन्ति प्राणो हि वायुः
text_mt: They say: 'Those who depart from the introductory verses of the gāyatrī depart from the vital breath.' In that they belong to Vāyu, they do not depart from the vital breath; for Vāyu is the vital breath.

sanskrit_iast: atho śamayanty evainam etayā śantir hi vāyuḥ
meaning: अथो शमयन्त्य् एवैनम् एतया शन्तिर् हि वायुः
text_mt: Moreover, by this they appease him; for Vāyu is appeasement.

sanskrit_iast: ā yāhi somapītaya iti saumī pāvamānī
meaning: आ याहि सोमपीतय इति सौमी पावमानी
text_mt: 'Come to the drinking of Soma'—this is a verse addressed to Soma for the Pavamāna.

sanskrit_iast: niyutvatī bhavati paśavo vai niyutaḥ śāntiḥ paśavaḥ śāntenaiva tad ādityam upayanti
meaning: नियुत्वती भवति पशवो वै नियुतः शान्तिः पशवः शान्तेनैव तद् आदित्यम् उपयन्ति
text_mt: It contains the word 'team'; cattle are a team, cattle are appeasement; through what is appeased they undertake the sun.

sanskrit_iast: divākīrtyasāmā bhavati
meaning: दिवाकीर्त्यसामा भवति
text_mt: It has the Divākīrtyasāman.

sanskrit_iast: svarbhānur vā āsur ādityaṃ tamasāvidhyat tasya devā divākīrtyais tamo 'pāghnan yad divākīrtyāni bhavanti tama evāsmād apaghnanti raśmayo vā eta ādityasya yad divākīrtyāni raśmibhir eva tad ādityaṃ sākṣād ārabhante
meaning: स्वर्भानुर् वा आसुर् आदित्यं तमसाविध्यत् तस्य देवा दिवाकीर्त्यैस् तमो ऽपाघ्नन् यद् दिवाकीर्त्यानि भवन्ति तम एवास्माद् अपघ्नन्ति रश्मयो वा एत आदित्यस्य यद् दिवाकीर्त्यानि रश्मिभिर् एव तद् आदित्यं साक्षाद् आरभन्ते
text_mt: Svarbhānu, the Asura, pierced the sun with darkness; the gods smote away his darkness with the Divākīrtyas. That the Divākīrtyas take place, is that they smite away darkness from him. The Divākīrtyas are the rays of this sun; by means of the rays they grasp the sun visibly.

sanskrit_iast: bhrājābhrāje pavamānamukhe bhavato mukhata evāsya tābhyāṃ tamo 'paghnanti
meaning: भ्राजाभ्राजे पवमानमुखे भवतो मुखत एवास्य ताभ्यां तमो ऽपघ्नन्ति
text_mt: The Bhrāja and Ābhrāja are at the beginning of the Pavamāna; with these two they smite away darkness from his face.

sanskrit_iast: mahādivākīrtyaṃ ca vikarṇaṃ ca madhyato bhavato madhyata evāsya tābhyāṃ tamo 'paghnanti bhāsam antato bhavati patta evāsya tena tamo 'paghnanti
meaning: महादिवाकीर्त्यं च विकर्णं च मध्यतो भवतो मध्यत एवास्य ताभ्यां तमो ऽपघ्नन्ति भासम् अन्ततो भवति पत्त एवास्य तेन तमो ऽपघ्नन्ति
text_mt: The Mahādivākīrtya and Vikarṇa are in the middle; with these two they smite away darkness from his middle. The Bhāsa is at the end; with that they smite away darkness from his feet.

sanskrit_iast: daśastobhaṃ bhavti daśākṣarā virāḍ virājy eva pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: दशस्तोभं भव्ति दशाक्षरा विराड् विराज्य् एव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: It has ten stobhas; the virāj has ten syllables; in the virāj they establish themselves.

sanskrit_iast: yat tv ity āhuḥ ṣaḍbhir ito māsair adhvānaṃ yanti ṣaḍbhiḥ punar āyanti kva tarhi svargo loko yasya kāmāya sattram āsata iti
meaning: यत् त्व् इत्य् आहुः षड्भिर् इतो मासैर् अध्वानं यन्ति षड्भिः पुनर् आयन्ति क्व तर्हि स्वर्गो लोको यस्य कामाय सत्त्रम् आसत इति
text_mt: Now they say: 'By six months they go the path from here; by six they return. Where then is the world of heaven, for desire of which they perform the sacrificial session?'

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhānaṃ diva iti svargaṃ lokam ārabhante
meaning: मूर्धानं दिव इति स्वर्गं लोकम् आरभन्ते
text_mt: With '[Agni,] the head of heaven,' they lay hold of the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: aratiṃ pṛthivyā ity asmiṃ loke pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: अरतिं पृथिव्या इत्य् अस्मिं लोके प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: With 'the navel of the earth,' they establish themselves in this world.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaram ṛta ājātam agnim iti viṣuvata eva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
meaning: वैश्वानरम् ऋत आजातम् अग्निम् इति विषुवत एव तद् रूपं क्रियते
text_mt: With 'Agni Vaiśvānara born in the cosmic order,' the form of the Viṣuvant is made.

sanskrit_iast: kaviṃ samrājam atitihiṃ janānām ity annādyam evopayanti
meaning: कविं सम्राजम् अतितिहिं जनानाम् इत्य् अन्नाद्यम् एवोपयन्ति
text_mt: With 'the sage, the sovereign ruler, the guest of men,' they obtain food.

sanskrit_iast: āsan nāpātraṃ janayanta devā iti jāyanta eva
meaning: आसन् नापात्रं जनयन्त देवा इति जायन्त एव
text_mt: With 'a vessel for the mouth the gods generated,' they are indeed born.

sanskrit_iast: tat triṣṭub jagatīṣu bhavati traiṣṭubhjāgato vā ādityo yad ato 'nyāsu syād ava svargāl lokāt padyeran
meaning: तत् त्रिष्टुब् जगतीषु भवति त्रैष्टुभ्जागतो वा आदित्यो यद् अतो ऽन्यासु स्याद् अव स्वर्गाल् लोकात् पद्येरन्
text_mt: This triṣṭubh is set in jagatīs; the sun belongs to the triṣṭubh and jagatī; if it were in others than these, they would fall down from the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: samrāḍvatīṣu bhavati sāmrājyaṃ vai svargo lokaḥ svarga eva loke pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: सम्राड्वतीषु भवति साम्राज्यं वै स्वर्गो लोकः स्वर्ग एव लोके प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: It is in [verses] containing the word 'sovereign ruler'; sovereign rule is the world of heaven; in the world of heaven they establish themselves.

sanskrit_iast: ātmā vā eṣa saṃvvatsarasya yad viṣuvān pakṣāv etāv abhito bhavato yena ceto 'bhīvartena yanti yaś ca parasmāt pragātho bhavati tāv ubhau viṣuvati kāryau pakṣāv eva tad yajñasyātman pratidadhati svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
meaning: आत्मा वा एष संव्वत्सरस्य यद् विषुवान् पक्षाव् एताव् अभितो भवतो येन चेतो ऽभीवर्तेन यन्ति यश् च परस्मात् प्रगाथो भवति ताव् उभौ विषुवति कार्यौ पक्षाव् एव तद् यज्ञस्यात्मन् प्रतिदधति स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
text_mt: The Viṣuvant is indeed the body of the year; these two wings are on both sides: both that [chant] by which they go with the Abhīvarta from here, and the pragātha which is beyond, both are to be performed on the Viṣuvant. Thus they place the two wings on the body of the sacrifice, for the attainment of the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: indra kratuṃ na ābhareti pragātho bhavati
meaning: इन्द्र क्रतुं न आभरेति प्रगाथो भवति
text_mt: There is the pragātha beginning: 'Indra, bring us insight.'

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭho vā etaṃ putrahato 'paśyat sa prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata yad eṣa pragātho bhavati prajātyai
meaning: वसिष्ठो वा एतं पुत्रहतो ऽपश्यत् स प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायत यद् एष प्रगाथो भवति प्रजात्यै
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha, whose son had been killed, saw this [pragātha]. He propagated with offspring and cattle. In that there is this pragātha, it is for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: jīvā jyotir aśīmahīti ye vai svasti saṃvvatsaraṃ saṃtaranti te jīvā jyotir aśnuvate
meaning: जीवा ज्योतिर् अशीमहीति ये वै स्वस्ति संव्वत्सरं संतरन्ति ते जीवा ज्योतिर् अश्नुवते
text_mt: [With the words:] 'Living, may we attain the light,' those who cross over the year safely attain the light while living.

sanskrit_iast: māno ajñātā vṛjanā durādhyo māśivāso 'vakramur iti ye vai stenā ripavas te durādhyas tān eva tad atikrāmati
meaning: मानो अज्ञाता वृजना दुराध्यो माशिवासो ऽवक्रमुर् इति ये वै स्तेना रिपवस् ते दुराध्यस् तान् एव तद् अतिक्रामति
text_mt: [With the words:] 'Let not unknown, malicious bands, let not the unpropitious trample upon us,' those who are thieves and enemies are the malicious ones; those indeed he steps over thereby.

sanskrit_iast: tvayā vyayaṃ pravataḥ śaśvatīr apo 'ti śūra tarāma so 'tisaṃvvatsaro vai pravataḥ śaśvatīr apas tam eva tat taranti
meaning: त्वया व्ययं प्रवतः शश्वतीर् अपो ऽति शूर तराम सो ऽतिसंव्वत्सरो वै प्रवतः शश्वतीर् अपस् तम् एव तत् तरन्ति
text_mt: [With the words:] 'Through thee, O hero, may we cross over the continuous waters in downward course,' the continuous waters in downward course are indeed the year; that indeed they cross over thereby.

sanskrit_iast: adyādyāśvaḥ śvas tvām idā hyo naro vayam enam idā hya iti saṃtanayaḥ pragāthā bhavanti teṣām ekaḥ kāryaḥ salomatvāya śvastanam evābhisaṃtanvanti
meaning: अद्याद्याश्वः श्वस् त्वाम् इदा ह्यो नरो वयम् एनम् इदा ह्य इति संतनयः प्रगाथा भवन्ति तेषाम् एकः कार्यः सलोमत्वाय श्वस्तनम् एवाभिसंतन्वन्ति
text_mt: There are the connecting pragāthas: 'Today, today, tomorrow, tomorrow, thee now, yesterday, O men, we him now, yesterday'; one of them is to be performed for consistency; they thereby connect with the morrow.

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhur indra kratuṃ na ābharety eva kāryaṃ samṛddhyai
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुर् इन्द्र क्रतुं न आभरेत्य् एव कार्यं समृद्ध्यै
text_mt: Moreover, however, they say: only [the pragātha] 'Indra, bring us insight' is to be performed, for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: pratyavarohiṇo māsā bhavanti
meaning: प्रत्यवरोहिणो मासा भवन्ति
text_mt: The months are descending.

sanskrit_iast: yathā vā ito vṛkṣaṃ rohanty evam enaṃ pratyavarohanti svargam eva lokaṃ rūḍhvāsmiṃl loke pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: यथा वा इतो वृक्षं रोहन्त्य् एवम् एनं प्रत्यवरोहन्ति स्वर्गम् एव लोकं रूढ्वास्मिंल् लोके प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: Just as they climb up a tree from here, so do they climb down it. Having climbed to the heavenly world, they establish themselves in this world.

sanskrit_iast: gauś cāyuś ca stomau bhavataḥ
meaning: गौश् चायुश् च स्तोमौ भवतः
text_mt: The Go and the Āyus are the two stomas.

sanskrit_iast: dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: द्विपाद् यजमानः प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: The sacrificer is two-footed; [it is] for firm standing.

sanskrit_iast: ūnātiriktau bhavata ūnātiriktaṃ vā anu prajāḥ prajāyante prajātyai
meaning: ऊनातिरिक्तौ भवत ऊनातिरिक्तं वा अनु प्रजाः प्रजायन्ते प्रजात्यै
text_mt: They are deficient and redundant; after the deficient and redundant, indeed, creatures are propagated; [it is] for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: vairājau bhavato 'nnaṃ virāḍ annādya eva pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: वैराजौ भवतो ऽन्नं विराड् अन्नाद्य एव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: They are in the manner of the Virāj; food is the virāj; they establish themselves in food.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni bhavanti
meaning: द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि भवन्ति
text_mt: There are the ten days of the twelve-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: virāḍ vā eṣā samṛddhā yad daśāhāni virājy eva samṛddhāyāṃ pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: विराड् वा एषा समृद्धा यद् दशाहानि विराज्य् एव समृद्धायां प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: The ten days are indeed this complete virāj; they establish themselves in the complete virāj.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣthāni bhavanti vīryaṃ vai pṛṣṭhāni vīrya eva pratitiṣṭhanti cchandomā bhavanti paśavo vai cchandomāḥ paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanty athaitad daśamam ahar āptastomam āptacchanda āptavibhaktikam aniruktaṃ prājāpatyam
meaning: पृष्थानि भवन्ति वीर्यं वै पृष्ठानि वीर्य एव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति च्छन्दोमा भवन्ति पशवो वै च्छन्दोमाः पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठन्त्य् अथैतद् दशमम् अहर् आप्तस्तोमम् आप्तच्छन्द आप्तविभक्तिकम् अनिरुक्तं प्राजापत्यम्
text_mt: There are the pṛṣṭhas; the pṛṣṭhas are indeed virility; they establish themselves in virility. There are the Chandomas; cattle are indeed the Chandomas; they establish themselves in cattle. Now this tenth day has obtained its stoma, obtained its metre, obtained its division; it is unexpressed, belonging to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: yad adhyāhur ati tad recayanti tasmān na vyucyam
meaning: यद् अध्याहुर् अति तद् रेचयन्ति तस्मान् न व्युच्यम्
text_mt: In that they speak beyond, they cause an excess; therefore it is not to be explained.

sanskrit_iast: parokṣam anuṣṭubham upayanti prajāpatir vā anuṣṭub yat pratyakṣam upeyuḥ prajāpatim ṛccheyuḥ
meaning: परोक्षम् अनुष्टुभम् उपयन्ति प्रजापतिर् वा अनुष्टुब् यत् प्रत्यक्षम् उपेयुः प्रजापतिम् ऋच्छेयुः
text_mt: They approach the anuṣṭubh cryptically; Prajāpati is indeed the anuṣṭubh; if they were to approach it visibly, they would collide with Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: yo vai sattrasya sad veda sad bhavati vāmadevyaṃ vai sāmnāṃ sad agnir devatānāṃ virāṭ chandasāṃ trayastriṃśaḥ stomānāṃ tāny eva tad ekadhā saṃbhṛtyottiṣṭhanti
meaning: यो वै सत्त्रस्य सद् वेद सद् भवति वामदेव्यं वै साम्नां सद् अग्निर् देवतानां विराट् छन्दसां त्रयस्त्रिंशः स्तोमानां तान्य् एव तद् एकधा संभृत्योत्तिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: He who knows the real of the sacrificial session becomes real. The Vāmadevya is the real among sāmans, Agni among the deities, the virāj among metres, the thirty-three-fold among stomas. Having collected these in one, they rise [from the session].

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti yataḥ sattrād udasthātā3sthitā3d iti
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति यतः सत्त्राद् उदस्थाता3स्थिता3द् इति
text_mt: The theologians say: 'Did you rise from a moving or from a stationary sacrificial session?'

sanskrit_iast: ye rathantareṇa stutvottiṣṭhanti te yata uttiṣṭhanti tān brūyād apratiṣṭhānā bhaviṣyantīti ye bṛhatā stutyottiṣṭhanti te sthitād uttiṣṭhanti tān brūyāt sthāyukaiṣāṃ śrīr bhaviṣyati na vasīyāṃso bhaviṣyantīti
meaning: ये रथन्तरेण स्तुत्वोत्तिष्ठन्ति ते यत उत्तिष्ठन्ति तान् ब्रूयाद् अप्रतिष्ठाना भविष्यन्तीति ये बृहता स्तुत्योत्तिष्ठन्ति ते स्थिताद् उत्तिष्ठन्ति तान् ब्रूयात् स्थायुकैषां श्रीर् भविष्यति न वसीयांसो भविष्यन्तीति
text_mt: Those who rise having chanted with the Rathantara, rise from a moving one; one should say of them: 'They will be without firm standing.' Those who rise having chanted with the Bṛhat, rise from a stationary one; one should say of them: 'Their fortune will remain fixed, they will not become wealthier.'

sanskrit_iast: ye vāmadevyena stutvottiṣṭhanti te sataḥ sad abhyuttiṣṭhanti pūrṇāt pūrṇam āyatanād āyatanam antarikṣāyatanā hi prajā
meaning: ये वामदेव्येन स्तुत्वोत्तिष्ठन्ति ते सतः सद् अभ्युत्तिष्ठन्ति पूर्णात् पूर्णम् आयतनाद् आयतनम् अन्तरिक्षायतना हि प्रजा
text_mt: Those who rise having chanted with the Vāmadevya, rise from the real to the real, from the full to the full, from the abode to the abode; for creatures have the intermediate space as their abode.

sanskrit_iast: trayastriṃśadakṣarāsu bhavati trayastriṃśaddevatāsv eva pratiṣṭhāyottiṣṭhanti
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिंशदक्षरासु भवति त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवतास्व् एव प्रतिष्ठायोत्तिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: It is on [verses] of thirty-three syllables; they rise having established themselves in the thirty-three deities.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyaṃ vai vāmadevyaṃ prajāpatāv eva pratiṣṭhāyottiṣṭhanti paśavo vai vāmadevyaṃ paśuṣv eva pratiṣṭhāyottiṣṭhanti
meaning: प्राजापत्यं वै वामदेव्यं प्रजापताव् एव प्रतिष्ठायोत्तिष्ठन्ति पशवो वै वामदेव्यं पशुष्व् एव प्रतिष्ठायोत्तिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: The Vāmadevya belongs to Prajāpati; they rise having established themselves in Prajāpati. The Vāmadevya is cattle; they rise having established themselves in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: patnīḥ saṃyājya prāñca udetyāyaṃ sahasramānava ity aticchandasāhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante
meaning: पत्नीः संयाज्य प्राञ्च उदेत्यायं सहस्रमानव इत्य् अतिच्छन्दसाहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते
text_mt: Having performed the Patnīsaṃyājas, going forth towards the east, they attend upon the Āhavanīya with the aticchandas [verse]: 'This thousandfold-minded one.'

sanskrit_iast: ime vai lokā aticchandā eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: इमे वै लोका अतिच्छन्दा एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: These worlds are the aticchandas; they establish themselves in these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: gor iti nidhanaṃ bhavati virājo vā etad rūpaṃ yad gaur virājy eva pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: गोर् इति निधनं भवति विराजो वा एतद् रूपं यद् गौर् विराज्य् एव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: The cadence is 'Gauḥ' (Cow). A cow is indeed this form of the virāj; they establish themselves in the virāj.

sanskrit_iast: pratyañcaḥ prapadya sārparājñyā ṛgbhiḥ stuvanti
meaning: प्रत्यञ्चः प्रपद्य सार्पराज्ञ्या ऋग्भिः स्तुवन्ति
text_mt: Entering westward, they praise with the verses of the Serpent Queen.

sanskrit_iast: arbudaḥ sarpa etābhir mṛtāṃ tvacam apāhata mṛtām evaitābhirs tvacam apaghnate
meaning: अर्बुदः सर्प एताभिर् मृतां त्वचम् अपाहत मृताम् एवैताभिर्स् त्वचम् अपघ्नते
text_mt: Arbuda the serpent cast off his dead skin by these [verses]; by these [verses] they cast off their dead skin.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vai sārparājñy asyām eva pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: इयं वै सार्पराज्ञ्य् अस्याम् एव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: The Serpent Queen is indeed this [earth]; they establish themselves on this [earth].

sanskrit_iast: tisṛbhiḥ stuvanti traya ime lokā eṣv eva pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: तिसृभिः स्तुवन्ति त्रय इमे लोका एष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: They praise with three [verses]; three are these worlds; they establish themselves in these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: manasopāvartayati
meaning: मनसोपावर्तयति

sanskrit_iast: manasā hiṅ karoti manasā prastauti manasodgāyati manasā pratiharati manasā nidhanam upayanty asamāptasya samāptyai
meaning: मनसा हिङ् करोति मनसा प्रस्तौति मनसोद्गायति मनसा प्रतिहरति मनसा निधनम् उपयन्त्य् असमाप्तस्य समाप्त्यै
text_mt: With the mind he makes the hiṅkāra, with the mind he chants the prastāva, with the mind he sings the udgītha, with the mind he chants the pratihāra, with the mind they undertake the cadence, for the completion of what is incomplete.

sanskrit_iast: yad vai vācā na samāpnuvanti manasā tat samāpnuvanti
meaning: यद् वै वाचा न समाप्नुवन्ति मनसा तत् समाप्नुवन्ति
text_mt: What they do not complete with speech, that they complete with the mind.

sanskrit_iast: pariśrite stuvanti brahmaṇaḥ parigṛhītyai
meaning: परिश्रिते स्तुवन्ति ब्रह्मणः परिगृहीत्यै
text_mt: They chant inside the enclosure, for the enclosure of the sacred word.

sanskrit_iast: brahmodyaṃ vadanti brahmavarcasa eva pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: ब्रह्मोद्यं वदन्ति ब्रह्मवर्चस एव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: They speak the theological riddle; they establish themselves in brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: caturhotāraṃ hotā vyācaṣṭe stutam eva tad anuśaṃsati nahi tat stutaṃ yad ananuśastam
meaning: चतुर्होतारं होता व्याचष्टे स्तुतम् एव तद् अनुशंसति नहि तत् स्तुतं यद् अननुशस्तम्
text_mt: The hotṛ recites the Caturhotṛ [formula]; he thereby recites along with what has been chanted; for that which is unrecited along with is not chanted.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiṃ parivadanty āptvevainaṃ tad vyācakṣate tāvad āpāmainam iti
meaning: प्रजापतिं परिवदन्त्य् आप्त्वेवैनं तद् व्याचक्षते तावद् आपामैनम् इति
text_mt: They speak of Prajāpati on all sides; having obtained him, as it were, they explain him, [saying:] 'Thus far have we obtained him.'

sanskrit_iast: gṛhapatir audumbarīṃ dhārayati gṛhapatir vā ūrjo yantorjam evaibhyo yacchati
meaning: गृहपतिर् औदुम्बरीं धारयति गृहपतिर् वा ऊर्जो यन्तोर्जम् एवैभ्यो यच्छति
text_mt: The master of the house holds the udumbara pillar; the master of the house is the restrainer of sap; he bestows sap upon them.

sanskrit_iast: vācaṃ yacchanti
meaning: वाचं यच्छन्ति

sanskrit_iast: dugdhānīva vai tarhi chandasāṃsi yātayāmāny antargatāni tāny eva tad rasenāpyāyayanti
meaning: दुग्धानीव वै तर्हि छन्दसांसि यातयामान्य् अन्तर्गतानि तान्य् एव तद् रसेनाप्याययन्ति
text_mt: Exhausted, as it were, at that time are the metres, their strength gone, turned inward; they refresh them with sap.

sanskrit_iast: atho śvastanam evābhisaṃtanvanti
meaning: अथो श्वस्तनम् एवाभिसंतन्वन्ति
text_mt: Moreover, they thereby connect with the morrow.

sanskrit_iast: ātmadakṣiṇaṃ vā etad yat sattram
meaning: आत्मदक्षिणं वा एतद् यत् सत्त्रम्
text_mt: This sacrificial session is one whose sacrificial fee is one's own self.

sanskrit_iast: yadā vai puruṣa ātmano 'vadyati yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tam abhyaśnute
meaning: यदा वै पुरुष आत्मनो ऽवद्यति यं कामं कामयते तम् अभ्यश्नुते
text_mt: When a man cuts off a portion from his own self, he attains whatever desire he desires.

sanskrit_iast: dvābhyāṃ lomāvadyati dvābhyāṃ tvacaṃ dvābhyāṃ māṃsaṃ dvābhyām asthi dvābhyāṃ majjānaṃ dvābhyāṃ pīvaś ca lohitaṃ ca
meaning: द्वाभ्यां लोमावद्यति द्वाभ्यां त्वचं द्वाभ्यां मांसं द्वाभ्याम् अस्थि द्वाभ्यां मज्जानं द्वाभ्यां पीवश् च लोहितं च
text_mt: With two [days] he cuts off the hair; with two, the skin; with two, the flesh; with two, the bone; with two, the marrow; with two, the fat and blood.

sanskrit_iast: śikhā anupravapante pāpmānam eva tad apaghnate laghīyāṃsaḥ svargaṃ lokam ayāmeti
meaning: शिखा अनुप्रवपन्ते पाप्मानम् एव तद् अपघ्नते लघीयांसः स्वर्गं लोकम् अयामेति
text_mt: They shave their tufts of hair; they thereby strike away evil, [thinking:] 'Lightened, may we go to the heavenly world.'

sanskrit_iast: atho gavām evānurūpā bhavanti sarvasyānnādyasyāvaruddhyai
meaning: अथो गवाम् एवानुरूपा भवन्ति सर्वस्यान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै
text_mt: Moreover, they conform to cattle, for the obtaining of all food.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata so 'ricyata so 'padyata taṃ devā abhisamagacchanta te 'bruvan mahad asmai vrataṃ saṃbharāma yad imaṃ dhinavad iti tasmai yat saṃvvatsaram annaṃ pacyate tat samabharaṃs tad asmai prāyacchaṃs tad avrajayat tad enam adhinon mahan maryā vrataṃ yad imam adhinvīd iti tan mahāvratasya mahāvratatvam
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत सो ऽरिच्यत सो ऽपद्यत तं देवा अभिसमगच्छन्त ते ऽब्रुवन् महद् अस्मै व्रतं संभराम यद् इमं धिनवद् इति तस्मै यत् संव्वत्सरम् अन्नं पच्यते तत् समभरंस् तद् अस्मै प्रायच्छंस् तद् अव्रजयत् तद् एनम् अधिनोन् महन् मर्या व्रतं यद् इमम् अधिन्वीद् इति तन् महाव्रतस्य महाव्रतत्वम्
text_mt: Prajāpati created creatures. He was emptied; he collapsed. The gods gathered around him. They said: 'Let us prepare a great rite for him, which may gladden him.' They gathered for him the food that ripens in a year; they gave it to him; it entered him; it gladdened him. 'Great, O comrades, was the rite which gladdened him!'—hence the Mahāvrata's nature as the Mahāvrata.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vāva mahāṃs tasyaitad vratam annam eva
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वाव महांस् तस्यैतद् व्रतम् अन्नम् एव
text_mt: Prajāpati is indeed the Great One; this rite of his is food.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur madhyaḥ saṃvvatsarasyopetyaṃ madhyato vā annaṃ jagdhaṃ dhinoti
meaning: तद् आहुर् मध्यः संव्वत्सरस्योपेत्यं मध्यतो वा अन्नं जग्धं धिनोति
text_mt: Concerning this they say: 'It is to be undertaken in the middle of the year; food eaten in the middle indeed gladdens.'

sanskrit_iast: tad v āhur yan madhyata upayanty ardham annādyasyāpnuvanty ardhaṃ sambaṭ kurvantīty upariṣṭād eva saṃvvatsarasyopetyaṃ saṃvvatsare vā annaṃ sarvaṃ pacyate
meaning: तद् व् आहुर् यन् मध्यत उपयन्त्य् अर्धम् अन्नाद्यस्याप्नुवन्त्य् अर्धं सम्बट् कुर्वन्तीत्य् उपरिष्टाद् एव संव्वत्सरस्योपेत्यं संव्वत्सरे वा अन्नं सर्वं पच्यते
text_mt: Concerning this, however, they also say: 'In that they undertake it in the middle, they obtain half of the food and throw half into confusion; it is to be undertaken at the end of the year; in a year indeed all food ripens.'

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśaṃ bhavati caturviṃśo vai saṃvvatsaro 'nnaṃ pañcaviṃśam
meaning: चतुर्विंशं भवति चतुर्विंशो वै संव्वत्सरो ऽन्नं पञ्चविंशम्
text_mt: It is twenty-four-fold; the year is twenty-four-fold; food is the twenty-fifth.

sanskrit_iast: yad vā adaś caturviṃśaṃprāyaṇīyaṃ tad etad udayanīyam
meaning: यद् वा अदश् चतुर्विंशंप्रायणीयं तद् एतद् उदयनीयम्
text_mt: What is the twenty-four-fold opening day over there, that is this concluding day here.

sanskrit_iast: yat saṃvvatsaram annaṃ saṃbharanti saiṣā pañcaviṃśy upajāyate
meaning: यत् संव्वत्सरम् अन्नं संभरन्ति सैषा पञ्चविंश्य् उपजायते
text_mt: Because they gather food during the year, this twenty-fifth [day] is produced.

sanskrit_iast: vāmadevyaṃ mahāvrataṃ kāryam
meaning: वामदेव्यं महाव्रतं कार्यम्
text_mt: The Mahāvrata should be performed with the Vāmadevya [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: trivṛc chiro bhavati
meaning: त्रिवृच् छिरो भवति

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd dhy eva śiro loma tvag asthi
meaning: त्रिवृद् ध्य् एव शिरो लोम त्वग् अस्थि
text_mt: For the head indeed is threefold: hair, skin, bone.

sanskrit_iast: pāṅkta itara ātmā loma tvaṅ māṃsam asthi majjā
meaning: पाङ्क्त इतर आत्मा लोम त्वङ् मांसम् अस्थि मज्जा
text_mt: The rest of the body is fivefold: hair, skin, flesh, bone, marrow.

sanskrit_iast: sakṛd dhiṅkṛtena śirasā pārācā stuvate
meaning: सकृद् धिङ्कृतेन शिरसा पाराचा स्तुवते
text_mt: With the head, having uttered 'hiṅ' only once, they praise straight onwards.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāc chiro 'ṅgāni medyanti nānumedyati na kṛśyanty anukṛśyati
meaning: तस्माच् छिरो ऽङ्गानि मेद्यन्ति नानुमेद्यति न कृश्यन्त्य् अनुकृश्यति
text_mt: Therefore, though the limbs grow fat, the head does not grow fat along with them; nor, when they grow thin, does it grow thin along with them.

sanskrit_iast: punar abhyāvartam itareṇātmanā stuvate tasmād itara ātmā medyati ca kṛśyati ca
meaning: पुनर् अभ्यावर्तम् इतरेणात्मना स्तुवते तस्माद् इतर आत्मा मेद्यति च कृश्यति च
text_mt: With the rest of the body they praise returning again and again; therefore the rest of the body both grows fat and grows thin.

sanskrit_iast: arkavatīṣu gāyatrīṣu śiro bhavati
meaning: अर्कवतीषु गायत्रीषु शिरो भवति
text_mt: The head consists of gāyatrī [verses] containing the word 'arka'.

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ vā arko brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatry annādyaṃ caivaibhyo brahmavarcasaṃ ca mukhato dadhāti
meaning: अन्नं वा अर्को ब्रह्मवर्चसं गायत्र्य् अन्नाद्यं चैवैभ्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसं च मुखतो दधाति
text_mt: The arka is food, the gāyatrī is brahminical lustre; he places both food and brahminical lustre at their head.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśasaptadaśau pakṣau bhavataḥ prakṣābhyāṃ vai yajamāno vayo bhūtvā svargaṃ lokam eti
meaning: पञ्चदशसप्तदशौ पक्षौ भवतः प्रक्षाभ्यां वै यजमानो वयो भूत्वा स्वर्गं लोकम् एति
text_mt: The two wings are the fifteenfold and seventeenfold [stomas]; by means of the two wings the sacrificer, having become a bird, goes to the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: tāv āhuḥ samau kāryau pañcadaśau vā saptadaśau vā savīvadhatvāya
meaning: ताव् आहुः समौ कार्यौ पञ्चदशौ वा सप्तदशौ वा सवीवधत्वाय
text_mt: Regarding these two, they say: 'They should be made equal, either both fifteenfold or both seventeenfold, for the sake of balance.'

sanskrit_iast: tad v āhur yat samau bhavata ekavīryau tarhi bhavata iti pañcadaśasaptadaśāv eva kāryau sācīva vai vayaḥ pakṣau kṛtvāpatīyaḥ patati
meaning: तद् व् आहुर् यत् समौ भवत एकवीर्यौ तर्हि भवत इति पञ्चदशसप्तदशाव् एव कार्यौ साचीव वै वयः पक्षौ कृत्वापतीयः पतति
text_mt: Regarding this they also say: 'If they are equal, then they possess the same power; they should indeed be made fifteenfold and seventeenfold; for a bird, having made its wings slantwise, flies more swiftly.'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇato bṛhat kāryaṃ dakṣiṇo vā ardha ātmano vīryavattaraḥ
meaning: दक्षिणतो बृहत् कार्यं दक्षिणो वा अर्ध आत्मनो वीर्यवत्तरः
text_mt: On the right the Bṛhat should be performed; for the right half of the body is stronger.

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhur uttarata eva kāryaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsino 'rdhāt traiṣṭubhaṃ vai bṛhat traiṣṭubho vai brāhmaṇācchaṃsī traiṣṭubhaḥ pañcadaśastomaḥ
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुर् उत्तरत एव कार्यं ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनो ऽर्धात् त्रैष्टुभं वै बृहत् त्रैष्टुभो वै ब्राह्मणाच्छंसी त्रैष्टुभः पञ्चदशस्तोमः
text_mt: Now they also say: 'It should rather be performed on the left, from the side of the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; for the Bṛhat belongs to the triṣṭubh, the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin belongs to the triṣṭubh, and the fifteenfold stoma belongs to the triṣṭubh.'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇato rathantaraṃ kāryaṃ maitrāvaruṇasyārdhād gāyatraṃ vai rathantaraṃ gāyatro maitrāvaruṇo gāyatraḥ saptadaśastomaḥ
meaning: दक्षिणतो रथन्तरं कार्यं मैत्रावरुणस्यार्धाद् गायत्रं वै रथन्तरं गायत्रो मैत्रावरुणो गायत्रः सप्तदशस्तोमः
text_mt: On the right the Rathantara should be performed, from the side of the Maitrāvaruṇa; for the Rathantara belongs to the gāyatrī, the Maitrāvaruṇa belongs to the gāyatrī, and the seventeenfold stoma belongs to the gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśaṃ pucchaṃ bhavati
meaning: एकविंशं पुच्छं भवति
text_mt: The tail is twenty-one-fold.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśo vai stomānāṃ pratiṣṭhā tasmād vayaḥ pucchena pratiṣṭhāyotpatati pucchena pratiṣṭhāya niṣīdati
