text_mt: Just as a bitch carries her pups, biting together without crushing them, [or] as the wind blows gently over the waters.

sanskrit_iast: svadhūr vāmadevyaṃ geyam
meaning: स्वधूर् वामदेव्यं गेयम्
text_mt: The Vāmadevya should be sung having its own yoke.

sanskrit_iast: yo vai svadhūr vāmadevyaṃ gāyati svadhūr bhavati
meaning: यो वै स्वधूर् वामदेव्यं गायति स्वधूर् भवति
text_mt: He who sings the Vāmadevya having its own yoke becomes one who possesses his own yoke.

sanskrit_iast: yāty asyānyo niyānena nānyasya niyānena yāti
meaning: यात्य् अस्यान्यो नियानेन नान्यस्य नियानेन याति
text_mt: Another goes by his path; he does not go by another's path.

sanskrit_iast: na bṛhato na rathantarasyānurūpaṃ geyaṃ svenaivāyatanena geyam āyatanavān bhavati
meaning: न बृहतो न रथन्तरस्यानुरूपं गेयं स्वेनैवायतनेन गेयम् आयतनवान् भवति
text_mt: It should not be sung as a counterpart to the Bṛhat or to the Rathantara; it should be sung in its own domain; he comes to possess a proper domain.

sanskrit_iast: devā vai paśūn vyabhajanta te rudram antarāyaṃs tān vāmadevyasya stotra upekṣate
meaning: देवा वै पशून् व्यभजन्त ते रुद्रम् अन्तरायंस् तान् वामदेव्यस्य स्तोत्र उपेक्षते
text_mt: The gods divided the cattle; they excluded Rudra. He looks upon them at the chant of praise of the Vāmadevya.

sanskrit_iast: aniruktaṃ geyam
meaning: अनिरुक्तं गेयम्

sanskrit_iast: yan nirāha rudrāya paśūn apidadhāti rudras tāṃ samāṃ paśūn dhātuko bhavati
meaning: यन् निराह रुद्राय पशून् अपिदधाति रुद्रस् तां समां पशून् धातुको भवति
text_mt: If he utters it explicitly, he hands over the cattle to Rudra; Rudra becomes prone to destroy cattle for that year.

sanskrit_iast: revatīṣu vāmadevyena paśukāmaḥ stuvīta
meaning: रेवतीषु वामदेव्येन पशुकामः स्तुवीत
text_mt: One desirous of cattle should chant praise with the Vāmadevya on Revatī verses.

sanskrit_iast: āpo vai revatyaḥ paśavo vāmadevyam adbhya evāsmai paśūn prajanayati
meaning: आपो वै रेवत्यः पशवो वामदेव्यम् अद्भ्य एवास्मै पशून् प्रजनयति
text_mt: The Revatīs are waters; the Vāmadevya is cattle; from the waters indeed he produces cattle for him.

sanskrit_iast: anavartiḥ paśuto bhavati prajā svasya mīliteva bhavati
meaning: अनवर्तिः पशुतो भवति प्रजा स्वस्य मीलितेव भवति
text_mt: There is no turning away from cattle; his offspring becomes, as it were, close-knit.

sanskrit_iast: kavatībhyo hy eti prajāpateḥ
meaning: कवतीभ्यो ह्य् एति प्रजापतेः
text_mt: For it goes from the verses containing 'ka', [which belong] to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: imau vai lokau sahāstāṃ tau viyantāv abrūtāṃv vivāhaṃv vivahāvahai saha nāv astv iti
meaning: इमौ वै लोकौ सहास्तां तौ वियन्ताव् अब्रूतांव् विवाहंव् विवहावहै सह नाव् अस्त्व् इति
text_mt: These two worlds were together. Parting, they said: 'Let us contract a marriage; let there be [a bond] between us!'

sanskrit_iast: tayor ayam amuṣmai śyaitaṃ prāyacchan naudhasam asāv asmai
meaning: तयोर् अयम् अमुष्मै श्यैतं प्रायच्छन् नौधसम् असाव् अस्मै
text_mt: Of the two, this [world] gave the Śyaita to that one; that one [gave] the Naudhasa to this one.

sanskrit_iast: tata enayor nidhane viparyakrāmatāṃ devavivāho vai śyaitanaudhase
meaning: तत एनयोर् निधने विपर्यक्रामतां देवविवाहो वै श्यैतनौधसे
text_mt: Then their cadences crossed over. The Śyaita and the Naudhasa are indeed a divine marriage.

sanskrit_iast: pravasīyāṃsaṃ vivāham āpnoti ya evaṃv veda
meaning: प्रवसीयांसं विवाहम् आप्नोति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He obtains a more prosperous marriage, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: ito vā ime lokā ūrdhvāḥ kalpamānā yanty amuto 'rvāñcaḥ kalpamānā āyanti
meaning: इतो वा इमे लोका ऊर्ध्वाः कल्पमाना यन्त्य् अमुतो ऽर्वाञ्चः कल्पमाना आयन्ति
text_mt: From here these worlds go upward, ordering themselves; from there they come hitherward, ordering themselves.

sanskrit_iast: yad rathantareṇa stuvantīmaṃl lokaṃ tena yunakty antarikṣaṃv vāmadevyena naudhasenāmuṃ yad bṛhatā stuvanty amuṃl lokaṃ tena yanakty antarikṣaṃv vāmadevyena śyaitenemam
meaning: यद् रथन्तरेण स्तुवन्तीमंल् लोकं तेन युनक्त्य् अन्तरिक्षंव् वामदेव्येन नौधसेनामुं यद् बृहता स्तुवन्त्य् अमुंल् लोकं तेन यनक्त्य् अन्तरिक्षंव् वामदेव्येन श्यैतेनेमम्
text_mt: When they praise with the Rathantara, he yokes this world with it, the intermediate space with the Vāmadevya, that [world] with the Naudhasa. When they praise with the Bṛhat, he yokes that world with it, the intermediate space with the Vāmadevya, this [world] with the Śyaita.

sanskrit_iast: kḷptān imāl lokān upāste ya evaṃv veda
meaning: कॢप्तान् इमाल् लोकान् उपास्ते य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He attends upon these worlds well-ordered, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhadrathantare vai śaitanaudhase yad rathantarāya naudhasaṃ prati prayuñjanti bṛhad evāsmai tat prati prayuñjanti bṛhad dhy etat paro'kṣaṃ yan naudhasaṃ yad bṛhate śyaitaṃ prati prayuñjanti rathantaram evāsmai tat prati prayuñjanti rathantaraṃ hy etat paro'kṣaṃ yac chyaitam
meaning: बृहद्रथन्तरे वै शैतनौधसे यद् रथन्तराय नौधसं प्रति प्रयुञ्जन्ति बृहद् एवास्मै तत् प्रति प्रयुञ्जन्ति बृहद् ध्य् एतत् परोऽक्षं यन् नौधसं यद् बृहते श्यैतं प्रति प्रयुञ्जन्ति रथन्तरम् एवास्मै तत् प्रति प्रयुञ्जन्ति रथन्तरं ह्य् एतत् परोऽक्षं यच् छ्यैतम्
text_mt: The Śyaita and Naudhasa are indeed the Bṛhat and the Rathantara. When they apply the Naudhasa as a counterpart to the Rathantara, they apply the Bṛhat as a counterpart to it, for what is Naudhasa is cryptically the Bṛhat; when they apply the Śyaita as a counterpart to the Bṛhat, they apply the Rathantara as a counterpart to it, for what is Śyaita is cryptically the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: ubhabhyāṃ bṛhadrathantarābhyāṃ stute ya evaṃv veda
meaning: उभभ्यां बृहद्रथन्तराभ्यां स्तुते य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: Praise is chanted for him with both the Bṛhat and the Rathantara, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: devā vai brahma vyabhajanta tāṃ nodhāḥ kākṣīvata āgacchat te 'bruvann ṛṣir na āgaṃs tasmai brahma dadāmeti tasmā etat sāma prāyacchaṃs tasmān naudhasaṃ brahma vai naudhasam
meaning: देवा वै ब्रह्म व्यभजन्त तां नोधाः काक्षीवत आगच्छत् ते ऽब्रुवन्न् ऋषिर् न आगंस् तस्मै ब्रह्म ददामेति तस्मा एतत् साम प्रायच्छंस् तस्मान् नौधसं ब्रह्म वै नौधसम्
text_mt: The gods divided the sacred word. Nodhās, son of Kakṣīvat, approached them. They said: 'A seer has come to us; let us give him the sacred word.' They gave him this sāman; therefore it is called Naudhasa; the Naudhasa is indeed the sacred word.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavarcasakāma etena stuvīta brahmavarcasī bhavati
meaning: ब्रह्मवर्चसकाम एतेन स्तुवीत ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति
text_mt: One desirous of brahminical lustre should chant praise with this; he becomes endowed with brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: athaitac chyaitam
meaning: अथैतच् छ्यैतम्

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ paśūn asṛjata te 'smāt sṛṣṭā apākrāmaṃs tān etena sāmnābhivyāharat te 'smā atiṣṭhanta te śetyā abhavan yac chetyā abhavaṃs tasmāc chyaitaṃ paśavo vai śyaitam
meaning: प्रजापतिः पशून् असृजत ते ऽस्मात् सृष्टा अपाक्रामंस् तान् एतेन साम्नाभिव्याहरत् ते ऽस्मा अतिष्ठन्त ते शेत्या अभवन् यच् छेत्या अभवंस् तस्माच् छ्यैतं पशवो वै श्यैतम्
text_mt: Prajāpati created cattle. Having been created, they departed from him. He addressed them with this sāman. They stood still for him; they became docile. Because they became docile, therefore it is [called] the Śyaita. The Śyaita is indeed cattle.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāma etena stuvīta paśumān bhavati
meaning: पशुकाम एतेन स्तुवीत पशुमान् भवति
text_mt: One who desires cattle should chant with this; he becomes rich in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tāḥ sṛṣṭā aśocaṃs tāḥ śyaitena huṃmā ity abhyajighrat tato vai tāḥ samaidhanta samedhante tāṃ samāṃ prajā yatraivaṃ vidvāñ chyaitenodgāyati
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत ताः सृष्टा अशोचंस् ताः श्यैतेन हुंमा इत्य् अभ्यजिघ्रत् ततो वै ताः समैधन्त समेधन्ते तां समां प्रजा यत्रैवं विद्वाञ् छ्यैतेनोद्गायति
text_mt: Prajāpati created creatures. Having been created, they grieved. He sniffed at them with the Śyaita, saying 'huṃ-mā'. Then indeed they thrived. The creatures thrive for that year in which one who knows thus sings the udgītha with the Śyaita.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa vai yajamānasya prajāpatir yad udgātā yac chyaitena hiṅ karoti prajāpatir eva bhūtvā prajā abhijihgrati
meaning: एष वै यजमानस्य प्रजापतिर् यद् उद्गाता यच् छ्यैतेन हिङ् करोति प्रजापतिर् एव भूत्वा प्रजा अभिजिह्ग्रति
text_mt: The udgātṛ is indeed the Prajāpati of the sacrificer. In that he makes the sound 'hiṅ' with the Śyaita, he sniffs at the creatures, having himself become Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: vasunidhanaṃ bhavati paśavo vai vasu paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: वसुनिधनं भवति पशवो वै वसु पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: It has 'vasu' as its cadence. Cattle are indeed wealth. He firmly establishes himself in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: āṣkāraṇidhanaṃ kāṇvaṃv vaṣaṭkāraṇidhanam abhicaraṇīyasya brahmasāma kuryād abhinidhanaṃ mādhyandine pavamāne
meaning: आष्कारणिधनं काण्वंव् वषट्कारणिधनम् अभिचरणीयस्य ब्रह्मसाम कुर्याद् अभिनिधनं माध्यन्दिने पवमाने
text_mt: One should make the Kāṇva [sāman] with the āṣ-sound as its cadence, or with the vaṣaṭ-call as its cadence, the Brahman's chant for one practicing sorcery, [or make it] with 'abhi' as its cadence in the mid-day Pavamāna.

sanskrit_iast: deveṣur vā eṣā yad vaṣatkāro 'bhīti vā indro vṛtrāya vajraṃ prāharad abhītyevāsmai vajraṃ prahṛtya deveṣv ā vaṣaṭkāreṇa vidhyati
meaning: देवेषुर् वा एषा यद् वषत्कारो ऽभीति वा इन्द्रो वृत्राय वज्रं प्राहरद् अभीत्येवास्मै वज्रं प्रहृत्य देवेष्व् आ वषट्कारेण विध्यति
text_mt: The vaṣaṭ-call is indeed an arrow of the gods. Saying 'abhi' (forth!), Indra hurled his thunderbolt at Vṛtra. Having hurled the thunderbolt at him, saying 'abhi', he pierces him with the arrow of the gods by means of the vaṣaṭ-call.

sanskrit_iast: traikakubhaṃ paśukāmāya brahmasāma kuryāt tvam aṅga praśaṃsiṣa ity etāsu
meaning: त्रैककुभं पशुकामाय ब्रह्मसाम कुर्यात् त्वम् अङ्ग प्रशंसिष इत्य् एतासु
text_mt: One should make the Traikakubha the Brahman's chant for one who desires cattle, on these [verses beginning]: 'Do you indeed, O most mighty god, praise a mortal?'

sanskrit_iast: indro yatīn sālāvṛkebhyaḥ prāyacchat teṣāṃ traya udaśiṣyanta rāyovājo bṛhadgiriḥ pṛthuraśmis te 'bruvan ko naḥ putrān bhariṣyantīty aham intīndro 'bravīt tāṃs trikakub adhinidhāyācarat sa etat sāmāpaśyad yat trikakub apaśyat tasmāt traikakubham
meaning: इन्द्रो यतीन् सालावृकेभ्यः प्रायच्छत् तेषां त्रय उदशिष्यन्त रायोवाजो बृहद्गिरिः पृथुरश्मिस् ते ऽब्रुवन् को नः पुत्रान् भरिष्यन्तीत्य् अहम् इन्तीन्द्रो ऽब्रवीत् तांस् त्रिककुब् अधिनिधायाचरत् स एतत् सामापश्यद् यत् त्रिककुब् अपश्यत् तस्मात् त्रैककुभम्
text_mt: Indra handed over the ascetics to the hyenas. Three of them were left over: Rāyovāja, Bṛhadgiri, and Pṛthuraśmi. They said: 'Who will support us, our sons?' 'I shall,' said Indra. Placing them on three peaks, he went about. He saw this sāman. Because he saw it on three peaks, therefore it is [called] the Traikakubha.

sanskrit_iast: sa ātmānam eva punar upādhāvat tvam aṅga praśaṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyaṃ na tvad anyo maghavann asti ca marḍitendra bravīmi te vaca iti sa etena ca pragāthenaitena sāmnā sahasraṃ paśūn asṛjata tān ebhyaḥ prāyacchat te pratyatiṣṭhan
meaning: स आत्मानम् एव पुनर् उपाधावत् त्वम् अङ्ग प्रशंसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यं न त्वद् अन्यो मघवन्न् अस्ति च मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वच इति स एतेन च प्रगाथेनैतेन साम्ना सहस्रं पशून् असृजत तान् एभ्यः प्रायच्छत् ते प्रत्यतिष्ठन्
text_mt: He took refuge in himself again: 'Do you indeed, O most mighty god, praise a mortal? There is no other comforter than you, O Maghavan; O Indra, I speak your word.' With this pragātha and with this sāman he created a thousand cattle. He gave them to these [three]. They became firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ paśukāmaḥ syād yah pratiṣṭhākāma etasmin pragātha etena sāmnā stuvīta pra sahasraṃ paśūn āpnoti pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: यः पशुकामः स्याद् यह् प्रतिष्ठाकाम एतस्मिन् प्रगाथ एतेन साम्ना स्तुवीत प्र सहस्रं पशून् आप्नोति प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: He who desires cattle, he who desires firm standing, should chant with this sāman on this pragātha; he obtains a thousand cattle, he becomes firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: trivīryaṃ vā etat sāma trīndriyam aindrya ṛca aindraṃ sāmaindreti nidhanam indriya eva vīrye pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: त्रिवीर्यं वा एतत् साम त्रीन्द्रियम् ऐन्द्र्य ऋच ऐन्द्रं सामैन्द्रेति निधनम् इन्द्रिय एव वीर्ये प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: This sāman has threefold strength, threefold power: the verse belongs to Indra, the sāman belongs to Indra, and the cadence is 'o Indra'. He becomes firmly established in power, in strength.

sanskrit_iast: traiśokaṃ jyogāmayāvine brahmasāma kuryāt
meaning: त्रैशोकं ज्योगामयाविने ब्रह्मसाम कुर्यात्
text_mt: One should make the Traiśoka the Brahman's chant for one who has been long diseased.

sanskrit_iast: ime vai lokāḥ sahāsaṃs te 'śocantaṃs teṣām indra etena sāmnā śucam apāhan yat trayāṇāṃ śocatām apāhaṃs tasmāt traiśokam
meaning: इमे वै लोकाः सहासंस् ते ऽशोचन्तंस् तेषाम् इन्द्र एतेन साम्ना शुचम् अपाहन् यत् त्रयाणां शोचताम् अपाहंस् तस्मात् त्रैशोकम्
text_mt: These worlds were together; they grieved. Indra struck away their grief with this sāman. Because he struck away the grief of the three grieving ones, therefore it is [called] the Traiśoka.

sanskrit_iast: yāsmād apāhan sā puṃścalīṃ prāviśad yām antarikṣāt sā klībaṃ yām amuṣmāt sainasvinam
meaning: यास्माद् अपाहन् सा पुंश्चलीं प्राविशद् याम् अन्तरिक्षात् सा क्लीबं याम् अमुष्मात् सैनस्विनम्
text_mt: The [grief] that he struck away from this [earth] entered an unchaste woman; that from the intermediate space [entered] a eunuch; that from yonder [sky entered] a sinner.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt teṣāṃ nāśaitavyā ya eṣām āśāmeti tasmā eva śuco 'pabhajate
meaning: तस्मात् तेषां नाशैतव्या य एषाम् आशामेति तस्मा एव शुचो ऽपभजते
text_mt: Therefore one should not eat of their [food]. Whoever eats of their [food] partakes of that very grief.

sanskrit_iast: śucā vā eṣa viddho yasya jyog āmayati yat traiśokaṃ brahmasāma bhavati śucam evāsmād apahanti
meaning: शुचा वा एष विद्धो यस्य ज्योग् आमयति यत् त्रैशोकं ब्रह्मसाम भवति शुचम् एवास्माद् अपहन्ति
text_mt: He who is long diseased is pierced by grief. In that the Traiśoka is the Brahman's chant, he strikes away grief from him.

sanskrit_iast: diveti nidhanam upayanti vyuṣṭir vai divā vy evāsmai vāsayati
meaning: दिवेति निधनम् उपयन्ति व्युष्टिर् वै दिवा व्य् एवास्मै वासयति
text_mt: They sing with 'divā' ('by day') as the cadence. 'Divā' is dawn; it dawns for him.

sanskrit_iast: āṣkāraṇidhanaṃ kāṇvaṃ pratiṣṭhākāmāya brahmasāma kuryāt
meaning: आष्कारणिधनं काण्वं प्रतिष्ठाकामाय ब्रह्मसाम कुर्यात्
text_mt: One should make the Kāṇva [sāman] with the āṣ-sound as its cadence the Brahman's chant for one who desires firm standing.

sanskrit_iast: kaṇvo vā etat sāmarte nidhanam apaśyat sa na pratyatiṣṭhat sa vṛṣadaṃśasyāṣiti kṣuvata upāśṛṇot sa tad eva nidhanam apaśyat tato vai sa pratyatiṣṭhad yad etat sāma bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: कण्वो वा एतत् सामर्ते निधनम् अपश्यत् स न प्रत्यतिष्ठत् स वृषदंशस्याषिति क्षुवत उपाशृणोत् स तद् एव निधनम् अपश्यत् ततो वै स प्रत्यतिष्ठद् यद् एतत् साम भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: Kaṇva saw this sāman without a cadence; he did not become firmly established. He heard a tom-cat sneezing 'āṣ'. He saw that very cadence. Then indeed he became firmly established. That this sāman is [employed] is for firm standing.

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭhasya janitraṃ prajākāmāya brahmasāma kuryāt
meaning: वसिष्ठस्य जनित्रं प्रजाकामाय ब्रह्मसाम कुर्यात्
text_mt: One should make Vasiṣṭha's Janitra the Brahman's chant for one who desires offspring.

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭho vā etat putrahataḥ sāmāpaśyat sa prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata yad etat sāma bhavati prajātyai
meaning: वसिष्ठो वा एतत् पुत्रहतः सामापश्यत् स प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायत यद् एतत् साम भवति प्रजात्यै
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha, his sons having been slain, saw this sāman. He propagated with offspring and cattle. That this sāman is [employed] is for propagation.

sanskrit_iast: ātharvaṇaṃ lokakāmāya brahmasāma kuryāt
meaning: आथर्वणं लोककामाय ब्रह्मसाम कुर्यात्
text_mt: One should make the Ātharvaṇa the Brahman's chant for one who desires a world.

sanskrit_iast: atharvāṇo vā etal lokākāmāḥ sāmāpaśyaṃs tenāmartyaṃl lokam apaśyan yad etat sāma bhavati svargasya lokasya prajātyai
meaning: अथर्वाणो वा एतल् लोकाकामाः सामापश्यंस् तेनामर्त्यंल् लोकम् अपश्यन् यद् एतत् साम भवति स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य प्रजात्यै
text_mt: The Atharvans, desiring a world, saw this sāman; through it they saw the immortal world. That this sāman is [employed] is for the propagation of the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: abhīvartaṃ bhrātṛvyavate brahmasāma kuryāt
meaning: अभीवर्तं भ्रातृव्यवते ब्रह्मसाम कुर्यात्
text_mt: One should make the Abhīvarta the Brahman's chant for one who has a rival.

sanskrit_iast: abhīvartena vai devā asurān abhyavartanta yad abhīvarto brahmasāma bhavati bhrātṛvyasyābhivṛtyai
meaning: अभीवर्तेन वै देवा असुरान् अभ्यवर्तन्त यद् अभीवर्तो ब्रह्मसाम भवति भ्रातृव्यस्याभिवृत्यै
text_mt: By means of the Abhīvarta the gods approached and overcame the Asuras. That the Abhīvarta is the Brahman's chant is for overcoming the rival.

sanskrit_iast: śrāyantīyaṃ yajñavibhraṣṭāya brahmasāma kuryāt
meaning: श्रायन्तीयं यज्ञविभ्रष्टाय ब्रह्मसाम कुर्यात्
text_mt: One should make the Śrāyantīya the Brahman's chant for one who has fallen away from the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir uṣasam adhyait svāṃ duhitaraṃ tasya retaḥ parāpatat tad asyāṃ nyaṣicyata tad aśrīṇād idaṃ me mā duṣad iti tat sad akarot paśūn eva
meaning: प्रजापतिर् उषसम् अध्यैत् स्वां दुहितरं तस्य रेतः परापतत् तद् अस्यां न्यषिच्यत तद् अश्रीणाद् इदं मे मा दुषद् इति तत् सद् अकरोत् पशून् एव
text_mt: Prajāpati approached the Dawn, his own daughter. His semen fell away; it was poured out upon her. He mixed it, [thinking]: 'Let this of mine not be spoiled.' He made it real, namely, cattle.

sanskrit_iast: yac chrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma bhavati śrīṇāti caivenaṃ sac ca karoti
meaning: यच् छ्रायन्तीयं ब्रह्मसाम भवति श्रीणाति चैवेनं सच् च करोति
text_mt: In that the Śrāyantīya is the Brahman's chant, he mixes it and makes him real.

sanskrit_iast: devāś ca vā asurāś caiṣu lokeṣv aspardhanta te devāḥ prajāpatim upādhāvaṃs tebhya etat sāma prāyacchad etenainān kālayiṣyaddham iti tenainān ebhyo lokebhyo 'kālayanta yad akālayanta tasmāt kāleyam
meaning: देवाश् च वा असुराश् चैषु लोकेष्व् अस्पर्धन्त ते देवाः प्रजापतिम् उपाधावंस् तेभ्य एतत् साम प्रायच्छद् एतेनैनान् कालयिष्यद्धम् इति तेनैनान् एभ्यो लोकेभ्यो ऽकालयन्त यद् अकालयन्त तस्मात् कालेयम्
text_mt: The gods and the Asuras were contending for these worlds. The gods ran up to Prajāpati. He gave them this sāman, [saying]: 'With this you shall drive them away.' With it they drove them away from these worlds. Because they drove them away (akālayanta), therefore it is [called] the Kāleya.

sanskrit_iast: ebhyo vai lokebhyo bhrātṛvyaṃ kālayate ya evaṃv veda
meaning: एभ्यो वै लोकेभ्यो भ्रातृव्यं कालयते य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He drives away his rival from these worlds who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: stomo vai deveṣu taro nāmāsīd yajño 'sureṣu vidadvasus te devās tarobhir vo vidadvasum iti stomena yajñam asurāṇām āvṛñjata
meaning: स्तोमो वै देवेषु तरो नामासीद् यज्ञो ऽसुरेषु विदद्वसुस् ते देवास् तरोभिर् वो विदद्वसुम् इति स्तोमेन यज्ञम् असुराणाम् आवृञ्जत
text_mt: Among the gods there was a stoma named 'Taras'; among the Asuras the sacrifice was 'Vidadvasu'. The gods, with the verse 'With their speeds, Vidadvasu for you', seized the sacrifice of the Asuras by means of the stoma.

sanskrit_iast: stomena yajñaṃ bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃv veda
meaning: स्तोमेन यज्ञं भ्रातृव्यस्य वृङ्क्ते य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He seizes the sacrifice of his rival by means of the stoma who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: sāhdyā vai nāma devā āsaṃs te 'vacchidya tṛtīyasavanaṃ mādhyandinena savanena saha svargaṃl lokam āyaṃs tad devāḥ lokeyena samatanvan yat kāleyaṃ bhavati tṛtīyasavanasya saṃtatyai
meaning: साह्द्या वै नाम देवा आसंस् ते ऽवच्छिद्य तृतीयसवनं माध्यन्दिनेन सवनेन सह स्वर्गंल् लोकम् आयंस् तद् देवाः लोकेयेन समतन्वन् यत् कालेयं भवति तृतीयसवनस्य संतत्यै
text_mt: There were gods named Sādhyas. Having cut off the third pressing together with the mid-day pressing, they went to the heavenly world. The gods then continued it by means of the [Kā]leya. That the Kāleya is [employed] is for the continuity of the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: vidadvasu vai tṛtīyasavanaṃ yat tarobhir vo vidadvasum iti prastauti tṛtīyasavanam eva tad abhyativadati
meaning: विदद्वसु वै तृतीयसवनं यत् तरोभिर् वो विदद्वसुम् इति प्रस्तौति तृतीयसवनम् एव तद् अभ्यतिवदति
text_mt: Vidadvasu is indeed the third pressing. In that he chants the prastāva with 'With their speeds, Vidadvasu for you', he thereby addresses the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi vai rūpāṇi kāleyaṃ yat padaprastāvaṃ tena rāthantaraṃ yad bṛhato rohān rohati tena bārhataṃ yat stobhavān pratihāras tena bārhataṃ yad dravadiḍaṃ tena rāthantaraṃ sarveṣv eva rūpeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: सर्वाणि वै रूपाणि कालेयं यत् पदप्रस्तावं तेन राथन्तरं यद् बृहतो रोहान् रोहति तेन बार्हतं यत् स्तोभवान् प्रतिहारस् तेन बार्हतं यद् द्रवदिडं तेन राथन्तरं सर्वेष्व् एव रूपेषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: The Kāleya has all characteristics. In that it has the prastāva of a quarter-verse, it has the nature of the Rathantara; in that it ascends the ascents of the Bṛhat, it has the nature of the Bṛhat; in that the pratihāra has a stobha, it has the nature of the Bṛhat; in that it has a running iḍā, it has the nature of the Rathantara. He becomes firmly established in all forms.

sanskrit_iast: sādhyā vai nāma devā āsaṃs te sarveṇa yajñena saha svargaṃl lokam āyaṃs te devāśīchandāṃsy abruvan somam āharateti te jagatīṃ prāhiṇvan sā trīṇy akṣarāṇi hitvaikākṣarā bhūtvāgacchat triṣṭubhaṃ prāhiṇvan saikam akṣaraṃ hitvā tryakṣarā bhūtvāgacchad gāyatrīṃ prāhiṇvaṃś caturakṣarāṇi vai tarhi cchandāṃsy āsan sā tāni cākṣarāṇi haranty āgacchad aṣṭākṣarā bhūtvā trīṇi ca savanāni hastābhyāṃ dve savane dantair daṃṣṭvā tṛtīyasavanaṃ tasmād dve aṃśumatī savane dhītaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ dantair hi tad daṃṣṭvā dhayanty aharat tasya ye hriyamāṇasyāṃśavaḥ parāpataṃs te pūtīkā abhavan yāni puṣpāṇy avāśīyanta tāny arjjunāni yat prāprothat te praprothās tasmāt tṛtīyasavana āśiram avanayanti yam eva taṃ gāvaḥ somam adanti tasya taṃ rasam avanayanti sasomatvāya
meaning: साध्या वै नाम देवा आसंस् ते सर्वेण यज्ञेन सह स्वर्गंल् लोकम् आयंस् ते देवाशीछन्दांस्य् अब्रुवन् सोमम् आहरतेति ते जगतीं प्राहिण्वन् सा त्रीण्य् अक्षराणि हित्वैकाक्षरा भूत्वागच्छत् त्रिष्टुभं प्राहिण्वन् सैकम् अक्षरं हित्वा त्र्यक्षरा भूत्वागच्छद् गायत्रीं प्राहिण्वंश् चतुरक्षराणि वै तर्हि च्छन्दांस्य् आसन् सा तानि चाक्षराणि हरन्त्य् आगच्छद् अष्टाक्षरा भूत्वा त्रीणि च सवनानि हस्ताभ्यां द्वे सवने दन्तैर् दंष्ट्वा तृतीयसवनं तस्माद् द्वे अंशुमती सवने धीतं तृतीयसवनं दन्तैर् हि तद् दंष्ट्वा धयन्त्य् अहरत् तस्य ये ह्रियमाणस्यांशवः परापतंस् ते पूतीका अभवन् यानि पुष्पाण्य् अवाशीयन्त तान्य् अर्ज्जुनानि यत् प्राप्रोथत् ते प्रप्रोथास् तस्मात् तृतीयसवन आशिरम् अवनयन्ति यम् एव तं गावः सोमम् अदन्ति तस्य तं रसम् अवनयन्ति ससोमत्वाय
text_mt: The gods named Sādhyas indeed existed. They went to the world of heaven together with the entire sacrifice. Those gods said to the metres: 'Fetch the Soma.' They sent the jagatī. Leaving three syllables behind, having become one syllable, she returned. They sent the triṣṭubh. Leaving one syllable behind, having become three syllables, she returned. They sent the gāyatrī. In those days, indeed, the metres were four-syllabled. She returned carrying those syllables, having become eight-syllabled, and the three pressings: two pressings with her two hands, [and] clamping the third pressing with her teeth. Therefore, two pressings are with shoots, [and] the third pressing is sucked, for she carried it away clamping it with her teeth and sucking it. The shoots of it that fell off as it was being carried, they became pūtīka plants; the flowers that dropped off, they became arjuna trees; what snorted forth, that became the praprothas. Therefore, at the third pressing, they pour on the milk-mixture. The very essence of that Soma which the cows eat, they pour in for the sake of its having [its full] Soma-nature.

sanskrit_iast: te triṣṭub jagatyai gāyatrīm abrūtām upa tvāyāveti sābravīt kiṃ me tataḥ syād iti yat kāmayasa ity abrūtāṃ sābvravīn mama sarvaṃ prātaḥsavanam aham uttare savane praṇayānīti tasmād gāyatraṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ gāyatry uttare savane praṇayati
meaning: ते त्रिष्टुब् जगत्यै गायत्रीम् अब्रूताम् उप त्वायावेति साब्रवीत् किं मे ततः स्याद् इति यत् कामयस इत्य् अब्रूतां साब्व्रवीन् मम सर्वं प्रातःसवनम् अहम् उत्तरे सवने प्रणयानीति तस्माद् गायत्रं प्रातःसवनं गायत्र्य् उत्तरे सवने प्रणयति
text_mt: The triṣṭubh and the jagatī said to the gāyatrī: 'Let us two come along to you.' She said: 'What would be mine from that?' They said: 'Whatever you desire.' She said: 'All the morning pressing shall be mine, [and] I shall lead on the two subsequent pressings.' Therefore, the morning pressing belongs to the gāyatrī; the gāyatrī leads on the two subsequent pressings.

sanskrit_iast: tān triṣṭup tribhir akṣarair upait saikādaśākṣarā bhūtvā prājāyata tāṃ jagaty ekenākṣareṇopait sā dvādaśākṣarā bhūtvā prājāyata
meaning: तान् त्रिष्टुप् त्रिभिर् अक्षरैर् उपैत् सैकादशाक्षरा भूत्वा प्राजायत तां जगत्य् एकेनाक्षरेणोपैत् सा द्वादशाक्षरा भूत्वा प्राजायत
text_mt: The triṣṭubh approached her with three syllables; having become eleven-syllabled, she brought forth offspring. The jagatī approached her with one syllable; having become twelve-syllabled, she brought forth offspring.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād āhur gāyatrī vāva sarvāṇi cchandāṃsi gāyatrī hy etān poṣān puṣyanty aid iti
meaning: तस्माद् आहुर् गायत्री वाव सर्वाणि च्छन्दांसि गायत्री ह्य् एतान् पोषान् पुष्यन्त्य् ऐद् इति
text_mt: Therefore, they say: 'The gāyatrī indeed is all the metres, for the gāyatrī went on nourishing these nourishments.'

sanskrit_iast: indras tṛtīyasavanād bībhatsamāna udakrāmat tad devāḥ svādiṣṭhayeti asvadayan madiṣṭhayeti madvad akurvan pavasva soma dhārayety apāvayann indrāya pātave suta iti tato vai tad indra upāvartata yat svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayeti prastauti tṛtīyasavanasya sendratvāya
meaning: इन्द्रस् तृतीयसवनाद् बीभत्समान उदक्रामत् तद् देवाः स्वादिष्ठयेति अस्वदयन् मदिष्ठयेति मद्वद् अकुर्वन् पवस्व सोम धारयेत्य् अपावयन्न् इन्द्राय पातवे सुत इति ततो वै तद् इन्द्र उपावर्तत यत् स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठयेति प्रस्तौति तृतीयसवनस्य सेन्द्रत्वाय
text_mt: Indra stepped forth from the third pressing, feeling disgust. The gods made it sweet with [the verse]: 'With the sweetest' [SV 1.468]; they made it exhilarating with [the words]: 'with the most exhilarating'; they purified it with: 'purify yourself, O Soma, in a stream'; [they brought him back] with: 'pressed for Indra to drink.' Thereupon indeed Indra turned back to it. When he introduces [the chant] with 'With the sweetest, with the most exhilarating,' it is to provide the third pressing with Indra.

sanskrit_iast: svādiṣṭhā vai deveṣu paśava āsan madiṣṭhā asureṣu te devāḥ svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayeti paśūn asurāṇām avṛñjata
meaning: स्वादिष्ठा वै देवेषु पशव आसन् मदिष्ठा असुरेषु ते देवाः स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठयेति पशून् असुराणाम् अवृञ्जत
text_mt: The sweetest cattle indeed were among the gods, the most exhilarating among the asuras. The gods, with 'the sweetest, the most exhilarating,' wrested away the cattle of the asuras.

sanskrit_iast: paśūn bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃv veda
meaning: पशून् भ्रातृव्यस्य वृङ्क्ते य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He wrests away the cattle of his rival who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: tāsu saṃhitam
meaning: तासु संहितम्

sanskrit_iast: sādhyā vai nāmadevā āsaṃs te 'vacchidya tṛtīyasavanaṃ mādhyandinena savanena saha svargaṃl lokam āyaṃs tad devāḥ saṃhitena samadadhur yat samadadhus tasmāt saṃhitam
meaning: साध्या वै नामदेवा आसंस् ते ऽवच्छिद्य तृतीयसवनं माध्यन्दिनेन सवनेन सह स्वर्गंल् लोकम् आयंस् तद् देवाः संहितेन समदधुर् यत् समदधुस् तस्मात् संहितम्
text_mt: The gods named Sādhyas indeed existed. Having severed the third pressing, they went to the world of heaven along with the midday pressing. The gods joined it together with the Saṃhita. Because they joined it together, therefore it is the Saṃhita.

sanskrit_iast: kāleyaṃ purastād bhavati saṃhitam upariṣṭād etābhyāṃ hi tṛtīyasavanaṃ saṃtāyate
meaning: कालेयं पुरस्ताद् भवति संहितम् उपरिष्टाद् एताभ्यां हि तृतीयसवनं संतायते
text_mt: The Kāleya is in front; the Saṃhita is above. For by these two the third pressing is held together.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi vai rūpāṇi saṃhitaṃ yat padaprastāvaṃ tena rāthantaraṃ yad bṛhato rohān rohati tena bārhataṃ yad padanidhanaṃ tena rāthantaraṃ sarveṣv eva rūpeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: सर्वाणि वै रूपाणि संहितं यत् पदप्रस्तावं तेन राथन्तरं यद् बृहतो रोहान् रोहति तेन बार्हतं यद् पदनिधनं तेन राथन्तरं सर्वेष्व् एव रूपेषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: All forms indeed are the Saṃhita. In that its introduction consists of a verse-quarter, thereby it has the character of the Rathantara; in that it ascends the ascents of the Bṛhat, thereby it has the character of the Bṛhat; in that its cadence consists of a verse-quarter, thereby it has the character of the Rathantara. He firmly establishes himself in all forms.

sanskrit_iast: uṣṇikkakubhāv ete bhavataḥ
meaning: उष्णिक्ककुभाव् एते भवतः
text_mt: These two [metres], the uṣṇih and the kakubh, are [used here].

sanskrit_iast: uṣṇikkakubbhyāṃ vā indro vṛtrāya vajraṃ prāharat kakubhi parākramatoṣṇihā prāharat tasmāt kakubho madhyamaṃ padaṃ bhūyiṣṭhākṣaraṃ parākramaṇaṃ hi tad abhi samauhat tasmād uṣṇiha uttamaṃ padaṃ bhūyiṣṭhākṣaraṃ puro gurur iva hi vajraḥ
meaning: उष्णिक्ककुब्भ्यां वा इन्द्रो वृत्राय वज्रं प्राहरत् ककुभि पराक्रमतोष्णिहा प्राहरत् तस्मात् ककुभो मध्यमं पदं भूयिष्ठाक्षरं पराक्रमणं हि तद् अभि समौहत् तस्माद् उष्णिह उत्तमं पदं भूयिष्ठाक्षरं पुरो गुरुर् इव हि वज्रः
text_mt: With the uṣṇih and the kakubh, Indra hurled the vajra at Vṛtra. Stepping forward on the kakubh, he struck with the uṣṇih. Therefore, the middle verse-quarter of the kakubh has the most syllables, for it gathered itself for the stepping forward. Therefore, the last verse-quarter of the uṣṇih has the most syllables, for the vajra is as if heavy in front.

sanskrit_iast: vajraṃ bhrātṛvyāya praharati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: वज्रं भ्रातृव्याय प्रहरति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He hurls the vajra at his rival who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: nāsike vā ete yajñasya yad uṣṇikkakubhau tasmāt samānaṃ chandaḥ satī nānā yajñaṃv vahatas tasmāt samānāyā nāsikāyāḥ satyā nānā prāṇāv uccarataḥ
meaning: नासिके वा एते यज्ञस्य यद् उष्णिक्ककुभौ तस्मात् समानं छन्दः सती नाना यज्ञंव् वहतस् तस्मात् समानाया नासिकायाः सत्या नाना प्राणाव् उच्चरतः
text_mt: These two, the uṣṇih and the kakubh, are indeed the two nostrils of the sacrifice. Therefore, being of the same metre, they carry the sacrifice variously. Therefore, the two nostrils being the same, the two breaths go forth variously.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇā vā uṣṇikkakubhau tasmāt tābhyāṃ na vaṣaṭ kurvanti yad vaṣaṭ kuryuḥ prāṇān agnau pradadhyuḥ
meaning: प्राणा वा उष्णिक्ककुभौ तस्मात् ताभ्यां न वषट् कुर्वन्ति यद् वषट् कुर्युः प्राणान् अग्नौ प्रदध्युः
text_mt: The uṣṇih and the kakubh are indeed the breaths. Therefore, they do not pronounce the vaṣaṭ-call with them. If they were to pronounce the vaṣaṭ-call, they would place the breaths into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: tāsu saphaṃ vipham iva vai tṛtīyasavanaṃ tṛtīyasavanasya saphatvāyāthauṣkalam etena vai prajāpatiḥ puṣkalān paśūn asṛjata teṣu rūpam adadhād yad etat sāma bhavati paśuṣv eva rūpaṃ dadhāti
meaning: तासु सफं विफम् इव वै तृतीयसवनं तृतीयसवनस्य सफत्वायाथौष्कलम् एतेन वै प्रजापतिः पुष्कलान् पशून् असृजत तेषु रूपम् अदधाद् यद् एतत् साम भवति पशुष्व् एव रूपं दधाति
text_mt: On these [verses is chanted] the Sapha [sāman]. The third pressing is, as it were, hooffless; [this is done] for the third pressing's having hooves. Then the Auṣkala [sāman]. By this Prajāpati created copious cattle; he placed form into them. In that this sāman is [used], he places form in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: purojitī vo andhasa iti padyā cākṣaryā ca virājau bhavataḥ padyayā vai devāḥ svargaṃl lokam āyann akṣaryayā ṛṣayo nu prājānān yad ete padyā cākṣaryā ca virājau bhavataḥ svargasya lokasya prajñātyai
meaning: पुरोजिती वो अन्धस इति पद्या चाक्षर्या च विराजौ भवतः पद्यया वै देवाः स्वर्गंल् लोकम् आयन्न् अक्षर्यया ऋषयो नु प्राजानान् यद् एते पद्या चाक्षर्या च विराजौ भवतः स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य प्रज्ञात्यै
text_mt: [On the verses beginning] 'With your ancient liquor' [SV 1.470], there are two virāj [verses], one measured by feet and one measured by syllables. By the one measured by feet, the gods went to the world of heaven; by the one measured by syllables, the ṛṣis perceived it. In that these two virāj [verses], one measured by feet and one measured by syllables, are [used], it is for the discernment of the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: tāsu śyāvāśvam
meaning: तासु श्यावाश्वम्

sanskrit_iast: śyāvāśvam ārvanānasaṃ sattram āsīnaṃ dhanvodavahan sa etat sāmāpaśyat tena vṛṣṭim asṛjata tato vai sa pratyatiṣṭhat tato gātum avindata gātuvid vā etat sāma
meaning: श्यावाश्वम् आर्वनानसं सत्त्रम् आसीनं धन्वोदवहन् स एतत् सामापश्यत् तेन वृष्टिम् असृजत ततो वै स प्रत्यतिष्ठत् ततो गातुम् अविन्दत गातुविद् वा एतत् साम
text_mt: When Śyāvāśva Ārvanānasa was engaged in a sacrificial session, the water carried him off into the desert. He saw this sāman. By it, he created rain. Thereupon indeed he firmly established himself; thereupon he found a path. A path-finding [sāman] indeed is this sāman.

sanskrit_iast: vindate gātuṃ pratitiṣṭhaty etena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: विन्दते गातुं प्रतितिष्ठत्य् एतेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: He finds a path, he establishes himself firmly, who has praised with this.

sanskrit_iast: indras tṛtīyasavanād bībhatsamāna udakrāmat taṃ devāḥ śyāvāślvenaihāyi ehiyety anvāhvayan sa upāvartata yad etat sāma bhavati tṛtīyasavanasya sendratvāya
meaning: इन्द्रस् तृतीयसवनाद् बीभत्समान उदक्रामत् तं देवाः श्यावाश्ल्वेनैहायि एहियेत्य् अन्वाह्वयन् स उपावर्तत यद् एतत् साम भवति तृतीयसवनस्य सेन्द्रत्वाय
text_mt: Indra stepped forth from the third pressing, feeling disgust. The gods called after him with the Śyāvāśva [sāman]: 'O come hither, come hither!' He turned back. In that this sāman is [used], it is to provide the third pressing with Indra.

sanskrit_iast: athaitad āndhīgavam andhīgur vā etat paśukāmaḥ sāmāpaśyat tena sahasraṃ paśūn asṛjata yad etat sāma bhavati paśūnāṃ puṣṭyai madhye nidhanam aiḍaṃ bhavaty etena vai tṛtīyasavanaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yan madhye nidhanam aiḍaṃ na syād apratiṣṭhitaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ syāt
meaning: अथैतद् आन्धीगवम् अन्धीगुर् वा एतत् पशुकामः सामापश्यत् तेन सहस्रं पशून् असृजत यद् एतत् साम भवति पशूनां पुष्ट्यै मध्ये निधनम् ऐडं भवत्य् एतेन वै तृतीयसवनं प्रतिष्ठितं यन् मध्ये निधनम् ऐडं न स्याद् अप्रतिष्ठितं तृतीयसवनं स्यात्
text_mt: Now this Āndhīgava [sāman]. Andhīgu, desiring cattle, saw this sāman. By it he created a thousand cattle. In that this sāman is [used], it is for the flourishing of cattle. In the middle, the cadence contains the word 'iḍā'. By this indeed the third pressing is firmly established. If the cadence containing 'iḍā' were not in the middle, the third pressing would be without firm support.

sanskrit_iast: daśākṣaraṃ madhyato nidhanam upayanti daśākṣarā virāḍ virājy eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: दशाक्षरं मध्यतो निधनम् उपयन्ति दशाक्षरा विराड् विराज्य् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: They undertake the ten-syllabled cadence in the middle. The virāj has ten syllables. He firmly establishes himself in the virāj.

sanskrit_iast: abhi priyāṇi pavata iti kāvaṃ prājāpatyaṃ sāma
meaning: अभि प्रियाणि पवत इति कावं प्राजापत्यं साम
text_mt: [On the verse beginning] 'He purifies himself towards what is dear' [SV 1.471] is the Kāva [sāman], belonging to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: prajā vai priyāṇi paśavaḥ priyāṇi prajāyām eva paśuṣu pratitiṣtśuṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: प्रजा वै प्रियाणि पशवः प्रियाणि प्रजायाम् एव पशुषु प्रतितिष्त्शुषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: Offspring are what is dear; cattle are what is dear. He firmly establishes himself in offspring, in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: raśmī vā etau yajñasya yad auśanakāve devakośo vā eṣa yajñam abhisamubjito yad ete antato bhavato yajñasyāriṣṭyai
meaning: रश्मी वा एतौ यज्ञस्य यद् औशनकावे देवकोशो वा एष यज्ञम् अभिसमुब्जितो यद् एते अन्ततो भवतो यज्ञस्यारिष्ट्यै
text_mt: The Auśana and the Kāva are indeed the two reins of the sacrifice. This divine container holds the sacrifice enclosed. In that these two are at the end, it is for the uninjured state of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: devā vai brahma vyabhajanta tasya yo raso 'tyaricyata tad yajñāyajñīyam abhavat
meaning: देवा वै ब्रह्म व्यभजन्त तस्य यो रसो ऽत्यरिच्यत तद् यज्ञायज्ञीयम् अभवत्
text_mt: The gods divided the sacred word. Whatever sap of it was left over, that became the Yajñāyajñīya [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇo vā eṣa raso yad yajñāyajñīyaṃ yad yajñāyajñīyena stuvanti brahmaṇa eva rase yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: ब्रह्मणो वा एष रसो यद् यज्ञायज्ञीयं यद् यज्ञायज्ञीयेन स्तुवन्ति ब्रह्मण एव रसे यज्ञं प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: The sap of the sacred word indeed is this Yajñāyajñīya. In that they praise with the Yajñāyajñīya, he firmly establishes the sacrifice in the sap of the sacred word.

sanskrit_iast: yonir vai yajñāyajñīyam etasmād vai yoneḥ prajāpatir yajñam asṛjata tasmād yajñāyajñīyam
meaning: योनिर् वै यज्ञायज्ञीयम् एतस्माद् वै योनेः प्रजापतिर् यज्ञम् असृजत तस्माद् यज्ञायज्ञीयम्
text_mt: The womb indeed is the Yajñāyajñīya. From this womb Prajāpati created the sacrifice. Therefore, it is the Yajñāyajñīya.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād vā etena purā brāhmaṇā bahiṣpavamānam astoṣata yoner yajñaṃ pratanavāmahā iti yajñaṃ tataḥ stuvanti yonau yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: तस्माद् वा एतेन पुरा ब्राह्मणा बहिष्पवमानम् अस्तोषत योनेर् यज्ञं प्रतनवामहा इति यज्ञं ततः स्तुवन्ति योनौ यज्ञं प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: Therefore, with this [sāman], brāhmaṇas formerly praised the Bahiṣpavamāna, [thinking]: 'Let us extend the sacrifice from the womb.' When they praise the sacrifice from it, he firmly establishes the sacrifice in the womb.

sanskrit_iast: asureṣu vai sarvo yajña āsīt te devā yajñāyajñīyam apaśyaṃs teṣāṃ yajñā yajñā vo agnaya ity agnihotram avṛñjata girā girā ca dakṣasa iti darśapūrṇamāsau pra pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasam iti cāturmāsyāni priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam iti saumyam adhvaram
meaning: असुरेषु वै सर्वो यज्ञ आसीत् ते देवा यज्ञायज्ञीयम् अपश्यंस् तेषां यज्ञा यज्ञा वो अग्नय इत्य् अग्निहोत्रम् अवृञ्जत गिरा गिरा च दक्षस इति दर्शपूर्णमासौ प्र प्र वयम् अमृतं जातवेदसम् इति चातुर्मास्यानि प्रियं मित्रं न शंसिषम् इति सौम्यम् अध्वरम्
text_mt: All sacrifice was indeed with the Asuras. The gods saw the Yajñāyajñīya. From them, with "At every sacrifice, for you, O Agni...", they tore away the agnihotra; with "and with song for the capable...", the New and Full Moon sacrifices; with "Forth, forth we [praise] the immortal Jātavedas...", the Cāturmāsya rites; with "A dear friend, as it were, I would not fail to praise...", the Soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yajñā vo agnaye girā ca dakṣase pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam iti vai tarhi cchandāṃsy āsaṃs te devā abhyārambham abhinivartyaṃ cchandobhir yajñam asurāṇām avṛñjata
meaning: यज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरा च दक्षसे प्र वयम् अमृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शंसिषम् इति वै तर्हि च्छन्दांस्य् आसंस् ते देवा अभ्यारम्भम् अभिनिवर्त्यं च्छन्दोभिर् यज्ञम् असुराणाम् अवृञ्जत
text_mt: In the beginning the metres were indeed: "Sacrifices for you, O Agni, and with song for the capable; forth we [praise] the immortal Jātavedas; a dear friend, as it were, I would not fail to praise." Taking hold of them [and] bringing them round, the gods tore away the sacrifice of the Asuras by means of the metres.

sanskrit_iast: chandobhir yajñaṃ bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃv veda
meaning: छन्दोभिर् यज्ञं भ्रातृव्यस्य वृङ्क्ते य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows thus tears away the sacrifice of his rival by means of the metres.

sanskrit_iast: etad dha sma vā āha kūśāmbaḥ svāyavo brahmā lātavyaḥ kaṃ svid adya śiśumārī yajñapathe 'pyastā gariṣyati
meaning: एतद् ध स्म वा आह कूशाम्बः स्वायवो ब्रह्मा लातव्यः कं स्विद् अद्य शिशुमारी यज्ञपथे ऽप्यस्ता गरिष्यति
text_mt: On this point, Kūśāmba Svāyava, the Brahman of the Lātavyas, used to say: "Whom indeed will the female dolphin cast into the path of the sacrifice swallow today?"

sanskrit_iast: eṣā vai śiśumārī yajñapathe 'pyastā yajñāyajñīyaṃ yad girā girety āhātmānaṃ tad udgātā girati
meaning: एषा वै शिशुमारी यज्ञपथे ऽप्यस्ता यज्ञायज्ञीयं यद् गिरा गिरेत्य् आहात्मानं तद् उद्गाता गिरति
text_mt: This female dolphin cast into the path of the sacrifice is indeed the Yajñāyajñīya. When he says "girā-girā" [with song after song], the udgātṛ swallows himself [girati].

sanskrit_iast: airaṃ kṛtvodgeyam irāyāṃ yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayaty apramāyuka udgātā bhavati
meaning: ऐरं कृत्वोद्गेयम् इरायां यज्ञं प्रतिष्ठापयत्य् अप्रमायुक उद्गाता भवति
text_mt: Having made it into "irā" [nourishment], it should be chanted. He firmly establishes the sacrifice in nourishment; the udgātṛ does not become liable to die before his time.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānare vā etad udgātātmānaṃ pradadhāti yat pra pra vayam ity āha praprīṃ vayam iti vaktavyaṃv vaiśvānaram eva parikrāmati
meaning: वैश्वानरे वा एतद् उद्गातात्मानं प्रदधाति यत् प्र प्र वयम् इत्य् आह प्रप्रीं वयम् इति वक्तव्यंव् वैश्वानरम् एव परिक्रामति
text_mt: The udgātṛ indeed places himself into Vaiśvānara when he says "pra-pra vayam" [forth, forth we]. He should say "praprīṃ vayam"; he thereby steps around Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit_iast: yo vai nihnuvānaṃ cchanda upaiti pāpīyān ujjagivān bhavaty etad vai nihnuvānaṃ cchando yan na śaṃsiṣam iti nu śaṃsiṣam iti vaktavyaṃ suśaṃsiṣam iti vā na nihnuvānaṃ chanda upaiti vasīyān ujjagivān bhavati
meaning: यो वै निह्नुवानं च्छन्द उपैति पापीयान् उज्जगिवान् भवत्य् एतद् वै निह्नुवानं च्छन्दो यन् न शंसिषम् इति नु शंसिषम् इति वक्तव्यं सुशंसिषम् इति वा न निह्नुवानं छन्द उपैति वसीयान् उज्जगिवान् भवति
text_mt: Whoever approaches a metre that makes denial becomes worse off after chanting. This indeed is a metre that makes denial, namely "na śaṁsiṣam" [I would not praise]. He should say "nu śaṁsiṣam" [now I would praise], or "suśaṁsiṣam" [I would praise well]. He does not approach a metre that makes denial; he becomes better off after chanting.

sanskrit_iast: yasya vai yajñā vāgantā bhavanti vācaś chidreṇa sravanty ete vai yajñā vāgantā ye yajñāyajñīyāntā etad vācaś chidraṃ yad anṛtaṃ yad agniṣṭomayājy anṛtam āha tad anv asya yajñaḥ sravaty akṣareṇāntataḥ pratiṣṭhāpyam akṣareṇaiva yajñasya cchidram api dadhāti
meaning: यस्य वै यज्ञा वागन्ता भवन्ति वाचश् छिद्रेण स्रवन्त्य् एते वै यज्ञा वागन्ता ये यज्ञायज्ञीयान्ता एतद् वाचश् छिद्रं यद् अनृतं यद् अग्निष्टोमयाज्य् अनृतम् आह तद् अन्व् अस्य यज्ञः स्रवत्य् अक्षरेणान्ततः प्रतिष्ठाप्यम् अक्षरेणैव यज्ञस्य च्छिद्रम् अपि दधाति
text_mt: The sacrifices of him which end in speech flow out through the hole in speech. Those sacrifices indeed end in speech which end with the Yajñāyajñīya. Untruth is this hole in speech: when one who has offered the Agniṣṭoma speaks untruth, his sacrifice flows out after it. It should be firmly established at the end with a syllable; by means of the syllable he stops up the hole of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: virājo vā etad rūpaṃ yad akṣaraṃ virājy evāntataḥ pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: विराजो वा एतद् रूपं यद् अक्षरं विराज्य् एवान्ततः प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: This syllable is indeed the form of the virāj; at the end he is firmly established in the virāj.

sanskrit_iast: ito vai prātar ūrdhvāṇi cchandāṃsi yujyante 'muto 'vāñci yajñāyajñīyasya stotre yujyante yajñā vo agnaye girā ca dakṣasa iti dvādaśākṣaraṃ pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasam ity ekādaśākṣaraṃ priyaṃ mitraṃn na śaṃsiṣam ity aṣṭākṣaram
meaning: इतो वै प्रातर् ऊर्ध्वाणि च्छन्दांसि युज्यन्ते ऽमुतो ऽवाञ्चि यज्ञायज्ञीयस्य स्तोत्रे युज्यन्ते यज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरा च दक्षस इति द्वादशाक्षरं प्र वयम् अमृतं जातवेदसम् इत्य् एकादशाक्षरं प्रियं मित्रंन् न शंसिषम् इत्य् अष्टाक्षरम्
text_mt: From here, in the morning, the metres are yoked upwards; from yonder, they are yoked downwards in the chant of praise of the Yajñāyajñīya: "yajñā vo agnaye girā ca dakṣase" is of twelve syllables; "pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasam" is of eleven syllables; "priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṁsiṣam" is of eight syllables.

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭubham uttamāṃ saṃpādayatīyaṃ vā anuṣṭub asyām eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: अनुष्टुभम् उत्तमां संपादयतीयं वा अनुष्टुब् अस्याम् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: He brings about the anuṣṭubh as the last. This [earth] is the anuṣṭubh; he is firmly established on this very [earth].

sanskrit_iast: vāg vā anuṣṭub vācy eva pratitiṣṭhati jyaiṣṭhyaṃ vā anuṣṭub jaiṣṭhya eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: वाग् वा अनुष्टुब् वाच्य् एव प्रतितिष्ठति ज्यैष्ठ्यं वा अनुष्टुब् जैष्ठ्य एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: The anuṣṭubh is speech; he is firmly established in speech. The anuṣṭubh is seniority; he is firmly established in seniority.

sanskrit_iast: katham iva yajñāyajñīyaṃ geyam ity āhur yathānaḍvān prasrāvayamāṇa ittham iva cettham iva ceti
meaning: कथम् इव यज्ञायज्ञीयं गेयम् इत्य् आहुर् यथानड्वान् प्रस्रावयमाण इत्थम् इव चेत्थम् इव चेति
text_mt: They ask: "How should the Yajñāyajñīya be chanted?" As an ox while urinating, like this and like that.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaraṃ vā etad udgātānu prasīdann etīty āhur yad yajñāyajñīyasyarcaṃ saṃpratyāheti parikrāmatevodgeyaṃv vaiśvānaram eva parikrāmati
meaning: वैश्वानरं वा एतद् उद्गातानु प्रसीदन्न् एतीत्य् आहुर् यद् यज्ञायज्ञीयस्यर्चं संप्रत्याहेति परिक्रामतेवोद्गेयंव् वैश्वानरम् एव परिक्रामति
text_mt: They say: "The udgātṛ indeed goes sliding along after Vaiśvānara when he recites the verse of the Yajñāyajñīya continuously." It should be chanted as if stepping around; he thereby steps around Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānare vā etad adhvaryuḥ sadasyān abhisṛjati yad yajñāyajñīyasya stotram upāvartayati prāvṛtenodgeyaṃv vaiśvānareṇānabhidāhāya
meaning: वैश्वानरे वा एतद् अध्वर्युः सदस्यान् अभिसृजति यद् यज्ञायज्ञीयस्य स्तोत्रम् उपावर्तयति प्रावृतेनोद्गेयंव् वैश्वानरेणानभिदाहाय
text_mt: The adhvaryu indeed brings the members of the assembly into contact with Vaiśvānara when he introduces the chant of praise of the Yajñāyajñīya. It should be chanted covered, in order not to be scorched by Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit_iast: na ha tu vai pitaraḥ prāvṛtaṃ jānanti yajñāyajñīyasya vai stotre pitaro yathāyathaṃ jijñāsanta ākarṇābhyāṃ prāvṛtyaṃ tad eva prāvṛtaṃ tad aprāvṛtaṃ jānanti pitaro na vaiśvānaro hinasti
meaning: न ह तु वै पितरः प्रावृतं जानन्ति यज्ञायज्ञीयस्य वै स्तोत्रे पितरो यथायथं जिज्ञासन्त आकर्णाभ्यां प्रावृत्यं तद् एव प्रावृतं तद् अप्रावृतं जानन्ति पितरो न वैश्वानरो हिनस्ति
text_mt: The fathers, however, do not know one who is [completely] covered. At the chant of praise of the Yajñāyajñīya, the fathers wish to recognise each his own. It should be covered up to the ears; that is both covered and uncovered. The fathers recognise [him], and Vaiśvānara does not harm [him].

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ paścāt patnya upasṛjanti vaiśvānaram eva tac chamayanty āpo hi śāntiḥ
meaning: अपः पश्चात् पत्न्य उपसृजन्ति वैश्वानरम् एव तच् छमयन्त्य् आपो हि शान्तिः
text_mt: Behind, the wives pour water; they thereby appease Vaiśvānara, for water is appeasement.

sanskrit_iast: atho reta eva tat siñcanty āpo hi retaḥ
meaning: अथो रेत एव तत् सिञ्चन्त्य् आपो हि रेतः
text_mt: Moreover, they thereby pour semen, for water is semen.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇān ūrūn abhiṣiñcanti dakṣiṇato hi retaḥ sicyate
meaning: दक्षिणान् ऊरून् अभिषिञ्चन्ति दक्षिणतो हि रेतः सिच्यते
text_mt: They pour it over the right thighs, for semen is poured from the right side.

sanskrit_iast: mahad iva pratyūhyaṃ mana evāsya taj janayanti
meaning: महद् इव प्रत्यूह्यं मन एवास्य तज् जनयन्ति
text_mt: One should draw it back, as it were, greatly; they thereby generate his mind.

sanskrit_iast: udgātrā patnīḥ saṃkhyāpayanti retodheyāya
meaning: उद्गात्रा पत्नीः संख्यापयन्ति रेतोधेयाय
text_mt: They cause the wives to look together with the udgātṛ, for the placing of semen.

sanskrit_iast: hiṅkāraṃ prati saṃkhyāpayanti hiṅkṛtād dhi reto 'dhīyata
meaning: हिङ्कारं प्रति संख्यापयन्ति हिङ्कृताद् धि रेतो ऽधीयत
text_mt: They cause them to look together at the sound hiṅ; for from the uttered hiṅ semen is deposited.

sanskrit_iast: ātṛtīyāyāḥ saṃkhyāpayanti trivad dhi retaḥ
meaning: आतृतीयायाः संख्यापयन्ति त्रिवद् धि रेतः
text_mt: They cause them to look together until the third [verse]; for semen is threefold.

sanskrit_iast: devā vā agniṣṭomam abhijityokthāni nāśaknuvann abhijetuṃ te 'gnim abruvaṃs tvayā mukhenedaṃ cayāmeti so 'bravīt kiṃ me tataḥ syād iti yat kāmayasa ity abruvan so 'bravīn maddevatyāsūkthāni praṇayān iti
meaning: देवा वा अग्निष्टोमम् अभिजित्योक्थानि नाशक्नुवन्न् अभिजेतुं ते ऽग्निम् अब्रुवंस् त्वया मुखेनेदं चयामेति सो ऽब्रवीत् किं मे ततः स्याद् इति यत् कामयस इत्य् अब्रुवन् सो ऽब्रवीन् मद्देवत्यासूक्थानि प्रणयान् इति
text_mt: The gods, having conquered the Agniṣṭoma, were unable to conquer the ukthas. They said to Agni: "With you as our leader, let us conquer this." He said: "What shall be for me therefrom?" They said: "Whatever you desire." He said: "Let them bring forward the ukthas on verses dedicated to me."

sanskrit_iast: tasmād āgneyīṣūkthāni praṇayanti
meaning: तस्माद् आग्नेयीषूक्थानि प्रणयन्ति
text_mt: Therefore, they bring forward the ukthas on verses dedicated to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād u gāyatrīṣu gāyatracchandā hy agniḥ
meaning: तस्माद् उ गायत्रीषु गायत्रच्छन्दा ह्य् अग्निः
text_mt: And therefore on gāyatrī verses, for Agni has the gāyatrī metre.

sanskrit_iast: te 'gniṃ mukhaṃ kṛtvā sākam aśvenābhyakrāman yat sākam aśvenābhyakrāmaṃs tasmāt sākamaśvam
meaning: ते ऽग्निं मुखं कृत्वा साकम् अश्वेनाभ्यक्रामन् यत् साकम् अश्वेनाभ्यक्रामंस् तस्मात् साकमश्वम्
text_mt: Having made Agni their leader, they marched forth with the Sākamaśva. Because they marched forth with a horse together [sākam aśvena], therefore it is called the Sākamaśva.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt sākamaśvenokthāni praṇayanty etena hi tāny agre 'bhyajayan
meaning: तस्मात् साकमश्वेनोक्थानि प्रणयन्त्य् एतेन हि तान्य् अग्रे ऽभ्यजयन्
text_mt: Therefore, they bring forward the ukthas with the Sākamaśva, for with this they conquered them in the beginning.

sanskrit_iast: sa indro 'bravīt kaś cāhaṃ cedam anvavaiṣyāva ity ahaṃ ceti varuṇas taṃv varuṇo 'nvatiṣṭhad indra āharat tasmād aindrāvaruṇam anuśasyate
meaning: स इन्द्रो ऽब्रवीत् कश् चाहं चेदम् अन्ववैष्याव इत्य् अहं चेति वरुणस् तंव् वरुणो ऽन्वतिष्ठद् इन्द्र आहरत् तस्माद् ऐन्द्रावरुणम् अनुशस्यते
text_mt: That Indra said: "Who and I shall go down after this?" "I also," said Varuṇa. Varuṇa stood behind him; Indra brought it away. Therefore, [a recitation] addressed to Indra and Varuṇa is recited after.

sanskrit_iast: sa evābravīt kaś cāhaṃ cedam anvavaiṣyāva ity ahaṃ ceti bṛhaspatis taṃ bṛhaspatir anvatiṣṭad indra āharat tasmād aindrābārhaspatyam anuśasyate sa evābravīt kaś cāhaṃ cedam anvavaiṣyāva ity ahaṃ ceti viṣṇus taṃ viṣṇur anvatiṣṭad indra āharat tasmād aindrāvaiṣṇavam anuśasyate
meaning: स एवाब्रवीत् कश् चाहं चेदम् अन्ववैष्याव इत्य् अहं चेति बृहस्पतिस् तं बृहस्पतिर् अन्वतिष्टद् इन्द्र आहरत् तस्माद् ऐन्द्राबार्हस्पत्यम् अनुशस्यते स एवाब्रवीत् कश् चाहं चेदम् अन्ववैष्याव इत्य् अहं चेति विष्णुस् तं विष्णुर् अन्वतिष्टद् इन्द्र आहरत् तस्माद् ऐन्द्रावैष्णवम् अनुशस्यते
text_mt: He alone said: "Who and I shall go down after this?" "I also," said Bṛhaspati. Bṛhaspati stood behind him; Indra brought it away. Therefore, [a recitation] addressed to Indra and Bṛhaspati is recited after. He alone said: "Who and I shall go down after this?" "I also," said Viṣṇu. Viṣṇu stood behind him; Indra brought it away. Therefore, [a recitation] addressed to Indra and Viṣṇu is recited after.

sanskrit_iast: paśūn vā ebhyas tān āharat paśavo vā ukthāni paśukāma ukthena stuvīta paśumān bhavati
meaning: पशून् वा एभ्यस् तान् आहरत् पशवो वा उक्थानि पशुकाम उक्थेन स्तुवीत पशुमान् भवति
text_mt: He brought those cattle away for them. Cattle, indeed, are the ukthas. One who desires cattle should chant with an uktha; he becomes possessed of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhatā vā indro vṛtrāya vajraṃ prāharat tasya tejaḥ parāpatat tat saubharam abhavat
meaning: बृहता वा इन्द्रो वृत्राय वज्रं प्राहरत् तस्य तेजः परापतत् तत् सौभरम् अभवत्
text_mt: Indra hurled the vajra at Vṛtra with the Bṛhat. Its splendour flew away; it became the Saubhara.

sanskrit_iast: jāmi vā etad yajñe kriyata ity āhur yad rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ rathantaraṃ saṃdhir nāntarā bṛhatā stuvantīti yat saubhareṇa stuvanti bṛhataiva tad antarā stuvanti bṛhato hy etat tejo yat saubharam
meaning: जामि वा एतद् यज्ञे क्रियत इत्य् आहुर् यद् रथन्तरं पृष्ठं रथन्तरं संधिर् नान्तरा बृहता स्तुवन्तीति यत् सौभरेण स्तुवन्ति बृहतैव तद् अन्तरा स्तुवन्ति बृहतो ह्य् एतत् तेजो यत् सौभरम्
text_mt: They say: "A tautology indeed is committed in the sacrifice when the pṛṣṭha is the Rathantara, the saṃdhi is the Rathantara, and between them they do not chant with the Bṛhat." In that they chant with the Saubhara, they chant between them with the Bṛhat itself, for this Saubhara is the splendour of the Bṛhat.

sanskrit_iast: yadi bṛhat sāmātirātraḥ syāt saubharam ukthānāṃ brahma sāma kāryaṃ bṛhad eva tat tejasā samardhayati
meaning: यदि बृहत् सामातिरात्रः स्यात् सौभरम् उक्थानां ब्रह्म साम कार्यं बृहद् एव तत् तेजसा समर्धयति
text_mt: If the atirātra has the Bṛhat as its sāman, the Saubhara should be made the brahma-sāman of the ukthas; he thereby supplies the Bṛhat with splendour.

sanskrit_iast: yadi rathantarasāmnā saubharaṃ kuryād ajāmitāyai
meaning: यदि रथन्तरसाम्ना सौभरं कुर्याद् अजामितायै
text_mt: If with the Rathantara as sāman, he should use the Saubhara for the sake of variation.

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ vai svargaṃl lokaṃ yatāṃ diśo 'vlīyanta tāḥ saubhareṇo ity udastaṃbhuvaṃs tato vai tā adṛṃhanta tataḥ pratyatiṣṭhaṃs tataḥ svargaṃl lokaṃ prājānan yaḥ svargakāmaḥ syād yaḥ pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ saubhareṇa stuvīta pra svargaṃl lokaṃ jānāti pratitṣṭhati
meaning: देवानां वै स्वर्गंल् लोकं यतां दिशो ऽव्लीयन्त ताः सौभरेणो इत्य् उदस्तंभुवंस् ततो वै ता अदृंहन्त ततः प्रत्यतिष्ठंस् ततः स्वर्गंल् लोकं प्राजानन् यः स्वर्गकामः स्याद् यः प्रतिष्ठाकामः सौभरेण स्तुवीत प्र स्वर्गंल् लोकं जानाति प्रतित्ष्ठति
text_mt: When the gods were going to the heavenly world, the quarters collapsed. With the Saubhara [saying] "u", they propped them up. Then indeed they became firm; then they were firmly established; then they discerned the heavenly world. He who desires heaven, he who desires a firm foundation, should chant with the Saubhara; he discerns the heavenly world and is firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tāḥ sṛṣṭā āśanāyaṃs tābhyaḥ saubhareṇorg ity annaṃ prāyacchat tato vai tāḥ samaidhanta
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत ताः सृष्टा आशनायंस् ताभ्यः सौभरेणोर्ग् इत्य् अन्नं प्रायच्छत् ततो वै ताः समैधन्त
text_mt: Prajāpati created creatures. Once created, they were hungry. To them, with the Saubhara, saying "ūrg" [nourishment], he gave food. Then indeed they prospered.

sanskrit_iast: samedhante tāṃ samāṃ prajā yatraivaṃv vidvān saubhareṇodgāyati
meaning: समेधन्ते तां समां प्रजा यत्रैवंव् विद्वान् सौभरेणोद्गायति
text_mt: Creatures prosper for that year in which one who knows thus chants as udgātṛ with the Saubhara.

sanskrit_iast: tā abruvan subhṛtaṃ no 'bhārṣīr iti tasmāt saubharam
meaning: ता अब्रुवन् सुभृतं नो ऽभार्षीर् इति तस्मात् सौभरम्
text_mt: They said, 'You have maintained us well (subhṛtam).' Therefore it is called Saubhara.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭiṃ vā abhyastāṃ prāyacchad annam eva
meaning: वृष्टिं वा अभ्यस्तां प्रायच्छद् अन्नम् एव
text_mt: Verily, it was rain that he gave them, [namely] food.

sanskrit_iast: yo vṛṣṭikāmaḥ syād yo 'nnādyakāmo yaḥ svargakāmaḥ saubhareṇa stuvīta
meaning: यो वृष्टिकामः स्याद् यो ऽन्नाद्यकामो यः स्वर्गकामः सौभरेण स्तुवीत
text_mt: He who is desirous of rain, he who is desirous of food, he who is desirous of heaven should praise with the Saubhara.

sanskrit_iast: hīṣiti vṛṣṭikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryād ūrg ity annādyakāmāyo iti svargakāmāya
meaning: हीषिति वृष्टिकामाय निधनं कुर्याद् ऊर्ग् इत्य् अन्नाद्यकामायो इति स्वर्गकामाय
text_mt: He should make 'hīṣ' as the cadence for one desirous of rain, 'ūrj' for one desirous of food, [and] 'u' for one desirous of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: sarve vai kāmāḥ saubharaṃ sarveṣv eva kāmeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: सर्वे वै कामाः सौभरं सर्वेष्व् एव कामेषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: All desires are the Saubhara; he becomes firmly established in all desires.

sanskrit_iast: athaitan nārmedham
meaning: अथैतन् नार्मेधम्

sanskrit_iast: nṛmedhasam āṅgirasaṃ sattram āsīnaṃ śvabhir abhyāhvayan so 'gnim upādhāvat pāhi no agna ekayeti taṃv vaiśvānaraḥ paryudatiṣṭhat tato vai sa pratyatiṣṭhat tato gātum avindata
meaning: नृमेधसम् आङ्गिरसं सत्त्रम् आसीनं श्वभिर् अभ्याह्वयन् सो ऽग्निम् उपाधावत् पाहि नो अग्न एकयेति तंव् वैश्वानरः पर्युदतिष्ठत् ततो वै स प्रत्यतिष्ठत् ततो गातुम् अविन्दत
text_mt: While Nṛmedha Āṅgirasa was engaged in a sacrificial session, they challenged him with dogs. He ran up to Agni with [the verse]: 'Protect us, O Agni, with the single [verse].' Vaiśvānara rose up all around him; thereby he stood firm, thereby he found a way.

sanskrit_iast: gātuvid vā etat sāma vindate gātuṃ pratitiṣṭhaty etena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: गातुविद् वा एतत् साम विन्दते गातुं प्रतितिष्ठत्य् एतेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: This sāman is indeed a way-finder; praising with it, he finds a way [and] stands firm.

sanskrit_iast: naiva hy etad ahno rūpaṃ na rātrer yad ukthānām
meaning: नैव ह्य् एतद् अह्नो रूपं न रात्रेर् यद् उक्थानाम्
text_mt: For that which belongs to the ukthas is not the form of the day, nor of the night.

sanskrit_iast: kakup prathamāthoṣṇig atha purauṣṇig anuṣṭup tenānuṣṭubho nayanty acchāvākasāmnaḥ
meaning: ककुप् प्रथमाथोष्णिग् अथ पुरौष्णिग् अनुष्टुप् तेनानुष्टुभो नयन्त्य् अच्छावाकसाम्नः
text_mt: The first is a kakubh, then an uṣṇih, then a purauṣṇih, an anuṣṭubh. Thereby they lead [the uktha] from the anuṣṭubh of the Acchāvāka's sāman.

sanskrit_iast: hārivarṇaṃ bhavati
meaning: हारिवर्णं भवति

sanskrit_iast: asurā vā eṣu lokeṣv āsaṃs tān devā hariśriyam ity asmāl lokāt prāṇudanta virājasīty antarikṣād divo diva ity amuṣmāt
meaning: असुरा वा एषु लोकेष्व् आसंस् तान् देवा हरिश्रियम् इत्य् अस्माल् लोकात् प्राणुदन्त विराजसीत्य् अन्तरिक्षाद् दिवो दिव इत्य् अमुष्मात्
text_mt: The Asuras were in these worlds. The gods drove them out from this world with [the words] 'having the beauty of Hari', from the intermediate space with 'thou shinest', [and] from yonder [world] with 'day by day'.

sanskrit_iast: tad ya evaṃ vedaibhyo lokebhyo bhrātṛvyaṃ praṇudyemāṃl lokān abhyārohati
meaning: तद् य एवं वेदैभ्यो लोकेभ्यो भ्रातृव्यं प्रणुद्येमांल् लोकान् अभ्यारोहति
text_mt: He who knows thus, having driven his rival away from these worlds, ascends these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: harivarṇo vā etat paśukāmaḥ sāmāpaśyat tena sahasraṃ paśūn asṛjata yad etat sāma bhavati paśūnāṃ puṣṭaiḥ
meaning: हरिवर्णो वा एतत् पशुकामः सामापश्यत् तेन सहस्रं पशून् असृजत यद् एतत् साम भवति पशूनां पुष्टैः
text_mt: Harivarṇa, being desirous of cattle, saw this sāman. With it he produced a thousand cattle. Since this sāman is [used], it is for the thriving of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgirasaḥ svargaṃl lokaṃ yato rakṣāṃsy anvasacanta tāny etena harivarṇo 'pāhanta yad etat sāma bhavati rakṣasām apahatyai
meaning: अङ्गिरसः स्वर्गंल् लोकं यतो रक्षांस्य् अन्वसचन्त तान्य् एतेन हरिवर्णो ऽपाहन्त यद् एतत् साम भवति रक्षसाम् अपहत्यै
text_mt: The demons pursued the Aṅgirases as they were going to the heavenly world. Harivarṇa struck them down with this [sāman]. Since this sāman is [used], it is for the smiting of the demons.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhāni vā asṛjyanta teṣāṃ yat tejo raso 'tyaricyata tad devāḥ samabharaṃs tad udvaṃśīyam abhavat
meaning: पृष्ठानि वा असृज्यन्त तेषां यत् तेजो रसो ऽत्यरिच्यत तद् देवाः समभरंस् तद् उद्वंशीयम् अभवत्
text_mt: The pṛṣṭhas were created. Whatever brilliance, [whatever] sap was left over from them, the gods collected together; that became the Udvaṁśīya.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāṃ vā etat pṛṣṭhānāṃ tejo yad udvaṃśīyaṃ tasmād vā etat purā sajātāya nākran pāpavasīyaso vidhṛtyai
meaning: सर्वेषां वा एतत् पृष्ठानां तेजो यद् उद्वंशीयं तस्माद् वा एतत् पुरा सजाताय नाक्रन् पापवसीयसो विधृत्यै
text_mt: The Udvaṁśīya is the brilliance of all the pṛṣṭhas. Therefore, in former times, they did not perform this for a fellow-tribesman, in order to maintain the distinction between worse and better.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa hy eva pṛṣṭhais tuṣṭuvāno ya udvaṃśīyena stuvate
meaning: एष ह्य् एव पृष्ठैस् तुष्टुवानो य उद्वंशीयेन स्तुवते
text_mt: For he indeed has praised with the pṛṣṭhas who praises with the Udvaṁśīya.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi vai rūpāṇy udvaṃśīyam
meaning: सर्वाणि वै रूपाण्य् उद्वंशीयम्
text_mt: All forms indeed are the Udvaṁśīya.

sanskrit_iast: gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇa eti rathantarasya rūpam eti hi rathantaram
meaning: गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिण एति रथन्तरस्य रूपम् एति हि रथन्तरम्
text_mt: 'The singers sing to thee, he goes' is the form of the Rathantara, for the Rathantara goes.

sanskrit_iast: ādir bṛhata ūrdhvam iva hi bṛhat
meaning: आदिर् बृहत ऊर्ध्वम् इव हि बृहत्
text_mt: The ādi belongs to the Bṛhat, for the Bṛhat is, as it were, upward.

sanskrit_iast: pariṣṭobho vairūpasya pariṣṭubhaṃ hi vairūpam
meaning: परिष्टोभो वैरूपस्य परिष्टुभं हि वैरूपम्
text_mt: The pariṣṭobha belongs to the Vairūpa, for the Vairūpa has pariṣṭobhas.

sanskrit_iast: anutodo vairājasyānutunnaṃ hi vairājam
meaning: अनुतोदो वैराजस्यानुतुन्नं हि वैराजम्
text_mt: The anutoda belongs to the Vairāja, for the Vairāja is anutunna.

sanskrit_iast: ardheḍā śakvarīṇām atisvāro revatīnām
meaning: अर्धेडा शक्वरीणाम् अतिस्वारो रेवतीनाम्
text_mt: The ardheḍā belongs to the Śakvarīs; the atisvāra belongs to the Revatīs.

sanskrit_iast: ardheḍayā vai devā asurān avahatyātisvāreṇa svargaṃl lokam ārohan
meaning: अर्धेडया वै देवा असुरान् अवहत्यातिस्वारेण स्वर्गंल् लोकम् आरोहन्
text_mt: By means of the ardheḍā the gods smote the Asuras, [and] by means of the atisvāra they ascended to the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: tad ya evaṃv vedārdheḍayaiva bhrātṛvyam avahatyātisvāreṇa svargaṃl lokam ārohati
meaning: तद् य एवंव् वेदार्धेडयैव भ्रातृव्यम् अवहत्यातिस्वारेण स्वर्गंल् लोकम् आरोहति
text_mt: He who knows thus, having smitten his rival by means of the ardheḍā, ascends to the heavenly world by means of the atisvāra.

sanskrit_iast: ardheḍayā vai pūrvaṃ yajñaṃ saṃsthāpayanty atisvāreṇottram ārabhante
meaning: अर्धेडया वै पूर्वं यज्ञं संस्थापयन्त्य् अतिस्वारेणोत्त्रम् आरभन्ते
text_mt: With the ardheḍā they bring the former sacrifice to completion; with the atisvāra they undertake the latter.

sanskrit_iast: upainam uttaro yajño namati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: उपैनम् उत्तरो यज्ञो नमति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: The latter sacrifice inclines unto him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: pāṅktaṃ vā etat sāma pāṅkto yajñaḥ pāṅktāḥ paśavo yajña eva paśuṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: पाङ्क्तं वा एतत् साम पाङ्क्तो यज्ञः पाङ्क्ताः पशवो यज्ञ एव पशुषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: This sāman is fivefold; the sacrifice is fivefold; cattle are fivefold. He is established in the sacrifice, in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: āṣṭādaṃṣṭre ṛddhikāmāya kuryāt
meaning: आष्टादंष्ट्रे ऋद्धिकामाय कुर्यात्

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭādaṃṣṭro vairūpo 'putro 'prajā ajīryat sa imāṃl lokān vicicchidvāṃ amanyata sa ete jarasi sāmanī apaśyat tayor aprayogād abibhet so 'bravīd ṛdhnavad yobhe sāmabhyāṃ stavatā iti
meaning: अष्टादंष्ट्रो वैरूपो ऽपुत्रो ऽप्रजा अजीर्यत् स इमांल् लोकान् विचिच्छिद्वां अमन्यत स एते जरसि सामनी अपश्यत् तयोर् अप्रयोगाद् अबिभेत् सो ऽब्रवीद् ऋध्नवद् योभे सामभ्यां स्तवता इति
text_mt: Aṣṭādaṁṣṭra Vairūpa grew old without a son, without offspring. He thought these worlds were cut off from him. In old age he saw these two sāmans. He feared because they were not applied. He said, 'May he prosper who praises with both sāmans!'

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣer vā etat prāśodbhūtaṃ yad aṣṭādaṃṣṭre bhavata ṛdhyā eva
meaning: ऋषेर् वा एतत् प्राशोद्भूतं यद् अष्टादंष्ट्रे भवत ऋध्या एव
text_mt: That there are the two Āṣṭādaṁṣṭra [sāmans] is indeed the fruition of the seer's prayer, for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṣu brahmavarcasakāmāyokthāni praṇayeyur gāyatryāṃ brahmasāmānuṣṭubhy acchāvākasāma saiṣā gāyatrī saṃpadyate
meaning: गायत्रीषु ब्रह्मवर्चसकामायोक्थानि प्रणयेयुर् गायत्र्यां ब्रह्मसामानुष्टुभ्य् अच्छावाकसाम सैषा गायत्री संपद्यते
text_mt: For one desirous of brahminical lustre they should lead forth the ukthas on gāyatrī verses; on a gāyatrī is the Brahma-sāman, on an anuṣṭubh the Acchāvāka-sāman: this amounts to a gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī teja eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe
meaning: तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं गायत्री तेज एव ब्रह्मवर्चसम् अवरुन्धे
text_mt: The gāyatrī is brilliance, brahminical lustre; he secures brilliance, brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṣu paśukāmāyokthāni praṇayeyur uṣṇihi brahmasāmānuṣṭubhy acchāvākasāma saiṣoṣṇik saṃpadyate
meaning: गायत्रीषु पशुकामायोक्थानि प्रणयेयुर् उष्णिहि ब्रह्मसामानुष्टुभ्य् अच्छावाकसाम सैषोष्णिक् संपद्यते
text_mt: For one desirous of cattle they should lead forth the ukthas on gāyatrī verses; on an uṣṇih is the Brahma-sāman, on an anuṣṭubh the Acchāvāka-sāman: this amounts to an uṣṇih.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vā uṣṇik paśūn evāvarundhe
meaning: पशवो वा उष्णिक् पशून् एवावरुन्धे
text_mt: The uṣṇih is cattle; he secures cattle.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṣu puruṣakāmāyokthāni praṇayeyuḥ kakubhi brahmasāmānuṣṭubhy acchāvākasāma saiṣā kakup saṃpadyate
meaning: गायत्रीषु पुरुषकामायोक्थानि प्रणयेयुः ककुभि ब्रह्मसामानुष्टुभ्य् अच्छावाकसाम सैषा ककुप् संपद्यते
text_mt: For one desirous of men they should lead forth the ukthas on gāyatrī verses; on a kakubh is the Brahma-sāman, on an anuṣṭubh the Acchāvāka-sāman: this amounts to a kakubh.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣo vai kakup puruṣān evāvarundhe
meaning: पुरुषो वै ककुप् पुरुषान् एवावरुन्धे
text_mt: The kakubh is man; he secures men.

sanskrit_iast: virāṭsv annādyakāmāyokthāni praṇayeyur uṣṇihi brahmasāmānuṣṭubhy acchāvākasāma saiṣā virāṭ saṃpadyate
meaning: विराट्स्व् अन्नाद्यकामायोक्थानि प्रणयेयुर् उष्णिहि ब्रह्मसामानुष्टुभ्य् अच्छावाकसाम सैषा विराट् संपद्यते
text_mt: For one desirous of food they should lead forth the ukthas on virāj verses; on an uṣṇih is the Brahma-sāman, on an anuṣṭubh the Acchāvāka-sāman: this amounts to a virāj.

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ virāḍ annādyam evāvarundhe
meaning: अन्नं विराड् अन्नाद्यम् एवावरुन्धे
text_mt: The virāj is food; he secures food.

sanskrit_iast: akṣarapaṅktiṣu jyaiṣṭhyakāmāyokthāni praṇayeyur uṣṇihi brahmasāmānuṣṭubhy acchāvākasāma saiṣānuṣṭup saṃpadyate
meaning: अक्षरपङ्क्तिषु ज्यैष्ठ्यकामायोक्थानि प्रणयेयुर् उष्णिहि ब्रह्मसामानुष्टुभ्य् अच्छावाकसाम सैषानुष्टुप् संपद्यते
text_mt: For one desirous of seniority they should lead forth the ukthas on akṣarapaṅkti verses; on an uṣṇih is the Brahma-sāman, on an anuṣṭubh the Acchāvāka-sāman: this amounts to an anuṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast: jyaiṣṭhyaṃ vā anuṣṭub jyaiṣṭhyam avāvarundhe
meaning: ज्यैष्ठ्यं वा अनुष्टुब् ज्यैष्ठ्यम् अवावरुन्धे
text_mt: The anuṣṭubh is seniority; he secures seniority.

sanskrit_iast: devā vā ukthāny abhijitya rātriṃ nāśaknuvann abhijetuṃ te 'surān rātriṃ tamaḥ praviṣṭāṃ nānuvyapaśyaṃs ta etam anuṣṭupśirasaṃ pragāthm apaśyan virājaṃ jyotiḥ tān virājā jyotiṣānupaśyanto 'nuṣṭubhā vajreṇa rātrer nirāghnan
meaning: देवा वा उक्थान्य् अभिजित्य रात्रिं नाशक्नुवन्न् अभिजेतुं ते ऽसुरान् रात्रिं तमः प्रविष्टां नानुव्यपश्यंस् त एतम् अनुष्टुप्शिरसं प्रगाथ्म् अपश्यन् विराजं ज्योतिः तान् विराजा ज्योतिषानुपश्यन्तो ऽनुष्टुभा वज्रेण रात्रेर् निराघ्नन्
text_mt: The gods, having conquered the ukthas, were not able to conquer the night. They could not discern the Asuras who had entered the darkness, the night. They saw this pragātha with an anuṣṭubh as its head, the virāj, a light. Discerning them by means of the virāj, the light, they smote them out of the night with the anuṣṭubh, the thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast: yad eṣo 'nuṣṭupśirāḥ pragātho bhavati virāḍ eva jyotiṣānupaśyann anuṣṭubhā vajreṇa rātrer bhrātṛvyaṃ nirhanti
meaning: यद् एषो ऽनुष्टुप्शिराः प्रगाथो भवति विराड् एव ज्योतिषानुपश्यन्न् अनुष्टुभा वज्रेण रात्रेर् भ्रातृव्यं निर्हन्ति
text_mt: Since this pragātha has an anuṣṭubh as its head, [the sacrificer], discerning his rival by means of the virāj, the light, smites him out of the night with the anuṣṭubh, the thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast: tān samantaṃ paryāyaṃ prāṇudanta yat paryāyaṃ prāṇudanta tat paryāyāṇāṃ paryāyatvam
meaning: तान् समन्तं पर्यायं प्राणुदन्त यत् पर्यायं प्राणुदन्त तत् पर्यायाणां पर्यायत्वम्
text_mt: They drove them away round about in a round (paryāya). In that they drove them away in a round, that is the roundness of the rounds.

sanskrit_iast: prathamāni padāni punarādīni bhavanti prathamasya paryāyasya
meaning: प्रथमानि पदानि पुनरादीनि भवन्ति प्रथमस्य पर्यायस्य
text_mt: The initial verse-quarters are repeated of the first round.

sanskrit_iast: prathamair hi padaiḥ punar ādāya prathamarātrāt prāṇudanta
meaning: प्रथमैर् हि पदैः पुनर् आदाय प्रथमरात्रात् प्राणुदन्त
text_mt: For, repeating the initial verse-quarters, they drove [them] away from the first part of the night.

sanskrit_iast: pāntam ā vo andhasa iti prastauti
meaning: पान्तम् आ वो अन्धस इति प्रस्तौति
text_mt: He chants the prastāva with: 'The draught of your juice'.

sanskrit_iast: ahar vai pāntam andho rātrir ahnaiva tad rātrim ārabhante
meaning: अहर् वै पान्तम् अन्धो रात्रिर् अह्नैव तद् रात्रिम् आरभन्ते
text_mt: The day is the draught, the juice is the night. Thereby they undertake the night by means of the day.

sanskrit_iast: tāsu vaitahavyam
meaning: तासु वैतहव्यम्

sanskrit_iast: vītahavyaḥ śrāyaso jyog niruddha etat sāmāpaśyat so 'vagacchat pratyatiṣṭhad avagacchati pratitiṣṭhaty etena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: वीतहव्यः श्रायसो ज्योग् निरुद्ध एतत् सामापश्यत् सो ऽवगच्छत् प्रत्यतिष्ठद् अवगच्छति प्रतितिष्ठत्य् एतेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Vītahavya Śrāyasa, having been excluded for a long time, saw this sāman. He attained [his wish] and became firmly established. He who praises with this attains [his wish] and becomes firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: tam iva vā ete praviśantiye rātrim upayanti yad eko nidhanaṃ rātrer mukhe bhavati prajñātyai
meaning: तम् इव वा एते प्रविशन्तिये रात्रिम् उपयन्ति यद् एको निधनं रात्रेर् मुखे भवति प्रज्ञात्यै
text_mt: They enter, as it were, into darkness who approach the night. That there is a single cadence at the beginning of the night is for discernment.

sanskrit_iast: yadā vai puruṣaḥ svam oka āgacchati sarvaṃ tarhi prajānāti sarvam asmai divā bhavati
meaning: यदा वै पुरुषः स्वम् ओक आगच्छति सर्वं तर्हि प्रजानाति सर्वम् अस्मै दिवा भवति
text_mt: When a man comes to his own home, then he knows everything; everything becomes day for him.

sanskrit_iast: te madhyamaṃ paryāyam aśrayanta teṣām aurdhvasadmanena vācam avṛñjata
meaning: ते मध्यमं पर्यायम् अश्रयन्त तेषाम् और्ध्वसद्मनेन वाचम् अवृञ्जत
text_mt: They resorted to the middle round. By means of the Aurdhvasadmana [sāman] they wrested away speech from them.

sanskrit_iast: vācaṃ bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃv veda
meaning: वाचं भ्रातृव्यस्य वृङ्क्ते य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows thus wrests away the speech of his rival.

sanskrit_iast: triṇidhanaṃ bhavati
meaning: त्रिणिधनं भवति

sanskrit_iast: yathā vā ahno mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ triṇidhanāyatanam evam eṣa rātrer madhyamaḥ paryāyas triṇidhanāyatanaḥ salokatvāya
meaning: यथा वा अह्नो माध्यन्दिनं सवनं त्रिणिधनायतनम् एवम् एष रात्रेर् मध्यमः पर्यायस् त्रिणिधनायतनः सलोकत्वाय
text_mt: Just as the midday pressing of the day is the seat of three cadences, so this middle round of the night is the seat of three cadences, for [attaining] the same world.

sanskrit_iast: madhyamāni padāni punarādīni bhavanti madhyamasya paryāyasya madhyamair hi padaiḥ punar ādāyaṃ madhyamarātrāt prāṇudanta
meaning: मध्यमानि पदानि पुनरादीनि भवन्ति मध्यमस्य पर्यायस्य मध्यमैर् हि पदैः पुनर् आदायं मध्यमरात्रात् प्राणुदन्त
text_mt: The middle verse-quarters are repeated of the middle round. For, repeating the middle verse-quarters, they drove [them] away from the middle of the night.

sanskrit_iast: ta uttamaṃ paryāyam aśrayanta teṣāṃ ghṛtaścyun nidhanena paśūn avṛñjata paśavo vai ghṛtaścyutaḥ
meaning: त उत्तमं पर्यायम् अश्रयन्त तेषां घृतश्च्युन् निधनेन पशून् अवृञ्जत पशवो वै घृतश्च्युतः
text_mt: They resorted to the last round. By means of the cadence 'dripping with ghee' they wrested away cattle from them. Cattle indeed are dripping with ghee.

sanskrit_iast: paśūn bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃv veda
meaning: पशून् भ्रातृव्यस्य वृङ्क्ते य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows thus wrests away the cattle of his rival.

sanskrit_iast: uttamāni padāni punarādīni bhavanty uttamasya paryāyasyottamair hi padaiḥpunar ādāyam uttamarātrāt prāṇudanta
meaning: उत्तमानि पदानि पुनरादीनि भवन्त्य् उत्तमस्य पर्यायस्योत्तमैर् हि पदैःपुनर् आदायम् उत्तमरात्रात् प्राणुदन्त
text_mt: The final verses of the final round are repeated, for by taking [them] up again with the final verses, they drove [them] out from the end of the night.

sanskrit_iast: tān sandhinābhipalāyanta
meaning: तान् सन्धिनाभिपलायन्त
text_mt: They fled from them towards the twilight chant.

sanskrit_iast: tān āśvinenāsaṃhāyyam agamayan
meaning: तान् आश्विनेनासंहाय्यम् अगमयन्

sanskrit_iast: asaṃhāyyaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ gamayati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: असंहाय्यं भ्रातृव्यं गमयति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows this brings his rival to ruin.

sanskrit_iast: eṣā vā agniṣṭomasya saṃmā yad rātriḥ
meaning: एषा वा अग्निष्टोमस्य संमा यद् रात्रिः
text_mt: The night, indeed, is the measure of the Agniṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa stotrāṇy agniṣṭomo dvādaśa strotrāṇi rātriḥ
meaning: द्वादश स्तोत्राण्य् अग्निष्टोमो द्वादश स्त्रोत्राणि रात्रिः
text_mt: The Agniṣṭoma has twelve chants of praise; the night has twelve chants of praise.

sanskrit_iast: eṣā vā ukthasya saṃmā yad rātriḥ
meaning: एषा वा उक्थस्य संमा यद् रात्रिः
text_mt: The night, indeed, is the measure of the Uktha.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇy ukthāni tridevatyaḥ sandhiḥ
meaning: त्रीण्य् उक्थानि त्रिदेवत्यः सन्धिः
text_mt: The ukthas are three; the twilight chant has three deities.

sanskrit_iast: yathā vā ahna ukthāny evam eṣa rātreḥ sandhir nānārūpāṇy ahna ukthāni nānārūpā ete tṛcā bhavanti
meaning: यथा वा अह्न उक्थान्य् एवम् एष रात्रेः सन्धिर् नानारूपाण्य् अह्न उक्थानि नानारूपा एते तृचा भवन्ति
text_mt: As are the ukthas of the day, so is this twilight chant of the night: manifold are the ukthas of the day, [and] manifold are these triplets.

sanskrit_iast: rathantaraṃ pratiṣṭhākāmāya sandhiṃ kuryāt
meaning: रथन्तरं प्रतिष्ठाकामाय सन्धिं कुर्यात्
text_mt: For one desirous of a firm standing, he should make the Rathantara the twilight chant.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vai rathantaram asyām eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: इयं वै रथन्तरम् अस्याम् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: This [earth], indeed, is the Rathantara; he firmly stands on this very [earth].

sanskrit_iast: bṛhat svargakāmāya sandhiṃ kuryāt
meaning: बृहत् स्वर्गकामाय सन्धिं कुर्यात्
text_mt: For one desirous of heaven, he should make the Bṛhat the twilight chant.

sanskrit_iast: svargo loko bṛhat svarga eva loke pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: स्वर्गो लोको बृहत् स्वर्ग एव लोके प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: The Bṛhat is the heavenly world; he firmly stands in the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: vāravantīyaṃ vā vāmadevyaṃ vā śruddhyaṃ vai teṣām ekaṃ paśukāmāya sandhiṃ kuryāt
meaning: वारवन्तीयं वा वामदेव्यं वा श्रुद्ध्यं वै तेषाम् एकं पशुकामाय सन्धिं कुर्यात्
text_mt: For one desirous of cattle, he should make one of these—either the Vāravantīya, or the Vāmadevya, or the Śruddhīya—the twilight chant.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vā etāni sāmāni paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: पशवो वा एतानि सामानि पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: These s権利āmans are cattle; he firmly stands among cattle.

sanskrit_iast: āśvinaṃ hotānuśaṃsati
meaning: आश्विनं होतानुशंसति

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vā etat sahasram asṛjata tad devebhyaḥ prāyacchat tasmin na samarādhayaṃs te sūryaṃ kāṣṭhāṃ kṛtvājim adhāvan
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वा एतत् सहस्रम् असृजत तद् देवेभ्यः प्रायच्छत् तस्मिन् न समराधयंस् ते सूर्यं काष्ठां कृत्वाजिम् अधावन्
text_mt: Prajāpati created this thousand [of verses]; he gave it to the gods. Over it they could not agree; having made the sun their goal, they ran a race.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām aśvinau prathamāv adhāvatāṃ tāv anvavadan saha no 'stv iti tāv abrūtāṃ kiṃ tataḥ syād iti yat kāmayethe ity abruvaṃs tāv abrūtām asmaddevatyam idam uktham ucyātā iti tasmād āśvinam ucyate
meaning: तेषाम् अश्विनौ प्रथमाव् अधावतां ताव् अन्ववदन् सह नो ऽस्त्व् इति ताव् अब्रूतां किं ततः स्याद् इति यत् कामयेथे इत्य् अब्रुवंस् ताव् अब्रूताम् अस्मद्देवत्यम् इदम् उक्थम् उच्याता इति तस्माद् आश्विनम् उच्यते
text_mt: Of them, the two Aśvins ran first. [The others] said after them: 'Let it be shared with us.' They two said: 'What would come of it then?' They said: 'Whatever you two desire.' They two said: 'Let this uktha be addressed to us as deities.' Therefore it is called the Āśvina.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāḥ khalu devatāḥ śasyante
meaning: सर्वाः खलु देवताः शस्यन्ते
text_mt: All the deities indeed are praised.

sanskrit_iast: kṣipraṃ śasyam ājim iva hy ete dhāvanty ā sūryasyodetoḥ śaṃset sūryaṃ hi kāṣṭhām akurvata
meaning: क्षिप्रं शस्यम् आजिम् इव ह्य् एते धावन्त्य् आ सूर्यस्योदेतोः शंसेत् सूर्यं हि काष्ठाम् अकुर्वत
text_mt: It is to be recited quickly, for like a race these run; he should recite it until the rising of the sun, for they made the sun their goal.

sanskrit_iast: pāntam ā vo andhasa iti vaitahavyam anyakṣetraṃvā ete prayanti ye rātrim upayanti yad okonidhanaṃ rātrer mukhe bhavaty okaso 'pracyāvāya
meaning: पान्तम् आ वो अन्धस इति वैतहव्यम् अन्यक्षेत्रंवा एते प्रयन्ति ये रात्रिम् उपयन्ति यद् ओकोनिधनं रात्रेर् मुखे भवत्य् ओकसो ऽप्रच्यावाय
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'They drink from your juice' is the Vaitahavya. Those who undertake the night-rite go to a foreign field, as it were; in that there is a cadence on the word 'oka' (home) at the beginning of the night, it is for not falling away from home.

sanskrit_iast: pra va indrāya mādanam iti gaurīvitam
meaning: प्र व इन्द्राय मादनम् इति गौरीवितम्
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'Forth to Indra [offer] the intoxicating [draught]' is the Gaurīvita.

sanskrit_iast: brahma yad devā vyakurvata tato yad atyaricyata tad gaurīvitam abhavat
meaning: ब्रह्म यद् देवा व्यकुर्वत ततो यद् अत्यरिच्यत तद् गौरीवितम् अभवत्
text_mt: When the gods distributed the sacred word, what was left over from it became the Gaurīvita.

sanskrit_iast: atiriktaṃ gaurīvitam atiriktam etat stotraṃ yad rātrir atirikta evātiriktaṃ dadhāti
meaning: अतिरिक्तं गौरीवितम् अतिरिक्तम् एतत् स्तोत्रं यद् रात्रिर् अतिरिक्त एवातिरिक्तं दधाति
text_mt: Surplus is the Gaurīvita; surplus is this chant of praise, which is the night; he places surplus into surplus.

sanskrit_iast: vayam u tvā tad id arthā iti kāṇvam
meaning: वयम् उ त्वा तद् इद् अर्था इति काण्वम्
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'We [turn] to you for that very purpose' is the Kāṇva.

sanskrit_iast: etena vai kaṇva indrasya sāṃvidyam agacchad indrasyaivaitena sāṃvidyaṃ gacchati
meaning: एतेन वै कण्व इन्द्रस्य सांविद्यम् अगच्छद् इन्द्रस्यैवैतेन सांविद्यं गच्छति
text_mt: By this, Kaṇva attained agreement with Indra; by this, he attains agreement with Indra.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya madvane sutam iti śrautakakṣaṃ kṣatrasāma pra kṣatram evaitena bhavati
meaning: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतम् इति श्रौतकक्षं क्षत्रसाम प्र क्षत्रम् एवैतेन भवति
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'For the joyous Indra the pressed [juice]' is the Śrautakakṣa, a sāman of noble power; by this, noble power thrives.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ ta indra soma iti daivodāsam
meaning: अयं त इन्द्र सोम इति दैवोदासम्
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'This Soma for you, O Indra' is the Daivodāsa.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomena vai devā imaṃl lokam abhyajayann antarikṣam ukthenātirātreṇāmuṃ ta imaṃl lokaṃ punar abhyakāmayanta ta ihety asmiṃl loke pratyatiṣṭhan yad etat sāma bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: अग्निष्टोमेन वै देवा इमंल् लोकम् अभ्यजयन्न् अन्तरिक्षम् उक्थेनातिरात्रेणामुं त इमंल् लोकं पुनर् अभ्यकामयन्त त इहेत्य् अस्मिंल् लोके प्रत्यतिष्ठन् यद् एतत् साम भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
