text_mt: By the Agniṣṭoma the gods conquered this world; by the Uktha, the intermediate region; by the Atirātra, yonder [world]. They desired this world again; they firmly stood in this world, [thinking,] 'here [we are].' In that this sāman is used, it is for firm standing.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvasadmanam api śarvarīṣu prohanti
meaning: ऊर्ध्वसद्मनम् अपि शर्वरीषु प्रोहन्ति
text_mt: They also introduce the Ūrdhvasadman in the night [chants].

sanskrit_iast: asurā vā eṣu lokeṣv āsaṃs tān devā ūrdhvasadmanenaibhyo lokebhyaḥ prāṇudanta
meaning: असुरा वा एषु लोकेष्व् आसंस् तान् देवा ऊर्ध्वसद्मनेनैभ्यो लोकेभ्यः प्राणुदन्त
text_mt: The asuras were in these worlds; the gods drove them out from these worlds by means of the Ūrdhvasadman.

sanskrit_iast: tad ya evaṃv vedaibhyo lokebhyo bhrātṛvyaṃ praṇudya sva āyatane sattram āste
meaning: तद् य एवंव् वेदैभ्यो लोकेभ्यो भ्रातृव्यं प्रणुद्य स्व आयतने सत्त्रम् आस्ते
text_mt: He who knows this, having driven his rival out from these worlds, celebrates the sacrificial session in his own abode.

sanskrit_iast: ā tū na indra kṣumantam ity ākūpāram
meaning: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तम् इत्य् आकूपारम्
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'Come to us, O Indra, rich in cattle' is the Ākūpāra.

sanskrit_iast: akūpārāṅgirasasyāsīt tasyā yathā godhāyās tvag eva tvag āsīt tām etena triḥsāmnendraḥ pūtvā sūryatvacasam akarot tad vāva sā tarhy akāmayata yatkāmā etena sāmnā stuvate sa ebhyaḥ kāmaḥ samṛdhyate
meaning: अकूपाराङ्गिरसस्यासीत् तस्या यथा गोधायास् त्वग् एव त्वग् आसीत् ताम् एतेन त्रिःसाम्नेन्द्रः पूत्वा सूर्यत्वचसम् अकरोत् तद् वाव सा तर्ह्य् अकामयत यत्कामा एतेन साम्ना स्तुवते स एभ्यः कामः समृध्यते
text_mt: Akūpārā was a daughter of Aṅgiras; her skin was like the skin of an iguana; Indra, having cleansed her three times with this sāman, made her sun-skinned. That was indeed what she desired then; whatever desire they have when chanting with this sāman, that desire is fulfilled for them.

sanskrit_iast: abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sutaṃ ity ārṣabhaṃ kṣatrasāma kṣatram evaitena bhavati
meaning: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुतं इत्य् आर्षभं क्षत्रसाम क्षत्रम् एवैतेन भवति
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'Unto you, O bull, the pressed [juice]' is the Ārṣabha, a sāman of noble power; by this, noble power comes to be.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃv vaso sutam andha iti gāram etena vai gara indram aprīṇāt prīta evāsyaitenendro bhavati
meaning: इदंव् वसो सुतम् अन्ध इति गारम् एतेन वै गर इन्द्रम् अप्रीणात् प्रीत एवास्यैतेनेन्द्रो भवति
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'This pressed draught, O Vasu' is the Gāra; by this, Gara pleased Indra; Indra is pleased with him by this.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ hy anv ojaseti mādhucchandasaṃ prajāpater vā eṣā tanūr ayātayāmnī prayujyate
meaning: इदं ह्य् अन्व् ओजसेति माधुच्छन्दसं प्रजापतेर् वा एषा तनूर् अयातयाम्नी प्रयुज्यते
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'For here, along with power' is the Mādhucchandasa; this, indeed, is the unexhausted body of Prajāpati [that] is employed.

sanskrit_iast: ā tv etā niṣīdateti daivātitham
meaning: आ त्व् एता निषीदतेति दैवातिथम्
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'Come and sit down here' is the Daivātitha.

sanskrit_iast: devātithiḥ saputro 'śanāyaṃś carann araṇya urvārūṇy avindat tāny etena sāmnopāsīdat tā asmai gāvaḥ pṛśnayo bhūtvodatiṣṭhan yad etat sām a bhavati paśūnāṃ puṣṭyai
meaning: देवातिथिः सपुत्रो ऽशनायंश् चरन्न् अरण्य उर्वारूण्य् अविन्दत् तान्य् एतेन साम्नोपासीदत् ता अस्मै गावः पृश्नयो भूत्वोदतिष्ठन् यद् एतत् साम् अ भवति पशूनां पुष्ट्यै
text_mt: Devātithi, wandering hungry with his son in the wilderness, found some cucumbers; he sat by them with this sāman; they rose up for him having become speckled cows. In that this sāman is used, it is for the thriving of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: yoge yoge tavastaram iti saumedhaṃ rātriṣāma rātrer eva samṛdhyai
meaning: योगे योगे तवस्तरम् इति सौमेधं रात्रिषाम रात्रेर् एव समृध्यै
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'In every team [we invoke] the stronger' is the Saumedha, a night-sāman, for the success of the night.

sanskrit_iast: indra suteṣu someṣv iti kautsam
meaning: इन्द्र सुतेषु सोमेष्व् इति कौत्सम्
text_mt: [The sāman on the verse] 'O Indra, when the Somas are pressed' is the Kautsa.

sanskrit_iast: kutsaś ca luśaś cendraṃ vyahvayetāṃ sa indraḥ kutsam upāvartata taṃ śatena vārdhrībhir āṇḍayor abadhnāt taṃ luśo 'bhyavadat pramucyasva pari kutsād ihāgahi kim u tvāvān āṇḍayor baddha āsātā iti tās saṃcchidya prādravat sa etat kutsaḥ sāmāpaśyat tenainam anvavadat sa upāvartata
meaning: कुत्सश् च लुशश् चेन्द्रं व्यह्वयेतां स इन्द्रः कुत्सम् उपावर्तत तं शतेन वार्ध्रीभिर् आण्डयोर् अबध्नात् तं लुशो ऽभ्यवदत् प्रमुच्यस्व परि कुत्साद् इहागहि किम् उ त्वावान् आण्डयोर् बद्ध आसाता इति तास् संच्छिद्य प्राद्रवत् स एतत् कुत्सः सामापश्यत् तेनैनम् अन्ववदत् स उपावर्तत
text_mt: Kutsa and Luśa challenged Indra; Indra turned toward Kutsa; he bound him by the testicles with a hundred leather thongs. Luśa spoke to him: 'Free yourself from Kutsa and come here! How can one like you sit bound by the testicles?' Having cut them, he ran off. Kutsa saw this sāman; with it he called after him; he turned back.

sanskrit_iast: yad etat sāma bhavati sendratvāya
meaning: यद् एतत् साम भवति सेन्द्रत्वाय
text_mt: In that this sāman is used, it is for possessing Indra.

sanskrit_iast: yadi sattrāya dīkṣerann atha sāmy uttiṣṭhet somam apabhajya viśvajitātirātreṇa yajeta sarvavedasena sarvasmā eva dīkṣate sarvam āpnoti
meaning: यदि सत्त्राय दीक्षेरन्न् अथ साम्य् उत्तिष्ठेत् सोमम् अपभज्य विश्वजितातिरात्रेण यजेत सर्ववेदसेन सर्वस्मा एव दीक्षते सर्वम् आप्नोति
text_mt: If they should be consecrated for a sacrificial session and then one leaves halfway through, having separated the Soma, he should sacrifice with the Viśvajit Atirātra with all his possessions given as dakṣiṇā; he is consecrated for everything, he obtains everything.

sanskrit_iast: yā id dakṣiṇā dadāti tābhir iti prayuṅkte
meaning: या इद् दक्षिणा ददाति ताभिर् इति प्रयुङ्क्ते
text_mt: He employs it with [the thought]: 'With these, [I give] whatever dakṣiṇās he gives.'

sanskrit_iast: yadi paryāyair astutam abhivyucchet pancadaśabhir hotre stuyuḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcabhir itarebhyaḥ
meaning: यदि पर्यायैर् अस्तुतम् अभिव्युच्छेत् पन्चदशभिर् होत्रे स्तुयुः पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिर् इतरेभ्यः
text_mt: If dawn should break upon them when the rounds are not yet chanted, they should chant fifteen [verses] for the hotṛ, and five each for the others.

sanskrit_iast: agne vivasvad uṣasa iti sandhinā stuyuḥ prāṇā vai trivṛt stomānāṃ pratiṣṭhā rathantaraṃ sāmnāṃ prāṇāṃs caivopayanti pratiṣṭhāṃ ca
meaning: अग्ने विवस्वद् उषस इति सन्धिना स्तुयुः प्राणा वै त्रिवृत् स्तोमानां प्रतिष्ठा रथन्तरं साम्नां प्राणांस् चैवोपयन्ति प्रतिष्ठां च
text_mt: They should chant the twilight chant with: 'O Agni, radiant at the dawns'; the ninefold stoma is the vital breaths, the Rathantara is the firm standing of the s権利āmans; they attain the vital breaths and firm standing.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṣṭiṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni hotā śaṃsati
meaning: षष्टिं च त्रीणि च शतानि होता शंसति
text_mt: The hotṛ recites three hundred and sixty [verses].

sanskrit_iast: tāvatyaḥ saṃvatsarasya rātrayaḥ saṃvatsarasaṃmitābhir eva tad ṛgbhir āśīvinam āpnoti
meaning: तावत्यः संवत्सरस्य रात्रयः संवत्सरसंमिताभिर् एव तद् ऋग्भिर् आशीविनम् आप्नोति
text_mt: So many are the nights of the year; with verses equal in number to the year, he thus obtains the Āśvina.

sanskrit_iast: yad arvāk stuvanti tad astutaṃ yat samprati stuvanti tat stutaṃ yad atiṣṭuvanti tat suṣṭutam
meaning: यद् अर्वाक् स्तुवन्ति तद् अस्तुतं यत् सम्प्रति स्तुवन्ति तत् स्तुतं यद् अतिष्टुवन्ति तत् सुष्टुतम्
text_mt: When they chant fewer, it is unchanted; when they chant the exact amount, it is chanted; when they chant more, it is well-chanted.

sanskrit_iast: yady arvāk stuyur yāvatībhir na stuyus tāvatībhir vātiṣṭuyur bhūyo 'kṣarābhir vā
meaning: यद्य् अर्वाक् स्तुयुर् यावतीभिर् न स्तुयुस् तावतीभिर् वातिष्टुयुर् भूयो ऽक्षराभिर् वा
text_mt: If they should chant fewer, they should chant with as many more verses, or with [verses of] more syllables, as they did not chant.

sanskrit_iast: yady atiṣṭuyur yāvatībhir atiṣṭuyus tāvatībhir vā na stuyuḥ kanīyo 'kṣarābhir vā
meaning: यद्य् अतिष्टुयुर् यावतीभिर् अतिष्टुयुस् तावतीभिर् वा न स्तुयुः कनीयो ऽक्षराभिर् वा
text_mt: If they should chant more, they should omit as many verses, or [use verses of] fewer syllables, as they chanted in excess.

sanskrit_iast: yady arvāk stuyus trīḍam agniṣṭomasāma kāryaṃ nidhanam ekeḍayā ye dve tābhyām eva tat samaṃ kriyate
meaning: यद्य् अर्वाक् स्तुयुस् त्रीडम् अग्निष्टोमसाम कार्यं निधनम् एकेडया ये द्वे ताभ्याम् एव तत् समं क्रियते
text_mt: If they should chant fewer, the Agniṣṭoma-sāman is to be made with three iḍās; with the one iḍā of the cadence, it is made equal to those which are two.

sanskrit_iast: yady atiṣṭuyuḥ svāram agniṣṭomasāma kāryam ūnam iva vā etat sāmno yat svaras tenaiva tat samaṃ kriyate
meaning: यद्य् अतिष्टुयुः स्वारम् अग्निष्टोमसाम कार्यम् ऊनम् इव वा एतत् साम्नो यत् स्वरस् तेनैव तत् समं क्रियते
text_mt: If they should chant more, the Agniṣṭoma-sāman is to be made with a svar-ending; what is tone is deficient, as it were, of the sāman; by that it is made equal.

sanskrit_iast: yadi somau saṃsutau syātāṃ mahati rātreḥ prātaranuvākam upākuryāt
meaning: यदि सोमौ संसुतौ स्यातां महति रात्रेः प्रातरनुवाकम् उपाकुर्यात्
text_mt: If two Somas should be pressed together, he should begin the morning recitation in the deep of the night.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvo vācaṃ pūrvaś chandāṃsi pūrvo devatā vṛṅkte
meaning: पूर्वो वाचं पूर्वश् छन्दांसि पूर्वो देवता वृङ्क्ते
text_mt: Being first, he appropriates speech; being first, the metres; being first, the deities.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣaṇvatīṃ pratipadaṃ kuryād indro vai vṛṣā prātaḥsavanād evaiṣām indraṃv vṛṅkte
meaning: वृषण्वतीं प्रतिपदं कुर्याद् इन्द्रो वै वृषा प्रातःसवनाद् एवैषाम् इन्द्रंव् वृङ्क्ते
text_mt: He should make an introductory verse containing [the word] 'bull'; Indra is a bull; he appropriates Indra from their morning pressing.

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhuḥ savanamukhe savanamukhe kāryā savanamukhāt savanamukhād evaiṣām indraṃv vṛṅkte
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुः सवनमुखे सवनमुखे कार्या सवनमुखात् सवनमुखाद् एवैषाम् इन्द्रंव् वृङ्क्ते
text_mt: Moreover they say: it is to be made at the beginning of each pressing; he appropriates Indra from the very beginning of each of their pressings.

sanskrit_iast: susamiddhe hotavyam agnir vai sarvā devatāḥ sarvā eva devatāḥ paśyañ juhoti
meaning: सुसमिद्धे होतव्यम् अग्निर् वै सर्वा देवताः सर्वा एव देवताः पश्यञ् जुहोति
text_mt: He should offer into a well-kindled [fire]; for Agni is all the deities. Beholding all the deities indeed he offers.

sanskrit_iast: saṃveśāyopaveśāya gāyatryai cchandase 'bhibhūtaye svāhā saṃveśāyopaveśāya triṣṭubhe cchandase 'bhibhūtaye svāhā saṃveśāyopaveśāya jagatyai cchandase 'bhibhūtaye svāheti juhoti
meaning: संवेशायोपवेशाय गायत्र्यै च्छन्दसे ऽभिभूतये स्वाहा संवेशायोपवेशाय त्रिष्टुभे च्छन्दसे ऽभिभूतये स्वाहा संवेशायोपवेशाय जगत्यै च्छन्दसे ऽभिभूतये स्वाहेति जुहोति
text_mt: "To lying down, to sitting down, to the gāyatrī metre, to overcoming, svāhā! To lying down, to sitting down, to the triṣṭubh metre, to overcoming, svāhā! To lying down, to sitting down, to the jagatī metre, to overcoming, svāhā!"—thus he offers.

sanskrit_iast: cchandāṃsi vā abhibhūtayas tair evainān abhibhavaty ubhe bṛhadrathantare kārye
meaning: च्छन्दांसि वा अभिभूतयस् तैर् एवैनान् अभिभवत्य् उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे कार्ये
text_mt: The metres are indeed the overcomings; by means of them he overcomes them. Both the Bṛhat and Rathantara should be used.

sanskrit_iast: yatra vā indrasya harī tad indraḥ indrasya vai harī bṛhadrathantare yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare bhavataḥ pūrva evendrasya harī ārabhante
meaning: यत्र वा इन्द्रस्य हरी तद् इन्द्रः इन्द्रस्य वै हरी बृहद्रथन्तरे यद् उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे भवतः पूर्व एवेन्द्रस्य हरी आरभन्ते
text_mt: Where Indra's two bay steeds are, there is Indra. The Bṛhat and Rathantara are Indra's two bay steeds. When both the Bṛhat and Rathantara are [used], they take hold of Indra's two bay steeds first.

sanskrit_iast: tair aśravase kārye
meaning: तैर् अश्रवसे कार्ये

sanskrit_iast: turaśravasaś ca vai pārāvatānāṃ ca somau saṃsutāv āstāṃ tata ete turaśravāḥ sāmanī apaśyat tābhyām asmā indraḥ śalmalināṃ yamunāyā havyaṃ nirāvahat yat tair aśravase bhavato havyam evaiṣāṃv vṛṅkte
meaning: तुरश्रवसश् च वै पारावतानां च सोमौ संसुताव् आस्तां तत एते तुरश्रवाः सामनी अपश्यत् ताभ्याम् अस्मा इन्द्रः शल्मलिनां यमुनाया हव्यं निरावहत् यत् तैर् अश्रवसे भवतो हव्यम् एवैषांव् वृङ्क्ते
text_mt: The Soma [sacrifices] of Turaśravas and of the Pārāvatas were pressed simultaneously. Then Turaśravas saw these two sāmans. By means of them Indra brought out the oblation of the Śalmalins from the Yamunā for him. When the two Tauraśravasa [sāmans] are [used], he deprives them of their oblation.

sanskrit_iast: pūrve 'bhiṣuṇuyuḥ
meaning: पूर्वे ऽभिषुणुयुः

sanskrit_iast: yā vai pūrvāḥ prasnānti tāḥ pūrvās tīrthaṃ jayanti pūrva evendram ārabhante
meaning: या वै पूर्वाः प्रस्नान्ति ताः पूर्वास् तीर्थं जयन्ति पूर्व एवेन्द्रम् आरभन्ते
text_mt: Those who bathe first win the ford first. They take hold of Indra first.

sanskrit_iast: vihavyaṃ śasyam
meaning: विहव्यं शस्यम्

sanskrit_iast: jamadagneś ca vā ṛṣīṇāṃ ca somau saṃsutāv āstāṃ tata etaj gamadagnir vihavyam apaśyat tam indra upāvartata yad vihavyaṃ hotā śaṃsatīndram evaiṣāṃv vṛṅkte
meaning: जमदग्नेश् च वा ऋषीणां च सोमौ संसुताव् आस्तां तत एतज् गमदग्निर् विहव्यम् अपश्यत् तम् इन्द्र उपावर्तत यद् विहव्यं होता शंसतीन्द्रम् एवैषांव् वृङ्क्ते
text_mt: The Soma [sacrifices] of Jamadagni and of the ṛṣis were pressed simultaneously. Then Jamadagni saw this Vihavya [hymn]. To him Indra turned. When the Hotṛ recites the Vihavya, he deprives them of Indra.

sanskrit_iast: yadītaro 'gniṣṭomaḥ syād ukthaḥ kāryo yady uktho 'tirātro yo vai bhūyān yajñakratuḥ sa indrasya priyo bhūyasaivaiṣāṃ yajnakratunendraṃv vṛṅkte
meaning: यदीतरो ऽग्निष्टोमः स्याद् उक्थः कार्यो यद्य् उक्थो ऽतिरात्रो यो वै भूयान् यज्ञक्रतुः स इन्द्रस्य प्रियो भूयसैवैषां यज्नक्रतुनेन्द्रंव् वृङ्क्ते
text_mt: If the other [rite] should be an Agniṣṭoma, an Ukthya should be performed; if an Ukthya, an Atirātra. Whichever sacrificial rite is greater, that is dear to Indra; by means of a greater sacrificial rite he deprives them of Indra.

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhur duṣprāpa iva vai paraḥ panthā yam evāgre yajñakratum ārabheta tasmān neyād iti
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुर् दुष्प्राप इव वै परः पन्था यम् एवाग्रे यज्ञक्रतुम् आरभेत तस्मान् नेयाद् इति
text_mt: And they also say: "Hard to reach, as it were, is the higher path; whichever sacrificial rite one undertakes in the beginning, from that he should not depart."

sanskrit_iast: sajanīyaṃ śasyam agastyasya kayāśubhīyaṃ śasyam
meaning: सजनीयं शस्यम् अगस्त्यस्य कयाशुभीयं शस्यम्
text_mt: The Sajanīya [hymn] is to be recited; Agastya's Kayāśubhīya [hymn] is to be recited.

sanskrit_iast: asyā amuṣyā adyaśvān mithunād ahorātrābhyām evainān nirbhajati
meaning: अस्या अमुष्या अद्यश्वान् मिथुनाद् अहोरात्राभ्याम् एवैनान् निर्भजति
text_mt: From this [world], from yonder [world], from today and tomorrow, from the pair, by the day and night indeed he excludes them.

sanskrit_iast: yadi somam akrītam apahareyur anyaḥ kretavyaḥ
meaning: यदि सोमम् अक्रीतम् अपहरेयुर् अन्यः क्रेतव्यः
text_mt: If they should steal the unbought Soma, another [plant] should be bought.

sanskrit_iast: yadi krītaṃ yo 'nyo 'bhyāśaṃ syāt sa āhṛtyaḥ somavikrayaṇe tu kiṃ cid dadyāt
meaning: यदि क्रीतं यो ऽन्यो ऽभ्याशं स्यात् स आहृत्यः सोमविक्रयणे तु किं चिद् दद्यात्
text_mt: If [stolen when] bought, whatever other [Soma] might be at hand should be brought; but he should give something to the Soma-seller.

sanskrit_iast: yadi somaṃ na vindeyuḥ pūtīkān abhiṣuṇuyur yadi na pūtīkān arjjunāni
meaning: यदि सोमं न विन्देयुः पूतीकान् अभिषुणुयुर् यदि न पूतीकान् अर्ज्जुनानि
text_mt: If they should not find Soma, they should press pūtīka plants; if not pūtīka plants, brown [phālguna] plants.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrī somam āharat tasyā anu visṛjya somarakṣiḥ parṇam acchinat tasya yo 'ṃśuḥ parāpatat sa pūtīko 'bhavat tasmin devā ūtim avindann ūtīko vā eṣa yat pūtīkān abhiṣuṇvanty ūtim evāsmai vindanti
meaning: गायत्री सोमम् आहरत् तस्या अनु विसृज्य सोमरक्षिः पर्णम् अच्छिनत् तस्य यो ऽंशुः परापतत् स पूतीको ऽभवत् तस्मिन् देवा ऊतिम् अविन्दन्न् ऊतीको वा एष यत् पूतीकान् अभिषुण्वन्त्य् ऊतिम् एवास्मै विन्दन्ति
text_mt: The Gāyatrī brought Soma. Having shot after her, the Soma-guardian cut off a feather of hers. Whichever shoot of it flew away, that became the pūtīka. In it the gods found help (ūti); this is indeed an "ūtīka" (help-plant). When they press pūtīka plants, they find help for him.

sanskrit_iast: pratidhuk ca prātaḥ pūtīkāś ca śṛtaṃ ca madhyandine pūtīkāś ca dadhi cāparāhṇe pūtīkāś ca
meaning: प्रतिधुक् च प्रातः पूतीकाश् च शृतं च मध्यन्दिने पूतीकाश् च दधि चापराह्णे पूतीकाश् च
text_mt: Freshly milked milk and pūtīka plants in the morning, boiled milk and pūtīka plants at midday, and curd and pūtīka plants in the afternoon.

sanskrit_iast: somapītho vā etasmād apakrāmatīty āhur yasya somam apaharantīti sa oṣadhīś ca paśūṃś ca praviśati tam oṣadhibhyaś ca paśubhyaś cāvarundhe
meaning: सोमपीथो वा एतस्माद् अपक्रामतीत्य् आहुर् यस्य सोमम् अपहरन्तीति स ओषधीश् च पशूंश् च प्रविशति तम् ओषधिभ्यश् च पशुभ्यश् चावरुन्धे
text_mt: "The draught of Soma departs from him whose Soma they steal," they say. It enters into the plants and cattle; he secures it from the plants and cattle.

sanskrit_iast: indro vṛtram ahaṃs tasya yo nastaḥ somaḥ samadhāvat tāni babhrutūlāny arjunāni yo vapāyā utkhinnāyās tāni lohitatūlāni yāni babhrutūlāny arjunāni tāny abhiṣuṇuyād etad vai brahmaṇo rūpaṃ sākṣād eva somam abhiṣuṇoti
meaning: इन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहंस् तस्य यो नस्तः सोमः समधावत् तानि बभ्रुतूलान्य् अर्जुनानि यो वपाया उत्खिन्नायास् तानि लोहिततूलानि यानि बभ्रुतूलान्य् अर्जुनानि तान्य् अभिषुणुयाद् एतद् वै ब्रह्मणो रूपं साक्षाद् एव सोमम् अभिषुणोति
text_mt: Indra slew Vṛtra. The Soma which flowed together from his nostrils became brown-tufted arjuna plants; that from his ruptured caul became red-tufted [plants]. Those which are brown-tufted arjuna plants he should press. That is the form of brahman; directly indeed he presses Soma.

sanskrit_iast: śrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma kāryaṃ sad evainaṃ karoti
meaning: श्रायन्तीयं ब्रह्मसाम कार्यं सद् एवैनं करोति
text_mt: The Śrāyantīya should be made the Brahmasāman; it makes him real.

sanskrit_iast: yajñāyajñīyam anuṣṭubhi prohed vācaivainaṃ samardhayati vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma kāryam indriyasya vīryasya parigṛhītyai
meaning: यज्ञायज्ञीयम् अनुष्टुभि प्रोहेद् वाचैवैनं समर्धयति वारवन्तीयम् अग्निष्टोमसाम कार्यम् इन्द्रियस्य वीर्यस्य परिगृहीत्यै
text_mt: He should weave the Yajñāyajñīya into the anuṣṭubh; he strengthens it with speech. The Vāravantīya should be made the Agniṣṭomasāman, for securing vital power and manly strength.

sanskrit_iast: pañca dakṣiṇā deyāḥ
meaning: पञ्च दक्षिणा देयाः

sanskrit_iast: pāṅkto yajño yāvān yajñas tam evārabhate
meaning: पाङ्क्तो यज्ञो यावान् यज्ञस् तम् एवारभते
text_mt: Fivefold is the sacrifice; as great as the sacrifice is, of that he takes hold.

sanskrit_iast: avabhṛthād udetya punar dīkṣeta
meaning: अवभृथाद् उदेत्य पुनर् दीक्षेत
text_mt: Having emerged from the purifying bath, he should be consecrated again.

sanskrit_iast: tatra tad dadyād yad dāsyaṃ syāt
meaning: तत्र तद् दद्याद् यद् दास्यं स्यात्
text_mt: Then he should give whatever was to be given.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kalaśo dīryeta vaṣaṭkāraṇidhanaṃ brahmasāma kuryāt
meaning: यदि कलशो दीर्येत वषट्कारणिधनं ब्रह्मसाम कुर्यात्
text_mt: If the jar should burst, he should make the Brahmasāman have the vaṣaṭ-call as cadence.

sanskrit_iast: avaṣaṭkṛto vā etasya somaḥ parāsicyate yasya kalaśo dīryate yad vaṣaṭkāraṇīdhanaṃ brahmasāma bhavati vaṣaṭkṛta evāsya somo bhavati
meaning: अवषट्कृतो वा एतस्य सोमः परासिच्यते यस्य कलशो दीर्यते यद् वषट्कारणीधनं ब्रह्मसाम भवति वषट्कृत एवास्य सोमो भवति
text_mt: Without the vaṣaṭ-call having been uttered, his Soma is poured away, whose jar bursts. When the Brahmasāman has the vaṣaṭ-call as cadence, his Soma is indeed provided with the vaṣaṭ-call.

sanskrit_iast: vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnām ity etāsu kāryam
meaning: विधुं दद्राणं समने बहूनाम् इत्य् एतासु कार्यम्
text_mt: It should be performed on these [verses]: "Running alone in the assembly of many..."

sanskrit_iast: eṣa hi bahūnāṃ samane dīryate yat kalaśaḥ
meaning: एष हि बहूनां समने दीर्यते यत् कलशः
text_mt: For it is in the assembly of many that this jar bursts.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur na vā ārtyārtir anūdyārtyā vā eṣa ārtim anuvadati yaḥ kalaśo dīrṇe dadrāṇavatīṣu karotīti
meaning: तद् आहुर् न वा आर्त्यार्तिर् अनूद्यार्त्या वा एष आर्तिम् अनुवदति यः कलशो दीर्णे दद्राणवतीषु करोतीति
text_mt: Concerning this they say: "Distress is not to be repeated after distress; he speaks after distress with distress, who performs on [verses] containing 'running' when the jar has burst."

sanskrit_iast: śrāyantīyam eva kāryam
meaning: श्रायन्तीयम् एव कार्यम्
text_mt: The Śrāyantīya alone should be performed.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata sa dugdho riricāno 'manyata sa etac chrāyantīyam apaśyat tenātmānaṃ samaśrīṇāt prajayā paśubhir indriyeṇa
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत स दुग्धो रिरिचानो ऽमन्यत स एतच् छ्रायन्तीयम् अपश्यत् तेनात्मानं समश्रीणात् प्रजया पशुभिर् इन्द्रियेण
text_mt: Prajāpati created creatures. Being milked out, he felt emptied. He saw this Śrāyantīya; by it he restored himself with offspring, cattle, and vital power.

sanskrit_iast: dugdha iva eṣa riricāno yasya kalaśo dīryate yac chrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma bhavati punar evātmānaṃ saṃśrīṇāti prajayā paśubhir indriyeṇa
meaning: दुग्ध इव एष रिरिचानो यस्य कलशो दीर्यते यच् छ्रायन्तीयं ब्रह्मसाम भवति पुनर् एवात्मानं संश्रीणाति प्रजया पशुभिर् इन्द्रियेण
text_mt: Milked out as it were, emptied is he whose jar bursts. When the Brahmasāman is the Śrāyantīya, he restores himself again with offspring, cattle, and vital power.

sanskrit_iast: yadi śrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma syād vaiṣṇavīṣv anuṣṭupsu vaṣaṭkāraṇidhanaṃ kuryāt
meaning: यदि श्रायन्तीयं ब्रह्मसाम स्याद् वैष्णवीष्व् अनुष्टुप्सु वषट्कारणिधनं कुर्यात्
text_mt: If the Brahmasāman should be the Śrāyantīya, he should make it have the vaṣaṭ-call as cadence on Vaiṣṇava anuṣṭubh verses.

sanskrit_iast: yad vai yajñasya sravati vācaṃ pratisravati vāg anuṣṭup yajño viṣṇur vācaiva yajñasya cchidram apidadhāti
meaning: यद् वै यज्ञस्य स्रवति वाचं प्रतिस्रवति वाग् अनुष्टुप् यज्ञो विष्णुर् वाचैव यज्ञस्य च्छिद्रम् अपिदधाति
text_mt: Whatever of the sacrifice leaks, leaks toward speech; speech is the anuṣṭubh, Viṣṇu is the sacrifice; with speech he covers the fissure of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yad vai yajñasya sravaty antataḥ sravati vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma kāryaṃ yajñasyaiva cchidraṃ vārayate
meaning: यद् वै यज्ञस्य स्रवत्य् अन्ततः स्रवति वारवन्तीयम् अग्निष्टोमसाम कार्यं यज्ञस्यैव च्छिद्रं वारयते
text_mt: Whatever of the sacrifice leaks, leaks at the end. The Vāravantīya should be made the Agniṣṭomasāman; he wards off the fissure of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prātassavanāt somo 'tiricyeta asti somo ayaṃ suta iti marutvatīṣu gāyatreṣu stuyuḥ
meaning: यदि प्रातस्सवनात् सोमो ऽतिरिच्येत अस्ति सोमो अयं सुत इति मरुत्वतीषु गायत्रेषु स्तुयुः
text_mt: If Soma should remain over from the morning pressing, they should chant on Marutvat verses in gāyatrī [metres]: "There is this pressed Soma..."

sanskrit_iast: mādhyandinaṃ vā eṣa savanaṃ nikāmayamāno 'bhyatiricyate yaḥ prātassavanād atiricyate tasmān marutvatīṣu stuvanti marutvad dhi mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ tasmād u gāyatrīṣu gāyatraṃ hi prātassavanam
meaning: माध्यन्दिनं वा एष सवनं निकामयमानो ऽभ्यतिरिच्यते यः प्रातस्सवनाद् अतिरिच्यते तस्मान् मरुत्वतीषु स्तुवन्ति मरुत्वद् धि माध्यन्दिनं सवनं तस्माद् उ गायत्रीषु गायत्रं हि प्रातस्सवनम्
text_mt: Desiring the midday pressing, this one is left over, which is left over from the morning pressing. Therefore they chant on Marutvat verses, for the midday pressing is accompanied by the Maruts; and therefore on gāyatrī [verses], for the morning pressing belongs to the gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: yasmāt stomād atiricyate sa eva stomaḥ kāryaḥ salomatvāya
meaning: यस्मात् स्तोमाद् अतिरिच्यते स एव स्तोमः कार्यः सलोमत्वाय
text_mt: Whatever stoma it is left over from, that same stoma should be used, for conformity.

sanskrit_iast: aindrāvaiṣṇavaṃ hotānuśaṃsati
meaning: ऐन्द्रावैष्णवं होतानुशंसति

sanskrit_iast: vīryaṃ vā indro yajño viṣṇur vīrya eva yajñe pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: वीर्यं वा इन्द्रो यज्ञो विष्णुर् वीर्य एव यज्ञे प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: Indra is manly strength, Viṣṇu is the sacrifice; in manly strength, in the sacrifice, he stands firm.

sanskrit_iast: yadi mādhyandināt savanād atiricyeta baṇ mahāṃ asi sūryety ādityavatīṣu gaurīvitena stuyuḥ
meaning: यदि माध्यन्दिनात् सवनाद् अतिरिच्येत बण् महां असि सूर्येत्य् आदित्यवतीषु गौरीवितेन स्तुयुः
text_mt: If it should remain over from the midday pressing, they should chant with the Gaurīvita on verses to the Ādityas: "Truly, great art thou, O Sūrya..."

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyasavanaṃ vā eṣa nikāmayamāno 'bhyatiricyate yo mādhyandināt savanād atiricyate tasmād ādityavatīṣu stuvanty ādityaṃ hi tṛtīyasavanaṃ tasmād u bṛhatīṣu bārhataṃ hi mādhyandinaṃ savanam
meaning: तृतीयसवनं वा एष निकामयमानो ऽभ्यतिरिच्यते यो माध्यन्दिनात् सवनाद् अतिरिच्यते तस्माद् आदित्यवतीषु स्तुवन्त्य् आदित्यं हि तृतीयसवनं तस्माद् उ बृहतीषु बार्हतं हि माध्यन्दिनं सवनम्
text_mt: Desiring the third pressing, this one is left over, which is left over from the midday pressing. Therefore they chant on verses to the Ādityas, for the third pressing belongs to the Ādityas; and therefore on bṛhatī [verses], for the midday pressing belongs to the Bṛhat.

sanskrit_iast: yasmāt stomād atiricyeta sa eva stomaḥ kāryaḥ salomatvāyaindrāvaiṣṇavaṃ hotānuśaṃsati vīryaṃ vā indro yajño viṣṇur vīrya eva yajñe pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: यस्मात् स्तोमाद् अतिरिच्येत स एव स्तोमः कार्यः सलोमत्वायैन्द्रावैष्णवं होतानुशंसति वीर्यं वा इन्द्रो यज्ञो विष्णुर् वीर्य एव यज्ञे प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: Whatever stoma it should remain over from, that same stoma should be used, for conformity. The Hotṛ recites after it an Aindrāvaiṣṇava [hymn]. Indra is manly strength, Viṣṇu is the sacrifice; in manly strength, in the sacrifice, he stands firm.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tṛtīyasavanād atiricyeta viṣṇoḥ śipiviṣṭavatīṣu gaurīvitena stuyuḥ
meaning: यदि तृतीयसवनाद् अतिरिच्येत विष्णोः शिपिविष्टवतीषु गौरीवितेन स्तुयुः
text_mt: If it should remain over from the third pressing, they should chant with the Gaurīvita on verses to Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa.

sanskrit_iast: yajño vai viṣṇuś śipiviṣṭo yajña eva viṣṇau pratitiṣṭhaty atiriktaṃ gaurīvitam atirikta evātiriktaṃ dadhāti
meaning: यज्ञो वै विष्णुश् शिपिविष्टो यज्ञ एव विष्णौ प्रतितिष्ठत्य् अतिरिक्तं गौरीवितम् अतिरिक्त एवातिरिक्तं दधाति
text_mt: Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa is the sacrifice; in the sacrifice, in Viṣṇu, he stands firm. Redundant is the Gaurīvita; in the redundant he places the redundant.

sanskrit_iast: etad anyat kuryur ukthāni praṇayeyur ukthāni vā eṣa nikāmayamāno 'bhyatiricyate yo 'gniṣṭomād atiricyate yady ukthyebhyo 'tiricyetātirātraḥ kāryo rātriṃ vā eṣa nikāmayamāno 'bhyatiricyate ya ukthyebhyo 'tiricyate yadi rātrer atiricyeta viṣṇoḥ śipiviṣṭavatīṣu bṛhatā stuyur eṣu tu vā atiricyata ity āhur yo rātrer atiricyata iti
meaning: एतद् अन्यत् कुर्युर् उक्थानि प्रणयेयुर् उक्थानि वा एष निकामयमानो ऽभ्यतिरिच्यते यो ऽग्निष्टोमाद् अतिरिच्यते यद्य् उक्थ्येभ्यो ऽतिरिच्येतातिरात्रः कार्यो रात्रिं वा एष निकामयमानो ऽभ्यतिरिच्यते य उक्थ्येभ्यो ऽतिरिच्यते यदि रात्रेर् अतिरिच्येत विष्णोः शिपिविष्टवतीषु बृहता स्तुयुर् एषु तु वा अतिरिच्यत इत्य् आहुर् यो रात्रेर् अतिरिच्यत इति
text_mt: They should do this otherwise: they should bring forward the uktha [lauds]. Desiring the uktha [lauds], indeed, does he become redundant who is left over from the agniṣṭoma. If he is left over from the ukthya [lauds], an atirātra should be performed; for desiring the night, indeed, does he become redundant who is left over from the ukthya [lauds]. If he is left over from the night [rite], they should chant with the Bṛhat on verses addressed to Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa; for they say, 'In these [verses], indeed, he is left over,' who is left over from the night [rite].

sanskrit_iast: amuṃ vā eṣa lokaṃ nikāmayamāno 'bhyatiricyate yo rātrer atiricyate bṛhatā stuvanti bṛhad amuṃ lokam āptum arhati tam evāpnoti
meaning: अमुं वा एष लोकं निकामयमानो ऽभ्यतिरिच्यते यो रात्रेर् अतिरिच्यते बृहता स्तुवन्ति बृहद् अमुं लोकम् आप्तुम् अर्हति तम् एवाप्नोति
text_mt: Desiring that world, indeed, does he become redundant who is left over from the night [rite]. They chant with the Bṛhat; the Bṛhat is able to attain that world, and he attains that very [world].

sanskrit_iast: yadi dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate dagdhvāsthīny upanahya yo nediṣṭhī syāt taṃ dīkṣayitvā saha yajeran
meaning: यदि दीक्षितानां प्रमीयते दग्ध्वास्थीन्य् उपनह्य यो नेदिष्ठी स्यात् तं दीक्षयित्वा सह यजेरन्
text_mt: If one of the consecrated dies, having burned [the body] and tied up the bones, having consecrated him who is nearest [of kin], they should sacrifice together.

sanskrit_iast: etad anyat kuryur abhiṣutyānyat somam agṛhītvā grahān yāsau dakṣiṇā sraktis tad vā stuyur mārjālīye vā
meaning: एतद् अन्यत् कुर्युर् अभिषुत्यान्यत् सोमम् अगृहीत्वा ग्रहान् यासौ दक्षिणा स्रक्तिस् तद् वा स्तुयुर् मार्जालीये वा
text_mt: They should do this otherwise: having pressed other Soma without taking the libation-cups, they should chant either at that southern corner or at the Mārjālīya [hearth].

sanskrit_iast: api vā etasya yajñe yo dīkṣitaḥ pramīyate tam etena niravadayante
meaning: अपि वा एतस्य यज्ञे यो दीक्षितः प्रमीयते तम् एतेन निरवदयन्ते
text_mt: Indeed, him who, being consecrated, dies during his sacrifice, they appease by this.

sanskrit_iast: yāmena stuvanti yamalokam evainaṃ gamayanti
meaning: यामेन स्तुवन्ति यमलोकम् एवैनं गमयन्ति
text_mt: They chant with the Yāma [sāman]; they make him go to the world of Yama.

sanskrit_iast: tisṛbhiḥ stuvanti tṛtīye hi loke pitaraḥ
meaning: तिसृभिः स्तुवन्ति तृतीये हि लोके पितरः
text_mt: They chant with three [verses], for the Fathers are in the third world.

sanskrit_iast: parācībhiḥ stuvanti parāṅ hīto 'sau lokaḥ
meaning: पराचीभिः स्तुवन्ति पराङ् हीतो ऽसौ लोकः
text_mt: They chant with non-returning [verses], for that world is turned away from here.

sanskrit_iast: sarparājñyā ṛgbhiḥ stuvanti
meaning: सर्पराज्ञ्या ऋग्भिः स्तुवन्ति
text_mt: They chant with the verses of the Serpent Queen.

sanskrit_iast: arbudaḥ sarpa etābhir mṛtāṃ tvacam apāhata mṛtām evaitābhis tvacam apaghnate
meaning: अर्बुदः सर्प एताभिर् मृतां त्वचम् अपाहत मृताम् एवैताभिस् त्वचम् अपघ्नते
text_mt: Arbuda the serpent sloughed off his dead skin by means of these [verses]; by means of these they slough off the dead skin.

sanskrit_iast: tā ṛco 'nubruvantas trir mārjālīyaṃ pariyanti savyān ūrūn āghnānāḥ
meaning: ता ऋचो ऽनुब्रुवन्तस् त्रिर् मार्जालीयं परियन्ति सव्यान् ऊरून् आघ्नानाः
text_mt: Reciting these verses, beating their left thighs, they go thrice around the Mārjālīya [hearth].

sanskrit_iast: stutam anuśaṃsaty amuṣminn evainaṃ loke nidhnuvanti
meaning: स्तुतम् अनुशंसत्य् अमुष्मिन्न् एवैनं लोके निध्नुवन्ति
text_mt: He recites after the chant of praise; in that world they lay him down.

sanskrit_iast: yanti vā ete patha ity āhur ye mṛtāya kurvantīty aindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇate punaḥ panthānam apiyanti
meaning: यन्ति वा एते पथ इत्य् आहुर् ये मृताय कुर्वन्तीत्य् ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रान् ग्रहान् गृह्णते पुनः पन्थानम् अपियन्ति
text_mt: They say, 'Departing from the path are those who perform [rites] for the dead.' They take the libation-cups beginning with that for Indra and Vāyu; they return to the path.

sanskrit_iast: agna āyūṃṣi pavasa iti pratipatkāryā ya eva jīvanti teṣv āyur dadhāti
meaning: अग्न आयूंषि पवस इति प्रतिपत्कार्या य एव जीवन्ति तेष्व् आयुर् दधाति
text_mt: 'O Agni, you purify life-spans' is to be made the introductory verse; in those who are alive he bestows life.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsare 'sthīni yājayeyuḥ saṃvvatsaro vai sarvasya śāntir yat purā saṃvvatsarād yājayeyur vācam aruṣkṛtāṃ krūrām ṛccheyuḥ
meaning: संवत्सरे ऽस्थीनि याजयेयुः संव्वत्सरो वै सर्वस्य शान्तिर् यत् पुरा संव्वत्सराद् याजयेयुर् वाचम् अरुष्कृतां क्रूराम् ऋच्छेयुः
text_mt: After a year they should cause the bones to sacrifice; the year is indeed the pacification of everything. If they were to cause [them] to sacrifice before a year, they would meet with wounded, cruel speech.

sanskrit_iast: vṛtaḥ pavamānāḥ syuḥ saptadaśam itarat sarvam
meaning: वृतः पवमानाः स्युः सप्तदशम् इतरत् सर्वम्
text_mt: The Pavamāna [stotras] should be ninefold; all the rest seventeenfold.

sanskrit_iast: yat trivṛtaḥ pavamānā bhavanti prāṇā vai trivṛt prāṇān evopayanti yat saptadaśam itarat sarvaṃ prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajatim evopayanti
meaning: यत् त्रिवृतः पवमाना भवन्ति प्राणा वै त्रिवृत् प्राणान् एवोपयन्ति यत् सप्तदशम् इतरत् सर्वं प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजतिम् एवोपयन्ति
text_mt: In that the Pavamāna [stotras] are ninefold, the vital breaths are indeed ninefold; they obtain the vital breaths. In that all the rest is seventeenfold, Prajāpati is seventeenfold; they obtain procreation.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāpānair vā ete vyṛdhyanta ity āhur ye mṛtāya kurvantīti maitrāvaruṇāgrān grahān gṛhṇate prāṇāpānau mitrāvaruṇau prāṇāpānair eva samṛdhyante
meaning: प्राणापानैर् वा एते व्यृध्यन्त इत्य् आहुर् ये मृताय कुर्वन्तीति मैत्रावरुणाग्रान् ग्रहान् गृह्णते प्राणापानौ मित्रावरुणौ प्राणापानैर् एव समृध्यन्ते
text_mt: They say, 'Deprived of in-breath and out-breath are those who perform [rites] for the dead.' They draw the libation-cups beginning with that for Mitra and Varuṇa; Mitra and Varuṇa are in-breath and out-breath; they prosper with in-breath and out-breath.

sanskrit_iast: yasya kalaśa upadasyati kalaśam evāsyopadasyantaṃ prāṇo 'nūpadasyati prāṇo hi somaḥ
meaning: यस्य कलश उपदस्यति कलशम् एवास्योपदस्यन्तं प्राणो ऽनूपदस्यति प्राणो हि सोमः
text_mt: He whose vessel runs dry—the vital breath of him whose vessel runs dry diminishes after it, for Soma is vital breath.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhuḥ payo 'vanayed iti
meaning: तद् आहुः पयो ऽवनयेद् इति
text_mt: On this they say: 'He should pour down milk.'

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhur antarhitam iva vā etad yat payo hiraṇyam evāpo'bhyavanayed dhiraṇyam abhyunnayed iti
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुर् अन्तर्हितम् इव वा एतद् यत् पयो हिरण्यम् एवापोऽभ्यवनयेद् धिरण्यम् अभ्युन्नयेद् इति
text_mt: Moreover they say: 'Milk is as it were concealed; he should pour down gold into water, [and] draw up [the Soma] over gold.'

sanskrit_iast: prāṇā vā āpo 'mṛtaṃ hiraṇyam amṛta evāsya prāṇān dadhāti sa sarvam āyur eti
meaning: प्राणा वा आपो ऽमृतं हिरण्यम् अमृत एवास्य प्राणान् दधाति स सर्वम् आयुर् एति
text_mt: The waters are vital breaths, gold is immortality; he establishes his vital breaths in immortality; he attains a full life-span.

sanskrit_iast: yasya nārāśaṃsa upavāyati nārāśaṃsam evāsyopavāyantaṃ prāṇo 'nūpadasyati prāṇo hi somaḥ
meaning: यस्य नाराशंस उपवायति नाराशंसम् एवास्योपवायन्तं प्राणो ऽनूपदस्यति प्राणो हि सोमः
text_mt: He whose Nārāśaṃsa [cup] dries up—the vital breath of him whose Nārāśaṃsa [cup] dries up diminishes after it, for Soma is vital breath.

sanskrit_iast: yam adhvaryur antato grahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt tasyāptum avanayet
meaning: यम् अध्वर्युर् अन्ततो ग्रहं गृह्णीयात् तस्याप्तुम् अवनयेत्
text_mt: Whichever libation-cup the adhvaryu draws at the end, he should pour out its drop.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścityai vai graho gṛhyate prāyaścityevāsmai prāyaścittiṃ karoti
meaning: प्रायश्चित्यै वै ग्रहो गृह्यते प्रायश्चित्येवास्मै प्रायश्चित्तिं करोति
text_mt: For atonement, indeed, the cup is drawn; by the atonement itself he performs an atonement for him.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pītāpītau somau saṃgaccheyātām antaḥ paridhyaṅgārān nirvartya juhuyāt hutasya cāhutasya cāhutasya hutasya ca | pītāpītasya somasyendrāgnī pibataṃ sutaṃ svāheti saiva tasya prāyaścittiḥ
meaning: यदि पीतापीतौ सोमौ संगच्छेयाताम् अन्तः परिध्यङ्गारान् निर्वर्त्य जुहुयात् हुतस्य चाहुतस्य चाहुतस्य हुतस्य च | पीतापीतस्य सोमस्येन्द्राग्नी पिबतं सुतं स्वाहेति सैव तस्य प्रायश्चित्तिः
text_mt: If Somas, drunk and undrunk, should come together, having rolled out the burning coals inside the enclosing sticks, he should offer: 'Of the offered and unoffered, of the unoffered and offered, / of the drunk and undrunk Soma, drink, O Indra and Agni, what has been pressed, svāhā.' That is the atonement for it.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpataye svāhety abhakṣaṇīyasya juhuyād uttarārdhyapūrvārdhya uparavaḥ
meaning: प्रजापतये स्वाहेत्य् अभक्षणीयस्य जुहुयाद् उत्तरार्ध्यपूर्वार्ध्य उपरवः
text_mt: With 'To Prajāpati, svāhā,' he should offer [the portion] unfit for consumption into the north-eastern resonance hole.

sanskrit_iast: indur indum avāgād ity avavṛṣṭasya bhakṣayet
meaning: इन्दुर् इन्दुम् अवागाद् इत्य् अववृष्टस्य भक्षयेत्
text_mt: With 'Indu has reached Indu,' he should consume [Soma] that has been rained upon.

sanskrit_iast: tasya ta indrav indrapītasyendriyāvatas sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
meaning: तस्य त इन्द्रव् इन्द्रपीतस्येन्द्रियावतस् सर्वगणस्य सर्वगण उपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि
text_mt: 'Of you, O Indu, drunk by Indra, endowed with faculties, possessing all the troop, I, having all the troop, being invited, consume of the invited.'

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgra ity ājyenābhyupākṛtasya juhuyād agnīdhraṃ paretya bhūtānāṃ jātaḥ patir eka āsīt sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyām utemāṃ tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema svāheti saiva tasya prāyaścittiḥ
meaning: हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्र इत्य् आज्येनाभ्युपाकृतस्य जुहुयाद् अग्नीध्रं परेत्य भूतानां जातः पतिर् एक आसीत् स दाधार पृथिवीं द्याम् उतेमां तस्मै त इन्दो हविषा विधेम स्वाहेति सैव तस्य प्रायश्चित्तिः
text_mt: Going past the Agnīdhra [hearth], he should offer with ghee for that which has been brought forward, with: 'The Golden Germ arose in the beginning; born, he was the sole lord of creation; he upheld this earth and heaven; to that [god], O Indu, may we pay worship with oblation, svāhā.' That is the atonement for it.

sanskrit_iast: yadi grāvāpi śīryate paśubhir yajamāno vyṛdhyate paśavo vai grāvāṇo dyutānasya mārutasya sāmnā stuyuḥ
meaning: यदि ग्रावापि शीर्यते पशुभिर् यजमानो व्यृध्यते पशवो वै ग्रावाणो द्युतानस्य मारुतस्य साम्ना स्तुयुः
text_mt: If a pressing-stone breaks, the sacrificer is deprived of cattle; cattle are indeed the pressing-stones. They should chant with the sāman of Dyutāna, the son of the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: mārutā vai grāvāṇaḥ svenaivaināṃs tad rūpeṇa samardhayati
meaning: मारुता वै ग्रावाणः स्वेनैवैनांस् तद् रूपेण समर्धयति
text_mt: The pressing-stones belong to the Maruts; by its own characteristic form he causes them to prosper.

sanskrit_iast: yadi somam abhidahed grahān adhvaryuḥ spāśayeta stotrāṇy udgātā śastrāṇi hotātha yathāpūrvaṃ yajñena careyuḥ pañca dakṣiṇā deyāḥ pāṅkto yajño yāvān yajñas tam ārabhate 'vabhṛthād udetya punar dīkṣate tatra tad dadyād yad dāsyaṃ syāt purā dvādaśyā dīkṣeta yad dvādaśīm atinayed antardhīyeta
meaning: यदि सोमम् अभिदहेद् ग्रहान् अध्वर्युः स्पाशयेत स्तोत्राण्य् उद्गाता शस्त्राणि होताथ यथापूर्वं यज्ञेन चरेयुः पञ्च दक्षिणा देयाः पाङ्क्तो यज्ञो यावान् यज्ञस् तम् आरभते ऽवभृथाद् उदेत्य पुनर् दीक्षते तत्र तद् दद्याद् यद् दास्यं स्यात् पुरा द्वादश्या दीक्षेत यद् द्वादशीम् अतिनयेद् अन्तर्धीयेत
text_mt: If Soma burns up, the adhvaryu should attend to the cups, the udgātṛ to the chants of praise, the hotṛ to the recitations; then they should proceed with the sacrifice according to the regular order. Five sacrificial gifts are to be given; the sacrifice is fivefold; as great as the sacrifice is, so much he undertakes. Having emerged from the concluding bath, he consecrates himself again; there he should give that which he had intended to give. He should consecrate himself before the twelfth [day]; if he should let the twelfth [day] pass by, it would disappear.

sanskrit_iast: yadi mahāvīro bhidyeta taṃ bhinnam abhimṛśed ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ | saṃdhātā saṃdhiṃ maghavā purūvasur niṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ mā bhema niṣṭyā ivendra tvad araṇā iva | vanāni na prajahitāny adrivo duroṣāso amanmahi | amanmahīd anāśavo 'nugrābhaś ca vṛtrahan | sakṛt sute mahatā śūra rādhasānu stomaṃ mademahīti mahāvīraṃ bhinnam abhimṛśet saiva tasya prāyaścittiḥ
meaning: यदि महावीरो भिद्येत तं भिन्नम् अभिमृशेद् य ऋते चिद् अभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आतृदः | संधाता संधिं मघवा पुरूवसुर् निष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः मा भेम निष्ट्या इवेन्द्र त्वद् अरणा इव | वनानि न प्रजहितान्य् अद्रिवो दुरोषासो अमन्महि | अमन्महीद् अनाशवो ऽनुग्राभश् च वृत्रहन् | सकृत् सुते महता शूर राधसानु स्तोमं मदेमहीति महावीरं भिन्नम् अभिमृशेत् सैव तस्य प्रायश्चित्तिः
text_mt: If the Mahāvīra [pot] breaks, he should touch it when broken with: 'He who, even without joining, before the piercing of the collar-bones, / joins the joint, Maghavan of many treasures, repairs what has been disjointed again. Let us not fear as outcasts, O Indra, as strangers away from you; / like neglected forests, O possessor of the press-stone, we have considered ourselves difficult to burn. / We have considered ourselves weak and dependent, O slayer of Vṛtra; / once [the Soma is] pressed, with great bounty, O hero, may we rejoice in the stoma.' He should touch the broken Mahāvīra [pot]; that is the atonement for it.

sanskrit_iast: asuryaṃ vā etasmād varṇaṃ kṛtvā teja indriyaṃ vīryam annādyaṃ prajāḥ paśavo 'pakrāmanti yasya yūpo virohati sa īśvaraḥ pāpīyān bhavitoḥ
meaning: असुर्यं वा एतस्माद् वर्णं कृत्वा तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यम् अन्नाद्यं प्रजाः पशवो ऽपक्रामन्ति यस्य यूपो विरोहति स ईश्वरः पापीयान् भवितोः
text_mt: Having made an asuric color for him, fiery energy, power of the senses, virility, food, offspring, and cattle depart from him whose sacrificial post sprouts; he is liable to become worse off.

sanskrit_iast: tvāṣṭraṃ paśuṃ bahurūpam ālabheta tvaṣṭā vai paśūnāṃ rūpāṇāṃ vikartā tam eva tad upadhāvati sa enaṃ tejaseindriyeṇa vīryeṇānnādyena prajayā paśubhiḥ punas samardhayati saiva tasya prāyaścittiḥ
meaning: त्वाष्ट्रं पशुं बहुरूपम् आलभेत त्वष्टा वै पशूनां रूपाणां विकर्ता तम् एव तद् उपधावति स एनं तेजसेइन्द्रियेण वीर्येणान्नाद्येन प्रजया पशुभिः पुनस् समर्धयति सैव तस्य प्रायश्चित्तिः
text_mt: He should slaughter a many-colored animal for Tvaṣṭṛ. Tvaṣṭṛ is indeed the fashioner of the forms of cattle; to him he then has recourse. He provides him again with fiery energy, power of the senses, virility, food, offspring, and cattle. That is the atonement for it.

sanskrit_iast: agninā pṛthivyauṣadhibhis tenāyaṃ lokas trivṛd vāyunāntarikṣeṇa vayobhis tenaiṣa lokās trivṛd yo 'yam antar ādityena divā nakṣatrais tenāsau lokas trivṛd etad eva trivṛta āyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
meaning: अग्निना पृथिव्यौषधिभिस् तेनायं लोकस् त्रिवृद् वायुनान्तरिक्षेण वयोभिस् तेनैष लोकास् त्रिवृद् यो ऽयम् अन्तर् आदित्येन दिवा नक्षत्रैस् तेनासौ लोकस् त्रिवृद् एतद् एव त्रिवृत आयतनम् एषास्य बन्धुता
text_mt: By Agni, the earth, and the plants, this world is threefold; by Vāyu, the atmosphere, and the birds, this intermediate world is threefold; by the sun, the sky, and the constellations, that world is threefold. That is the domain of the ninefold stoma, that is its connection.

sanskrit_iast: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: आयतनवान् बन्धुमान् भवति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows thus becomes possessed of a domain and possessed of connections.

sanskrit_iast: tam u pratiṣṭhetyāhus trivṛd dhy evaiṣu lokeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ
meaning: तम् उ प्रतिष्ठेत्याहुस् त्रिवृद् ध्य् एवैषु लोकेषु प्रतिष्ठितः
text_mt: And they call it the support, for established in these worlds is the ninefold [stoma].

sanskrit_iast: ardhamāsa eva pañcadaśasyāyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
meaning: अर्धमास एव पञ्चदशस्यायतनम् एषास्य बन्धुता
text_mt: The half-month is the domain of the fifteenfold [stoma]; that is its connection.

sanskrit_iast: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: आयतनवान् बन्धुमान् भवति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows thus becomes possessed of a domain and possessed of connections.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ caujo balam ity āhur ardhamāsaśo hi prajāḥ paśava ojo balaṃ puṣyanti
meaning: तं चौजो बलम् इत्य् आहुर् अर्धमासशो हि प्रजाः पशव ओजो बलं पुष्यन्ति
text_mt: And they call it vitality and strength, for half-month by half-month offspring and cattle nourish vitality and strength.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsara eva saptadaśasyāyatanaṃ dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcadartava etad eva saptadaśasyāyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
meaning: संवत्सर एव सप्तदशस्यायतनं द्वादश मासाः पञ्चदर्तव एतद् एव सप्तदशस्यायतनम् एषास्य बन्धुता
text_mt: The year is the resort of the seventeenfold stoma; twelve are the months, five are the seasons: this is the resort of the seventeenfold stoma, this is its kinship.

sanskrit_iast: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: आयतनवान् बन्धुमान् भवति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows this becomes possessed of a resort, possessed of kinship.

sanskrit_iast: tam u prajāpatir ity āhuḥ saṃvatsaraṃ hi prajāḥ paśavo 'nuprajāyante
meaning: तम् उ प्रजापतिर् इत्य् आहुः संवत्सरं हि प्रजाः पशवो ऽनुप्रजायन्ते
text_mt: And they call it Prajāpati; for in accordance with the year creatures and cattle are brought forth.

sanskrit_iast: āditya evaikaviṃsasyāyatanaṃ dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcavartas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśa etad evaikaviṃśasyāyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
meaning: आदित्य एवैकविंसस्यायतनं द्वादश मासाः पञ्चवर्तस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंश एतद् एवैकविंशस्यायतनम् एषास्य बन्धुता
text_mt: The sun is the resort of the twenty-one-fold stoma; twelve are the months, five the seasons, three these worlds, yonder sun is the twenty-first: this is the resort of the twenty-one-fold stoma, this is its kinship.

sanskrit_iast: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: आयतनवान् बन्धुमान् भवति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows this becomes possessed of a resort, possessed of kinship.

sanskrit_iast: tam u devatalpa ity āhuḥ pra devatalpam āpnoti ya evaṃv veda
meaning: तम् उ देवतल्प इत्य् आहुः प्र देवतल्पम् आप्नोति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: And they call it the couch of the gods; he who knows this reaches the couch of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd eva triṇavasyāyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
meaning: त्रिवृद् एव त्रिणवस्यायतनम् एषास्य बन्धुता
text_mt: The ninefold stoma is the resort of the twenty-seven-fold stoma: this is its kinship.

sanskrit_iast: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: आयतनवान् बन्धुमान् भवति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows this becomes possessed of a resort, possessed of kinship.

sanskrit_iast: tam u puṣṭir ity āhus trivṛd dhy evaiṣa puṣṭaḥ
meaning: तम् उ पुष्टिर् इत्य् आहुस् त्रिवृद् ध्य् एवैष पुष्टः
text_mt: And they call it nourishment; for this [stoma] is nourished by the ninefold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: devatā eva trayastriṃśasyāyatanaṃ trayastriṃśad devatāḥ prajāpatiś catustriṃśa etad eva trayastriṃśasyāyatanam eṣāsya bandhutā
meaning: देवता एव त्रयस्त्रिंशस्यायतनं त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवताः प्रजापतिश् चतुस्त्रिंश एतद् एव त्रयस्त्रिंशस्यायतनम् एषास्य बन्धुता
text_mt: The deities are the resort of the thirty-three-fold stoma; thirty-three are the deities, Prajāpati is the thirty-fourth: this is the resort of the thirty-three-fold stoma, this is its kinship.

sanskrit_iast: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: आयतनवान् बन्धुमान् भवति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows this becomes possessed of a resort, possessed of kinship.

sanskrit_iast: tam u nāka ity āhur na hi prajāpatiḥ kasmai canākam
meaning: तम् उ नाक इत्य् आहुर् न हि प्रजापतिः कस्मै चनाकम्
text_mt: And they call it the firmament (nāka); for Prajāpati is not sorrow (na-akam) to anyone.

sanskrit_iast: chandāṃsy eva chandomānām āyatanam eṣaiṣāṃ bandhutā
meaning: छन्दांस्य् एव छन्दोमानाम् आयतनम् एषैषां बन्धुता
text_mt: The metres are the resort of the Chandomas: this is their kinship.

sanskrit_iast: āyatanavān bandhumān bhavati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: आयतनवान् बन्धुमान् भवति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows this becomes possessed of a resort, possessed of kinship.

sanskrit_iast: tān u puṣṭir ity āhuḥ paśavo hi chandomāḥ
meaning: तान् उ पुष्टिर् इत्य् आहुः पशवो हि छन्दोमाः
text_mt: And they call them nourishment; for the Chandomas are cattle.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata so 'tāmyat tasmai vāj jyotir udagṛhṇāt so 'bravīt ko me 'yaṃ jyotir udagṛhṇād iti svaiva te vāg ity abravīt tām abravīd virājaṃ tvā cchandasāṃ jyotiṣkṛtvā yajāntā iti
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत सो ऽताम्यत् तस्मै वाज् ज्योतिर् उदगृह्णात् सो ऽब्रवीत् को मे ऽयं ज्योतिर् उदगृह्णाद् इति स्वैव ते वाग् इत्य् अब्रवीत् ताम् अब्रवीद् विराजं त्वा च्छन्दसां ज्योतिष्कृत्वा यजान्ता इति
text_mt: Prajāpati created creatures; he became exhausted. Speech held up a light for him. He said: 'Who has held up this light for me?' 'Your own speech,' she said. He said to her: 'Having made you, the virāj, the light of the metres, let them sacrifice!'

sanskrit_iast: tasmād yo virājaṃ stomaṃ saṃpadyate taṃ jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭoma ity ācakṣate virāḍ ḍhi chandasāṃ jyotiḥ
meaning: तस्माद् यो विराजं स्तोमं संपद्यते तं ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोम इत्य् आचक्षते विराड् ढि छन्दसां ज्योतिः
text_mt: Therefore, the stoma which attains the virāj, that they call the Jyotiṣṭoma, the Agniṣṭoma; for the virāj is the light of the metres.

sanskrit_iast: jyotiḥ samānānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃv veda
meaning: ज्योतिः समानानां भवति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows this becomes a light among his equals.

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭup ca vai saptadaśaś ca samabhavatāṃ sānuṣṭup caturuttarāṇi chandāṃsy asṛjata ṣaḍuttarān stomān saptadaśas tāv etān madhyataḥ prājanayatām
meaning: अनुष्टुप् च वै सप्तदशश् च समभवतां सानुष्टुप् चतुरुत्तराणि छन्दांस्य् असृजत षडुत्तरान् स्तोमान् सप्तदशस् ताव् एतान् मध्यतः प्राजनयताम्
text_mt: The anuṣṭubh and the seventeenfold stoma arose together. The anuṣṭubh created the metres increasing by four [syllables]; the seventeenfold stoma [created] the stomas increasing by six [verses]. These two brought them forth from the middle.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛc ca triṇavaś ca rāthantarau tāv ajaś cāśvaś cānvasṛjyetāṃ tasmāt tau rāthantaraṃ prācīnaṃ pradhūnutaḥ
meaning: त्रिवृच् च त्रिणवश् च राथन्तरौ ताव् अजश् चाश्वश् चान्वसृज्येतां तस्मात् तौ राथन्तरं प्राचीनं प्रधूनुतः
text_mt: The ninefold and the twenty-seven-fold [stomas] are connected with the Rathantara; along with them the goat and the horse were created; therefore those two shake forward toward the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśaś caikaviṃśaś ca bārhatau tau gauś cāviś cānvasṛjyetāṃ tasmāt tau bārhataṃ prācīnaṃ bhāskurutaḥ
meaning: पञ्चदशश् चैकविंशश् च बार्हतौ तौ गौश् चाविश् चान्वसृज्येतां तस्मात् तौ बार्हतं प्राचीनं भास्कुरुतः
text_mt: The fifteenfold and the twenty-one-fold [stomas] are connected with the Bṛhat; along with them the cow and the sheep were created; therefore those two bleat forward toward the Bṛhat.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ vai vidvāṃsam āhur api grāmyāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ vāca ājānāti
meaning: एवं वै विद्वांसम् आहुर् अपि ग्राम्याणां पशूनां वाच आजानाति
text_mt: Thus indeed they say of a man who knows: he understands even the speech of domestic animals.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir akāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti sa ātmann ṛtvyam apaśyat tata ṛtvijo 'sṛjata yad ṛtvyād asṛjata tad ṛtvijām ṛtviktvaṃ tair etaṃ dvādaśāham upāsīdat so 'rādhnot
meaning: प्रजापतिर् अकामयत बहु स्यां प्रजायेयेति स आत्मन्न् ऋत्व्यम् अपश्यत् तत ऋत्विजो ऽसृजत यद् ऋत्व्याद् असृजत तद् ऋत्विजाम् ऋत्विक्त्वं तैर् एतं द्वादशाहम् उपासीदत् सो ऽराध्नोत्
text_mt: Prajāpati desired: 'May I be many, may I be reproduced.' He saw the timely power in himself; from it he created the priests. Because he created them from the timely power (ṛtvya), that is why the priests are priests (ṛtvij). With them he celebrated this twelve-day rite; he prospered.

sanskrit_iast: pitā no 'rātsīd iti māsā upāsīdaṃs te dīkṣayaivārādhnuvann upasatsu trayodaśam adīkṣayan so ' nuvyam abhavat tasmād upasatsu didīkṣāṇo 'nuvyaṃ bhavaty eva ca hi trayodaśaṃ māsaṃ cakṣate naiva ca
meaning: पिता नो ऽरात्सीद् इति मासा उपासीदंस् ते दीक्षयैवाराध्नुवन्न् उपसत्सु त्रयोदशम् अदीक्षयन् सो ' नुव्यम् अभवत् तस्माद् उपसत्सु दिदीक्षाणो ऽनुव्यं भवत्य् एव च हि त्रयोदशं मासं चक्षते नैव च
text_mt: The months celebrated [it], saying: 'Our father has prospered.' Through the consecration alone they prospered; at the Upasads they consecrated the thirteenth [month]; it became a supernumerary. Therefore, one who seeks consecration at the Upasads becomes a supernumerary; for indeed people both speak of a thirteenth month and do not speak of it.

sanskrit_iast: eko dīkṣetaiko hi prajāpatir arādhnod dvādaśa dīkṣeran dvādaśa hi māsā arādhnuvaṃś caturviṃśatir dīkṣeraṃś caturviṃśatir hy ardhamāsā arādhnuvan
meaning: एको दीक्षेतैको हि प्रजापतिर् अराध्नोद् द्वादश दीक्षेरन् द्वादश हि मासा अराध्नुवंश् चतुर्विंशतिर् दीक्षेरंश् चतुर्विंशतिर् ह्य् अर्धमासा अराध्नुवन्
text_mt: One should undergo consecration, for one Prajāpati prospered; twelve should undergo consecration, for twelve months prospered; twenty-four should undergo consecration, for twenty-four half-months prospered.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pañcadaśo dīkṣeteme pañceme pañceme pañceme pañceme catvāro 'sāv eka iti nirdiśeyur yasmā arāddhikāmāḥ syus tam evārāddhir anveti sarva itare rādhnuvanti
meaning: यदि पञ्चदशो दीक्षेतेमे पञ्चेमे पञ्चेमे पञ्चेमे पञ्चेमे चत्वारो ऽसाव् एक इति निर्दिशेयुर् यस्मा अराद्धिकामाः स्युस् तम् एवाराद्धिर् अन्वेति सर्व इतरे राध्नुवन्ति
text_mt: If fifteen should undergo consecration, they should point out: 'These five, these five, these five; these five, these four, yonder one.' The prosperity falls to him whom they wish to prosper; all the others prosper [likewise].

sanskrit_iast: yo vai devānāṃ gṛhapatiṃ vedāśnute gārhapataṃ pra gārhapatam āpnoti
meaning: यो वै देवानां गृहपतिं वेदाश्नुते गार्हपतं प्र गार्हपतम् आप्नोति
text_mt: He who knows the householder among the gods attains the householder's dignity, reaches the householder's dignity.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaro vai devānāṃ gṛhapatiḥ sa eva prajāpatis tasya māsā eva saha dīkṣiṇaḥ
meaning: संवत्सरो वै देवानां गृहपतिः स एव प्रजापतिस् तस्य मासा एव सह दीक्षिणः
text_mt: The year is the householder among the gods; it is Prajāpati; its fellow-initiates are the months.

sanskrit_iast: vindate saha dīkṣiṇo 'śnute gārhapatyaṃ pra gārhapatyaṃ āpnoti ya evaṃv veda |
meaning: विन्दते सह दीक्षिणो ऽश्नुते गार्हपत्यं प्र गार्हपत्यं आप्नोति य एवंव् वेद |
text_mt: He who knows this finds fellow-initiates, attains the householder's dignity, reaches the householder's dignity.

sanskrit_iast: yo vai chandasāṃ svarājaṃ vedāśnute svārājyaṃ pra svārājyaṃ āpnoti bṛhatī vāva chandasāṃ svarāḍ aśnute svārājyaṃ pra svārājyaṃ āpnoti ya evaṃv veda
meaning: यो वै छन्दसां स्वराजं वेदाश्नुते स्वाराज्यं प्र स्वाराज्यं आप्नोति बृहती वाव छन्दसां स्वराड् अश्नुते स्वाराज्यं प्र स्वाराज्यं आप्नोति य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: He who knows the self-ruler among the metres attains self-rule, reaches self-rule. The bṛhatī is the self-ruler among the metres. He who knows this attains self-rule, reaches self-rule.

sanskrit_iast: tām etām annādyāya vyāvṛjyāsate yad etaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ dvādaśa dīkṣā svādaśopasado dvādaśa prasutaḥ ṣaṭriṃśad etā rātrayo bhavanti ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā bṛhatī
meaning: ताम् एताम् अन्नाद्याय व्यावृज्यासते यद् एतं द्वादशाहं द्वादश दीक्षा स्वादशोपसदो द्वादश प्रसुतः षट्रिंशद् एता रात्रयो भवन्ति षट्त्रिंशदक्षरा बृहती
text_mt: They sit [engaged] in this [rite] appropriating it for food: that this twelve-day rite has twelve consecrations, twelve Upasads, twelve pressings; these become thirty-six nights; the bṛhatī has thirty-six syllables.

sanskrit_iast: jāyate vāva dīkṣayā punīta upasadbhir devalokam eva sutyayāpyeti
meaning: जायते वाव दीक्षया पुनीत उपसद्भिर् देवलोकम् एव सुत्ययाप्येति
text_mt: One is born through the consecration, purifies oneself through the Upasads, and enters the world of the gods through the pressing.

sanskrit_iast: etāvad vāva saṃvatsara indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yad etā rātrayo dvādaśa pūṛnamāsyo dvādaśaikaṣṭakā dvādaśāmāvāsyā yāvad eva saṃvatsara indriyaṃ vīryaṃ tad etenāptvāvarundhe dvādaśāhena
meaning: एतावद् वाव संवत्सर इन्द्रियं वीर्यं यद् एता रात्रयो द्वादश पूऋनमास्यो द्वादशैकष्टका द्वादशामावास्या यावद् एव संवत्सर इन्द्रियं वीर्यं तद् एतेनाप्त्वावरुन्धे द्वादशाहेन
text_mt: Just so much virility and vigour is in the year as these nights: twelve full moons, twelve eighth days after the full moon, twelve new moons. As much virility and vigour as is in the year, that he obtains and secures by this twelve-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: triṃśadakṣarā vā eṣā virāḍ ṣaḍ ṛtava ṛtuṣv eva virājā pratitiṣṭhaty ṛtubhir virāji
meaning: त्रिंशदक्षरा वा एषा विराड् षड् ऋतव ऋतुष्व् एव विराजा प्रतितिष्ठत्य् ऋतुभिर् विराजि
text_mt: This virāj has thirty syllables; six are the seasons. Through the virāj he firmly establishes himself in the seasons, and through the seasons in the virāj.

sanskrit_iast: dvātriṃśadakṣarā vā eṣānuṣṭub vāg anuṣṭup catuṣpādaḥ paśavo vācā paśūn dādhāra tasmād vācā siddhā vācāhūtā āyanti tasmād u nāma jānate
meaning: द्वात्रिंशदक्षरा वा एषानुष्टुब् वाग् अनुष्टुप् चतुष्पादः पशवो वाचा पशून् दाधार तस्माद् वाचा सिद्धा वाचाहूता आयन्ति तस्माद् उ नाम जानते
text_mt: This anuṣṭubh has thirty-two syllables; speech is the anuṣṭubh; cattle are four-footed. Through speech he has supported cattle; therefore, impelled by speech, summoned by speech, they come; therefore, too, they know their name.

sanskrit_iast: bhūtaṃ pūrvo 'tirātro bhaviṣyad uttaraḥ pṛthivī pūrvo 'tirātro dyaur uttaro 'gniḥ pūrvo 'tirātra āditya uttaraḥ prāṇaḥ pūrvo 'tirātra udāna uttaraḥ
meaning: भूतं पूर्वो ऽतिरात्रो भविष्यद् उत्तरः पृथिवी पूर्वो ऽतिरात्रो द्यौर् उत्तरो ऽग्निः पूर्वो ऽतिरात्र आदित्य उत्तरः प्राणः पूर्वो ऽतिरात्र उदान उत्तरः
text_mt: The first atirātra is what has been; the second is what will be. The first atirātra is the earth; the second is heaven. The first atirātra is Agni; the second is the sun. The first atirātra is the out-breath; the second is the up-breath.

sanskrit_iast: cakṣuṣī atirātrau kanīnike agniṣṭomau yasmād antarā agniṣṭomāv atirātrābhyāṃ tasmād antare satyau kanīnike bhuṅktaḥ
meaning: चक्षुषी अतिरात्रौ कनीनिके अग्निष्टोमौ यस्माद् अन्तरा अग्निष्टोमाव् अतिरात्राभ्यां तस्माद् अन्तरे सत्यौ कनीनिके भुङ्क्तः
text_mt: The two eyes are the two atirātras; the two pupils are the two Agniṣṭomas. Because the two Agniṣṭomas are between the two atirātras, therefore the two pupils, being inside, experience [sight].

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsarasya vā etau daṃṣṭrau yad atirātrau tayor na svaptavyaṃ saṃvatsarasya daṃṣṭrayor ātmānaṃ ned apidadhānīti
meaning: संवत्सरस्य वा एतौ दंष्ट्रौ यद् अतिरात्रौ तयोर् न स्वप्तव्यं संवत्सरस्य दंष्ट्रयोर् आत्मानं नेद् अपिदधानीति
text_mt: The two atirātras are the two tusks of the year. During them one should not sleep, [thinking:] 'Lest I place myself within the two tusks of the year.'

sanskrit_iast: tad āhuḥ ko 'svaptum arhati yad vāva prāṇo jāgāra tad eva jāgaritam iti
meaning: तद् आहुः को ऽस्वप्तुम् अर्हति यद् वाव प्राणो जागार तद् एव जागरितम् इति
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'Who can go without sleeping? When the breath stays awake, that itself is the waking.'

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṃ vā etāṃ jyotiḥpakṣām āsate yad etaṃ dvādaśāham aṣṭau madhya ukthā agniṣṭomāv abhito māsā svargṃ lokam etyājarasaṃ brahmādyam annam atti dīpyamānaḥ
meaning: गायत्रीं वा एतां ज्योतिःपक्षाम् आसते यद् एतं द्वादशाहम् अष्टौ मध्य उक्था अग्निष्टोमाव् अभितो मासा स्वर्ग्ं लोकम् एत्याजरसं ब्रह्माद्यम् अन्नम् अत्ति दीप्यमानः
text_mt: They sit [engaged in] this twelve-day rite as the gāyatrī with wings of light: in the middle are eight uktha days, flanked by two Agniṣṭomas. Having reached the heavenly world, glowing, he eats unaging food suitable for Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast: triṣpurastād rathantaraṃ upayanti tryāvṛd vai vāk sarvām eva vācam avarudhya sarvam annādyaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ tanvate
meaning: त्रिष्पुरस्ताद् रथन्तरं उपयन्ति त्र्यावृद् वै वाक् सर्वाम् एव वाचम् अवरुध्य सर्वम् अन्नाद्यं द्वादशाहं तन्वते
text_mt: Three times in the beginning they undertake the Rathantara; threefold is speech. Having secured all speech, all food, they perform the twelve-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: jāmi vā etad yajñe kriyata ity āhur yat triṣpurastād rathantaram upayantīti saubharam ukthānāṃ brahmasāma bhavati tenaiva tad ajāmi
meaning: जामि वा एतद् यज्ञे क्रियत इत्य् आहुर् यत् त्रिष्पुरस्ताद् रथन्तरम् उपयन्तीति सौभरम् उक्थानां ब्रह्मसाम भवति तेनैव तद् अजामि
text_mt: They say: 'A tautology is committed in the sacrifice in that they undertake the Rathantara three times in the beginning.' The Saubhara is the Brahma-sāman of the uktha days; thereby it is varied.

sanskrit_iast: pratnavatyaḥ prāyaṇīyasyāhnaḥ pratipado bhavanti teno eva tad ajāmi
meaning: प्रत्नवत्यः प्रायणीयस्याह्नः प्रतिपदो भवन्ति तेनो एव तद् अजामि
text_mt: Verses containing the word 'ancient' (pratna) are the introductory verses of the opening day; thereby too it is varied.

sanskrit_iast: trir vevopariṣṭād rathantaram upayanti trāvṛd vai vāk sarvām eva vācam avarudhya sarvam annādyaṃ dvādaśāhād uttiṣṭhanti
meaning: त्रिर् वेवोपरिष्टाद् रथन्तरम् उपयन्ति त्रावृद् वै वाक् सर्वाम् एव वाचम् अवरुध्य सर्वम् अन्नाद्यं द्वादशाहाद् उत्तिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: Three times at the end they undertake the Rathantara; threefold is speech. Having secured all speech, all food, they conclude the twelve-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: trayo vā ete trirātrā yad eṣa dvādaśāho gāytramukhaḥ prathamo gāyatramadhyo dvitīyo gāyatrottamas tṛtīyaḥ
meaning: त्रयो वा एते त्रिरात्रा यद् एष द्वादशाहो गाय्त्रमुखः प्रथमो गायत्रमध्यो द्वितीयो गायत्रोत्तमस् तृतीयः
text_mt: These three three-day periods are this twelve-day rite: the first has the gāyatrī in the beginning; the second has the gāyatrī in the middle; the third has the gāyatrī at the end.

sanskrit_iast: yasmād gāyatramukhaḥ prathamas tasmād ūrdhvo 'gnir dīdāya yasmād gāyatramadhyo dvitīyas tasmāt tiryaṅ vāyuḥ pavate
meaning: यस्माद् गायत्रमुखः प्रथमस् तस्माद् ऊर्ध्वो ऽग्निर् दीदाय यस्माद् गायत्रमध्यो द्वितीयस् तस्मात् तिर्यङ् वायुः पवते
text_mt: Because the first [three-day period] has the gāyatrī at the beginning, therefore Agni blazes upwards; because the second has the gāyatrī in the middle, therefore the wind blows horizontally.

sanskrit_iast: tejasā vā ete prayanti tejo madhye dadhati tejo 'bhyudyanti jyotiṣā vā ete prayanti jyotir madhye dadhati jyotir abhyudyanti cakṣuṣā vā ete prayanti cakṣur madhye dadhati cakṣur abhyudyanti prāṇena vā ete prayanti prāṇaṃ madhye dadhati prāṇam abhyudyanti ye gāyatryā prayanti gāyatrīṃ madhye dadhati gāyatrim abhyudyanti
meaning: तेजसा वा एते प्रयन्ति तेजो मध्ये दधति तेजो ऽभ्युद्यन्ति ज्योतिषा वा एते प्रयन्ति ज्योतिर् मध्ये दधति ज्योतिर् अभ्युद्यन्ति चक्षुषा वा एते प्रयन्ति चक्षुर् मध्ये दधति चक्षुर् अभ्युद्यन्ति प्राणेन वा एते प्रयन्ति प्राणं मध्ये दधति प्राणम् अभ्युद्यन्ति ये गायत्र्या प्रयन्ति गायत्रीं मध्ये दधति गायत्रिम् अभ्युद्यन्ति
text_mt: With fiery splendour they set out, fiery splendour they place in the middle, towards fiery splendour they rise; with light they set out, light they place in the middle, towards light they rise; with sight they set out, sight they place in the middle, towards sight they rise; with breath they set out, breath they place in the middle, towards breath they rise—those who set out with the gāyatrī, place the gāyatrī in the middle, and rise towards the gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: tantraṃ vā etad vitāyate yad eṣa dvādaśāhas tasyetair mayūkhā yad gāyatry asaṃvyāthāya
meaning: तन्त्रं वा एतद् वितायते यद् एष द्वादशाहस् तस्येतैर् मयूखा यद् गायत्र्य् असंव्याथाय
text_mt: A web is stretched out, namely this twelve-day rite; its pegs are these, namely the gāyatrīs, so that it will not waver.

sanskrit_iast: girikṣidauccāmanyaveti hovācābhipratārī kākṣaseniḥ kathaṃ dvādaśāha iti yathārān nemiḥ paryety evam enaṃ gāyatrī paryeti avisraṃsāya yathārā nābhau dhṛtā evam asyāṃ dvādaśāho dhṛtaḥ
meaning: गिरिक्षिदौच्चामन्यवेति होवाचाभिप्रतारी काक्षसेनिः कथं द्वादशाह इति यथारान् नेमिः पर्येत्य् एवम् एनं गायत्री पर्येति अविस्रंसाय यथारा नाभौ धृता एवम् अस्यां द्वादशाहो धृतः
text_mt: Abhipratārin Kākṣaseni said: 'O Girikṣit Auccāmanyava, how is the twelve-day rite?' 'Just as the rim encompasses the spokes, so the gāyatrī encompasses it, so that there is no falling apart; just as the spokes are held in the hub, so the twelve-day rite is held in it.'

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭubhaṃ vā etām annādyāya vyāvṛjyāsate yad etaṃ dvādaśāham
meaning: अनुष्टुभं वा एताम् अन्नाद्याय व्यावृज्यासते यद् एतं द्वादशाहम्
text_mt: In that they perform this twelve-day rite, they indeed sit wringing out this anuṣṭubh for food.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭābhir vā akṣair anuṣṭup prathamaṃ dvādaśāhasyāhar duyacchaty ekādaśabhir dvitīyaṃ dvādaśābhis tṛtīyam
meaning: अष्टाभिर् वा अक्षैर् अनुष्टुप् प्रथमं द्वादशाहस्याहर् दुयच्छत्य् एकादशभिर् द्वितीयं द्वादशाभिस् तृतीयम्
text_mt: With eight syllables the anuṣṭubh holds up the first day of the twelve-day rite, with eleven [syllables] the second, with twelve [syllables] the third.

sanskrit_iast: akṣaraṃ tryakṣaram ucchiṣyate tad evottaraṃ trirātram anuvidadhāti
meaning: अक्षरं त्र्यक्षरम् उच्छिष्यते तद् एवोत्तरं त्रिरात्रम् अनुविदधाति
text_mt: One syllable [or] three syllables remain over; that indeed disposes the subsequent three-day period.

sanskrit_iast: chandāṃsy evāsyās tṛtīyaṃ trirātraṃ vahanti
meaning: छन्दांस्य् एवास्यास् तृतीयं त्रिरात्रं वहन्ति
text_mt: The metres themselves carry the third three-day period of it.

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ vā etāṃ pratīcīṃ tiraścīṃ parācīm āsate 'nnādyāya tasmāt pratyañcaṃ tiryañcaṃ parāñcaṃ prajāḥ paśum upajīvanti
meaning: तां वा एतां प्रतीचीं तिरश्चीं पराचीम् आसते ऽन्नाद्याय तस्मात् प्रत्यञ्चं तिर्यञ्चं पराञ्चं प्रजाः पशुम् उपजीवन्ति
text_mt: They attend to this [anuṣṭubh] turned towards [them], turned crosswise, [and] turned away, for food; therefore creatures live upon cattle facing towards [them], crosswise, and turned away.

sanskrit_iast: chandāṃsi vā anyo'nyasya lokam abhadhyāyan gāyatrī triṣṭubhas triṣṭub jagatyā jagatī gāyatryās tāni vyauhan yathālokaṃ tato vai tāni yaṃ yaṃ kāmam akāmayanta tam asanvan
meaning: छन्दांसि वा अन्योऽन्यस्य लोकम् अभध्यायन् गायत्री त्रिष्टुभस् त्रिष्टुब् जगत्या जगती गायत्र्यास् तानि व्यौहन् यथालोकं ततो वै तानि यं यं कामम् अकामयन्त तम् असन्वन्
text_mt: The metres coveted one another's world: the gāyatrī [coveted the world] of the triṣṭubh, the triṣṭubh of the jagatī, the jagatī of the gāyatrī; they shifted them to their respective worlds; thereupon whatever desire they desired, that they obtained.

sanskrit_iast: yatkāmo vyūḍhacchandasā dvadaśāhena yajate so 'smai kāmaḥ samṛdhyate
meaning: यत्कामो व्यूढच्छन्दसा द्वदशाहेन यजते सो ऽस्मै कामः समृध्यते
text_mt: Whatever desire he has when he sacrifices with the twelve-day rite with shifted metres, that desire of his is fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast: oko vai devānāṃ dvādaśāho yatho vai manuṣyā imaṃ lokam āviṣṭā evaṃ devatā dvādaśāham āviṣṭā devatā ha vā etena yajate ya evaṃv vidvān dvādaśāhena yajate
meaning: ओको वै देवानां द्वादशाहो यथो वै मनुष्या इमं लोकम् आविष्टा एवं देवता द्वादशाहम् आविष्टा देवता ह वा एतेन यजते य एवंव् विद्वान् द्वादशाहेन यजते
text_mt: The twelve-day rite is indeed the dwelling of the gods; just as humans inhabit this world, so the deities inhabit the twelve-day rite. He indeed sacrifices to the deities who, knowing thus, sacrifices with the twelve-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhā vai devānāṃ dvādaśāho nāgṛhatāyā bhayyam
meaning: गृहा वै देवानां द्वादशाहो नागृहताया भय्यम्
text_mt: The twelve-day rite is indeed the home of the gods; there is no fear of being without a home.

sanskrit_iast: yo vai dvādaśāham agniṣṭomena kalpamānaṃ veda kalpate 'smai prātaḥsavanenaiva prathamas trirātraḥ kalpate mādhyandinena dvitīyas tṛtīyasavanena tṛtīyo 'gniṣṭomasāmnaiva daśamam ahaḥ kalpate
meaning: यो वै द्वादशाहम् अग्निष्टोमेन कल्पमानं वेद कल्पते ऽस्मै प्रातःसवनेनैव प्रथमस् त्रिरात्रः कल्पते माध्यन्दिनेन द्वितीयस् तृतीयसवनेन तृतीयो ऽग्निष्टोमसाम्नैव दशमम् अहः कल्पते
text_mt: Whoever knows the twelve-day rite arranging itself through the agniṣṭoma, for him it arranges itself: through the morning pressing the first three-day period arranges itself, through the midday [pressing] the second, through the third pressing the third; through the agniṣṭoma-sāman the tenth day arranges itself.

sanskrit_iast: kalpate 'smai ya evaṃv veda
meaning: कल्पते ऽस्मै य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: Things arrange themselves for him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: eti prety āśumad vītimad rukmat tejasvad yuñjānaṃ prathamasyāhno rūpaṃ trivṛtaḥ stomasya gāyatrasya chandaso rathantarasya sāmnaḥ
meaning: एति प्रेत्य् आशुमद् वीतिमद् रुक्मत् तेजस्वद् युञ्जानं प्रथमस्याह्नो रूपं त्रिवृतः स्तोमस्य गायत्रस्य छन्दसो रथन्तरस्य साम्नः
text_mt: [The words] eti, pra, swift, containing enjoyment, brilliant, full of fiery splendour, yoking: this is the characteristic mark of the first day, of the ninefold stoma, of the gāyatrī metre, of the Rathantara sāman.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣavad vṛtravad rayimad viśvavad upasthitaṃ dvitīyasyāhno rūpaṃ pañcadaśasya stomasya traiṣṭubhasya chandaso bṛhataḥ sāmnaḥ
meaning: वृषवद् वृत्रवद् रयिमद् विश्ववद् उपस्थितं द्वितीयस्याह्नो रूपं पञ्चदशस्य स्तोमस्य त्रैष्टुभस्य छन्दसो बृहतः साम्नः
text_mt: Containing bull, containing Vṛtra, containing wealth, containing all, standing near: this is the characteristic mark of the second day, of the fifteenfold stoma, of the triṣṭubh metre, of the Bṛhat sāman.

sanskrit_iast: udvat trivad digvat gomaṭ ṭaṣabhavat tṛtīyasyāhno rūpaṃ saptadaśasya stomasya jāgatasya chandaso vairūpasya sāmnaḥ
meaning: उद्वत् त्रिवद् दिग्वत् गोमट् टषभवत् तृतीयस्याह्नो रूपं सप्तदशस्य स्तोमस्य जागतस्य छन्दसो वैरूपस्य साम्नः
text_mt: Containing upward, containing three, containing quarters, containing cattle, containing a bull: this is the characteristic mark of the third day, of the seventeenfold stoma, of the jagatī metre, of the Vairūpa sāman.

sanskrit_iast: rājanvaj janavadvat sūryavad virāḍanutodavac caturthasyāhno rūpam ekaviṃśasya stomasyānuṣṭubhasya chandaso rājasya vai sāmnaḥ
meaning: राजन्वज् जनवद्वत् सूर्यवद् विराडनुतोदवच् चतुर्थस्याह्नो रूपम् एकविंशस्य स्तोमस्यानुष्टुभस्य छन्दसो राजस्य वै साम्नः
text_mt: Containing king, containing people, containing the sun, virāj, uninterrupted: this is the characteristic mark of the fourth day, of the twenty-one-fold stoma, of the anuṣṭubh metre, of the [Vairāja] sāman.

sanskrit_iast: citravac chiśumat paṅktiḥ śakvarī dyūnākṣarā gomad ṛṣabhavad vajryabhimat pañcamasyāhno rūpaṃ triṇavasya stomasya pāṅktena chandaso śakvarīṇāṃ sāmnaḥ
meaning: चित्रवच् छिशुमत् पङ्क्तिः शक्वरी द्यूनाक्षरा गोमद् ऋषभवद् वज्र्यभिमत् पञ्चमस्याह्नो रूपं त्रिणवस्य स्तोमस्य पाङ्क्तेन छन्दसो शक्वरीणां साम्नः
text_mt: Containing bright, containing child, paṅkti, śakvarī, defective in syllables, containing cattle, containing a bull, having the thunderbolt, hostile: this is the characteristic mark of the fifth day, of the twenty-seven-fold stoma, of the paṅkti metre, of the Śakvarī sāmans.

sanskrit_iast: parivat prativat saptapadā dvipadā vinārāśaṃsā gomad ṛṣabhavat ṣaṣṭhasyāhno rūpaṃ trayastriṃśasya stomasya sarveṣāṃ chandasāṃ rūpaṃ revatīnāṃ sāmnaḥ
meaning: परिवत् प्रतिवत् सप्तपदा द्विपदा विनाराशंसा गोमद् ऋषभवत् षष्ठस्याह्नो रूपं त्रयस्त्रिंशस्य स्तोमस्य सर्वेषां छन्दसां रूपं रेवतीनां साम्नः
text_mt: Containing around, containing against, seven-footed, two-footed, devoid of nārāśaṃsa verses, containing cattle, containing a bull: this is the characteristic mark of the sixth day, of the thirty-three-fold stoma, the characteristic mark of all metres, of the Revatī sāmans.

sanskrit_iast: yasmād eṣā samānā satī ṣaḍahavibhaktir nānārūpā tasmād virūpaḥ saṃvvatsaraḥ
meaning: यस्माद् एषा समाना सती षडहविभक्तिर् नानारूपा तस्माद् विरूपः संव्वत्सरः
text_mt: Because this distribution of the six-day period, though uniform, is manifold in form, therefore the year is manifold in form.

sanskrit_iast: virūpam enam anuprajāyate ya evaṃv veda
meaning: विरूपम् एनम् अनुप्रजायते य एवंव् वेद
text_mt: Manifold [offspring] is born after him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: agna iti prathamasyāhno rūpam agnivibhakter agnim iti dvitīyasyāgnineti tṛtīyasyāgnir iti caturthasya
meaning: अग्न इति प्रथमस्याह्नो रूपम् अग्निविभक्तेर् अग्निम् इति द्वितीयस्याग्निनेति तृतीयस्याग्निर् इति चतुर्थस्य
text_mt: [The case-form] agne is the characteristic mark of the first day among the case-forms of Agni; agnim of the second; agninā of the third; agniḥ of the fourth.

sanskrit_iast: devā vai śriyam aicchaṃs tān na prathame 'hany avindan na dvitīye na tṛtīye tāñ caturthe 'hany avindan vindate śriyaṃ ya evaṃ vedāgner iti pañcamasya teno śrīḥ pratyupoditety āhuḥ
meaning: देवा वै श्रियम् ऐच्छंस् तान् न प्रथमे ऽहन्य् अविन्दन् न द्वितीये न तृतीये ताञ् चतुर्थे ऽहन्य् अविन्दन् विन्दते श्रियं य एवं वेदाग्नेर् इति पञ्चमस्य तेनो श्रीः प्रत्युपोदितेत्य् आहुः
text_mt: The gods sought prosperity; they did not find it on the first day, nor on the second, nor on the third; they found it on the fourth day. He finds prosperity who knows thus. [The form] agneḥ is of the fifth day; 'through it, prosperity rose up before them,' they say.

sanskrit_iast: aprativādy enaṃ bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: अप्रतिवाद्य् एनं भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: His rival becomes unable to answer him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: agna iti ṣaṣṭhasya yenaiva rūpeṇa prayanti tad abhyudyanti
meaning: अग्न इति षष्ठस्य येनैव रूपेण प्रयन्ति तद् अभ्युद्यन्ति
text_mt: [The form] agne is of the sixth [day]. With the very form with which they set out, towards that they rise.

sanskrit_iast: yasmād eṣā samānā saty agnivbhaktir nānārūpā tasmād yathartv ādityas tapati
meaning: यस्माद् एषा समाना सत्य् अग्निव्भक्तिर् नानारूपा तस्माद् यथर्त्व् आदित्यस् तपति
text_mt: Because this distribution of Agni, though uniform, is manifold in form, therefore the sun burns according to the seasons.

sanskrit_iast: indreti prathamasyāhno rūpam indravibhakter indram iti dvitīyasyendreṇeti tṛtīyasyendra iti caturthasyendrād iti pañcamasyendreti ṣaṣṭhasya yenaiva rūpeṇa prayanti tad abhyudyanti yasmād eṣā samānā satīndravibhaktir nānārūpā tasmād yathartv oṣadhayaḥ pacyante
meaning: इन्द्रेति प्रथमस्याह्नो रूपम् इन्द्रविभक्तेर् इन्द्रम् इति द्वितीयस्येन्द्रेणेति तृतीयस्येन्द्र इति चतुर्थस्येन्द्राद् इति पञ्चमस्येन्द्रेति षष्ठस्य येनैव रूपेण प्रयन्ति तद् अभ्युद्यन्ति यस्माद् एषा समाना सतीन्द्रविभक्तिर् नानारूपा तस्माद् यथर्त्व् ओषधयः पच्यन्ते
text_mt: [The case-form] indra is the characteristic mark of the first day among the case-forms of Indra; indram of the second; indreṇa of the third; indraḥ of the fourth; indrāt of the fifth; indra of the sixth. With the very form with which they set out, towards that they rise. Because this distribution of Indra, though uniform, is manifold in form, therefore the plants ripen according to the seasons.

sanskrit_iast: yad ṛcā prastauti tat prathamasyāhno rūpam svaravibhakter yat purastāt stobhaṃ tad dvitīyasya yad ubhayataḥ stobhaṃ tat tṛtīyasya yad anutunnaṃ tac caturthasya yad abhyārabdhaṃ tat pañcamasya yad ihakāreṇābhyastaṃ tat ṣaṣṭhasyāhno rūpam
meaning: यद् ऋचा प्रस्तौति तत् प्रथमस्याह्नो रूपम् स्वरविभक्तेर् यत् पुरस्तात् स्तोभं तद् द्वितीयस्य यद् उभयतः स्तोभं तत् तृतीयस्य यद् अनुतुन्नं तच् चतुर्थस्य यद् अभ्यारब्धं तत् पञ्चमस्य यद् इहकारेणाभ्यस्तं तत् षष्ठस्याह्नो रूपम्
text_mt: That he chants the prastāva with a verse is the characteristic mark of the first day among the variations of musical tone; that which has the stobha at the beginning is of the second; that which has the stobha on both sides is of the third; that which is unthrust is of the fourth; that which is taken up is of the fifth; that which is repeated with the word iha is the characteristic mark of the sixth day.

sanskrit_iast: svarāṇāṃ yasmād eṣā samānā satī svaravibhaktir nnānārūpā tasmād yathartu vāyuḥ pavate
meaning: स्वराणां यस्माद् एषा समाना सती स्वरविभक्तिर् न्नानारूपा तस्माद् यथर्तु वायुः पवते
text_mt: Because this distribution of musical tones, though uniform, is manifold in form, therefore the wind blows according to the seasons.

sanskrit_iast: padanidhanaṃ prathamasyāhno rūpam nidhanavibhakter bahirṇidhanaṃ dvitīyasya niṃnidhanaṃ tṛtīyasyenidhanañ caturthasyāthakāraṇidhanaṃ pañcamasya yad ihākāreṇābhyastaṃ tat ṣaṣṭhasyāhno rūpaṃ nidhanānāṃ yasmād eṣā samānā satī nidhanavibhaktir nnānārūpā tasmād ime lokāḥ saha santo nānaiva
meaning: पदनिधनं प्रथमस्याह्नो रूपम् निधनविभक्तेर् बहिर्णिधनं द्वितीयस्य निंनिधनं तृतीयस्येनिधनञ् चतुर्थस्याथकारणिधनं पञ्चमस्य यद् इहाकारेणाभ्यस्तं तत् षष्ठस्याह्नो रूपं निधनानां यस्माद् एषा समाना सती निधनविभक्तिर् न्नानारूपा तस्माद् इमे लोकाः सह सन्तो नानैव
text_mt: A word-cadence is the characteristic mark of the first day among the variations of cadence; a cadence outside is of the second; a nim-cadence is of the third; an i-cadence is of the fourth; an atha-cadence is of the fifth; that which is repeated with the word ihā is the characteristic mark of the sixth day among cadences. Because this distribution of cadences, though uniform, is manifold in form, therefore these worlds, though being together, are distinct.

sanskrit_iast: dravadiḍaṃ prathamasyāhno rūpam iḍāvibhakter ūrdhveḍaṃ dvitīyasya pariṣṭubdheḍaṃ tṛtīyasyeḍābhir aiḍaṃ caturthasyādhyardheḍaṃ pañcamasya yad ihākāreṇābhyastaṃ tat ṣaṣṭhasyāhno rūpam iḍānāṃ yasmād eṣā samānā satīḍāvibhaktir nnānārūpā tasmāt samānāḥ santaḥ paśavo nānārūpāḥ
meaning: द्रवदिडं प्रथमस्याह्नो रूपम् इडाविभक्तेर् ऊर्ध्वेडं द्वितीयस्य परिष्टुब्धेडं तृतीयस्येडाभिर् ऐडं चतुर्थस्याध्यर्धेडं पञ्चमस्य यद् इहाकारेणाभ्यस्तं तत् षष्ठस्याह्नो रूपम् इडानां यस्माद् एषा समाना सतीडाविभक्तिर् न्नानारूपा तस्मात् समानाः सन्तः पशवो नानारूपाः
text_mt: A flowing iḍā is the characteristic mark of the first day among the variations of the iḍā; an upward iḍā is of the second; an iḍā surrounded by stobhas is of the third; an iḍā with iḍās is of the fourth; an iḍā with one and a half is of the fifth; that which is repeated with the word ihā is the characteristic mark of the sixth day among iḍās. Because this distribution of the iḍā, though uniform, is manifold in form, therefore cattle, though being uniform, are manifold in form.

sanskrit_iast: bharadvājāyanā vai sattram āsata tān apṛcchan kiṃ prathamenāhnā kuruteti praivaimeti kiṃ dvitīyenety avasam evākurmahīti kiṃ tṛtīyeneti pary evāplavāmahīti kiṃ caturtheneti sataiva sad apyadadhmeti kiṃ pañcameneti prāṇān eva vicchindanta aimeti kiṃ ṣaṣṭhenetīdam evāgacchāmeti iti
meaning: भरद्वाजायना वै सत्त्रम् आसत तान् अपृच्छन् किं प्रथमेनाह्ना कुरुतेति प्रैवैमेति किं द्वितीयेनेत्य् अवसम् एवाकुर्महीति किं तृतीयेनेति पर्य् एवाप्लवामहीति किं चतुर्थेनेति सतैव सद् अप्यदध्मेति किं पञ्चमेनेति प्राणान् एव विच्छिन्दन्त ऐमेति किं षष्ठेनेतीदम् एवागच्छामेति इति
text_mt: The Bharadvāyānas held a sacrificial session. People asked them: 'What do you do with the first day?' 'We set out.' 'What with the second?' 'We provide a resting place.' 'What with the third?' 'We float around.' 'What with the fourth?' 'By existence we overlay existence.' 'What with the fifth?' 'Interrupting the vital breaths we go.' 'What with the sixth?' 'We arrive right here.'

sanskrit_iast: yasya padena prastauty atha svāram abhi vāva tena devāḥ paśūn apaśyan yat purastāt stobhaṃ atha svāram ud eva tenāsṛjanata yad ubhayataḥ stobham atha svāram ebhya eva tena lokebhyo devāḥ paśubhyo 'nnādyaṃ prāyacchan yad anutunnam atha svāram upaiva tenāśikṣan yasya madhye nidhanam atha svāraṃ garbhāṃs tenādadhata tāni havatāsvāreṇa prājanayan
meaning: यस्य पदेन प्रस्तौत्य् अथ स्वारम् अभि वाव तेन देवाः पशून् अपश्यन् यत् पुरस्तात् स्तोभं अथ स्वारम् उद् एव तेनासृजनत यद् उभयतः स्तोभम् अथ स्वारम् एभ्य एव तेन लोकेभ्यो देवाः पशुभ्यो ऽन्नाद्यं प्रायच्छन् यद् अनुतुन्नम् अथ स्वारम् उपैव तेनाशिक्षन् यस्य मध्ये निधनम् अथ स्वारं गर्भांस् तेनादधत तानि हवतास्वारेण प्राजनयन्
text_mt: [A sāman] whose prastāva is chanted with a foot and then ends in a svāra tone—by that the gods saw cattle. That which has a stobha at the beginning and then ends in a svāra tone—by that they brought forth [cattle]. That which has a stobha on both sides and then ends in a svāra tone—by that the gods gave food to cattle from these worlds. That which is unthrust and then ends in a svāra tone—by that they strove to obtain [cattle].
