That which has its cadence in the middle and then ends in a svāra tone—by that they placed embryos [in them]. With that which has 'hāvat' and ends in a svāra tone, they brought them forth.

sanskrit_iast: imaṃ vāva devā lokaṃ padanidhanenābhy ajayann amuṃ bahirṇidhanenāntarikṣaṃ diṅnidhanenāmṛtatvam īnidhanenāgacchan brahmavarcasam athanidhanenāvārundhatāsminn eva loka ihanidhanena pratyatiṣṭhan
meaning: इमं वाव देवा लोकं पदनिधनेनाभ्य् अजयन्न् अमुं बहिर्णिधनेनान्तरिक्षं दिङ्निधनेनामृतत्वम् ईनिधनेनागच्छन् ब्रह्मवर्चसम् अथनिधनेनावारुन्धतास्मिन्न् एव लोक इहनिधनेन प्रत्यतिष्ठन्
text_mt: By the pada-cadence the gods conquered this world; by the outside cadence, that [world]; by the diś-cadence, the intermediate region; by the ī-cadence they went to immortality; by the atha-cadence they attained brahminical lustre; by the iha-cadence they became established in this very world.

sanskrit_iast: imaṃ vāva devā lokaṃ dravadiḍenābhy ajayann amum ūrdhveḍenāntarikṣaṃ pariṣṭubdheḍena pratiṣṭhām iḍābhir aiḍenāvārundhata pratiṣṭhāyādhyardheḍena vyajayantāsminn eva loka iheḍena pratyatiṣṭhan
meaning: इमं वाव देवा लोकं द्रवदिडेनाभ्य् अजयन्न् अमुम् ऊर्ध्वेडेनान्तरिक्षं परिष्टुब्धेडेन प्रतिष्ठाम् इडाभिर् ऐडेनावारुन्धत प्रतिष्ठायाध्यर्धेडेन व्यजयन्तास्मिन्न् एव लोक इहेडेन प्रत्यतिष्ठन्
text_mt: By the running-iḍā the gods conquered this world; by the upward-iḍā, that [world]; by the surrounded-iḍā, the intermediate region; by the iḍā-formed [chants] they attained firm standing through iḍās; firmly standing, they conquered by the one-and-a-half-iḍā; by the iha-iḍā they became established in this very world.

sanskrit_iast: na vāk saṃvatsaram ativadatīḍaiva saṃvatsaram ativadati garbheṇa saṃvatsare paryāvṛtya prajāyete tenātivadati
meaning: न वाक् संवत्सरम् अतिवदतीडैव संवत्सरम् अतिवदति गर्भेण संवत्सरे पर्यावृत्य प्रजायेते तेनातिवदति
text_mt: Speech does not over-reach the year; only the iḍā over-reaches the year; turning around with an embryo in a year, offspring are born; thereby it over-reaches.

sanskrit_iast: tā vā etāś catasraḥ ṣaḍahaṃ parācya iḍā atiyanty eṣā nūtaiṣā viṣūcy eṣā pratīcy etad vīḍam
meaning: ता वा एताश् चतस्रः षडहं पराच्य इडा अतियन्त्य् एषा नूतैषा विषूच्य् एषा प्रतीच्य् एतद् वीडम्
text_mt: These four forward iḍās cross over the six-day period: this one [turns] hither, this one sideways, this one backwards; this is the iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaro 'gnir vāk samvatsaro yad agnir vibhajyate vācam eva tad vibhajanti
meaning: संवत्सरो ऽग्निर् वाक् सम्वत्सरो यद् अग्निर् विभज्यते वाचम् एव तद् विभजन्ति
text_mt: The year is Agni; speech is the year; when Agni is divided, it is speech that they divide.

sanskrit_iast: dve dve akṣare vibhajanti dvau dvau hi māsāv ṛturatho māsānām eva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
meaning: द्वे द्वे अक्षरे विभजन्ति द्वौ द्वौ हि मासाव् ऋतुरथो मासानाम् एव तद् रूपं क्रियते
text_mt: They divide [it] by two syllables each, for two months make a season; thus its form is made that of the months.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍ ahāni vibhajanti ṣaḍ ṛtava ṛtūnāṃ dhṛtyā ṛtūnāṃ pratiṣṭhityā atho ṛtūnām eva tad rūpaṃ kriyate ṣaḍ u puruṣā yān agnir anuvihriyate
meaning: षड् अहानि विभजन्ति षड् ऋतव ऋतूनां धृत्या ऋतूनां प्रतिष्ठित्या अथो ऋतूनाम् एव तद् रूपं क्रियते षड् उ पुरुषा यान् अग्निर् अनुविह्रियते
text_mt: They divide [it across] six days; there are six seasons, for the upholding of the seasons, for the firm standing of the seasons; thus its form is made that of the seasons; and there are six persons according to whom Agni is distributed.

sanskrit_iast: yad idaṃ bahudhāgnir vihriyate tad asāv ādityaḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ pratyaṅ tasmād ete devate vibhaktim ānaśāte nāto 'nyā kā cana
meaning: यद् इदं बहुधाग्निर् विह्रियते तद् असाव् आदित्यः सर्वाः प्रजाः प्रत्यङ् तस्माद् एते देवते विभक्तिम् आनशाते नातो ऽन्या का चन
text_mt: That Agni here is distributed in many ways, that is yonder sun facing all creatures; therefore these two deities have attained distribution, no other whatsoever.

sanskrit_iast: stomo yujyate sattriyebhyo ' harbhyaḥ pratnavatībhiś copavatībhiś ca
meaning: स्तोमो युज्यते सत्त्रियेभ्यो ' हर्भ्यः प्रत्नवतीभिश् चोपवतीभिश् च
text_mt: The stoma is harnessed for the days of the sacrificial session by means of [verses] containing 'pratna' and containing 'upa'.

sanskrit_iast: yat pratnavatyo upavatībhyaḥ pūrvā yujyante brahma tat pūrvaṃ kṣatrād yujyate brahma hi pūrvaṃ kṣatram
meaning: यत् प्रत्नवत्यो उपवतीभ्यः पूर्वा युज्यन्ते ब्रह्म तत् पूर्वं क्षत्राद् युज्यते ब्रह्म हि पूर्वं क्षत्रम्
text_mt: When the pratnavatī [verses] are harnessed before the upavatī [verses], the priesthood is thereby harnessed before the nobility, for the priesthood is prior to the nobility.

sanskrit_iast: manas tat pūrvaṃ vāco yujyate mano hi yad dhi manasābhigacchati tad vācā vadati
meaning: मनस् तत् पूर्वं वाचो युज्यते मनो हि यद् धि मनसाभिगच्छति तद् वाचा वदति
text_mt: Mind is thereby harnessed before speech, for mind [is first]; what one conceives with the mind, that one speaks with speech.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhat tat pūrvaṃ rathantarād yujyate bṛhad dhi pūrvaṃ rathantarād vijityā tu vai rathantaraṃ pūrvaṃ yogam ānaśe
meaning: बृहत् तत् पूर्वं रथन्तराद् युज्यते बृहद् धि पूर्वं रथन्तराद् विजित्या तु वै रथन्तरं पूर्वं योगम् आनशे
text_mt: The Bṛhat is thereby harnessed before the Rathantara, for the Bṛhat is prior to the Rathantara; but through conquest the Rathantara attained the prior harnessing.

sanskrit_iast: sambhāryās tṛcā bhavanti yathāśiṣṭhān vahiṣṭhān sambhared evam evaitān sambharanti gatyai
meaning: सम्भार्यास् तृचा भवन्ति यथाशिष्ठान् वहिष्ठान् सम्भरेद् एवम् एवैतान् सम्भरन्ति गत्यै
text_mt: The triplets are to be brought together; just as one would bring together the swiftest and best draught-animals, so indeed they bring these together for progressing.

sanskrit_iast: nava bhavanti navāhasya yuktyā ṛcarcaivāhar yunakti yathāprārthasya śamyā avadadhyād evam evaitan navāhasya śamyā avadadhāti gatyai
meaning: नव भवन्ति नवाहस्य युक्त्या ऋचर्चैवाहर् युनक्ति यथाप्रार्थस्य शम्या अवदध्याद् एवम् एवैतन् नवाहस्य शम्या अवदधाति गत्यै
text_mt: There are nine, for the harnessing of the nine-day period; verse by verse, he harnesses the day; just as one would insert the yoke-pins of a chariot, so he inserts the yoke-pins of the nine-day period for progressing.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd eva stomo bhavati tejase brahmavarcasāya
meaning: त्रिवृद् एव स्तोमो भवति तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसाय
text_mt: The stoma is the ninefold stoma, for brilliance, for brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: ubhābhyāṃ vai rūpābhyāṃ bahiṣpavamānyo yujyante yatsāmā stomo bhavati tad ājyeṣu
meaning: उभाभ्यां वै रूपाभ्यां बहिष्पवमान्यो युज्यन्ते यत्सामा स्तोमो भवति तद् आज्येषु
text_mt: By two forms the Bahiṣpavamāna [verses] are harnessed; of whatever sāman the stoma is, that [same sāman] is in the ājyastotras.

sanskrit_iast: nirāhāvanty ājyāni bhavanti yuktam eva tair āhvayati
meaning: निराहावन्त्य् आज्यानि भवन्ति युक्तम् एव तैर् आह्वयति
text_mt: The ājyastotras are addressed to Nirāhāva; with them he invokes the harnessed [stoma].

sanskrit_iast: agna āyāhi vītaya ā no mitrāvaruṇāyāhi suṣamā hi ta indrāgnī āgataṃ sutam iti rāthantaram eva tad rūpaṃ nirdyotayati stomaḥ iti
meaning: अग्न आयाहि वीतय आ नो मित्रावरुणायाहि सुषमा हि त इन्द्राग्नी आगतं सुतम् इति राथन्तरम् एव तद् रूपं निर्द्योतयति स्तोमः इति
text_mt: ‘Agni, come to the feast’, ‘Mitrā-Varuṇā, come to us’, ‘Indra and Agni, come to the pressed [juice]’: by this the stoma illuminates the form of the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: pra somāso vipaścita iti gāyatrī bhavati pretyā abhidroṇāni babhrava ity abhikrāntyai stutā indrāya vāyava iti saṃskṛtyai pra soma deva vītaya iti pretyai pra tu draveti pretyai pra vā etenāhnā yanti
meaning: प्र सोमासो विपश्चित इति गायत्री भवति प्रेत्या अभिद्रोणानि बभ्रव इत्य् अभिक्रान्त्यै स्तुता इन्द्राय वायव इति संस्कृत्यै प्र सोम देव वीतय इति प्रेत्यै प्र तु द्रवेति प्रेत्यै प्र वा एतेनाह्ना यन्ति
text_mt: ‘Forward, the wise Soma juices’ is in gāyatrī [metre], for going forward; ‘Brown ones, unto the vats’ is for advancing; ‘Praised for Indra and Vāyu’ is for consecration; ‘Forward, divine Soma, to the feast’ is for going forward; ‘Run forward’ is for going forward; forward indeed they go by this day.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ bhavati
meaning: गायत्रं भवति

sanskrit_iast: yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: यद् एव गायत्रस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: Whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the Gāyatra [applies here].

sanskrit_iast: āśvaṃ bhavati
meaning: आश्वं भवति

sanskrit_iast: aśvo vai bhūtvā prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata sa prājāyata bahur abhavat prajāyate bahur bhavaty āśvena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: अश्वो वै भूत्वा प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत स प्राजायत बहुर् अभवत् प्रजायते बहुर् भवत्य् आश्वेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Having become a horse, Prajāpati created creatures; he procreated, he multiplied; he procreates and multiplies who has praised with the Āśva.

sanskrit_iast: ekākṣaraṃ nidhanam upayanti rathantarasyānativādāya
meaning: एकाक्षरं निधनम् उपयन्ति रथन्तरस्यानतिवादाय
text_mt: They apply a one-syllable cadence in order not to over-reach the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: anativādy enaṃ bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: अनतिवाद्य् एनं भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: His rival does not over-reach him, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: somasāma bhavati
meaning: सोमसाम भवति

sanskrit_iast: yathā vā imā anyā oṣadhayaḥ evaṃ soma āsīt sa tapo 'tapyata sa etat somasāmāpaśyat tena rājyamādhipatyam agacchad yaśo 'bhavad rājyam ādhipatyaṃ gacchati yaśo bhavati somasāmnā tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: यथा वा इमा अन्या ओषधयः एवं सोम आसीत् स तपो ऽतप्यत स एतत् सोमसामापश्यत् तेन राज्यमाधिपत्यम् अगच्छद् यशो ऽभवद् राज्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छति यशो भवति सोमसाम्ना तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: As are these other plants, so was Soma; he performed ascetic heat; he saw this Somasāman; by it he went to kingship and overlordship; he became illustrious; he goes to kingship and overlordship, he becomes illustrious, who has praised with the Somasāman.

sanskrit_iast: yaudhājayaṃ bhavati yad eva yaudhājayasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: यौधाजयं भवति यद् एव यौधाजयस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: The Yaudhājaya is [used]; whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the Yaudhājaya [applies here].

sanskrit_iast: auśanaṃ yad auśanasya stomaḥ
meaning: औशनं यद् औशनस्य स्तोमः
text_mt: The Auśana is what is the stoma of the Auśana.

sanskrit_iast: abhi tvā śūra no nu ma ity abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ rathantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: अभि त्वा शूर नो नु म इत्य् अभीति रथन्तरस्य रूपं रथन्तरं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: ‘Towards you, hero, we chant aloud’: ‘towards’ is the characteristic of the Rathantara, for this day is connected with the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: kayā naś citra ābhuvad iti kavatyas tena prājāpatyāḥ ko hi prajāpatiḥ prajāpater āptyai
meaning: कया नश् चित्र आभुवद् इति कवत्यस् तेन प्राजापत्याः को हि प्रजापतिः प्रजापतेर् आप्त्यै
text_mt: ‘By what wonderful [aid] will he be with us?’: these [verses] contain ‘ka’, therefore they belong to Prajāpati, for Ka is Prajāpati, for the attainment of Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vo dasmam ṛtīṣahaṃ vasor mandānam andhaso 'bhivatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava ity abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ rathantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: तं वो दस्मम् ऋतीषहं वसोर् मन्दानम् अन्धसो ऽभिवत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इत्य् अभीति रथन्तरस्य रूपं रथन्तरं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: ‘Him, your wondrous, battle-facing [lord]… rejoicing in the rich sap, as cows towards their calf at pastures’: ‘towards’ is the characteristic of the Rathantara, for this day is connected with the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ gīrbhir havāmaha iti havanta evainam
meaning: इन्द्रं गीर्भिर् हवामह इति हवन्त एवैनम्
text_mt: ‘We invoke Indra with songs’: they indeed invoke him.

sanskrit_iast: tarobhir vo vidadvasum iti stomo vai taro yajño vidadvasuḥ stomena vai yajño yujyate yat tarobhir vo vidadvasum ity āha yajñam eva tad yunakti
meaning: तरोभिर् वो विदद्वसुम् इति स्तोमो वै तरो यज्ञो विदद्वसुः स्तोमेन वै यज्ञो युज्यते यत् तरोभिर् वो विदद्वसुम् इत्य् आह यज्ञम् एव तद् युनक्ति
text_mt: ‘With swift deeds, him who finds wealth for you’: the stoma is swiftness, the sacrifice is finding wealth; by the stoma the sacrifice is harnessed; when he says, ‘With swift deeds, him who finds wealth for you’, he harnesses the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: rathantaraṃ bhavati brahma vai rathantaraṃ brahma prāyaṇīyam ahar brahmaṇa eva tad brahmākramya prayanti
meaning: रथन्तरं भवति ब्रह्म वै रथन्तरं ब्रह्म प्रायणीयम् अहर् ब्रह्मण एव तद् ब्रह्माक्रम्य प्रयन्ति
text_mt: The Rathantara is [used]; the Rathantara is the priesthood, the opening day is the priesthood; having stepped from the priesthood into the priesthood, they proceed.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vai rathantaram asyām eva pratiṣṭhāya sattram āsate
meaning: इयं वै रथन्तरम् अस्याम् एव प्रतिष्ठाय सत्त्रम् आसते
text_mt: This [earth] is the Rathantara; firmly standing on this very [earth], they perform the sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast: vāmadevyaṃ bhavati paśavo vai vāmadevyaṃ paśūnām avaruddhyai prājāpatyaṃ vai vāmadevyaṃ prajāpatāv eva pratiṣṭhāya sattram āsate
meaning: वामदेव्यं भवति पशवो वै वामदेव्यं पशूनाम् अवरुद्ध्यै प्राजापत्यं वै वामदेव्यं प्रजापताव् एव प्रतिष्ठाय सत्त्रम् आसते
text_mt: The Vāmadevya is [used]; cattle are the Vāmadevya, for the acquisition of cattle; the Vāmadevya belongs to Prajāpati; firmly standing in Prajāpati, they perform the sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast: naudhasaṃ bhavati brahma vai naudhasaṃ brahma prāyaṇīyam ahar brahmaṇa eva tad rahmākramante
meaning: नौधसं भवति ब्रह्म वै नौधसं ब्रह्म प्रायणीयम् अहर् ब्रह्मण एव तद् रह्माक्रमन्ते
text_mt: The Naudhasa is [used]; the Naudhasa is the priesthood, the opening day is the priesthood; they step from the priesthood into the priesthood.

sanskrit_iast: kāleyaṃ bhavati samānaloke vai kāleyañ ca rathantarañ ceyaṃ vai rathantaraṃ paśavaḥ kāleyam asyāñ caiva paśuṣu ca pratiṣṭhāya sattram āsate
meaning: कालेयं भवति समानलोके वै कालेयञ् च रथन्तरञ् चेयं वै रथन्तरं पशवः कालेयम् अस्याञ् चैव पशुषु च प्रतिष्ठाय सत्त्रम् आसते
text_mt: The Kāleya is [used]; the Kāleya and the Rathantara have the same realm; this [earth] is the Rathantara, cattle are the Kāleya; firmly standing on this [earth] and among cattle, they perform the sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast: dravadiḍaṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpaṃ stomaḥ
meaning: द्रवदिडं तथा ह्य् एतस्याह्नो रूपं स्तोमः
text_mt: The running-iḍā [is used], for such is the characteristic of this day, the stoma.

sanskrit_iast: pra somāso madacyuta iti gāyatrī bhavati madavad vai rasavṛt tṛtīyasavanaṃ madam eva tad rasaṃ dadhāty ayā pasvasva devayur ity eti rathantarasya rūpaṃ rāthantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ pavate 'har yato harir iti bṛhato rūpaṃ bṛhad eva tad etasminn ahani yunakti tad yuktaṃ śva ārabhante pra sunvānāyāndhasa iti pravatyo bhavanti praṇinīṇyam iva hy etad ahar abhi priyāṇi pavate ca nohita ity abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ rāthantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: प्र सोमासो मदच्युत इति गायत्री भवति मदवद् वै रसवृत् तृतीयसवनं मदम् एव तद् रसं दधात्य् अया पस्वस्व देवयुर् इत्य् एति रथन्तरस्य रूपं राथन्तरं ह्य् एतद् अहः पवते ऽहर् यतो हरिर् इति बृहतो रूपं बृहद् एव तद् एतस्मिन्न् अहनि युनक्ति तद् युक्तं श्व आरभन्ते प्र सुन्वानायान्धस इति प्रवत्यो भवन्ति प्रणिनीण्यम् इव ह्य् एतद् अहर् अभि प्रियाणि पवते च नोहित इत्य् अभीति रथन्तरस्य रूपं राथन्तरं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: ‘Forward, the exhilaration-dripping Soma juices’ is in gāyatrī [metre]; the third pressing is accompanied by exhilaration, full of sap; he thus places exhilaration and sap into it; ‘Flow thus, seeking the gods’: ‘thus’ is the characteristic of the Rathantara, for this day is connected with the Rathantara; ‘The day is purified where the tawny one goes’: this is the characteristic of the Bṛhat; he thereby harnesses the Bṛhat on this day; harnessed, they undertake it tomorrow; ‘Forward for him who presses the sap’: these contain ‘pra’, for this day is as if leading forward; ‘And he flows towards the dear [places], not hidden’: ‘towards’ is the characteristic of the Rathantara, for this day is connected with the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: yajñā yajñā vo agnaya ity agner vai yajño yajña eva tad yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: यज्ञा यज्ञा वो अग्नय इत्य् अग्नेर् वै यज्ञो यज्ञ एव तद् यज्ञं प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: ‘At every sacrifice, for you, Agni’: sacrifice belongs to Agni; he thereby establishes sacrifice in sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गायत्रं भवति यद् एव गायत्रस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: The Gāyatra is [used]; whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the Gāyatra [applies here].

sanskrit_iast: saṃhitaṃ bhavati vyakṣaraṇidhanaṃ pratiṣṭhāyai pratiṣṭhāyaiva sattram āsate
meaning: संहितं भवति व्यक्षरणिधनं प्रतिष्ठायै प्रतिष्ठायैव सत्त्रम् आसते
text_mt: The Saṃhita is [used], having a two-syllable cadence, for firm standing; having firmly stood, they perform the sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast: saphaṃ bhavati
meaning: सफं भवति

sanskrit_iast: saphena vai devā imān lokān samāpnuvvan yat samāpnuvaṃs tat saphasya saphatvam imān evaitena lokān samāpya sattram āsate
meaning: सफेन वै देवा इमान् लोकान् समाप्नुव्वन् यत् समाप्नुवंस् तत् सफस्य सफत्वम् इमान् एवैतेन लोकान् समाप्य सत्त्रम् आसते
text_mt: By the Śapha the gods reached these worlds; that they reached (samāpnuvan) them, that is the Śapha-ness of the Śapha; having reached these worlds by it, they perform the sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast: ākṣāraṃ bhavati
meaning: आक्षारं भवति

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau vā etāḥ kādughā āsaṃs tāsām ekā samaśīryata sā kṛṣir abhavad ṛdhyate 'smai kṛṣau ya evaṃ veda
meaning: अष्टौ वा एताः कादुघा आसंस् तासाम् एका समशीर्यत सा कृषिर् अभवद् ऋध्यते ऽस्मै कृषौ य एवं वेद
text_mt: There were, indeed, these eight wish-granting cows. Of them, one shattered; she became agriculture. He succeeds in agriculture who knows this.

sanskrit_iast: tāsu devāsurā aspardhanta te devā asurān kāmadughābhya ākṣāreṇānudanta nudate bhrātṛvyaṃ kāmadughābhya ākṣāreṇa tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: तासु देवासुरा अस्पर्धन्त ते देवा असुरान् कामदुघाभ्य आक्षारेणानुदन्त नुदते भ्रातृव्यं कामदुघाभ्य आक्षारेण तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: The gods and the asuras contested over them. The gods expelled the asuras from the wish-granting cows by means of the Ākṣāra. Praising with the Ākṣāra, one expels his rival from the wish-granting cows.

sanskrit_iast: ebhyo vai lokebhyo raso 'pākrāmat taṃ prajāpatir ākṣāreṇākṣārayad yad ākṣārayat tad ākṣārasyākṣāratvam
meaning: एभ्यो वै लोकेभ्यो रसो ऽपाक्रामत् तं प्रजापतिर् आक्षारेणाक्षारयद् यद् आक्षारयत् तद् आक्षारस्याक्षारत्वम्
text_mt: Sap departed from these worlds. Prajāpati caused it to flow (ākṣārayat) by means of the Ākṣāra; because he caused it to flow, that is the Ākṣāra-nature of the Ākṣāra.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād yaḥ purā puṇyo bhūtvā paścāt pāpīyān syād ākṣāraṃ brahma sāma kurvītātmany eved indriyaṃ vīryaṃ rasam ākṣārayati
meaning: तस्माद् यः पुरा पुण्यो भूत्वा पश्चात् पापीयान् स्याद् आक्षारं ब्रह्म साम कुर्वीतात्मन्य् एवेद् इन्द्रियं वीर्यं रसम् आक्षारयति
text_mt: Therefore, he who, having formerly been prosperous, should afterwards become worse off, should make the Ākṣāra the brahma-sāman: he causes faculty, virility, and sap to flow into himself alone.

sanskrit_iast: januṣaikarco bhavato 'hno dhṛtyai yad vā etasyāhno 'dhṛtaṃ tad etābhyāṃ dādhāra
meaning: जनुषैकर्चो भवतो ऽह्नो धृत्यै यद् वा एतस्याह्नो ऽधृतं तद् एताभ्यां दाधार
text_mt: There are two verses naturally [joined] as single verses, for the firm support of the day; whatever of this day is unsupported, that he holds firmly by means of these two.

sanskrit_iast: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati
meaning: गौरीवितं भवति

sanskrit_iast: gaurīvitir vā etac chāktyo brāhmaṇo 'tiriktam apaśyat tad gaurīvitam abhavat
meaning: गौरीवितिर् वा एतच् छाक्त्यो ब्राह्मणो ऽतिरिक्तम् अपश्यत् तद् गौरीवितम् अभवत्
text_mt: Gaurīviti Śāktya, a brahmin, saw this surplus; that became the Gaurīvita.

sanskrit_iast: atiriktaṃ vā etad atiriktena stuvanti yad gaurīvitenāhīnāñ chavastanavad bhavaty api prajāyā upakḷptam
meaning: अतिरिक्तं वा एतद् अतिरिक्तेन स्तुवन्ति यद् गौरीवितेनाहीनाञ् छवस्तनवद् भवत्य् अपि प्रजाया उपकॢप्तम्
text_mt: They praise, indeed, this surplus with what is surplus. That which is through the Gaurīvita brings [possession of] Ahīnas, possesses what belongs to tomorrow, and is prepared for offspring.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣā vā etad vājisāma vṛṣabho retodhā adya stuvanti śvaḥ prajāyate
meaning: वृषा वा एतद् वाजिसाम वृषभो रेतोधा अद्य स्तुवन्ति श्वः प्रजायते
text_mt: This is a vigorous, prize-winning sāman, a bull, an implanter of semen; they praise today, [and] tomorrow he propagates.

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭubhi chandasāṃ kriyate 'nuṣṭub bhi chandasāṃ yoniḥ svāyām eva tad yonau reto dhatte prajātyai
meaning: अनुष्टुभि छन्दसां क्रियते ऽनुष्टुब् भि छन्दसां योनिः स्वायाम् एव तद् योनौ रेतो धत्ते प्रजात्यै
text_mt: It is performed on the anuṣṭubh of the metres; the anuṣṭubh is indeed the womb of the metres; in its own womb, therefore, he deposits semen for propagation.

sanskrit_iast: prajāyate bahur bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: प्रजायते बहुर् भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He propagates, he becomes manifold, who knows this.

sanskrit_iast: dvyudāsaṃ bhavaty etau vā udāsau svargasya lokasyāvasānadarśau pūrveṇa pūrvam ahaḥ saṃsthāpayanty uttareṇottaram ahar abhyativadanti
meaning: द्व्युदासं भवत्य् एतौ वा उदासौ स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यावसानदर्शौ पूर्वेण पूर्वम् अहः संस्थापयन्त्य् उत्तरेणोत्तरम् अहर् अभ्यतिवदन्ति
text_mt: It has two unraisings. These two unraisings indeed look upon the resting place of the world of heaven: by the former they bring the former day to completion; by the latter they converse across to the next day.

sanskrit_iast: tad yathādaḥ pūrvedyuḥ spaṣṭaṃ tṛṇodakam anvavasyanto yanty evam eva tābhyāṃ svargaṃ lokam anvavasyanto yanti
meaning: तद् यथादः पूर्वेद्युः स्पष्टं तृणोदकम् अन्ववस्यन्तो यन्त्य् एवम् एव ताभ्यां स्वर्गं लोकम् अन्ववस्यन्तो यन्ति
text_mt: Just as there, having sighted grass and water on the previous day, they go settling down upon it, in the same way, by means of these two, they go settling down upon the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: gautamaṃ bhavati
meaning: गौतमं भवति

sanskrit_iast: sāmārṣeyavat svargāya yujyate svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: सामार्षेयवत् स्वर्गाय युज्यते स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Possessing the seership of a sāman, it is harnessed for heaven; praising with it, he does not fall from the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: yad u caivānuṣtṭubhasya madhye nidhanasya brāhmaṇaṃ tad du caitasya
meaning: यद् उ चैवानुष्त्टुभस्य मध्ये निधनस्य ब्राह्मणं तद् दु चैतस्य
text_mt: And whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the cadence in the middle of the anuṣṭubh, that indeed is [the brāhmaṇa] of this.

sanskrit_iast: kāvaṃ bhavati
meaning: कावं भवति

sanskrit_iast: lokabinduḥ sāma vindate lokaṃ kāvena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: लोकबिन्दुः साम विन्दते लोकं कावेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Finding a world, he finds a sāman; praising with the Kāva, he finds a world.

sanskrit_iast: svārasu svareṇa svareṇa hi devebhyo 'ntato 'nnādyaṃ pradīyate svareṇaiva tad devebhyo 'ntato 'nnādyaṃ pra yacchati
meaning: स्वारसु स्वरेण स्वरेण हि देवेभ्यो ऽन्ततो ऽन्नाद्यं प्रदीयते स्वरेणैव तद् देवेभ्यो ऽन्ततो ऽन्नाद्यं प्र यच्छति
text_mt: [It is chanted] on the svara [verses]; by means of the svara, indeed, food is given to the gods at the end; by means of the svara alone he bestows food upon the gods at the end.

sanskrit_iast: yajñāyajñīyaṃ bhavati
meaning: यज्ञायज्ञीयं भवति
text_mt: There is the Yajñāyajñīya.

sanskrit_iast: vāg yajñāyajñīyaṃ vāci yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhito vācy eva tad yajñam antataḥ pratiṣṭhāpayanti taṃ vāco 'dhi śva ārabhante
meaning: वाग् यज्ञायज्ञीयं वाचि यज्ञः प्रतिष्ठितो वाच्य् एव तद् यज्ञम् अन्ततः प्रतिष्ठापयन्ति तं वाचो ऽधि श्व आरभन्ते
text_mt: Speech is the Yajñāyajñīya; the sacrifice is established in speech; in speech alone, then, they establish the sacrifice at the end; from speech they begin it tomorrow.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd eva stomo bhavati tejase brahmavarcasāya
meaning: त्रिवृद् एव स्तोमो भवति तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसाय
text_mt: The stoma is the ninefold stoma alone, for brilliance and brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: pratipad bhavati
meaning: प्रतिपद् भवति

sanskrit_iast: samārabhate dvirātrasyāvrisraṃsāya
meaning: समारभते द्विरात्रस्याव्रिस्रंसाय
text_mt: He undertakes it together, for the non-disruption of the two-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: pavasvendo vṛṣāsuta ity anurūpyo bhavati vṛṣāvad vā eta aindraṃ traiṣṭubham ahar yat dvitīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
meaning: पवस्वेन्दो वृषासुत इत्य् अनुरूप्यो भवति वृषावद् वा एत ऐन्द्रं त्रैष्टुभम् अहर् यत् द्वितीयं तद् एव तद् अभिवदति
text_mt: “Clarify thyself, O drop, pressed out virile,” this is the correspondent [triplet]; virile, indeed, belonging to Indra, and of triṣṭubh nature is this second day; that is precisely what it addresses.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvam u tad rūpam apareṇa rūpeṇānuvadati yat pūrvaṃ rūpam apareṇa rūpeṇānuvadati tad anurūpasyānurūpatvam
meaning: पूर्वम् उ तद् रूपम् अपरेण रूपेणानुवदति यत् पूर्वं रूपम् अपरेण रूपेणानुवदति तद् अनुरूपस्यानुरूपत्वम्
text_mt: And it recites after the earlier form by means of a later form; because it recites after the earlier form by means of a later form, that is the correspondent nature of the correspondent [triplet].

sanskrit_iast: anurūpa enaṃ putro jāyate ya evaṃ veda
meaning: अनुरूप एनं पुत्रो जायते य एवं वेद
text_mt: A corresponding son is born to him who knows this.

sanskrit_iast: stotrīyānurūpau tṛcau bhavataḥ prāṇāpānānām avarudhyai
meaning: स्तोत्रीयानुरूपौ तृचौ भवतः प्राणापानानाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: The stotriya and anurūpa triplets are present, for the securing of the out-breath and the in-breath.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣaṇvantas tṛcā bhavatīndriyasya vīryasyāvarudhyai
meaning: वृषण्वन्तस् तृचा भवतीन्द्रियस्य वीर्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: The triplets possess virile [words], for the securing of faculty and virility.

sanskrit_iast: tṛca uttamo bhavati
meaning: तृच उत्तमो भवति

sanskrit_iast: yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti
meaning: येनैव प्राणेन प्रयन्ति तम् अभ्युद्यन्ति
text_mt: With the very breath with which they go forth, they rise up toward it.

sanskrit_iast: pañdadaśa eva stomo bhavati
meaning: पञ्ददश एव स्तोमो भवति
text_mt: The stoma is the fifteenfold stoma alone.

sanskrit_iast: ojasy eva tad vīrye pratitiṣṭhati ojo vīryaṃ pañcadaśaḥ
meaning: ओजस्य् एव तद् वीर्ये प्रतितिष्ठति ओजो वीर्यं पञ्चदशः
text_mt: He is established in vigour and virility; the fifteenfold stoma is vigour and virility.

sanskrit_iast: ubhābhyāṃ vai rūpābhyāṃ bahiṣpavamānyo yujyante yatsāmā stomo bhavati tad ājyeṣu
meaning: उभाभ्यां वै रूपाभ्यां बहिष्पवमान्यो युज्यन्ते यत्सामा स्तोमो भवति तद् आज्येषु
text_mt: With both forms indeed the Bahiṣpavamāna verses are harnessed; of whatever sāman the stoma is, that is in the ājyastotras.

sanskrit_iast: nirāhopasthitāny ājyāni bhavanti
meaning: निराहोपस्थितान्य् आज्यानि भवन्ति
text_mt: The ājyastotras are distinct and contiguous.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmaha indram id gāthino bṛhad indro agnā namo bṛhad iti bārhatam eva tad rūpaṃ nirdyotayati stomaḥ
meaning: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे मित्रं वयं हवामह इन्द्रम् इद् गाथिनो बृहद् इन्द्रो अग्ना नमो बृहद् इति बार्हतम् एव तद् रूपं निर्द्योतयति स्तोमः
text_mt: “Agni, the messenger, we choose,” “Mitra we invoke,” “Indra indeed the singers [have magnified with] the Bṛhat,” “Indra and Agni, homage, O Bṛhat” — thereby the stoma illuminates precisely that form belonging to the Bṛhat.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣā pavasva dhārayeti gāyatrī bhavaty ahno dhṛtyai
meaning: वृषा पवस्व धारयेति गायत्री भवत्य् अह्नो धृत्यै
text_mt: “Virile, clarify thyself with a stream” is a gāyatrī, for the firm support of the day.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣaṇvatyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa traiṣṭubhaṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: वृषण्वत्यस् त्रिष्टुभो रूपेण त्रैष्टुभं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: They are [verses] possessing virile [words], having the form of the triṣṭubh; for this day is of triṣṭubh nature.

sanskrit_iast: punānas soma dhārayeti dhṛtyai
meaning: पुनानस् सोम धारयेति धृत्यै
text_mt: “Being purified, O Soma, with a stream,” [this is] for firm support.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣā śoṇo abhikanikradad gā iti
meaning: वृषा शोणो अभिकनिक्रदद् गा इति
text_mt: “Virile, tawny, bellowing to the cows,” so [it runs].

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣaṇvatyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa samṛddhā vṛṣaṇvad vā etad aindraṃ traiṣṭubham ahar yat dvitīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
meaning: वृषण्वत्यस् त्रिष्टुभो रूपेण समृद्धा वृषण्वद् वा एतद् ऐन्द्रं त्रैष्टुभम् अहर् यत् द्वितीयं तद् एव तद् अभिवदति
text_mt: They are [verses] possessing virile [words], enriched with the form of the triṣṭubh; virile, indeed, belonging to Indra, and of triṣṭubh nature is this second day; that is precisely what it addresses.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गायत्रं भवति यद् एव गायत्रस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: There is the Gāyatra, [and] whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the Gāyatra.

sanskrit_iast: yauktāśvaṃ bhavati
meaning: यौक्ताश्वं भवति

sanskrit_iast: yuktāśvo va āṅgirasaḥ śiśū jātau viparyaharat tasmān mantro 'pākrāmat sa tapo 'tapyata sa etad yauktāśvam apaśyat taṃ mantra upāvartata tad vāva sa tarhy akāmayata kāmasani sama yauktāśvaṃ kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
meaning: युक्ताश्वो व आङ्गिरसः शिशू जातौ विपर्यहरत् तस्मान् मन्त्रो ऽपाक्रामत् स तपो ऽतप्यत स एतद् यौक्ताश्वम् अपश्यत् तं मन्त्र उपावर्तत तद् वाव स तर्ह्य् अकामयत कामसनि सम यौक्ताश्वं कामम् एवैतेनावरुन्धे
text_mt: Yuktāśva Āṅgirasa, indeed, exchanged his two newborn children; from him the sacred formula departed; he performed ascetic heat; he saw this Yauktāśva; to him the sacred formula returned; that indeed he desired at that time: the Yauktāśva is a sāman that wins desires; through it he secures his desire.

sanskrit_iast: āyāsye bhavataḥ
meaning: आयास्ये भवतः

sanskrit_iast: ayāsyo vā āṅgirasa ādityānāṃ dīkṣitānām annādyam āśnāt taṃ śug ārcchat sa tapo 'tapyata sa ete āyāsye apaśyat tābhyāṃ śucam apāhatāpa śucaṃ hata āyāsyābhyāṃ tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: अयास्यो वा आङ्गिरस आदित्यानां दीक्षितानाम् अन्नाद्यम् आश्नात् तं शुग् आर्च्छत् स तपो ऽतप्यत स एते आयास्ये अपश्यत् ताभ्यां शुचम् अपाहताप शुचं हत आयास्याभ्यां तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Ayāsya Āṅgirasa, indeed, ate the food of the Ādityas when they were consecrated; sorrow reached him; he performed ascetic heat; he saw these two Āyāsya [sāmans]; by means of them he struck away sorrow; praising with the two Āyāsyas, he strikes away sorrow.

sanskrit_iast: ebhyo vai lokebhyo vṛṣṭir apākrāmat tām ayāsya āyāsyābhyām acyāvayat cyāvayati vṛṣṭim āyāsyābhyāṃ tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: एभ्यो वै लोकेभ्यो वृष्टिर् अपाक्रामत् ताम् अयास्य आयास्याभ्याम् अच्यावयत् च्यावयति वृष्टिम् आयास्याभ्यां तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Rain departed from these worlds; Ayāsya caused it to move by means of the two Āyāsyas; praising with the two Āyāsyas, he causes rain to move.

sanskrit_iast: annādyaṃ vāva tad ebhyo lokebhyo 'pākrāmat tad ayāsya āyāsyābhyām acyāvayat cyāvayaty annādyam āyāsyābhyāṃ tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: अन्नाद्यं वाव तद् एभ्यो लोकेभ्यो ऽपाक्रामत् तद् अयास्य आयास्याभ्याम् अच्यावयत् च्यावयत्य् अन्नाद्यम् आयास्याभ्यां तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Food indeed departed from these worlds; Ayāsya caused it to move by means of the two Āyāsyas; praising with the two Āyāsyas, he causes food to move.

sanskrit_iast: vāsiṣṭhaṃ bhavati
meaning: वासिष्ठं भवति

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭho vā etena vaiḍavaḥ stutvāñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ stomaḥ
meaning: वसिष्ठो वा एतेन वैडवः स्तुत्वाञ्जसा स्वर्गं लोकम् अपश्यत् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः स्तोमः
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha Vaiḍava, indeed, having praised with this, straightway saw the world of heaven; [it is] for the discernment of the world of heaven; praising with it, the stoma does not fall from the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: tvām id dhi havāmaha iti tvam iti bṛhato rūpaṃ bārhataṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: त्वाम् इद् धि हवामह इति त्वम् इति बृहतो रूपं बार्हतं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: “Thee indeed we invoke”: “Thee” is the form of the Bṛhat, for this day belongs to the Bṛhat.

sanskrit_iast: abhipravaḥ surādhasam iti yuñjate vai pūrveṇāhnā hy etena prayanti
meaning: अभिप्रवः सुराधसम् इति युञ्जते वै पूर्वेणाह्ना ह्य् एतेन प्रयन्ति
text_mt: “Forth to you the bountiful”: they harness it, for with the previous day they go forth with this.

sanskrit_iast: tvām idā hyo nara ity adya caiva hyaś ca samārabhate dvirātrasyāvisraṃsāya
meaning: त्वाम् इदा ह्यो नर इत्य् अद्य चैव ह्यश् च समारभते द्विरात्रस्याविस्रंसाय
text_mt: “Thee now, yesterday, O heroes”: he undertakes it together both today and yesterday, for the non-disruption of the two-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhad bhavati varṣma vai bṛhad varṣma dvitīyam ahar varṣmaṇa eva tad varṣmākramante
meaning: बृहद् भवति वर्ष्म वै बृहद् वर्ष्म द्वितीयम् अहर् वर्ष्मण एव तद् वर्ष्माक्रमन्ते
text_mt: There is the Bṛhat; the Bṛhat is height; the second day is height; from height, therefore, they step upon height.

sanskrit_iast: śyetaṃ bhavati sāmnorvāho yajñasya santatyai
meaning: श्येतं भवति साम्नोर्वाहो यज्ञस्य सन्तत्यै
text_mt: There is the Śyeta, an upbearer of the two sāmans, for the continuity of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: mādhucchandasaṃ bhavati sāmārṣeyavat svargāya yujyate svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: माधुच्छन्दसं भवति सामार्षेयवत् स्वर्गाय युज्यते स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: There is the Mādhucchandasa; possessing the seership of a sāman, it is harnessed for heaven; praising with it, he does not fall from the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhveḍaṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpaṃ stomaḥ
meaning: ऊर्ध्वेडं तथा ह्य् एतस्याह्नो रूपं स्तोमः
text_mt: It has an upward iḍā; for such is the form of this day, the stoma.

sanskrit_iast: yas te mado vareṇya iti gāyatrī bhavati
meaning: यस् ते मदो वरेण्य इति गायत्री भवति
text_mt: “That exhilaration of thine which is choice” is a gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: madavad vai rasavat tṛtīyasavanaṃ madam eva tad rasaṃ dadhāti
meaning: मदवद् वै रसवत् तृतीयसवनं मदम् एव तद् रसं दधाति
text_mt: Possessing exhilaration and possessing sap is the third pressing; thus he places exhilaration and sap [in it].

sanskrit_iast: pavasva madhumattama iti pavanta iva hy etenāhnā madhumattama ity annaṃ vai madhv annādyam eva tad yajamāne dadhāti
meaning: पवस्व मधुमत्तम इति पवन्त इव ह्य् एतेनाह्ना मधुमत्तम इत्य् अन्नं वै मध्व् अन्नाद्यम् एव तद् यजमाने दधाति
text_mt: “Clarify thyself, most honey-filled”: for they clarify, as it were, through this day; “most honey-filled”: honey is food; he thus places food in the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: indram accha sutā ima itīndriyasya vīryasyāvarudhyai
meaning: इन्द्रम् अच्छ सुता इम इतीन्द्रियस्य वीर्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'These pressed [somas] towards Indra,' for the securing of sensory power and virility.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ pūṣā rayir bhaga iti
meaning: अयं पूषा रयिर् भग इति
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'This Pūṣan, wealth, Bhaga.'

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭubhaḥ satyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa traiṣṭubhaṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: अनुष्टुभः सत्यस् त्रिष्टुभो रूपेण त्रैष्टुभं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: Being anuṣṭubhs, [they are recited] in the form of triṣṭubhs, for this day belongs to the triṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣāmatīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇa iti jagatyaḥ satyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa traiṣṭubhaṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: वृषामतीनां पवते विचक्षण इति जगत्यः सत्यस् त्रिष्टुभो रूपेण त्रैष्टुभं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'The bull of thoughts, the far-seeing one, purifies himself.' Being jagatīs, [they are recited] in the form of triṣṭubhs, for this day belongs to the triṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गायत्रं भवति यद् एव गायत्रस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: The Gāyatra [sāman] is [used], as is the brāhmaṇa of the Gāyatra.

sanskrit_iast: hāviṣmataṃ bhavati
meaning: हाविष्मतं भवति

sanskrit_iast: haviṣmāṃś ca vai haviṣkṛc cāṅgirasāv āstāṃ dvitīye 'hani haviṣmān arādhnon navame 'hani haviṣkṛt
meaning: हविष्मांश् च वै हविष्कृच् चाङ्गिरसाव् आस्तां द्वितीये ऽहनि हविष्मान् अराध्नोन् नवमे ऽहनि हविष्कृत्
text_mt: Haviṣmat and Haviṣkṛt were two Āṅgirases. On the second day Haviṣmat succeeded, on the ninth day Haviṣkṛt.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ haviṣmān ity eva jātam ahar jātaṃ somaṃ prāha devebhyaḥ sāmnaivāsmā āśiṣam āśāste sāma hi saty āśīḥ
meaning: अयं हविष्मान् इत्य् एव जातम् अहर् जातं सोमं प्राह देवेभ्यः साम्नैवास्मा आशिषम् आशास्ते साम हि सत्य् आशीः
text_mt: Saying 'This one is possessed of oblations (haviṣmat),' he declares to the gods the day that has been produced, the Soma that has been produced. By means of the sāman he invokes a blessing upon him, for the sāman is a true blessing.

sanskrit_iast: śaṅku bhavaty ahno dhṛtyai yad vā adhṛtaṃ śaṅkunā tad dādhāra
meaning: शङ्कु भवत्य् अह्नो धृत्यै यद् वा अधृतं शङ्कुना तद् दाधार
text_mt: The Śaṅku [sāman] is [used] for the firm support of the day; whatever indeed is unsupported, he has supported by means of the peg (śaṅku).

sanskrit_iast: tad u sīdantīyam iy āhur etena vai prajāpatir ūrdhva imān lokān asīdad yad asīdat tat sīdantīyasya sīdantīyatvam ūrdhva imān lokān sīdati sīdantīyena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: तद् उ सीदन्तीयम् इय् आहुर् एतेन वै प्रजापतिर् ऊर्ध्व इमान् लोकान् असीदद् यद् असीदत् तत् सीदन्तीयस्य सीदन्तीयत्वम् ऊर्ध्व इमान् लोकान् सीदति सीदन्तीयेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: And they also call it the Sīdantīya. By this indeed Prajāpati ascended above and sat upon (asīdat) these worlds. Because he sat, that is the essence of the Sīdantīya. Having praised with the Sīdantīya, he sits above these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: sujñānaṃ bhavati
meaning: सुज्ञानं भवति

sanskrit_iast: svarvad vai rāthantaraṃ rūpaṃ svarṇadhanaṃ bārhatam
meaning: स्वर्वद् वै राथन्तरं रूपं स्वर्णधनं बार्हतम्
text_mt: Possessed of the sun (svarvat) is the form of the Rathantara; possessing the sun as a prize (svarṇadhana) is that of the Bṛhat.

sanskrit_iast: svarṇadhanaṃ bhavati tathā hy etasyāhno rūpam
meaning: स्वर्णधनं भवति तथा ह्य् एतस्याह्नो रूपम्
text_mt: It has 'svarṇadhana' [in its text]; for such is the form of this day.

sanskrit_iast: pluvau vā etāv upohante svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
meaning: प्लुवौ वा एताव् उपोहन्ते स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
text_mt: They push forward these two floats, as it were, for the attainment of the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati yad eva gaurīvitasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गौरीवितं भवति यद् एव गौरीवितस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: The Gaurīvita [sāman] is [used], as is the brāhmaṇa of the Gaurīvita.

sanskrit_iast: krauñcaṃ bhavati
meaning: क्रौञ्चं भवति

sanskrit_iast: vāg vai krauñcaṃ vāg dvādaśāho vācy eva tad vācā stuvate yajñasya prabhūtyai
meaning: वाग् वै क्रौञ्चं वाग् द्वादशाहो वाच्य् एव तद् वाचा स्तुवते यज्ञस्य प्रभूत्यै
text_mt: Speech is the Krauñca; speech is the twelve-day rite. By speech they praise in speech, for the prevailing of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yāmaṃ bhavati
meaning: यामं भवति

sanskrit_iast: etena vai yamo 'napajayyam amuṣya lokasyādhipatyam āśnutānapajayyam amuṣya lokasyādhipatyam aśnute yāmena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: एतेन वै यमो ऽनपजय्यम् अमुष्य लोकस्याधिपत्यम् आश्नुतानपजय्यम् अमुष्य लोकस्याधिपत्यम् अश्नुते यामेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: By this indeed Yama attained unconquerable sovereignty over that world; unconquerable sovereignty over that world attains he who has praised with the Yāma.

sanskrit_iast: etena vai yamī yamaṃ svargaṃ lokam agamayat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ stomaḥ
meaning: एतेन वै यमी यमं स्वर्गं लोकम् अगमयत् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः स्तोमः
text_mt: By this Yamī made Yama go to the world of heaven, for the viewing of the world of heaven. He who has praised does not fall from the world of heaven. [Thus the pavamāna-]stoma [ends].

sanskrit_iast: ehy ū ṣu bravāṇi ta ity ehivatyai bhavanti tṛtīyasyāhna upahavāya santatyai
meaning: एह्य् ऊ षु ब्रवाणि त इत्य् एहिवत्यै भवन्ति तृतीयस्याह्न उपहवाय सन्तत्यै
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'Come, I will speak well to you.' They contain the word 'come' (ehi), for the invitation of the third day, for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: apacchid iva vā etad yajñakāṇḍaṃ yad ukthāni yad eti salomatvāya
meaning: अपच्छिद् इव वा एतद् यज्ञकाण्डं यद् उक्थानि यद् एति सलोमत्वाय
text_mt: This section of the sacrifice, namely the ukthastotras, is as if cut off; in that he goes [with 'come'], it is for natural alignment.

sanskrit_iast: evāhy asi vīrayur iti samānaṃ vadantīdam ittham asad iti
meaning: एवाह्य् असि वीरयुर् इति समानं वदन्तीदम् इत्थम् असद् इति
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'Thus indeed you are eager for heroes,' speaking uniformly: 'Let this be so.'

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhann ity avardhanta hy etarhi yajamānam evaitayā vardhanti
meaning: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्न् इत्य् अवर्धन्त ह्य् एतर्हि यजमानम् एवैतया वर्धन्ति
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'All have magnified Indra.' They magnified [him] at this time; by this they magnify the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: sākam aśvaṃ bhavaty ukthānām abhijityā abhikrāntyai
meaning: साकम् अश्वं भवत्य् उक्थानाम् अभिजित्या अभिक्रान्त्यै
text_mt: The Sākamaśva [sāman] is [used], for the conquest and the overcoming of the ukthastotras.

sanskrit_iast: etena hy agra ukthāny adhyajayann etenābhyakrāman
meaning: एतेन ह्य् अग्र उक्थान्य् अध्यजयन्न् एतेनाभ्यक्रामन्
text_mt: For by this, in the beginning, they conquered the ukthastotras; by this they overcame [them].

sanskrit_iast: āmahīyavaṃ bhavati kḷptiś cānnādyañ ca samānaṃ vadantīṣu kriyata idam ittham asad iti
meaning: आमहीयवं भवति कॢप्तिश् चान्नाद्यञ् च समानं वदन्तीषु क्रियत इदम् इत्थम् असद् इति
text_mt: The Āmahīyava [sāman] is [used]—it is proper arrangement and food. It is performed on [verses] that speak uniformly: 'Let this be so.'

sanskrit_iast: kṣatraṃ vā etad ahar abhinirvadati yat pañcadaśaṃ yad gāyatrīṣu brahmasāma bhavati brahma caiva tat kṣatrañ ca sayujī karoti brahmaiva kṣatrasya purastān nidadhati brahmaṇe kṣatrañ ca viśañ cānuge karoti
meaning: क्षत्रं वा एतद् अहर् अभिनिर्वदति यत् पञ्चदशं यद् गायत्रीषु ब्रह्मसाम भवति ब्रह्म चैव तत् क्षत्रञ् च सयुजी करोति ब्रह्मैव क्षत्रस्य पुरस्तान् निदधति ब्रह्मणे क्षत्रञ् च विशञ् चानुगे करोति
text_mt: When it is fifteenfold, this day clearly expresses the nobility (kṣatra); when the brahmasāman is on gāyatrī verses, he joins the priesthood (brahman) and the nobility. They place the priesthood in front of the nobility; he makes the nobility and the commonalty (viś) follow after the priesthood.

sanskrit_iast: brahma vai pūrvam ahaḥ kṣatraṃ dvitīyaṃ yad gāyatrīṣu brahma sāma bhavati brahma tad yaśasārdhayati brahma hi gāyatrī
meaning: ब्रह्म वै पूर्वम् अहः क्षत्रं द्वितीयं यद् गायत्रीषु ब्रह्म साम भवति ब्रह्म तद् यशसार्धयति ब्रह्म हि गायत्री
text_mt: The priesthood is the first day; the nobility is the second. When the brahmasāman is on gāyatrī verses, he causes the priesthood to thrive with glory, for the gāyatrī is the priesthood.

sanskrit_iast: tad u samānaṃ vadantīṣu kriyate samṛddhyai
meaning: तद् उ समानं वदन्तीषु क्रियते समृद्ध्यै
text_mt: And that is performed on [verses] that speak uniformly, for success.

sanskrit_iast: āṣṭādaṃṣṭre bhavataḥ
meaning: आष्टादंष्ट्रे भवतः

sanskrit_iast: aiyāhā iti vā indro vṛtram ahann aiyādohoveti nyagṛhṇād vārtraghne sāmanī vīryavatī
meaning: ऐयाहा इति वा इन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहन्न् ऐयादोहोवेति न्यगृह्णाद् वार्त्रघ्ने सामनी वीर्यवती
text_mt: Saying 'aiyāhā,' Indra slew Vṛtra; saying 'aiyādohovā,' he held [him] down. The two sāmans are Vṛtra-slaying and full of virility.

sanskrit_iast: ojo evaitābhyāṃ vīryam avarundhe
meaning: ओजो एवैताभ्यां वीर्यम् अवरुन्धे
text_mt: By these two he secures strength and virility.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśa eva stomo bhavaty ojasy eva tad vīrye pratitiṣṭhaty ojo vīryaṃ pañcadaśaḥ
meaning: पञ्चदश एव स्तोमो भवत्य् ओजस्य् एव तद् वीर्ये प्रतितिष्ठत्य् ओजो वीर्यं पञ्चदशः
text_mt: The stoma is fifteenfold; he thus firmly establishes himself in strength and virility, for the fifteenfold [stoma] is strength and virility.

sanskrit_iast: davidyutaty āruceti tṛtīyasyāhnaḥ pratipad bhavati
meaning: दविद्युतत्य् आरुचेति तृतीयस्याह्नः प्रतिपद् भवति
text_mt: [The verse beginning:] 'Flashing with brightness' is the introductory verse of the third day.

sanskrit_iast: davidyutatī vai gāyatrī pariṣṭobhantī triṣṭub gavāśīr jagatī trīṇi rūpāṇi samārabhate trirātrasyāvisraṃsāya
meaning: दविद्युतती वै गायत्री परिष्टोभन्ती त्रिष्टुब् गवाशीर् जगती त्रीणि रूपाणि समारभते त्रिरात्रस्याविस्रंसाय
text_mt: The flashing one is the gāyatrī; the resounding one is the triṣṭubh; the cow-mixture is the jagatī. He brings together three forms, so that the three-day period will not fall apart.

sanskrit_iast: ete asṛgram indava ity anurūpo bhavati
meaning: एते असृग्रम् इन्दव इत्य् अनुरूपो भवति
text_mt: [The verse beginning:] 'These drops have been poured out' is the corresponding verse.

sanskrit_iast: eta iti vai prajāpatir devān asṛjatāsṛgram iti manuṣyān indava iti pitṛṃs tad eva tad abhivadati
meaning: एत इति वै प्रजापतिर् देवान् असृजतासृग्रम् इति मनुष्यान् इन्दव इति पितृंस् तद् एव तद् अभिवदति
text_mt: Saying 'these' (ete), Prajāpati created the gods; saying 'have been poured out' (asṛgram), men; saying 'drops' (indavaḥ), the ancestors. It thus expresses that.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvam u caiva tad repam apareṇa rūpeṇānuvadati yat pūrvaṃ rūpam apareṇa rūpaṇo 'nuvadati tad anurūpasyānurūpatvam anurūpa enaṃ putro jāyate ya evaṃ veda
meaning: पूर्वम् उ चैव तद् रेपम् अपरेण रूपेणानुवदति यत् पूर्वं रूपम् अपरेण रूपणो ऽनुवदति तद् अनुरूपस्यानुरूपत्वम् अनुरूप एनं पुत्रो जायते य एवं वेद
text_mt: And he repeats the previous form with a subsequent form. That he repeats the previous form with a subsequent form, that is the conformity of the corresponding verse. A son conforming [to him] is born to him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: stotrīyānurūpau tṛco bhavataḥ prāṇāpānānām avarudhyai
meaning: स्तोत्रीयानुरूपौ तृचो भवतः प्राणापानानाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: The chant-verse and the corresponding verse are two triplets, for the securing of the out-breath and the in-breath.

sanskrit_iast: rājā medhābhir īyate pavamāno manāv adhy antarikṣeṇa yātava iti
meaning: राजा मेधाभिर् ईयते पवमानो मनाव् अध्य् अन्तरिक्षेण यातव इति
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'The king, the purifying one, approaches with wisdom, over mankind, to journey through the intermediate space.'

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣadevatyas tṛco bhavaty antarikṣadevatyam etad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
meaning: अन्तरिक्षदेवत्यस् तृचो भवत्य् अन्तरिक्षदेवत्यम् एतद् अहर् यत् तृतीयं तद् एव तद् अभिवदति
text_mt: The triplet has the intermediate space as its deity; this day, which is the third, has the intermediate space as its deity; he thus expresses that.

sanskrit_iast: pañcarcau bhavati pañcapadā paṅktiḥ pāṅktam annam annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: पञ्चर्चौ भवति पञ्चपदा पङ्क्तिः पाङ्क्तम् अन्नम् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: It is in five verses; the paṅkti has five feet; food belongs to the paṅkti, for the securing of food.

sanskrit_iast: tṛca uttamo bhavati yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhy upayānti
meaning: तृच उत्तमो भवति येनैव प्राणेन प्रयन्ति तम् अभ्य् उपयान्ति
text_mt: The last is a triplet; by the same breath with which they advance, they return.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa eva stomo bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai prajātyai
meaning: सप्तदश एव स्तोमो भवति प्रतिष्ठायै प्रजात्यै
text_mt: The stoma is seventeenfold, for firm standing, for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: agnināgniḥ samidhyata ity āgreyam ājyaṃ bhavati
meaning: अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यत इत्य् आग्रेयम् आज्यं भवति
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'Agni is kindled by Agni.' The ājyastotra belongs to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: pūrve eva tad ahanī samiddhe tṛtīyam ahar abhisamindhe
meaning: पूर्वे एव तद् अहनी समिद्धे तृतीयम् अहर् अभिसमिन्धे
text_mt: The two previous days having been kindled, he kindles the third day towards them.

sanskrit_iast: mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣam iti rāthantaram maitrāvaruṇam
meaning: मित्रं हुवे पूतदक्षम् इति राथन्तरम् मैत्रावरुणम्
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'I call upon Mitra of purified skill.' The [chant] for Mitrāvaruṇa is of the Rathantara [type].

sanskrit_iast: huva iti vai rāthantaraṃ rūpam
meaning: हुव इति वै राथन्तरं रूपम्
text_mt: [The word] 'I call' (huve) is indeed the form of the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: rathantaram etat parokṣaṃ yad vairūpaṃ rāthantaram eva tad rūpaṃ nirdyotayati
meaning: रथन्तरम् एतत् परोक्षं यद् वैरूपं राथन्तरम् एव तद् रूपं निर्द्योतयति
text_mt: This Rathantara is unmanifest, in that it is Vairūpa; he thus illuminates the form of the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣusa ity aindram
meaning: इन्द्रेण सं हि दृक्षुस इत्य् ऐन्द्रम्
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'For you have been seen together with Indra.' [This chant] belongs to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: sam iva vā ime lokā dadṛśire 'ntarikṣadevatyam etad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
meaning: सम् इव वा इमे लोका ददृशिरे ऽन्तरिक्षदेवत्यम् एतद् अहर् यत् तृतीयं तद् एव तद् अभिवदति
text_mt: These worlds have appeared together, as it were. This day, which is the third, has the intermediate space as its deity; he thus expresses that.

sanskrit_iast: tā huve yayor idam iti rāthantaram aindrāgnam
meaning: ता हुवे ययोर् इदम् इति राथन्तरम् ऐन्द्राग्नम्
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'I call on the two whose this is.' The [chant] for Indrāgnī is of the Rathantara [type].

sanskrit_iast: huva iti vai rāthantaraṃ rūpaṃ rathantaram etat parokṣaṃ yad vairūpaṃ rāthantaram eva tad rūpaṃ nirdyotayati stomaḥ
meaning: हुव इति वै राथन्तरं रूपं रथन्तरम् एतत् परोक्षं यद् वैरूपं राथन्तरम् एव तद् रूपं निर्द्योतयति स्तोमः
text_mt: [The word] 'I call' is indeed the form of the Rathantara; this Rathantara is unmanifest, in that it is Vairūpa; he thus illuminates the form of the Rathantara. [Thus the ājya-]stoma [ends].

sanskrit_iast: uccā te jātam andhasa iti gāyatrī bhavati
meaning: उच्चा ते जातम् अन्धस इति गायत्री भवति
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'High is your born [juice] of the plant.' It is a gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: udvad vā etad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
meaning: उद्वद् वा एतद् अहर् यत् तृतीयं तद् एव तद् अभिवदति
text_mt: This day, which is the third, contains the word 'high' (udvat); he thus expresses that.

sanskrit_iast: andhasvatī bhavaty ahar vā andho 'hna ārambhaḥ
meaning: अन्धस्वती भवत्य् अहर् वा अन्धो ऽह्न आरम्भः
text_mt: It contains the word 'plant' (andhasvatī); the day is the plant, the beginning of the day.

sanskrit_iast: abhi somāsa āyava iti
meaning: अभि सोमास आयव इति

sanskrit_iast: abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ bṛhad iti bṛhata ubhayoḥ saha rūpam upaity ubhau hi varṇāv etad ahaḥ
meaning: अभीति रथन्तरस्य रूपं बृहद् इति बृहत उभयोः सह रूपम् उपैत्य् उभौ हि वर्णाव् एतद् अहः
text_mt: [The word] 'towards' (abhi) is the form of the Rathantara; [the word] 'great' (bṛhat) is of the Bṛhat. He unites the form of both, for this day has both characters.

sanskrit_iast: tisro vāca īrayati pravahnir iti tṛtīyasyāhno rūpaṃ tena tṛtīyam ahar ārabhante
meaning: तिस्रो वाच ईरयति प्रवह्निर् इति तृतीयस्याह्नो रूपं तेन तृतीयम् अहर् आरभन्ते
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'The leader sends forth three voices.' That is the form of the third day; by it they begin the third day.

sanskrit_iast: triṣṭubhaḥ satyo jagatyo rūpeṇa jāgataṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: त्रिष्टुभः सत्यो जगत्यो रूपेण जागतं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: [The verses], being triṣṭubhs, have the form of jagatīs, for this day belongs to the jagatī.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गायत्रं भवति यद् एव गायत्रस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: The Gāyatra [sāman] is [used], as [explained in] the explanation of the Gāyatra.

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṭambhaṃ bhavati
meaning: वैष्टम्भं भवति

sanskrit_iast: ahar vā etad avlīyata tad devā vaiṣṭambhair vyaṣṭabhnuvaṃs tad vaiṣṭambhasya vaiṣṭambhatvam
meaning: अहर् वा एतद् अव्लीयत तद् देवा वैष्टम्भैर् व्यष्टभ्नुवंस् तद् वैष्टम्भस्य वैष्टम्भत्वम्
text_mt: This day was collapsing; the gods propped it up with the Vaiṣṭambha [sāmans]. That is the Vaiṣṭambha's nature as Vaiṣṭambha.

sanskrit_iast: diśa iti nidhanam upayanti diśāṃ dhṛtyai
meaning: दिश इति निधनम् उपयन्ति दिशां धृत्यै
text_mt: They employ 'the quarters' as the cadence, for the firmness of the quarters.

sanskrit_iast: paurūmadgaṃ bhavati
meaning: पौरूमद्गं भवति

sanskrit_iast: ahar vā etad avlīyamānaṃ tad rakṣāṃsy anvasacanta tasmād devāḥ paurūmadgena rakṣāṃsy apāghnann apa pāpmānaṃ hate paurūmadgena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: अहर् वा एतद् अव्लीयमानं तद् रक्षांस्य् अन्वसचन्त तस्माद् देवाः पौरूमद्गेन रक्षांस्य् अपाघ्नन्न् अप पाप्मानं हते पौरूमद्गेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: As this day was collapsing, the demons attached themselves to it. From it the gods struck away the demons by means of the Paurūmadga. He who has praised with the Paurūmadga strikes away evil.

sanskrit_iast: devāś ca vāsurāś cāspardhanta te devā asurāṇāṃ paurūmadgena puro 'majjayan yat puro 'majjayaṃs tasmāt paurūmadgaṃ pāpmānam evaitena bhrātṛvyaṃ majjayati
meaning: देवाश् च वासुराश् चास्पर्धन्त ते देवा असुराणां पौरूमद्गेन पुरो ऽमज्जयन् यत् पुरो ऽमज्जयंस् तस्मात् पौरूमद्गं पाप्मानम् एवैतेन भ्रातृव्यं मज्जयति
text_mt: The gods and the asuras contended. By means of the Paurūmadga the gods submerged the strongholds of the asuras. Because they submerged the strongholds (puraḥ), therefore it is [called] Paurūmadga. By means of it he submerges his evil rival.

sanskrit_iast: gautamaṃ bhavati
meaning: गौतमं भवति

sanskrit_iast: yad eva gautamasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: यद् एव गौतमस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: [It is] just as [explained in] the explanation of the Gautama.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayataḥ stotraṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpam
meaning: उभयतः स्तोत्रं तथा ह्य् एतस्याह्नो रूपम्
text_mt: The chant of praise is on both sides, for such is the form of this day.

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣaṃ bhavati
meaning: अन्तरिक्षं भवति

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣadevatyam etad ahar yat tṛtīyam antarikṣa eva tad antarikṣeṇa stuvate pratiṣṭhāyai
meaning: अन्तरिक्षदेवत्यम् एतद् अहर् यत् तृतीयम् अन्तरिक्ष एव तद् अन्तरिक्षेण स्तुवते प्रतिष्ठायै
text_mt: This third day has the atmosphere (antarikṣa) as its deity; thereby they praise in the atmosphere by means of the Antarikṣa for a firm support.

sanskrit_iast: āṣkāraṇidhanaṃ kāṇvaṃ bhavati
meaning: आष्कारणिधनं काण्वं भवति
text_mt: The Kāṇva [sāman] with the cadence āṣkāra is [used].

sanskrit_iast: as iti vai rāthantaraṃ rūpaṃ has iti bārhataṃ tṛtīyam eva tad rūpam upayanti samṛdhyai
meaning: अस् इति वै राथन्तरं रूपं हस् इति बार्हतं तृतीयम् एव तद् रूपम् उपयन्ति समृध्यै
text_mt: 'As' is the Rathantara form; 'has' is the Bārhata form. Thereby they take up the third form for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgirasāṃ saṃkrośo bhavati
meaning: अङ्गिरसां संक्रोशो भवति
text_mt: The Saṃkrośa of the Aṅgirases is [used].

sanskrit_iast: etena vā aṅgirasaḥ saṃkrośamānāḥ svargaṃ lokam āpan svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ stomaḥ
meaning: एतेन वा अङ्गिरसः संक्रोशमानाः स्वर्गं लोकम् आपन् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः स्तोमः
text_mt: Shouting together (saṃkrośamānāḥ) by means of this, the Aṅgirases attained the heavenly world. [It serves] for the revelation of the heavenly world. Having praised, he does not fall from the heavenly world. [It is the] stoma.

sanskrit_iast: yady āva indra te śatam iti śatavatyo bhavanti
meaning: यद्य् आव इन्द्र ते शतम् इति शतवत्यो भवन्ति
text_mt: [The verses] 'If, O Indra, a hundred of you' contain [the word] 'hundred'.

sanskrit_iast: śatavad vai paśūnāṃ rūpaṃ sahasravat paśūnām evaitābhī rūpam avarūndhe
meaning: शतवद् वै पशूनां रूपं सहस्रवत् पशूनाम् एवैताभी रूपम् अवरून्धे
text_mt: Possessing a hundred, possessing a thousand, is the form of cattle; by these [verses] he obtains the form of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: vayaṅ ghatvā sutāvanta iti satobṛhatyo varṣīyaś chanda ākramate 'napabhraṃśāya
meaning: वयङ् घत्वा सुतावन्त इति सतोबृहत्यो वर्षीयश् छन्द आक्रमते ऽनपभ्रंशाय
text_mt: [In the verses] 'We, having pressed [Soma], to you', [the metre] is satobṛhatīs; he ascends to a loftier metre for non-slipping.

sanskrit_iast: taraṇir it siṣāsati vājaṃ purandhyā yujā | āva indraṃ puruhūtaṃ na me girety āvad akṣaram uddhatam iva vai tṛtīyam ahar yad eva tāvad akṣaraṃ bhavaty ahar evaitena pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: तरणिर् इत् सिषासति वाजं पुरन्ध्या युजा | आव इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं न मे गिरेत्य् आवद् अक्षरम् उद्धतम् इव वै तृतीयम् अहर् यद् एव तावद् अक्षरं भवत्य् अहर् एवैतेन प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: 'Crossing over, he wishes to win prize, united with wisdom' / 'To you, O Indra, invoked by many, not to my song'—having the syllable āvat. The third day is, as it were, elevated; in that it has that syllable āvat, he firmly establishes the day by it.

sanskrit_iast: pañcanidhanaṃ vairūpaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati diśāṃ dhṛtyai
meaning: पञ्चनिधनं वैरूपं पृष्ठं भवति दिशां धृत्यै
text_mt: The Vairūpa [sāman] with five cadences is the pṛṣṭha, for the firmness of the quarters.

sanskrit_iast: pañcapadā paṅktiḥ pāṅktam annam annāghasyāvarūdhyai
meaning: पञ्चपदा पङ्क्तिः पाङ्क्तम् अन्नम् अन्नाघस्यावरूध्यै
text_mt: The paṅkti has five feet; food is fivefold; [it is] for the attainment of food.

sanskrit_iast: diśāṃ vā etat sāma yad vairūpaṃ diśo hy evaitenābhivadati
meaning: दिशां वा एतत् साम यद् वैरूपं दिशो ह्य् एवैतेनाभिवदति
text_mt: This Vairūpa is the sāman of the quarters, for with it he addresses the quarters.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat pañcanidhanaṃ tenartūnāṃ pañca hy ṛtavaḥ
meaning: अथ यत् पञ्चनिधनं तेनर्तूनां पञ्च ह्य् ऋतवः
text_mt: Now, that it has five cadences, thereby it belongs to the seasons, for there are five seasons.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtubhiś ca vā ime lokā digbhiś cāvṛtās teṣv evobhayeṣu yajamānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati yajamānaṃ vā anupratitiṣṭhantam udgātā pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ vidvān vairūpeṇodgāyati
meaning: ऋतुभिश् च वा इमे लोका दिग्भिश् चावृतास् तेष्व् एवोभयेषु यजमानं प्रतिष्ठापयति यजमानं वा अनुप्रतितिष्ठन्तम् उद्गाता प्रतितिष्ठति य एवं विद्वान् वैरूपेणोद्गायति
text_mt: These worlds are encompassed by the seasons and the quarters; in both of these he firmly establishes the sacrificer. Following the sacrificer who attains a firm support, the udgātṛ attains a firm support, who, knowing thus, sings as udgātṛ with the Vairūpa.

sanskrit_iast: digvad bhavati bhrātṛvyasyāpanutyai
meaning: दिग्वद् भवति भ्रातृव्यस्यापनुत्यै
text_mt: It contains [the word] 'quarter' (diś), for the driving away of the rival.

sanskrit_iast: diśaṃ viśam iti nidhanam upayanti diśāṃ dhṛtyai
meaning: दिशं विशम् इति निधनम् उपयन्ति दिशां धृत्यै
text_mt: They employ 'quarter, settlement' (diśaṃ viśam) as the cadence, for the firmness of the quarters.

sanskrit_iast: has ity upariṣṭād diśāṃ nidhanam upayanti tena bārhatam
meaning: हस् इत्य् उपरिष्टाद् दिशां निधनम् उपयन्ति तेन बार्हतम्
text_mt: They employ 'has' above as the cadence of the quarters; thereby it is Bārhata.

sanskrit_iast: rāthantaro vā ayaṃ loko bārhato 'sāv ubhe eva tad bṛhadrathantarayo rūpeṇāparādhnoti
meaning: राथन्तरो वा अयं लोको बार्हतो ऽसाव् उभे एव तद् बृहद्रथन्तरयो रूपेणापराध्नोति
text_mt: This world is Rathantara; that [world] is Bārhata; thus he does not fail both through the form of the Bṛhat and Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: anaḍvāhau vā etau devayānau yajamānasya yad bṛhadrathantare tāv eva tad yunakti svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
meaning: अनड्वाहौ वा एतौ देवयानौ यजमानस्य यद् बृहद्रथन्तरे ताव् एव तद् युनक्ति स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
text_mt: These two, the Bṛhat and the Rathantara, are the two draft-oxen of the sacrificer that lead to the gods; he yokes them for the attainment of the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: aśvavad bhavati prajātyai
meaning: अश्ववद् भवति प्रजात्यै
text_mt: It contains [the word] 'horse', for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: yathā maṇḍūka āṭ karoty evaṃ nidhanam upayanty ayātayāmatāyai
meaning: यथा मण्डूक आट् करोत्य् एवं निधनम् उपयन्त्य् अयातयामतायै
text_mt: As a frog croaks 'āt', so they employ the cadence, for freshness.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa vairūpāṇi bhavanti dvādaśamāsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsara eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: द्वादश वैरूपाणि भवन्ति द्वादशमासाः संवत्सरः संवत्सर एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: There are twelve Vairūpas; the year has twelve months; he is firmly established in the year.

sanskrit_iast: virūpaḥ saṃvatsaro virūpam annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: विरूपः संवत्सरो विरूपम् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: The year is multiform (virūpa); [it is] for the attainment of multiform food.

sanskrit_iast: mahāvaiṣṭambhaṃ brahmasāma bhavaty annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: महावैष्टम्भं ब्रह्मसाम भवत्य् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: The Mahāvaiṣṭambha is the brahmasāman, for the attainment of food.

sanskrit_iast: yadā vai puruṣo 'nnam atty athāntarato viṣṭabdhaḥ
meaning: यदा वै पुरुषो ऽन्नम् अत्त्य् अथान्तरतो विष्टब्धः
text_mt: When a man eats food, he is propped up within.

sanskrit_iast: diśa iti nidhanam upayanti diśāṃ dhṛtyai
meaning: दिश इति निधनम् उपयन्ति दिशां धृत्यै
text_mt: They employ 'the quarters' as the cadence, for the firmness of the quarters.

sanskrit_iast: sato bṛhatīṣu stuvanti pūrvayor ahnoḥ pratyudyamāya
meaning: सतो बृहतीषु स्तुवन्ति पूर्वयोर् अह्नोः प्रत्युद्यमाय
text_mt: They praise on satobṛhatīs, for the counter-balancing of the two preceding days.

sanskrit_iast: rauravam acchāvākasāma bhavati
meaning: रौरवम् अच्छावाकसाम भवति
text_mt: The Raurava is the acchāvākasāman.

sanskrit_iast: agnir vai rūro rūdro 'gniḥ
meaning: अग्निर् वै रूरो रूद्रो ऽग्निः
text_mt: Agni is Rūra; Agni is Rudra.

sanskrit_iast: agnir vā etasya paśūn apakramayati yasya paśavo 'pakrāmanty agnir eva tasya paśūn abhikramayati yasya paśavo 'bhikrāmanti
meaning: अग्निर् वा एतस्य पशून् अपक्रमयति यस्य पशवो ऽपक्रामन्त्य् अग्निर् एव तस्य पशून् अभिक्रमयति यस्य पशवो ऽभिक्रामन्ति
text_mt: Agni causes the cattle of him whose cattle wander away to wander away; Agni causes the cattle of him whose cattle approach to approach.

sanskrit_iast: abhy abhy evāsya paśavaḥ krāmanti ya evaṃ vidvān rauraveṇa stuvate
meaning: अभ्य् अभ्य् एवास्य पशवः क्रामन्ति य एवं विद्वान् रौरवेण स्तुवते
text_mt: Cattle continually approach him who, knowing thus, praises with the Raurava.

sanskrit_iast: pariṣṭubdheḍaṃ tathā hy etasyāhno rūpaṃ stomaḥ
meaning: परिष्टुब्धेडं तथा ह्य् एतस्याह्नो रूपं स्तोमः
text_mt: It has an intercalated iḍā, for such is the form of this day. [It is the] stoma.

sanskrit_iast: tisro vāca udīrata iti tṛtīyasyāhno rūpaṃ tena tṛtīyam ahar ārabhante
meaning: तिस्रो वाच उदीरत इति तृतीयस्याह्नो रूपं तेन तृतीयम् अहर् आरभन्ते
text_mt: 'Three voices rise up' is the form of the third day; with it they begin the third day.

sanskrit_iast: udvad vā etat trivad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
meaning: उद्वद् वा एतत् त्रिवद् अहर् यत् तृतीयं तद् एव तद् अभिवदति
text_mt: This third day contains 'up' (ud) and contains 'three' (tri); it directly expresses that.

sanskrit_iast: ā sotā pariṣiñcata iti parivatyo bhavanti
meaning: आ सोता परिषिञ्चत इति परिवत्यो भवन्ति
text_mt: [The verses] 'Come, pressers, pour around' contain [the prefix] pari.

sanskrit_iast: anto vai tṛtīyam ahas tasyaitāḥ paryāptyai
meaning: अन्तो वै तृतीयम् अहस् तस्यैताः पर्याप्त्यै
text_mt: The third day is the end; these [verses serve] for reaching it.

sanskrit_iast: sakhāya āniṣīdata ity uddhattam iva vai tṛtīyam ahar yad āha niṣīdatety ahar evaitena pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: सखाय आनिषीदत इत्य् उद्धत्तम् इव वै तृतीयम् अहर् यद् आह निषीदतेत्य् अहर् एवैतेन प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: [In the verse] 'O friends, sit down', the third day is, as it were, elevated; in that he says 'sit down', he firmly establishes the day by it.

sanskrit_iast: sutāso madhumattamā ity anuṣṭubhaḥ satyo jagatyo rūpeṇa jāgataṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: सुतासो मधुमत्तमा इत्य् अनुष्टुभः सत्यो जगत्यो रूपेण जागतं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: [The verses] 'The pressed [drops], most sweet', being anuṣṭubhs, have the form of jagatīs, for this day belongs to the jagatī.

sanskrit_iast: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspata iti
meaning: पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पत इति
text_mt: 'Your filter is stretched out, O Brahmaṇaspati.'

sanskrit_iast: vitatam iva vā idam antarikṣam antareme antarikṣadevatyam etad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ tad eva tad abhivadati
meaning: विततम् इव वा इदम् अन्तरिक्षम् अन्तरेमे अन्तरिक्षदेवत्यम् एतद् अहर् यत् तृतीयं तद् एव तद् अभिवदति
text_mt: This atmosphere is, as it were, stretched out between these two [worlds]; this third day has the atmosphere as its deity; it directly expresses that.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गायत्रं भवति यद् एव गायत्रस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: The Gāyatra [sāman] is [used], as [explained in] the explanation of the Gāyatra.

sanskrit_iast: pāṣṭhauhaṃ bhavati
meaning: पाष्ठौहं भवति

sanskrit_iast: paṣṭhavāḍ vā etenāṅgirasaś caturthasyāhno vācaṃ vadantīm upāśṛṇot sa ho vāg iti nidhanam upait tad asyābhyuditaṃ tad ahar avasat
meaning: पष्ठवाड् वा एतेनाङ्गिरसश् चतुर्थस्याह्नो वाचं वदन्तीम् उपाशृणोत् स हो वाग् इति निधनम् उपैत् तद् अस्याभ्युदितं तद् अहर् अवसत्
text_mt: By means of this, Paṣṭhavāh, an Aṅgiras, overheard Speech speaking the voice of the fourth day. He took 'vāg' as the cadence. With that arisen for him, he dwelt that day.

sanskrit_iast: vācaḥ sāma bhavati
meaning: वाचः साम भवति

sanskrit_iast: vāg vai dvādaśāho vācy eva tad vācā stuvate yajñasya prabhūtyai
meaning: वाग् वै द्वादशाहो वाच्य् एव तद् वाचा स्तुवते यज्ञस्य प्रभूत्यै
text_mt: The twelve-day rite is Speech; they praise in Speech by means of Speech, for the abundance of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: niṣkirīyāḥ sattram āsata te tṛtīyam ahar na prājānaṃs tān etat sāma gāyamānān vāg upāplavat tena tṛtīyam ahaḥ prājānaṃs te 'bruvann iyaṃ vāva nas tṛtīyam ahar adīdṛśad iti tṛtīyasyaivaiṣāhno dṛṣṭiḥ
meaning: निष्किरीयाः सत्त्रम् आसत ते तृतीयम् अहर् न प्राजानंस् तान् एतत् साम गायमानान् वाग् उपाप्लवत् तेन तृतीयम् अहः प्राजानंस् ते ऽब्रुवन्न् इयं वाव नस् तृतीयम् अहर् अदीदृशद् इति तृतीयस्यैवैषाह्नो दृष्टिः
text_mt: The Niṣkirīyas were holding a sacrificial session; they did not know the third day. To them, while singing this sāman, Speech floated near. By it they knew the third day. They said: 'She indeed has made us see the third day.' This is the vision of the third day.

sanskrit_iast: śauktaṃ bhavati
meaning: शौक्तं भवति

sanskrit_iast: śuktir vā etenāṅgiraso 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: शुक्तिर् वा एतेनाङ्गिरसो ऽञ्जसा स्वर्गं लोकम् अपश्यत् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: By means of this, Śukti, an Aṅgiras, directly saw the heavenly world. [It serves] for the revelation of the heavenly world. Having praised, he does not fall from the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati yad eva gaurīvitasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गौरीवितं भवति यद् एव गौरीवितस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: The Gaurīvita [sāman] is [used], as is the brāhmaṇa of the Gaurīvita.

sanskrit_iast: tvāṣṭrīsāma bhavati
meaning: त्वाष्ट्रीसाम भवति

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ vā akṣyāmayiṇaṃ bhūtāni nāsvāpayaṃs tam etena tvāṣṭrayo 'svāpayaṃs tad vāva tās tarhy akāmayanta
meaning: इन्द्रं वा अक्ष्यामयिणं भूतानि नास्वापयंस् तम् एतेन त्वाष्ट्रयो ऽस्वापयंस् तद् वाव तास् तर्ह्य् अकामयन्त
text_mt: When Indra was afflicted with eye disease, creatures could not make him sleep; the Tvāṣṭrīs made him sleep by means of this [sāman]; that, indeed, was what they desired at that time.

sanskrit_iast: kāmasani sāma tvāṣṭrīsāma kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
meaning: कामसनि साम त्वाष्ट्रीसाम कामम् एवैतेनावरुन्धे
text_mt: The Tvāṣṭrī sāman is a wish-granting sāman; he secures his wish by it.

sanskrit_iast: indro vṛtrād vibhyad gāṃ prāviśat taṃ tvāṣṭrayo 'bruvaṃ janayāmeti tam etaiḥ sāmabhir ajanayaṃ jāyāmahā iti vai sattram āsate jāyanta eva
meaning: इन्द्रो वृत्राद् विभ्यद् गां प्राविशत् तं त्वाष्ट्रयो ऽब्रुवं जनयामेति तम् एतैः सामभिर् अजनयं जायामहा इति वै सत्त्रम् आसते जायन्त एव
text_mt: Indra, fearing Vṛtra, entered a cow; the Tvāṣṭrīs said: 'Let us bring him forth'; they brought him forth by means of these sāmans; saying: 'Let us be born,' indeed, they sit for a sacrificial session; they are indeed born.

sanskrit_iast: ariṣṭaṃ bhavati
meaning: अरिष्टं भवति

sanskrit_iast: devāś ca vā asurāś cāspardhanta yaṃ devānām aghnan na sa samabhavad yam asurāṇāṃ saṃ so 'bhavat te devās tapo 'tapyanta ta etad ariṣṭam apaśyaṃs tato 'yaṃ devānām aghnat saṃ so 'bhavad yam asurāṇāṃ na sa samabhavad anenāriṣāmeti tad ariṣṭasyāriṣṭatvam ariṣṭayā evāriṣṭam antataḥ kriyate
meaning: देवाश् च वा असुराश् चास्पर्धन्त यं देवानाम् अघ्नन् न स समभवद् यम् असुराणां सं सो ऽभवत् ते देवास् तपो ऽतप्यन्त त एतद् अरिष्टम् अपश्यंस् ततो ऽयं देवानाम् अघ्नत् सं सो ऽभवद् यम् असुराणां न स समभवद् अनेनारिषामेति तद् अरिष्टस्यारिष्टत्वम् अरिष्टया एवारिष्टम् अन्ततः क्रियते
text_mt: The gods and the Asuras contended; whichever of the gods they killed did not revive, but whichever of the Asuras [they killed] did revive; those gods performed ascetic heat; they saw this Ariṣṭa [sāman]; then, whichever of the gods he killed revived, but whichever of the Asuras [he killed] did not revive, [thinking:] 'May we not be harmed by this'; that is the unharmed nature of the Ariṣṭa; for safety he performs the Ariṣṭa at the end.

sanskrit_iast: trīḍaṃ bhavati trirātrasya dhṛtyai
meaning: त्रीडं भवति त्रिरात्रस्य धृत्यै
text_mt: It has three iḍās, for the support of the three-day period.

sanskrit_iast: dravantīm iḍām uttamām upayanti caturthasyāhnaḥ santatyai stomaḥ
meaning: द्रवन्तीम् इडाम् उत्तमाम् उपयन्ति चतुर्थस्याह्नः सन्तत्यै स्तोमः
text_mt: They undertake the flowing iḍā as the last, for the continuity of the fourth day. [So much for] the stoma.

sanskrit_iast: pramaṃhiṣṭhāya gāyateti
meaning: प्रमंहिष्ठाय गायतेति
text_mt: [The verse begins:] 'Sing to the most bountiful' [SV 1.324].

sanskrit_iast: yad gāyateti mahasa eva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
meaning: यद् गायतेति महस एव तद् रूपं क्रियते
text_mt: In that [it says] 'sing', a form of greatness is thereby made.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ te mad aṅgaṇīm asīti madavad vai rasavat tṛtīyasavanaṃ madam eva tad rasaṃ dadhāti
meaning: तं ते मद् अङ्गणीम् असीति मदवद् वै रसवत् तृतीयसवनं मदम् एव तद् रसं दधाति
text_mt: 'We are your intoxications' [SV 1.324]: having intoxication, indeed, having sap is the third pressing; thus he places intoxication and sap [in it].

sanskrit_iast: śrudhī havaṃ tiraścyā iti śrutyā eva
meaning: श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इति श्रुत्या एव
text_mt: 'Hear the call of Tiraścī' [SV 1.324]: for hearing alone.

sanskrit_iast: pramaṃhiṣṭhīya bhavati
meaning: प्रमंहिष्ठीय भवति
text_mt: The Pramaṃhiṣṭhīya [sāman] is [used].

sanskrit_iast: pramaṃhiṣṭhīyena vā indro vṛtrāya vajraṃ prāvartayat tam astṛṇuta bhrātṛvyavān pramaṃhiṣṭhīyenokthāni praṇayeta stṛṇute bhrātṛvyaṃ vasīyāṃ ātmanā bhavati
meaning: प्रमंहिष्ठीयेन वा इन्द्रो वृत्राय वज्रं प्रावर्तयत् तम् अस्तृणुत भ्रातृव्यवान् प्रमंहिष्ठीयेनोक्थानि प्रणयेत स्तृणुते भ्रातृव्यं वसीयां आत्मना भवति
text_mt: By means of the Pramaṃhiṣṭhīya, Indra hurled the thunderbolt at Vṛtra and laid him low; one who has a rival should introduce the ukthas with the Pramaṃhiṣṭhīya; he lays low his rival and becomes more prosperous himself.

sanskrit_iast: hārivarṇaṃ bhavati
meaning: हारिवर्णं भवति

sanskrit_iast: indraś ca vai namuciś cāsuraḥ samadadhātāṃ na no naktan na divāhanan nārdreṇa na śuṣkeṇeti tasya vyuṣṭāyām anudita āditye 'pāṃ phenena śiro 'chinad etad vai na naktaṃ na divā yat vyuṣṭāyām anudita āditya etan nārdran na śuṣkaṃ yad apāṃ phenas tad enaṃ pāpīyāṃ vācaṃ vadad anvavartata vīrahan na druho druha iti tan narcā na sāmnāpahantum aśaknot
meaning: इन्द्रश् च वै नमुचिश् चासुरः समदधातां न नो नक्तन् न दिवाहनन् नार्द्रेण न शुष्केणेति तस्य व्युष्टायाम् अनुदित आदित्ये ऽपां फेनेन शिरो ऽछिनद् एतद् वै न नक्तं न दिवा यत् व्युष्टायाम् अनुदित आदित्य एतन् नार्द्रन् न शुष्कं यद् अपां फेनस् तद् एनं पापीयां वाचं वदद् अन्ववर्तत वीरहन् न द्रुहो द्रुह इति तन् नर्चा न साम्नापहन्तुम् अशक्नोत्
text_mt: Indra and Namuci the Asura made a compact: 'Neither of us shall slay [the other] by night or by day, neither with wet nor with dry'; at dawn, before the sun had risen, he cut off his head with foam of water; for this is neither night nor day, when it is dawn and the sun has not risen; this is neither wet nor dry, which is foam of water; then he followed him, speaking evil speech: 'Hero-slayer, deceiver of a friend!'; he could not ward it off with either ṛc or sāman;

sanskrit_iast: hārivarṇasyaiva nidhanenāpāhata
meaning: हारिवर्णस्यैव निधनेनापाहत
text_mt: he warded it off by the cadence of the Hārivarṇa alone.

sanskrit_iast: apaśucaṃhate hārivarṇasya nidhanena śriyaṃ ca haraś copaiti tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: अपशुचंहते हारिवर्णस्य निधनेन श्रियं च हरश् चोपैति तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: He wards off grief by the cadence of the Hārivarṇa, and one who has praised attains prosperity and brilliance.

sanskrit_iast: tairaścayaṃ bhavati
meaning: तैरश्चयं भवति

sanskrit_iast: aṅgirasaḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ yanto rakṣāṃsy anvasacanta tāny etena tiraścāṅgirasas tiryaṅ paryavaid yat tiryaṅ aparyavait tasmāt tairaścyaṃ pāpmā vāva sa tān asacata taṃ tairaścyenāpāghnatāpa pāpmānaṃ hate tairaścyena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: अङ्गिरसः स्वर्गं लोकं यन्तो रक्षांस्य् अन्वसचन्त तान्य् एतेन तिरश्चाङ्गिरसस् तिर्यङ् पर्यवैद् यत् तिर्यङ् अपर्यवैत् तस्मात् तैरश्च्यं पाप्मा वाव स तान् असचत तं तैरश्च्येनापाघ्नताप पाप्मानं हते तैरश्च्येन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: When the Aṅgirases were going to heaven, the demons pursued them; by this [sāman] Tiras, an Aṅgiras, went across them sideways; because he went across sideways, therefore it is the Tairaścya; evil indeed pursued them; they struck away that [evil] by means of the Tairaścya; one who has praised strikes away evil by means of the Tairaścya.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa eva stomo bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai prajātyai
meaning: सप्तदश एव स्तोमो भवति प्रतिष्ठायै प्रजात्यै
text_mt: The stoma is seventeenfold, for firm standing, for propagation.

sanskrit_iast: pra ta āśvinīḥ pavamānadhenava iti caturthasyāhnaḥ pratipad bhavati
meaning: प्र त आश्विनीः पवमानधेनव इति चतुर्थस्याह्नः प्रतिपद् भवति
text_mt: 'Forth have [come] your swift Pavamāna-milch-cows' [SV 2.125] is the introductory verse of the fourth day.

sanskrit_iast: āpte trirātre rūpeṇa gāyatryo dvitīyaṃ prayanti prati vai gāyatryā rūpam
meaning: आप्ते त्रिरात्रे रूपेण गायत्र्यो द्वितीयं प्रयन्ति प्रति वै गायत्र्या रूपम्
text_mt: When the three-day period is completed in form, they proceed to the second [trirātra] with gāyatrīs; for the form of the gāyatrī is an answering [form].

sanskrit_iast: jagatī pratipad bhavati jāgatam etad ahar yat tṛtīyaṃ jagatyā eva taj jagatīm abhisaṃkrāmanti
meaning: जगती प्रतिपद् भवति जागतम् एतद् अहर् यत् तृतीयं जगत्या एव तज् जगतीम् अभिसंक्रामन्ति
text_mt: A jagatī is the introductory verse; this day, which is the third, is connected with the jagatī; from the jagatī they proceed to the jagatī.

sanskrit_iast: yad ato 'nyā pratipatsyāt pratikūlaṃ vānukūlaṃ vā syāt
meaning: यद् अतो ऽन्या प्रतिपत्स्यात् प्रतिकूलं वानुकूलं वा स्यात्
text_mt: If any other [verse] were to be the introductory verse, it would be adverse or congruent.

sanskrit_iast: pavamāno ajījanad ity anurūpo bhavati
meaning: पवमानो अजीजनद् इत्य् अनुरूपो भवति
text_mt: 'Pavamāna has begotten' [SV 2.128] is the corresponding verse.

sanskrit_iast: janadvad vā etad ahar yac caturtham annādyaṃ janayati virājaṃ janayaty ekaviṃśaṃ stomaṃ janayati
meaning: जनद्वद् वा एतद् अहर् यच् चतुर्थम् अन्नाद्यं जनयति विराजं जनयत्य् एकविंशं स्तोमं जनयति
text_mt: Possessed of 'generating', indeed, is this day, which is the fourth; it generates food, it generates the virāj, it generates the twenty-one-fold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvam u caiva tad rūpam apareṇa rūpeṇānuvadati tad anurūpasyānurūpatvam
meaning: पूर्वम् उ चैव तद् रूपम् अपरेण रूपेणानुवदति तद् अनुरूपस्यानुरूपत्वम्
text_mt: And he repeats the previous form with the subsequent form; that is the corresponding nature of the corresponding verse.

sanskrit_iast: anurūpa enaṃ putro jāyate ya evaṃ veda
meaning: अनुरूप एनं पुत्रो जायते य एवं वेद
text_mt: A corresponding son is born to him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: stotrīyānurūpau tṛcau bhavataḥ prāṇāpānānām avarudhyai
meaning: स्तोत्रीयानुरूपौ तृचौ भवतः प्राणापानानाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: The stotriya and corresponding verses are triplets, for securing the exhalations and inhalations.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍṛcau bhavata ṛtūnāṃ dhṛtyai
meaning: षडृचौ भवत ऋतूनां धृत्यै
text_mt: They are six verses, for the support of the seasons.

sanskrit_iast: tṛca uttamo bhavati yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti
meaning: तृच उत्तमो भवति येनैव प्राणेन प्रयन्ति तम् अभ्युद्यन्ति
text_mt: The triplet is the last; by whichever breath they set out, to that they rise up.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśa eva stomo bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: एकविंश एव स्तोमो भवति प्रतिष्ठायै प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: The stoma is twenty-one-fold, for firm standing; he stands firmly.

sanskrit_iast: janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgṛviḥ ity āgneyam ājyaṃ bhavati
meaning: जनस्य गोपा अजनिष्ट जागृविः इत्य् आग्नेयम् आज्यं भवति
text_mt: 'The wakeful guardian of the people has been born' [SV 2.131] is the ājyastotra to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: janadvad vā etad ahar yac caturtham annādyaṃ janayati virājaṃ janayaty ekaviṃśaṃ stomaṃ janayati
meaning: जनद्वद् वा एतद् अहर् यच् चतुर्थम् अन्नाद्यं जनयति विराजं जनयत्य् एकविंशं स्तोमं जनयति
text_mt: Possessed of 'generating', indeed, is this day, which is the fourth; it generates food, it generates the virāj, it generates the twenty-one-fold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvarūṇā iti bārhataṃ maitrāvarūṇam
meaning: अयं वां मित्रावरूणा इति बार्हतं मैत्रावरूणम्
text_mt: 'This of yours, O Mitra and Varuṇa' [SV 2.134] is the Maitrāvaruṇa [ājyastotra] in Bṛhat-form.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhad etat parokṣaṃ yad vairājaṃ bārhatam eva tad rūpaṃ nirdyotayati
meaning: बृहद् एतत् परोक्षं यद् वैराजं बार्हतम् एव तद् रूपं निर्द्योतयति
text_mt: This Bṛhat is unexpressed, which is the Vairāja; he makes manifest that very form belonging to the Bṛhat.

sanskrit_iast: indro dadhīco asthabhir iti dādhīcas tṛco bhavati
meaning: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर् इति दाधीचस् तृचो भवति
text_mt: 'Indra with the bones of Dadhyañc' [SV 2.137] is the triplet relating to Dadhyañc.

sanskrit_iast: dadhyaṅ vā āṅgiraso devānāṃ purodhānīya āsīd annaṃ vai brahmaṇaḥ purodhā annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: दध्यङ् वा आङ्गिरसो देवानां पुरोधानीय आसीद् अन्नं वै ब्रह्मणः पुरोधा अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: Dadhyañc, an Aṅgiras, was the domestic priest of the gods; food, indeed, is the domestic priest of the brahman, for securing food.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vāmasya manmana ity aindrāgnam
meaning: इयं वामस्य मन्मन इत्य् ऐन्द्राग्नम्
text_mt: 'This thought of ours' [SV 2.140] is to Indra and Agni.

sanskrit_iast: indrāgnī pūrvyastutir abhrād vṛṣṭir ivājani ity ānuṣṭubhī vai vṛṣṭir ānuṣṭubham etad ahar yac caturthaṃ samīcyau virājau dadhāty annādyāya stomaḥ
meaning: इन्द्राग्नी पूर्व्यस्तुतिर् अभ्राद् वृष्टिर् इवाजनि इत्य् आनुष्टुभी वै वृष्टिर् आनुष्टुभम् एतद् अहर् यच् चतुर्थं समीच्यौ विराजौ दधात्य् अन्नाद्याय स्तोमः
text_mt: 'Indra and Agni, the ancient praise has been born like rain from a cloud' [SV 2.141]; rain indeed is connected with the anuṣṭubh; this day, which is the fourth, is connected with the anuṣṭubh; he establishes two congruent virājs, for food. [So much for] the stoma.

sanskrit_iast: payasva dakṣasādhana iti gāyatrī bhavati sidhyai
meaning: पयस्व दक्षसाधन इति गायत्री भवति सिध्यै
text_mt: 'Flow, O promoter of skill' [SV 2.143] is a gāyatrī, for success.

sanskrit_iast: yat pavasveti tad bṛhato rūpaṃ bārhataṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: यत् पवस्वेति तद् बृहतो रूपं बार्हतं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: That [it says] 'flow' is the form of the Bṛhat, for this day belongs to the Bṛhat.

sanskrit_iast: tavāhaṃ soma rāraṇa sakhya indo dive dive | purūṇi babhro nicaranti mām ava paridhīṃr atitāṃ ihi iti
meaning: तवाहं सोम रारण सख्य इन्दो दिवे दिवे | पुरूणि बभ्रो निचरन्ति माम् अव परिधींर् अतितां इहि इति
text_mt: 'May I rejoice in your friendship, O Soma, O drop, day by day; many [shafts] fall upon me, O tawny one; pass beyond these enclosures' [SV 2.146]:

sanskrit_iast: ati hy āyañ chakunā iva paptim ety ati hy apatat
meaning: अति ह्य् आयञ् छकुना इव पप्तिम् एत्य् अति ह्य् अपतत्
text_mt: for they went beyond: 'Like birds we flew,' [the verse says], for he flew beyond.

sanskrit_iast: punāno akramīd abhīti
meaning: पुनानो अक्रमीद् अभीति

sanskrit_iast: gāyatryaḥ satyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa tasmāt triṣṭubhāṃ loke kriyante
meaning: गायत्र्यः सत्यस् त्रिष्टुभो रूपेण तस्मात् त्रिष्टुभां लोके क्रियन्ते
