sanskrit_iast: āpo vai revatyas tā yat pṛṣṭhaṃ kuryur apaśur yajamānaḥ syāt paśūn asya nirdaheyur yatra vā āpo vivartante tad oṣadhayo jāyante 'tha yatrāvatiṣṭhante nirmṛtukās tatra bhavanti tasmāt pavamāne kurvanti parācā hi pavamānena stuvate
meaning: आपो वै रेवत्यस् ता यत् पृष्ठं कुर्युर् अपशुर् यजमानः स्यात् पशून् अस्य निर्दहेयुर् यत्र वा आपो विवर्तन्ते तद् ओषधयो जायन्ते ऽथ यत्रावतिष्ठन्ते निर्मृतुकास् तत्र भवन्ति तस्मात् पवमाने कुर्वन्ति पराचा हि पवमानेन स्तुवते
text_mt: The waters indeed are the Revatīs; if they were to make them the pṛṣṭha, the sacrificer would be without cattle, [for] they would burn up his cattle. Where waters roll on, there plants grow; but where they stand still, things perish there. Therefore they perform them in the Pavamāna, for they praise with a forward-moving Pavamāna.

sanskrit_iast: methī vā iṣovṛdhīyaṃ rajjuḥ krauñcaṃ vatso vājadāvaryo revatyo mātaro yad etāny evaṃ sāmāni kriyanta evam eva prattāṃ dugdhe
meaning: मेथी वा इषोवृधीयं रज्जुः क्रौञ्चं वत्सो वाजदावर्यो रेवत्यो मातरो यद् एतान्य् एवं सामानि क्रियन्त एवम् एव प्रत्तां दुग्धे
text_mt: The hitching post indeed is the Iṣovṛdhīya; the rope is the Krauñca; the calf is the Vājadāvarīs; the mothers are the Revatīs. Because these sāmans are performed in this manner, he milks her just when she is surrendered.

sanskrit_iast: aukṣṇorandhre bhavataḥ
meaning: औक्ष्णोरन्ध्रे भवतः
text_mt: The two Aukṣṇorandhras are [employed].

sanskrit_iast: ukṣṇorandhro vā etābhyāṃ kāvyo 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: उक्ष्णोरन्ध्रो वा एताभ्यां काव्यो ऽञ्जसा स्वर्गं लोकम् अपश्यत् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Ukṣṇorandhra Kāvya, by these two, directly saw the world of heaven, for the revelation of the world of heaven; having praised, he does not fall from the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: vājajid bhavati sarvasyāptyai sarvasya jityai sarvaṃ vā ete vājaṃ jayanti ye ṣaṣṭham ahar āgacchanti
meaning: वाजजिद् भवति सर्वस्याप्त्यै सर्वस्य जित्यै सर्वं वा एते वाजं जयन्ति ये षष्ठम् अहर् आगच्छन्ति
text_mt: The Vājajit is [employed], for the attainment of everything, for the winning of everything; for all booty they win who come to the sixth day.

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ vai vājo 'nnādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: अन्नं वै वाजो ऽन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: Food indeed is booty, for securing food.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasāma bhavati
meaning: वरुणसाम भवति

sanskrit_iast: etena vai varuṇo rājyam ādhipatyam agacchad yaśo 'bhavad rājyam ādhipatyaṃ gacchati yaśo bhavati varuṇasāmnā tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: एतेन वै वरुणो राज्यम् आधिपत्यम् अगच्छद् यशो ऽभवद् राज्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छति यशो भवति वरुणसाम्ना तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: By this Varuṇa attained kingship and overlordship, and became famous; he attains kingship and overlordship, and becomes famous, who has praised with the Varuṇasāman.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgirasāṃ goṣṭho bhavati
meaning: अङ्गिरसां गोष्ठो भवति
text_mt: The Goṣṭha of the Aṅgirases is [employed].

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai revatyo gauṣṭham eva tat paśubhyaḥ paryasyanti tam evainān pravartayanty avisraṃsāya
meaning: पशवो वै रेवत्यो गौष्ठम् एव तत् पशुभ्यः पर्यस्यन्ति तम् एवैनान् प्रवर्तयन्त्य् अविस्रंसाय
text_mt: Cattle indeed are the Revatīs; they cast a cowpen around the cattle; they drive them into it, so that they do not slip away.

sanskrit_iast: ihavad vāmadevyaṃ bhavati
meaning: इहवद् वामदेव्यं भवति
text_mt: The Vāmadevya containing [the word] 'iha' is [employed].

sanskrit_iast: etena vai vāmadevo 'nnasya purodhām agacchad annaṃ vai brahmaṇaḥ purodhā annasyāvarudhyai
meaning: एतेन वै वामदेवो ऽन्नस्य पुरोधाम् अगच्छद् अन्नं वै ब्रह्मणः पुरोधा अन्नस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: By this Vāmadeva attained the primacy of food; food indeed is the primacy of the brahman, for securing food.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṣu stuvanti pratiṣṭhāyai brahmavarñcasāya yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti
meaning: गायत्रीषु स्तुवन्ति प्रतिष्ठायै ब्रह्मवर्ञ्चसाय येनैव प्राणेन प्रयन्ति तम् अभ्युद्यन्ति
text_mt: They praise on gāyatrī verses, for support, for brahminical lustre; with whichever breath they proceed, that they rise up toward.

sanskrit_iast: marutvatyo gāyatryo bhavanti tad u traiṣṭubhād rūpān na yanti stomaḥ
meaning: मरुत्वत्यो गायत्र्यो भवन्ति तद् उ त्रैष्टुभाद् रूपान् न यन्ति स्तोमः
text_mt: The gāyatrī verses are accompanied by the Maruts; and thus they do not depart from the form of the triṣṭubh. [Such is] the stoma.

sanskrit_iast: yātayāmāny anyāni chandāṃsy ayātayāmā gāyatrī tasmād gāyatrīṣu stuvanti
meaning: यातयामान्य् अन्यानि छन्दांस्य् अयातयामा गायत्री तस्माद् गायत्रीषु स्तुवन्ति
text_mt: Exhausted are the other metres, unexhausted is the gāyatrī; therefore they praise on gāyatrī verses.

sanskrit_iast: surūpa kṛtnum ūtaya ity abhyārambheṇa ṣaṭpadāḥ ṣaṣṭhasyāhno rūpaṃ tena ṣaṣṭham ahar ārabhante santatyai
meaning: सुरूप कृत्नुम् ऊतय इत्य् अभ्यारम्भेण षट्पदाः षष्ठस्याह्नो रूपं तेन षष्ठम् अहर् आरभन्ते सन्तत्यै
text_mt: 'For aid him who makes beautiful forms'—by this undertaking there are six-footed verses, the form of the sixth day; by it they undertake the sixth day, for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: ubhe yad indra rodasī iti ṣaṭpadāḥ ṣaṣṭhasyāhno rūpaṃ tena ṣaṣṭham ahar ārabhante santatyai
meaning: उभे यद् इन्द्र रोदसी इति षट्पदाः षष्ठस्याह्नो रूपं तेन षष्ठम् अहर् आरभन्ते सन्तत्यै
text_mt: 'When both heaven and earth, O Indra'—these are six-footed verses, the form of the sixth day; by it they undertake the sixth day, for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: revatīṣu vāravantīyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati
meaning: रेवतीषु वारवन्तीयं पृष्ठं भवति
text_mt: On the Revatī verses the Vāravantīya is the pṛṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ vā eṣa raso yad revatyo revatīnāṃ raso yad vāravantīyaṃ sarasā eva tad revatīḥ prayuṅkte yad vāravantīyena pṛṣṭhena stuvate
meaning: अपां वा एष रसो यद् रेवत्यो रेवतीनां रसो यद् वारवन्तीयं सरसा एव तद् रेवतीः प्रयुङ्क्ते यद् वारवन्तीयेन पृष्ठेन स्तुवते
text_mt: This sap of the waters is what the Revatīs are; the sap of the Revatīs is what the Vāravantīya is; full of sap indeed he employs the Revatīs when they praise with the Vāravantīya as the pṛṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast: revad vā etad raivatyaṃ yad vāravantīyam asya revān revātyā jāyate
meaning: रेवद् वा एतद् रैवत्यं यद् वारवन्तीयम् अस्य रेवान् रेवात्या जायते
text_mt: Wealthy indeed is this belonging to the Revatīs, which is the Vāravantīya; wealthy is he born to him through the Revatī.

sanskrit_iast: revān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: रेवान् भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He becomes wealthy who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: keśine vā etad dālbhyāya sāmāvir abhavat tad enam abravīd agātāro mā gāyanti mā mayodgāsiṣur iti kathaṃ ta āgā bhagava ity abravīd āgeyam evāsmy āgāyann iva gāyet pratiṣṭhāyai tad alammaṃ pārijānataṃ paścādakṣaṃ śayānam etām āgāṃ gāyantam ajānāt tam abravīt puras tvā dadhā iti tam abruvan ko nv ayaṃ kasmā alam ity alaṃ nu vai mahyam iti tad alammasyālammatvam
meaning: केशिने वा एतद् दाल्भ्याय सामाविर् अभवत् तद् एनम् अब्रवीद् अगातारो मा गायन्ति मा मयोद्गासिषुर् इति कथं त आगा भगव इत्य् अब्रवीद् आगेयम् एवास्म्य् आगायन्न् इव गायेत् प्रतिष्ठायै तद् अलम्मं पारिजानतं पश्चादक्षं शयानम् एताम् आगां गायन्तम् अजानात् तम् अब्रवीत् पुरस् त्वा दधा इति तम् अब्रुवन् को न्व् अयं कस्मा अलम् इत्य् अलं नु वै मह्यम् इति तद् अलम्मस्यालम्मत्वम्
text_mt: This sāman revealed itself to Keśin Dālbhya. It said to him: 'Non-singers sing me; they have not sung out with me.' 'How is your song, O venerable one?' he said. 'I am indeed to be sung as an arrival; as if singing an arrival, one should sing, for support.' Then he recognized Alamma Pārijānata lying behind the axle, singing this arrival-song. He said to him: 'I place you in front.' They said to him: 'Who is this one now? For what is he sufficient (alam)?' 'He is indeed sufficient for me,' [he said]; that is the sufficiency of Alamma.

sanskrit_iast: iheheti gāyet pratiṣṭhāyai
meaning: इहेहेति गायेत् प्रतिष्ठायै
text_mt: One should sing 'iha iha', for support.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabho raivato bhavati
meaning: ऋषभो रैवतो भवति
text_mt:
There is the Ṛṣabha based on the Revatī verses.
Cattle, indeed, are connected with the Revatī; thus he unites a pair among cattle for procreation. Truly, cattle do not reproduce without a bull.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai raivatyaḥ paśuṣv eva tan mithunam apyarjati prajātyai na ha vā anṛṣabhāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante
meaning: पशवो वै रैवत्यः पशुष्व् एव तन् मिथुनम् अप्यर्जति प्रजात्यै न ह वा अनृषभाः पशवः प्रजायन्ते

sanskrit_iast: śyeno bhavati
meaning: श्येनो भवति

sanskrit_iast: śyeno ha vai pūrvapretāni vayāṃsy āpnoti pūrvapretānīva vai pūrvāṇy ahāni teṣām āptyai śyenaḥ kriyate
meaning: श्येनो ह वै पूर्वप्रेतानि वयांस्य् आप्नोति पूर्वप्रेतानीव वै पूर्वाण्य् अहानि तेषाम् आप्त्यै श्येनः क्रियते
text_mt: The falcon (śyena) reaches the birds that have flown ahead. The preceding days are, as it were, those that have flown ahead; the Śyena is performed to attain them.

sanskrit_iast: śyeno vā etad ahaḥ sampārayitum arhati sa hi vayasām āśiṣṭhas tasyānapahananāya sampāraṇāyaitat kriyate 'nto hi ṣaṣṭhaṃ cāhaḥ saptamaṃ ca
meaning: श्येनो वा एतद् अहः सम्पारयितुम् अर्हति स हि वयसाम् आशिष्ठस् तस्यानपहननाय सम्पारणायैतत् क्रियते ऽन्तो हि षष्ठं चाहः सप्तमं च
text_mt: The falcon is able to carry this day across; for it is the swiftest of birds. This is performed so that it may carry it across without striking it down; for the sixth day and the seventh day are the end.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti yad bṛhad āyatanāni pṛṣṭhāny athaite dve gāyatryau dve jagatyau kva tarhi bṛhatyo bhavantīti
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति यद् बृहद् आयतनानि पृष्ठान्य् अथैते द्वे गायत्र्यौ द्वे जगत्यौ क्व तर्हि बृहत्यो भवन्तीति
text_mt: The theologians say: 'Since the pṛṣṭhas have the bṛhatī as their base, and here there are two gāyatrī and two jagatī [verses], where then are the bṛhatīs?'

sanskrit_iast: ye dve jagatyoḥ pade te gāyatryā upasampadyete tat sarvā bṛhatyo bhavanty āyatane pṛṣṭhāni yātayatyāyatanavān bhavati
meaning: ये द्वे जगत्योः पदे ते गायत्र्या उपसम्पद्येते तत् सर्वा बृहत्यो भवन्त्य् आयतने पृष्ठानि यातयत्यायतनवान् भवति
text_mt: The two verses of the two jagatīs are added to the gāyatrī; thus they all become bṛhatīs. He sets the pṛṣṭhas in their proper place; he becomes possessed of a base.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṭpadāsu stuvanti ṣaḍrātrasya dhṛtyai
meaning: षट्पदासु स्तुवन्ति षड्रात्रस्य धृत्यै
text_mt: They praise on six-line [verses] for the firm support of the six-day period.

sanskrit_iast: saptapadayā yajati saptamasyāhnaḥ santatyai stomaḥ
meaning: सप्तपदया यजति सप्तमस्याह्नः सन्तत्यै स्तोमः
text_mt: He sacrifices with a seven-line [verse] for the continuity of the seventh day. [Such is] the stoma.

sanskrit_iast: parisvāno giriṣṭhā iti parivatyo gāyatryo bhavanti sarvasya paryāptyai
meaning: परिस्वानो गिरिष्ठा इति परिवत्यो गायत्र्यो भवन्ति सर्वस्य पर्याप्त्यै
text_mt: 'Sounding all around, dwelling on the mountain': there are gāyatrīs containing the word 'pari' ('around'), for the compassing of everything.

sanskrit_iast: sasunveyo vasūnām iti paśavo vai vasu paśūnām avarudhyai
meaning: ससुन्वेयो वसूनाम् इति पशवो वै वसु पशूनाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: 'To be pressed out, possessing goods': cattle, indeed, are goods; [it is] for the obtainment of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vassakhāyo madāya iti vālakhilyāḥ
meaning: तं वस्सखायो मदाय इति वालखिल्याः
text_mt: 'Him, O friends, for exhilaration': these are the Vālakhilyas.

sanskrit_iast: vālakhilyāv etau tṛcau ṣaṣṭhe cāhani saptame ca
meaning: वालखिल्याव् एतौ तृचौ षष्ठे चाहनि सप्तमे च
text_mt: These two triplets are the Vālakhilyas on the sixth and on the seventh day.

sanskrit_iast: yad etau vālakhilyau tṛcau bhavato 'hnor eva vyatiṣaṅgayāvyatisraṃsāya santatyai
meaning: यद् एतौ वालखिल्यौ तृचौ भवतो ऽह्नोर् एव व्यतिषङ्गयाव्यतिस्रंसाय सन्तत्यै
text_mt: That there are these two Vālakhilya triplets is for the interlinking of the two days, for unloosening, for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: somāḥ pavanta indava ity anuṣṭubho nibhasado bhavanti pratiṣṭhāyai
meaning: सोमाः पवन्त इन्दव इत्य् अनुष्टुभो निभसदो भवन्ति प्रतिष्ठायै
text_mt: 'The somas, drops, purify themselves': these are anuṣṭubhs with broad seats, for a firm foundation.

sanskrit_iast: ayā pavā pavasvainā vasūni iti triṣṭubhas satyo jagatyo rūpeṇa tasmāj jagatīnāṃ loke kriyante
meaning: अया पवा पवस्वैना वसूनि इति त्रिष्टुभस् सत्यो जगत्यो रूपेण तस्माज् जगतीनां लोके क्रियन्ते
text_mt: 'With this [stream], clarify yourself, purify these goods': though being triṣṭubhs, they have the form of jagatīs; therefore they are performed in the place of jagatīs.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brahmāṇam
meaning: गायत्रं भवति यद् एव गायत्रस्य ब्रह्माणम्
text_mt: There is the Gāyatra [sāman]; what belongs to the Gāyatra is the sacred power.

sanskrit_iast: vaidanvātāni bhavanti
meaning: वैदन्वातानि भवन्ति
text_mt: There are the Vaidanvata sāmans.

sanskrit_iast: vidanvān vai bhārgava indrasya pratyahaṃs taṃ śug ārcchat sa tapo 'tapyata sa etāni vaidanvatāny apaśyat taiḥ śucam apāhatāpaśucaṃ hate vaidanvatais tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: विदन्वान् वै भार्गव इन्द्रस्य प्रत्यहंस् तं शुग् आर्च्छत् स तपो ऽतप्यत स एतानि वैदन्वतान्य् अपश्यत् तैः शुचम् अपाहतापशुचं हते वैदन्वतैस् तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Vidanvat Bhārgava contradicted Indra; grief came upon him. He performed ascetic heat; he saw these Vaidanvata sāmans. With them he drove away his grief; having praised with the Vaidanvata sāmans, he drives away his grief.

sanskrit_iast: bharadvājasya lomata bhavati
meaning: भरद्वाजस्य लोमत भवति
text_mt: There is the Loma of Bharadvāja.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai loma paśūnām avarudhyai
meaning: पशवो वै लोम पशूनाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: Hair (loma) is cattle; [it is] for the obtainment of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: tad u dīrgham ity āhur āyur vai dīrgham āyuṣo 'varudhyai
meaning: तद् उ दीर्घम् इत्य् आहुर् आयुर् वै दीर्घम् आयुषो ऽवरुध्यै
text_mt: And they also call it long (dīrgha); life-span (āyus) is long; [it is] for the obtainment of life-span.

sanskrit_iast: kārṇaśravasaṃ bhavati śṛṇvanti tuṣṭuvānam
meaning: कार्णश्रवसं भवति शृण्वन्ति तुष्टुवानम्
text_mt: There is the Kārṇaśravasa sāman; they listen to him who has praised.

sanskrit_iast: karṇaśravā vā etad āṅigarasaḥ paśukāmaḥ sāmāpaśyat tena sahasraṃ paśūn asṛjata yad etat sāma bhavati paśūnāṃ puṣṭyai
meaning: कर्णश्रवा वा एतद् आङिगरसः पशुकामः सामापश्यत् तेन सहस्रं पशून् असृजत यद् एतत् साम भवति पशूनां पुष्ट्यै
text_mt: Karṇaśravas Āṅgirasa, desiring cattle, saw this sāman. By it he produced a thousand cattle. That this sāman is used is for the flourishing of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati gaurivitasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गौरीवितं भवति गौरिवितस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: There is the Gaurīvita sāman; [this has] the brāhmaṇa of the Gaurīvita.

sanskrit_iast: madhuścyunnidhanaṃ bhavati
meaning: मधुश्च्युन्निधनं भवति
text_mt: There is a cadence dripping with honey.

sanskrit_iast: paramasyānnādyasyāvarudhyai paramaṃ vā etad annādya yan madhu
meaning: परमस्यान्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै परमं वा एतद् अन्नाद्य यन् मधु
text_mt: [It is] for the obtainment of the highest food; for honey is this highest food.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpater vā etau stanau yad ghṛtaścyunnidhanaṃ ca madhuścyunnidhanaṃ ca yajño vai prajāpatis tam etābhyāṃ dugdhe yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate taṃ dugdhe
meaning: प्रजापतेर् वा एतौ स्तनौ यद् घृतश्च्युन्निधनं च मधुश्च्युन्निधनं च यज्ञो वै प्रजापतिस् तम् एताभ्यां दुग्धे यं कामं कामयते तं दुग्धे
text_mt: These two udders of Prajāpati are that cadence dripping with ghee and that cadence dripping with honey. The sacrifice is Prajāpati; he milks it through these two; whatever desire he desires, that he milks.

sanskrit_iast: krauñce bhavataḥ
meaning: क्रौञ्चे भवतः

sanskrit_iast: śnauṣṭhaṃ bhavati
meaning: श्नौष्ठं भवति

sanskrit_iast: śnuṣṭir vā etenāṅgiraso 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāt lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: श्नुष्टिर् वा एतेनाङ्गिरसो ऽञ्जसा स्वर्गं लोकम् अपश्यत् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै स्वर्गात् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: By this Śnuṣṭi Āṅgirasa directly saw the world of heaven; [it is] for the perceiving of the heavenly world; he who has praised does not fall from the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: agner vā etad vaiśvānaraṃ sāma dīdihīti nidhanam upayanti dīdā eva hy agnir vaiśvānaraḥ
meaning: अग्नेर् वा एतद् वैश्वानरं साम दीदिहीति निधनम् उपयन्ति दीदा एव ह्य् अग्निर् वैश्वानरः
text_mt: This is the Vaiśvānara sāman of Agni. They use 'dīdihi' ('shine bright') as the cadence; for Agni Vaiśvānara is indeed shining.

sanskrit_iast: nidhanāntāḥ pavamānā bhavanty ahno dhṛtyai stomaḥ
meaning: निधनान्ताः पवमाना भवन्त्य् अह्नो धृत्यै स्तोमः
text_mt: The pavamāna [lauds] end in cadences for the firm support of the day. [Such is] the stoma.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti prāyaṇato dvipadāḥ kāryā udayanatā3 iti
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति प्रायणतो द्विपदाः कार्या उदयनता3 इति
text_mt: The theologians say: 'Should two-footed [verses] be used at the beginning or at the conclusion?'

sanskrit_iast: udayanata eva kāryāḥ puruṣo vai dvipadāḥ pratiṣṭhāyai
meaning: उदयनत एव कार्याः पुरुषो वै द्विपदाः प्रतिष्ठायै
text_mt: They should be used only at the conclusion. Man is two-footed; [it is] for a firm foundation.

sanskrit_iast: vācā vai sarvaṃ yajñaṃ tanvate tasmāt sarvāṃ vācaṃ puruṣo vadati sarvā hy asmin saṃstutā pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: वाचा वै सर्वं यज्ञं तन्वते तस्मात् सर्वां वाचं पुरुषो वदति सर्वा ह्य् अस्मिन् संस्तुता प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: They perform the entire sacrifice with speech; therefore, man speaks all speech; for when fully praised, all [speech] is established in him.

sanskrit_iast: gūrdo bhavati
meaning: गूर्दो भवति

sanskrit_iast: gopāyanānāṃ vai sattram āsīnānāṃ kirātakulyāv asuramāye antaḥparidhy asūn prākiratāṃ te agre tvan no antama ity agnim upāsīdaṃs tenāsūn aspṛṇvaṃs tad vāva te tarhy akāmayanta kāmasani sāma gūrdaḥ kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
meaning: गोपायनानां वै सत्त्रम् आसीनानां किरातकुल्याव् असुरमाये अन्तःपरिध्य् असून् प्राकिरतां ते अग्रे त्वन् नो अन्तम इत्य् अग्निम् उपासीदंस् तेनासून् अस्पृण्वंस् तद् वाव ते तर्ह्य् अकामयन्त कामसनि साम गूर्दः कामम् एवैतेनावरुन्धे
text_mt: When the Gopāyanas were performing a sacrificial session, Kirāta and Ākuli, using Asura-magic, scattered their life-breaths inside the enclosing sticks. They approached Agni with 'Agni, be nearest to us'; thereby they saved their life-breaths. That indeed is what they then desired. The Gūrda sāman wins desires; by this he obtains desire.

sanskrit_iast: gotamasya bhandra bhavati
meaning: गोतमस्य भन्द्र भवति
text_mt: There is the Bhanda sāman of Gotama.

sanskrit_iast: āśiṣam evāsmā etenāśāste sāma hi satyāśīḥ
meaning: आशिषम् एवास्मा एतेनाशास्ते साम हि सत्याशीः
text_mt: Thereby he invokes a blessing for him; for the sāman is a true blessing.

sanskrit_iast: etena vai gotamo jemānaṃ mahimānam agacchat tasmād ye ca parāñco gotamād ye cārvāñcas ta ubhaye gotamā ṛṣayo bruvate
meaning: एतेन वै गोतमो जेमानं महिमानम् अगच्छत् तस्माद् ये च पराञ्चो गोतमाद् ये चार्वाञ्चस् त उभये गोतमा ऋषयो ब्रुवते
text_mt: By this Gotama attained triumphant greatness; therefore, both those who are further and those who are nearer from Gotama call themselves Gotama sages.

sanskrit_iast: udvaṃśaputrā bhavati
meaning: उद्वंशपुत्रा भवति

sanskrit_iast: yad vā udvaṃśīyaṃ tad udvaṃśaputraḥ
meaning: यद् वा उद्वंशीयं तद् उद्वंशपुत्रः
text_mt: What is the Udvaṃśīya, that is the Udvaṃśaputra.

sanskrit_iast: ardheḍām atisvarati
meaning: अर्धेडाम् अतिस्वरति

sanskrit_iast: tasmād ūdhardhārā ati carantīḍāyām antataḥ paśuṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: तस्माद् ऊधर्धारा अति चरन्तीडायाम् अन्ततः पशुषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: Therefore, streams go beyond the udder; in the end he finds a firm foundation in cattle at the iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: kḷpta upariṣṭād ṛk sāma ca vimucyete abhy u svareṇa saptamam ahaḥ svarati santatyai
meaning: कॢप्त उपरिष्टाद् ऋक् साम च विमुच्येते अभ्य् उ स्वरेण सप्तमम् अहः स्वरति सन्तत्यै
text_mt: Arranged above, the verse and the sāman are unyoked; and with the sound he intones towards the seventh day for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: ūhuṣīva vā etarhi vāg yadā ṣaḍahaḥ santiṣṭhate na bahu vaden nānyaṃ pṛcchen nānyasmai prabrūyāt
meaning: ऊहुषीव वा एतर्हि वाग् यदा षडहः सन्तिष्ठते न बहु वदेन् नान्यं पृच्छेन् नान्यस्मै प्रब्रूयात्
text_mt: Speech is as it were exhausted when the six-day rite concludes. He should not speak much, he should not ask another, he should not tell another.

sanskrit_iast: madhu vāśayed ghṛtaṃ vā yathehuṣo bahaṃ pratyanakti tathā tat
meaning: मधु वाशयेद् घृतं वा यथेहुषो बहं प्रत्यनक्ति तथा तत्
text_mt: He should eat honey or ghee; just as one anoints the shoulder of an ox that has drawn [a load], so is that.

sanskrit_iast: trayastriṃśa eva stomo bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai devatāsu vā eṣa pratiṣṭhitaḥ
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिंश एव स्तोमो भवति प्रतिष्ठायै देवतासु वा एष प्रतिष्ठितः
text_mt: The stoma is the thirty-three-fold stoma alone, for a firm foundation; it is established among the deities.

sanskrit_iast: āpyante vā etat stomāś chandāṃsi yat ṣaḍaha āpyate
meaning: आप्यन्ते वा एतत् स्तोमाश् छन्दांसि यत् षडह आप्यते
text_mt: The stomas and metres are reached when the six-day rite is reached.

sanskrit_iast: āpte ṣaḍahe chandāṃsi stomān kṛtvā prayanti
meaning: आप्ते षडहे छन्दांसि स्तोमान् कृत्वा प्रयन्ति
text_mt: When the six-day rite is reached, they go forth making the metres into the stomas.

sanskrit_iast: pra kāvyam uśanevara bruvāṇa iti gāyatryā rūpeṇa prayanti
meaning: प्र काव्यम् उशनेवर ब्रुवाण इति गायत्र्या रूपेण प्रयन्ति
text_mt: 'Uttering wisdom like Uśanā', thus they go forth in the form of the gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vai gāyatry asyām eva pratiṣṭhāya prayanti
meaning: इयं वै गायत्र्य् अस्याम् एव प्रतिष्ठाय प्रयन्ति
text_mt: This [earth] is the gāyatrī; having established themselves on this very [earth], they go forth.

sanskrit_iast: triṣṭup pratipad bhavati
meaning: त्रिष्टुप् प्रतिपद् भवति
text_mt: The introductory verse is a triṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast: ojo vīryaṃ triṣṭubojasyeva vīrye parākramya prayanti
meaning: ओजो वीर्यं त्रिष्टुबोजस्येव वीर्ये पराक्रम्य प्रयन्ति
text_mt: The triṣṭubh is force and heroic strength; having exerted themselves, as it were, in force and heroic strength, they go forth.

sanskrit_iast: stotrīyas tṛco bhavati prāṇāpānānām avarudhyai
meaning: स्तोत्रीयस् तृचो भवति प्राणापानानाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: The chant of praise is a triplet, for the retention of out-breaths and in-breaths.

sanskrit_iast: harivatyo bhavanti chandomānām ayātayāmatāyai
meaning: हरिवत्यो भवन्ति छन्दोमानाम् अयातयामतायै
text_mt: There are [verses] containing the word 'hari' ('bay/golden'), so that the chandomas do not become exhausted.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśarcau bhavataḥ
meaning: द्वादशर्चौ भवतः

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsaram eva tatpūrvasmai ṣaḍahāya pratyudyacchati savīvadhatāyai
meaning: द्वादश मासाः संवत्सरः संवत्सरम् एव तत्पूर्वस्मै षडहाय प्रत्युद्यच्छति सवीवधतायै
text_mt: The year consists of twelve months. He raises up the year against the preceding six-day rite, to form a carrying pole.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśatir bhavanti caturviṃśatir ardhamāsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsaram eva tatpūrvasmai ṣaḍahāya pratyudyacchati savīvadhatāyai
meaning: चतुर्विंशतिर् भवन्ति चतुर्विंशतिर् अर्धमासाः संवत्सरः संवत्सरम् एव तत्पूर्वस्मै षडहाय प्रत्युद्यच्छति सवीवधतायै
text_mt: There are twenty-four [verses]; the year consists of twenty-four half-months. He raises up the year against the preceding six-day rite, to form a carrying pole.

sanskrit_iast: dṛta aindrota iti hovācābhipratārī kākṣasenir ye mahāvṛkṣasyāgraṃ gacchanti ka te tato bhavanti prarājan pakṣiṇaḥ patanty avāpakṣāḥ padyante
meaning: दृत ऐन्द्रोत इति होवाचाभिप्रतारी काक्षसेनिर् ये महावृक्षस्याग्रं गच्छन्ति क ते ततो भवन्ति प्रराजन् पक्षिणः पतन्त्य् अवापक्षाः पद्यन्ते
text_mt: Dṛta Aindrota—so said Abhipratārin Kākṣaseni—'Those who go to the top of a great tree, what becomes of them from there, O king? Birds fly off; the wingless fall down.'

sanskrit_iast: ye vai vidvāṃsas te pakṣiṇo ye 'vidvāṃsas te 'pakṣās trivṛt pañcadaśāv eva stomau pakṣau kṛtvā svarga lokaṃ prayanti
meaning: ये वै विद्वांसस् ते पक्षिणो ये ऽविद्वांसस् ते ऽपक्षास् त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशाव् एव स्तोमौ पक्षौ कृत्वा स्वर्ग लोकं प्रयन्ति
text_mt: Those who are wise are winged; those who are unwise are wingless. Having made the ninefold stoma and fifteenfold stoma their wings, they go forth to the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśa eva stomo bhavati teja se brahmavarcasāya
meaning: चतुर्विंश एव स्तोमो भवति तेज से ब्रह्मवर्चसाय
text_mt: The stoma is the twenty-four-fold [stoma], for splendour, for brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratim pṛthivyā ity āgreyam ājyaṃ bhavati
meaning: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिम् पृथिव्या इत्य् आग्रेयम् आज्यं भवति
text_mt: The ājyastotra addressed to Agni is [the triplet beginning]: "The head of heaven, the navel of the earth…"

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhā vā eṣa divo yas tṛtīyas trirātraḥ
meaning: मूर्धा वा एष दिवो यस् तृतीयस् त्रिरात्रः
text_mt: This head of heaven is the third three-day period.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaram ṛta ājātam agnim iti vaiśvānara iti vā agneḥ priyaṃ dhāma priyeṇaivainaṃ tad dhāmnā parokṣam upaśikṣati
meaning: वैश्वानरम् ऋत आजातम् अग्निम् इति वैश्वानर इति वा अग्नेः प्रियं धाम प्रियेणैवैनं तद् धाम्ना परोक्षम् उपशिक्षति
text_mt: "[Agni] Vaiśvānara, born of the cosmic order"—Vaiśvānara is indeed Agni’s dear domain; by means of his dear domain he thus serves him indirectly.

sanskrit_iast: pra vo mitrāya gāyata iti dyāvāpṛthivīyaṃ maitrāvaruṇaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī vai mitrāvaruṇayoḥ priyaṃ dhāma priyeṇaivainau tad dhāmnā parokṣam upaśikṣati
meaning: प्र वो मित्राय गायत इति द्यावापृथिवीयं मैत्रावरुणं द्यावापृथिवी वै मित्रावरुणयोः प्रियं धाम प्रियेणैवैनौ तद् धाम्ना परोक्षम् उपशिक्षति
text_mt: "Sing forth to Mitra [and Varuṇa]…"—this [is the triplet] addressed to Heaven and Earth, belonging to the Maitrāvaruṇa; Heaven and Earth are indeed the dear domain of Mitra and Varuṇa; by means of their dear domain he thus serves them indirectly.

sanskrit_iast: indrāyāhi citrabhānav ity ārbhavam aindram ṛbhavo vā indrasya priyaṃ dhāma priyeṇaivainaṃ tad dhāmnā parokṣam upaśikṣati
meaning: इन्द्रायाहि चित्रभानव् इत्य् आर्भवम् ऐन्द्रम् ऋभवो वा इन्द्रस्य प्रियं धाम प्रियेणैवैनं तद् धाम्ना परोक्षम् उपशिक्षति
text_mt: "Come, O Indra, of wondrous splendour…"—this [is the triplet] addressed to the Ṛbhus, belonging to Indra; the Ṛbhus are indeed Indra's dear domain; by means of his dear domain he thus serves him indirectly.

sanskrit_iast: tam īḍiṣva yo arciṣā ity aniruktam aindrāgnaṃ devatānām anabhidharṣāyottamārdhe 'nirāha devatānām apraṇāśāya stomaḥ
meaning: तम् ईडिष्व यो अर्चिषा इत्य् अनिरुक्तम् ऐन्द्राग्नं देवतानाम् अनभिधर्षायोत्तमार्धे ऽनिराह देवतानाम् अप्रणाशाय स्तोमः
text_mt: "Praise him who with flame…"—this [is the triplet] belonging to Indra and Agni, unexpressed, so as not to overpower the deities; in the latter half he does not express it, so that the deities may not be lost, [thus is] the stoma.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣā pavasva dhāraya iti gāyatrī bhavaty ahno dhṛtyai
meaning: वृषा पवस्व धारय इति गायत्री भवत्य् अह्नो धृत्यै
text_mt: "Flow as a bull with a stream…"—this is in the gāyatrī [metre], for the support of the day.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣaṇvatyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa traiṣṭubhaṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: वृषण्वत्यस् त्रिष्टुभो रूपेण त्रैष्टुभं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: [The verses] contain the word 'bull', in the form of the triṣṭubh; for this day belongs to the triṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast: punānaḥ soma dhāraya iti dhṛtyai
meaning: पुनानः सोम धारय इति धृत्यै
text_mt: "Purifying yourself, O Soma, with a stream…"—[this is] for support.

sanskrit_iast: pro ayāsīd indur indrasya niṣkṛtam iti pravatyo bhavanti praṇinīṣeṇyam iva hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: प्रो अयासीद् इन्दुर् इन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् इति प्रवत्यो भवन्ति प्रणिनीषेण्यम् इव ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: "The drop has gone forth to Indra's rendezvous"—these [verses] contain the word 'forth'; for this day is, as it were, to be led forth.

sanskrit_iast: jagatyaḥ satyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa tasmāt triṣṭubhāṃ loke kriyante
meaning: जगत्यः सत्यस् त्रिष्टुभो रूपेण तस्मात् त्रिष्टुभां लोके क्रियन्ते
text_mt: Being jagatīs, they are in the form of the triṣṭubh; therefore they are performed in the place of the triṣṭubhs.

sanskrit_iast: santani bhavati saptamasyāhnaḥ santatyai
meaning: सन्तनि भवति सप्तमस्याह्नः सन्तत्यै
text_mt: There is the Santani [sāman], for the continuity of the seventh day.

sanskrit_iast: yathā vai vyokasau vipradravata evam ete ṣaṣṭhaṃ cāhaḥ saptamaṃ ca vipradravatas tau yathā samānīya saṃyujyād evam evaite etena sāmnā saṃyunakti
meaning: यथा वै व्योकसौ विप्रद्रवत एवम् एते षष्ठं चाहः सप्तमं च विप्रद्रवतस् तौ यथा समानीय संयुज्याद् एवम् एवैते एतेन साम्ना संयुनक्ति
text_mt: Just as two creatures lacking a common home run apart, so these two, the sixth day and the seventh day, run apart; just as one would bring them together and yoke them, even so does he yoke these two with this sāman.

sanskrit_iast: yajño vai devebhyo 'pākrāmat sa suparṇarūpaṃ kṛtvācarat taṃ devā etaiḥ sāmabhirārabhanta yajña iva vā eṣa yac chandomā yajñasyaivaiṣa ārambhaḥ
meaning: यज्ञो वै देवेभ्यो ऽपाक्रामत् स सुपर्णरूपं कृत्वाचरत् तं देवा एतैः सामभिरारभन्त यज्ञ इव वा एष यच् छन्दोमा यज्ञस्यैवैष आरम्भः
text_mt: The sacrifice departed from the gods; having assumed the form of an eagle, it flew about. The gods seized it by means of these sāmans. The sacrifice, as it were, is what the Chandomas are; this is the very seizing of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: rohitakūlīyaṃ bhavaty ājijityāyai
meaning: रोहितकूलीयं भवत्य् आजिजित्यायै
text_mt: The Rohitakūlīya [sāman] is used, for winning the race.

sanskrit_iast: etena vai viśvāmitro rohitābhyāṃ rohitakūla ājim ajayat
meaning: एतेन वै विश्वामित्रो रोहिताभ्यां रोहितकूल आजिम् अजयत्
text_mt: By this [sāman] Viśvāmitra, with two red mares, won the race at Rohitakūla.

sanskrit_iast: viśvāmitro bharatānāṃ manassatyāyāt so 'dantibhir nāma janatayāṃśaṃ prāsyate māṃ māṃ yūyaṃ astikāṃ jayāthemāni mahyaṃ yūyaṃ pūrayātha yadīmāv idaṃ rohitāv aśmācitaṃ kūlam udvahāta iti sa ete sāmanī apaśyat tābhyāṃ yuktvā prāsedhat sa udjayat
meaning: विश्वामित्रो भरतानां मनस्सत्यायात् सो ऽदन्तिभिर् नाम जनतयांशं प्रास्यते मां मां यूयं अस्तिकां जयाथेमानि मह्यं यूयं पूरयाथ यदीमाव् इदं रोहिताव् अश्माचितं कूलम् उद्वहात इति स एते सामनी अपश्यत् ताभ्यां युक्त्वा प्रासेधत् स उद्जयत्
text_mt: Viśvāmitra went to the Bharatas for the fulfilment of a wish. He was about to cast lots with a people called the Adantis: "Do not conquer me! Fill these [stakes] for me, if these two red mares will carry [my chariot] up this bank heaped with stones!" He saw these two sāmans; having yoked [his chariot] with them, he drove on; he won.

sanskrit_iast: ājir vā eṣa pratato yad dvādaśāhas tasyaite ujjityai
meaning: आजिर् वा एष प्रततो यद् द्वादशाहस् तस्यैते उज्जित्यै
text_mt: This twelve-day rite is an extended race; these [sāmans] are for winning it.

sanskrit_iast: kaṇvarathantaraṃ bhavati tejo vā etad rathantarasya yat kaṇvarathantaram
meaning: कण्वरथन्तरं भवति तेजो वा एतद् रथन्तरस्य यत् कण्वरथन्तरम्
text_mt: The Kaṇvarathantara [sāman] is used; the Kaṇvarathantara is the splendour of the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: sarasam eva tad rathantaraṃ prayuṅkte yat kaṇvarathantareṇa saptame 'hani stuvate
meaning: सरसम् एव तद् रथन्तरं प्रयुङ्क्ते यत् कण्वरथन्तरेण सप्तमे ऽहनि स्तुवते
text_mt: Full of sap, indeed, he employs the Rathantara when they praise with the Kaṇvarathantara on the seventh day.

sanskrit_iast: jāmi dvādaśāhasyāstīti ha smāhogradevo rājanir bārhataṃ ṣaṣṭham ahar bārhataṃ saptamaṃ yat kaṇvarathantaraṃ bhavati tenājāmi
meaning: जामि द्वादशाहस्यास्तीति ह स्माहोग्रदेवो राजनिर् बार्हतं षष्ठम् अहर् बार्हतं सप्तमं यत् कण्वरथन्तरं भवति तेनाजामि
text_mt: "There is tautology in the twelve-day rite," Ugradeva Rājani used to say; "the sixth day is connected with the Bṛhat, the seventh day is connected with the Bṛhat. That there is the Kaṇvarathantara, thereby there is variation."

sanskrit_iast: gauṅgavaṃ bhavati
meaning: गौङ्गवं भवति

sanskrit_iast: agnir akāmayatānnādaḥ syām iti sa tapo 'tapyata sa etad gauṅgavam apaśyat tenānnādo 'bhavad yad annaṃ vitvā gardadyad agaṅgūyat tad gauṅgavasya gauṅgavatvam annādyasyāvarudhyai gauṅgavaṃ kiyate
meaning: अग्निर् अकामयतान्नादः स्याम् इति स तपो ऽतप्यत स एतद् गौङ्गवम् अपश्यत् तेनान्नादो ऽभवद् यद् अन्नं वित्वा गर्दद्यद् अगङ्गूयत् तद् गौङ्गवस्य गौङ्गवत्वम् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै गौङ्गवं कियते
text_mt: Agni desired: "May I be an eater of food." He performed ascetic heat; he saw this Gauṅgava; by it he became an eater of food. Because, having found food, he roared (agardat), because he gurgled (agaṅgūyat), that is the Gauṅgava-nature of the Gauṅgava. The Gauṅgava is performed for the acquisition of food.

sanskrit_iast: yat sāma devatā praśaṃyati tena yajamānāḥ satyāśiṣaḥ satyāśiṣo 'sāmeti vai sattram āsate satyāśiṣa eva bhavanti
meaning: यत् साम देवता प्रशंयति तेन यजमानाः सत्याशिषः सत्याशिषो ऽसामेति वै सत्त्रम् आसते सत्याशिष एव भवन्ति
text_mt: Because the deity praises the sāman, thereby the sacrificers have their wishes fulfilled. "May we have our wishes fulfilled," thus they sit at the sacrificial session; they truly have their wishes fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast: āyāsyaṃ bhavati tiraścīnanidhanaṃ pratiṣṭhāyai
meaning: आयास्यं भवति तिरश्चीननिधनं प्रतिष्ठायै
text_mt: The Āyāsya [sāman] is used, with a transverse cadence, for a firm foundation.

sanskrit_iast: ayāsyo vā āṅgirasa ādityānāṃ dīkṣitānām annam āśnāt sa vyabhraṃśata sa etāny āyāsyāny apaśyat tair ātmānaṃ samaśrīṇād vibhraṣṭam iva vai saptamam ahar yad etat sāma bhavaty ahar eva tena saṃśrīṇāti
meaning: अयास्यो वा आङ्गिरस आदित्यानां दीक्षितानाम् अन्नम् आश्नात् स व्यभ्रंशत स एतान्य् आयास्यान्य् अपश्यत् तैर् आत्मानं समश्रीणाद् विभ्रष्टम् इव वै सप्तमम् अहर् यद् एतत् साम भवत्य् अहर् एव तेन संश्रीणाति
text_mt: Ayāsya Āṅgirasa ate the food of the consecrated Ādityas; he fell away. He saw these Āyāsya [sāmans]; with them he restored himself. The seventh day is, as it were, fallen away; that this sāman is used, he thereby restores the day.

sanskrit_iast: pravadbhargavaṃ bhavati
meaning: प्रवद्भर्गवं भवति
text_mt: The Pravadbhārgava [sāman] is used.

sanskrit_iast: vayaṃ ghatvā sutāvanta iti bṛhatyo varṣīyaśchanda ākramate 'napabhraṃśāya
meaning: वयं घत्वा सुतावन्त इति बृहत्यो वर्षीयश्छन्द आक्रमते ऽनपभ्रंशाय
text_mt: "We [approach] you, who have the pressed juice…"—these are bṛhatīs; he mounts a higher metre, for avoiding a fall.

sanskrit_iast: nakiṣ ṭaṃ karmaṇā naśad iti bṛhatyaḥ satyo 'bhyārambheṇa jagatyaḥ
meaning: नकिष् टं कर्मणा नशद् इति बृहत्यः सत्यो ऽभ्यारम्भेण जगत्यः
text_mt: "No one shall attain it by work…"—these, being bṛhatīs, are jagatīs by repetition.

sanskrit_iast: apabhraṃśa iva vā eṣa yaj jyāyasaḥ stomāt kanīyāṃsaṃ stomam upayanti yad etā abhyārambheṇa jagatyo bhavanty ahna eva pratyuttambhāya
meaning: अपभ्रंश इव वा एष यज् ज्यायसः स्तोमात् कनीयांसं स्तोमम् उपयन्ति यद् एता अभ्यारम्भेण जगत्यो भवन्त्य् अह्न एव प्रत्युत्तम्भाय
text_mt: It is, as it were, a falling down when they go from a greater stoma to a lesser stoma; that these become jagatīs by repetition is for propping up the day.

sanskrit_iast: abhinidhanaṃ kāṇvaṃ bhavita
meaning: अभिनिधनं काण्वं भवित
text_mt: The Abhinidhana Kāṇva [sāman] is used.

sanskrit_iast: abhinidhanena vā indro vṛtrāya vajraṃ prāharat tam astṛṇuta stṛṇute bhrātṛvyam abhinidhanena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: अभिनिधनेन वा इन्द्रो वृत्राय वज्रं प्राहरत् तम् अस्तृणुत स्तृणुते भ्रातृव्यम् अभिनिधनेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: With the Abhinidhana Indra hurled the thunderbolt at Vṛtra; he laid him low. He who has praised with the Abhinidhana lays low his rival.

sanskrit_iast: vaikhānasā vā ṛṣaya indrasya priyā āsaṃs tān rahasyur devamalimluḍ munimaraṇe 'mārayat taṃ devā abruvan kva tarṣayo 'bhūvānn iti tān praiṣam aicchat tān nāvindat sa imān lokān ekadhāreṇāpunāt tān munimaraṇe 'vindat tān etena sāmnā samairayat tad vāva sa tarhy akāmayata kāmasani sāma vaikhānasaṃ kāmam evaitenāvarundhe stomaḥ
meaning: वैखानसा वा ऋषय इन्द्रस्य प्रिया आसंस् तान् रहस्युर् देवमलिम्लुड् मुनिमरणे ऽमारयत् तं देवा अब्रुवन् क्व तर्षयो ऽभूवान्न् इति तान् प्रैषम् ऐच्छत् तान् नाविन्दत् स इमान् लोकान् एकधारेणापुनात् तान् मुनिमरणे ऽविन्दत् तान् एतेन साम्ना समैरयत् तद् वाव स तर्ह्य् अकामयत कामसनि साम वैखानसं कामम् एवैतेनावरुन्धे स्तोमः
text_mt: The Vaikhānasa seers were dear to Indra. Rahasyu Devamalimluc killed them at Munimaraṇa. The gods said to him: "Where have the seers gone?" He sought them out; he did not find them. He purified these worlds with a single stream; he found them at Munimaraṇa. He revived them with this sāman. That is what he then desired. The Vaikhānasa is a wish-granting sāman; he secures his wish by it; [such is] the stoma.

sanskrit_iast: yas te mado vareṇya iti gāyatrī bhavati madavad vai rasavat tṛtīyasavanaṃ madam eva tad rasaṃ dadhāti
meaning: यस् ते मदो वरेण्य इति गायत्री भवति मदवद् वै रसवत् तृतीयसवनं मदम् एव तद् रसं दधाति
text_mt: "That exhilarating draught of yours which is the best…"—this is in the gāyatrī [metre]; exhilarating, full of sap is the third pressing; he thus puts exhilarating sap into it.

sanskrit_iast: eṣasya dhārayā suta iti kakubhaḥ satyo 'bhyārambheṇa triṣṭubhaḥ
meaning: एषस्य धारया सुत इति ककुभः सत्यो ऽभ्यारम्भेण त्रिष्टुभः
text_mt: "This [Soma] pressed in a stream…"—these, being kakubhs, are triṣṭubhs by repetition.

sanskrit_iast: apabhraṃśa iva vā eṣa yat jyāyasaḥ stomāt kanīyāṃsaṃ stomam upayanti yad etā abhyārambheṇa triṣṭubho bhavanty ahna eva pratyuttambhāya
meaning: अपभ्रंश इव वा एष यत् ज्यायसः स्तोमात् कनीयांसं स्तोमम् उपयन्ति यद् एता अभ्यारम्भेण त्रिष्टुभो भवन्त्य् अह्न एव प्रत्युत्तम्भाय
text_mt: It is, as it were, a falling down when they go from a greater stoma to a lesser stoma; that these become triṣṭubhs by repetition is for propping up the day.

sanskrit_iast: sakhāya āniṣīdata iti vālakhilyā vālakhilyāv etau tṛcau ṣaṣṭhe cāhani saptame ca yad etau vākhilyau tṛcau bhavato 'hnor eva vyatiṣaṅgāyāvyavasraṃsāya santatyai
meaning: सखाय आनिषीदत इति वालखिल्या वालखिल्याव् एतौ तृचौ षष्ठे चाहनि सप्तमे च यद् एतौ वाखिल्यौ तृचौ भवतो ऽह्नोर् एव व्यतिषङ्गायाव्यवस्रंसाय सन्तत्यै
text_mt: "O friends, sit down…"—these are the Vālakhilyā [verses]; these two triplets on the sixth day and on the seventh day are Vālakhilyās; that these two triplets are Vālakhilyās is for the interlinking of the two days, for avoiding slipping down, for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: purojitī vo andhasa iti virāḍ annaṃ virāḍ annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: पुरोजिती वो अन्धस इति विराड् अन्नं विराड् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: "Conquering in the beginning, for your drink…"—this is the virāj; the virāj is food; [it is] for the acquisition of food.

sanskrit_iast: pra vājy akṣār ity akṣarapaṅktiḥ stomānāṃ prabhūtiḥ
meaning: प्र वाज्य् अक्षार् इत्य् अक्षरपङ्क्तिः स्तोमानां प्रभूतिः
text_mt: "Forth flowed the courser…"—this is the akṣarapaṅkti, the abundance of the stomas.

sanskrit_iast: atho etad dhy evaitarhi chando 'yātayāma yad akṣarapaṅktis tena chandomā ayātayāmānaḥ kriyante
meaning: अथो एतद् ध्य् एवैतर्हि छन्दो ऽयातयाम यद् अक्षरपङ्क्तिस् तेन छन्दोमा अयातयामानः क्रियन्ते
text_mt: Moreover, this metre, the akṣarapaṅkti, is unexhausted at this point; thereby the Chandomas are made unexhausted.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti yat ṣaḍahe stomāś chandāṃsy āpyante kiṃ chandasaś chandomā ity etac chandaso yad etā akṣarapaṅktaya iti brūyāt
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति यत् षडहे स्तोमाश् छन्दांस्य् आप्यन्ते किं छन्दसश् छन्दोमा इत्य् एतच् छन्दसो यद् एता अक्षरपङ्क्तय इति ब्रूयात्
text_mt: The theologians say: "Since the stomas and the metres are exhausted in the six-day period, of what metre are the Chandomas?" One should say: "Of this metre, that they are these akṣarapaṅktis."

sanskrit_iast: ye somāsaḥ parāvati iti parāvatam iva vā etarhi yajño gatas tam evaitenānvicchanti
meaning: ये सोमासः परावति इति परावतम् इव वा एतर्हि यज्ञो गतस् तम् एवैतेनान्विच्छन्ति
text_mt: "The Somas that are far away…"—the sacrifice, as it were, has gone far away at this point; it is that which they seek after with this.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣaṇidhanaṃ bhavati
meaning: दक्षणिधनं भवति
text_mt: The Dakṣanidhana [sāman] is used.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tā asmāt sṛṣṭā abalā ivācchadayaṃs tāsv etena sāmnā dakṣāyety ojo vīryam adadhād yad etat sāma bhavaty oja eva vīryam ātman dhatte
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत ता अस्मात् सृष्टा अबला इवाच्छदयंस् तास्व् एतेन साम्ना दक्षायेत्य् ओजो वीर्यम् अदधाद् यद् एतत् साम भवत्य् ओज एव वीर्यम् आत्मन् धत्ते
text_mt: Prajāpati created creatures; created from him, they seemed weak. Into them, with this sāman, [saying] "For strength (dakṣāya)", he placed vigour and valour. That this sāman is used, he places vigour and valour in himself.

sanskrit_iast: śārkaraṃ bhavati
meaning: शार्करं भवति

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāny astuvan sa śarkaraṃ śiśumārarṣim upetyābravīt stuhi meti so 'paḥ praskandann abravīd etāvato 'haṃ tvāṃ stuyām iti tasmād apāṃ vegam avejayat sa hīna ivāmanyata sa etat sāmāpaśyat tenāpo 'nusamāśnuta tad vāva sa tarhy akāmayata kāmasani sāma śārkaraṃ kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
meaning: इन्द्रं सर्वाणि भूतान्य् अस्तुवन् स शर्करं शिशुमारर्षिम् उपेत्याब्रवीत् स्तुहि मेति सो ऽपः प्रस्कन्दन्न् अब्रवीद् एतावतो ऽहं त्वां स्तुयाम् इति तस्माद् अपां वेगम् अवेजयत् स हीन इवामन्यत स एतत् सामापश्यत् तेनापो ऽनुसमाश्नुत तद् वाव स तर्ह्य् अकामयत कामसनि साम शार्करं कामम् एवैतेनावरुन्धे
text_mt: All beings praised Indra. He approached Śarkara, the dolphin-seer, and said, 'Praise me.' Leaping into the waters, he said, 'From as much [water as this] may I praise you.' Therefore he shook the rush of the waters. He considered himself as though left behind. He saw this sāman; by it he pervaded the waters. Truly that was what he desired at that time. The Śārkara sāman is wish-granting; he obtains [his] desire by it.

sanskrit_iast: plavo bhavati
meaning: प्लवो भवति

sanskrit_iast: samudraṃ vā ete prasnāntīty āhur ye dvādaśāham upayantīti yo vā aplavaḥ samudraṃ prarunāti na sa tata udeti yata plavo bhavati svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
meaning: समुद्रं वा एते प्रस्नान्तीत्य् आहुर् ये द्वादशाहम् उपयन्तीति यो वा अप्लवः समुद्रं प्ररुनाति न स तत उदेति यत प्लवो भवति स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
text_mt: They say: 'Those who undertake the twelve-day rite bathe across the ocean.' He who crosses the ocean without a boat (plava) does not emerge from it. That there is the Plava is for attaining the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: ativiśvāni duritā taremeti yad evaiṣāṃ duṣṭutaṃ duśśastaṃ tad etena taranti
meaning: अतिविश्वानि दुरिता तरेमेति यद् एवैषां दुष्टुतं दुश्शस्तं तद् एतेन तरन्ति
text_mt: 'May we cross over all misfortunes'—whatever has been ill-chanted or ill-recited by them, that they cross over by this.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśākṣaraṇidhano bhavaty ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭub ojīvīryaṃ triṣṭub ojasy eva vīrye pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: एकादशाक्षरणिधनो भवत्य् एकादशाक्षरा त्रिष्टुब् ओजीवीर्यं त्रिष्टुब् ओजस्य् एव वीर्ये प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: It has an eleven-syllable cadence. The triṣṭubh has eleven syllables; the triṣṭubh is vigour and virility. He firmly establishes himself in vigour and virility.

sanskrit_iast: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati yad eva gaurīvitasya brahmaṇam
meaning: गौरीवितं भवति यद् एव गौरीवितस्य ब्रह्मणम्
text_mt: There is the Gaurīvita; whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the Gaurīvita [applies here].

sanskrit_iast: kārtayaśaṃ bhavati
meaning: कार्तयशं भवति

sanskrit_iast: hīti nidhanam upayanti pāpmano 'pahatyai
meaning: हीति निधनम् उपयन्ति पाप्मनो ऽपहत्यै
text_mt: They undertake the cadence 'hī' for the destruction of evil.

sanskrit_iast: apa pāpmānaṃ hate kārtayaśena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: अप पाप्मानं हते कार्तयशेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: He who has praised with the Kārtayaśa smites away evil.

sanskrit_iast: sāhaiviṣaṃ bhavati
meaning: साहैविषं भवति

sanskrit_iast: suhavir vā etenāṅgiraso 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: सुहविर् वा एतेनाङ्गिरसो ऽञ्जसा स्वर्गं लोकम् अपश्यत् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Suhavis Āṅgirasa indeed directly saw the heavenly world by this. It is for the beholding of the heavenly world. He who has praised [with it] does not fall from the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: brahmāvādino vadanti yat ṣaḍahe stomāś chandāṃsy āpyante kiṃ chandasaś chandomā iti puruṣaś chandasa iti brūyāt puruṣo vai pāṅktaḥ puruṣo dvipadā chandomānām ayātayāmatāyai
meaning: ब्रह्मावादिनो वदन्ति यत् षडहे स्तोमाश् छन्दांस्य् आप्यन्ते किं छन्दसश् छन्दोमा इति पुरुषश् छन्दस इति ब्रूयात् पुरुषो वै पाङ्क्तः पुरुषो द्विपदा छन्दोमानाम् अयातयामतायै
text_mt: The theologians say: 'Since the stomas and metres are exhausted in the six-day period, what metre do the Chandomas have?' One should say: 'Man is their metre.' Man indeed is fivefold; man is two-footed. [This is] for the non-exhaustion of the Chandomas.

sanskrit_iast: jarābodhīyaṃ bhavaty annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: जराबोधीयं भवत्य् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: There is the Jarābodhīya, for the acquisition of food.

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ vai jarābodhīyaṃ mukhaṃ gāyatrī mukha eva tad annaṃ dhatte 'nnam atti
meaning: अन्नं वै जराबोधीयं मुखं गायत्री मुख एव तद् अन्नं धत्ते ऽन्नम् अत्ति
text_mt: Food indeed is the Jarābodhīya; the mouth is the gāyatrī. He places food right in the mouth; he eats food.

sanskrit_iast: annādo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: अन्नादो भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He who knows this becomes an eater of food.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṣu stuvanti pratiṣṭhāyai brahmavarcasāya yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti
meaning: गायत्रीषु स्तुवन्ति प्रतिष्ठायै ब्रह्मवर्चसाय येनैव प्राणेन प्रयन्ति तम् अभ्युद्यन्ति
text_mt: They praise on gāyatrī verses for firm support, for brahminical lustre. With whichever breath they go forth, to that they rise up.

sanskrit_iast: iḍāntāḥ pāvamānā bhavanti paśavo vā iḍāḥ paśavaś chandomāḥ paśuṣv eva tat paśūn dadhāti stomaḥ
meaning: इडान्ताः पावमाना भवन्ति पशवो वा इडाः पशवश् छन्दोमाः पशुष्व् एव तत् पशून् दधाति स्तोमः
text_mt: The Pavamāna chants end with Iḍā. Cattle are Iḍā; cattle are the Chandomas. Thereby the stoma places cattle in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ā te vatso mano yamad ity apacchid iva vā etad yajñakāṇḍaṃ yad ukthāni yad eti salomatvāyaiva
meaning: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमद् इत्य् अपच्छिद् इव वा एतद् यज्ञकाण्डं यद् उक्थानि यद् एति सलोमत्वायैव
text_mt: 'Let the calf hold fast your mind'—this uktha-section of the sacrifice is, as it were, cut off. That he goes [to it] is for smoothness.

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ na indrābhara iti pūrṇāḥ kakubhaḥ
meaning: त्वं न इन्द्राभर इति पूर्णाः ककुभः
text_mt: 'Bring to us, O Indra'—[these are] complete kakubh verses.

sanskrit_iast: apabhraṃśa iva vā eṣa yaj jayāyasaḥ stomāt kanīyāṃsaṃ stomam upayanti yad etāḥ pūrṇāḥ kakubho bhavanty anapabhraṃśāya
meaning: अपभ्रंश इव वा एष यज् जयायसः स्तोमात् कनीयांसं स्तोमम् उपयन्ति यद् एताः पूर्णाः ककुभो भवन्त्य् अनपभ्रंशाय
text_mt: It is like a falling off when they go from a greater stoma to a lesser stoma. That these are complete kakubh verses is to avoid falling off.

sanskrit_iast: vatsaś ca vai medhātithiś ca kāṇvāv āstāṃ taṃ vatsaṃ medhātithir ākrośad abrāhmaṇo 'si śūdrāputra iti so 'bravīd ṛtenāgniṃ vyayāva yataro nau brahmīyān iti vātsena vatso vyain maidhātithena medhātithis tasya na loma ca nauṣat tad vāva sa tarhy akāmayata kāmasani sāma vātsaṃ kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
meaning: वत्सश् च वै मेधातिथिश् च काण्वाव् आस्तां तं वत्सं मेधातिथिर् आक्रोशद् अब्राह्मणो ऽसि शूद्रापुत्र इति सो ऽब्रवीद् ऋतेनाग्निं व्ययाव यतरो नौ ब्रह्मीयान् इति वात्सेन वत्सो व्यैन् मैधातिथेन मेधातिथिस् तस्य न लोम च नौषत् तद् वाव स तर्ह्य् अकामयत कामसनि साम वात्सं कामम् एवैतेनावरुन्धे
text_mt: Vatsa and Medhātithi were two Kāṇva descendants. Medhātithi reviled Vatsa: 'You are a non-brahmin, the son of a Śūdrā.' He said: 'Let us two walk through fire with truth, [to see] which of us is the better brahmin.' Vatsa walked through with the Vātsa, Medhātithi with the Maidhātitha. Not a single hair of his was scorched. Truly that was what he desired at that time. The Vātsa sāman is wish-granting; he obtains [his] desire by it.

sanskrit_iast: sauśravasaṃ bhavati
meaning: सौश्रवसं भवति

sanskrit_iast: upagur vai sauśravasaḥ kutsasyauravasya purohita āsīt sa kutsaḥ paryaśapad ya indraṃ yajātā iti sa indraḥ suśravasam upetyābravīd yajasva māśanāyāmivā iti tam ayajata sa indraḥ puroḍāśas taḥ kutsam upetyābravīd ayakṣata mā kva te pariśaptam abhūd iti kas tvā yaṣṭeti suśravā iti sa kutsa aurava upāgāḥ sauśravasasyodgāyata audumbaryā śiro 'cchinat sa śuśravā indram abravīt tvattanād vai medam īdṛg upāgād iti tam etena sāmnā samairayat tad vāva sa tarhy akāmayata kāmasani sāma sauśravasaṃ kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
meaning: उपगुर् वै सौश्रवसः कुत्सस्यौरवस्य पुरोहित आसीत् स कुत्सः पर्यशपद् य इन्द्रं यजाता इति स इन्द्रः सुश्रवसम् उपेत्याब्रवीद् यजस्व माशनायामिवा इति तम् अयजत स इन्द्रः पुरोडाशस् तः कुत्सम् उपेत्याब्रवीद् अयक्षत मा क्व ते परिशप्तम् अभूद् इति कस् त्वा यष्टेति सुश्रवा इति स कुत्स औरव उपागाः सौश्रवसस्योद्गायत औदुम्बर्या शिरो ऽच्छिनत् स शुश्रवा इन्द्रम् अब्रवीत् त्वत्तनाद् वै मेदम् ईदृग् उपागाद् इति तम् एतेन साम्ना समैरयत् तद् वाव स तर्ह्य् अकामयत कामसनि साम सौश्रवसं कामम् एवैतेनावरुन्धे
text_mt: Upagu Sauśravasa was the domestic priest of Kutsa Aurava. Kutsa cursed: 'Whoever shall sacrifice to Indra [shall be cursed].' Indra approached Suśravas and said: 'Sacrifice to me, [I am] afflicted by hunger.' He sacrificed to him. Indra, holding the sacrificial cake, approached Kutsa and said: '[He] has sacrificed to me; where is your curse gone?' 'Who sacrificed to you?' 'Suśravas.' Kutsa Aurava cut off the head of Upagu Sauśravasa, who was chanting, with an audumbarī pole. Suśravas said to Indra: 'Through your cause this has come upon me.' He restored him with this sāman. Truly that was what he desired at that time. The Sauśravasa sāman is wish-granting; he obtains [his] desire by it.

sanskrit_iast: vīṅkaṃ bhavati
meaning: वीङ्कं भवति

sanskrit_iast: cyavano vai dādhīco 'śvinoḥ priya āsīt so 'jīryat tam etena sāmnāpsu vyaiṅkayatāṃ taṃ punaryuvānam akurutāṃ tad vāva tau tarhy akāmayetāṃ kāmasani sāma vīṅkaṃ kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
meaning: च्यवनो वै दाधीचो ऽश्विनोः प्रिय आसीत् सो ऽजीर्यत् तम् एतेन साम्नाप्सु व्यैङ्कयतां तं पुनर्युवानम् अकुरुतां तद् वाव तौ तर्ह्य् अकामयेतां कामसनि साम वीङ्कं कामम् एवैतेनावरुन्धे
text_mt: Cyavana Dādhīca was dear to the Aśvins. He grew old. With this sāman they swung him in the waters; they made him young again. Truly that was what the two desired at that time. The Vīṅka sāman is wish-granting; he obtains [his] desire by it.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśa eva stomo bhavati tejase brahmavarcasāya
meaning: चतुर्विंश एव स्तोमो भवति तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसाय
text_mt: The stoma is the twenty-four-fold alone, for fiery energy, for brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: śiśuṃ jajñānaṃ haryataṃ mṛjanti ity aṣṭam asy āhnaḥ pratid bhavati
meaning: शिशुं जज्ञानं हर्यतं मृजन्ति इत्य् अष्टम् अस्य् आह्नः प्रतिद् भवति
text_mt: 'They cleanse the newborn, lovely babe' is the introductory verse of the eighth day.

sanskrit_iast: śiśur iva vā eṣa saptamenāhnā jāyate tam aṣṭamenāhnā mṛjanti
meaning: शिशुर् इव वा एष सप्तमेनाह्ना जायते तम् अष्टमेनाह्ना मृजन्ति
text_mt: Like a newborn babe he is born on the seventh day; they cleanse him on the eighth day.

sanskrit_iast: stotrīyas tṛco bhavati prāṇāpānānām avarudhyai
meaning: स्तोत्रीयस् तृचो भवति प्राणापानानाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: There is a chant-triplet, for the retention of out-breath and in-breath.

sanskrit_iast: harivatyo bhavanti chandomānām ayātayāmatāyai
meaning: हरिवत्यो भवन्ति छन्दोमानाम् अयातयामतायै
text_mt: They contain the word 'hari', for the non-exhaustion of the Chandomas.

sanskrit_iast: navarcā bhavanti
meaning: नवर्चा भवन्ति

sanskrit_iast: pañcarco bhavati pañcapadā paṅktiḥ pāṅktam annam annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: पञ्चर्चो भवति पञ्चपदा पङ्क्तिः पाङ्क्तम् अन्नम् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: There is a five-verse hymn. The paṅkti has five verses; food is fivefold, for the acquisition of food.

sanskrit_iast: bāṇavān bhavaty anto vai bāṇo 'nta etad aṣṭamam ahnām anta eva tad antena stuvate pratiṣṭhāyai
meaning: बाणवान् भवत्य् अन्तो वै बाणो ऽन्त एतद् अष्टमम् अह्नाम् अन्त एव तद् अन्तेन स्तुवते प्रतिष्ठायै
text_mt: There is [the hymn] with the bāṇa; the end indeed is the bāṇa. The eighth of the days is the end. They praise with the end at the end, for firm support.

sanskrit_iast: trayas tṛcā bhavanti prāṇāpānānāṃ santatyai
meaning: त्रयस् तृचा भवन्ति प्राणापानानां सन्तत्यै
text_mt: There are three triplets, for the continuity of out-breath and in-breath.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ vo devam agnibhiḥ sajoṣā ity āgneyam ājyaṃ bhavati
meaning: अग्निं वो देवम् अग्निभिः सजोषा इत्य् आग्नेयम् आज्यं भवति
text_mt: 'Your god Agni with the fires, in concord' is the ājyastotra to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: agnibhir ity eva pūrvāṇy ahāni abhi samiddhāny aṣṭamam ahar abhisamindhe
meaning: अग्निभिर् इत्य् एव पूर्वाण्य् अहानि अभि समिद्धान्य् अष्टमम् अहर् अभिसमिन्धे
text_mt: By 'with the fires', having kindled the previous days, he kindles the eighth day.

sanskrit_iast: mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmaha iti bārhataṃ maitrāvaruṇam
meaning: मित्रं वयं हवामह इति बार्हतं मैत्रावरुणम्
text_mt: 'Mitra we invoke' is the Maitrāvaruṇa chant in the bṛhatī metre.

sanskrit_iast: ugragādham iva vā etac chandomās tad yathāta ugragādhe vyātiṣajya gāhanta evam evaitad rūpe vyatiṣajati chandomānām asaṃvyāthāya
meaning: उग्रगाधम् इव वा एतच् छन्दोमास् तद् यथात उग्रगाधे व्यातिषज्य गाहन्त एवम् एवैतद् रूपे व्यतिषजति छन्दोमानाम् असंव्याथाय
text_mt: The Chandomas are indeed like a strong ford. Just as they plunge into a strong ford by crossing over [intertwined], so he intertwines in form, for the unsteadiness of the Chandomas [to be averted].

sanskrit_iast: tam indraṃ vājayāmasi ity aindram
meaning: तम् इन्द्रं वाजयामसि इत्य् ऐन्द्रम्
text_mt: 'We make that Indra strong' is [the ājyastotra] to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭamena vai devā ahnendram avājayan navamena pāpmānam aghnann ahar evaitena vājayanti
meaning: अष्टमेन वै देवा अह्नेन्द्रम् अवाजयन् नवमेन पाप्मानम् अघ्नन्न् अहर् एवैतेन वाजयन्ति
text_mt: By the eighth day the gods invigorated Indra; by the ninth they slew evil. By this they invigorate the day.

sanskrit_iast: indre agnā namo bṛhad iti bārhatam aindrāgnam
meaning: इन्द्रे अग्ना नमो बृहद् इति बार्हतम् ऐन्द्राग्नम्
text_mt: 'To Indra and Agni great homage' is the Aindrāgna chant in the bṛhatī metre.

sanskrit_iast: ugragādham iva vā etad yac chandomās tad yathāta ugragādhe vyatiṣajya gāhanta evam evaitad rape vyatiṣajati chandomānām asaṃvyāthāya stomaḥ
meaning: उग्रगाधम् इव वा एतद् यच् छन्दोमास् तद् यथात उग्रगाधे व्यतिषज्य गाहन्त एवम् एवैतद् रपे व्यतिषजति छन्दोमानाम् असंव्याथाय स्तोमः
text_mt: The Chandomas are indeed like a strong ford. Just as they plunge into a strong ford by crossing over [intertwined], so the stoma intertwines in form, for the unsteadiness of the Chandomas [to be averted].

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutam iti gāyatrī bhavaty ahno dhṛtyai
meaning: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतम् इति गायत्री भवत्य् अह्नो धृत्यै
text_mt: 'O Adhvaryu, [the soma] pressed with stones' is in the gāyatrī metre, for the holding fast of the day.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatryaḥ satyas triṣṭubhorūpeṇa traiṣṭubhaṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: गायत्र्यः सत्यस् त्रिष्टुभोरूपेण त्रैष्टुभं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: Being gāyatrī verses, [they are recited] in the manner of triṣṭubh verses, for this day belongs to the triṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast: abhi somāsa āyava ity abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ bṛhad iti bṛhata ubhayoḥ saha rūpam upaity ubhau hi varṇāv etad ahaḥ
meaning: अभि सोमास आयव इत्य् अभीति रथन्तरस्य रूपं बृहद् इति बृहत उभयोः सह रूपम् उपैत्य् उभौ हि वर्णाव् एतद् अहः
text_mt: 'Unto the Soma juices, the active ones'—'unto' is the form of the Rathantara; 'great' is that of the Bṛhat. He assumes the form of both together, for both colours belong to this day.

sanskrit_iast: dhartā divaḥ pavate kṛtvyo rasa ity adhṛta iva vā eṣas tryaho yad dharteti dhṛtyā eva
meaning: धर्ता दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रस इत्य् अधृत इव वा एषस् त्र्यहो यद् धर्तेति धृत्या एव
text_mt: 'The upholder of heaven purifies himself, the active sap'—unsupported, as it were, is this three-day period; because it says 'upholder', it is for holding fast.

sanskrit_iast: jagatyas satyas triṣṭubho rūpeṇa tasmāt triṣṭubho loke kriyante
meaning: जगत्यस् सत्यस् त्रिष्टुभो रूपेण तस्मात् त्रिष्टुभो लोके क्रियन्ते
text_mt: Being jagatī verses, [they are recited] in the manner of triṣṭubh verses; therefore they are performed in the place of the triṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गायत्रं भवति यद् एव गायत्रस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: There is the Gāyatra; whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the Gāyatra [applies here].

sanskrit_iast: vairūpaṃ bhavati
meaning: वैरूपं भवति

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai vairūpaṃ paśūnām avarudhyai virūpaḥ saṃvatsaro virūpam annam annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: पशवो वै वैरूपं पशूनाम् अवरुध्यै विरूपः संवत्सरो विरूपम् अन्नम् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: The Vairūpa is cattle, for the acquisition of cattle. Diverse is the year; diverse is food, for the acquisition of food.

sanskrit_iast: āśu bhārgavaṃ bhavati
meaning: आशु भार्गवं भवति

sanskrit_iast: ahar vā etad avlīyata tad devā āśunābhyadhinvaṃs tad āśor āśutvam
meaning: अहर् वा एतद् अव्लीयत तद् देवा आशुनाभ्यधिन्वंस् तद् आशोर् आशुत्वम्
text_mt: This day was collapsing; the gods refreshed it with the swift (āśu) [sāman]; that is the swiftness of the Āśu.

sanskrit_iast: mārgīyavaṃ bhavati
meaning: मार्गीयवं भवति

sanskrit_iast: devaṃ vā etaṃ mṛgayur iti vadanty etena vai sa ubhayeṣāṃ paśūnām ādhipatyam āśnutobhayeṣāṃ paśūnām ādhipatyam aśnute mārgīyaveṇa tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: देवं वा एतं मृगयुर् इति वदन्त्य् एतेन वै स उभयेषां पशूनाम् आधिपत्यम् आश्नुतोभयेषां पशूनाम् आधिपत्यम् अश्नुते मार्गीयवेण तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: They speak of this god as the hunter. By this [sāman] he indeed attained lordship over both kinds of cattle; he who has praised with the Mārgīyava attains lordship over both kinds of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: saumitraṃ bhavati
meaning: सौमित्रं भवति

sanskrit_iast: yad eva saumitrasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: यद् एव सौमित्रस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: Whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the Saumitra [applies here].

sanskrit_iast: aiṭataṃ bhavati
meaning: ऐटतं भवति

sanskrit_iast: iṭan vā etena kāvyo 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: इटन् वा एतेन काव्यो ऽञ्जसा स्वर्गं लोकम् अपश्यत् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: By this, indeed, Iṭan Kāvya directly saw the heavenly world; it is for the sighting of the heavenly world. He who has praised [with it] does not fall from the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: sākamaśvaṃ bhavati yad eva sākamaśvasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: साकमश्वं भवति यद् एव साकमश्वस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: There is the Sākamaśva [sāman]; whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the Sākamaśva [applies here].

sanskrit_iast: tad u dhurāṃ sāmety āhuḥ prāṇā vai dhuraḥ prāṇānām avarudhyai
meaning: तद् उ धुरां सामेत्य् आहुः प्राणा वै धुरः प्राणानाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: And they say: 'It is the sāman of the yokes.' The vital breaths indeed are the yokes, [it serves] for the securing of the vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast: vilambasauparṇaṃ bhavati
meaning: विलम्बसौपर्णं भवति
text_mt: There is the Vilambasauparṇa [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: ātmā vā eṣa sauparṇānāṃ yad aṣṭame 'hani pakṣāv etāv abhito bhavato ye saptamanavamayor vīva vā antarātmā pakṣau lambate yadantarātmā pakṣau vilambate tasmād vilambasauparṇam
meaning: आत्मा वा एष सौपर्णानां यद् अष्टमे ऽहनि पक्षाव् एताव् अभितो भवतो ये सप्तमनवमयोर् वीव वा अन्तरात्मा पक्षौ लम्बते यदन्तरात्मा पक्षौ विलम्बते तस्माद् विलम्बसौपर्णम्
text_mt: This is indeed the trunk of the Sauparṇa [chants], that which is on the eighth day; these two wings on both sides are those which belong to the seventh and ninth [days]. The trunk hangs down, as it were, between the two wings; because the trunk hangs down between the two wings, therefore it is called Vilambasauparṇa.

sanskrit_iast: svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai sauparṇaṃ kriyate
meaning: स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै सौपर्णं क्रियते
text_mt: For the attainment of the heavenly world the Sauparṇa is performed.

sanskrit_iast: dvitīyaṃ hy etad rūpaṃ yac chandomāḥ
meaning: द्वितीयं ह्य् एतद् रूपं यच् छन्दोमाः
text_mt: For this is a second form, namely the Chandomas.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai vāmadevyaṃ paśavaś chandomāḥ paśuṣv eva tat paśūn saṃdadhāti
meaning: पशवो वै वामदेव्यं पशवश् छन्दोमाः पशुष्व् एव तत् पशून् संदधाति
text_mt: The Vāmadevya indeed is cattle; the Chandomas are cattle; thereby he firmly places cattle among cattle.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrapārśvaṃ bhavati
meaning: गायत्रपार्श्वं भवति
text_mt: There is the Gāyatrapārśva [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: ahar vā etad avlīyata tad devā gāyatrapārśvena samatanvaṃs tasmād gāyatrapārśvam
meaning: अहर् वा एतद् अव्लीयत तद् देवा गायत्रपार्श्वेन समतन्वंस् तस्माद् गायत्रपार्श्वम्
text_mt: This day was indeed collapsing; the gods braced it with the Gāyatrapārśva; therefore it is called Gāyatrapārśva.

sanskrit_iast: trirātro yad vyaśīryata tam etaiḥ sāmabhir abhiṣajyan gāyatrapārśvenopāyacchan santaninā samatanvan saṃkṛtinā samaskurvan pratiṣṭhitau pūrvau trirātrāv apratiṣṭhita eṣa yad etāny eva sāmāni kriyanta etasyaiva pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: त्रिरात्रो यद् व्यशीर्यत तम् एतैः सामभिर् अभिषज्यन् गायत्रपार्श्वेनोपायच्छन् सन्तनिना समतन्वन् संकृतिना समस्कुर्वन् प्रतिष्ठितौ पूर्वौ त्रिरात्राव् अप्रतिष्ठित एष यद् एतान्य् एव सामानि क्रियन्त एतस्यैव प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: When the three-day period crumbled, they healed it with these sāmans: with the Gāyatrapārśva they supported it, with the Santani they stretched it, with the Saṃkṛti they put it in order. Firmly established were the two previous three-day periods; unestablished was this one. That these very sāmans are performed is solely for the establishing of this [period].

sanskrit_iast: pauruhanmanaṃ bhavati
meaning: पौरुहन्मनं भवति
text_mt: There is the Pauruhanmana [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: puruhanmā vā etena vaikhānaso 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyai svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: पुरुहन्मा वा एतेन वैखानसो ऽञ्जसा स्वर्गं लोकम् अपश्यत् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: By this, indeed, Puruhanman Vaikhānasa directly saw the heavenly world; it is for the sighting of the heavenly world. He who has praised [with it] does not fall from the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāghātyaṃ bhavaty abhyāghātyasāmāno hi chandomāḥ
meaning: अभ्याघात्यं भवत्य् अभ्याघात्यसामानो हि छन्दोमाः
text_mt: There is the Abhyāghātya [sāman], for the Chandomas have sāmans that are struck upon.

sanskrit_iast: dvaigataṃ bhavati
meaning: द्वैगतं भवति

sanskrit_iast: dvigad vā etena bhārgavo dviḥ svargaṃ lokam agacchad āgatya punar agacchat dvayoḥ kāmayor avarudhyai dvaigataṃ kriyate
meaning: द्विगद् वा एतेन भार्गवो द्विः स्वर्गं लोकम् अगच्छद् आगत्य पुनर् अगच्छत् द्वयोः कामयोर् अवरुध्यै द्वैगतं क्रियते
text_mt: By this, indeed, Dvigat Bhārgava went twice to the heavenly world: having returned, he went again. For the securing of two desires the Dvaigata is performed.

sanskrit_iast: hārāyaṇaṃ bhavati
meaning: हारायणं भवति

sanskrit_iast: indras tejaskāmo haraskāmas tapo 'tapyata sa etad dhārāyaṇam apaśyat tena tejo haro 'vārundha tejasvī harasvī bhavati hārāyaṇena tuṣtuvānaḥ
meaning: इन्द्रस् तेजस्कामो हरस्कामस् तपो ऽतप्यत स एतद् धारायणम् अपश्यत् तेन तेजो हरो ऽवारुन्ध तेजस्वी हरस्वी भवति हारायणेन तुष्तुवानः
text_mt: Indra, desiring fiery brilliance, desiring lustre, performed ascetic heat. He saw this Hārāyaṇa; by it he secured fiery brilliance and lustre. He who has praised with the Hārāyaṇa becomes endowed with fiery brilliance and lustre.

sanskrit_iast: achidraṃ bhavati
meaning: अछिद्रं भवति

sanskrit_iast: yad vā etasyāhnaś chidram āsīt tad devā acchidreṇāpy auhaṃs tad acchidrasyācchidratvam
meaning: यद् वा एतस्याह्नश् छिद्रम् आसीत् तद् देवा अच्छिद्रेणाप्य् औहंस् तद् अच्छिद्रस्याच्छिद्रत्वम्
text_mt: Whatever flaw this day had, that the gods covered over with the Achidra; that is the flawless nature of the Achidra.

sanskrit_iast: bārhadukthaṃ bhavati
meaning: बार्हदुक्थं भवति

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaduktho vā etena vāmneyo 'nnasya purodhām agacchad annaṃ vai brahmaṇaḥ purodhām annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: बृहदुक्थो वा एतेन वाम्नेयो ऽन्नस्य पुरोधाम् अगच्छद् अन्नं वै ब्रह्मणः पुरोधाम् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: By this, indeed, Bṛhaduktha Vāmneya attained pre-eminence in food. Food indeed is the pre-eminence of the brahmin; [it serves] for the securing of food.

sanskrit_iast: udvad bhārgavaṃ bhavati
meaning: उद्वद् भार्गवं भवति
text_mt: There is the Udvat-Bhārgava [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: pravatā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ prāyann udvatodāyan
meaning: प्रवता वै देवाः स्वर्गं लोकं प्रायन्न् उद्वतोदायन्
text_mt: Along the downward slope the gods departed to the heavenly world; by the upward slope they mounted upward.

sanskrit_iast: nidhanāntāḥ pavamānā bhavanty ahno dhṛtyai stomaḥ
meaning: निधनान्ताः पवमाना भवन्त्य् अह्नो धृत्यै स्तोमः
text_mt: The Pavamāna [chants] have cadences at the end, for the upholding of the day; the stoma [is applied].

sanskrit_iast: ka īṃ veda sute sacā iti satobṛhatyaḥ
meaning: क ईं वेद सुते सचा इति सतोबृहत्यः
text_mt: 'Who knows him when the soma is pressed together—': these are satobṛhatī verses.

sanskrit_iast: apabhraṃśa iva vā eṣa yas saptame 'hani satobṛhatyo bhavanti nāṣṭame tasmād aṣṭame kāryā anapabhraṃśāya
meaning: अपभ्रंश इव वा एष यस् सप्तमे ऽहनि सतोबृहत्यो भवन्ति नाष्टमे तस्माद् अष्टमे कार्या अनपभ्रंशाय
text_mt: It is like a slipping down, that on the seventh day there are satobṛhatī verses, but not on the eighth; therefore on the eighth day they are to be used, to prevent slipping down.

sanskrit_iast: tadāhuḥ śithilam iva vā etac chando yat satobṛhātīty eṣā vai pratiṣṭhitā bṛhatī yā punaḥpadā yad indra prāg apāg udag iti diśāṃ vimarśaḥ pratiṣṭityai
meaning: तदाहुः शिथिलम् इव वा एतच् छन्दो यत् सतोबृहातीत्य् एषा वै प्रतिष्ठिता बृहती या पुनःपदा यद् इन्द्र प्राग् अपाग् उदग् इति दिशां विमर्शः प्रतिष्टित्यै
text_mt: As to this they say: 'Loose indeed is this metre, namely the satobṛhatī.' This, indeed, is the firmly established bṛhatī which has a repeated foot; that [verse begins]: 'O Indra, east, west, north'—this consideration of the quarters is for firm establishment.

sanskrit_iast: tāsu naipātithaṃ brahmasāma
meaning: तासु नैपातिथं ब्रह्मसाम
text_mt: On these [verses], the Naipātitha is the sāman of the brahman.

sanskrit_iast: sāmārṣeyavat svargāya yujyate svargāl lokān na cyavate tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: सामार्षेयवत् स्वर्गाय युज्यते स्वर्गाल् लोकान् न च्यवते तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Possessed of the seer of the sāman, it is harnessed for heaven; he who has praised [with it] does not fall from the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayaṃ śṛṇavac ca na iti
meaning: उभयं शृणवच् च न इति
text_mt: 'May he hear both [prayers] of ours—'.

sanskrit_iast: yac ca pṛṣṭhāni yāni caitāny ahāni teṣām ubhayeṣāṃ santatyai
meaning: यच् च पृष्ठानि यानि चैतान्य् अहानि तेषाम् उभयेषां सन्तत्यै
text_mt: Both what the pṛṣṭhas are and what these days are—it serves for the continuity of both of these.

sanskrit_iast: tāsu vaiyaśvam
meaning: तासु वैयश्वम्

sanskrit_iast: vyaśvo vā etenāṅgiraso 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat svargasya lokasyānukhyātyā etat pṛṣṭhānām antataḥ kriyate stomaḥ
meaning: व्यश्वो वा एतेनाङ्गिरसो ऽञ्जसा स्वर्गं लोकम् अपश्यत् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्या एतत् पृष्ठानाम् अन्ततः क्रियते स्तोमः
text_mt: By this, indeed, Vyaśva Āṅgirasa directly saw the heavenly world; for the sighting of the heavenly world this is performed at the end of the pṛṣṭhas; the stoma [is applied].

sanskrit_iast: pavasva deva āyuṣag indraṃ gacchatu te mada iti gāyatrī bhavati madavad vai rasavat tṛtīyasavanaṃ madam eva tad rasaṃ dadhāti
meaning: पवस्व देव आयुषग् इन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मद इति गायत्री भवति मदवद् वै रसवत् तृतीयसवनं मदम् एव तद् रसं दधाति
text_mt: 'Clarify yourself, O god, together with life; may your exhilaration reach Indra': this is a gāyatrī verse. Endowed with exhilaration, endowed with sap, indeed, is the third pressing; thereby he places exhilaration and sap [in it].

sanskrit_iast: prāṇā śiśur mahīnām iti prāṇavatyo bhavanti prāṇān eva tad yajamāne dadhāti
meaning: प्राणा शिशुर् महीनाम् इति प्राणवत्यो भवन्ति प्राणान् एव तद् यजमाने दधाति
text_mt: 'The breath, the child of the great ones': [verses] containing the word 'breath' they are; thereby he places breaths in the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: abhī no vājasātamam ity abhīti rathantarasya rūpaṃ rāthantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: अभी नो वाजसातमम् इत्य् अभीति रथन्तरस्य रूपं राथन्तरं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: 'Towards us, most winning of bounty': by the word 'towards' (abhi) there is the characteristic of the Rathantara, for this day belongs to the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: pavasva soma mahān samudra ity akṣarapaṅktiḥ stomānāṃ prabhūtir atho etad dhy evaitarhi chando 'yātayāma yad akṣarapaṅktis tena chandomā ayātayāmānaḥ kriyante brahmavādino vadanti yat ṣaḍahe stomāś chandāṃsy āpyante kiṃ chandasaś chandomā ity etac chandaso yad etā akṣarapaṅktaya iti brūyāt
meaning: पवस्व सोम महान् समुद्र इत्य् अक्षरपङ्क्तिः स्तोमानां प्रभूतिर् अथो एतद् ध्य् एवैतर्हि छन्दो ऽयातयाम यद् अक्षरपङ्क्तिस् तेन छन्दोमा अयातयामानः क्रियन्ते ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति यत् षडहे स्तोमाश् छन्दांस्य् आप्यन्ते किं छन्दसश् छन्दोमा इत्य् एतच् छन्दसो यद् एता अक्षरपङ्क्तय इति ब्रूयात्
text_mt: 'Clarify yourself, O Soma, as a great ocean': this akṣarapaṅkti is the abundance of the stomas; moreover, at this time the only metre not exhausted is the akṣarapaṅkti; thereby the Chandomas are made inexhaustible. The theological disputants say: 'Since at the six-day rite the stomas and metres are exhausted, what metre do the Chandomas have?' One should answer: 'They have this metre, namely these akṣarapaṅkti verses.'

sanskrit_iast: hinvanti sūram usraya iti gāyatryaḥ satyo jagatyo rūpeṇa tasmāj jagatīnāṃ loke kriyante
meaning: हिन्वन्ति सूरम् उस्रय इति गायत्र्यः सत्यो जगत्यो रूपेण तस्माज् जगतीनां लोके क्रियन्ते
text_mt: 'The beams drive on the hero': being gāyatrī verses, they have the form of jagatī verses; therefore they are performed in the place of jagatī verses.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ bhavati yad eva gāyatrasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गायत्रं भवति यद् एव गायत्रस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: There is the Gāyatra [sāman]; whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the Gāyatra [applies here].

sanskrit_iast: svāśirām arko bhavati
meaning: स्वाशिराम् अर्को भवति

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ vā arko 'nnādyasyāvarudhyai prāṇā vai svāśiraḥ prāṇānām arudhyai
meaning: अन्नं वा अर्को ऽन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै प्राणा वै स्वाशिरः प्राणानाम् अरुध्यै
text_mt: The arka is food, [it serves] for the securing of food; the svāśiras are the vital breaths, [it serves] for the securing of the vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast: surūpaṃ bhavati
meaning: सुरूपं भवति

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai surūpaṃ paśūnām avarudhyai
meaning: पशवो वै सुरूपं पशूनाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: The Surūpa is cattle, [it serves] for the securing of cattle. There is the Bhāsa [sāman]; he who has praised [with it] shines.

sanskrit_iast: bhāsaṃ bhavati bhāti tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: भासं भवति भाति तुष्टुवानः

sanskrit_iast: padanidhanaṃ rāthantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: पदनिधनं राथन्तरं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: It has its cadence on a word, for this day belongs to the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: svarbhānur vā āsura ādityaṃ tamasāvidhyat sa na vyarocata tasyātrir bhāsena tamo 'pāhan sa vyarocata yad vai tad bhā abhavat tad bhāsasya bhāsatvam
meaning: स्वर्भानुर् वा आसुर आदित्यं तमसाविध्यत् स न व्यरोचत तस्यात्रिर् भासेन तमो ऽपाहन् स व्यरोचत यद् वै तद् भा अभवत् तद् भासस्य भासत्वम्
text_mt: Svarbhānu, the Asura, pierced the sun with darkness; it did not shine forth. Atri struck away its darkness with the Bhāsa [sāman]; it shone forth. In that there came to be light (bhā), that is the nature of the Bhāsa [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: tama iva vā etāny ahāni yac chandomās tebhya etena sāmnā vivāsayati
meaning: तम इव वा एतान्य् अहानि यच् छन्दोमास् तेभ्य एतेन साम्ना विवासयति
text_mt: These days, namely the Chandomas, are darkness as it were; away from them he drives the darkness by means of this sāman.

sanskrit_iast: kākṣīvataṃ bhavati
meaning: काक्षीवतं भवति

sanskrit_iast: kākṣīvān vā etenauśijaḥ prajātiṃ bhūmānam agacchat prajāyate bahur bhavati kākṣīvatena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: काक्षीवान् वा एतेनौशिजः प्रजातिं भूमानम् अगच्छत् प्रजायते बहुर् भवति काक्षीवतेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: By this, indeed, Kakṣīvant Auśija attained offspring and abundance; he who has praised with the Kākṣīvata is propagated and becomes abundant.

sanskrit_iast: āsitaṃ bhavati
meaning: आसितं भवति

sanskrit_iast: asito vā etena daivalas trayāṇāṃ lokānāṃ dṛṣṭim apaśyat trayāṇāṃ kāmānām avarudhyā āsitaṃ kriyate
meaning: असितो वा एतेन दैवलस् त्रयाणां लोकानां दृष्टिम् अपश्यत् त्रयाणां कामानाम् अवरुध्या आसितं क्रियते
text_mt: By this, indeed, Asita Devala saw the vision of the three worlds; for the securing of three desires the Āsita is performed.

sanskrit_iast: aiṣiraṃ bhavati
meaning: ऐषिरं भवति

sanskrit_iast: traitaṃ bhavati pratiṣṭhāyai
meaning: त्रैतं भवति प्रतिष्ठायै
text_mt: There is the Traita [sāman], for firm establishment.

sanskrit_iast: padanidhanaṃ rāthantaraṃ rāthantaraṃ hy etad ahaḥ
meaning: पदनिधनं राथन्तरं राथन्तरं ह्य् एतद् अहः
text_mt: It has its cadence on a word; it belongs to the Rathantara, for this day belongs to the Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast: nāthavindu sāma vindate nāthaṃ nāthavindūny etāny ahāni yat chandomā nātham evaitair vindate
meaning: नाथविन्दु साम विन्दते नाथं नाथविन्दून्य् एतान्य् अहानि यत् छन्दोमा नाथम् एवैतैर् विन्दते
text_mt: The Nāthavindu sāman: he finds help; these days, namely the Chandomas, are finding help; by these he finds help.

sanskrit_iast: gaurīvitaṃ bhavati yad eva gaurīvitasya brāhmaṇam
meaning: गौरीवितं भवति यद् एव गौरीवितस्य ब्राह्मणम्
text_mt: There is the Gaurīvita [sāman]; whatever is the brāhmaṇa of the Gaurīvita [applies here].

sanskrit_iast: kautsaṃ bhavati
meaning: कौत्सं भवति

sanskrit_iast: etena vai kutso 'ndhaso vipānam apaśyat sa ha sma vai surādṛtinopavasathaṃ dhārayaty ubhayasyānnādyasyāvarudhyai kautsaṃ kriyate
meaning: एतेन वै कुत्सो ऽन्धसो विपानम् अपश्यत् स ह स्म वै सुरादृतिनोपवसथं धारयत्य् उभयस्यान्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै कौत्सं क्रियते
text_mt: By this, indeed, Kutsa saw the distinction in drinking the blind soma; he used to observe the fast-day with a skin of liquor. The Kautsa is performed for securing both kinds of food.

sanskrit_iast: śuddhāśuddhīyaṃ bhavati
meaning: शुद्धाशुद्धीयं भवति
text_mt: There is the Śuddhāśuddhīya [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: indro yatīn sālāvṛkebhyaḥ prāyacchat tam aślīlā vāg abhyavadat so 'śuddho 'manyata sa etac chuddhāśuddhīyam apaśyat tenāśudhyac chudhyati śuddhāśuddhīyena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: इन्द्रो यतीन् सालावृकेभ्यः प्रायच्छत् तम् अश्लीला वाग् अभ्यवदत् सो ऽशुद्धो ऽमन्यत स एतच् छुद्धाशुद्धीयम् अपश्यत् तेनाशुध्यच् छुध्यति शुद्धाशुद्धीयेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Indra delivered the yatis to the wild dogs. An abusive voice spoke against him; he considered himself impure. He saw this Śuddhāśuddhīya; by it he became purified. He who has chanted with the Śuddhāśuddhīya becomes purified.

sanskrit_iast: krauñcaṃ bhavati yad eva krauñcasya brāhmaṇaṃ yat dvitīye 'hani
meaning: क्रौञ्चं भवति यद् एव क्रौञ्चस्य ब्राह्मणं यत् द्वितीये ऽहनि
text_mt: There is the Krauñca [sāman], according to the explanation of the Krauñca on the second day.

sanskrit_iast: rayiṣṭhaṃ bhavati
meaning: रयिष्ठं भवति

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai rayiṣṭhaṃ paśūnām avarudhyai
meaning: पशवो वै रयिष्ठं पशूनाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: Cattle, indeed, are the Rayiṣṭha, for securing cattle.

sanskrit_iast: audalaṃ bhavati
meaning: औदलं भवति

sanskrit_iast: udalo vā etena vaiśvāmitraḥ prajātiṃ bhūmānam agacchat prajāyate bahur bhavaty audalena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: उदलो वा एतेन वैश्वामित्रः प्रजातिं भूमानम् अगच्छत् प्रजायते बहुर् भवत्य् औदलेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Udala Vaiśvāmitra, indeed, by this attained procreation and abundance. He procreates and becomes abundant who has chanted with the Audala.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavādino vadanti yat ṣaḍahe stomāś chandāṃsy āpyante kiṃ chandasaś chandomā iti puruṣachandasa iti brūyāt puruṣo vai pāṅktaḥ puruṣo dvipadāś chandomānām ayātayāmatayau
meaning: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति यत् षडहे स्तोमाश् छन्दांस्य् आप्यन्ते किं छन्दसश् छन्दोमा इति पुरुषछन्दस इति ब्रूयात् पुरुषो वै पाङ्क्तः पुरुषो द्विपदाश् छन्दोमानाम् अयातयामतयौ
text_mt: The theologians say: 'Since the stomas and metres are exhausted in the six-day period, of what metre are the Chandomas?' He should say: 'Of the human metre.' The human being is fivefold; the human being is two-footed; [it is] for the non-exhaustion of the Chandomas.

sanskrit_iast: viśoviśīyaṃ bhavati
meaning: विशोविशीयं भवति

sanskrit_iast: agnir akāmayata viśo viśo 'tithis syāṃ viśo viśa ātithyam aśnuvīyeti sa tapo 'tapyata sa etad viśoviśīyam apaśyat tena viśo viśo 'tithir abhavat viśo viśa ātithyam aśnuta viśo viśo 'tithir bhavati viśo viśa ātithyam aśnute viśoviśīyena tuṣṭuvānaḥ
meaning: अग्निर् अकामयत विशो विशो ऽतिथिस् स्यां विशो विश आतिथ्यम् अश्नुवीयेति स तपो ऽतप्यत स एतद् विशोविशीयम् अपश्यत् तेन विशो विशो ऽतिथिर् अभवत् विशो विश आतिथ्यम् अश्नुत विशो विशो ऽतिथिर् भवति विशो विश आतिथ्यम् अश्नुते विशोविशीयेन तुष्टुवानः
text_mt: Agni desired: 'May I be the guest of clan after clan; may I receive hospitality from clan after clan.' He performed ascetic heat; he saw this Viśoviśīya; by it he became the guest of clan after clan; he received hospitality from clan after clan. He becomes the guest of clan after clan; he receives hospitality from clan after clan, who has chanted with the Viśoviśīya.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṣu stuvanti pratiṣṭāyai brahmavarcasāya yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti
meaning: गायत्रीषु स्तुवन्ति प्रतिष्टायै ब्रह्मवर्चसाय येनैव प्राणेन प्रयन्ति तम् अभ्युद्यन्ति
text_mt: They chant on gāyatrī verses for firm support, for brahminical lustre; by whatever breath they go forth, into that they rise.

sanskrit_iast: iḍāntāḥ pavamānā bhavanti paśavo vā iḍā paśavaś chandomāḥ paśuṣv eva tat paśūn dadhāti stomaḥ
meaning: इडान्ताः पवमाना भवन्ति पशवो वा इडा पशवश् छन्दोमाः पशुष्व् एव तत् पशून् दधाति स्तोमः
text_mt: The pavamānas end in iḍā. Cattle are iḍā; the Chandomas are cattle. Thus the stoma places cattle in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: preṣṭhaṃ vo atithim ity ātithyasyaiva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
meaning: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिम् इत्य् आतिथ्यस्यैव तद् रूपं क्रियते
text_mt: With 'The dearest guest of yours...', a manifestation of hospitality is thereby made.

sanskrit_iast: aindra no gadhi priya itīndriyasya vīryasyāvarudhyai
meaning: ऐन्द्र नो गधि प्रिय इतीन्द्रियस्य वीर्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: With 'Indra, come to us, dear...', for securing Indra's heroic power.

sanskrit_iast: purāṃ bhindur yuvā kavir amitaujā ajāyata | indro viśvasya karmaṇo dhartā vajrī puruṣṭuta iti dhṛtyā eva
meaning: पुरां भिन्दुर् युवा कविर् अमितौजा अजायत | इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुत इति धृत्या एव
text_mt: With 'The shatterer of strongholds, youthful, wise, of unmeasured might was born; Indra, the upholder of every deed, thunderbolt-wielder, praised by many,' for firmness alone.

sanskrit_iast: auśanaṃ bhavati
meaning: औशनं भवति

sanskrit_iast: uśanā vai kāvyo 'kāmayata yāvān itareṣāṃ kāvyānāṃ lokas tāvantaṃ spṛṇuyām iti sa tapo 'tapyata sa etad auśanam apaśyat tena tāvantaṃ lokam aspṛṇod yāvān itareṣāṃ kāvyānām āsīt tad vāva sa tarhy akāmayata kāmasani sāmauśanaṃ kāmam evaitenāvarundhe
meaning: उशना वै काव्यो ऽकामयत यावान् इतरेषां काव्यानां लोकस् तावन्तं स्पृणुयाम् इति स तपो ऽतप्यत स एतद् औशनम् अपश्यत् तेन तावन्तं लोकम् अस्पृणोद् यावान् इतरेषां काव्यानाम् आसीत् तद् वाव स तर्ह्य् अकामयत कामसनि सामौशनं कामम् एवैतेनावरुन्धे
text_mt: Uśanas Kāvya desired: 'May I gain as much world as is the world of the other Kāvyas.' He performed ascetic heat; he saw this Auśana; by it he gained as much world as belonged to the other Kāvyas. For that is what he then desired. The Auśana sāman wins desire; by it he secures his desire.

sanskrit_iast: sāṃvartaṃ bhavati
meaning: सांवर्तं भवति
