meaning: यदा संवत्सरस्य गृहपतिर् भवत्य् अथ वैश्वदेवस्य मात्राम् आप्नोत्य् अतो वा इतरे परस्तरां परस्तराम् एव सर्वे
text_mt: When he becomes the master of the year, then he reaches the measure of the Vaiśvadeva; from here onward, indeed, the others are higher and higher, each and every one.

sanskrit_iast: etān eva lokān āpnoty etān lokān jayati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: एतान् एव लोकान् आप्नोत्य् एतान् लोकान् जयति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He who knows thus obtains these very worlds, he conquers these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ
meaning: सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमः

sanskrit_iast: devāś ca vā asurāś ca prajāpater dvayāḥ putrā āsaṃs te 'surā bhūyāṃso balīyāṃsa āsan kanīyāṃso devās te devāḥ prajāpatim upādhāvan sa etam upahavyam apaśyat
meaning: देवाश् च वा असुराश् च प्रजापतेर् द्वयाः पुत्रा आसंस् ते ऽसुरा भूयांसो बलीयांस आसन् कनीयांसो देवास् ते देवाः प्रजापतिम् उपाधावन् स एतम् उपहव्यम् अपश्यत्
text_mt: The gods and the asuras were the two sons of Prajāpati; the asuras were more numerous and stronger; the gods were fewer; those gods ran to Prajāpati; he perceived this Upahavya.

sanskrit_iast: sa aikṣata yan niruktam āhariṣyāmy asurā me yajñaṃ haniṣyantīti so 'niruktam āharat
meaning: स ऐक्षत यन् निरुक्तम् आहरिष्याम्य् असुरा मे यज्ञं हनिष्यन्तीति सो ऽनिरुक्तम् आहरत्
text_mt: He thought, 'If I bring it forward explicitly, the asuras will destroy my sacrifice'; so he brought it forward inexplicitly.

sanskrit_iast: sa uttame stotre devo vo draviṇodā iti devān abhiparyāvartata
meaning: स उत्तमे स्तोत्रे देवो वो द्रविणोदा इति देवान् अभिपर्यावर्तत
text_mt: In the highest chant of praise, with 'The divine giver of wealth to you', he turned towards the gods.

sanskrit_iast: tato devā abhavan parāsurāḥ
meaning: ततो देवा अभवन् परासुराः
text_mt: Thereupon the gods prospered and the asuras were defeated.

sanskrit_iast: bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He prospers in himself, and his rival is defeated, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhuḥ yajñāyajñā vo agnaya ity eva kāryam
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुः यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नय इत्य् एव कार्यम्
text_mt: Now indeed they say: It should only be performed with 'Sacrifice after sacrifice to you, O Agni'.

sanskrit_iast: agnir vai sarvā devatās tena na devatānāṃ kāṃ canāntar eti
meaning: अग्निर् वै सर्वा देवतास् तेन न देवतानां कां चनान्तर् एति
text_mt: Agni is all the deities; thereby he excludes no deity whatsoever.

sanskrit_iast: indro yatīn sālāvṛkeyebhyaḥ prāyacchat tam aślīlā vāg abhyavadat sa prajāpatim upādhāvat tasmā etam upahavyaṃ prāyacchat taṃ viśve devā upāhvayanta tasmād upahavyaḥ
meaning: इन्द्रो यतीन् सालावृकेयेभ्यः प्रायच्छत् तम् अश्लीला वाग् अभ्यवदत् स प्रजापतिम् उपाधावत् तस्मा एतम् उपहव्यं प्रायच्छत् तं विश्वे देवा उपाह्वयन्त तस्माद् उपहव्यः
text_mt: Indra delivered the ascetics to the hyenas; an evil report accused him; he ran to Prajāpati; he gave him this Upahavya; the All-Gods invited him to it; therefore it is [called] the Upahavya.

sanskrit_iast: abhiśasyamānaṃ yājayet
meaning: अभिशस्यमानं याजयेत्
text_mt: He should sacrifice for one who is falsely accused.

sanskrit_iast: devatā vā etaṃ parivrajanti yam anṛtam abhiśaṃsanti devatā evāsyānnam ādayanti
meaning: देवता वा एतं परिव्रजन्ति यम् अनृतम् अभिशंसन्ति देवता एवास्यान्नम् आदयन्ति
text_mt: The deities wander away from him whom they accuse falsely; they cause the deities to eat his food.

sanskrit_iast: tasya pūtasya svaditasya manuṣyā annam adanti
meaning: तस्य पूतस्य स्वदितस्य मनुष्या अन्नम् अदन्ति
text_mt: Men eat the food of him who is purified and approved.

sanskrit_iast: grāmakāmo yajeta
meaning: ग्रामकामो यजेत

sanskrit_iast: mārutī bhavati marutau vai devānāṃ viśo viśam evāsmā anuniyunakty anapakrāmukāsmād viḍ bhavati
meaning: मारुती भवति मरुतौ वै देवानां विशो विशम् एवास्मा अनुनियुनक्त्य् अनपक्रामुकास्माद् विड् भवति
text_mt: There is a verse addressed to the Maruts; the Maruts are the common people of the gods; he attaches the common people to him; the common people do not depart from him.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāmo yajeta pauṣī bhavati
meaning: पशुकामो यजेत पौषी भवति
text_mt: One who desires cattle should sacrifice [with it]; there is a verse addressed to Pūṣan.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai pūṣā paśūn evāvarundhe
meaning: पशवो वै पूषा पशून् एवावरुन्धे
text_mt: Pūṣan is cattle; he secures cattle.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevī bhavati viśve hy enaṃ devā upāhvayanta
meaning: वैश्वदेवी भवति विश्वे ह्य् एनं देवा उपाह्वयन्त
text_mt: There is a verse addressed to the All-Gods; for the All-Gods invited him.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhatsāmā bhavati
meaning: बृहत्सामा भवति

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir hy enam indrāya prāyacchat
meaning: प्रजापतिर् ह्य् एनम् इन्द्राय प्रायच्छत्
text_mt: For Prajāpati gave it to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: aśvaḥ śyavo dakṣiṇā
meaning: अश्वः श्यवो दक्षिणा

sanskrit_iast: sa hy aniruktaḥ
meaning: स ह्य् अनिरुक्तः

sanskrit_iast: sa brahmaṇe deyaḥ
meaning: स ब्रह्मणे देयः

sanskrit_iast: brahmā vā ṛtvijām aniruktaḥ svenaivainaṃ tad rūpeṇa samardhayati
meaning: ब्रह्मा वा ऋत्विजाम् अनिरुक्तः स्वेनैवैनं तद् रूपेण समर्धयति
text_mt: The brahman priest is the inexplicit one among the priests; by means of its own form he makes him prosper.

sanskrit_iast: yāvad dha vai kumāre sadyo jāta eno nāsmiṃs tāvac ca naino bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: यावद् ध वै कुमारे सद्यो जात एनो नास्मिंस् तावच् च नैनो भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: As much sin as is in a newborn child, just so much sin is not in him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ
meaning: सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमः

sanskrit_iast: tasya dvādaśa dīkṣopasadaḥ
meaning: तस्य द्वादश दीक्षोपसदः
text_mt: Its consecrations and upasads are twelve.

sanskrit_iast: svargakāmo yajeta
meaning: स्वर्गकामो यजेत

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsaraḥ svargo lokaḥ svargam evaitena lokam āpnoti
meaning: द्वादश मासाः संवत्सरः संवत्सरः स्वर्गो लोकः स्वर्गम् एवैतेन लोकम् आप्नोति
text_mt: The year is twelve months; heaven is the year; by this he reaches the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtavrato bhavati
meaning: घृतव्रतो भवति

sanskrit_iast: devavrataṃ vai ghṛtaṃ devavratenaiva devatā apyeti
meaning: देवव्रतं वै घृतं देवव्रतेनैव देवता अप्येति
text_mt: Ghee is indeed the vow of the gods; by means of the vow of the gods he reaches the deities.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇottareṇa kāṇḍenopaity uttara uttara eṣāṃ lokānāṃ jyāyān svargasya samaṣṭyai
meaning: उत्तरेणोत्तरेण काण्डेनोपैत्य् उत्तर उत्तर एषां लोकानां ज्यायान् स्वर्गस्य समष्ट्यै
text_mt: He approaches [the altar] with higher and higher sections [of the grass]; each higher of these worlds is greater, for the attainment of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhatsāma bhavati bṛhatā vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyan svargam evetena lokam āpnoti
meaning: बृहत्साम भवति बृहता वै देवाः स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् स्वर्गम् एवेतेन लोकम् आप्नोति
text_mt: The Bṛhat is the sāman; by the Bṛhat, indeed, the gods went to the world of heaven; by this he reaches the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtam uktvā prasarpanty ṛtenaivainaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti
meaning: ऋतम् उक्त्वा प्रसर्पन्त्य् ऋतेनैवैनं स्वर्गं लोकं गमयन्ति
text_mt: Having spoken cosmic order, they glide forward; by cosmic order itself they cause him to go to the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: somacamaso dakṣiṇā devatayaiva devatā apyeti
meaning: सोमचमसो दक्षिणा देवतयैव देवता अप्येति
text_mt: A Soma-cup is the sacrificial fee; by the deity itself he reaches the deity.

sanskrit_iast: audumbaro bhavaty ūrg udumbara ūrjam evāvarundhe
meaning: औदुम्बरो भवत्य् ऊर्ग् उदुम्बर ऊर्जम् एवावरुन्धे
text_mt: It is made of udumbara wood; udumbara is vigor; he obtains vigor.

sanskrit_iast: sagotrāya brahmaṇe deyaḥ somapīthasyāvidohāya
meaning: सगोत्राय ब्रह्मणे देयः सोमपीथस्याविदोहाय
text_mt: It is to be given to a Brahman priest of the same lineage, so that the Soma-draught is not drained away.

sanskrit_iast: sarvaḥ saptadaśo bhavati
meaning: सर्वः सप्तदशो भवति
text_mt: It is entirely seventeenfold.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ sa vai saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsaraḥ svargo lokaḥ svargam evaitena lokam āpnoti
meaning: द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः स वै संवत्सरः संवत्सरः स्वर्गो लोकः स्वर्गम् एवैतेन लोकम् आप्नोति
text_mt: Twelve months and five seasons: that indeed is the year; heaven is the year; by this he reaches the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ
meaning: सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमः

sanskrit_iast: tasya dīkṣaṇīyāyām iṣṭau dvādaśamānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dadāti caturviṃśatimānaṃ prāyaṇīyāyāṃ dve caturviṃśatimāne ātithyāyāṃ catvāri caturviṃśatimānāni prātaḥ prathamāyām upasady aṣṭau caturviṃśatimānāny aparāhṇe prathamāyām upasadi ṣoḍaśacaturviṃśatimānāni prātar madhyamāyām upasadi dvātriṃśataṃ caturviṃśatimānāny aparāhṇe madhyamāyām upasadi catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ caturviṃśatimānāni prātar uttamāyām upasady aṣṭāviṃśatiśataṃ caturviṃśatimānāny aparāhṇa uttamāyām upasadi dve aṣṭāviṃśatiśatamāne agnīṣomīyasya paśor vapāyāṃ catvāry aṣṭāviṃśatiśatamānāni prātaḥ paśor vapāyām aṣṭāv aṣṭāviṃśatiśatamānāni prātaḥsavane sanneṣu nārāśaṃseṣu ṣoḍaśāṣṭāviṃśatiśatamānāni mādhyandine savane 'naḍucchataṃ ca rukmo hotuḥ srag udgātur dvātriṃśatam aṣṭāviṃśatiśatamānāni tṛtīyasavane sanneṣu nārāśaṃseṣu catuḥṣaṣṭim aṣṭāviṃśatiśatamānāny udayanīyāyām iṣṭāv aṣṭāviṃśatiśatam aṣṭāviṃśatiśatamānāni vaśāyā vapāyām
meaning: तस्य दीक्षणीयायाम् इष्टौ द्वादशमानं हिरण्यं ददाति चतुर्विंशतिमानं प्रायणीयायां द्वे चतुर्विंशतिमाने आतिथ्यायां चत्वारि चतुर्विंशतिमानानि प्रातः प्रथमायाम् उपसद्य् अष्टौ चतुर्विंशतिमानान्य् अपराह्णे प्रथमायाम् उपसदि षोडशचतुर्विंशतिमानानि प्रातर् मध्यमायाम् उपसदि द्वात्रिंशतं चतुर्विंशतिमानान्य् अपराह्णे मध्यमायाम् उपसदि चतुःषष्टिं चतुर्विंशतिमानानि प्रातर् उत्तमायाम् उपसद्य् अष्टाविंशतिशतं चतुर्विंशतिमानान्य् अपराह्ण उत्तमायाम् उपसदि द्वे अष्टाविंशतिशतमाने अग्नीषोमीयस्य पशोर् वपायां चत्वार्य् अष्टाविंशतिशतमानानि प्रातः पशोर् वपायाम् अष्टाव् अष्टाविंशतिशतमानानि प्रातःसवने सन्नेषु नाराशंसेषु षोडशाष्टाविंशतिशतमानानि माध्यन्दिने सवने ऽनडुच्छतं च रुक्मो होतुः स्रग् उद्गातुर् द्वात्रिंशतम् अष्टाविंशतिशतमानानि तृतीयसवने सन्नेषु नाराशंसेषु चतुःषष्टिम् अष्टाविंशतिशतमानान्य् उदयनीयायाम् इष्टाव् अष्टाविंशतिशतम् अष्टाविंशतिशतमानानि वशाया वपायाम्
text_mt: At its preparatory offering he gives twelve measures of gold; twenty-four measures at the opening offering; two [portions of] twenty-four measures at the hospitality offering; four [portions of] twenty-four measures at the morning [session] on the first upasadday; eight [portions of] twenty-four measures in the afternoon on the first upasadday; sixteen [portions of] twenty-four measures at the morning [session] on the middle upasadday; thirty-two [portions of] twenty-four measures in the afternoon on the middle upasadday; sixty-four [portions of] twenty-four measures at the morning [session] on the last upasadday; one hundred and twenty-eight [portions of] twenty-four measures in the afternoon on the last upasadday; two [portions of] one hundred and twenty-eight measures at the omentum of the victim for Agni and Soma; four [portions of] one hundred and twenty-eight measures at the omentum of the morning victim; eight [portions of] one hundred and twenty-eight measures when the nārāśaṃsa cups are deposited at the morning pressing; sixteen [portions of] one hundred and twenty-eight measures at the midday pressing, and a hundred draft-oxen, and a golden ornament for the hotṛ, a garland for the udgātṛ; thirty-two [portions of] one hundred and twenty-eight measures when the nārāśaṃsa cups are deposited at the third pressing; sixty-four [portions of] one hundred and twenty-eight measures at the concluding offering; one hundred and twenty-eight [portions of] one hundred and twenty-eight measures at the omentum of the barren cow.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa vā anaḍuho lokam āpnoti ya evaṃ veda
meaning: एष वा अनडुहो लोकम् आप्नोति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He who knows thus reaches the world of the draft-ox.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa vai jyotiṣmantaṃ puṇyaṃ lokaṃ jayati ya evaṃ vidvān etena yajate
meaning: एष वै ज्योतिष्मन्तं पुण्यं लोकं जयति य एवं विद्वान् एतेन यजते
text_mt: He who, knowing thus, sacrifices with this rite, conquers a luminous, holy world.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ
meaning: सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमः

sanskrit_iast: tasya prātaḥsavanīyān somān pratiduhā śrīṇāti śṛtena madhyandine dadhnā tṛtīyasavane
meaning: तस्य प्रातःसवनीयान् सोमान् प्रतिदुहा श्रीणाति शृतेन मध्यन्दिने दध्ना तृतीयसवने
text_mt: He mixes its Somas of the morning pressing with fresh milk, with boiled milk at the midday pressing, with sour milk at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāmo yajeta
meaning: पशुकामो यजेत

sanskrit_iast: yat sarvāṇi savanāny āśīrvanti bhavanty anusavanam evainaṃ paśubhiḥ sarmardhayati prajā tv asya mīliteva bhavati śukriye hi savane payasā śrīṇāti
meaning: यत् सर्वाणि सवनान्य् आशीर्वन्ति भवन्त्य् अनुसवनम् एवैनं पशुभिः सर्मर्धयति प्रजा त्व् अस्य मीलितेव भवति शुक्रिये हि सवने पयसा श्रीणाति
text_mt: In that all the pressings are accompanied by a milk mixture, he prospers him with cattle pressing by pressing; but his offspring is as it were blinking, for at the bright pressing he mixes [the Soma] with milk.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyaṃ yājayet
meaning: वैश्यं याजयेत्

sanskrit_iast: etad vai vaiśyasya samṛddhaṃ yat paśavaḥ paśubhir evainaṃ samardhayati
meaning: एतद् वै वैश्यस्य समृद्धं यत् पशवः पशुभिर् एवैनं समर्धयति
text_mt: For this is the prosperity of a vaiśya: namely, cattle; he prospers him with cattle.

sanskrit_iast: tasya kaṇvarathantaraṃ pṛṣṭham
meaning: तस्य कण्वरथन्तरं पृष्ठम्
text_mt: Its pṛṣṭha is the Kaṇvarathantara.

sanskrit_iast: sadoviśīyaṃ brahmasāma
meaning: सदोविशीयं ब्रह्मसाम
text_mt: The Sadoviśīya is the brahmasāman.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai kaṇvarathantaraṃ paśavaḥ sadoviśīyam ābhipūrvān evāsmin paśūn dadhāti
meaning: पशवो वै कण्वरथन्तरं पशवः सदोविशीयम् आभिपूर्वान् एवास्मिन् पशून् दधाति
text_mt: The Kaṇvarathantara is cattle; the Sadoviśīya is cattle; he places cattle in him in proper order.

sanskrit_iast: sarvaḥ saptadaśo bhavati
meaning: सर्वः सप्तदशो भवति
text_mt: It is entirely seventeenfold.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ sa vai saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsaraṃ paśavo 'nuprajāyante tān evāptvāvarundhe
meaning: द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः स वै संवत्सरः संवत्सरं पशवो ऽनुप्रजायन्ते तान् एवाप्त्वावरुन्धे
text_mt: Twelve months and five seasons: that indeed is the year; cattle propagate along with the year; having reached them, he secures them.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa ukthyaḥ
meaning: सप्तदश उक्थ्यः

sanskrit_iast: indro vṛtram ahan sa viṣvaṅvīryeṇa vyārcchat tasmai devāḥ prāyaścittim aicchaṃs taṃ na kiṃ canādhinot taṃ tīvrasoma evādhinot
meaning: इन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहन् स विष्वङ्वीर्येण व्यार्च्छत् तस्मै देवाः प्रायश्चित्तिम् ऐच्छंस् तं न किं चनाधिनोत् तं तीव्रसोम एवाधिनोत्
text_mt: Indra slew Vṛtra; he parted in all directions from his valor; the gods sought an expiation for him; nothing refreshed him; only the sharp Soma refreshed him.

sanskrit_iast: somātipavitaṃ yājayet
meaning: सोमातिपवितं याजयेत्
text_mt: He should cause him to sacrifice through whom Soma has flowed past.

sanskrit_iast: chidra iva vā eṣa yaṃ somo 'tipavate yat tīvrasomena yajate pihityā evācchidratāyai
meaning: छिद्र इव वा एष यं सोमो ऽतिपवते यत् तीव्रसोमेन यजते पिहित्या एवाच्छिद्रतायै
text_mt: He through whom Soma flows past is as if with a hole; in that he sacrifices with the sharp Soma, it is for covering [it] up, for holelessness.

sanskrit_iast: rājānam aparuddhaṃ yājayet
meaning: राजानम् अपरुद्धं याजयेत्
text_mt: He should cause an expelled king to sacrifice [with it].

sanskrit_iast: viḍ vā etam atipavate yo rājāparudhyate yat tīvrasomena yajate pihityā evācchidratāyai
meaning: विड् वा एतम् अतिपवते यो राजापरुध्यते यत् तीव्रसोमेन यजते पिहित्या एवाच्छिद्रतायै
text_mt: The people flows past him who is an expelled king; in that he sacrifices with the sharp Soma, it is for covering [it] up, for holelessness.

sanskrit_iast: grāmakāmo yajeta
meaning: ग्रामकामो यजेत

sanskrit_iast: grāmo vā etam atipavate yo 'laṃ grāmāya san grāmaṃ na vindate yat tīvrasomena yajate pihityā evācchidratāyai
meaning: ग्रामो वा एतम् अतिपवते यो ऽलं ग्रामाय सन् ग्रामं न विन्दते यत् तीव्रसोमेन यजते पिहित्या एवाच्छिद्रतायै
text_mt: The village flows past him who, being worthy of a village, does not obtain a village; in that he sacrifices with the sharp Soma, it is for covering [it] up, for holelessness.

sanskrit_iast: prajākāmo yajeta prajā vā etam atipavate yo 'laṃ prajāyāḥ san prajāṃ na vindate yat tīvrasomena yajate pihityā evācchidratāyai
meaning: प्रजाकामो यजेत प्रजा वा एतम् अतिपवते यो ऽलं प्रजायाः सन् प्रजां न विन्दते यत् तीव्रसोमेन यजते पिहित्या एवाच्छिद्रतायै
text_mt: One desirous of offspring should sacrifice [with it]; offspring flows past him who, being worthy of offspring, does not obtain offspring; in that he sacrifices with the sharp Soma, it is for covering [it] up, for holelessness.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāmo yajeta paśavo vā etam atipavante yo 'laṃ paśubhyaḥ san paśūn na vindate yat tīvrasomena yajate pihityā evācchidratāyai
meaning: पशुकामो यजेत पशवो वा एतम् अतिपवन्ते यो ऽलं पशुभ्यः सन् पशून् न विन्दते यत् तीव्रसोमेन यजते पिहित्या एवाच्छिद्रतायै
text_mt: One desirous of cattle should sacrifice [with it]; cattle flow past him who, being worthy of cattle, does not obtain cattle; in that he sacrifices with the sharp Soma, it is for covering [it] up, for holelessness.

sanskrit_iast: āmayāvinaṃ yājayet prāṇā vā etam atipavante ya āmayāvī yat tīvrasomena yajate pihityā evācchidratāyai
meaning: आमयाविनं याजयेत् प्राणा वा एतम् अतिपवन्ते य आमयावी यत् तीव्रसोमेन यजते पिहित्या एवाच्छिद्रतायै
text_mt: He should cause a sick person to sacrifice [with it]; the vital breaths flow past him who is sick; in that he sacrifices with the sharp Soma, it is for covering [it] up, for holelessness.

sanskrit_iast: śatam āśiraṃ duhanti tīvrayanty evainam
meaning: शतम् आशिरं दुहन्ति तीव्रयन्त्य् एवैनम्
text_mt: They milk a hundred [cows for] the mixture; they make him sharp indeed.

sanskrit_iast: tat tā u eva dakṣiṇāḥ
meaning: तत् ता उ एव दक्षिणाः

sanskrit_iast: abhy abhisomān unnayanti tīvra enaṃ dhinavad ity ubhāv adhvaryū sarve camasādhvaryavo 'cchāvākāya pratigṛṇanti tīvrayanty evainam
meaning: अभ्य् अभिसोमान् उन्नयन्ति तीव्र एनं धिनवद् इत्य् उभाव् अध्वर्यू सर्वे चमसाध्वर्यवो ऽच्छावाकाय प्रतिगृणन्ति तीव्रयन्त्य् एवैनम्
text_mt: They draw up the Somas one after another, [thinking,] 'May it refresh him sharply'; both adhvaryus and all the camasa-adhvaryus respond to the acchāvāka; they make him sharp indeed.

sanskrit_iast: tad abhakṣayanta ṛtvijaś camasān avajighranti tīvrayanty evainaṃ tat tān acchāvākasya stotre bhakṣayanti tīvrayanty evainam
meaning: तद् अभक्षयन्त ऋत्विजश् चमसान् अवजिघ्रन्ति तीव्रयन्त्य् एवैनं तत् तान् अच्छावाकस्य स्तोत्रे भक्षयन्ति तीव्रयन्त्य् एवैनम्
text_mt: Then the officiating priests, without consuming, smell the cups; they make him sharp indeed; then they consume them at the chant of praise of the acchāvāka; they make him sharp indeed.

sanskrit_iast: tad yat savanāni vyavabhakṣayeyur apakrāmukā yajamānāc chrīḥ syāt sakṛtsakṛt savanānām antato bhakṣayanti savanānām asaṃbhedāya
meaning: तद् यत् सवनानि व्यवभक्षयेयुर् अपक्रामुका यजमानाच् छ्रीः स्यात् सकृत्सकृत् सवनानाम् अन्ततो भक्षयन्ति सवनानाम् असंभेदाय
text_mt: Now, if they were to consume between the pressings, prosperity would depart from the sacrificer; they consume once each at the end of the pressings, to prevent the confusion of the pressings.

sanskrit_iast: rathantaraṃ sāma bhavati
meaning: रथन्तरं साम भवति

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vai rathantaram asyāṃ vā eṣa na pratitiṣṭhati yo na pratitiṣṭhaty asyām evainaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: इयं वै रथन्तरम् अस्यां वा एष न प्रतितिष्ठति यो न प्रतितिष्ठत्य् अस्याम् एवैनं प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: This [earth] is the Rathantara; he who is not firmly established is not firmly established on this [earth]; he establishes him firmly on this [earth].

sanskrit_iast: śrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma bhavaty etad evāsmiñ chrīṇāti
meaning: श्रायन्तीयं ब्रह्मसाम भवत्य् एतद् एवास्मिञ् छ्रीणाति
text_mt: The Śrāyantīya is the brahmasāman; this very [prosperity] he mixes in him.

sanskrit_iast: vāg anuṣṭup vāco raso yajñāyajñīyaṃ vācy evāsya rasaṃ dadhāti
meaning: वाग् अनुष्टुप् वाचो रसो यज्ञायज्ञीयं वाच्य् एवास्य रसं दधाति
text_mt: The anuṣṭubh is speech; the Yajñāyajñīya is the essence of speech; he places essence in his speech.

sanskrit_iast: viśoviśīyam agniṣṭomasāma bhavaty etad evāsmin sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: विशोविशीयम् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवत्य् एतद् एवास्मिन् सर्वं प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: The Viśoviśīya is the agniṣṭomasāman; he establishes everything firmly in him.

sanskrit_iast: udvaṃśīyam ukthānām antato bhavati sarveṣāṃ vā etat pṛṣṭhānāṃ rūpaṃ sarveṣv eva rūpeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: उद्वंशीयम् उक्थानाम् अन्ततो भवति सर्वेषां वा एतत् पृष्ठानां रूपं सर्वेष्व् एव रूपेषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: The Udvaṃśīya is at the end of the ukthas; this indeed is the form of all the pṛṣṭhas; he is established firmly in all the forms.

sanskrit_iast: ukthyo bhavati paśavo vā ukthāni paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: उक्थ्यो भवति पशवो वा उक्थानि पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: It is an ukthya; the ukthas are cattle; he is established firmly in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśimān saptadaśī
meaning: सप्तदश उक्थ्यः षोडशिमान् सप्तदशी
text_mt: It is a seventeenfold ukthya possessing the ṣoḍaśin, [or] a seventeenfold [ṣoḍaśin].

sanskrit_iast: yāvān vai prajāpatir ūrdhvas tāvāṃs tiryaṅ
meaning: यावान् वै प्रजापतिर् ऊर्ध्वस् तावांस् तिर्यङ्
text_mt: As great as Prajāpati is upward, so great is he across.

sanskrit_iast: yāvanta ime lokā ūrdhvās tāvantas tiryañcaḥ
meaning: यावन्त इमे लोका ऊर्ध्वास् तावन्तस् तिर्यञ्चः
text_mt: As great as these worlds are upward, so great are they across.

sanskrit_iast: vājapeyayājī vāva prajāpatim āpnoti
meaning: वाजपेययाजी वाव प्रजापतिम् आप्नोति
text_mt: One who sacrifices with the Vājapeya indeed reaches Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: yat saptadaśa stotrāṇi tenordhvam apnoti yat sarvaḥ saptadaśas tena tiryañcam
meaning: यत् सप्तदश स्तोत्राणि तेनोर्ध्वम् अप्नोति यत् सर्वः सप्तदशस् तेन तिर्यञ्चम्
text_mt: In that there are seventeen chants of praise, thereby he reaches [him] upward; in that it is entirely seventeenfold, thereby [he reaches him] across.

sanskrit_iast: tasya nānāvīryāṇi savanāni
meaning: तस्य नानावीर्याणि सवनानि
text_mt: Its pressings possess various powers.

sanskrit_iast: aniruktaṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ vājavan mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ citravat tṛtīyasavanam
meaning: अनिरुक्तं प्रातःसवनं वाजवन् माध्यन्दिनं सवनं चित्रवत् तृतीयसवनम्
text_mt: The morning pressing is undefined; the midday pressing contains the word 'strength'; the third pressing contains the word 'bright'.

sanskrit_iast: yad aniruktaṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ bhavaty anirukto vai prajāpatiḥ prajāpatim evāpnoti yad vājavan mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ annaṃ vai vājo 'nnādyasyāvarudhyai yac citravat tṛtīyasavanaṃ svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
meaning: यद् अनिरुक्तं प्रातःसवनं भवत्य् अनिरुक्तो वै प्रजापतिः प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोति यद् वाजवन् माध्यन्दिनं सवनं अन्नं वै वाजो ऽन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै यच् चित्रवत् तृतीयसवनं स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
text_mt: In that the morning pressing is unexpressed—for Prajāpati is unexpressed—he reaches Prajāpati. In that the midday pressing contains the word 'vāja' [strength/booty]—for food is vāja—it is for obtaining food. In that the third pressing contains the word 'citra' [bright/diverse], it is for the attainment of the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: viyonir vājapeya ity āhuḥ prājāpatyaḥ san niruktasāmeti yad aniruktaṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ tena sayoniḥ
meaning: वियोनिर् वाजपेय इत्य् आहुः प्राजापत्यः सन् निरुक्तसामेति यद् अनिरुक्तं प्रातःसवनं तेन सयोनिः
text_mt: "The Vājapeya has no proper womb [origin]," they say, "being dedicated to Prajāpati, yet having expressed sāmans." In that the morning pressing is unexpressed, thereby it possesses a proper womb.

sanskrit_iast: rathantaraṃ sāma bhavaty āśīya ujjhityai
meaning: रथन्तरं साम भवत्य् आशीय उज्झित्यै
text_mt: The Rathantara is the sāman, for reaching and conquering.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vai rathantaram asyām evādhy abhiṣicyate
meaning: इयं वै रथन्तरम् अस्याम् एवाध्य् अभिषिच्यते
text_mt: This [earth] is indeed the Rathantara; upon this [earth] alone he is consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād vājapeyayājy apratyavarohī
meaning: तस्माद् वाजपेययाज्य् अप्रत्यवरोही
text_mt: Therefore, the performer of the Vājapeya does not descend [to a lower rank].

sanskrit_iast: asyāṃ hi so 'dhy abhiṣicyate
meaning: अस्यां हि सो ऽध्य् अभिषिच्यते
text_mt: For upon this [earth] he is consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: abhīvarto brahmasāma bhavati brahmaṇo vā eṣa ṛṣabha ṛṣabhatām evainaṃ gamayati
meaning: अभीवर्तो ब्रह्मसाम भवति ब्रह्मणो वा एष ऋषभ ऋषभताम् एवैनं गमयति
text_mt: The Abhīvarta is the Brahma-sāman; this is the bull of the Brahman; it leads him indeed to bull-hood [supremacy].

sanskrit_iast: yajñāyajñīyam anuṣṭubhi bhavati vāg anuṣṭup vāco raso yajñāyajñīyaṃ vācy evāsya rasaṃ dadhāti
meaning: यज्ञायज्ञीयम् अनुष्टुभि भवति वाग् अनुष्टुप् वाचो रसो यज्ञायज्ञीयं वाच्य् एवास्य रसं दधाति
text_mt: The Yajñāyajñīya is on the anuṣṭubh; speech is the anuṣṭubh, and the essence of speech is the Yajñāyajñīya; he places the essence in his speech.

sanskrit_iast: vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma bhavatīndriyasya vīryasya parigṛhītyai
meaning: वारवन्तीयम् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवतीन्द्रियस्य वीर्यस्य परिगृहीत्यै
text_mt: The Vāravantīya is the Agniṣṭoma-sāman, for securing sensory and virile power.

sanskrit_iast: udvaṃśīyam ukthānām antato bhavati sarveṣāṃ vā etat pṛṣṭhānāṃ rūpaṃ sarveṣv eva rūpeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: उद्वंशीयम् उक्थानाम् अन्ततो भवति सर्वेषां वा एतत् पृष्ठानां रूपं सर्वेष्व् एव रूपेषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: The Udvaṁśīya is at the end of the ukthas; this is the form of all the pṛṣṭhas; he firmly establishes himself in all forms.

sanskrit_iast: gaurīvitaṃ ṣoḍaśisāma bhavati
meaning: गौरीवितं षोडशिसाम भवति
text_mt: The Gaurīvita is the Ṣoḍaśi-sāman.

sanskrit_iast: atiriktaṃ gaurīvitam atiriktaḥ ṣoḍaśy atirikta evātiriktaṃ dadhāti
meaning: अतिरिक्तं गौरीवितम् अतिरिक्तः षोडश्य् अतिरिक्त एवातिरिक्तं दधाति
text_mt: Redundant is the Gaurīvita, redundant is the Ṣoḍaśin; he places the redundant in the redundant.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur jāmi vā etad yajñe kriyate yad udvaṃśīyād gaurīvitena stuvate svārāt svāreṇeti
meaning: तद् आहुर् जामि वा एतद् यज्ञे क्रियते यद् उद्वंशीयाद् गौरीवितेन स्तुवते स्वारात् स्वारेणेति
text_mt: Regarding this they say: "A tautology is committed in the sacrifice when they chant with the Gaurīvita after the Udvaṁśīya, [chanting] with a svāra-cadenced sāman after a svāra-cadenced sāman."

sanskrit_iast: na jāmy asti savanaṃ saṃtiṣṭhate
meaning: न जाम्य् अस्ति सवनं संतिष्ठते
text_mt: There is no tautology; the pressing concludes.

sanskrit_iast: ukthaṃ śasyate vaṣaṭkāro 'ntarā tenājāmi
meaning: उक्थं शस्यते वषट्कारो ऽन्तरा तेनाजामि
text_mt: An uktha is recited, and the vaṣaṭ-call comes between; thereby there is variation.

sanskrit_iast: apacchid iva vā etad yajñakāṇḍaṃ yat ṣoḍaśī tenājāmi
meaning: अपच्छिद् इव वा एतद् यज्ञकाण्डं यत् षोडशी तेनाजामि
text_mt: This division of the sacrifice, namely the Ṣoḍaśin, is as it were disconnected; thereby there is variation.

sanskrit_iast: yajñāraṇye saṃtiṣṭhata ity āhur aty ukthāny ety ati ṣoḍaśinaṃ na rātriṃ prāpnotīti
meaning: यज्ञारण्ये संतिष्ठत इत्य् आहुर् अत्य् उक्थान्य् एत्य् अति षोडशिनं न रात्रिं प्राप्नोतीति
text_mt: "It ends in the wilderness of the sacrifice," they say, "it goes beyond the ukthas, beyond the Ṣoḍaśin, and does not reach the night."

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ śipiviṣṭavatīṣu bṛhad uttamaṃ bhavati
meaning: विष्णोः शिपिविष्टवतीषु बृहद् उत्तमं भवति
text_mt: The Bṛhat on [verses] addressed to Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa is the final chant.

sanskrit_iast: eṣā vai prajāpateḥ paśuṣṭhā tanūr yac chipiviṣṭaḥ prāṇo vai bṛhat prāṇa eva paśuṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: एषा वै प्रजापतेः पशुष्ठा तनूर् यच् छिपिविष्टः प्राणो वै बृहत् प्राण एव पशुषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: That which is Śipiviṣṭa is Prajāpati's form resting in cattle; the breath is the Bṛhat; he establishes breath in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhatā stuvanti bṛhad amuṃ lokam āptum arhati tam evāpnoti
meaning: बृहता स्तुवन्ति बृहद् अमुं लोकम् आप्तुम् अर्हति तम् एवाप्नोति
text_mt: They chant with the Bṛhat; the Bṛhat is fit to obtain that world; he obtains it.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir akāmayata vājam āpnuyāṃ svargaṃ lokam iti sa etaṃ vājapeyam apaśyad vājapeyo vā eṣa vājam evaitena svargaṃ lokam āpnoti
meaning: प्रजापतिर् अकामयत वाजम् आप्नुयां स्वर्गं लोकम् इति स एतं वाजपेयम् अपश्यद् वाजपेयो वा एष वाजम् एवैतेन स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नोति
text_mt: Prajāpati desired: "May I win vāja, the heavenly world." He saw this Vājapeya; this is indeed the Vājapeya; by this he reaches vāja, the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: śukravatyo jyotiṣmatyaḥ prātaḥsavane bhavanti tejo brahmavarcasaṃ tābhir avarundhe
meaning: शुक्रवत्यो ज्योतिष्मत्यः प्रातःसवने भवन्ति तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं ताभिर् अवरुन्धे
text_mt: There are [verses] containing 'śukra' [bright] and 'jyotis' [light] in the morning pressing; by them he obtains fiery energy and brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: vājavatyo mādhyandine bhavanti svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
meaning: वाजवत्यो माध्यन्दिने भवन्ति स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
text_mt: There are [verses] containing 'vāja' in the midday pressing, for the attainment of the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: annavatyo gaṇavatyaḥ paśumatyas tṛtīyasavane bhavanti bhūmānaṃ tābhir avarunadhe
meaning: अन्नवत्यो गणवत्यः पशुमत्यस् तृतीयसवने भवन्ति भूमानं ताभिर् अवरुनधे
text_mt: There are [verses] containing 'anna' [food], 'gaṇa' [troops], and 'paśu' [cattle] in the third pressing; by them he secures abundance.

sanskrit_iast: sarvaḥ saptadaśo bhavati prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim evāpnoti
meaning: सर्वः सप्तदशो भवति प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोति
text_mt: The whole [sacrifice] is seventeenfold; Prajāpati is seventeenfold; he reaches Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyasraja ṛtvijo bhavanti mahasa eva tad rūpaṃ kriyate
meaning: हिरण्यस्रज ऋत्विजो भवन्ति महस एव तद् रूपं क्रियते
text_mt: The officiating priests wear golden garlands; that is done as a manifestation of greatness,

sanskrit_iast: eṣa me 'muṣmin loke prakāśo 'sad iti
meaning: एष मे ऽमुष्मिन् लोके प्रकाशो ऽसद् इति
text_mt: [thinking]: "May this be my illumination in yonder world."

sanskrit_iast: jyotir vai hiraṇyaṃ jyotir evāsmin dadhāti
meaning: ज्योतिर् वै हिरण्यं ज्योतिर् एवास्मिन् दधाति
text_mt: Gold is light; he places light in him.

sanskrit_iast: ājiṃ dhāvanti yajamānam ujjāpayanti svargam evainaṃ tal lokam ujjāpayanti
meaning: आजिं धावन्ति यजमानम् उज्जापयन्ति स्वर्गम् एवैनं तल् लोकम् उज्जापयन्ति
text_mt: They run a race; they make the sacrificer win; they make him win that heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: nākaṃ rohati svargam eva tal lokaṃ rohati
meaning: नाकं रोहति स्वर्गम् एव तल् लोकं रोहति
text_mt: He mounts the vault of heaven; he ascends to that heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: sarajase rohati manuṣyalokād evainam antar dadhāti
meaning: सरजसे रोहति मनुष्यलोकाद् एवैनम् अन्तर् दधाति
text_mt: He mounts [a chariot] while there is dust; he hides him from the world of men.

sanskrit_iast: vājināṃ sāma brahmā rathacakre 'bhigāyati vājo vai svargo lokaḥ svargam evainaṃ tal lokam ujjāpayati
meaning: वाजिनां साम ब्रह्मा रथचक्रे ऽभिगायति वाजो वै स्वर्गो लोकः स्वर्गम् एवैनं तल् लोकम् उज्जापयति
text_mt: The Brahman priest sings the sāman of the swift steeds on a chariot-wheel; vāja is the heavenly world; he makes him win that heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ śipiviṣṭavatīṣu bṛhaduttamaṃ bhavati svargam eva tal lokaṃ rūḍhvā bradhnasya viṣṭapam abhyatikrāmati
meaning: विष्णोः शिपिविष्टवतीषु बृहदुत्तमं भवति स्वर्गम् एव तल् लोकं रूढ्वा ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपम् अभ्यतिक्रामति
text_mt: The Bṛhat on [verses] addressed to Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa is the final chant; having ascended to that heavenly world, he steps beyond the summit of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomaṃ prathamam āharati yajñamukhaṃ vā agniṣṭomo yajñamukham evārabhya savamākramate
meaning: अग्निष्टोमं प्रथमम् आहरति यज्ञमुखं वा अग्निष्टोमो यज्ञमुखम् एवारभ्य सवमाक्रमते
text_mt: He first performs the Agniṣṭoma; the Agniṣṭoma is the mouth of the sacrifice; having begun from the mouth of the sacrifice, he enters upon the consecration.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣo 'bhiṣecanīyaḥ
meaning: अथैषो ऽभिषेचनीयः

sanskrit_iast: tasya dvātriṃśāḥ pavamānā dvātriṃśadakṣarā 'nuṣṭub vāg anuṣṭub yāvatī vāk tayaiva sūyate
meaning: तस्य द्वात्रिंशाः पवमाना द्वात्रिंशदक्षरा ऽनुष्टुब् वाग् अनुष्टुब् यावती वाक् तयैव सूयते
text_mt: Its pavamāna chants are thirty-two-fold; the anuṣṭubh consists of thirty-two syllables; speech is the anuṣṭubh; by as much as speech extends, by that much he is consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: saṃśara iva vā eṣa chandasāṃ yad viṣamā stomā ayathāpūrvam iti
meaning: संशर इव वा एष छन्दसां यद् विषमा स्तोमा अयथापूर्वम् इति
text_mt: "It is like a destruction of the metres when the stomas are uneven and not in proper order," [they say].

sanskrit_iast: yat samāḥ pavamānās tenāsaṃśaras tena yathāpūrvam
meaning: यत् समाः पवमानास् तेनासंशरस् तेन यथापूर्वम्
text_mt: In that the pavamānas are equal, thereby there is no destruction, thereby they are in proper order.

sanskrit_iast: ātmanā vā agniṣṭomenardhnoty ātmanā puṇyo bhavaty atha yad ukthāni paśavo vā ukthāni viḍ ukthāni yad ukthāni bhavanty anusantatyā eva
meaning: आत्मना वा अग्निष्टोमेनर्ध्नोत्य् आत्मना पुण्यो भवत्य् अथ यद् उक्थानि पशवो वा उक्थानि विड् उक्थानि यद् उक्थानि भवन्त्य् अनुसन्तत्या एव
text_mt: By the Agniṣṭoma he thrives in himself, he becomes virtuous in himself. Now as to the ukthas: the ukthas are cattle, the ukthas are the people; in that there are ukthas, it is for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: vāyo śukro ayāmita iti vāyavyā pratipad bhavati vāg vai vāyur vācam evāsya yajñamukhe yunakti tayābhiṣicyate sarvasyā eva vācaḥ sūyate sarvā enaṃ vāco rājeti vadanti
meaning: वायो शुक्रो अयामित इति वायव्या प्रतिपद् भवति वाग् वै वायुर् वाचम् एवास्य यज्ञमुखे युनक्ति तयाभिषिच्यते सर्वस्या एव वाचः सूयते सर्वा एनं वाचो राजेति वदन्ति
text_mt: "O Vāyu, the clear [Soma] has been offered to you"—the introductory verse is addressed to Vāyu. Vāyu is speech; he hitches speech to the mouth of the sacrifice; by it he is consecrated; he is consecrated for all speech; all speeches proclaim him king.

sanskrit_iast: saṃbhāryā bhavanti pṛṣṭhāny eva tābhir yunakti yan nānādevatyās tena yunakti vīryaṃ vai pṛṣṭhāni vīrya evādhy abhiṣicyate
meaning: संभार्या भवन्ति पृष्ठान्य् एव ताभिर् युनक्ति यन् नानादेवत्यास् तेन युनक्ति वीर्यं वै पृष्ठानि वीर्य एवाध्य् अभिषिच्यते
text_mt: There are collected [verses]; by them he hitches the pṛṣṭhas. In that they are addressed to various deities, thereby he hitches them. The pṛṣṭhas are virile power; he is consecrated upon virile power.

sanskrit_iast: yanti vā ete yajñamukhād ity āhur ye saṃbhāryāḥ kurvata iti
meaning: यन्ति वा एते यज्ञमुखाद् इत्य् आहुर् ये संभार्याः कुर्वत इति
text_mt: "They depart from the mouth of the sacrifice," they say, "who employ collected [verses]."

sanskrit_iast: yat pavasya vāco agriya iti tena yajñamukhān na yanti
meaning: यत् पवस्य वाचो अग्रिय इति तेन यज्ञमुखान् न यन्ति
text_mt: In that there is: "Clarify yourself as the foremost of speech," thereby they do not depart from the mouth of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: davidyutatyā rucā iti chandasāṃ rūpaṃ chandāṃsy evāsya yajñamukhe yunakti tair abhiṣicyate
meaning: दविद्युतत्या रुचा इति छन्दसां रूपं छन्दांस्य् एवास्य यज्ञमुखे युनक्ति तैर् अभिषिच्यते
text_mt: "With flashing brilliance"—this is the form of the metres; he hitches the metres at the mouth of his sacrifice; by them he is consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: etam u tyaṃ daśa kṣipa ity ādityā ādityā vā imāḥ prajās tāsām eva madhyataḥ sūyate
meaning: एतम् उ त्यं दश क्षिप इत्य् आदित्या आदित्या वा इमाः प्रजास् तासाम् एव मध्यतः सूयते
text_mt: "Him, the ten fingers..."—these are addressed to the Ādityas; these creatures belong to the Ādityas; in the midst of them he is consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: pavasvendo vṛṣā suta vṛṣaṇvatyo bhavanti triṣṭubho rūpaṃ vīryaṃ vai triṣṭup vīrya evādhy abhiṣicyate
meaning: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुत वृषण्वत्यो भवन्ति त्रिष्टुभो रूपं वीर्यं वै त्रिष्टुप् वीर्य एवाध्य् अभिषिच्यते
text_mt: "Flow, Indu, as a bull, when pressed"—these [verses] contain the word 'bull'; this is the form of the triṣṭubh; the triṣṭubh is virile power; he is consecrated upon virile power.

sanskrit_iast: utte śuṣmāsa īrata ity udvatyo bhavanty udvad vā anuṣṭubho rūpam ānuṣṭubho rājanyas tasmād udvatyo bhavanti
meaning: उत्ते शुष्मास ईरत इत्य् उद्वत्यो भवन्त्य् उद्वद् वा अनुष्टुभो रूपम् आनुष्टुभो राजन्यस् तस्माद् उद्वत्यो भवन्ति
text_mt: "Upward your vital energies rise"—these [verses] contain the word 'upward'; containing the word 'upward' is the form of the anuṣṭubh; the noble belongs to the anuṣṭubh; therefore, they contain the word 'upward'.

sanskrit_iast: pavamānasya te kava iti prāṇānāṃ kḷptyai
meaning: पवमानस्य ते कव इति प्राणानां कॢप्त्यै
text_mt: "For you who clarify yourself, wise one"—this is for the alignment of the breaths.

sanskrit_iast: adha kṣapā pariṣkṛta ity anuṣṭup prathamānuṣṭub uttamā vāg vā anuṣṭub vācaiva prayanti vācam abhyudyanti
meaning: अध क्षपा परिष्कृत इत्य् अनुष्टुप् प्रथमानुष्टुब् उत्तमा वाग् वा अनुष्टुब् वाचैव प्रयन्ति वाचम् अभ्युद्यन्ति
text_mt: "Then, adorned through the night"—this is an anuṣṭubh; the first is an anuṣṭubh, the last is an anuṣṭubh; speech is the anuṣṭubh; with speech they set out, to speech they arrive.

sanskrit_iast: chinnam iva vā etad yad ekarcā yad etāvānuṣṭubhau tṛcāv abhito bhavato bahavaḥ puraetāro bhavanti bahavaḥ paścāpinaḥ
meaning: छिन्नम् इव वा एतद् यद् एकर्चा यद् एतावानुष्टुभौ तृचाव् अभितो भवतो बहवः पुरएतारो भवन्ति बहवः पश्चापिनः
text_mt: What is a single verse is, as it were, cut off. In that these two triplets in anuṣṭubh metre are on both sides, there are many going before, many coming behind.

sanskrit_iast: sauryānuṣṭub uttamā bhavati svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
meaning: सौर्यानुष्टुब् उत्तमा भवति स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
text_mt: The final [verse] is an anuṣṭubh addressed to Sūrya, for the attainment of the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasya vai suṣuvāṇasya bhargo 'pākrāmat sa tredhāpatad bhṛgus tṛtīyam abhavac chrāyantīyaṃ tṛtīyam apas tṛtīyaṃ prāviśat
meaning: वरुणस्य वै सुषुवाणस्य भर्गो ऽपाक्रामत् स त्रेधापतद् भृगुस् तृतीयम् अभवच् छ्रायन्तीयं तृतीयम् अपस् तृतीयं प्राविशत्
text_mt: When Varuṇa was consecrated, his radiant splendor departed. It fell threefold: one-third became Bhṛgu, one-third became the Śrāyantīya [sāman], and one-third entered the waters.

sanskrit_iast: yad bhārgavo hotā bhavati tenaiva tad indriyaṃ vīryam āptvāvarundhe yat śrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma bhavati tenaiva tad indriyaṃ vīryam āptvārundhe yat puṣkarasrajaṃ pratimuñcate tenaiva tad indriyaṃ vīryam āptvāvarundhe
meaning: यद् भार्गवो होता भवति तेनैव तद् इन्द्रियं वीर्यम् आप्त्वावरुन्धे यत् श्रायन्तीयं ब्रह्मसाम भवति तेनैव तद् इन्द्रियं वीर्यम् आप्त्वारुन्धे यत् पुष्करस्रजं प्रतिमुञ्चते तेनैव तद् इन्द्रियं वीर्यम् आप्त्वावरुन्धे
text_mt: In that the Hotṛ is a descendant of Bhṛgu, he thereby reaches and secures that sensory and virile power. In that the Śrāyantīya is the Brahma-sāman, he thereby reaches and secures that sensory and virile power. In that he fastens on a lotus-garland, he thereby reaches and secures that sensory and virile power.

sanskrit_iast: daśamī bhavati
meaning: दशमी भवति

sanskrit_iast: daśa camasā daśa camasādhvaryavo daśa daśa camasam abhiyanty ā daśamāt puruṣād anvākhyāya prasarpanti daśa samṛddho hy eṣa yajña enaṃ vāva te tad yajñam anvaicchan ya etena yajata etad evendriyaṃ vīryam āttvāsmin dadhāti
meaning: दश चमसा दश चमसाध्वर्यवो दश दश चमसम् अभियन्त्य् आ दशमात् पुरुषाद् अन्वाख्याय प्रसर्पन्ति दश समृद्धो ह्य् एष यज्ञ एनं वाव ते तद् यज्ञम् अन्वैच्छन् य एतेन यजत एतद् एवेन्द्रियं वीर्यम् आत्त्वास्मिन् दधाति
text_mt: Ten are the cups; ten are the cup-adhvaryus; ten by ten approach each cup; they glide while reciting [their lineage] back to the tenth ancestor; for this sacrifice is perfected in the number ten. It was this sacrifice that they sought after then; he who sacrifices with this ritual secures this very sensory and virile power and places it in himself.

sanskrit_iast: sarvaḥ saptadaśo bhavati dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ sa vai saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsarād evendriyaṃ vīryam āptvāvarundhe
meaning: सर्वः सप्तदशो भवति द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः स वै संवत्सरः संवत्सराद् एवेन्द्रियं वीर्यम् आप्त्वावरुन्धे
text_mt: It is entirely seventeenfold. Twelve are the months, five are the seasons; that indeed is the year. Having attained sensual power and virility from the year itself, he secures [them].

sanskrit_iast: indro vṛtram ahaṃs tasyeyaṃ citrāṇy upaid rūpāṇy asau nakṣatrāṇām avakāśena puṇḍarīkaṃ jāyate yat puṣkarasrajaṃ pratimuñcate vṛtrasyaiva tad rūpaṃ kṣatraṃ pratimuñcate
meaning: इन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहंस् तस्येयं चित्राण्य् उपैद् रूपाण्य् असौ नक्षत्राणाम् अवकाशेन पुण्डरीकं जायते यत् पुष्करस्रजं प्रतिमुञ्चते वृत्रस्यैव तद् रूपं क्षत्रं प्रतिमुञ्चते
text_mt: Indra slew Vṛtra. His manifold forms came to this [earth]. Yonder, through the space between the asterisms, a lotus is born. When he fastens on a lotus-wreath, he fastens on that very form, the dominion of Vṛtra.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa puṣkarā bhavanti dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsare 'ntar bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca bhūtena caivainaṃ bhavyena ca samardhayati
meaning: द्वादश पुष्करा भवन्ति द्वादश मासाः संवत्सरः संवत्सरे ऽन्तर् भूतं च भव्यं च भूतेन चैवैनं भव्येन च समर्धयति
text_mt: There are twelve lotuses. Twelve are the months, [which are] the year. Within the year is both what has become and what is to be. He prospers him with both what has become and what is to be.

sanskrit_iast: srag udgātus saurya udgātā na vai tasmai vyaucchad atho vy evāsmai vāsayati
meaning: स्रग् उद्गातुस् सौर्य उद्गाता न वै तस्मै व्यौच्छद् अथो व्य् एवास्मै वासयति
text_mt: The wreath belongs to the udgātṛ. The udgātṛ belongs to Sūrya. It indeed did not dawn for him; and so it dawns for him.

sanskrit_iast: rukmo hotur āgneyo hotātho amum evāsmā ādityam unnayati
meaning: रुक्मो होतुर् आग्नेयो होताथो अमुम् एवास्मा आदित्यम् उन्नयति
text_mt: The gold ornament belongs to the hotṛ. The hotṛ belongs to Agni; and so he raises yonder sun for him.

sanskrit_iast: prākāśāv adhvaryor yāv iva hy adhvaryū atho cakṣuṣī evāsmin dadhāti
meaning: प्राकाशाव् अध्वर्योर् याव् इव ह्य् अध्वर्यू अथो चक्षुषी एवास्मिन् दधाति
text_mt: The two mirrors belong to the adhvaryu, for there are, as it were, two adhvaryus; and so he places the two eyes in him.

sanskrit_iast: aśvaḥ prastotuḥ prājāpatyo 'śvaḥ prājāpatyaḥ prastotātho preva hy aśvaḥ prothati preva prastotā stauti
meaning: अश्वः प्रस्तोतुः प्राजापत्यो ऽश्वः प्राजापत्यः प्रस्तोताथो प्रेव ह्य् अश्वः प्रोथति प्रेव प्रस्तोता स्तौति
text_mt: The horse belongs to the prastotṛ. Connected with Prajāpati is the horse; connected with Prajāpati is the prastotṛ; and moreover the horse snorts as it were, [and] the prastotṛ chants as it were.

sanskrit_iast: dhenuḥ pratihartuḥ paya evāsmin dadhāti
meaning: धेनुः प्रतिहर्तुः पय एवास्मिन् दधाति
text_mt: The milch cow belongs to the pratihartṛ; he places milk in him.

sanskrit_iast: vaśā maitrāvaruṇasya vaśaṃ mā nayād iti
meaning: वशा मैत्रावरुणस्य वशं मा नयाद् इति
text_mt: The barren cow belongs to the maitrāvaruṇa, with the thought: ‘May he lead me into his power.’

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabho brāhmaṇācchaṃsino vīryaṃ vā ṛṣabho vīryam evāsmin dadhāti
meaning: ऋषभो ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनो वीर्यं वा ऋषभो वीर्यम् एवास्मिन् दधाति
text_mt: The bull belongs to the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; virility indeed is the bull; he places virility in him.

sanskrit_iast: vāsaḥ potuḥ pavitratvāya
meaning: वासः पोतुः पवित्रत्वाय
text_mt: The garment belongs to the potṛ, for purification.

sanskrit_iast: varāsī neṣṭur anulambeva hy eṣā hotrā
meaning: वरासी नेष्टुर् अनुलम्बेव ह्य् एषा होत्रा
text_mt: The coarse cloth belongs to the neṣṭṛ, for this hotrā is dangling as it were.

sanskrit_iast: sthūri yavācitam acchāvākasya sthūrir iva hy eṣā hotrātho nirvaruṇatvāyaiva yavā na vai tarhi yad asyāṃ dakṣiṇā abhy abhavann atho asya ta eva tenābhīṣṭāḥ prītā bhavanti
meaning: स्थूरि यवाचितम् अच्छावाकस्य स्थूरिर् इव ह्य् एषा होत्राथो निर्वरुणत्वायैव यवा न वै तर्हि यद् अस्यां दक्षिणा अभ्य् अभवन्न् अथो अस्य त एव तेनाभीष्टाः प्रीता भवन्ति
text_mt: A one-horse cart loaded with barley belongs to the acchāvāka, for this hotrā is one-sided as it were; moreover, barley is for freedom from Varuṇa. Indeed at that time, when the sacrificial gifts did not reach this [hotrā], those very ones of his become thereby sought and propitiated.

sanskrit_iast: anaḍvān agnīdho yuktyai
meaning: अनड्वान् अग्नीधो युक्त्यै
text_mt: The draft ox belongs to the agnīdh, for yoking.

sanskrit_iast: ajaḥ subrahmaṇyāyai
meaning: अजः सुब्रह्मण्यायै

sanskrit_iast: vatsatary unnetuḥ sāṇḍas trivatso grāvastuto mithunatvāya
meaning: वत्सतर्य् उन्नेतुः साण्डस् त्रिवत्सो ग्रावस्तुतो मिथुनत्वाय
text_mt: The heifer belongs to the unnetṛ; the uncastrated three-year-old bull belongs to the grāvastut, for pairing.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa paṣṭhauhyo garbhiṇyo brahmaṇo dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsara eva pratitiṣṭhaty atha yad garbhiṇyo vāg vai dhenur mantro garbho vācy evāsya mantraṃ dadhāty āmantraṇīyo bhavaty atha yad dhenubhavyā dvādaśa payāṃsi tāny evāsmin dadhāti tasmād āhuḥ payasvī rājā puṇya iti
meaning: द्वादश पष्ठौह्यो गर्भिण्यो ब्रह्मणो द्वादश मासाः संवत्सरः संवत्सर एव प्रतितिष्ठत्य् अथ यद् गर्भिण्यो वाग् वै धेनुर् मन्त्रो गर्भो वाच्य् एवास्य मन्त्रं दधात्य् आमन्त्रणीयो भवत्य् अथ यद् धेनुभव्या द्वादश पयांसि तान्य् एवास्मिन् दधाति तस्माद् आहुः पयस्वी राजा पुण्य इति
text_mt: Twelve pregnant four-year-old cows belong to the brahman. Twelve are the months, [which are] the year; he firmly establishes himself in the year itself. Then, as to their being pregnant: speech is indeed the milch cow, the mantra is the embryo; he places the mantra in his speech itself; he becomes worthy of being addressed. Then, as to their being future milch cows: twelve are the milks; those he places in him. Therefore they say: ‘The king is rich in milk, virtuous.’

sanskrit_iast: yo vai savād eti nainaṃ sava upanamaty atha yaḥ sāmabhya eti pāpīyān suṣuvāṇo bhavati
meaning: यो वै सवाद् एति नैनं सव उपनमत्य् अथ यः सामभ्य एति पापीयान् सुषुवाणो भवति
text_mt: He who departs from the sava, to him the sava does not fall; and he who departs from the sāmans, having pressed [soma], becomes worse off.

sanskrit_iast: saṃbhāryā bhavanti pṛṣṭhāny eva tābhir yunakti
meaning: संभार्या भवन्ति पृष्ठान्य् एव ताभिर् युनक्ति
text_mt: There are collected [sāmans]; by means of them he yokes the pṛṣṭhas.

sanskrit_iast: etāni vāva sāmāni yat pṛṣṭhāni
meaning: एतानि वाव सामानि यत् पृष्ठानि
text_mt: These indeed are the sāmans, namely the pṛṣṭhas.

sanskrit_iast: yat saṃbhāryā bhavanti tad eva sāmabhyo naiti
meaning: यत् संभार्या भवन्ति तद् एव सामभ्यो नैति
text_mt: In that they are collected [sāmans], thereby he does not depart from the sāmans.

sanskrit_iast: yāni devarājñāṃ sāmāni tair amuṣmin loka ṛdhnoti yāni manuṣyarājñāṃ tair asminn ubhayor anayor lokayor ṛdhnoti devaloke ca manuṣyaloke ca
meaning: यानि देवराज्ञां सामानि तैर् अमुष्मिन् लोक ऋध्नोति यानि मनुष्यराज्ञां तैर् अस्मिन्न् उभयोर् अनयोर् लोकयोर् ऋध्नोति देवलोके च मनुष्यलोके च
text_mt: Those sāmans of the divine kings, through them he thrives in yonder world; those of the human kings, through them in this world. In both these worlds he thrives, in the world of the gods and in the world of men.

sanskrit_iast: sāmatriṣṭubhy adhy abhiṣicyate vīryaṃ vai sāma triṣṭup vīrya evādhy abhiṣicyate
meaning: सामत्रिष्टुभ्य् अध्य् अभिषिच्यते वीर्यं वै साम त्रिष्टुप् वीर्य एवाध्य् अभिषिच्यते
text_mt: He is consecrated upon a triṣṭubh of sāman; virility indeed is the sāman, [and] the triṣṭubh; he is consecrated upon virility itself.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśa rājasāmāni bhavanty ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭub ojo vīryaṃ triṣṭub ojasy eva vīrye 'dhy abhiṣicyate
meaning: एकादश राजसामानि भवन्त्य् एकादशाक्षरा त्रिष्टुब् ओजो वीर्यं त्रिष्टुब् ओजस्य् एव वीर्ये ऽध्य् अभिषिच्यते
text_mt: There are eleven rājasāmans; eleven-syllabled is the triṣṭubh; splendour and virility is the triṣṭubh; he is consecrated upon splendour and virility itself.

sanskrit_iast: yat trivṛtam abhiṣecanīye kuryur brahma kṣatrāyāpidadhyur yat trivṛtam uddharanti brahma tat kṣatrād uddharanti tasmād bharatāṃ pratidaṇḍā brahmaṇā na hi te trivṛtam abhiṣecanīye kurvanti
meaning: यत् त्रिवृतम् अभिषेचनीये कुर्युर् ब्रह्म क्षत्रायापिदध्युर् यत् त्रिवृतम् उद्धरन्ति ब्रह्म तत् क्षत्राद् उद्धरन्ति तस्माद् भरतां प्रतिदण्डा ब्रह्मणा न हि ते त्रिवृतम् अभिषेचनीये कुर्वन्ति
text_mt: If they were to employ the ninefold stoma at the Abhiṣecanīya, they would cover up the spiritual power for the temporal power. In that they omit the ninefold stoma, they thereby remove the spiritual power from the temporal power. Therefore the descendants of Bharata are given to punishing the brāhmaṇa, for they do not employ the ninefold stoma at the Abhiṣecanīya.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśo 'bhiṣecanīyasyottamaḥ saptadaśo daśapeya ekaviṃśaḥ keśavapanīyasya prathamaḥ kṣatraṃ vā ekaviṃśo viṭ saptadaśaḥ kṣatreṇaivāsmai viśam ubhayataḥ parigṛhṇāty anapakrāmukāsmād viṭ bhavati
meaning: एकविंशो ऽभिषेचनीयस्योत्तमः सप्तदशो दशपेय एकविंशः केशवपनीयस्य प्रथमः क्षत्रं वा एकविंशो विट् सप्तदशः क्षत्रेणैवास्मै विशम् उभयतः परिगृह्णात्य् अनपक्रामुकास्माद् विट् भवति
text_mt: The twenty-one-fold stoma is the last of the Abhiṣecanīya; the seventeenfold stoma belongs to the Daśapeya; the twenty-one-fold stoma is the first of the Keśavapanīya. Temporal power is the twenty-one-fold stoma; the people is the seventeenfold stoma. By means of the temporal power he encloses the people for him on both sides; the people becomes not straying away from him.

sanskrit_iast: yad vai rājasūyenābhiṣicyate tat svargaṃ lokam ārohati sa yad imaṃ lokaṃ nopāvarohed ati janaṃ vā gacched ud vā mādyed yad eṣo 'rvācīnastomaḥ keśavapanīyo bhavaty asya lokasyānuddhānāya yathā śākhāyāḥ śākhām ālambham upāvarohed evam etenemaṃ lokam upāvarohati pratiṣṭhāyai
meaning: यद् वै राजसूयेनाभिषिच्यते तत् स्वर्गं लोकम् आरोहति स यद् इमं लोकं नोपावरोहेद् अति जनं वा गच्छेद् उद् वा माद्येद् यद् एषो ऽर्वाचीनस्तोमः केशवपनीयो भवत्य् अस्य लोकस्यानुद्धानाय यथा शाखायाः शाखाम् आलम्भम् उपावरोहेद् एवम् एतेनेमं लोकम् उपावरोहति प्रतिष्ठायै
text_mt: When one is consecrated through the Rājasūya, he ascends to the heavenly world. If he should not descend to this world, he would either pass beyond the people or run mad. In that this Keśavapanīya has downward-tending stomas, it is for not leaving this world. Just as one might descend taking hold of branch after branch, so by this he descends to this world, for firm establishment.

sanskrit_iast: indro vṛtram ahan sa viṣyaṅvīryeṇa vyabhraṃśata sa etac chrāyantīyam apaśyat tenātmānaṃ samaśrīṇād indriyeṇa vā eṣa vīryeṇa vyṛdhyate yo rājasūyenābhiṣicyate vṛtraṃ hi hanti yac chrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāma bhavati punar evātmānaṃ saṃśrīṇāti
meaning: इन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहन् स विष्यङ्वीर्येण व्यभ्रंशत स एतच् छ्रायन्तीयम् अपश्यत् तेनात्मानं समश्रीणाद् इन्द्रियेण वा एष वीर्येण व्यृध्यते यो राजसूयेनाभिषिच्यते वृत्रं हि हन्ति यच् छ्रायन्तीयं ब्रह्मसाम भवति पुनर् एवात्मानं संश्रीणाति
text_mt: Indra slew Vṛtra. His virility broke away on all sides. He saw this Śrāyantīya [sāman]; by means of it he reconnected himself. He who is consecrated through the Rājasūya is deprived of sensual power and virility, for he slays Vṛtra. In that the Śrāyantīya is the brahmasāman, he reconnects himself anew.

sanskrit_iast: yajñāyajñīyam anuṣṭubhi bhavati vācā vā eṣa vyṛdhyate yo rājasūyenābhiṣicyate vṛtraṃ hi hanti vāg anuṣṭub vāco raso yajñāyajñīyaṃ vācy evāsya rasaṃ dadhāti
meaning: यज्ञायज्ञीयम् अनुष्टुभि भवति वाचा वा एष व्यृध्यते यो राजसूयेनाभिषिच्यते वृत्रं हि हन्ति वाग् अनुष्टुब् वाचो रसो यज्ञायज्ञीयं वाच्य् एवास्य रसं दधाति
text_mt: The Yajñāyajñīya is in the anuṣṭubh. He who is consecrated through the Rājasūya is deprived of speech, for he slays Vṛtra. Speech is the anuṣṭubh; the essence of speech is the Yajñāyajñīya; he places the essence in his speech.

sanskrit_iast: vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma bhavatīndriyeṇa vā eṣa vīryeṇa vyṛdhyate yo rājasūyenābhiṣicyate vṛtraṃ hi hanti yad vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma bhavatīndriyasya vīryasya parigṛhītyai
meaning: वारवन्तीयम् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवतीन्द्रियेण वा एष वीर्येण व्यृध्यते यो राजसूयेनाभिषिच्यते वृत्रं हि हन्ति यद् वारवन्तीयम् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवतीन्द्रियस्य वीर्यस्य परिगृहीत्यै
text_mt: The Vāravantīya is the agniṣṭomasāman. He who is consecrated through the Rājasūya is deprived of sensual power and virility, for he slays Vṛtra. In that the Vāravantīya is the agniṣṭomasāman, it is for the seizing of sensual power and virility.

sanskrit_iast: aśrayan vāva śrāyantīyenāvārayanta vāravantīyenendriyasya vā eṣā vīryasya parigṛhītiḥ
meaning: अश्रयन् वाव श्रायन्तीयेनावारयन्त वारवन्तीयेनेन्द्रियस्य वा एषा वीर्यस्य परिगृहीतिः
text_mt: They connected [themselves] by the Śrāyantīya; they warded off [evil] by the Vāravantīya; this indeed is the grasping of sensual power and virility.

sanskrit_iast: apratiṣṭhito vā eṣa yo rājasūyenābhiṣicyate yadā vā etena dvirātreṇa yajate 'thaiva pratiṣṭhā
meaning: अप्रतिष्ठितो वा एष यो राजसूयेनाभिषिच्यते यदा वा एतेन द्विरात्रेण यजते ऽथैव प्रतिष्ठा
text_mt: He who is consecrated through the Rājasūya is unestablished. When he sacrifices with this two-day rite, then indeed is firm establishment.

sanskrit_iast: yāvanti saṃvatsarasyāhorātrāṇi tāvatya etāḥ stotrīyāḥ saṃvatsara eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: यावन्ति संवत्सरस्याहोरात्राणि तावत्य एताः स्तोत्रीयाः संवत्सर एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: As many day-and-nights as belong to the year, so many are these strophic verses. He is firmly established in the year itself.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar atirātra uttaraṃ nānaivāhorātrayoḥ pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: अग्निष्टोमः पूर्वम् अहर् अतिरात्र उत्तरं नानैवाहोरात्रयोः प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: The first day is an agniṣṭoma, the second an atirātra; he is firmly established distinctly in the two, the day and the night.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyāṃ pūrvam ahar udriṣṭa uttaraṃ nānaivārdhamāsayoḥ pratitiṣṭhati paurṇamāsyāṃ pūrvam ahar vyaṣṭakāyām uttaraṃ nānaiva māsoḥ pratitiṣṭhati tad āhur ya eva samānapakṣe puṇyāhanī syātāṃ tayor eva kāryaṃ samṛdhyai
meaning: अमावास्यायां पूर्वम् अहर् उद्रिष्ट उत्तरं नानैवार्धमासयोः प्रतितिष्ठति पौर्णमास्यां पूर्वम् अहर् व्यष्टकायाम् उत्तरं नानैव मासोः प्रतितिष्ठति तद् आहुर् य एव समानपक्षे पुण्याहनी स्यातां तयोर् एव कार्यं समृध्यै
text_mt: On the new-moon day the first day [is performed], on the day after the new moon the second; he is firmly established distinctly in the two half-months. On the full-moon day the first day [is performed], on the eighth day after the full moon the second; he is firmly established distinctly in the two months. Regarding this, they say: ‘On whichever two auspicious days should fall in the same fortnight, on those two alone it should be performed, for prosperity.’

sanskrit_iast: apaśavyo dvirātra ity āhur dve hy ete chandasī gāyatraṃ ca traiṣṭubhaṃ ca jagatīm antaryantīti na tena jagatī kṛtā yat tṛtīyasavane kriyate
meaning: अपशव्यो द्विरात्र इत्य् आहुर् द्वे ह्य् एते छन्दसी गायत्रं च त्रैष्टुभं च जगतीम् अन्तर्यन्तीति न तेन जगती कृता यत् तृतीयसवने क्रियते
text_mt: They say: ‘The two-day rite is unpropitious for cattle, for these are two metres, the gāyatrī and the triṣṭubh; they omit the jagatī.’ By that, the jagatī is not made, which is performed at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: yadā vā eṣāhīnasyāhar bhajate sāhvasya vā savanam athaiva jagatī kṛtā traiśokam uttarasyāhno brahmasāma bhavati vaikhānasam acchāvākasāma yac chukriye savane kriyete tenaiva jagatī kṛtā tena paśavyaḥ
meaning: यदा वा एषाहीनस्याहर् भजते साह्वस्य वा सवनम् अथैव जगती कृता त्रैशोकम् उत्तरस्याह्नो ब्रह्मसाम भवति वैखानसम् अच्छावाकसाम यच् छुक्रिये सवने क्रियेते तेनैव जगती कृता तेन पशव्यः
text_mt: When this [rite] shares the day of an ahīna or the pressing of a sāhva, then indeed the jagatī is made. The Traiśoka is the brahmasāman of the second day; the Vaikhānasa is the acchāvākasāman. In that these two are performed at the bright pressing, thereby the jagatī is made; thereby it is propitious for cattle.

sanskrit_iast: vyuṣṭir vā eṣa dvirātro vy evāsmai vāsayati
meaning: व्युष्टिर् वा एष द्विरात्रो व्य् एवास्मै वासयति
text_mt: This two-day rite is indeed daybreak; and so it dawns for him.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa rāṭ
meaning: अथैष राट्

sanskrit_iast: yo rājya āśaṃsamāno rājyaṃ na prāpnuyāt sa etena yajeta rājaivainaṃ rājānaṃ karoti taṃ tu vairājeti vadeyur yaṃ rājā rājānaṃ kuryād rājaivainaṃ rājānaṃ karoti
meaning: यो राज्य आशंसमानो राज्यं न प्राप्नुयात् स एतेन यजेत राजैवैनं राजानं करोति तं तु वैराजेति वदेयुर् यं राजा राजानं कुर्याद् राजैवैनं राजानं करोति
text_mt: He who, aspiring to kingship, should not obtain kingship, should sacrifice with this. The king indeed makes him a king. But him they should call ‘all-ruling’, whom a king should make a king; the king indeed makes him a king.

sanskrit_iast: chando 'nye yajñāḥ saṃpadyante stomam eṣa vīryaṃ vai stomo vīrya evādhy abhiṣicyate
meaning: छन्दो ऽन्ये यज्ञाः संपद्यन्ते स्तोमम् एष वीर्यं वै स्तोमो वीर्य एवाध्य् अभिषिच्यते
text_mt: Other sacrifices correspond to the metre; this one to the stoma. Virility indeed is the stoma; he is consecrated upon virility itself.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāv ekaviṃśāḥ saṃstuto bhavaty aṣṭau vai vīrā rāṣṭraṃ samudyacchanti rājabhrātā ca rājaputraś ca purohitaś ca mahiṣī ca sūtaś ca grāmaṇī ca kṣattā ca saṃgrahītā caite vai vīrā rāṣṭraṃ samudyacchanty eteṣv evādhy abhiṣicyate
meaning: अष्टाव् एकविंशाः संस्तुतो भवत्य् अष्टौ वै वीरा राष्ट्रं समुद्यच्छन्ति राजभ्राता च राजपुत्रश् च पुरोहितश् च महिषी च सूतश् च ग्रामणी च क्षत्ता च संग्रहीता चैते वै वीरा राष्ट्रं समुद्यच्छन्त्य् एतेष्व् एवाध्य् अभिषिच्यते
text_mt: Eight twenty-one-fold stomas are chanted. Eight heroes, indeed, uphold the realm: the king's brother, the king's son, the domestic priest, the chief queen, the charioteer, the village headman, the chamberlain, and the collector. These heroes, indeed, uphold the realm; upon these very ones he is consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: kṣatraṃ vā ekaviṃśaḥ pratiṣṭhā kṣatrasyevāsya prakāśo bhavati pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: क्षत्रं वा एकविंशः प्रतिष्ठा क्षत्रस्येवास्य प्रकाशो भवति प्रतितिष्ठति य एवं वेद
text_mt: The twenty-one-fold stoma is nobility, a firm support. His radiance becomes like that of nobility; he obtains a firm support, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa virāḍ annādyakāmo yajeta
meaning: अथैष विराड् अन्नाद्यकामो यजेत
text_mt: Now this virāj rite: one desiring food should sacrifice [with it].

sanskrit_iast: parokṣam anye yajñā virājaṃ saṃpadyante pratyakṣam eṣa virājaṃ saṃpannaḥ
meaning: परोक्षम् अन्ये यज्ञा विराजं संपद्यन्ते प्रत्यक्षम् एष विराजं संपन्नः
text_mt: Other sacrifices correspond to the virāj indirectly; this one corresponds to the virāj directly.

sanskrit_iast: pratyakṣam etenānnādyam avarundhe 'nnādo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: प्रत्यक्षम् एतेनान्नाद्यम् अवरुन्धे ऽन्नादो भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: Directly through this, he secures food; an eater of food he becomes, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: sarvo daśadaśī bhavati daśākṣarā virāḍ vairājam annam annādyasyāvarudhyai
meaning: सर्वो दशदशी भवति दशाक्षरा विराड् वैराजम् अन्नम् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै
text_mt: Everything consists of tens. The virāj has ten syllables; food is virāj-like, for the securing of food.

sanskrit_iast: tā u pañca pañca bhavanti pāṅkto yajñaḥ pāṅktā paśavo yajña eva paśuṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: ता उ पञ्च पञ्च भवन्ति पाङ्क्तो यज्ञः पाङ्क्ता पशवो यज्ञ एव पशुषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: They are in fives; the sacrifice is fivefold, cattle are fivefold; in the sacrifice itself, in cattle, he finds a firm support.

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva pratiṣṭhākāmo yajeta daśabhir vā idaṃ puruṣaḥ pratiṣṭhito 'syām eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: एतेनैव प्रतिष्ठाकामो यजेत दशभिर् वा इदं पुरुषः प्रतिष्ठितो ऽस्याम् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: One desiring a firm support should sacrifice with this very [rite]. By ten [toes], indeed, man is firmly established here; in this [earth] he firmly establishes himself.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa aupaśadaḥ
meaning: अथैष औपशदः

sanskrit_iast: gandharvāpsarasāṃ stomaḥ prajākāmo yajeta gandharvāpsaraso vai manuṣyasya prajāyā vāprajastāyā veśate teṣām atra somapīthas tān svena bhāgadheyena prīṇāti te 'smai tṛptāḥ prītāḥ prajāṃ prayacchanti
meaning: गन्धर्वाप्सरसां स्तोमः प्रजाकामो यजेत गन्धर्वाप्सरसो वै मनुष्यस्य प्रजाया वाप्रजस्ताया वेशते तेषाम् अत्र सोमपीथस् तान् स्वेन भागधेयेन प्रीणाति ते ऽस्मै तृप्ताः प्रीताः प्रजां प्रयच्छन्ति
text_mt: It is the stoma of the Gandharvas and Apsarases. One desiring offspring should sacrifice [with it]. The Gandharvas and Apsarases rule over a man's offspring or childlessness. Their drink of Soma is here. He gratifies them with their own share; satisfied and pleased, they bestow offspring upon him.

sanskrit_iast: ekaikā stotrīyopajāyate prajām evāsmā upajanayati
meaning: एकैका स्तोत्रीयोपजायते प्रजाम् एवास्मा उपजनयति
text_mt: One stoma-verse at a time is additionally produced; he additionally produces offspring for him.

sanskrit_iast: kakubhaṃ prācīm udūhati puruṣo vai kakub garbha eva sa madhyato dhīyate
meaning: ककुभं प्राचीम् उदूहति पुरुषो वै ककुब् गर्भ एव स मध्यतो धीयते
text_mt: He pushes the kakubh forward. Man is the kakubh; it is placed in the middle as an embryo.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad eṣā dvipadā kakubho loke kriyate garbha eva tad dhi taṃ prajanayati
meaning: अथ यद् एषा द्विपदा ककुभो लोके क्रियते गर्भ एव तद् धि तं प्रजनयति
text_mt: And that this two-verse hymn is made in the place of the kakubh, it is an embryo; thereby he brings it to birth.

sanskrit_iast: cyāvanaṃ bhavati prajātir vai cyāvanam
meaning: च्यावनं भवति प्रजातिर् वै च्यावनम्
text_mt: The Cyāvana sāman is used; the Cyāvana is procreation.

sanskrit_iast: prajāyate bahur bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: प्रजायते बहुर् भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He procreates and becomes numerous, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭhasya janitre bhavato vasiṣṭho vā ete putrahataḥ sāmanī apaśyat sa prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata yad ete sāmanī bhavataḥ prajātyai
meaning: वसिष्ठस्य जनित्रे भवतो वसिष्ठो वा एते पुत्रहतः सामनी अपश्यत् स प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायत यद् एते सामनी भवतः प्रजात्यै
text_mt: The two Janitra sāmans of Vasiṣṭha are used. Vasiṣṭha, when his sons had been slain, saw these two sāmans. He procreated with offspring and cattle. That these two sāmans are used is for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: dve saṃstutānāṃ virājam atiricyete dve striyā ūne prajananāya prajananam eva tat kriyate prajātyai
meaning: द्वे संस्तुतानां विराजम् अतिरिच्येते द्वे स्त्रिया ऊने प्रजननाय प्रजननम् एव तत् क्रियते प्रजात्यै
text_mt: Two verses of the chants of praise exceed the virāj; two are lacking in a woman for procreation; procreation itself is thereby brought about for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa punaḥstomaḥ
meaning: अथैष पुनःस्तोमः

sanskrit_iast: yo bahu pratigṛhya garagīr iva manyeta sa etena yajeta
meaning: यो बहु प्रतिगृह्य गरगीर् इव मन्येत स एतेन यजेत
text_mt: One who, having accepted much, should consider himself as having swallowed poison, should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: yaikādaśī yad eva pūrvavayase bahu pratigṛhṇāti yad garaṃ girati yad anannam atti prātaḥsavanāya tan niharati
meaning: यैकादशी यद् एव पूर्ववयसे बहु प्रतिगृह्णाति यद् गरं गिरति यद् अनन्नम् अत्ति प्रातःसवनाय तन् निहरति
text_mt: The eleventh [verse]: whatever he accepts in large quantity in early life, whatever poison he swallows, whatever improper food he eats, that he removes for the morning pressing.

sanskrit_iast: atha yā dvādaśī yad evottaravayase bahu pratigṛhṇati yad garaṃ girati yad anannam atti tṛtīyasavanāya tan niharati
meaning: अथ या द्वादशी यद् एवोत्तरवयसे बहु प्रतिगृह्णति यद् गरं गिरति यद् अनन्नम् अत्ति तृतीयसवनाय तन् निहरति
text_mt: And the twelfth: whatever he accepts in large quantity in later life, whatever poison he swallows, whatever improper food he eats, that he removes for the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: vairājo vai puruṣaḥ sa madhyato 'śuddho madhyata evainaṃ pāpmano muñcati
meaning: वैराजो वै पुरुषः स मध्यतो ऽशुद्धो मध्यत एवैनं पाप्मनो मुञ्चति
text_mt: Man is virāj-like; he is impure in the middle; from the middle he frees him from evil.

sanskrit_iast: śuddhāśuddhīye bhavataḥ
meaning: शुद्धाशुद्धीये भवतः
text_mt: The two Śuddhāśuddhīya sāmans are used.

sanskrit_iast: indro yatīn sālāvṛkeyebhyaḥ prāyacchat tam aślīlā vāg abhyavadat so 'śuddho 'manyata sa ete śuddhāśuddhīye apaśyat tābhyām aśudhyat
meaning: इन्द्रो यतीन् सालावृकेयेभ्यः प्रायच्छत् तम् अश्लीला वाग् अभ्यवदत् सो ऽशुद्धो ऽमन्यत स एते शुद्धाशुद्धीये अपश्यत् ताभ्याम् अशुध्यत्
text_mt: Indra gave the Yatis over to the hyenas. An unseemly voice reproached him. He considered himself impure. He saw these two Śuddhāśuddhīya sāmans; by means of them he became pure.

sanskrit_iast: yad eva bahu pratigṛhṇāti yad garaṃ girati yad anannam atti yad aśuddho manyate tad etābhyāṃ śudhyati
meaning: यद् एव बहु प्रतिगृह्णाति यद् गरं गिरति यद् अनन्नम् अत्ति यद् अशुद्धो मन्यते तद् एताभ्यां शुध्यति
text_mt: Whatever he accepts in large quantity, whatever poison he swallows, whatever improper food he eats, whatever he considers impure, by these two he is purified of that.

sanskrit_iast: gauṣūktaṃ cāśvasūktaṃ ca bhavataḥ
meaning: गौषूक्तं चाश्वसूक्तं च भवतः
text_mt: The Gauṣūkta and Aśvasūkta sāmans are used.

sanskrit_iast: gauṣūktiś cāśvasūktiś ca bahu pratigṛhya garagirāv amanyetāṃ tāv ete sāmanī apaśyatāṃ tābhyāṃ garaṃ niraghnātām
meaning: गौषूक्तिश् चाश्वसूक्तिश् च बहु प्रतिगृह्य गरगिराव् अमन्येतां ताव् एते सामनी अपश्यतां ताभ्यां गरं निरघ्नाताम्
text_mt: Gauṣūkti and Aśvasūkti, having accepted much, considered themselves as having swallowed poison. They saw these two sāmans; by means of them they struck away the poison.

sanskrit_iast: yad eva bahu pratigṛhṇāti yad garaṃ girati yad anannam atti tad etābhyāṃ nirhate
meaning: यद् एव बहु प्रतिगृह्णाति यद् गरं गिरति यद् अनन्नम् अत्ति तद् एताभ्यां निर्हते
text_mt: Whatever he accepts in large quantity, whatever poison he swallows, whatever improper food he eats, that he removes by these two.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśa stotrāṇi bhavanty ojo vīryaṃ pañcadaśaḥ pāpmana evainaṃ muktvaujasā vīryeṇa samardhayati
meaning: पञ्चदश स्तोत्राणि भवन्त्य् ओजो वीर्यं पञ्चदशः पाप्मन एवैनं मुक्त्वौजसा वीर्येण समर्धयति
text_mt: There are fifteen chants of praise. The fifteenfold stoma is vigour and valour. Having freed him from evil, he strengthens him with vigour and valour.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa catuṣṭomaḥ
meaning: अथैष चतुष्टोमः

sanskrit_iast: paśukāmo yajeta
meaning: पशुकामो यजेत

sanskrit_iast: yac catasṛbhir bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ paśūn evāvarundhe
meaning: यच् चतसृभिर् बहिष्पवमानं भवति चतुष्पादाः पशवः पशून् एवावरुन्धे
text_mt: In that the Bahiṣpavamāna consists of four verses, cattle are four-footed; he secures cattle.

sanskrit_iast: yad aṣṭābhir ājyāny aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavaḥ śaphaśas tat paśūn āpnoti
meaning: यद् अष्टाभिर् आज्यान्य् अष्टाशफाः पशवः शफशस् तत् पशून् आप्नोति
text_mt: In that the ājyastotras consist of eight [verses], cattle have eight hoofs; hoof by hoof he obtains cattle.

sanskrit_iast: yat dvādaśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamāno dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsaraṃ paśavo 'nu prajāyante tān evāvarundhe
meaning: यत् द्वादशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमानो द्वादश मासाः संवत्सरः संवत्सरं पशवो ऽनु प्रजायन्ते तान् एवावरुन्धे
text_mt: In that the midday Pavamāna is twelvefold, the year has twelve months; cattle bring forth following the year; these he secures.

sanskrit_iast: yat ṣoḍaśāni pṛṣṭhāni ṣoḍaśa kalāḥ paśavaḥ kalāśas tat paśūn āpnoti
meaning: यत् षोडशानि पृष्ठानि षोडश कलाः पशवः कलाशस् तत् पशून् आप्नोति
text_mt: In that the pṛṣṭhas are sixteenfold, cattle have sixteen parts; part by part he obtains cattle.

sanskrit_iast: yad viṃśa ārbhavaḥ pāṅktatvam eṣāṃ tad āpnoti
meaning: यद् विंश आर्भवः पाङ्क्तत्वम् एषां तद् आप्नोति
text_mt: In that the Ārbhava is twentyfold, he obtains thereby their fivefold nature.

sanskrit_iast: yac caturviṃśo 'gniṣṭomaś caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī teja eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe
meaning: यच् चतुर्विंशो ऽग्निष्टोमश् चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा गायत्री तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं गायत्री तेज एव ब्रह्मवर्चसम् अवरुन्धे
text_mt: In that the Agniṣṭoma is twenty-four-fold, the gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables; the gāyatrī is fiery splendour and brahminical lustre; he secures fiery splendour and brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇo gāyatrī prajananaṃ prāṇād eva gāyatryāḥ prajāyate
meaning: प्राणो गायत्री प्रजननं प्राणाद् एव गायत्र्याः प्रजायते
text_mt: Breath is the gāyatrī, procreation; from breath, indeed, from the gāyatrī, he procreates.

sanskrit_iast: ekaṃ sāma bahūni chandāṃsi tasmād eko bahūn poṣān puṣyati
meaning: एकं साम बहूनि छन्दांसि तस्माद् एको बहून् पोषान् पुष्यति
text_mt: There is one sāman, many metres; therefore one person supports many nourished [dependents].

sanskrit_iast: ātmā vā agniṣṭomaḥ paśavaś chandāṃsy ātmany eva tat paśūn pratiṣṭhāpayati noktho nāgniṣṭomo na hi grāmyāḥ paśavo nāraṇyāḥ
meaning: आत्मा वा अग्निष्टोमः पशवश् छन्दांस्य् आत्मन्य् एव तत् पशून् प्रतिष्ठापयति नोक्थो नाग्निष्टोमो न हि ग्राम्याः पशवो नारण्याः
text_mt: The Agniṣṭoma is the self; the metres are cattle; he establishes cattle in the self. There is neither an Uktha nor not an Agniṣṭoma, for cattle are neither domestic nor wild.

sanskrit_iast: atha yasya catvāri stotrāṇi catasṛbhiś catvāry aṣṭābhiś catvāri dvādaśabhiś catvāri ṣoḍaśabhiḥ sa gāṃ nātivadati
meaning: अथ यस्य चत्वारि स्तोत्राणि चतसृभिश् चत्वार्य् अष्टाभिश् चत्वारि द्वादशभिश् चत्वारि षोडशभिः स गां नातिवदति
text_mt: Now he whose chants of praise are four with four verses, four with eight, four with twelve, four with sixteen, he does not speak beyond a cow.

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśakalāḥ paśavaḥ kalāśas tat paśūn āpnoti
meaning: षोडशकलाः पशवः कलाशस् तत् पशून् आप्नोति
text_mt: Cattle have sixteen parts; part by part he obtains cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśimān bhavati paśavo vā ukthāni vajraḥ ṣoḍaśī vajreṇaivāsmai paśūn parigṛhṇāty anapakrāmukā asmāt paśavo bhavanti noktho nātirātro na hi grāmyāḥ paśavo nāraṇyāḥ
meaning: उक्थ्यः षोडशिमान् भवति पशवो वा उक्थानि वज्रः षोडशी वज्रेणैवास्मै पशून् परिगृह्णात्य् अनपक्रामुका अस्मात् पशवो भवन्ति नोक्थो नातिरात्रो न हि ग्राम्याः पशवो नारण्याः
text_mt: It is an ukthya having a ṣoḍaśin. The ukthas are cattle; the ṣoḍaśin is the thunderbolt; by means of the thunderbolt he encloses cattle for him. Cattle do not depart from him. There is neither an Uktha nor an atirātra, for cattle are neither domestic nor wild.

sanskrit_iast: asurāṇāṃ vai balas tamasā prāvṛto 'śmāpidhānaś cāsīt tasmin gavyaṃ vasv antar āsīt taṃ devā nāśaknuvan bhettuṃ te bṛhaspatim abruvann imān na utsṛjeti sa udbhidaiva balaṃ vyacyāvayad balabhidābhinat tān utsedhenaivodasṛjan niṣedhena paryagṛhṇāt
meaning: असुराणां वै बलस् तमसा प्रावृतो ऽश्मापिधानश् चासीत् तस्मिन् गव्यं वस्व् अन्तर् आसीत् तं देवा नाशक्नुवन् भेत्तुं ते बृहस्पतिम् अब्रुवन्न् इमान् न उत्सृजेति स उद्भिदैव बलं व्यच्यावयद् बलभिदाभिनत् तान् उत्सेधेनैवोदसृजन् निषेधेन पर्यगृह्णात्
text_mt: The cave Bala belonging to the Asuras was covered in darkness and had a stone for a lid. Inside it was bovine wealth. The gods were not able to split it. They said to Bṛhaspati: "Release these for us." By the Udbhid he loosened Bala; by the Balabhid he split it. By the Utsedha he drove them out; by the Niṣedha he enclosed them.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāmo yajeta
meaning: पशुकामो यजेत

sanskrit_iast: yad udbhidā yajeta balam evasmai vicyāvayati yad balabhidā balam evāsmai bhinatti
meaning: यद् उद्भिदा यजेत बलम् एवस्मै विच्यावयति यद् बलभिदा बलम् एवास्मै भिनत्ति
text_mt: When he sacrifices with the Udbhid, he loosens Bala for him; when with the Balabhid, he splits Bala for him.

sanskrit_iast: utsedhaniṣedhau brahmasāmanī bhavata utsedhenaivāsmai paśūn utsidhya niṣedhena parigṛhṇāti
meaning: उत्सेधनिषेधौ ब्रह्मसामनी भवत उत्सेधेनैवास्मै पशून् उत्सिध्य निषेधेन परिगृह्णाति
text_mt: The Utsedha and Niṣedha are the two Brahman-sāmans; having driven out cattle for him by the Utsedha, he encloses them by the Niṣedha.

sanskrit_iast: yajña indram avardhayad iti brahmaṇa ājyaṃ rūpeṇa samṛddham
meaning: यज्ञ इन्द्रम् अवर्धयद् इति ब्रह्मण आज्यं रूपेण समृद्धम्
text_mt: "The sacrifice strengthened Indra": this is the ājyastotra of the Brahman, complete in its characteristic form.

sanskrit_iast: saptisaptadaśau bhavato yat saptabhiḥ stuvanti sapta grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ paśūn evāvarūndhe saptapadā śakvarī paśavaḥ śakvarī paśūn evāvarūndhe 'tha yat saptadaśabhiḥ prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim evāpnoti
meaning: सप्तिसप्तदशौ भवतो यत् सप्तभिः स्तुवन्ति सप्त ग्राम्याः पशवः पशून् एवावरून्धे सप्तपदा शक्वरी पशवः शक्वरी पशून् एवावरून्धे ऽथ यत् सप्तदशभिः प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोति
text_mt: They are a sevenfold and a seventeenfold stoma. In that they praise with seven verses, domestic cattle are seven; he secures cattle. The Śakvarī has seven feet; the Śakvarī is cattle; he secures cattle. Now in that [they praise] with seventeen, Prajāpati is seventeenfold; he obtains Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṃ saṃpadyate tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī teja eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe prāṇo gāyatrī prajananaṃ prāṇād eva gāyatryāḥ prajāyate
meaning: गायत्रीं संपद्यते तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं गायत्री तेज एव ब्रह्मवर्चसम् अवरुन्धे प्राणो गायत्री प्रजननं प्राणाद् एव गायत्र्याः प्रजायते
text_mt: It corresponds to the gāyatrī. The gāyatrī is fiery splendour and brahminical lustre; he secures fiery splendour and brahminical lustre. Breath is the gāyatrī, procreation; from breath, indeed, from the gāyatrī, he procreates.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣo 'pacitir apacitikāmo yajetāpacityaivāsmā apacitiṃ vindati
meaning: अथैषो ऽपचितिर् अपचितिकामो यजेतापचित्यैवास्मा अपचितिं विन्दति
text_mt: Now this Apaciti rite. One desiring honour should sacrifice [with it]; by means of honour he gains honour for him.

sanskrit_iast: tasya caturviṃśau pavamānau caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī tejasaivāsmai brahmavarcasenāpacitiṃ vindati
meaning: तस्य चतुर्विंशौ पवमानौ चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा गायत्री तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं गायत्री तेजसैवास्मै ब्रह्मवर्चसेनापचितिं विन्दति
text_mt: Its two Pavamāna chants are twenty-four-fold. The gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables; the gāyatrī is fiery splendour and brahminical lustre; through fiery splendour and brahminical lustre he gains honour for him.

sanskrit_iast: ubhe bṛhadrathantare bhavata ubhābhyām evāsmai bṛhadrathantarābhyām apacitiṃ vindati
meaning: उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे भवत उभाभ्याम् एवास्मै बृहद्रथन्तराभ्याम् अपचितिं विन्दति
text_mt: Both the Bṛhat and the Rathantara are [used]; through both, the Bṛhat and the Rathantara, he procures respect for him.

sanskrit_iast: bhargayaśasī bhavato bhargeṇaivāsmai bhargo dadhāti yaśasā yaśaḥ
meaning: भर्गयशसी भवतो भर्गेणैवास्मै भर्गो दधाति यशसा यशः
text_mt: The Bharga and the Yaśas are [used]; through the Bharga he bestows brilliance on him, through the Yaśas [he bestows] renown.

sanskrit_iast: ubhaye stomā yugmantaś cāyujaś cobhayair evāsmai stomair apacitiṃ vindati
meaning: उभये स्तोमा युग्मन्तश् चायुजश् चोभयैर् एवास्मै स्तोमैर् अपचितिं विन्दति
text_mt: Both kinds of stomas [are used], even-ending and odd; through both kinds of stomas he procures respect for him.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur vilomāna stomā īśvarā yajamānaṃ vikṣetor vi hy atiyantīti
meaning: तद् आहुर् विलोमान स्तोमा ईश्वरा यजमानं विक्षेतोर् वि ह्य् अतियन्तीति
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'The stomas are contradictory; they are capable of injuring the sacrificer, for they diverge.'

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśo 'gniṣṭomo bhavati pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśo 'ntata eva yajñasya pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: एकविंशो ऽग्निष्टोमो भवति प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंशो ऽन्तत एव यज्ञस्य प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: The Agniṣṭoma is twenty-one-fold; the twenty-one-fold stoma is a firm support; he firmly establishes himself at the very end of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa sarvastomo 'pacitir apacitikāmo yajeta sarvair evāsmai stomair apacitiṃ vindati
meaning: अथैष सर्वस्तोमो ऽपचितिर् अपचितिकामो यजेत सर्वैर् एवास्मै स्तोमैर् अपचितिं विन्दति
text_mt: Now this Apaciti is all-stoma; he who desires respect should sacrifice [with it]; through all the stomas he procures respect for him.

sanskrit_iast: virājaṃ saṃpadyata eṣa vā apacito yo 'nnādo 'nnaṃ virāḍ annādyam evāsmin dadhāti
meaning: विराजं संपद्यत एष वा अपचितो यो ऽन्नादो ऽन्नं विराड् अन्नाद्यम् एवास्मिन् दधाति
text_mt: It amounts to the virāj; he indeed is respected who eats food; the virāj is food; he bestows food on him.

sanskrit_iast: ubhe bṛhadrathantare bhavato bhargayaśasī bhavata ubhaye stomāś chandomāś ca pṛṣṭhyāś cobhayair evāsmai stomair apacitiṃ vindati
meaning: उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे भवतो भर्गयशसी भवत उभये स्तोमाश् छन्दोमाश् च पृष्ठ्याश् चोभयैर् एवास्मै स्तोमैर् अपचितिं विन्दति
text_mt: Both the Bṛhat and the Rathantara are [used]; the Bharga and the Yaśas are [used]; both kinds of stomas [are used], the Chandomas and the Pṛṣṭhyas; through both kinds of stomas he procures respect for him.

sanskrit_iast: tasya chandomāḥ pṛṣṭhāni paśavo vai chandomā annaṃ pṛṣṭhāny abhipūrvam evāsminn annādyaṃ paśūn dadhāti yac chandomavāṃs tena dvādaśāhayājinam āpnoti
meaning: तस्य छन्दोमाः पृष्ठानि पशवो वै छन्दोमा अन्नं पृष्ठान्य् अभिपूर्वम् एवास्मिन्न् अन्नाद्यं पशून् दधाति यच् छन्दोमवांस् तेन द्वादशाहयाजिनम् आप्नोति
text_mt: Its pṛṣṭhas are the Chandomas; the Chandomas are cattle, the pṛṣṭhas are food; he bestows food [and] cattle on him in succession; because it possesses Chandomas, thereby he equals one who sacrifices with the twelve-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur nānālokāḥ stomāś chandomāś ca pṛṣṭhyāś ca yad ekasmin yajñakratau samavarudhyanta īśvaro yajamāno 'pratiṣṭhātor iti
meaning: तद् आहुर् नानालोकाः स्तोमाश् छन्दोमाश् च पृष्ठ्याश् च यद् एकस्मिन् यज्ञक्रतौ समवरुध्यन्त ईश्वरो यजमानो ऽप्रतिष्ठातोर् इति
text_mt: Regarding this they say: 'The stomas, both Chandomas and Pṛṣṭhyas, belong to different worlds; when they are combined in one sacrifice, the sacrificer is liable to be deprived of a firm support.'

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśo 'gniṣṭomo bhavati pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśaḥ pratiṣṭhām eva tad abhyāyanti
meaning: एकविंशो ऽग्निष्टोमो भवति प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंशः प्रतिष्ठाम् एव तद् अभ्यायन्ति
text_mt: The Agniṣṭoma is twenty-one-fold; the twenty-one-fold stoma is indeed a firm support; thereby they attain a firm support.

sanskrit_iast: pakṣī vā eṣa stomaḥ
meaning: पक्षी वा एष स्तोमः

sanskrit_iast: pakṣy eṣa nidhīyate
meaning: पक्ष्य् एष निधीयते

sanskrit_iast: na vā apakṣaḥ pakṣiṇam āpnoty atha yad eṣa pakṣy apakṣiṇi nidhīyate tasmāt pakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaiḥ patanti
meaning: न वा अपक्षः पक्षिणम् आप्नोत्य् अथ यद् एष पक्ष्य् अपक्षिणि निधीयते तस्मात् पक्षिणः पक्षैः पतन्ति
text_mt: The wingless does not reach the winged; now, since this winged [stoma] is placed on the wingless, therefore winged [creatures] fly with wings.

sanskrit_iast: pakṣī jyotiṣmān puṇyān lokān saṃcarati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: पक्षी ज्योतिष्मान् पुण्यान् लोकान् संचरति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He who knows this moves winged, possessing light, through the virtuous worlds.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtāv abhito bhavatas tejo brahmavarcasaṃ trivṛt teja eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe
meaning: त्रिवृताव् अभितो भवतस् तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं त्रिवृत् तेज एव ब्रह्मवर्चसम् अवरुन्धे
text_mt: There are two ninefold stomas on both sides; the ninefold stoma is splendour [and] brahminical lustre; he secures splendour [and] brahminical lustre.

sanskrit_iast: atha pañcadaśau vīryaṃ vai pañcadaśo vīryam evāvarundhe
meaning: अथ पञ्चदशौ वीर्यं वै पञ्चदशो वीर्यम् एवावरुन्धे
text_mt: Then there are two fifteenfold stomas; the fifteenfold stoma is virility; he secures virility.

sanskrit_iast: atha saptadaśau paśavo vai saptadaśaḥ paśūn evāvarundhe
meaning: अथ सप्तदशौ पशवो वै सप्तदशः पशून् एवावरुन्धे
text_mt: Then there are two seventeenfold stomas; the seventeenfold stoma is cattle; he secures cattle.

sanskrit_iast: athaikaviṃśau pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśo madhyata eva yajñasya pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: अथैकविंशौ प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंशो मध्यत एव यज्ञस्य प्रतितिष्ठति
