sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tā asmāt sṛṣṭāḥ parācya āyan natsyati na iti bibhyatyaḥ so 'bravīd upa mā vartadhvaṃ tathā vai vo 'tsyāmi yathādyamānā bhūyasyaḥ prajaniṣyatha iti tābhyo vainaṃ ṛtaṃ brūhīty abruvaṃs tābhya ṛtanidhanenartam abravīd īnidhanenāvayat triṇidhanena prājanayad etair ha vā idaṃ sāmabhir mṛtyuḥ prajā atti ca prajanayati
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत ता अस्मात् सृष्टाः पराच्य आयन् नत्स्यति न इति बिभ्यत्यः सो ऽब्रवीद् उप मा वर्तध्वं तथा वै वो ऽत्स्यामि यथाद्यमाना भूयस्यः प्रजनिष्यथ इति ताभ्यो वैनं ऋतं ब्रूहीत्य् अब्रुवंस् ताभ्य ऋतनिधनेनर्तम् अब्रवीद् ईनिधनेनावयत् त्रिणिधनेन प्राजनयद् एतैर् ह वा इदं सामभिर् मृत्युः प्रजा अत्ति च प्रजनयति
text_mt: Prajāpati created creatures. Once created from him, they moved away, fearing: 'He will eat us!' He said: 'Turn towards me! I will eat you only in such a way that, while being eaten, you will be born forth more abundantly.' They said to him: 'Speak the cosmic order to us.' To them he spoke the cosmic order with the ṛta-cadence, he made them grow with the ī-cadence, [and] he caused them to be born forth with the tri-cadence. By these sāmans indeed Death eats creatures and causes them to be born forth.

sanskrit_iast: adyamānasya bhūyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: अद्यमानस्य भूयो भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: There is an increase of what is being eaten for one who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: jyeṣṭhasāmāni vā etāni śreṣṭhasāmāni prajāpatisāmāni
meaning: ज्येष्ठसामानि वा एतानि श्रेष्ठसामानि प्रजापतिसामानि
text_mt: These are indeed the elder-sāmans, the best-sāmans, the sāmans of Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: gacchati jyaiṣṭhayaṃ śraiṣṭhayaṃ ya evaṃ veda
meaning: गच्छति ज्यैष्ठयं श्रैष्ठयं य एवं वेद
text_mt: He who knows thus attains seniority and pre-eminence.

sanskrit_iast: etair vai sāmabhiḥ prajāpatir imān lokān sarvān kāmān dugdhe yad ācyā dugdhe tad ācyā dohānām ācyā dohatvam
meaning: एतैर् वै सामभिः प्रजापतिर् इमान् लोकान् सर्वान् कामान् दुग्धे यद् आच्या दुग्धे तद् आच्या दोहानाम् आच्या दोहत्वम्
text_mt: By these sāmans Prajāpati indeed milks all desires from these worlds. Because he milks them by stretching, that is the stretch-milking nature of the stretch-milkings.

sanskrit_iast: sarvān imān lokān kāmān dugdhe ya evaṃ vidvān etais sāmabhiḥ stute
meaning: सर्वान् इमान् लोकान् कामान् दुग्धे य एवं विद्वान् एतैस् सामभिः स्तुते
text_mt: He milks all desires from these worlds who, knowing thus, chants with these sāmans.

sanskrit_iast: ime vai lokā etāni sāmāny ayam evartanidhanam antarikṣam īnidhanaṃ dyaus triṇidhanam
meaning: इमे वै लोका एतानि सामान्य् अयम् एवर्तनिधनम् अन्तरिक्षम् ईनिधनं द्यौस् त्रिणिधनम्
text_mt: These worlds are indeed these sāmans: this [earth] is the ṛta-cadence, the intermediate space is the ī-cadence, the sky is the tri-cadence.

sanskrit_iast: yathā kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrāṇy anusañcaraty evam imān lokān anusañcarati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: यथा क्षेत्रज्ञः क्षेत्राण्य् अनुसञ्चरत्य् एवम् इमान् लोकान् अनुसञ्चरति य एवं वेद
text_mt: Just as one who knows the fields traverses the fields, so he traverses these worlds who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: agner vā etāni vaiśvānarasya sāmāni yatra vā etair aśāntaiḥ stuvanti tat prajā devo ghātuko bhavaty agnim upanidhāya stuvate svāyā eva tad devatāyāḥ sāmyekṣāya namaskṛtyodgāyati śāntais stuvanti
meaning: अग्नेर् वा एतानि वैश्वानरस्य सामानि यत्र वा एतैर् अशान्तैः स्तुवन्ति तत् प्रजा देवो घातुको भवत्य् अग्निम् उपनिधाय स्तुवते स्वाया एव तद् देवतायाः साम्येक्षाय नमस्कृत्योद्गायति शान्तैस् स्तुवन्ति
text_mt: These are indeed the sāmans of Agni Vaiśvānara. Where they chant with these when not pacified, there the god becomes destructive to creatures. Having placed a fire near, they chant; having paid homage to his own deity for direct perception, the udgātṛ sings. They chant with [sāmans] that are pacified.

sanskrit_iast: vāg vai śabalī tasyās trirātro vatsas trirātro vā etāṃ pradāpayati
meaning: वाग् वै शबली तस्यास् त्रिरात्रो वत्सस् त्रिरात्रो वा एतां प्रदापयति
text_mt: Speech is indeed the dappled cow (Śabalī); her calf is the three-day rite. The three-day rite indeed causes her to give milk.

sanskrit_iast: tad ya evaṃ veda tasmā eṣā prattā dugdhe
meaning: तद् य एवं वेद तस्मा एषा प्रत्ता दुग्धे
text_mt: Therefore, she, being given, yields milk for him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: yo 'lam annādyāya sann athānnaṃ nādyāt
meaning: यो ऽलम् अन्नाद्याय सन्न् अथान्नं नाद्यात्
text_mt: One who, being capable of [enjoying] food, yet should not eat food,

sanskrit_iast: barāsīṃ paridhāya taptaṃ piban dvādaśa rātrīr adhaḥ śayīta
meaning: बरासीं परिधाय तप्तं पिबन् द्वादश रात्रीर् अधः शयीत
text_mt: having put on a coarse hemp garment, drinking hot [water], should lie on the ground for twelve nights.

sanskrit_iast: yā dvādaśī syāt tasyā upavyuṣaṃ śabalīhomaṃ hutvā purā vāgbhyaḥ sampravaditor yatra grāmyasya paśor nāśṛṇuyāt tad araṇyaṃ paretya darbhastambam ālabhya śabali śabalīti trir āhvayed yad anyac chunaś ca gardabhāc ca prativāśyate sā samṛddhā
meaning: या द्वादशी स्यात् तस्या उपव्युषं शबलीहोमं हुत्वा पुरा वाग्भ्यः सम्प्रवदितोर् यत्र ग्राम्यस्य पशोर् नाशृणुयात् तद् अरण्यं परेत्य दर्भस्तम्बम् आलभ्य शबलि शबलीति त्रिर् आह्वयेद् यद् अन्यच् छुनश् च गर्दभाच् च प्रतिवाश्यते सा समृद्धा
text_mt: On whichever is the twelfth, at dawn, having offered the Śabalī-oblation before voices sound forth, having gone out to the wilderness where he would not hear [the sound of] a domestic animal, taking hold of a clump of darbha grass, he should call out thrice: 'O Śabalī! O Śabalī!' If anything other than a dog or a donkey answers with a cry, it has succeeded.

sanskrit_iast: yadi na prativāśyeta saṃvatsare punar āhvayeta
meaning: यदि न प्रतिवाश्येत संवत्सरे पुनर् आह्वयेत
text_mt: If no answer should be made with a cry, he should call out again after a year.

sanskrit_iast: śabali samudro 'si viśvavyacā brahma devānāṃ prathamajā ṛtasyānnam asi śukram asi tejo 'sy amṛtam asi tāṃ tvā vidma śabali dīdyānāṃ tasyāste pṛthivī pādo 'ntarikṣaṃ pādo dyauḥ pādaḥ samudraḥ pāda eṣāsi śabali tāṃ tvā vidma sā na iṣam ūrjaṃ dhukṣva vasordhārāṃ śabali prajānāṃ śaciṣṭhā vratam anugeṣaṃ svāhā
meaning: शबलि समुद्रो ऽसि विश्वव्यचा ब्रह्म देवानां प्रथमजा ऋतस्यान्नम् असि शुक्रम् असि तेजो ऽस्य् अमृतम् असि तां त्वा विद्म शबलि दीद्यानां तस्यास्ते पृथिवी पादो ऽन्तरिक्षं पादो द्यौः पादः समुद्रः पाद एषासि शबलि तां त्वा विद्म सा न इषम् ऊर्जं धुक्ष्व वसोर्धारां शबलि प्रजानां शचिष्ठा व्रतम् अनुगेषं स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O Śabalī, you are the ocean, all-encompassing, sacred lore, first-born of the gods, of cosmic order! You are food, you are seed, you are brilliance, you are immortality! As such, shining brightly, we know you, O Śabalī. Of you, the earth is a foot, the intermediate space is a foot, the sky is a foot, the ocean is a foot. Such are you, O Śabalī; as such we know you. As such, milk for us nourishment and vigour, a stream of wealth, O Śabalī, most mighty of creatures! May I follow the observance. Svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: catuṣṭomo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśa ukthyaḥ sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ
meaning: चतुष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंश उक्थ्यः सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः
text_mt: The agniṣṭoma has the fourfold stoma, the ukthya has the twenty-one-fold stoma, the atirātra has all the stomas.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpater vā akṣy aśvat tat parāpatat tad aśvo 'bhavat tad aśvasyāśvatvaṃ tad devā aśvamedhena pratyadadhur eṣa vāva prajāpatiṃ sarvaṃ karoti yo 'śvamedhena yajate
meaning: प्रजापतेर् वा अक्ष्य् अश्वत् तत् परापतत् तद् अश्वो ऽभवत् तद् अश्वस्याश्वत्वं तद् देवा अश्वमेधेन प्रत्यदधुर् एष वाव प्रजापतिं सर्वं करोति यो ऽश्वमेधेन यजते
text_mt: Prajāpati's eye swelled; it fell away. It became a horse; that is the horse-nature of the horse. The gods restored it by means of the horse sacrifice. He indeed makes Prajāpati whole who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa vāva saśarīraḥ sambhavaty amuṣmai lokāyayo 'śvamedhī
meaning: एष वाव सशरीरः सम्भवत्य् अमुष्मै लोकाययो ऽश्वमेधी
text_mt: He indeed comes into being with a body for that world who performs the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: saraghā vā aśvasya sakthy āvṛhat tad devāś catuṣṭomena pratyadadhur yac catuṣṭomo bhavaty aśvasya sarvatvāya
meaning: सरघा वा अश्वस्य सक्थ्य् आवृहत् तद् देवाश् चतुष्टोमेन प्रत्यदधुर् यच् चतुष्टोमो भवत्य् अश्वस्य सर्वत्वाय
text_mt: A bee tore out the horse's thigh. The gods restored it by means of the fourfold stoma. In that there is the fourfold stoma, it is for the completeness of the horse.

sanskrit_iast: yat tisro 'nuṣṭubhaś catasro gāyatrīḥ karoti tasmāt tribhis tiṣṭhan pratitiṣṭhati sarvān palāyamānaḥ pratidadhāti
meaning: यत् तिस्रो ऽनुष्टुभश् चतस्रो गायत्रीः करोति तस्मात् त्रिभिस् तिष्ठन् प्रतितिष्ठति सर्वान् पलायमानः प्रतिदधाति
text_mt: In that he makes three anuṣṭubhs and four gāyatrīs, therefore, standing on three [legs], it stands firmly; running, it sets down all [four].

sanskrit_iast: anto vā aśvaḥ paśūnām anto 'nuṣṭup chandasām anto viṣṇur devatānām antaś catuṣṭomas stomānām antas trirātro yajñānāṃ yad vaiplavyo 'nuṣṭubhaḥ pratipado bhavanti catuṣṭoma stomas trirātro yajño 'nta eva tadantaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: अन्तो वा अश्वः पशूनाम् अन्तो ऽनुष्टुप् छन्दसाम् अन्तो विष्णुर् देवतानाम् अन्तश् चतुष्टोमस् स्तोमानाम् अन्तस् त्रिरात्रो यज्ञानां यद् वैप्लव्यो ऽनुष्टुभः प्रतिपदो भवन्ति चतुष्टोम स्तोमस् त्रिरात्रो यज्ञो ऽन्त एव तदन्तं प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: The horse is the end of cattle, the anuṣṭubh is the end of metres, Viṣṇu is the end of deities, the fourfold stoma is the end of stomas, the three-day rite is the end of sacrifices. In that floating anuṣṭubhs are the introductory verses, the fourfold stoma is the stoma, and the three-day rite is the sacrifice, he thereby establishes the end upon the end.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśam ahar bhavati yasminn aśva ālabhyata ekaviṃśo vā ito 'sāv ādityo dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśa ādityasyaivainaṃ mātrāṃ gamayati
meaning: एकविंशम् अहर् भवति यस्मिन्न् अश्व आलभ्यत एकविंशो वा इतो ऽसाव् आदित्यो द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंश आदित्यस्यैवैनं मात्रां गमयति
text_mt: The day on which the horse is immolated is twenty-one-fold. That sun is indeed the twenty-first from here: twelve months, five seasons, these three worlds, [and] that sun as the twenty-first. He causes him to attain the very measure of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: tasya mahānāmnyaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavanti
meaning: तस्य महानाम्न्यः पृष्ठं भवन्ति
text_mt: The Mahānāmnī [verses] are its pṛṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast: anyad anyad vā etāś chando 'nyonya ete paśava ālabhyanta etā vā etaṃ samāpnuvanti yan mahānāmnyaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavanty aśvasya sarvatvāya
meaning: अन्यद् अन्यद् वा एताश् छन्दो ऽन्योन्य एते पशव आलभ्यन्त एता वा एतं समाप्नुवन्ति यन् महानाम्न्यः पृष्ठं भवन्त्य् अश्वस्य सर्वत्वाय
text_mt: These metres are of various kinds; these various cattle are immolated. These [verses] indeed encompass this [sacrifice]. In that the Mahānāmnī [verses] are the pṛṣṭha, it is for the completeness of the horse.

sanskrit_iast: pārthuraśmaṃ brahmasāma bhavati
meaning: पार्थुरश्मं ब्रह्मसाम भवति
text_mt: The Pārthuraśma is the brahmasāman.

sanskrit_iast: īśvaro vā eṣo 'yato 'dhṛtaḥ parāṃ parāvatam eto raśminā vā aśvo dhṛto yat pārthuraśmaṃ brahmasāma bhavaty aśvasyaiva yatyai
meaning: ईश्वरो वा एषो ऽयतो ऽधृतः परां परावतम् एतो रश्मिना वा अश्वो धृतो यत् पार्थुरश्मं ब्रह्मसाम भवत्य् अश्वस्यैव यत्यै
text_mt: This [horse], if unrestrained and unheld, is capable of going to the farthest distance. The horse is indeed held by a rein (raśmi). In that the Pārthuraśma is the brahmasāman, it is for the holding of the horse.

sanskrit_iast: sarvastomo 'tirātro bhavati sarvasyāptyai sarvasya jityai sarvam evaitenāpnoti sarvaṃ jayati
meaning: सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवति सर्वस्याप्त्यै सर्वस्य जित्यै सर्वम् एवैतेनाप्नोति सर्वं जयति
text_mt: The atirātra has all the stomas, for the attainment of all, for the conquest of all. By this he indeed attains all, he conquers all.

sanskrit_iast: ekayūpo vaikādaśinī vānyeṣāṃ yajñānāṃ bhavaty ekaviṃśiny aśvamedhasya khādiro vā bailvo vā pārṇo vā 'nyeṣāṃ yajñānāṃ bhavati naicudāra ekaviṃśatyaratnir aśvamedhasya nānyeṣāṃ paśūnāṃ tejanyā avadyanty avadyanty aśvamedhasya dakṣiṇato 'nyeṣāṃ paśūnām avadyanty uttarato 'śvamedhasya plakṣaśākhāsv anyeṣāṃ paśūnām avadyanti vetasaśākhāsv aśvamedhasya yūpe grāmyān paśūn niyuñjanty ārokeṣv āraṇyān dhārayanty ā grāmyān paśūn labhante prāraṇyān sṛjanti
meaning: एकयूपो वैकादशिनी वान्येषां यज्ञानां भवत्य् एकविंशिन्य् अश्वमेधस्य खादिरो वा बैल्वो वा पार्णो वा ऽन्येषां यज्ञानां भवति नैचुदार एकविंशत्यरत्निर् अश्वमेधस्य नान्येषां पशूनां तेजन्या अवद्यन्त्य् अवद्यन्त्य् अश्वमेधस्य दक्षिणतो ऽन्येषां पशूनाम् अवद्यन्त्य् उत्तरतो ऽश्वमेधस्य प्लक्षशाखास्व् अन्येषां पशूनाम् अवद्यन्ति वेतसशाखास्व् अश्वमेधस्य यूपे ग्राम्यान् पशून् नियुञ्जन्त्य् आरोकेष्व् आरण्यान् धारयन्त्य् आ ग्राम्यान् पशून् लभन्ते प्रारण्यान् सृजन्ति
text_mt: In other sacrifices there is either a single post or a set of eleven posts; in the horse sacrifice there is a set of twenty-one posts. In other sacrifices [the post] is made of khadira, or bilva, or palāśa wood; in the horse sacrifice it is made of naicudāra wood and is twenty-one cubits long. In the case of other animals they do not cut [the portions] on a reed mat, [but] in the horse sacrifice they do cut [them on a reed mat]. In the case of other animals they cut the portions on the south side, [but] in the horse sacrifice on the north side. In the case of other animals they cut the portions on plakṣa branches, [but] in the horse sacrifice on vetasa branches. To the sacrificial post they tie the domestic animals, [and] in the intervals they hold the wild animals. They seize the domestic animals; they set free the wild animals.

sanskrit_iast: trayas trivṛto 'tirātrāḥ sarve ṣoḍaśimantaḥ
meaning: त्रयस् त्रिवृतो ऽतिरात्राः सर्वे षोडशिमन्तः
text_mt: There are three ninefold atirātras, all possessing the ṣoḍaśin.

sanskrit_iast: yo rājya āśaṃseta sa etena yajeta
meaning: यो राज्य आशंसेत स एतेन यजेत
text_mt: He who aspires to kingship should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: rājā vā eṣa stomānāṃ rājyam evāsmin dadhāti
meaning: राजा वा एष स्तोमानां राज्यम् एवास्मिन् दधाति
text_mt: This indeed is the king among the stomas; he establishes kingship in him.

sanskrit_iast: yadākṣārāṇi prathamam ahar bhajanta ekākṣarā vai vāg vāco 'nativādāya
meaning: यदाक्षाराणि प्रथमम् अहर् भजन्त एकाक्षरा वै वाग् वाचो ऽनतिवादाय
text_mt: When they share monosyllabic [sāmans] on the first day, speech is indeed monosyllabic, for the non-overstepping of speech.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat dvyakṣaraṇidhanam ājyadohaṃ bhavaty uttarayor ahor abhisantatyā anvaham ājyadohāni bhavanty anvaham evainaṃ paśubhiḥ samardhayanti
meaning: अथ यत् द्व्यक्षरणिधनम् आज्यदोहं भवत्य् उत्तरयोर् अहोर् अभिसन्तत्या अन्वहम् आज्यदोहानि भवन्त्य् अन्वहम् एवैनं पशुभिः समर्धयन्ति
text_mt: Now, that the ājyadoha sāman has a disyllabic cadence is for the continuous connection of the two subsequent days. Day by day there are ājyadoha sāmans; day by day they provide him with cattle.

sanskrit_iast: sarve ṣoḍaśimanto bhavantīndriyaṃ vīryaṃ ṣoḍaśīndriyeṇaivainān vīryeṇa samardhayati
meaning: सर्वे षोडशिमन्तो भवन्तीन्द्रियं वीर्यं षोडशीन्द्रियेणैवैनान् वीर्येण समर्धयति
text_mt: All [days] possess the ṣoḍaśin. The ṣoḍaśin is power [and] virility; he provides them with power and virility.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśāḥ pavamānās trivṛnty ājyāni pañcadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomaś catuścatvāriṃśāḥ pavamānāḥ pañcadaśāny ājyāni saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāny ekaviṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ soktho 'ṣṭācatvāriṃśāḥ pavamānā ekaviṃśāny ājyāni triṇavāni pṛṣṭhāni trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśāny ukthāni saṣoḍaśikāni pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiś chandomapavamānaḥ
meaning: चतुर्विंशाः पवमानास् त्रिवृन्त्य् आज्यानि पञ्चदशानि पृष्ठानि सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमश् चतुश्चत्वारिंशाः पवमानाः पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि सप्तदशानि पृष्ठान्य् एकविंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः सोक्थो ऽष्टाचत्वारिंशाः पवमाना एकविंशान्य् आज्यानि त्रिणवानि पृष्ठानि त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंशान्य् उक्थानि सषोडशिकानि पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिश् छन्दोमपवमानः
text_mt: The pavamānas are twenty-four-fold; the ājyastotras are ninefold; the pṛṣṭhas are fifteenfold; the agniṣṭoma is seventeenfold. [On the second day,] the pavamānas are forty-four-fold; the ājyastotras are fifteenfold; the pṛṣṭhas are seventeenfold; the agniṣṭoma is twenty-one-fold with ukthas. [On the third day,] the pavamānas are forty-eight-fold; the ājyastotras are twenty-one-fold; the pṛṣṭhas are twenty-seven-fold; the agniṣṭoma is thirty-three-fold; the ukthas are twenty-one-fold together with the ṣoḍaśin; the night is fifteenfold; the sandhi is ninefold: [this is] the Chandomapavamāna rite.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāmo yajet
meaning: पशुकामो यजेत्

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai chandomā yac chandomāḥ pavamānā bhavanti paśūnevāvarūndhe
meaning: पशवो वै छन्दोमा यच् छन्दोमाः पवमाना भवन्ति पशूनेवावरून्धे
text_mt: The chandomas are indeed cattle. Since the pavamānas are chandomas, he secures cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ubhaye stomā yugmantaś cāyujaś ca tat mithunaṃ tasmān mithunāt prajāyate
meaning: उभये स्तोमा युग्मन्तश् चायुजश् च तत् मिथुनं तस्मान् मिथुनात् प्रजायते
text_mt: Both stomas are [used], the even and the odd. That is a pair; from that pair he propagates.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛt prātassavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ saptadaśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ caturviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ catuścatvāriṃśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam aṣṭācatvāriṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ soktham ekaviṃśaṃ prātassavanan triṇavaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ trayastriṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ soktham ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhir antarvasuḥ
meaning: त्रिवृत् प्रातस्सवनं पञ्चदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं सप्तदशं तृतीयसवनं चतुर्विंशं प्रातस्सवनं चतुश्चत्वारिंशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् अष्टाचत्वारिंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थम् एकविंशं प्रातस्सवनन् त्रिणवं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं त्रयस्त्रिंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थम् एकविंशः षोडशी पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिर् अन्तर्वसुः
text_mt: The morning pressing is ninefold, the midday pressing fifteenfold, the third pressing seventeenfold. [On the second day,] the morning pressing is twenty-four-fold, the midday pressing forty-four-fold, the third pressing forty-eight-fold with ukthas. [On the third day,] the morning pressing is twenty-one-fold, the midday pressing twenty-seven-fold, the third pressing thirty-three-fold with ukthas; the ṣoḍaśin is twenty-one-fold, the night is fifteenfold, the sandhi is ninefold: [this is] the Antarvasu rite.

sanskrit_iast: ime lokās trirātraḥ
meaning: इमे लोकास् त्रिरात्रः

sanskrit_iast: astīva vā ayaṃ loko 'stīvāsau chidram ivāntarikṣam
meaning: अस्तीव वा अयं लोको ऽस्तीवासौ छिद्रम् इवान्तरिक्षम्
text_mt: This world is, as it were, solid; that [world] is, as it were, solid; the intermediate space is, as it were, a void.

sanskrit_iast: astīva trirātrasya prathamam ahar astīvottamaṃ chidram iva madhyataḥ
meaning: अस्तीव त्रिरात्रस्य प्रथमम् अहर् अस्तीवोत्तमं छिद्रम् इव मध्यतः
text_mt: The first day of the three-day period is, as it were, solid; the last [day] is, as it were, solid; in the middle it is, as it were, a void.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai chandomā yac chandomā madhyato bhavanty apihityā evācchidratāyai
meaning: पशवो वै छन्दोमा यच् छन्दोमा मध्यतो भवन्त्य् अपिहित्या एवाच्छिद्रतायै
text_mt: The chandomas are indeed cattle. That the chandomas are in the middle is for filling [the void], for voidlessness.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛt prātassavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ saptadaśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ ekaviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ triṇavaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ trayastriṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ sokthaṃ caturviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ catuścatvāriṃśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam aṣṭācatvāriṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ soktham ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ parākaḥ
meaning: त्रिवृत् प्रातस्सवनं पञ्चदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं सप्तदशं तृतीयसवनं एकविंशं प्रातस्सवनं त्रिणवं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं त्रयस्त्रिंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थं चतुर्विंशं प्रातस्सवनं चतुश्चत्वारिंशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् अष्टाचत्वारिंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थम् एकविंशः षोडशी पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः पराकः
text_mt: The morning pressing is ninefold, the midday pressing fifteenfold, the third pressing seventeenfold. [On the second day,] the morning pressing is twenty-one-fold, the midday pressing twenty-seven-fold, the third pressing thirty-three-fold with ukthas. [On the third day,] the morning pressing is twenty-four-fold, the midday pressing forty-four-fold, the third pressing forty-eight-fold with ukthas; the ṣoḍaśin is twenty-one-fold, the night is fifteenfold, the sandhi is ninefold: [this is] the Parāka rite.

sanskrit_iast: parākeṇa vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokamāyan svargakāmo yajeta parāṅ evaitena svargaṃ lokam ākramate
meaning: पराकेण वै देवाः स्वर्गं लोकमायन् स्वर्गकामो यजेत पराङ् एवैतेन स्वर्गं लोकम् आक्रमते
text_mt: By means of the Parāka the gods went to the world of heaven. One who desires heaven should sacrifice [with it]; directly, indeed, does he stride to the world of heaven by this.

sanskrit_iast: yad vā etasyākaṃ tad asya parāk tat parākasya parākatvam
meaning: यद् वा एतस्याकं तद् अस्य पराक् तत् पराकस्य पराकत्वम्
text_mt: Now, what is pain for him, that is departed from him; that is the departedness of the Parāka.

sanskrit_iast: na vai tatra jagmuṣe kiñcanā'kam
meaning: न वै तत्र जग्मुषे किञ्चनाऽकम्
text_mt: For him who has gone thither, there is no pain whatsoever.

sanskrit_iast: nāsmā akaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: नास्मा अकं भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: No pain comes to him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: prajāyās tv akḷptaḥ parāṅ hy evaitena svargaṃ lokam ākramate tad yad ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī bhavati pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhis tenāsmin loke pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: प्रजायास् त्व् अकॢप्तः पराङ् ह्य् एवैतेन स्वर्गं लोकम् आक्रमते तद् यद् एकविंशः षोडशी भवति पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिस् तेनास्मिन् लोके प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: However, it is unsuited for offspring, for directly does he stride to the world of heaven by this. In that the ṣoḍaśin is twenty-one-fold, the night fifteenfold, and the sandhi ninefold, he thereby stands firmly in this world.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśāḥ pavamānās trivṛnty ājyāni pañcadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomaś caturviṃśāḥ pavamānāḥ pañcadaśāny ājyāni saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāny ekaviṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ sokthaś caturviṃśāḥ pavamānāḥ saptadaśāny ājyāny ekaviṃśani pṛṣṭhāni triṇavo 'gniṣṭomaḥ sokthaś caturviṃśāḥ pavamānā ekaviṃśāny ājyāni triṇavāni pṛṣṭhāni trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśāny ukthāni saṣoḍaśikāni pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhi
meaning: चतुर्विंशाः पवमानास् त्रिवृन्त्य् आज्यानि पञ्चदशानि पृष्ठानि सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमश् चतुर्विंशाः पवमानाः पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि सप्तदशानि पृष्ठान्य् एकविंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः सोक्थश् चतुर्विंशाः पवमानाः सप्तदशान्य् आज्यान्य् एकविंशनि पृष्ठानि त्रिणवो ऽग्निष्टोमः सोक्थश् चतुर्विंशाः पवमाना एकविंशान्य् आज्यानि त्रिणवानि पृष्ठानि त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंशान्य् उक्थानि सषोडशिकानि पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धि
text_mt: The pavamānas are twenty-four-fold, the ājyastotras ninefold, the pṛṣṭhas fifteenfold, the agniṣṭoma seventeenfold. [On the second day,] the pavamānas are twenty-four-fold, the ājyastotras fifteenfold, the pṛṣṭhas seventeenfold, the agniṣṭoma twenty-one-fold with ukthas. [On the third day,] the pavamānas are twenty-four-fold, the ājyastotras seventeenfold, the pṛṣṭhas twenty-one-fold, the agniṣṭoma twenty-seven-fold with ukthas. [On the fourth day,] the pavamānas are twenty-four-fold, the ājyastotras twenty-one-fold, the pṛṣṭhas twenty-seven-fold, the agniṣṭoma thirty-three-fold, the ukthas twenty-one-fold together with the ṣoḍaśin, the night fifteenfold, the sandhi ninefold.

sanskrit_iast: atrir akāmayata catvāro me vīrā ājāyerann iti sa etam apaśyat tasya catvāro vīrā ājāyantāsya catvāro vīrā jāyante ya evaṃ veda
meaning: अत्रिर् अकामयत चत्वारो मे वीरा आजायेरन्न् इति स एतम् अपश्यत् तस्य चत्वारो वीरा आजायन्तास्य चत्वारो वीरा जायन्ते य एवं वेद
text_mt: Atri desired: "May four heroes be born to me!" He saw this [rite]; four heroes were born to him. Four heroes are born to him who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: ekaṃ stomam utsṛjyaikam abhyārabhate vīrajananaṃ vai stomo vīram evāsmai tat prajanayati
meaning: एकं स्तोमम् उत्सृज्यैकम् अभ्यारभते वीरजननं वै स्तोमो वीरम् एवास्मै तत् प्रजनयति
text_mt: Setting aside one stoma, he takes up another. The stoma is indeed the procreation of a hero; thus he procreates a hero for him.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśāḥ pavamānā bhavanti caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī prajananaṃ gāyatrī prajātyai
meaning: चतुर्विंशाः पवमाना भवन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा गायत्री प्रजननं गायत्री प्रजात्यै
text_mt: The pavamānas are twenty-four-fold. The gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables. The gāyatrī is procreation, for propagation.

sanskrit_iast: ubhaye stomā yugmantaś cāyujaś ca tan mithunaṃ tasmān mithunāt prajāyate
meaning: उभये स्तोमा युग्मन्तश् चायुजश् च तन् मिथुनं तस्मान् मिथुनात् प्रजायते
text_mt: Both stomas are [used], the even and the odd. That is a pair; from that pair he propagates.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomaḥ prathamam ahar ūktho dvitīyaṃ ṣoḍaśī tṛtīyam atirātraś caturthaṃ nānāvīryatāyai
meaning: अग्निष्टोमः प्रथमम् अहर् ऊक्थो द्वितीयं षोडशी तृतीयम् अतिरात्रश् चतुर्थं नानावीर्यतायै
text_mt: The first day is an agniṣṭoma, the second an ukthya, the third a ṣoḍaśin, the fourth an atirātra, for the sake of different powers.

sanskrit_iast: nānāvīryāṇy ahāni karoti
meaning: नानावीर्याण्य् अहानि करोति
text_mt: He makes the days of different powers.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ vai prathamam ahas traiṣṭubhaṃ dvitīyaṃ jāgataṃ tṛtīyam ānuṣṭubhaṃ caturtham
meaning: गायत्रं वै प्रथमम् अहस् त्रैष्टुभं द्वितीयं जागतं तृतीयम् आनुष्टुभं चतुर्थम्
text_mt: The first day belongs to the gāyatrī, the second to the triṣṭubh, the third to the jagatī, the fourth to the anuṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yat tṛtīye 'hani ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇīyus tṛtīyenāhnānuṣṭubham āpnuyur acchandaś caturtham ahaḥ syād ānuṣṭubho vai ṣoḍaśīti
meaning: तद् आहुर् यत् तृतीये ऽहनि षोडशिनं गृह्णीयुस् तृतीयेनाह्नानुष्टुभम् आप्नुयुर् अच्छन्दश् चतुर्थम् अहः स्याद् आनुष्टुभो वै षोडशीति
text_mt: Concerning this they say: "If they were to take the ṣoḍaśi-cup on the third day, they would reach the anuṣṭubh on the third day, and the fourth day would be without a metre, for the ṣoḍaśin belongs to the anuṣṭubh."

sanskrit_iast: caturthe 'hani ṣoḍaśī grahītavyaḥ sva āyatane ṣoḍaśī gṛhyate
meaning: चतुर्थे ऽहनि षोडशी ग्रहीतव्यः स्व आयतने षोडशी गृह्यते
text_mt: On the fourth day the ṣoḍaśi-cup is to be taken; the ṣoḍaśin is taken in its own abode.

sanskrit_iast: chandobhir ahāni nānāvīryāṇi karoti
meaning: छन्दोभिर् अहानि नानावीर्याणि करोति
text_mt: Through the metres he makes the days of different powers.

sanskrit_iast: naudhasaṃ prathamasyāhno brahmasāma śyaitaṃ dvitīyasya śrāyantīyaṃ tṛtīyasya traiśokaṃ caturthasya
meaning: नौधसं प्रथमस्याह्नो ब्रह्मसाम श्यैतं द्वितीयस्य श्रायन्तीयं तृतीयस्य त्रैशोकं चतुर्थस्य
text_mt: The Naudhasa is the brahmasāman of the first day, the Śyaita of the second, the Śrāyantīya of the third, the Traiśoka of the fourth.

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur apabhraṃśa iva vā eṣa yat jyāyasaḥ chandaso 'dhi kanīyaś chanda upaitīti
meaning: तद् आहुर् अपभ्रंश इव वा एष यत् ज्यायसः छन्दसो ऽधि कनीयश् छन्द उपैतीति
text_mt: Concerning this they say: "It is indeed like a descent when one passes from a greater metre to a smaller metre."

sanskrit_iast: tadyadeṣā caturthe'hanyatijagatī kriyate'napabhraṃśāya
meaning: तद्यदेषा चतुर्थेऽहन्यतिजगती क्रियतेऽनपभ्रंशाय
text_mt: Therefore, this atijagatī is employed on the fourth day, to prevent a descent.

sanskrit_iast: kāleyaṃ prathamasyāho 'cchāvākasāma mādhucchandasaṃ dvitīyasya rauravaṃ tṛtīyasya samantaṃ caturthasya nānāvīryatāyai nānāvīryāṇy ahāni karoti
meaning: कालेयं प्रथमस्याहो ऽच्छावाकसाम माधुच्छन्दसं द्वितीयस्य रौरवं तृतीयस्य समन्तं चतुर्थस्य नानावीर्यतायै नानावीर्याण्य् अहानि करोति
text_mt: The Kāleya is the acchāvākasāman of the first day, the Mādhucchandasa of the second, the Raurava of the third, the Samanta of the fourth, for the sake of different powers; he makes the days of different powers.

sanskrit_iast: abhitvā vṛṣabhā suta iti tṛtīyasyāhno rathantaraṃ kastam indra tvā vasava iti vāmadevyaṃ yajñā yathā apūrva iti caturthasyāhno bṛhat ed u madhor madintaram iti vāmadevyaṃ chandasāṃ nānāvīryatāyai nānāvīryāṇy ahāni kāroti
meaning: अभित्वा वृषभा सुत इति तृतीयस्याह्नो रथन्तरं कस्तम् इन्द्र त्वा वसव इति वामदेव्यं यज्ञा यथा अपूर्व इति चतुर्थस्याह्नो बृहत् एद् उ मधोर् मदिन्तरम् इति वामदेव्यं छन्दसां नानावीर्यतायै नानावीर्याण्य् अहानि कारोति
text_mt: On "To thee, the bull, pressed out" is the Rathantara of the third day; on "Who, O Indra, to thee, the Vasus" is the Vāmadevya. On "O sacrifices, as non-precedented" is the Bṛhat of the fourth day; on "Come, of the mead most exhilarating" is the Vāmadevya; for the sake of different powers of the metres, he makes the days of different powers.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛt pañcadaśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ prathamam ahaḥ
meaning: त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशो ऽग्निष्टोमः प्रथमम् अहः
text_mt: The first day is a ninefold and fifteenfold agniṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast: athottarasyāhnoś caturviṃśaṃ vahiṣpavamānaṃ pañcadaśāni trīṇy ājyāni saptadaśam acchāvākasyaikaviṃśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamānaḥ saptadaśe dve pṛṣṭhe ekaviṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃṃ soktham
meaning: अथोत्तरस्याह्नोश् चतुर्विंशं वहिष्पवमानं पञ्चदशानि त्रीण्य् आज्यानि सप्तदशम् अच्छावाकस्यैकविंशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमानः सप्तदशे द्वे पृष्ठे एकविंशं तृतीयसवनंं सोक्थम्
text_mt: Then, for the next day, the Bahiṣpavamāna is twenty-four-fold; three ājyastotras are fifteenfold, [that] of the acchāvāka is seventeenfold; the Mādhyandina Pavamāna is twenty-one-fold; two pṛṣṭhas are seventeenfold; the third pressing is twenty-one-fold, having ukthas.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyasyāhna ekaviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ trīṇi cājyāni pañcadaśam acchāvākasya caturviṃśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamāna ekaviṃśāni pṛṣṭhāni triṇavaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ dve cokthe ekaviṃśam acchāvākasya
meaning: तृतीयस्याह्न एकविंशं बहिष्पवमानं त्रीणि चाज्यानि पञ्चदशम् अच्छावाकस्य चतुर्विंशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमान एकविंशानि पृष्ठानि त्रिणवं तृतीयसवनं द्वे चोक्थे एकविंशम् अच्छावाकस्य
text_mt: For the third day, the Bahiṣpavamāna is twenty-one-fold, and three ājyastotras [are twenty-one-fold], [that] of the acchāvāka is fifteenfold; the Mādhyandina Pavamāna is twenty-four-fold; the pṛṣṭhas are twenty-one-fold; the third pressing is twenty-seven-fold, and [so are] two ukthas, [while that] of the acchāvāka is twenty-one-fold.

sanskrit_iast: caturthasyāhnaś caturviśāḥ pavamānāḥ pañcadaśaṃ hotur ājyaṃ saptadaśāni trīṇy ekaviṃśāni pṛṣṭhāni trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśāny ukthāni saṣoḍaśikāni pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
meaning: चतुर्थस्याह्नश् चतुर्विशाः पवमानाः पञ्चदशं होतुर् आज्यं सप्तदशानि त्रीण्य् एकविंशानि पृष्ठानि त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंशान्य् उक्थानि सषोडशिकानि पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
text_mt: For the fourth day, the pavamānas are twenty-four-fold; the hotṛ's ājyastotra is fifteenfold, three [ājyastotras] are seventeenfold; the pṛṣṭhas are twenty-one-fold; the agniṣṭoma [chant] is thirty-three-fold; the ukthas are twenty-one-fold, with a sixteenfold chant; the night is fifteenfold; the twilight chant is ninefold.

sanskrit_iast: jamadagniḥ puṣṭikāma etam āharat sa imān poṣān apuṣyat
meaning: जमदग्निः पुष्टिकाम एतम् आहरत् स इमान् पोषान् अपुष्यत्
text_mt: Jamadagni, desirous of prosperity, brought this [rite]. He prospered with these prosperities.

sanskrit_iast: yad idam āhur navā ūrvau palitau sañjānāte iti
meaning: यद् इदम् आहुर् नवा ऊर्वौ पलितौ सञ्जानाते इति
text_mt: As to what they say here: 'Two new grey thighs agree with one another'—

sanskrit_iast: tat sarvān evaitena poṣān puṣyati
meaning: तत् सर्वान् एवैतेन पोषान् पुष्यति
text_mt: thus he prospers with all prosperities by this [rite].

sanskrit_iast: jagatī chandobhiḥ sampadyate
meaning: जगती छन्दोभिः सम्पद्यते
text_mt: It corresponds to the jagatī through the metres.

sanskrit_iast: jagatī vai chandasāṃ paramaṃ poṣaṃ puṣṭā paramam evaite poṣaṃ puṣyati
meaning: जगती वै छन्दसां परमं पोषं पुष्टा परमम् एवैते पोषं पुष्यति
text_mt: The jagatī, indeed, among the metres has prospered with supreme prosperity; he indeed prospers with supreme prosperity by this [rite].

sanskrit_iast: puroḍāśinya upasado bhavanti paśavo vai puroḍāśāḥ paśuṣveva pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: पुरोडाशिन्य उपसदो भवन्ति पशवो वै पुरोडाशाः पशुष्वेव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: The upasads have sacrificial cakes. The sacrificial cakes are indeed cattle; they firmly establish themselves in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: agne ver hotra ver adhvaram āpitaraṃ vaiśvānaram avase 'kar indrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: अग्ने वेर् होत्र वेर् अध्वरम् आपितरं वैश्वानरम् अवसे ऽकर् इन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O Agni, accept the hotṛ's office, accept the sacrifice; you have made Vaiśvānara an ally for aid; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: devāv aśvinau madhukaśayādyemaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānāya mimikṣatam indrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: देवाव् अश्विनौ मधुकशयाद्येमं यज्ञं यजमानाय मिमिक्षतम् इन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O divine Aśvins, sprinkle today this sacrifice for the sacrificer with your honey-whip; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: deva viṣṇa urv adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyādhi vikramasvendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: देव विष्ण उर्व् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायाधि विक्रमस्वेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O divine Viṣṇu, stride widely today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: deva soma retodhā adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyaidhīndrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: देव सोम रेतोधा अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायैधीन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O divine Soma, be the placer of seed today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: deva savitaḥ susāvitram adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāsuvasvendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: देव सवितः सुसावित्रम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानासुवस्वेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O divine Savitṛ, bestow good impulse today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: deva dhātaḥ sudhātādyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyaidhīndrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: देव धातः सुधाताद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायैधीन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O divine Dhātṛ, be a good supporter today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: devā grāvāṇo madhumatīm adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāya vācaṃ vadatendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: देवा ग्रावाणो मधुमतीम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानाय वाचं वदतेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O divine pressing-stones, speak today in this sacrifice a honey-rich speech for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: devy anumate 'nvadyemaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānāya manyasvendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: देव्य् अनुमते ऽन्वद्येमं यज्ञं यजमानाय मन्यस्वेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O divine Anumati, approve today this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: devy adite svādityām adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyāsuvasvendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: देव्य् अदिते स्वादित्याम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायासुवस्वेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O divine Aditi, impel good Aditi-like care today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: devya āpo nannamyadhvam adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: देव्य आपो नन्नम्यध्वम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O divine Waters, bend down repeatedly today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: sadassadaḥ prajāvān ṛbhur juṣāṇa indrāya devebhyo juhutā havis svāhā
meaning: सदस्सदः प्रजावान् ऋभुर् जुषाण इन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविस् स्वाहा
text_mt: 'Seated in the sadas, rich in offspring, let the Ṛbhu, being pleased, sacrifice the oblation for Indra, for the gods, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: deva tvaṣṭaḥ suretodhā adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyaidhīndrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
meaning: देव त्वष्टः सुरेतोधा अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायैधीन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
text_mt: 'O divine Tvaṣṭṛ, be a placer of good seed today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: āgneya ekakapāla āśvino dvikapālo vaiṣṇavas trikapālaḥ saumyaś catuṣkapālaḥ sāvitraḥ pañcakapālo dhātraḥ ṣaṭkapālo mārūtaḥ saptakapālo bārhaspatyo 'ṣṭākapālo maitro navakapālo vārūṇo daśakapāla aindra ekādaśakapālo vaiśvadevo dvādaśakapālaḥ
meaning: आग्नेय एककपाल आश्विनो द्विकपालो वैष्णवस् त्रिकपालः सौम्यश् चतुष्कपालः सावित्रः पञ्चकपालो धात्रः षट्कपालो मारूतः सप्तकपालो बार्हस्पत्यो ऽष्टाकपालो मैत्रो नवकपालो वारूणो दशकपाल ऐन्द्र एकादशकपालो वैश्वदेवो द्वादशकपालः
text_mt: There is a single-cup cake for Agni, a two-cup cake for the Aśvins, a three-cup cake for Viṣṇu, a four-cup cake for Soma, a five-cup cake for Savitṛ, a six-cup cake for Dhātṛ, a seven-cup cake for the Maruts, an eight-cup cake for Bṛhaspati, a nine-cup cake for Mitra, a ten-cup cake for Varuṇa, an eleven-cup cake for Indra, a twelve-cup cake for the All-Gods.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛta prātassavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ saptadaśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ prātassavanaṃ saptadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam ekaviṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ sokthaṃ saptadaśaṃ prātassavanam ekaviṃśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ triṇavaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ soktham ekaviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ triṇavaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ trayastriṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ pratyavarohīṇy ukthāni triṇavaṃ prathamaṃ dve ekaviṃśe saṣoḍaśike pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
meaning: त्रिवृत प्रातस्सवनं पञ्चदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं सप्तदशं तृतीयसवनं पञ्चदशं प्रातस्सवनं सप्तदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् एकविंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थं सप्तदशं प्रातस्सवनम् एकविंशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं त्रिणवं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थम् एकविंशं प्रातस्सवनं त्रिणवं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं त्रयस्त्रिंशं तृतीयसवनं प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उक्थानि त्रिणवं प्रथमं द्वे एकविंशे सषोडशिके पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
text_mt: The morning pressing is ninefold, the midday pressing is fifteenfold, the third pressing is seventeenfold; the morning pressing is fifteenfold, the midday pressing is seventeenfold, the third pressing is twenty-one-fold, having ukthas; the morning pressing is seventeenfold, the midday pressing is twenty-one-fold, the third pressing is twenty-seven-fold, having ukthas; the morning pressing is twenty-one-fold, the midday pressing is twenty-seven-fold, the third pressing is thirty-three-fold; the ukthas are descending: the first is twenty-seven-fold, two are twenty-one-fold, with a sixteenfold chant; the night is fifteenfold; the twilight chant is ninefold.

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭhaḥ putrahato hīna ivāmanyata sa etam apaśyat so 'graṃ paryaid yo hīna iva manyeta sa etena yajeta
meaning: वसिष्ठः पुत्रहतो हीन इवामन्यत स एतम् अपश्यत् सो ऽग्रं पर्यैद् यो हीन इव मन्येत स एतेन यजेत
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha, his son having been slain, considered himself as if bereft. He saw this [rite]; he attained the summit. He who considers himself as if bereft should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: yat stomāt stomam abhisaṃkrāmaty agrād evāgraṃ rohati vasiṣṭhasya janitre bhavataḥ prajātyai
meaning: यत् स्तोमात् स्तोमम् अभिसंक्रामत्य् अग्राद् एवाग्रं रोहति वसिष्ठस्य जनित्रे भवतः प्रजात्यै
text_mt: Because he transitions from stoma to stoma, he ascends from summit to summit. The two [sāmans] of Vasiṣṭha's birth-place are [used] for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: pratyavarohīṇy uttamasyāhna ukthāni bhavanti pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उत्तमस्याह्न उक्थानि भवन्ति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: The ukthas of the last day are descending, for firm establishment.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthaḥ saptadaśa uktha ekaviṃśo 'tirātro viśvāmitrasya sañjayaḥ
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थः सप्तदश उक्थ एकविंशो ऽतिरात्रो विश्वामित्रस्य सञ्जयः
text_mt: A ninefold agniṣṭoma, a fifteenfold uktha, a seventeenfold uktha, a twenty-one-fold atirātra—[this is] Viśvāmitra's complete victory.

sanskrit_iast: jahnuvṛcīvanto rāṣṭra āhiṃsanta sa viśvāmitro jāhnavo rājaitam apaśyat sa rāṣṭram abhavad arāṣṭram itare
meaning: जह्नुवृचीवन्तो राष्ट्र आहिंसन्त स विश्वामित्रो जाह्नवो राजैतम् अपश्यत् स राष्ट्रम् अभवद् अराष्ट्रम् इतरे
text_mt: The Jahnus and the Vṛcīvants were contending for the kingdom. King Viśvāmitra, the descendant of Jahnu, saw this [rite]. He became the kingdom; the others became kingdomless.

sanskrit_iast: bhrātṛvyavān yajeta
meaning: भ्रातृव्यवान् यजेत

sanskrit_iast: bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He thrives in himself; his rival is defeated, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: jyotir vā eṣa vihṛtaḥ
meaning: ज्योतिर् वा एष विहृतः

sanskrit_iast: jyotiḥ prajānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: ज्योतिः प्रजानां भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He becomes the light of creatures, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: catuṣṭomo vā eṣa catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: चतुष्टोमो वा एष चतुष्पादाः पशवः पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: This is a four-stoma [rite]. Cattle are four-footed. He firmly establishes himself in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśaṃ stomā nātiyanti pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśo 'ntata eva yajñasya pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: एकविंशं स्तोमा नातियन्ति प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंशो ऽन्तत एव यज्ञस्य प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: The stomas do not exceed the twenty-one-fold. The twenty-one-fold [stoma] is indeed a firm standing; at the end of the sacrifice, he firmly establishes himself.

sanskrit_iast: dve trivṛtī savane pañcadaśam ekaṃ dve pañcadaśe savane saptadaśam ekaṃ dve saptadaśe savane ekaviṃśam ekaṃ dve ekaviṃśe savane triṇavam ekaṃ dve triṇave savane trayastriṃśam ekaṃ pratyavarohīṇy ukthāni triṇavaṃ prathamaṃ dve ekaviṃśe saṣoḍaśike pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
meaning: द्वे त्रिवृती सवने पञ्चदशम् एकं द्वे पञ्चदशे सवने सप्तदशम् एकं द्वे सप्तदशे सवने एकविंशम् एकं द्वे एकविंशे सवने त्रिणवम् एकं द्वे त्रिणवे सवने त्रयस्त्रिंशम् एकं प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उक्थानि त्रिणवं प्रथमं द्वे एकविंशे सषोडशिके पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
text_mt: Two pressings are ninefold, one is fifteenfold; two pressings are fifteenfold, one is seventeenfold; two pressings are seventeenfold, one is twenty-one-fold; two pressings are twenty-one-fold, one is twenty-seven-fold; two pressings are twenty-seven-fold, one is thirty-three-fold; the ukthas are descending: the first is twenty-seven-fold, two are twenty-one-fold, with a sixteenfold chant; the night is fifteenfold; the twilight chant is ninefold.

sanskrit_iast: devāś ca vā asurāś cāspardhanta te na vyajayanta te 'bruvan vāco mithunena vijayāmahai yatare no vāco mithunaṃ na prativindāṃs te parā bhavān iti te devā eka ity abruvann ekety asurā vāco mithunaṃ pratyavindan dvāv iti devā abruvan dve ity asurā vāco mithunaṃ pratyavindanaṃs traya iti devā abruvaṃs tisra ity asurā vāco mithunaṃ pratyavindaṃś catvāra iti devā abruvaṃś catastra ity asurā vāco mithunaṃ pratyavindan pañceti devā abruvan nāsurā avindaṃs tato devā abhavan parāsurāḥ
meaning: देवाश् च वा असुराश् चास्पर्धन्त ते न व्यजयन्त ते ऽब्रुवन् वाचो मिथुनेन विजयामहै यतरे नो वाचो मिथुनं न प्रतिविन्दांस् ते परा भवान् इति ते देवा एक इत्य् अब्रुवन्न् एकेत्य् असुरा वाचो मिथुनं प्रत्यविन्दन् द्वाव् इति देवा अब्रुवन् द्वे इत्य् असुरा वाचो मिथुनं प्रत्यविन्दनंस् त्रय इति देवा अब्रुवंस् तिस्र इत्य् असुरा वाचो मिथुनं प्रत्यविन्दंश् चत्वार इति देवा अब्रुवंश् चतस्त्र इत्य् असुरा वाचो मिथुनं प्रत्यविन्दन् पञ्चेति देवा अब्रुवन् नासुरा अविन्दंस् ततो देवा अभवन् परासुराः
text_mt: The gods and the asuras were contending. They could not win. They said: 'Let us win by the pair of Speech. Whichever [party] among us cannot find the matching pair of Speech, they shall be defeated.' The gods said: 'Ekaḥ' [one, masculine]; the asuras found the matching pair of Speech: 'Ekā' [one, feminine]. The gods said: 'Dvau' [two, masculine]; the asuras found the matching pair of Speech: 'Dve' [two, feminine]. The gods said: 'Trayaḥ' [three, masculine]; the asuras found the matching pair of Speech: 'Tisraḥ' [three, feminine]. The gods said: 'Catvāraḥ' [four, masculine]; the asuras found the matching pair of Speech: 'Catasraḥ' [four, feminine]. The gods said: 'Pañca' [five]; the asuras could not find [a pair]. Thereupon the gods prevailed; the asuras were defeated.

sanskrit_iast: bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He thrives in himself; his rival is defeated, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ vā eṣāṃ tad vīryam annādyam avṛñjata
meaning: संवत्सरं वा एषां तद् वीर्यम् अन्नाद्यम् अवृञ्जत
text_mt: They wrested their year's virility and food.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ vīryam annādyaṃ bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃ veda
meaning: संवत्सरं वीर्यम् अन्नाद्यं भ्रातृव्यस्य वृङ्क्ते य एवं वेद
text_mt: He wrests the year's virility and food of his rival, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: pañcarātro vā eṣa pāṅktaḥ purūṣaḥ pāṅktāḥ paśavas tena purūṣaṃ ca paśūṃś cāpnoti
meaning: पञ्चरात्रो वा एष पाङ्क्तः पुरूषः पाङ्क्ताः पशवस् तेन पुरूषं च पशूंश् चाप्नोति
text_mt: This is a five-day rite. Man is fivefold; cattle are fivefold. Thereby he obtains both man and cattle.

sanskrit_iast: āstharir vā eṣa santato yajño dvau dvau hi stomāv ahar vahato yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tam etenābhyaśnute
meaning: आस्थरिर् वा एष सन्ततो यज्ञो द्वौ द्वौ हि स्तोमाव् अहर् वहतो यं कामं कामयते तम् एतेनाभ्यश्नुते
text_mt: This continuous sacrifice is non-one-horse [yoked in pairs]; for two stomas each carry a day. Whatever desire he desires, he attains by this.

sanskrit_iast: yatra yatra hy asthūriṇā kāmayate tat tad abhyaśnute
meaning: यत्र यत्र ह्य् अस्थूरिणा कामयते तत् तद् अभ्यश्नुते
text_mt: For wherever one desires [to go] with a span [of two horses], there he reaches.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho bhavati santatyai
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो भवति सन्तत्यै
text_mt: The five-day rite is linked [from day to day], for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: pratyavarohīṇy uttamasyāhna ukthāni bhavanti pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उत्तमस्याह्न उक्थानि भवन्ति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: Descending are the uktha [stotras] of the final day, for firm support.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthaḥ saptadaśa ukthaḥ pañcadaśa ukthaḥ saptadaśo 'tirātraḥ pañcaśāradīyo marutāṃ stomaḥ
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थः सप्तदश उक्थः पञ्चदश उक्थः सप्तदशो ऽतिरात्रः पञ्चशारदीयो मरुतां स्तोमः
text_mt: A ninefold agniṣṭoma, a fifteenfold ukthya, a seventeenfold ukthya, a fifteenfold ukthya, a seventeenfold atirātra: [this is] the Pañcaśāradīya, the stoma of the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayeta bahu syām iti sa etena yajeta
meaning: यः कामयेत बहु स्याम् इति स एतेन यजेत
text_mt: He who desires, 'May I become manifold,' should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: marūto vai devānāṃ bhūyiṣṭhā bahur eva bhavati
meaning: मरूतो वै देवानां भूयिष्ठा बहुर् एव भवति
text_mt: The Maruts indeed are the most numerous of the gods; he becomes manifold indeed.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśaṃ stomā nātiyanti prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim evāpnoti
meaning: सप्तदशं स्तोमा नातियन्ति प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोति
text_mt: The stomas do not exceed the seventeenfold; Prajāpati is seventeenfold; he reaches Prajāpati himself.

sanskrit_iast: agastyo vai marūdbhya ukṣṇaḥ praukṣat tān indrāyābadhnāt te vajram ādāyābhyapatan sa etat kayāśubhīyam apaśyat tenāśamayat
meaning: अगस्त्यो वै मरूद्भ्य उक्ष्णः प्रौक्षत् तान् इन्द्रायाबध्नात् ते वज्रम् आदायाभ्यपतन् स एतत् कयाशुभीयम् अपश्यत् तेनाशमयत्
text_mt: Agastya consecrated bulls for the Maruts; he tied them for Indra. Taking the thunderbolt, they flew at him. He saw this Kayāśubhīya [hymn]; with it he pacified [them].

sanskrit_iast: yat kayāśubhīyaṃ śasyate śāntyā eva
meaning: यत् कयाशुभीयं शस्यते शान्त्या एव
text_mt: In that the Kayāśubhīya is recited, it is for pacification.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa pṛśnīn ukṣṇaḥ pañcavarṣān saptadaśa pṛśnīs trivatsā apravītās tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitānetarā labhante pretarān sṛjanti
meaning: सप्तदश पृश्नीन् उक्ष्णः पञ्चवर्षान् सप्तदश पृश्नीस् त्रिवत्सा अप्रवीतास् तान् पर्यग्निकृतान् प्रोक्षितानेतरा लभन्ते प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति
text_mt: Seventeen spotted bulls of five years [and] seventeen unserved spotted three-year-old heifers: having carried fire around them and sprinkled them, they seize the one set, [and] release the other set.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ saṃvatsare navanītapṛśnīr arūṇā ānayanti tāṃś caivokṣṇas tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitān etarā labhante pretarān sṛjanti tataḥ saṃvatsare rājīvā ānayanti tāṃś caivokṣṇas tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitān etarā labhante pretarān sṛjanti tataḥ saṃvatsare piśaṅgīr ānayanti tāṃś caivokṣṇas tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitān etarā labhante pretarān sṛjanti tataḥ saṃvatsare sāraṅgīr ānayanti tāṃś caivokṣṇas tān paryagnikṛtān pokṣitān etarā labhante pretarān sṛjanti
meaning: ततः संवत्सरे नवनीतपृश्नीर् अरूणा आनयन्ति तांश् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् पर्यग्निकृतान् प्रोक्षितान् एतरा लभन्ते प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति ततः संवत्सरे राजीवा आनयन्ति तांश् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् पर्यग्निकृतान् प्रोक्षितान् एतरा लभन्ते प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति ततः संवत्सरे पिशङ्गीर् आनयन्ति तांश् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् पर्यग्निकृतान् प्रोक्षितान् एतरा लभन्ते प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति ततः संवत्सरे सारङ्गीर् आनयन्ति तांश् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् पर्यग्निकृतान् पोक्षितान् एतरा लभन्ते प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति
text_mt:
Then, after a year, they bring butter-spotted reddish [heifers] and the same bulls; having carried fire around them and sprinkled them, they seize the one set, [and] release the other set. Then, after a year, they bring striped [heifers] and the same bulls; having carried fire around them and sprinkled them, they seize the one set, [and] release the other set. Then, after a year, they bring tawny [heifers] and the same bulls; having carried fire around them and sprinkled them, they seize the one set, [and] release the other set. Then, after a year, they bring dappled [heifers] and the same bulls; having carried fire around them and sprinkled them, they seize the one set, [and] release the other set.

Then, after a year, the Soma [days] take place.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ saṃvatsare somā bhavanti
meaning: ततः संवत्सरे सोमा भवन्ति

sanskrit_iast: trīṃs trīn anvaham ālabhante pañcottame 'hani
meaning: त्रींस् त्रीन् अन्वहम् आलभन्ते पञ्चोत्तमे ऽहनि
text_mt: Day after day they seize three each; five on the final day.

sanskrit_iast: ajo 'gnīṣomīyaḥ
meaning: अजो ऽग्नीषोमीयः

sanskrit_iast: aindrā mārūto ukṣāṇo mārūtyo vatsataryaḥ
meaning: ऐन्द्रा मारूतो उक्षाणो मारूत्यो वत्सतर्यः
text_mt: The bulls belong to Indra and the Maruts; the heifers belong to the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: yadi rūdro 'bhimanyotāgnaye rūdravate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
meaning: यदि रूद्रो ऽभिमन्योताग्नये रूद्रवते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
text_mt: If Rudra should assail [one of them], having assigned an eight-pot-sherd cake to Agni possessed of Rudra, one should then seize another.

sanskrit_iast: yadi saṃśīryaita bhaumam ekakapālaṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
meaning: यदि संशीर्यैत भौमम् एककपालं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
text_mt: If [one] should break down, having assigned a one-pot-sherd [cake] to Bhūmi, one should then seize another.

sanskrit_iast: yady avasīder nairṛtaṃ caruṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta yady apsu mriyetāponaptrīyaṃ caruṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta yady andhasyāt sauryaṃ caruṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
meaning: यद्य् अवसीदेर् नैरृतं चरुं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत यद्य् अप्सु म्रियेतापोनप्त्रीयं चरुं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत यद्य् अन्धस्यात् सौर्यं चरुं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
text_mt: If [one] should collapse, having assigned a mess [of boiled rice] to Nirṛti, one should then seize another. If [one] should die in the waters, having assigned a mess to Apāṃ Napāt, one should then seize another. If [one] should become blind, having assigned a mess to Sūrya, one should then seize another.

sanskrit_iast: yadi ślavaṇo vā kuṭo vā syād bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ nipyāthānyam ālabheta
meaning: यदि श्लवणो वा कुटो वा स्याद् बार्हस्पत्यं चरुं निप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
text_mt: If it should be one-eared or hornless, having assigned a mess to Bṛhaspati, one should then seize another.

sanskrit_iast: yadi palāyeta vāyavyaṃ caruṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
meaning: यदि पलायेत वायव्यं चरुं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
text_mt: If it should run away, having assigned a mess to Vāyu, one should then seize another.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prāsahājayeyur indrāya prasahvana ekādaśakapālaṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
meaning: यदि प्रासहाजयेयुर् इन्द्राय प्रसह्वन एकादशकपालं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
text_mt: If [enemies] should carry it off by force, having assigned an eleven-pot-sherd [cake] to Indra Prasahvan, one should then seize another.

sanskrit_iast: yady anyena mṛtyunā mriyeta prājāpatyaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
meaning: यद्य् अन्येन मृत्युना म्रियेत प्राजापत्यं द्वादशकपालं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
text_mt: If it should die by another death, having assigned a twelve-pot-sherd [cake] to Prajāpati, one should then seize another.

sanskrit_iast: etena vā ekayāvā gāndamo vetasvatīṣṭvā sarvām ṛddhim ārdhnot
meaning: एतेन वा एकयावा गान्दमो वेतस्वतीष्ट्वा सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् आर्ध्नोत्
text_mt: By this [rite], having sacrificed on the Vetasvatī, Ekayāvā Gāndama prospered in all prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: sarvām ṛddhim ṛdhnoti ya evaṃ veda
meaning: सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नोति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He prospers in all prosperity who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo gaur ukthyo mahāvrataṃ gaur ukthya āyur atirātraḥ
meaning: ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्यो महाव्रतं गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: A Jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma, a Go ukthya, the Mahāvrata, a Go ukthya, an Āyus atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaro vai vrataṃ tasya vasanta ṛtur mukhaṃ grīṣmaś ca varṣāś ca pakṣau śaran madhyaṃ hemantaḥ puccham
meaning: संवत्सरो वै व्रतं तस्य वसन्त ऋतुर् मुखं ग्रीष्मश् च वर्षाश् च पक्षौ शरन् मध्यं हेमन्तः पुच्छम्
text_mt: The year indeed is the Vrata; the spring season is its head, summer and the rains are the two wings, autumn is the middle, winter is the tail.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāc charadam oṣadhayo 'bhisampacyante śarad dhi madhyaṃ saṃvatsarasya
meaning: तस्माच् छरदम् ओषधयो ऽभिसम्पच्यन्ते शरद् धि मध्यं संवत्सरस्य
text_mt: Therefore plants ripen fully in autumn, for autumn is the middle of the year.

sanskrit_iast: akṛtaṃ vā ete kurvanti ye purā saṃvatsarāt vratam upayanti
meaning: अकृतं वा एते कुर्वन्ति ये पुरा संवत्सरात् व्रतम् उपयन्ति
text_mt: Those who undertake the Vrata before a year perform what is incomplete.

sanskrit_iast: etad vai vratam āptaṃ yat pañcarātre pañca hy ṛtavaḥ
meaning: एतद् वै व्रतम् आप्तं यत् पञ्चरात्रे पञ्च ह्य् ऋतवः
text_mt: This Vrata is attained when it is in a five-day rite, for there are five seasons.

sanskrit_iast: āptena vratena stute sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda
meaning: आप्तेन व्रतेन स्तुते सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He is praised with an attained Vrata; he attains a complete lifespan who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ
meaning: पृष्ठयः षडहः

sanskrit_iast: ṛtavo na pratyatiṣṭhaṃs ta etena pratyatiṣṭhan pratiṣṭhākāmo yajeta praty eva tiṣṭhati
meaning: ऋतवो न प्रत्यतिष्ठंस् त एतेन प्रत्यतिष्ठन् प्रतिष्ठाकामो यजेत प्रत्य् एव तिष्ठति
text_mt: The seasons were not firmly established; through this they were firmly established. One desiring firm support should sacrifice; he is firmly supported indeed.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍ vā ṛtava ṛtuṣv evaitena pratitiṣṭhati pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati pratyakṣam ṛdhyai
meaning: षड् वा ऋतव ऋतुष्व् एवैतेन प्रतितिष्ठति पृष्ठयः षडहो भवति प्रत्यक्षम् ऋध्यै
text_mt: Six indeed are the seasons; in the seasons he is firmly established through this. There is a Pṛṣṭhya six-day rite visibly for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: pratyakṣaṃ hy etenartava ārdhnuvann ṛdhyā eva
meaning: प्रत्यक्षं ह्य् एतेनर्तव आर्ध्नुवन्न् ऋध्या एव
text_mt: For visibly through this did the seasons prosper, for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ saptadaśa ukthyo jyotir gaur āyur atirātraḥ
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः सप्तदश उक्थ्यो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: A ninefold agniṣṭoma, a fifteenfold ukthya, a seventeenfold ukthya, a Jyotis, a Go, an Āyus atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayeta sarvam āyur iyām iti sa etena yajeta
meaning: यः कामयेत सर्वम् आयुर् इयाम् इति स एतेन यजेत
text_mt: He who desires, 'May I attain a complete lifespan,' should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: yat tryahaḥ purastād bhavati trayaḥ prāṇāpānavyānās ta eva tat saṃdhīyante
meaning: यत् त्र्यहः पुरस्ताद् भवति त्रयः प्राणापानव्यानास् त एव तत् संधीयन्ते
text_mt: In that there is a three-day period in front, there are three [vital breaths]: out-breath, in-breath, and diffused breath; these indeed are thereby joined together.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat jyotir gaur āyur atirātro bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: अथ यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: Then, in that there are the Jyotis, the Go, and the Āyus atirātra, it is for firm support.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho viśvajid atirātraḥ
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: The intertwining five-day rite, [and] a Viśvajit atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: anyasmai vai kāmāya sattram anyasmai yajño na tatsatreṇāpnoti yasmaikaṃ yajño na tad yajñenāpnoti yasmaikaṃ sattram
meaning: अन्यस्मै वै कामाय सत्त्रम् अन्यस्मै यज्ञो न तत्सत्रेणाप्नोति यस्मैकं यज्ञो न तद् यज्ञेनाप्नोति यस्मैकं सत्त्रम्
text_mt: For one desire indeed is the sacrificial session, for another is the sacrifice. That for which a sacrificial session [is performed] one does not attain by a sacrifice; that for which a sacrifice [is performed] one does not attain by a sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast: sattram iva vā etad yad anulomaṃ pṛṣṭhāni yad ekadhā pṛṣṭhāni bhavanty ekadhaivāsmiṃs tad ojo vīryaṃ dadhāti
meaning: सत्त्रम् इव वा एतद् यद् अनुलोमं पृष्ठानि यद् एकधा पृष्ठानि भवन्त्य् एकधैवास्मिंस् तद् ओजो वीर्यं दधाति
text_mt: Like a sacrificial session indeed is this when the pṛṣṭhas are in regular order. In that the pṛṣṭhas become uniform, he places vigour and valour in him in a uniform way.

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ pṛṣṭhāny annādyam evāsmin dadhāti
meaning: अन्नं पृष्ठान्य् अन्नाद्यम् एवास्मिन् दधाति
text_mt: Food is the pṛṣṭhas; he places food in him.

sanskrit_iast: paśavaḥ pṛṣṭhāni paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: पशवः पृष्ठानि पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: Cattle are the pṛṣṭhas; he is firmly established in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho bhavati santatyai
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो भवति सन्तत्यै
text_mt: There is an intertwining five-day rite for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: viśvajid atirātro bhavati viśvasyābhijityai
meaning: विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रो भवति विश्वस्याभिजित्यै
text_mt: There is a Viśvajit atirātra for conquering all.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho mahāvratam atirātraḥ
meaning: पृष्ठयः षडहो महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, [and] the Mahāvrata atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: sapta ṛṣaya etenārdhnuvaṃs tenarddhis tasmād etena yajanta ṛddhyā eva
meaning: सप्त ऋषय एतेनार्ध्नुवंस् तेनर्द्धिस् तस्माद् एतेन यजन्त ऋद्ध्या एव
text_mt: The seven seers prospered through this; through it there was prosperity. Therefore they sacrifice with this, for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: sapta śirasi prāṇāḥ prāṇā indriyāṇīndriyāṇy evaitenāpnoti
meaning: सप्त शिरसि प्राणाः प्राणा इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियाण्य् एवैतेनाप्नोति
text_mt: Seven are the vital breaths in the head; the vital breaths are the faculties; faculties indeed does he attain through this.

sanskrit_iast: sapta grāmyāḥ paśavas tān etenāpnoti
meaning: सप्त ग्राम्याः पशवस् तान् एतेनाप्नोति
text_mt: Seven are the domestic cattle; these he attains through this.

sanskrit_iast: vrataṃ saptamasyāhnaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati tad dhy anāptam annaṃ vai vratam annādyam evaitenāpnoti
meaning: व्रतं सप्तमस्याह्नः पृष्ठं भवति तद् ध्य् अनाप्तम् अन्नं वै व्रतम् अन्नाद्यम् एवैतेनाप्नोति
text_mt: The Vrata is the pṛṣṭha of the seventh day, for it is unattained. Food indeed is the Vrata; food he attains through this.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati pratyakṣam ṛdhyai
meaning: पृष्ठयः षडहो भवति प्रत्यक्षम् ऋध्यै
text_mt: There is a Pṛṣṭhya six-day rite visibly for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: pratyakṣaṃ hy etena sapta ṛṣaya ārdhnuvann ṛdhyā eva
meaning: प्रत्यक्षं ह्य् एतेन सप्त ऋषय आर्ध्नुवन्न् ऋध्या एव
text_mt: For visibly through this did the seven seers prosper, for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ saptadaśaṃ mahāvratam atirātraḥ
meaning: पृष्ठयः षडहः सप्तदशं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, a seventeenfold Mahāvrata, an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: tasya trivṛc chiraḥ pañcadaśau pakṣau saptadaśa ātmaikaviṃśaṃ puccham
meaning: तस्य त्रिवृच् छिरः पञ्चदशौ पक्षौ सप्तदश आत्मैकविंशं पुच्छम्
text_mt: Its head is ninefold, the two wings fifteenfold, the trunk seventeenfold, the tail twenty-one-fold.

sanskrit_iast: etena vai prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata
meaning: एतेन वै प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत
text_mt: Through this indeed did Prajāpati create offspring.

sanskrit_iast: pra prajayā pra paśubhir jāyate ya evaṃ veda
meaning: प्र प्रजया प्र पशुभिर् जायते य एवं वेद
text_mt: He propagates with offspring and with cattle who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśo vai prajāpatir yat saptadaśaṃ vrataṃ bhavati prajāpatim evāpnoti
meaning: सप्तदशो वै प्रजापतिर् यत् सप्तदशं व्रतं भवति प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोति
text_mt: Seventeenfold indeed is Prajāpati; in that the Vrata is seventeenfold, he reaches Prajāpati himself.

sanskrit_iast: yat trivṛc chiro bhavati nava prāṇāḥ prāṇeṣv eva prati tiṣṭhati
meaning: यत् त्रिवृच् छिरो भवति नव प्राणाः प्राणेष्व् एव प्रति तिष्ठति
text_mt: In that the head is ninefold, nine are the vital breaths; he is firmly established in the vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast: yat pañcadaśau pakṣau savīvadhatvāya
meaning: यत् पञ्चदशौ पक्षौ सवीवधत्वाय
text_mt: In that the two wings are fifteenfold, [it is] for the balance of the shoulder-yoke.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa ātmā bhavati prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajā patim evāpnoti
meaning: सप्तदश आत्मा भवति प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजा पतिम् एवाप्नोति
text_mt: The trunk is seventeenfold; Prajāpati is seventeenfold; he reaches Prajāpati himself.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśaṃ puccha bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: एकविंशं पुच्छ भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: The tail is twenty-one-fold, for firm support.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaś chandomapavamānaṃ mahāvratam atirātraḥ
meaning: पृष्ठयः षडहश् छन्दोमपवमानं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, a Mahāvrata with chandoma-pavamānas, an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāmo yajeta
meaning: पशुकामो यजेत

sanskrit_iast: paśavo vai chandāmāḥ
meaning: पशवो वै छन्दामाः

sanskrit_iast: yac chadomāḥ pavamānā mahāvratasya bhavanti paśūnevāvarūndhe
meaning: यच् छदोमाः पवमाना महाव्रतस्य भवन्ति पशूनेवावरून्धे
text_mt: When the chandoma [sāmans] become the Pavamāna [chants] of the Mahāvrata, he obtains cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ubhaye stomā yugmantaś cāyujaś ca tan mithunaṃ tasmān mithunāt prajāyate
meaning: उभये स्तोमा युग्मन्तश् चायुजश् च तन् मिथुनं तस्मान् मिथुनात् प्रजायते
text_mt: Both [kinds of] stomas [are used], even and odd. That is a pair; from that pair he propagates.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho 'tha trayastriṃśām ahas tasya catustriṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ saptadaśaṃ mahāvratam atirātras tasya caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ trivṛc chiraḥ pañcadaśau pakṣau saptadaśa ātmaikaviṃśaṃ puccham
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो ऽथ त्रयस्त्रिंशाम् अहस् तस्य चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः सप्तदशं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रस् तस्य चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानं त्रिवृच् छिरः पञ्चदशौ पक्षौ सप्तदश आत्मैकविंशं पुच्छम्
text_mt: The contiguous five-day rite; then the thirty-third day; its agniṣṭoma is thirty-four-fold; the seventeenfold Mahāvrata; an atirātra. Its Bahiṣpavamāna is twenty-four-fold; the ninefold stoma is the head; two fifteenfold stomas are the two wings; the seventeenfold stoma is the body; the twenty-one-fold stoma is the tail.

sanskrit_iast: etena vai jamadagniḥ sarvān poṣān apuṣyat sarvān evaitena poṣān puṣyati
meaning: एतेन वै जमदग्निः सर्वान् पोषान् अपुष्यत् सर्वान् एवैतेन पोषान् पुष्यति
text_mt: By this indeed Jamadagni flourished in all prosperities; by this one flourishes in all prosperities.

sanskrit_iast: yad abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāhaḥ purastād bhavati santatyā eva
meaning: यद् अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहः पुरस्ताद् भवति सन्तत्या एव
text_mt: That the contiguous five-day rite is in the beginning is for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: athaitat trayastriṃśam ahas trayastriṃśad devatā devatā evāpnoti
meaning: अथैतत् त्रयस्त्रिंशम् अहस् त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवता देवता एवाप्नोति
text_mt: Then this thirty-third day: there are thirty-three deities; he obtains the deities.

sanskrit_iast: tasya catustriṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ prajāpatiś catustriṃśo devatānāṃ prajāpatim evāpnoti
meaning: तस्य चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः प्रजापतिश् चतुस्त्रिंशो देवतानां प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोति
text_mt: Its agniṣṭoma is thirty-four-fold: Prajāpati is the thirty-fourth of the deities; he obtains Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati mahāvratasya caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī prajananaṃ gāyatrī prajātyai
meaning: चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानं भवति महाव्रतस्य चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा गायत्री प्रजननं गायत्री प्रजात्यै
text_mt: The Bahiṣpavamāna of the Mahāvrata is twenty-four-fold: the gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables; the gāyatrī is procreative; [it is] for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: ubhaye stomā yugmantaś cāyujaś ca tan mithunaṃ tasmān mithunāt prajāyate
meaning: उभये स्तोमा युग्मन्तश् चायुजश् च तन् मिथुनं तस्मान् मिथुनात् प्रजायते
text_mt: Both [kinds of] stomas [are used], even and odd. That is a pair; from that pair he propagates.

sanskrit_iast: yat trivṛc chiro bhavati nava prāṇāḥ prāṇeṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati yat pañcadaśau pakṣau savīvadhatvāya saptadaśa ātmā bhavati prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim evāpnoty ekaviṃśaṃ pucchaṃ bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: यत् त्रिवृच् छिरो भवति नव प्राणाः प्राणेष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति यत् पञ्चदशौ पक्षौ सवीवधत्वाय सप्तदश आत्मा भवति प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोत्य् एकविंशं पुच्छं भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: That the ninefold stoma is the head, there are nine vital breaths; he is established in the vital breaths. That two fifteenfold stomas are the two wings is for balance. The seventeenfold stoma is the body: Prajāpati is seventeenfold; he obtains Prajāpati. The twenty-one-fold stoma is the tail, for firm establishment.

sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo 'bhijid agniṣṭomo viśvajid agniṣṭomaḥ sarvajid agniṣṭomaḥ sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ
meaning: ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो ऽभिजिद् अग्निष्टोमो विश्वजिद् अग्निष्टोमः सर्वजिद् अग्निष्टोमः सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः
text_mt: The Jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma, the Go ukthya, the Āyus ukthya, the Abhijit agniṣṭoma, the Viśvajit agniṣṭoma, the Sarvajit agniṣṭoma, the all-stoma atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: etena vā indro 'ty ānyā devatā abhavad aty anyā prajā bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: एतेन वा इन्द्रो ऽत्य् आन्या देवता अभवद् अत्य् अन्या प्रजा भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: By this indeed Indra surpassed the other deities. He who knows this surpasses other creatures.

sanskrit_iast: yat jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ purastād bhavati prajñātān stomānupaitīmān eva lokān eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः पुरस्ताद् भवति प्रज्ञातान् स्तोमानुपैतीमान् एव लोकान् एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: That the Jyotis, Go, and Āyus three-day rite is in the beginning: he enters upon well-known stomas, these worlds; he is established in these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: athābhijid abhijitā vai devā imān lokān abhyajayan viśvajitā viśvam ajayan sarvajitā sarvam ajayan
meaning: अथाभिजिद् अभिजिता वै देवा इमान् लोकान् अभ्यजयन् विश्वजिता विश्वम् अजयन् सर्वजिता सर्वम् अजयन्
text_mt: Then the Abhijit: by the Abhijit indeed the gods conquered these worlds; by the Viśvajit they conquered the universe; by the Sarvajit they conquered all.

sanskrit_iast: sarvastomātirātro bhavati sarvasyāptyai sarvasya jityai sarvam evaitenāpnoti sarvaṃ jayati
meaning: सर्वस्तोमातिरात्रो भवति सर्वस्याप्त्यै सर्वस्य जित्यै सर्वम् एवैतेनाप्नोति सर्वं जयति
text_mt: There is an all-stoma atirātra, for the attainment of all, for the victory of all. By this he attains all, he conquers all.

sanskrit_iast: catvāri trivṛnty ahāny agniṣṭomamukhāni viśvajin mahāvrataṃ jyotiṣṭomo 'tirātraḥ
meaning: चत्वारि त्रिवृन्त्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोममुखानि विश्वजिन् महाव्रतं ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽतिरात्रः
text_mt: Four ninefold days beginning with the agniṣṭoma, the Viśvajit, the Mahāvrata, the Jyotiṣṭoma atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: etena vai prajāpatiḥ purūṣam asṛjata sa sarvasyānnādyasyādhipatyam agacchat
meaning: एतेन वै प्रजापतिः पुरूषम् असृजत स सर्वस्यान्नाद्यस्याधिपत्यम् अगच्छत्
text_mt:
By this indeed Prajāpati created man; he attained lordship over all food.

He who knows this attains lordship over all food.

sanskrit_iast: sarvasyānnādyasyādhipatyaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: सर्वस्यान्नाद्यस्याधिपत्यं गच्छति य एवं वेद

sanskrit_iast: śiro vā agre sambhavataḥ sambhavati caturdhā vihitaṃ vai śiraḥ prāṇaś cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ vāgātmā vai pṛṣṭhāni yat pṛṣṭhāny upaiti śira evātmānam anusandadhāti
meaning: शिरो वा अग्रे सम्भवतः सम्भवति चतुर्धा विहितं वै शिरः प्राणश् चक्षुः श्रोत्रं वागात्मा वै पृष्ठानि यत् पृष्ठान्य् उपैति शिर एवात्मानम् अनुसन्दधाति
text_mt: The head indeed is first formed when [a fetus] is formed. Fourfold indeed is the head constituted: breath, eye, ear, and speech. The body indeed is the pṛṣṭhas. When he approaches the pṛṣṭhas, he connects the body following the head.

sanskrit_iast: etad vai purūṣam akas tasmā annam eva vratam apidadhāti
meaning: एतद् वै पुरूषम् अकस् तस्मा अन्नम् एव व्रतम् अपिदधाति
text_mt: This indeed made man; upon him he covers food as the vow [vrata].

sanskrit_iast: atha yat jyotiṣṭomo 'tirātro bhavaty akḷptasya kḷptyai
meaning: अथ यत् ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवत्य् अकॢप्तस्य कॢप्त्यै
text_mt: Now, that there is the Jyotiṣṭoma atirātra is for the ordering of the disordered.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhayaḥ stomaḥ ṣaḍaho viśvajid atirātraḥ
meaning: पृष्ठयः स्तोमः षडहो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: The pṛṣṭha stoma six-day rite, the Viśvajit atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: anyasmai vai kāmāya sattram anyasmai yajño na tat sattreṇāpnoti yasmaikaṃ yajño na tad yajñenāpnoti yasmaikaṃ sattraṃ sattram iva vā etad yad anulomaṃ pṛṣṭhāni yadaikadhā pṛṣṭhāni bhavaty ekadhaivāsmiṃs tejo vīryaṃ dadhāty annaṃ pṛṣṭhāny annādyam evāsmin dadhāti paśavaḥ pṛṣṭhāni paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: अन्यस्मै वै कामाय सत्त्रम् अन्यस्मै यज्ञो न तत् सत्त्रेणाप्नोति यस्मैकं यज्ञो न तद् यज्ञेनाप्नोति यस्मैकं सत्त्रं सत्त्रम् इव वा एतद् यद् अनुलोमं पृष्ठानि यदैकधा पृष्ठानि भवत्य् एकधैवास्मिंस् तेजो वीर्यं दधात्य् अन्नं पृष्ठान्य् अन्नाद्यम् एवास्मिन् दधाति पशवः पृष्ठानि पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: For one desire is a sacrificial session, for another is an ordinary sacrifice. He does not obtain by the sacrificial session that for which an ordinary sacrifice [is meant]; nor does he obtain by an ordinary sacrifice that for which a sacrificial session [is meant]. It is like a sacrificial session, in that the pṛṣṭhas are in natural order. When the pṛṣṭhas are uniform, he places lustre and valour in him in a unified manner. The pṛṣṭhas are food; he places food in him. The pṛṣṭhas are cattle; he is established in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: yad vai manuṣyāṇāṃ pratyakṣaṃ taddevānāṃ parokṣamatha yanma manuṣyāṇāṃ parokṣaṃ taddevānāṃ pratyakṣam
meaning: यद् वै मनुष्याणां प्रत्यक्षं तद्देवानां परोक्षमथ यन्म मनुष्याणां परोक्षं तद्देवानां प्रत्यक्षम्
text_mt: What is visible to men is invisible to the gods; and what is invisible to men is visible to the gods.

sanskrit_iast: etad vai parokṣaṃ vrataṃ yad viśvajit pratyakṣam evaitenānnādyam avarundhe
meaning: एतद् वै परोक्षं व्रतं यद् विश्वजित् प्रत्यक्षम् एवैतेनान्नाद्यम् अवरुन्धे
text_mt: This indeed is the invisible vow, namely the Viśvajit; by this he visibly obtains food.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho mahāvrataṃ jyotiṣṭomo 'tirātraḥ
meaning: पृष्ठयः षडहो महाव्रतं ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽतिरात्रः
text_mt: The pṛṣṭha six-day rite, the Mahāvrata, the Jyotiṣṭoma atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: etena vai devā devatvam agacchan
meaning: एतेन वै देवा देवत्वम् अगच्छन्
text_mt: By this indeed the gods went to divinity.

sanskrit_iast: devatvaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: देवत्वं गच्छति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He who knows this goes to divinity.

sanskrit_iast: etad vai vratam āptaṃ yad aṣṭarātre 'gniṣṭomo hi vrataṃ sampadyate
meaning: एतद् वै व्रतम् आप्तं यद् अष्टरात्रे ऽग्निष्टोमो हि व्रतं सम्पद्यते
text_mt: This vow is attained, that in an eight-day rite the vow becomes an agniṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat jyotiṣṭhomo 'tirātro bhavaty akḷptasya kḷptyai
meaning: अथ यत् ज्योतिष्ठोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवत्य् अकॢप्तस्य कॢप्त्यै
text_mt: Now, that there is the Jyotiṣṭoma atirātra is for the ordering of the disordered.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭarātreṇa vai devāḥ sarvam āśnuvata
meaning: अष्टरात्रेण वै देवाः सर्वम् आश्नुवत
text_mt: By the eight-day rite indeed the gods attained all.

sanskrit_iast: sarvam aśnute ya evaṃ veda
meaning: सर्वम् अश्नुते य एवं वेद
text_mt: He who knows this attains all.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho jyotir gaur āyur atirātro devā vai mṛtyor abibhayus te prajāpatim upādhāvaṃs tebhya etena navarātreṇāmṛtatvaṃ prāyacchat
meaning: पृष्ठयः षडहो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो देवा वै मृत्योर् अबिभयुस् ते प्रजापतिम् उपाधावंस् तेभ्य एतेन नवरात्रेणामृतत्वं प्रायच्छत्
text_mt: The pṛṣṭha six-day rite, the Jyotis, the Go, the Āyus, the atirātra. The gods indeed were afraid of death; they ran to Prajāpati. To them he granted immortality by this nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etad vāva manuṣyasyāmṛtatvaṃ yat sarvam āyur eti vasīyān bhavati
meaning: एतद् वाव मनुष्यस्यामृतत्वं यत् सर्वम् आयुर् एति वसीयान् भवति
text_mt:
This indeed is immortality for a man: that he reaches a complete lifespan and becomes more prosperous.

He reaches a complete lifespan and becomes more prosperous, who knows this.

sanskrit_iast: sarvam āyur eti vasīyān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: सर्वम् आयुर् एति वसीयान् भवति य एवं वेद

sanskrit_iast: navarātro vā eṣa nava prāṇāḥ prāṇeṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: नवरात्रो वा एष नव प्राणाः प्राणेष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: This is a nine-day rite; there are nine vital breaths; he is established in the vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati pratyakṣam ṛddhayā atha yat jyotir gaur āyur atirātro bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: पृष्ठयः षडहो भवति प्रत्यक्षम् ऋद्धया अथ यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: There is the pṛṣṭha six-day rite, manifestly for prosperity. Then, that there is the Jyotis, Go, Āyus, and atirātra is for firm establishment.

sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭhomo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo 'bhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho viśvajid atirātraḥ paśukāmo yajeta
meaning: ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्ठोमो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो ऽभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः पशुकामो यजेत
text_mt: The Jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma, the Go ukthya, the Āyus ukthya, the contiguous five-day rite, the Viśvajit atirātra. One desirous of cattle should sacrifice [with this].

sanskrit_iast: yat jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ purastād bhavati prajñātān stomānupaitīmān eva lokān eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः पुरस्ताद् भवति प्रज्ञातान् स्तोमानुपैतीमान् एव लोकान् एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठति
text_mt: That the Jyotis, Go, and Āyus three-day rite is in the beginning: he enters upon well-known stomas, these worlds; he is established in these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho madhyato bhavati pāṅktaḥ purūṣaḥ pāṅktāḥ paśavas tena purūṣaṃ ca paśūṃś cāpnoti
meaning: अथ यद् अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो मध्यतो भवति पाङ्क्तः पुरूषः पाङ्क्ताः पशवस् तेन पुरूषं च पशूंश् चाप्नोति
text_mt: Now, that the contiguous five-day rite is in the middle: fivefold is man, fivefold are cattle; thereby he obtains both man and cattle.

sanskrit_iast: viśvajid atirātro bhavati viśvasyābhijityai
meaning: विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रो भवति विश्वस्याभिजित्यै
text_mt: The Viśvajit atirātra is for the complete victory over all.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyas trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ saptadaśo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśa ukthyaḥ saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomas triṇavo 'gniṣṭomas trayastriṃśa ukthyas triṇavo 'gniṣṭomo viśvajid atirātraḥ
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यस् त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंश उक्थ्यः सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमस् त्रिणवो ऽग्निष्टोमस् त्रयस्त्रिंश उक्थ्यस् त्रिणवो ऽग्निष्टोमो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: A ninefold agniṣṭoma, a fifteenfold ukthya, a ninefold agniṣṭoma, a seventeenfold agniṣṭoma, a twenty-one-fold ukthya, a seventeenfold agniṣṭoma, a twenty-seven-fold agniṣṭoma, a thirty-three-fold ukthya, a twenty-seven-fold agniṣṭoma, the Viśvajit atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: indro 'surān hatvākāryaṃ cakṛvāṃ amanyata taṃ devā etena stomenāyājayan sa pāpmano nairdaśyam agacchat
meaning: इन्द्रो ऽसुरान् हत्वाकार्यं चकृवां अमन्यत तं देवा एतेन स्तोमेनायाजयन् स पाप्मनो नैर्दश्यम् अगच्छत्
text_mt: Indra, having slain the Asuras, thought that he had done what ought not to be done. The gods made him sacrifice with this stoma; he went beyond the ten days of evil.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād iṣuhato vā daṇḍahato vā daśamīṃ nairdaśyaṃ gacchati
meaning: तस्माद् इषुहतो वा दण्डहतो वा दशमीं नैर्दश्यं गच्छति
text_mt: Therefore, one struck by an arrow or struck by a stick passes beyond the danger on the tenth day.

sanskrit_iast: daśa daśinī vā eṣā virāḍ annaṃ virāḍ annādyam evāsmin dadhāti
meaning: दश दशिनी वा एषा विराड् अन्नं विराड् अन्नाद्यम् एवास्मिन् दधाति
text_mt: This virāj consists of tens. The virāj is food; he places food in him.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomena vai devā asurān nigṛhya madhyata ukthaiḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyantāgniṣṭomenaiva bhrātṛvyaṃ nigṛhya madhyata ukthyaiḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate
meaning: अग्निष्टोमेन वै देवा असुरान् निगृह्य मध्यत उक्थैः प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायन्ताग्निष्टोमेनैव भ्रातृव्यं निगृह्य मध्यत उक्थ्यैः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते
text_mt: The gods indeed, having restrained the Asuras with the agniṣṭoma, propagated in the middle with offspring and cattle through the ukthyas. Having restrained the rival with the agniṣṭoma, he propagates in the middle with offspring and cattle through the ukthyas.

sanskrit_iast: trikakub vā eṣa yajñaḥ
meaning: त्रिककुब् वा एष यज्ञः

sanskrit_iast: trikakup samānānāṃ ca prajānāṃ ca bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: त्रिककुप् समानानां च प्रजानां च भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He who knows this becomes three-peaked among his equals and among his offspring.

sanskrit_iast: trayastrivṛto 'gniṣṭomās trayaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyās trayaḥ saptadaśa ukthyā ekaviṃśo 'tirātraḥ kusuruvindadaśarātraḥ
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिवृतो ऽग्निष्टोमास् त्रयः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यास् त्रयः सप्तदश उक्थ्या एकविंशो ऽतिरात्रः कुसुरुविन्ददशरात्रः
text_mt: Three ninefold agniṣṭomas, three fifteenfold ukthyas, three seventeenfold ukthyas, a twenty-one-fold atirātra: [this is] the Kusurubinda ten-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayeta bahu syām iti sa etena yajeta
meaning: यः कामयेत बहु स्याम् इति स एतेन यजेत
text_mt: Whoever should desire, 'May I become manifold,' should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: yad gaṇaśaḥ stomo bahur eva bhavati
meaning: यद् गणशः स्तोमो बहुर् एव भवति
text_mt: In that the stoma is in groups, he becomes manifold.

sanskrit_iast: saha trivṛta saha pañcadaśāḥ saha saptadaśāḥ
meaning: सह त्रिवृत सह पञ्चदशाः सह सप्तदशाः
text_mt: Together are the ninefold stomas, together the fifteenfold stomas, together the seventeenfold stomas.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśo 'tirātro bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: एकविंशो ऽतिरात्रो भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: There is a twenty-one-fold atirātra, for firm establishment.

sanskrit_iast: jyotir vā eṣa vihṛtaḥ
meaning: ज्योतिर् वा एष विहृतः

sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣ prajānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: ज्योतिष् प्रजानां भवति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He becomes a light of creatures who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: catuṣṭomo vā eṣa catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
meaning: चतुष्टोमो वा एष चतुष्पादाः पशवः पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
