text_mt: This is a four-stoma rite; cattle are four-footed; he establishes himself firmly in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśaṃ stomā nātiyanti pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśaḥ praty eva tiṣṭhati
meaning: एकविंशं स्तोमा नातियन्ति प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंशः प्रत्य् एव तिष्ठति
text_mt: The stomas do not exceed the twenty-one-fold stoma; the twenty-one-fold stoma is a firm foundation; he establishes himself firmly.

sanskrit_iast: etena vai kusurūvinda auddālakir iṣṭvā bhūmānam āśnuta
meaning: एतेन वै कुसुरूविन्द औद्दालकिर् इष्ट्वा भूमानम् आश्नुत
text_mt: By this Kusurūvinda Auddālaki, having sacrificed, attained abundance.

sanskrit_iast: bhūmānam aśnute ya evaṃ veda
meaning: भूमानम् अश्नुते य एवं वेद
text_mt: He attains abundance who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāhaś catvāraś chandomaḥ viśvajid atirātraḥ paśukāmo yajeta
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहश् चत्वारश् छन्दोमः विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः पशुकामो यजेत
text_mt: The five-day rite with repeated [stomas], four Chandomas, [and] the Viśvajit atirātra: one desiring cattle should sacrifice [with this].

sanskrit_iast: yad abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāhaḥ purastād bhavati pāṅktaḥ puruṣaḥ pāṅktāḥ paśavas tena purūṣaṃ ca paśūṃś cāpnoti
meaning: यद् अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहः पुरस्ताद् भवति पाङ्क्तः पुरुषः पाङ्क्ताः पशवस् तेन पुरूषं च पशूंश् चाप्नोति
text_mt: Since the five-day rite with repeated [stomas] comes first: man is fivefold, cattle are fivefold; thereby he obtains both man and cattle.

sanskrit_iast: chandomā madhyato bhavanti paśavo vai chandomāḥ paśūnām avarudhyai
meaning: छन्दोमा मध्यतो भवन्ति पशवो वै छन्दोमाः पशूनाम् अवरुध्यै
text_mt: The Chandomas are in the middle; the Chandomas are cattle, for the secure acquisition of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: viśvajid atirātro bhavati viśvasyābhijityai
meaning: विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रो भवति विश्वस्याभिजित्यै
text_mt: The Viśvajit is an atirātra, for the winning of all.

sanskrit_iast: triṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo jyotir ukthyas triṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo gaurukthyo 'bhijid agniṣṭomo gaur ukthyo viśvajid agniṣṭoma āyur ukthyo viśvajid agniṣṭomasya sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ
meaning: त्रिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो ज्योतिर् उक्थ्यस् त्रिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो गौरुक्थ्यो ऽभिजिद् अग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्यो विश्वजिद् अग्निष्टोम आयुर् उक्थ्यो विश्वजिद् अग्निष्टोमस्य सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः
text_mt: A three-stoma agniṣṭoma, a Jyotis ukthya, a three-stoma agniṣṭoma, a Go ukthya, an Abhijit agniṣṭoma, a Go ukthya, a Viśvajit agniṣṭoma, an Āyus ukthya, [and] of the Viśvajit agniṣṭoma an all-stoma atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: devā vā asurair hanyamānās te prajāpatim upādhāvaṃs tebhya etāṃ devapuraṃ prāyacchat tāṃ prāviśan
meaning: देवा वा असुरैर् हन्यमानास् ते प्रजापतिम् उपाधावंस् तेभ्य एतां देवपुरं प्रायच्छत् तां प्राविशन्
text_mt: The gods, being slain by the asuras, ran to Prajāpati; he gave them this fortress of the gods; they entered it.

sanskrit_iast: abhicāryamāṇaṃ yājayed etām eva devapuraṃ praviśaty asṛtyai
meaning: अभिचार्यमाणं याजयेद् एताम् एव देवपुरं प्रविशत्य् असृत्यै
text_mt: One should make him on whom malevolent magic is practised sacrifice [with this]; he enters this very fortress of the gods, for non-destruction.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ ṣaḍahas trayaś chandomāś catuṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo viśvajid atirātraḥ
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः षडहस् त्रयश् छन्दोमाश् चतुष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: The six-day rite with repeated [stomas], three Chandomas, a four-stoma agniṣṭoma, [and] the Viśvajit atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: svārājyo vā eṣa yajñaḥ
meaning: स्वाराज्यो वा एष यज्ञः

sanskrit_iast: svārājyaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: स्वाराज्यं गच्छति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He goes to sovereign rule who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir hi svārājyaṃ parameṣṭhī svārājyam
meaning: प्रजापतिर् हि स्वाराज्यं परमेष्ठी स्वाराज्यम्
text_mt: For Prajāpati is sovereign rule; Parameṣṭhin is sovereign rule.

sanskrit_iast: parameṣṭhitāṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: परमेष्ठितां गच्छति य एवं वेद
text_mt: He attains the state of Parameṣṭhin who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: ubhe bṛhadrathantare bhavatas tad dhi svārājyam ayutaṃ dakṣiṇās tad dhi svārājyaṃ ṣaḍviṃśastomo bhavati sa hi svārājyaṃ catuṣṭomastomaḥ sa hy anto 'nte śriyā gacchati ya evaṃ veda
meaning: उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे भवतस् तद् धि स्वाराज्यम् अयुतं दक्षिणास् तद् धि स्वाराज्यं षड्विंशस्तोमो भवति स हि स्वाराज्यं चतुष्टोमस्तोमः स ह्य् अन्तो ऽन्ते श्रिया गच्छति य एवं वेद
text_mt: Both Bṛhat and Rathantara are present, for that is sovereign rule; ten thousand are the sacrificial gifts, for that is sovereign rule; it has the twenty-six-fold stoma, for that is sovereign rule; its stoma is the four-stoma, for that is the end; he reaches the end with glory who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: etena vai kṣema dhṛtvā pauṇḍarīkaṃ iṣṭvā sudāmnas tīra uttare
meaning: एतेन वै क्षेम धृत्वा पौण्डरीकं इष्ट्वा सुदाम्नस् तीर उत्तरे
text_mt: By this Kṣema Dhṛtva Pauṇḍarīka, having sacrificed on the northern bank of the Sudāman,

sanskrit_iast: sarvām ṛddhim ārdhnot sarvāmṛddhim ṛdhnoti ya evaṃ veda
meaning: सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् आर्ध्नोत् सर्वामृद्धिम् ऋध्नोति य एवं वेद
text_mt: prospered in all prosperity; he prospers in all prosperity who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sarvastomo 'tirātraś catvāraś chandomā atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रः पृष्ठयः षडहः सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रश् चत्वारश् छन्दोमा अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, an all-stoma atirātra, four Chandomas, [and] an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa vā āpto dvādaśāho yat trayodaśarātraḥ
meaning: एष वा आप्तो द्वादशाहो यत् त्रयोदशरात्रः
text_mt: This is the complete twelve-day rite, which is the thirteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: samāno hy eṣa yat prayaṇīyaś codayanīyaś cātirātrau kāmaṃ kāmayante tam etābhir abhyaśnuvate
meaning: समानो ह्य् एष यत् प्रयणीयश् चोदयनीयश् चातिरात्रौ कामं कामयन्ते तम् एताभिर् अभ्यश्नुवते
text_mt: For it is identical in that the opening and concluding rites are atirātras; whatever desire they desire, that they obtain by these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: gṛhapates tu vāg upadāsukā bhavati tad yan madhye sarvastomo 'tirātro bhavati tena gṛhapater vāg anupadāsukā bhavati
meaning: गृहपतेस् तु वाग् उपदासुका भवति तद् यन् मध्ये सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवति तेन गृहपतेर् वाग् अनुपदासुका भवति
text_mt: The voice of the householder is liable to fail; that an all-stoma atirātra is in the middle, thereby the voice of the householder does not fail.

sanskrit_iast: etā vā aryalagṛhapataya ārūṇihotāraḥ subhagāsūpayanti te sarvām ṛddhim ārdhnuvan sarvām ṛddhim ṛdhnuvanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एता वा अर्यलगृहपतय आरूणिहोतारः सुभगासूपयन्ति ते सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् आर्ध्नुवन् सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नुवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: These [nights] the Aryalas as householders, the Āruṇis as hotṛs, fortunate, undertook; they prospered in all prosperity; they prosper in all prosperity who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atirātro dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś ca
meaning: अतिरात्रो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् च
text_mt: An atirātra, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, the Mahāvrata, and an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: vāg vā eṣā pratāyate yad eṣa dvādaśāhas tāṃ vicchindyur yan madhye 'tirātraṃ kuryuḥ
meaning: वाग् वा एषा प्रतायते यद् एष द्वादशाहस् तां विच्छिन्द्युर् यन् मध्ये ऽतिरात्रं कुर्युः
text_mt: Speech is extended here, which is this twelve-day rite; they would cut it asunder if they were to place an atirātra in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: yad upariṣṭād vratam upayanti na vācaṃ vicchindanty āpnuvanti trayodaśaṃ māsam
meaning: यद् उपरिष्टाद् व्रतम् उपयन्ति न वाचं विच्छिन्दन्त्य् आप्नुवन्ति त्रयोदशं मासम्
text_mt: Since they undertake the vow at the end, they do not cut speech asunder; they obtain the thirteenth month.

sanskrit_iast: etā vai pratiṣṭhitās trayodaśa rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एता वै प्रतिष्ठितास् त्रयोदश रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: These are firmly established thirteen nights; they establish themselves firmly who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastriṃśārambhaṇo 'tirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रः पृष्ठयः षडहः पृष्ठयः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिंशारम्भणो ऽतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, [and] an atirātra beginning with the thirty-three-fold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: kāmasanayo vā etā rātrayaḥ
meaning: कामसनयो वा एता रात्रयः
text_mt: These nights are obtainers of desires.

sanskrit_iast: virāḍh ḍhi daśātmaikādaśī prajā dvādaśī paśavas trayodaśī kāmāya caturdaśī
meaning: विराढ् ढि दशात्मैकादशी प्रजा द्वादशी पशवस् त्रयोदशी कामाय चतुर्दशी
text_mt: For the virāj is ten; the self is the eleventh; offspring is the twelfth; cattle is the thirteenth; the fourteenth is for desire.

sanskrit_iast: sarvān evaitābhiḥ kāmān avarūndhate
meaning: सर्वान् एवैताभिः कामान् अवरून्धते
text_mt: All desires they secure by these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: etā vāva bradhnasya viṣṭapo yad etau trayastriṃśau madhyataḥ saṃdhīyete tena bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ rohanti
meaning: एता वाव ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपो यद् एतौ त्रयस्त्रिंशौ मध्यतः संधीयेते तेन ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं रोहन्ति
text_mt: These indeed are the surface of the ruddy sun: that these two thirty-three-fold [days] are joined in the middle, thereby they ascend to the surface of the ruddy sun.

sanskrit_iast: dviḥ pṛṣṭhāny upayanty abhipūrvam evaitābhir annādyaṃ dadhate
meaning: द्विः पृष्ठान्य् उपयन्त्य् अभिपूर्वम् एवैताभिर् अन्नाद्यं दधते
text_mt: Twice they undertake the pṛṣṭhas; in regular order they secure food for themselves by these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha āyur gaur jyotir atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः पृष्ठ्य षडह आयुर् गौर् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, the three-day rite consisting of Jyotis, Go, [and] Āyus, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, Āyus, Go, Jyotis, [and] an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: yāṃs talpe vodake vā vivāhe vā mīmāṃseraṃs ta etā upeyuḥ
meaning: यांस् तल्पे वोदके वा विवाहे वा मीमांसेरंस् त एता उपेयुः
text_mt: Those whose eligibility for the marriage bed, or for water, or for marriage they would call into question, they should undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: yat jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ prajñātāṃ stomān upayanti
meaning: यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः प्रज्ञातां स्तोमान् उपयन्ति
text_mt: In that there is the three-day rite of Jyotis, Go, [and] Āyus, they undertake well-known stomas.

sanskrit_iast: imān eva lokān eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhānti
meaning: इमान् एव लोकान् एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठान्ति
text_mt: These worlds indeed: in these very worlds they establish themselves firmly.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho madhyato bhavaty eṣu vāva devatalpo devatalpam eva tad ārohanti talpyā bhavanti
meaning: अथ यत् पृष्ठयः षडहो मध्यतो भवत्य् एषु वाव देवतल्पो देवतल्पम् एव तद् आरोहन्ति तल्प्या भवन्ति
text_mt: Then, in that the pṛṣṭhya six-day rite is in the middle: among these is the bed of the gods; it is the bed of the gods that they then ascend; they become worthy of the bed.

sanskrit_iast: pravasīyasas talpam āpnuvanti
meaning: प्रवसीयसस् तल्पम् आप्नुवन्ति
text_mt: They attain the bed of one who is more prosperous.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad āyur gaur jyotir atirātro yeneto yanti tena punar āyanti
meaning: अथ यद् आयुर् गौर् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रो येनेतो यन्ति तेन पुनर् आयन्ति
text_mt: Then, in that there is Āyus, Go, Jyotis, [and] an atirātra: by that [path] by which they go thither, by that they return.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro gauś cāyuś ca dve ahanī dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो गौश् चायुश् च द्वे अहनी द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, Go and Āyus as two days, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, [and] an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: yad gauś cāyuś ca dve ahanī bhavato mithunau stomāv upayanti prajātyai
meaning: यद् गौश् चायुश् च द्वे अहनी भवतो मिथुनौ स्तोमाव् उपयन्ति प्रजात्यै
text_mt: In that Go and Āyus are two days, they undertake two stomas as a pair, for propagation.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāya
meaning: अथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननाय
text_mt: Then, as for the ten days of the twelve-day rite: they undertake unbroken speech, for generation.

sanskrit_iast: etā vai pratiṣṭhitāś caturdaśa rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एता वै प्रतिष्ठिताश् चतुर्दश रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: These are firmly established fourteen nights; they establish themselves firmly who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho mahāvrataṃ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastriṃśārambhaṇo 'tirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रः पृष्ठयः षडहो महाव्रतं पृष्ठयः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिंशारम्भणो ऽतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, the Mahāvrata, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, [and] an atirātra beginning with the thirty-three-fold stoma.

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai devā devatvam agacchan devatvaṃ gacchanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एताभिर् वै देवा देवत्वम् अगच्छन् देवत्वं गच्छन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: By these [nights] the gods went to divinity; they go to divinity who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: etad vai devānāṃ sattraṃ tad adyāpi devāḥ sattram āsate
meaning: एतद् वै देवानां सत्त्रं तद् अद्यापि देवाः सत्त्रम् आसते
text_mt: This is the sacrificial session of the gods; even today the gods sit at this sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsy atirātro 'tha yāni ṣaḍ ahāni sa pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaha ekāṣṭakā mahāvratam atha yāni ṣaḍ ahāni sa pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho 'māvāsyātirātraḥ
meaning: पौर्णमास्य् अतिरात्रो ऽथ यानि षड् अहानि स पृष्ठयः षडह एकाष्टका महाव्रतम् अथ यानि षड् अहानि स पृष्ठयः षडहो ऽमावास्यातिरात्रः
text_mt: The full-moon day is an atirātra; then the six days that follow are the pṛṣṭhya six-day rite; the Ekāṣṭakā is the Mahāvrata; then the six days that follow are the pṛṣṭhya six-day rite; the new-moon day is an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt tarhi manuṣyāṇāṃ na suto devānāṃ hi tarhi sutaḥ pratyakṣam evaitābhir devatā abhyārohanti
meaning: तस्मात् तर्हि मनुष्याणां न सुतो देवानां हि तर्हि सुतः प्रत्यक्षम् एवैताभिर् देवता अभ्यारोहन्ति
text_mt: Therefore at that time there is no Soma-pressing for men, for at that time the Soma-pressing is of the gods; directly by these [nights] they ascend to the deities.

sanskrit_iast: pratinodāt tu bhayyam itaram anupakṣo dīkṣerann apratinodāya
meaning: प्रतिनोदात् तु भय्यम् इतरम् अनुपक्षो दीक्षेरन्न् अप्रतिनोदाय
text_mt: From mutual conflict, however, fear is to be expected; they should consecrate themselves without rivalry, to avoid mutual conflict.

sanskrit_iast: atirātras trivṛd agniṣṭud agniṣṭomo jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaha āyur gaur jyotir atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रस् त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टुद् अग्निष्टोमो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः पृष्ठयः षडह आयुर् गौर् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, a ninefold Agniṣṭut agniṣṭoma, the three-day rite consisting of Jyotis, Go, [and] Āyus, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, Āyus, Go, Jyotis, [and] an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: kṣatraṃ vā etā rātrayo 'bhinirvadanti
meaning: क्षत्रं वा एता रात्रयो ऽभिनिर्वदन्ति
text_mt: These nights proclaim nobility.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavarcasakāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: ब्रह्मवर्चसकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: Those desiring brahminical lustre should undertake [them].

sanskrit_iast: yat trivṛd agniṣṭud agniṣṭomo bhavati brahma tad yaśasārdhayati
meaning: यत् त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टुद् अग्निष्टोमो भवति ब्रह्म तद् यशसार्धयति
text_mt: In that there is a ninefold Agniṣṭut agniṣṭoma, thereby he causes the priesthood to prosper with glory.

sanskrit_iast: brahma vai trivṛt
meaning: ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत्

sanskrit_iast: yat jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ prajñātān stomān upayantīmān eva lokān eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanty atha yat pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho madhyato bhavaty annaṃ vai pṛṣṭāny annam eva tan madhyato dhīyate tasmān madhye sad annaṃ dhinoty atha yad āyur gaur jyotir atirātro yeneto yanti tena punar āyanti
meaning: यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः प्रज्ञातान् स्तोमान् उपयन्तीमान् एव लोकान् एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्त्य् अथ यत् पृष्ठयः षडहो मध्यतो भवत्य् अन्नं वै पृष्टान्य् अन्नम् एव तन् मध्यतो धीयते तस्मान् मध्ये सद् अन्नं धिनोत्य् अथ यद् आयुर् गौर् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रो येनेतो यन्ति तेन पुनर् आयन्ति
text_mt: In that there is the three-day rite of Jyotis, Go, [and] Āyus, they undertake well-known stomas, these very worlds; in these very worlds they establish themselves firmly. Then, in that the pṛṣṭhya six-day rite is in the middle: the pṛṣṭhas are food; it is food that is then placed in the middle; therefore, being in the middle, food satisfies. Then, in that there is Āyus, Go, Jyotis, [and] an atirātra: by that [path] by which they go thither, by that they return.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭud agniṣṭomo jyotir gaur āyus tryaho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टुद् अग्निष्टोमो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: A ninefold Agniṣṭut agniṣṭoma, the three-day rite consisting of Jyotis, Go, [and] Āyus, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, [and] an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: anyasmai vai kāmāya sattram anyasmai yajño na tat sattreṇāpnoti yasmaikaṃ yajño na tad yajñenāpnoti yasmaikaṃ sattram
meaning: अन्यस्मै वै कामाय सत्त्रम् अन्यस्मै यज्ञो न तत् सत्त्रेणाप्नोति यस्मैकं यज्ञो न तद् यज्ञेनाप्नोति यस्मैकं सत्त्रम्
text_mt: For one desire is a sacrificial session, for another is a sacrifice; one does not attain by a sacrificial session that for which a sacrifice is [performed], nor does one attain by a sacrifice that for which a sacrificial session is [performed].

sanskrit_iast: yad anyato 'tirātrās tena yajño 'tha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni tena sattram
meaning: यद् अन्यतो ऽतिरात्रास् तेन यज्ञो ऽथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि तेन सत्त्रम्
text_mt: In that there are atirātras on both sides, by that it is a sacrifice; and those which are the ten days of the twelve-day rite, by that it is a sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast: ubhāv evaitābhiḥ kāmāv avarūndhate
meaning: उभाव् एवैताभिः कामाव् अवरून्धते
text_mt: They obtain both desires by these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyus tryaho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ prajākāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः प्रजाकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, the three-day period of Jyotis, Go, and Āyus, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, and an atirātra: those desirous of offspring should undertake [this rite].

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata pra prajayā pra paśubhir jāyante ya etā upayanti
meaning: एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत प्र प्रजया प्र पशुभिर् जायन्ते य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: By these, indeed, Prajāpati created offspring; they propagate with offspring and with cattle who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: yat jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ prajātān stomān upayantīmān eva lokān eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः प्रजातान् स्तोमान् उपयन्तीमान् एव लोकान् एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: In that there is the three-day period of Jyotis, Go, and Āyus, they undertake the produced stomas, these very worlds; in these very worlds they become established.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāya
meaning: अथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननाय
text_mt: And those which are the ten days of the twelve-day rite, they undertake unbroken speech for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: etā vai pratiṣṭhitāḥ pañcadaśa rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एता वै प्रतिष्ठिताः पञ्चदश रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: These fifteen nights are indeed firmly established; they become firmly established who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: etā eva samahāvratāḥ
meaning: एता एव समहाव्रताः

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vā indraḥ paramāṃ vijitiṃ vyajayata paramām evaitābhir vijitiṃ vijayante
meaning: एताभिर् वा इन्द्रः परमां विजितिं व्यजयत परमाम् एवैताभिर् विजितिं विजयन्ते
text_mt: By these, indeed, Indra won the supreme victory; by these they win the supreme victory.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśo vai vajro na vā agṛhītena vajreṇa vīryaṃ karoti yā ṣoḍaśy ārambhaṇam eva tad gṛhītena vajreṇa vīryaṃ karoti
meaning: पञ्चदशो वै वज्रो न वा अगृहीतेन वज्रेण वीर्यं करोति या षोडश्य् आरम्भणम् एव तद् गृहीतेन वज्रेण वीर्यं करोति
text_mt: The fifteenfold stoma is indeed the thunderbolt; one does not perform heroic deeds with an ungrasped thunderbolt; that which is the sixteenth [day] is its handle; with a grasped thunderbolt one performs heroic deeds.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyur gaur āyuḥ pañcāho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् गौर् आयुः पञ्चाहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, the five-day period of Jyotis, Go, Āyus, Go, and Āyus, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, and an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai prajāpatir anantāṃ śriyam ajayad anantā vā etā yat pañcāhavidhāḥ
meaning: एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिर् अनन्तां श्रियम् अजयद् अनन्ता वा एता यत् पञ्चाहविधाः
text_mt: By these, indeed, Prajāpati won endless prosperity; these are indeed endless, in that they consist of five-day periods.

sanskrit_iast: yat pañcāho 'nantād eva prajāyante
meaning: यत् पञ्चाहो ऽनन्ताद् एव प्रजायन्ते
text_mt: In that there is a five-day period, they are born from the endless itself.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāya
meaning: अथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननाय
text_mt: And those which are the ten days of the twelve-day rite, they undertake unbroken speech for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: etā vai pratiṣṭhitāḥ saptadaśa rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एता वै प्रतिष्ठिताः सप्तदश रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: These seventeen nights are indeed firmly established; they become firmly established who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atirātro 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, the six-day Abhiplava, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, and an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: devā vai mṛtyor abibhayus te prajāpatim upādhāvaṃs tebhya etenāṣṭādaśarātreṇāmṛtatvaṃ prāyacchat
meaning: देवा वै मृत्योर् अबिभयुस् ते प्रजापतिम् उपाधावंस् तेभ्य एतेनाष्टादशरात्रेणामृतत्वं प्रायच्छत्
text_mt: The gods were afraid of death; they ran to Prajāpati; to them, through this eighteen-night [rite], he gave immortality.

sanskrit_iast: etad vāva manuṣyasyāmṛtatvaṃ yat sarvam āyur eti vasīyān bhavati
meaning: एतद् वाव मनुष्यस्यामृतत्वं यत् सर्वम् आयुर् एति वसीयान् भवति
text_mt: This is indeed man's immortality: that he reaches his full lifespan and becomes wealthier.

sanskrit_iast: sarvam āyur yanti vasīyāṃso bhavanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: सर्वम् आयुर् यन्ति वसीयांसो भवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: They reach their full lifespan and become wealthier who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: dvir vā etā nava nava prāṇā abhipūrvam evaitābhir āyur dadhate
meaning: द्विर् वा एता नव नव प्राणा अभिपूर्वम् एवैताभिर् आयुर् दधते
text_mt: Twice nine are these [days]; nine are the vital breaths; through these they obtain life in proper succession.

sanskrit_iast: etā eva samahāvratāḥ
meaning: एता एव समहाव्रताः

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai vāyur āraṇyānāṃ paśunām ādhipatyaṃ gacchanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एताभिर् वै वायुर् आरण्यानां पशुनाम् आधिपत्यं गच्छन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: By these, indeed, Vāyu [attained] lordship of wild animals; they attain [lordship] who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: mṛgasatraṃ vā etat
meaning: मृगसत्रं वा एतत्

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vā āraṇyāḥ paśavo nākṛtāḥ prajāyante
meaning: एताभिर् वा आरण्याः पशवो नाकृताः प्रजायन्ते
text_mt: By these, indeed, wild animals propagate without a mark.

sanskrit_iast: anākṛtam eṣāṃ prajāyate ya etā upayanti
meaning: अनाकृतम् एषां प्रजायते य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: Without a mark their [offspring] is born who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atrirātro 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho 'bhijic ca viśvajic ca dve ahanī dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: अत्रिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ऽभिजिच् च विश्वजिच् च द्वे अहनी द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, the six-day Abhiplava, Abhijit and Viśvajit as two days, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, and an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: purūṣakāmā upeyur etābhir vai prajāpatiḥ purūṣam asṛjata
meaning: पुरूषकामा उपेयुर् एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिः पुरूषम् असृजत
text_mt: Those desirous of men should undertake [this rite]; by these, indeed, Prajāpati created man.

sanskrit_iast: sa sarvasyānnādyasyādhipatyam agacchat sarvasyānnādyasyādhipatyaṃ gacchanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: स सर्वस्यान्नाद्यस्याधिपत्यम् अगच्छत् सर्वस्यान्नाद्यस्याधिपत्यं गच्छन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: He attained lordship over all food; they attain lordship over all food who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: purūṣasatraṃ vā etat
meaning: पुरूषसत्रं वा एतत्

sanskrit_iast: viṃśo vai purūṣo daśa hi hastyā aṅgulyo daśa pādyāḥ
meaning: विंशो वै पुरूषो दश हि हस्त्या अङ्गुल्यो दश पाद्याः
text_mt: Man consists of twenty parts: ten are the fingers of the hand, ten are the toes.

sanskrit_iast: yad etā viṃśatī rātrayo bhavanty eṣv evaitābhir lokeṣu purūṣaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayanti
meaning: यद् एता विंशती रात्रयो भवन्त्य् एष्व् एवैताभिर् लोकेषु पुरूषं प्रतिष्ठापयन्ति
text_mt: In that there are these twenty nights, by these they establish man in these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: etā vai pratiṣṭhitā viṃśatī rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एता वै प्रतिष्ठिता विंशती रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: These twenty nights are indeed firmly established; they become firmly established who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atirātro 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho 'tirātro 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho 'tirātraḥ paśukāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ऽतिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ऽतिरात्रः पशुकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, a six-day Abhiplava, an atirātra, a six-day Abhiplava, a six-day Abhiplava, and an atirātra: those desirous of cattle should undertake [this rite].

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vā ādityāḥ sapta grāmyān paśūn udasṛjanta paśūn evaitābhir utsṛjanti
meaning: एताभिर् वा आदित्याः सप्त ग्राम्यान् पशून् उदसृजन्त पशून् एवैताभिर् उत्सृजन्ति
text_mt: By these, indeed, the Ādityas brought forth the seven domestic cattle; by these they bring forth cattle.

sanskrit_iast: trir vai sapta saptādityāḥ
meaning: त्रिर् वै सप्त सप्तादित्याः
text_mt: Three times seven are the Ādityas, seven by seven.

sanskrit_iast: paśava ādityāḥ
meaning: पशव आदित्याः

sanskrit_iast: ādityā asmiṃl loke ṛddhā ādityā amuṣmin
meaning: आदित्या अस्मिंल् लोके ऋद्धा आदित्या अमुष्मिन्
text_mt: The Ādityas prosper in this world, the Ādityas in that one.

sanskrit_iast: paśavo 'smin ṛtavo 'muṣmin
meaning: पशवो ऽस्मिन् ऋतवो ऽमुष्मिन्
text_mt: Cattle are in this [world], the seasons in that one.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayor anayor lokayor ṛdhnuvanti devaloke ca manuṣyaloke ca ya etā upayanti
meaning: उभयोर् अनयोर् लोकयोर् ऋध्नुवन्ति देवलोके च मनुष्यलोके च य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: In both these worlds they prosper, in the world of the gods and in the world of men, who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahas trayaḥ svarasāmāno divākīrtyam ahas trayaḥ svarasāmānaḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastriṃśārambhaṇo 'tirātro brahmavarcasakāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रः पृष्ठयः षडहस् त्रयः स्वरसामानो दिवाकीर्त्यम् अहस् त्रयः स्वरसामानः पृष्ठयः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिंशारम्भणो ऽतिरात्रो ब्रह्मवर्चसकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, a six-day Pṛṣṭhya, the three Svarasāmans, the Divākīrtya day, the three Svarasāmans, a six-day Pṛṣṭhya, and an atirātra beginning with the thirty-three-fold stoma: those desirous of brahminical lustre should undertake [this rite].

sanskrit_iast: svarbhānur vā āsuraḥ sūryaṃ tamasāvidhyat tasmai devāḥ prāyaścittim aicchaṃs ta etā avindaṃs tābhir asmāt tamo 'pāghnan
meaning: स्वर्भानुर् वा आसुरः सूर्यं तमसाविध्यत् तस्मै देवाः प्रायश्चित्तिम् ऐच्छंस् त एता अविन्दंस् ताभिर् अस्मात् तमो ऽपाघ्नन्
text_mt: Svarbhānu, the Asura, pierced the sun with darkness; for him the gods sought an expiation; they found these [nights]; by them they struck away the darkness from him.

sanskrit_iast: apa tamo ghnate ya etā upayanti
meaning: अप तमो घ्नते य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: They strike away darkness who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: saumāpauṣaṃ paśum upālabhyam ālabheran
meaning: सौमापौषं पशुम् उपालभ्यम् आलभेरन्
text_mt: They should seize a sacrificial animal dedicated to Soma and Pūṣan as the one to be seized.

sanskrit_iast: somo vai brāhmaṇaḥ paśavaḥ pūṣā svām eva tad devatāṃ paśubhir baṃhayante tvacam evākrata
meaning: सोमो वै ब्राह्मणः पशवः पूषा स्वाम् एव तद् देवतां पशुभिर् बंहयन्ते त्वचम् एवाक्रत
text_mt: Soma is the brāhmaṇa, Pūṣan is cattle; thus they strengthen their own deity through cattle; they make a skin for themselves.

sanskrit_iast: manor ṛcaḥ sāmidhenyo bhavanti
meaning: मनोर् ऋचः सामिधेन्यो भवन्ति
text_mt: Verses of Manu are the kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: manur vai yat kiṃ cāvadat tad bheṣajaṃ bheṣajatāyai
meaning: मनुर् वै यत् किं चावदत् तद् भेषजं भेषजतायै
text_mt: Whatever Manu said, that is medicine; [this is done] for the sake of medicine.

sanskrit_iast: naidādhīya upeyuḥ
meaning: नैदाधीय उपेयुः

sanskrit_iast: tad dhy eṣa prati tejiṣṭhaṃ tapati
meaning: तद् ध्य् एष प्रति तेजिष्ठं तपति
text_mt: For then this [sun] shines most fiercely upon [the earth].

sanskrit_iast: kilāsatvāt tu bhayam ati hy ebhyo 'pahanti
meaning: किलासत्वात् तु भयम् अति ह्य् एभ्यो ऽपहन्ति
text_mt: However, there is fear of leprosy, for it smites away too much for them.

sanskrit_iast: etā vā ugradevo rājanir upait sa kilāso 'bhavat
meaning: एता वा उग्रदेवो राजनिर् उपैत् स किलासो ऽभवत्
text_mt: Ugradeva, the descendant of Rajana, undertook these [nights]; he became leprous.

sanskrit_iast: akilāso bhavati ya evaṃ vidvānetā upaiti
meaning: अकिलासो भवति य एवं विद्वानेता उपैति
text_mt: He who knows thus, undertaking these [nights], does not become leprous.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyus tryaho 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś cānnādyakāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् चान्नाद्यकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, the three-day period of Jyotis, Go, and Āyus, the six-day Abhiplava, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, the Mahāvrata, and an atirātra: those desirous of food should undertake [this rite].

sanskrit_iast: pañcartavo dvādaśa māsās traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśo 'nnaṃ dvāviṃśam ebhyo lokebhyaḥ saṃvatsarād amuṣmād ādityād annādyam avarundhate ya etā upayanti
meaning: पञ्चर्तवो द्वादश मासास् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंशो ऽन्नं द्वाविंशम् एभ्यो लोकेभ्यः संवत्सराद् अमुष्माद् आदित्याद् अन्नाद्यम् अवरुन्धते य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: Five are the seasons, twelve are the months, three are these worlds, that sun is the twenty-first, food is the twenty-second; from these worlds, from the year, from that sun, they obtain food who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyur gaur āyuḥ pañcāho 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ pratiṣṭhākāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् गौर् आयुः पञ्चाहो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः प्रतिष्ठाकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, the five-day period of Jyotis, Go, Āyus, Go, and Āyus, the six-day Abhiplava, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, and an atirātra: those desirous of a firm footing should undertake [this rite].

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai prajāpatir eṣu lokeṣu pratyatiṣṭhat
meaning: एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिर् एषु लोकेषु प्रत्यतिष्ठत्
text_mt: By these, indeed, Prajāpati found a firm footing in these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: yad etās trayoviṃśatī rātrayo bhavanti traya ime lokā eṣv evaitābhir lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: यद् एतास् त्रयोविंशती रात्रयो भवन्ति त्रय इमे लोका एष्व् एवैताभिर् लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: In that there are these twenty-three nights, three are these worlds; in these very worlds they become firmly established by these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: etā vai pratiṣṭhitās trayoviṃśatī rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एता वै प्रतिष्ठितास् त्रयोविंशती रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: These twenty-three nights are indeed firmly established; they become firmly established who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ stomaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastriṃśam ahar aniruktam upahavyasya tantre kḷpta tasya kaṇvarathantaraṃ madhyandine 'tha trayastriṃśa niruktaṃ triṇavaṃ dve ekaviṃśe triṇavaṃ trayastriṃśam ahar niruktaṃ trayastriṃśam ahar aniruktam pṛṣṭhayaḥ stomaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ pratyaṅ trivṛd ahar aniruktaṃ jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo 'tirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रः पृष्ठयः स्तोमः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिंशम् अहर् अनिरुक्तम् उपहव्यस्य तन्त्रे कॢप्त तस्य कण्वरथन्तरं मध्यन्दिने ऽथ त्रयस्त्रिंश निरुक्तं त्रिणवं द्वे एकविंशे त्रिणवं त्रयस्त्रिंशम् अहर् निरुक्तं त्रयस्त्रिंशम् अहर् अनिरुक्तम् पृष्ठयः स्तोमः षडहः प्रत्यङ् त्रिवृद् अहर् अनिरुक्तं ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो ऽतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, a six-day Pṛṣṭhya stoma, an unexpressed thirty-three-fold day arranged on the procedure of the Upahavya—its Kaṇvarathantara at the midday [service]—then an expressed thirty-three-fold [day], a twenty-seven-fold [day], two twenty-one-fold [days], a twenty-seven-fold [day], an expressed thirty-three-fold day, an unexpressed thirty-three-fold day, a six-day Pṛṣṭhya stoma in reverse order, an unexpressed ninefold day, a Jyotiṣṭoma-Agniṣṭoma, [and] an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai devāḥ svarge loke samasīdan svarge loke sīdāmety etāḥ
meaning: एताभिर् वै देवाः स्वर्गे लोके समसीदन् स्वर्गे लोके सीदामेत्य् एताः
text_mt: By these, indeed, the gods sat together in the heavenly world; [wishing,] 'May we sit in the heavenly world,' [they undertake] these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: etā vāva bradhnasya viṣṭapo yad ete trayastiṃśā madhyataḥ saṃdhīyante tena bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ rohanti
meaning: एता वाव ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपो यद् एते त्रयस्तिंशा मध्यतः संधीयन्ते तेन ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं रोहन्ति
text_mt: These are indeed the summit of the sun, because these thirty-three-fold [days] are joined together in the middle; thereby they ascend to the summit of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: madhyataḥ pṛṣṭhāny upayanty annaṃ vai pṛṣṭhāny annam eva tan madhyato dhīyate tasmān madhye sad annaṃ dhinoti
meaning: मध्यतः पृष्ठान्य् उपयन्त्य् अन्नं वै पृष्ठान्य् अन्नम् एव तन् मध्यतो धीयते तस्मान् मध्ये सद् अन्नं धिनोति
text_mt: In the middle they perform the pṛṣṭhas. The pṛṣṭhas are food; thus food is placed in the middle. Therefore, food, being in the middle, invigorates.

sanskrit_iast: saptāhā vā ete
meaning: सप्ताहा वा एते

sanskrit_iast: ato vai prajāḥ prajāyante
meaning: अतो वै प्रजाः प्रजायन्ते
text_mt: From this, indeed, creatures are born.

sanskrit_iast: pra prajayā pra paśubhirjāyante ya etā upayanti
meaning: प्र प्रजया प्र पशुभिर्जायन्ते य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: They are propagated with offspring and with cattle who undertake these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: apaśavyaṃ vā etat sattraṃ yad acchandomaṃ yat saptāhās tena chandomavatyas tena paśavyāḥ
meaning: अपशव्यं वा एतत् सत्त्रं यद् अच्छन्दोमं यत् सप्ताहास् तेन छन्दोमवत्यस् तेन पशव्याः
text_mt: Deprived of cattle is that sacrificial session which is without Chandomas. Because they are seven-day periods, thereby they possess Chandomas; thereby they are rich in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: trayastriṃśas trayastriṃśam anveti trivṛt trivṛtam agrād agraṃ rohanti yat trayastriṃśas trayastriṃśam anveti prāṇāt prāṇeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिंशस् त्रयस्त्रिंशम् अन्वेति त्रिवृत् त्रिवृतम् अग्राद् अग्रं रोहन्ति यत् त्रयस्त्रिंशस् त्रयस्त्रिंशम् अन्वेति प्राणात् प्राणेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: A thirty-three-fold stoma follows a thirty-three-fold stoma; a ninefold stoma [follows] a ninefold stoma. They climb from summit to summit. In that a thirty-three-fold stoma follows a thirty-three-fold stoma, they become established from breath in breaths.

sanskrit_iast: yat trivṛt trivṛtam
meaning: यत् त्रिवृत् त्रिवृतम्

sanskrit_iast: vilomāno vā etā rātrayo yat jyotir agniṣṭoma utthānīyam ahar bhavaty akḷptasya kḷptyai
meaning: विलोमानो वा एता रात्रयो यत् ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोम उत्थानीयम् अहर् भवत्य् अकॢप्तस्य कॢप्त्यै
text_mt: Uneven indeed are these nights. In that the Jyotis Agniṣṭoma is the concluding day, it is for the ordering of what is unordered.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro dvāv abhiplavau ṣaḍahau dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ prajākāmā vā paśukāmā vopeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो द्वाव् अभिप्लवौ षडहौ द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः प्रजाकामा वा पशुकामा वोपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, two Abhiplava six-day periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra—those desiring offspring or desiring cattle should undertake [these twenty-four nights].

sanskrit_iast: kḷptādvai yoneḥ prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante yat kḷptau ṣaḍahāv upayanti kḷptādeva yoneḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyante
meaning: कॢप्ताद्वै योनेः प्रजाः पशवः प्रजायन्ते यत् कॢप्तौ षडहाव् उपयन्ति कॢप्तादेव योनेः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायन्ते
text_mt: From an ordered womb, indeed, offspring and cattle are born. In that they undertake two ordered six-day periods, they are born with offspring and cattle from an ordered womb.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāya
meaning: अथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननाय
text_mt: Then, as to the ten days of the twelve-day rite, they undertake unbroken speech for generation.

sanskrit_iast: etā vai pratiṣṭhitāś caturviṃśatī rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एता वै प्रतिष्ठिताश् चतुर्विंशती रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: These are firmly established twenty-four nights. They who undertake these become firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: etā eva samahāvratāḥ
meaning: एता एव समहाव्रताः

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai prajāpatiḥ sarvam annādyam avārūndha
meaning: एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिः सर्वम् अन्नाद्यम् अवारून्ध
text_mt: By these, indeed, Prajāpati secured all food.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśatiḥ saṃvatsarasyārdhamāsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ pañcaviṃśo 'nnaṃ vrataṃ saṃvatsarād etābhir annādyam avarūndhate ya etā upayanti
meaning: चतुर्विंशतिः संवत्सरस्यार्धमासाः संवत्सरः पञ्चविंशो ऽन्नं व्रतं संवत्सराद् एताभिर् अन्नाद्यम् अवरून्धते य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: Twenty-four are the half-months of the year; the year is the twenty-fifth; the Vrata is food. Through these, from the year, they secure food who undertake these.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro gauś cāyuś ca dve ahanī dvāv abhiplavau ṣaḍāhau dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो गौश् चायुश् च द्वे अहनी द्वाव् अभिप्लवौ षडाहौ द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, the Go and the Āyus, two days, two Abhiplava six-day periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra [—twenty-six nights].

sanskrit_iast: ṛtavo na pratyatiṣṭhaṃs ta etābhiḥ pratyatiṣṭhan pratiṣṭhākāmā upeyuḥ praty eva tiṣṭhanti
meaning: ऋतवो न प्रत्यतिष्ठंस् त एताभिः प्रत्यतिष्ठन् प्रतिष्ठाकामा उपेयुः प्रत्य् एव तिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: The seasons were not firmly established; they became firmly established through these. Those desiring a firm foundation should undertake [them]; they indeed become firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍ vā ṛtava ṛtuṣv evaitābhiḥ pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: षड् वा ऋतव ऋतुष्व् एवैताभिः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: Six are the seasons. In the seasons indeed they become firmly established through these.

sanskrit_iast: yad gauś cāyuś ca dve ahanī bhavato mithunau stomāv upayanti prajātyai
meaning: यद् गौश् चायुश् च द्वे अहनी भवतो मिथुनौ स्तोमाव् उपयन्ति प्रजात्यै
text_mt: In that the Go and the Āyus are two days, they undertake a pair of stomas for procreation.

sanskrit_iast: yat kḷptau ṣaḍahāv upayanti kḷptyā eva
meaning: यत् कॢप्तौ षडहाव् उपयन्ति कॢप्त्या एव
text_mt: In that they undertake two ordered six-day periods, it is just for proper order.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāya
meaning: अथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननाय
text_mt: Then, as to the ten days of the twelve-day rite, they undertake unbroken speech for generation.

sanskrit_iast: etā vai pratiṣṭhitā ṣaḍviṃśatī rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एता वै प्रतिष्ठिता षड्विंशती रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: These are firmly established twenty-six nights. They who undertake these become firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyus tryaho dvāv abhiplavau ṣaḍahau dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātra ṛddhikāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहो द्वाव् अभिप्लवौ षडहौ द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्र ऋद्धिकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, the three-day period of Jyotis, Go, and Āyus, two Abhiplava six-day periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra—those desiring prosperity should undertake [them].

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai nakṣatrāṇi sarvāmṛddhim ārdhnuvan sarvām ṛddhim ṛdhnuvanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एताभिर् वै नक्षत्राणि सर्वामृद्धिम् आर्ध्नुवन् सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नुवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: By these indeed the constellations attained all prosperity. They attain all prosperity who undertake these.

sanskrit_iast: yad etā saptaviṃśatī rātrayo bhavanti saptaviṃśatir nakṣatrāṇi nakṣatrasammitā vā etā rātrayo nakṣatrāṇām evardhim ṛdhnuvanti
meaning: यद् एता सप्तविंशती रात्रयो भवन्ति सप्तविंशतिर् नक्षत्राणि नक्षत्रसम्मिता वा एता रात्रयो नक्षत्राणाम् एवर्धिम् ऋध्नुवन्ति
text_mt: In that these are twenty-seven nights—twenty-seven are the constellations. Measured to the constellations indeed are these nights. They prosper with the prosperity of the constellations.

sanskrit_iast: etā eva samahāvratāḥ paśukāmā upeyur yad etā aṣṭāviṃśatī rātrayo bhavanty aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavaḥ śaphaśa evaitābhiḥ paśūn avarūndhate
meaning: एता एव समहाव्रताः पशुकामा उपेयुर् यद् एता अष्टाविंशती रात्रयो भवन्त्य् अष्टाशफाः पशवः शफश एवैताभिः पशून् अवरून्धते
text_mt: These same [nights], combined with the Mahāvrata, those desiring cattle should undertake. In that these are twenty-eight nights—eight-hoofed are cattle. Hoof by hoof indeed they secure cattle through these.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyur gaur āyuḥ pañcāho dvāv abhiplavau ṣaḍahau dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् गौर् आयुः पञ्चाहो द्वाव् अभिप्लवौ षडहौ द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, the five-day period of Jyotis, Go, Āyus, Go, and Āyus, two Abhiplava six-day periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra [—twenty-nine nights].

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai prajāpatir anantāṃ śriyam ajayat
meaning: एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिर् अनन्तां श्रियम् अजयत्
text_mt: By these indeed Prajāpati won endless splendour.

sanskrit_iast: anantā vā etā yā ekayānatriṃśann eti vai vāco 'nantam
meaning: अनन्ता वा एता या एकयानत्रिंशन्न् एति वै वाचो ऽनन्तम्
text_mt: Endless indeed are these [nights] which are one less than thirty; for one does not reach the end of speech.

sanskrit_iast: yad etā ekayānatriṃśad rātrayo bhavanty anantām evaitābhiḥ śriyaṃ jayanti
meaning: यद् एता एकयानत्रिंशद् रात्रयो भवन्त्य् अनन्ताम् एवैताभिः श्रियं जयन्ति
text_mt: In that these are twenty-nine nights, they win endless splendour through these.

sanskrit_iast: atirātras trayo 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātro 'nnādyakāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रस् त्रयो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहा द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रो ऽन्नाद्यकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, three Abhiplava six-day periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra—those desiring food should undertake [them].

sanskrit_iast: parokṣam anyāni sattrāṇi virājaṃ sampadyante pratyakṣam etā virājaṃ sampannāḥ
meaning: परोक्षम् अन्यानि सत्त्राणि विराजं सम्पद्यन्ते प्रत्यक्षम् एता विराजं सम्पन्नाः
text_mt: Cryptically other sacrificial sessions correspond to the virāj; directly these correspond to the virāj.

sanskrit_iast: pratyakṣam etābhir annādyam avarūndhate ya etā upayanti
meaning: प्रत्यक्षम् एताभिर् अन्नाद्यम् अवरून्धते य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: Directly they secure food through these who undertake these.

sanskrit_iast: etā eva samahāvratā etābhir vai prajāpatir abhipūrvam annādyam avārūndha
meaning: एता एव समहाव्रता एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिर् अभिपूर्वम् अन्नाद्यम् अवारून्ध
text_mt: These same [nights], combined with the Mahāvrata [are thirty-one nights]. By these indeed Prajāpati secured food successively.

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ virāḍ annaṃ vratam
meaning: अन्नं विराड् अन्नं व्रतम्
text_mt: Food is the virāj; food is the Vrata.

sanskrit_iast: abhipūrvam evaitābhir annādyam avarūndhate
meaning: अभिपूर्वम् एवैताभिर् अन्नाद्यम् अवरून्धते
text_mt: Successively indeed they secure food through these.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro gauś cāyuś ca dve ahanī trayo 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ paśukāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो गौश् चायुश् च द्वे अहनी त्रयो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहा द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः पशुकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, the Go and the Āyus, two days, three Abhiplava six-day periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra—those desiring cattle should undertake [them].

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭub vā etā rātrayaḥ
meaning: अनुष्टुब् वा एता रात्रयः
text_mt: The anuṣṭubh indeed are these nights.

sanskrit_iast: dvātriṃśad akṣarānuṣṭup
meaning: द्वात्रिंशद् अक्षरानुष्टुप्
text_mt: The anuṣṭubh has thirty-two syllables.

sanskrit_iast: vāg anuṣṭup
meaning: वाग् अनुष्टुप्

sanskrit_iast: catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ
meaning: चतुष्पादाः पशवः

sanskrit_iast: vācā paśūn dādhāra
meaning: वाचा पशून् दाधार

sanskrit_iast: etābhī rātrībhiḥ
meaning: एताभी रात्रीभिः

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt te vācā siddhā vācāhūtā ā yanti
meaning: तस्मात् ते वाचा सिद्धा वाचाहूता आ यन्ति
text_mt: Therefore they, being controlled by speech, being summoned by speech, come.

sanskrit_iast: atirātras trayaḥ pañcāhā viśvajid atirātra ekaḥ pañcāho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रस् त्रयः पञ्चाहा विश्वजिद् अतिरात्र एकः पञ्चाहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, three five-day periods, a Viśvajit atirātra, one five-day period, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra [—thirty-three nights].

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tā na pratyatiṣṭhaṃs tā etābhiḥ pratyatiṣṭhann ime lokā na pratyatiṣṭhaṃs ta etābhiḥ pratyatiṣṭhan pratyatiṣṭhan pratiṣṭhākāmā upeyuḥ praty eva tiṣṭhanti
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत ता न प्रत्यतिष्ठंस् ता एताभिः प्रत्यतिष्ठन्न् इमे लोका न प्रत्यतिष्ठंस् त एताभिः प्रत्यतिष्ठन् प्रत्यतिष्ठन् प्रतिष्ठाकामा उपेयुः प्रत्य् एव तिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: Prajāpati created creatures. They were not firmly established; through these they became firmly established. These worlds were not firmly established; through these they became firmly established. Those desiring a firm foundation should undertake [them]; they indeed become firmly established.

sanskrit_iast: arūpeṇa vā etāḥ sarūpā arūpeṇa prajāḥ sarūpā arūpeṇeme lokāḥ sarūpā yad rathantarasya lokaṃ bṛhad āpadyate bṛhato rathantaram arūpeṇaivaibhyas tat sarūpaṃ prajanayanti
meaning: अरूपेण वा एताः सरूपा अरूपेण प्रजाः सरूपा अरूपेणेमे लोकाः सरूपा यद् रथन्तरस्य लोकं बृहद् आपद्यते बृहतो रथन्तरम् अरूपेणैवैभ्यस् तत् सरूपं प्रजनयन्ति
text_mt: Through the formless indeed these [chants] are of like form; through the formless creatures are of like form; through the formless these worlds are of like form. In that the Bṛhat falls into the place of the Rathantara, and the Rathantara [into that] of the Bṛhat, through the formless indeed they generate for them that which has form.

sanskrit_iast: lupyate vā etat ṣaṣṭham ahar yat pañcāhān upayanti nartavaḥ kalpanteḥ yat pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahas tena ṣaṣṭham ahar na lupyate tenartavaḥ kalpante
meaning: लुप्यते वा एतत् षष्ठम् अहर् यत् पञ्चाहान् उपयन्ति नर्तवः कल्पन्तेः यत् पृष्ठयः षडहस् तेन षष्ठम् अहर् न लुप्यते तेनर्तवः कल्पन्ते
text_mt: The sixth day is omitted when they undertake five-day periods; the seasons do not order themselves. In that there is a Pṛṣṭhya six-day period, thereby the sixth day is not omitted; thereby the seasons order themselves.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni tena pañcāhebhyo na yanti
meaning: अथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि तेन पञ्चाहेभ्यो न यन्ति
text_mt: Then, as to the ten days of the twelve-day rite, thereby they do not depart from the five-day periods.

sanskrit_iast: ūdhar vā antarikṣaṃ stanāv abhito 'nena vā eṣa devebhyo dugdhe 'munā prajābhyaḥ
meaning: ऊधर् वा अन्तरिक्षं स्तनाव् अभितो ऽनेन वा एष देवेभ्यो दुग्धे ऽमुना प्रजाभ्यः
text_mt: The udder is the intermediate space; the two teats are on both sides. By this one he milks for the gods, by that one for creatures.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ vā antarikṣaṃ viyad imau stanāv abhitaḥ
meaning: इदं वा अन्तरिक्षं वियद् इमौ स्तनाव् अभितः
text_mt: This intermediate space is the expanding [udder]; these two are the teats on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: tad abhyanūktā
meaning: तद् अभ्यनूक्ता

sanskrit_iast: triṃśati trayaḥ paro ye devā barhir āsata vyann aha dvitā taneti
meaning: त्रिंशति त्रयः परो ये देवा बर्हिर् आसत व्यन्न् अह द्विता तनेति
text_mt: “In the thirty are three beyond; the gods who sat upon the sacrificial grass, / dividing, indeed, doubly stretch out the day.”

sanskrit_iast: ūdhar vai madhyamo 'tirātraḥ stanāv abhitaḥ
meaning: ऊधर् वै मध्यमो ऽतिरात्रः स्तनाव् अभितः
text_mt: The middle atirātra is the udder; the teats are on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: yad eṣo 'natirātraḥ syād ūdhaḥ pratiharet
meaning: यद् एषो ऽनतिरात्रः स्याद् ऊधः प्रतिहरेत्
text_mt: If this [rite] were without an atirātra, he would draw back the udder.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād atirātraḥ kārya ūdhaso 'pratihārāya
meaning: तस्माद् अतिरात्रः कार्य ऊधसो ऽप्रतिहाराय
text_mt: Therefore an atirātra is to be performed, so that the udder is not drawn back.

sanskrit_iast: trayastriṃśad devatā etābhir ārdhnuvaṃs tenardhis tasmād etābhir yajanta ṛdhyā eva
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवता एताभिर् आर्ध्नुवंस् तेनर्धिस् तस्माद् एताभिर् यजन्त ऋध्या एव
text_mt: Thirty-three deities prospered through these; thereby there is prosperity. Therefore they sacrifice with these, just for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: nānā brahmasāmāny upayanty ahnā nānā vīryatāyai nānaiva vīryāṇy avarūndhate
meaning: नाना ब्रह्मसामान्य् उपयन्त्य् अह्ना नाना वीर्यतायै नानैव वीर्याण्य् अवरून्धते
text_mt: They undertake different Brahmasāmans day by day for manifold virility. They secure distinct virilities.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho 'tirātro 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho 'tirātro 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvrataṃ cātirāś ca
meaning: अतिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ऽतिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ऽतिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि महाव्रतं चातिराश् च
text_mt: An atirātra, an Abhiplava six-day period, an atirātra, an Abhiplava six-day period, an atirātra, an Abhiplava six-day period, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, the Mahāvrata, and an atirātra [—thirty-four nights].

sanskrit_iast: ādityāś cāṅgirasaś caitat sattraṃ samadadhatādityānām ekaviṃśatir aṅgirasāṃ dvādaśāha ādityā asmiṃl loka ṛddhā ādityā amuṣminn aṅgiraso 'sminn aṅgiraso 'muṣmin dvayaṃ sattraṃ yāvad dvayena sattreṇardhnuvanti tāvaty etāsām ṛddhiḥ
meaning: आदित्याश् चाङ्गिरसश् चैतत् सत्त्रं समदधतादित्यानाम् एकविंशतिर् अङ्गिरसां द्वादशाह आदित्या अस्मिंल् लोक ऋद्धा आदित्या अमुष्मिन्न् अङ्गिरसो ऽस्मिन्न् अङ्गिरसो ऽमुष्मिन् द्वयं सत्त्रं यावद् द्वयेन सत्त्रेणर्ध्नुवन्ति तावत्य् एतासाम् ऋद्धिः
text_mt: The Ādityas and the Aṅgirases composed this sacrificial session. The twenty-one days belong to the Ādityas, the twelve-day rite to the Aṅgirases. The Ādityas prospered in this world, the Ādityas in that one; the Aṅgirases in this, the Aṅgirases in that. It is a twofold sacrificial session. As much as they prosper through a twofold sacrificial session, so great is their prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: atirātras trayaḥ pañcāhā viśvajid atirātras trayaḥ pañcāhā atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रस् त्रयः पञ्चाहा विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रस् त्रयः पञ्चाहा अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, three five-day periods, a Viśvajit, an atirātra, three five-day periods, an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: apaśavyaṃ vā etat sattraṃ yad acchandomaṃ yadviśvajiti chandomān upayanti tena chandomavatyas tena paśavyāḥ
meaning: अपशव्यं वा एतत् सत्त्रं यद् अच्छन्दोमं यद्विश्वजिति छन्दोमान् उपयन्ति तेन छन्दोमवत्यस् तेन पशव्याः
text_mt: This sacrificial session is indeed devoid of cattle, since it is without Chandomas. In that they perform Chandoma days on the Viśvajit, thereby it possesses Chandomas, thereby it leads to cattle.

sanskrit_iast: pakṣiṇyo vā etā rātrayo yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayante tam etābhir abhyaśnuvate yatra yatra hi pakṣī kāmayate tat tad abhyaśnute
meaning: पक्षिण्यो वा एता रात्रयो यं कामं कामयन्ते तम् एताभिर् अभ्यश्नुवते यत्र यत्र हि पक्षी कामयते तत् तद् अभ्यश्नुते
text_mt: These nights are indeed winged. Whatever wish they desire, they attain with these; for wherever a winged [bird] desires, there it reaches.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtā prayanti trivṛtodyanti prāṇā vai trivṛt stomānāṃ prāṇair eva prayanti prāṇeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: त्रिवृता प्रयन्ति त्रिवृतोद्यन्ति प्राणा वै त्रिवृत् स्तोमानां प्राणैर् एव प्रयन्ति प्राणेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: They start out with the ninefold stoma, they conclude with the ninefold stoma. The vital breaths, indeed, are the ninefold stoma among stomas. They start out with the vital breaths, they become established in the vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyus tryahas trayo 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś cardhikāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहस् त्रयो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहा द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् चर्धिकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, Jyotis, Go, Āyus [forming] a three-day period, three six-day Abhiplava periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, the Mahāvrata, and an atirātra: those desiring prosperity should undertake [these thirty-four nights].

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai prajāpatiḥ sarvām ṛddhim ārdhnot sarvām ṛddhim ṛdhnuvanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिः सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् आर्ध्नोत् सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नुवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: By these, indeed, Prajāpati prospered in all prosperity. In all prosperity do those prosper who undertake these.

sanskrit_iast: yad etāś catustriṃśad rātrayo bhavanti trayastriṃśad devatāḥ prajāpatiś catustriṃśo devatānāṃ prajāpater evardhim ṛdhnuvanti
meaning: यद् एताश् चतुस्त्रिंशद् रात्रयो भवन्ति त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवताः प्रजापतिश् चतुस्त्रिंशो देवतानां प्रजापतेर् एवर्धिम् ऋध्नुवन्ति
text_mt: In that there are these thirty-four nights: thirty-three are the deities, and Prajāpati is the thirty-fourth of the deities. They prosper in the very prosperity of Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyuḥ pañcāhas trayo 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ paśukāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुः पञ्चाहस् त्रयो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहा द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः पशुकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, Jyotis, Go, Āyus, a five-day period, three six-day Abhiplava periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra: those desiring cattle should undertake [these thirty-five nights].

sanskrit_iast: yad etāḥ pañcātriṃśad rātrayo bhavanti pāṅktāḥ paśavaḥ paśūn evaitābhir avarundhate
meaning: यद् एताः पञ्चात्रिंशद् रात्रयो भवन्ति पाङ्क्ताः पशवः पशून् एवैताभिर् अवरुन्धते
text_mt: In that there are these thirty-five nights: cattle are fivefold; with these they secure cattle.

sanskrit_iast: atirātraś catvāro 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ paśukāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रश् चत्वारो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहा द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः पशुकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: An atirātra, four six-day Abhiplava periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra: those desiring cattle should undertake [these thirty-six nights].

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai devā ādityam astabhnuvann ādityalokaṃ jayanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एताभिर् वै देवा आदित्यम् अस्तभ्नुवन्न् आदित्यलोकं जयन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: By these, indeed, the gods supported the sun. Those who undertake these conquer the world of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhatī vā etā rātrayaḥ svārājyaṃ chandasāṃ bṛhatī yo vai paśūnāṃ bhūmānaṃ gacchati sa svārājyaṃ gacchati pra svārājyam āpnuvanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: बृहती वा एता रात्रयः स्वाराज्यं छन्दसां बृहती यो वै पशूनां भूमानं गच्छति स स्वाराज्यं गच्छति प्र स्वाराज्यम् आप्नुवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: These nights are indeed the Bṛhatī. The Bṛhatī is self-rule among the metres. He who attains abundance of cattle attains self-rule. Those who undertake these attain self-rule.

sanskrit_iast: etā eva samahāvratāḥ
meaning: एता एव समहाव्रताः

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai prajāpatir ubhau kāmāv avārūndhānnaṃ vrataṃ paśavo bṛhaty ubhāv evaitābhiḥ kāmāv avarūndhate
meaning: एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिर् उभौ कामाव् अवारून्धान्नं व्रतं पशवो बृहत्य् उभाव् एवैताभिः कामाव् अवरून्धते
text_mt: By these, indeed, Prajāpati secured both desires: food, which is the [Mahā]vrata, and cattle, which are the Bṛhatī. They secure both desires by these.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro gauś cāyuś ca dve ahanī catvāro 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ paśukāmā upeyuḥ spaṣṭo 'rthaḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो गौश् चायुश् च द्वे अहनी चत्वारो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहा द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः पशुकामा उपेयुः स्पष्टो ऽर्थः
text_mt: An atirātra, Go and Āyus [as] two days, four six-day Abhiplava periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra: those desiring cattle should undertake [these thirty-eight nights]. The meaning is clear.

sanskrit_iast: yad etā aṣṭātriṃśad rātrayo bhavanty aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavaḥ śaphaśa evaitābhiḥ paśun avarūndhate
meaning: यद् एता अष्टात्रिंशद् रात्रयो भवन्त्य् अष्टाशफाः पशवः शफश एवैताभिः पशुन् अवरून्धते
text_mt: In that there are these thirty-eight nights: cattle are eight-hoofed; hoof by hoof they secure cattle by these.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyus tryahaś catvāro 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहश् चत्वारो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहा द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, Jyotis, Go, Āyus [forming] a three-day period, four six-day Abhiplava periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra [making thirty-nine nights].

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai prajāpatir anantā śriyam ajayad anantā vā etā yā ekayānacatvāriṃśan neti vai vāco 'nantam
meaning: एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिर् अनन्ता श्रियम् अजयद् अनन्ता वा एता या एकयानचत्वारिंशन् नेति वै वाचो ऽनन्तम्
text_mt: By these, indeed, Prajāpati conquered endless prosperity. Endless indeed are these [nights] which are thirty-nine; for 'no' is the endlessness of speech.

sanskrit_iast: yad etā ekayānacatvāriṃśad rātrayo bhavanty anantām evaitābhiḥ śriyaṃ jayanti
meaning: यद् एता एकयानचत्वारिंशद् रात्रयो भवन्त्य् अनन्ताम् एवैताभिः श्रियं जयन्ति
text_mt: In that there are these thirty-nine nights, they conquer endless prosperity by these.

sanskrit_iast: etā eva samahāvratāḥ
meaning: एता एव समहाव्रताः

sanskrit_iast: sarvā vā etā virājo daśinī prathamā viṃśinī dvitīyā triṃśinī tṛtīyaiṣā vai paramā virāṭ yac catvāriṃśad rātrayaḥ paṅktir vai paramā virāṭ
meaning: सर्वा वा एता विराजो दशिनी प्रथमा विंशिनी द्वितीया त्रिंशिनी तृतीयैषा वै परमा विराट् यच् चत्वारिंशद् रात्रयः पङ्क्तिर् वै परमा विराट्
text_mt: All these are virājes: the first contains ten, the second contains twenty, the third contains thirty; and this is the supreme virāj, namely forty nights; for the paṅkti is the supreme virāj.

sanskrit_iast: paramāyām eva virāji pratitiṣṭhanti
meaning: परमायाम् एव विराजि प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
text_mt: In the supreme virāj do they become established.

sanskrit_iast: atirātras trīṇi trivṛnty ahāny agniṣṭomamukhāny atirātro daśa pañcadaśā ukthyāḥ ṣoḍaśimad daśamam ahar atirātro dvādaśa saptadaśā ukthyā atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho 'tirātro dvādaśaikaviṃśā ukthyā atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रस् त्रीणि त्रिवृन्त्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोममुखान्य् अतिरात्रो दश पञ्चदशा उक्थ्याः षोडशिमद् दशमम् अहर् अतिरात्रो द्वादश सप्तदशा उक्थ्या अतिरात्रः पृष्ठयः षडहो ऽतिरात्रो द्वादशैकविंशा उक्थ्या अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, three ninefold days having the agniṣṭoma as opening, an atirātra, ten fifteenfold ukthya [days] with the tenth day containing the ṣoḍaśin, an atirātra, twelve seventeenfold ukthya [days], an atirātra, a six-day Pṛṣṭhya period, an atirātra, twelve twenty-one-fold ukthya [days], an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tā avidhṛtā asañjānānā anyonyām ādaṃs tena prajāpatir aśocat sa etā apaśyat tato vā idaṃ vyāvartata gāvo 'bhavann aśvā aśvāḥ purūṣāḥ purūṣā mṛgā mṛgāḥ
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत ता अविधृता असञ्जानाना अन्योन्याम् आदंस् तेन प्रजापतिर् अशोचत् स एता अपश्यत् ततो वा इदं व्यावर्तत गावो ऽभवन्न् अश्वा अश्वाः पुरूषाः पुरूषा मृगा मृगाः
text_mt: Prajāpati created creatures. Being held apart by nothing and having no understanding, they devoured one another. On that account Prajāpati grieved. He saw these [nights]. Thereupon this [creation] differentiated itself: cows became [cows], horses horses, men men, wild animals wild animals.

sanskrit_iast: vi pāpmanā vartante ya etā upayanti
meaning: वि पाप्मना वर्तन्ते य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: Those who undertake these part from evil.

sanskrit_iast: yad atirātrā antarā vidhṛtyai tasmān netara itarasmin reto dadhāti
meaning: यद् अतिरात्रा अन्तरा विधृत्यै तस्मान् नेतर इतरस्मिन् रेतो दधाति
text_mt: That there are atirātras between is for holding apart; therefore one [species] does not place its seed in another.

sanskrit_iast: yat pṛṣṭhyāḥ stomāḥ sa sṛṣṭās tasmād ajāvayaḥ paśūnāṃ saha caranti tasmād u gardabho vaḍavāyā reto dadhāti
meaning: यत् पृष्ठ्याः स्तोमाः स सृष्टास् तस्माद् अजावयः पशूनां सह चरन्ति तस्माद् उ गर्दभो वडवाया रेतो दधाति
text_mt: In that the pṛṣṭhya stomas are combined together, therefore goats and sheep range together among cattle; and therefore the donkey places his seed in the mare.

sanskrit_iast: apaśavyaṃ vā etat sattraṃ yad acchandomaṃ yat sandhiṣāmasu chandāṃsy upayanti tena chandomavatyas tena paśavyāḥ
meaning: अपशव्यं वा एतत् सत्त्रं यद् अच्छन्दोमं यत् सन्धिषामसु छन्दांस्य् उपयन्ति तेन छन्दोमवत्यस् तेन पशव्याः
text_mt: This sacrificial session is indeed devoid of cattle, since it is without Chandomas. In that they perform metres in the sandhisāmans, thereby it possesses Chandomas, thereby it leads to cattle.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṣu jarābodhīyam uṣṇikṣu śrudhyam anuṣṭupsu nānadaṃ bṛhatīṣu rathantaraṃ paṅktiṣu rāyovājīyaṃ triṣṭupsv auśanaṃ jagatīṣu kāvam
meaning: गायत्रीषु जराबोधीयम् उष्णिक्षु श्रुध्यम् अनुष्टुप्सु नानदं बृहतीषु रथन्तरं पङ्क्तिषु रायोवाजीयं त्रिष्टुप्स्व् औशनं जगतीषु कावम्
text_mt: On gāyatrīs the Jarābodhīya; on uṣṇihs the Śrudhya; on anuṣṭubhs the Nānada; on bṛhatīs the Rathantara; on paṅktis the Rāyovājīya; on triṣṭubhs the Auśana; on jagatīs the Kāva.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvāni chandāṃsy upayanty anapabhraṃśāya
meaning: ऊर्ध्वानि छन्दांस्य् उपयन्त्य् अनपभ्रंशाय
text_mt: They employ ascending metres, to avoid falling down.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇo vai svaro yat svarāv antato bhavatas tasmāt dvāv antataḥ prāṇau
meaning: प्राणो वै स्वरो यत् स्वराव् अन्ततो भवतस् तस्मात् द्वाव् अन्ततः प्राणौ
text_mt: Breath, indeed, is the svara. In that there are two svaras at the end, therefore there are two breaths at the end.

sanskrit_iast: atirātrau dvāv abhiplavau ṣaḍahau gauś cāyuś cātirātrau dvāv abhiplavau ṣaḍahāv abhijic ca viśvajic catirātrāv eko 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sarvastomaś ca nava saptadaśaś cātirātro dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś ca
meaning: अतिरात्रौ द्वाव् अभिप्लवौ षडहौ गौश् चायुश् चातिरात्रौ द्वाव् अभिप्लवौ षडहाव् अभिजिच् च विश्वजिच् चतिरात्राव् एको ऽभिप्लवः षडहः सर्वस्तोमश् च नव सप्तदशश् चातिरात्रो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् च
text_mt: Two atirātras, two six-day Abhiplava periods, Go and Āyus, two atirātras, two six-day Abhiplava periods, Abhijit and Viśvajit, two atirātras, one six-day Abhiplava period, a Sarvastoma and a nine-[and]-seventeenfold [day], an atirātra, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, the Mahāvrata, and an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: ādityānāṃ yamātirātrāḥ
meaning: आदित्यानां यमातिरात्राः
text_mt: These are the paired atirātras of the Ādityas.

sanskrit_iast: yamevaiṣā śrīr bhavati ya etā upayanti
meaning: यमेवैषा श्रीर् भवति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: Paired indeed is the prosperity of those who undertake these.

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vā ādityā dvandvam ārdhnuvan mitraś ca varūṇaś ca dhātā cāryamā cāṃśaś ca bhagaś cendraś ca vivasvāś caitāsām eva devatānām ṛddhim ṛdhnuvanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एताभिर् वा आदित्या द्वन्द्वम् आर्ध्नुवन् मित्रश् च वरूणश् च धाता चार्यमा चांशश् च भगश् चेन्द्रश् च विवस्वाश् चैतासाम् एव देवतानाम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नुवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: By these, indeed, the Ādityas prospered in pairs: Mitra and Varuṇa, Dhātṛ and Aryaman, Aṃśa and Bhaga, Indra and Vivasvat. In the prosperity of these very deities do they prosper who undertake these.

sanskrit_iast: tad abhyanūktā
meaning: तद् अभ्यनूक्ता

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau putrāso aditer ye jātās tanvaṃ pari devā upaprait saptabhiḥ parā mārtāṇḍam āsyad iti
meaning: अष्टौ पुत्रासो अदितेर् ये जातास् तन्वं परि देवा उपप्रैत् सप्तभिः परा मार्ताण्डम् आस्यद् इति
text_mt: 'Eight are the sons of Aditi who were born from her body; with seven she went forth to the gods, and she cast out Mārtāṇḍa.'

sanskrit_iast: ādityā asmiṃl loka ṛddhā ādityā amuṣminn ubhayor anayor lokayor ṛdhnuvanti devaloke ca manuṣyaloke ca ya etā upayanti
meaning: आदित्या अस्मिंल् लोक ऋद्धा आदित्या अमुष्मिन्न् उभयोर् अनयोर् लोकयोर् ऋध्नुवन्ति देवलोके च मनुष्यलोके च य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: The Ādityas prospered in this world, the Ādityas in that one. In both these worlds—the world of gods and the world of men—do they prosper who undertake these.

sanskrit_iast: atirātraś catvāro 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahāḥ sarvastomo 'tirātro dvāv abhiplavau ṣaḍahau dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रश् चत्वारो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहाः सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रो द्वाव् अभिप्लवौ षडहौ द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, four six-day Abhiplava periods, a Sarvastoma, an atirātra, two six-day Abhiplava periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata sa rūkṣo 'bhavat taṃ rūkṣaṃ nājanan sa ā cāṅktābhi cāṅkta
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत स रूक्षो ऽभवत् तं रूक्षं नाजनन् स आ चाङ्क्ताभि चाङ्क्त
text_mt: Prajāpati created creatures. He became dry. Since he was dry, they did not recognise him. He anointed himself all over.

sanskrit_iast: ya ātmānaṃ neva jānīraṃs ta etā upeyur yadā cāñjate 'bhi cāñjate śubham evātman dadhate jānanty enān
meaning: य आत्मानं नेव जानीरंस् त एता उपेयुर् यदा चाञ्जते ऽभि चाञ्जते शुभम् एवात्मन् दधते जानन्त्य् एनान्
text_mt: Those who should not recognise themselves, as it were, should undertake these [nights]. When they anoint themselves all over, they put beauty on themselves; they recognise them.

sanskrit_iast: gauggulavena prātassavane saugandhikena mādhyandine savane paitudāraveṇa tṛtīyasavane
meaning: गौग्गुलवेन प्रातस्सवने सौगन्धिकेन माध्यन्दिने सवने पैतुदारवेण तृतीयसवने
text_mt: With bdellium ointment at the morning pressing, with sweet-scented ointment at the midday pressing, with deodar ointment at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: agnir vai devānāṃ hautram upaiṣyañ charīram adhūnuta tasya yanmāṃ samāsīt tad guggulv abhavadyat snāva tat sugandhitejanaṃ yad asthi tat potudārv etāni vai devasurabhīṇi devasurabhibhir eva tad abhyañjate
meaning: अग्निर् वै देवानां हौत्रम् उपैष्यञ् छरीरम् अधूनुत तस्य यन्मां समासीत् तद् गुग्गुल्व् अभवद्यत् स्नाव तत् सुगन्धितेजनं यद् अस्थि तत् पोतुदार्व् एतानि वै देवसुरभीणि देवसुरभिभिर् एव तद् अभ्यञ्जते
text_mt: Agni, when about to undertake the hotṛ-office for the gods, shook his body. What meat he had became bdellium; what tendon, that was fragrant reed; what bone, that was deodar. These indeed are divine fragrances. With divine fragrances indeed they then anoint themselves.

sanskrit_iast: atirātraś caturviṃśaṃ prāyaṇīyam ahas trayo 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā abhijit trayaḥ svarasāmāno divākīrtyam ahas trayaḥ svarasāmāno viśvajid eko 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaha āyuś ca gauś ca dve āhanī dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś ca saṃvatsarasam mitā yāvatī saṃvatsarasyarddhis tāvaty etāsām ṛddhiḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रश् चतुर्विंशं प्रायणीयम् अहस् त्रयो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहा अभिजित् त्रयः स्वरसामानो दिवाकीर्त्यम् अहस् त्रयः स्वरसामानो विश्वजिद् एको ऽभिप्लवः षडह आयुश् च गौश् च द्वे आहनी द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् च संवत्सरसम् मिता यावती संवत्सरस्यर्द्धिस् तावत्य् एतासाम् ऋद्धिः
text_mt: An atirātra, the twenty-four-fold introductory day, three six-day Abhiplava periods, the Abhijit, three Svarasāman [days], the Divākīrtya day, three Svarasāman [days], the Viśvajit, one six-day Abhiplava period, Āyus and Go [as] two days, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, the Mahāvrata, and an atirātra: [these are] commensurate with the year. As great as is the prosperity of the year, so great is the prosperity of these [nights].

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yac caturviṃśam ahaḥ prayaṇīyaṃ kuryuḥ saṃvatsaram ārabhya na samāpayeyur iti trivṛd eva kāryaṃ prāṇā vai trivṛt prāṇān evopayanti
meaning: तद् आहुर् यच् चतुर्विंशम् अहः प्रयणीयं कुर्युः संवत्सरम् आरभ्य न समापयेयुर् इति त्रिवृद् एव कार्यं प्राणा वै त्रिवृत् प्राणान् एवोपयन्ति
text_mt: Concerning this they say: 'If they were to make the opening day twenty-four-fold, they would begin the year and not complete it.' The ninefold stoma should be performed; the vital breaths indeed are the ninefold stoma: it is the vital breaths that they enter upon.

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhuś caturviṃśam eva kāryaṃ samṛdhyai
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुश् चतुर्विंशम् एव कार्यं समृध्यै
text_mt: However, they also say: 'The twenty-four-fold day indeed should be performed for the sake of prosperity.'

sanskrit_iast: athaite svarasāmānaḥ śiro vai divākīrtyaṃ prāṇāḥ svarasāmāno yad divākīrtyam abhitaḥ svarasāmāno bhavanti śirasyeva tat prāṇā dhīyante
meaning: अथैते स्वरसामानः शिरो वै दिवाकीर्त्यं प्राणाः स्वरसामानो यद् दिवाकीर्त्यम् अभितः स्वरसामानो भवन्ति शिरस्येव तत् प्राणा धीयन्ते
text_mt: Now as to these Svarasāmans: the day to be celebrated in the middle of the day is the head; the Svarasāmans are the vital breaths. In that the Svarasāmans are on both sides of the day celebrated in the middle of the day, it is in the head that the vital breaths are placed.

sanskrit_iast: atha yāvantyau prāṇau tau viśvajid abhijitāv athaite goāyuṣī mithunau stomāv upayanti prajātyai
meaning: अथ यावन्त्यौ प्राणौ तौ विश्वजिद् अभिजिताव् अथैते गोआयुषी मिथुनौ स्तोमाव् उपयन्ति प्रजात्यै
text_mt: Now, the two vital breaths at the extremities are the Viśvajit and the Abhijit. Then as to these Go and Āyus: they enter upon these two paired stomas for the sake of procreation.

sanskrit_iast: athaitāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāya
meaning: अथैतानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननाय
text_mt: Then as to these ten days of the twelve-day rite: they enter upon speech uninterrupted for the sake of procreation.

sanskrit_iast: athaitad vratam annaṃ vai vrata na vā anyatra mukhād annaṃ dhinoti yad upariṣṭād vratam upayanti mukhata eva tad annādyaṃ dhīyate tasmān mukhe sad annaṃ dhinoti
meaning: अथैतद् व्रतम् अन्नं वै व्रत न वा अन्यत्र मुखाद् अन्नं धिनोति यद् उपरिष्टाद् व्रतम् उपयन्ति मुखत एव तद् अन्नाद्यं धीयते तस्मान् मुखे सद् अन्नं धिनोति
text_mt: Then as to this Mahāvrata: the Mahāvrata is food. Food does not satisfy anywhere else than in the mouth; in that they enter upon the Mahāvrata at the end, food is placed in the mouth; therefore food, being in the mouth, satisfies.

sanskrit_iast: athaitau prāyaṇīyodayanīyāv atirātrau yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudhanti
meaning: अथैतौ प्रायणीयोदयनीयाव् अतिरात्रौ येनैव प्राणेन प्रयन्ति तम् अभ्युधन्ति
text_mt: Then as to these two atirātras, the opening one and the concluding one: with the very breath with which they set out, they rise up to that same [breath].

sanskrit_iast: atirātro nava trivṛnty ahāny agniṣṭomamukhaṣ ṣaḍaho 'tha yāni trīṇy ahāny agniṣṭomāv abhita ukthyaṃ madhyato nava pañcadaśāny ahāny agniṣṭomam ukhaḥ ṣaḍaho 'tha yāni trīṇy ahāny agniṣṭomāv abhita ukthyaṃ madhyato nava saptadaśāny ahāny agniṣṭomamukhaḥ ṣaḍaho 'tha yāni trīṇy ahāny agniṣṭomāv abhita ukthyaṃ madhyato navaikaviṃśāny ahāny agniṣṭomamukhaḥ ṣaḍaho 'tha yāni trīṇy ahāny agniṣṭomāv abhita ukthyaṃ madhyato dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś ca
meaning: अतिरात्रो नव त्रिवृन्त्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोममुखष् षडहो ऽथ यानि त्रीण्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोमाव् अभित उक्थ्यं मध्यतो नव पञ्चदशान्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोमम् उखः षडहो ऽथ यानि त्रीण्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोमाव् अभित उक्थ्यं मध्यतो नव सप्तदशान्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोममुखः षडहो ऽथ यानि त्रीण्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोमाव् अभित उक्थ्यं मध्यतो नवैकविंशान्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोममुखः षडहो ऽथ यानि त्रीण्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोमाव् अभित उक्थ्यं मध्यतो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् च
text_mt: An atirātra; nine ninefold days, being a six-day period headed by an agniṣṭoma, and the three days having an ukthya in the middle between two agniṣṭomas; nine fifteenfold days, being a six-day period headed by an agniṣṭoma, and the three days having an ukthya in the middle between two agniṣṭomas; nine seventeenfold days, being a six-day period headed by an agniṣṭoma, and the three days having an ukthya in the middle between two agniṣṭomas; nine twenty-one-fold days, being a six-day period headed by an agniṣṭoma, and the three days having an ukthya in the middle between two agniṣṭomas; the ten days of the twelve-day rite; the Mahāvrata; and an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vai savitā sarvasya prasavam agacchat
meaning: एताभिर् वै सविता सर्वस्य प्रसवम् अगच्छत्
text_mt: By these, Savitṛ attained the impulse over all.

sanskrit_iast: sarvasya prasavaṃ gacchanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: सर्वस्य प्रसवं गच्छन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: Those who enter upon these [rites] attain the impulse over all.

sanskrit_iast: yad gaṇaśaḥ stomā bahava eva bhavanti saha trivṛtaḥ saha pañcadaśāḥ saha saptadaśāḥ sahaikaviṃśāḥ savitur vā etāḥ kakubhaḥ
meaning: यद् गणशः स्तोमा बहव एव भवन्ति सह त्रिवृतः सह पञ्चदशाः सह सप्तदशाः सहैकविंशाः सवितुर् वा एताः ककुभः
text_mt: In that the stomas are in groups, they become manifold: together the ninefold, together the fifteenfold, together the seventeenfold, together the twenty-one-fold. These are the summits of Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast: kakubhaḥ samānānāṃ ca prajānāṃ ca bhavanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: ककुभः समानानां च प्रजानां च भवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: Those who enter upon these [rites] become the summits among their equals and among their subjects.

sanskrit_iast: atirātraś catvāro 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā mahāvrataṃ dvāv abhiplavau ṣaḍahau dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
meaning: अतिरात्रश् चत्वारो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहा महाव्रतं द्वाव् अभिप्लवौ षडहौ द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
text_mt: An atirātra, four abhiplava six-day periods, the Mahāvrata, two abhiplava six-day periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, and an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtavo na pratyatiṣṭhaṃs ta etābhiḥ pratyatiṣṭhan pratiṣṭhākāmā upeyuḥ
meaning: ऋतवो न प्रत्यतिष्ठंस् त एताभिः प्रत्यतिष्ठन् प्रतिष्ठाकामा उपेयुः
text_mt: The seasons were not firmly established; through these [rites] they were firmly established. Those who desire a firm standing should enter upon them.

sanskrit_iast: praty eva tiṣṭhanti ṣaḍ vā ṛtava ṛtuṣv evaitābhiḥ pratitiṣṭhanti yat kḷptān ṣaḍahān upayanti kḷptyā eva
meaning: प्रत्य् एव तिष्ठन्ति षड् वा ऋतव ऋतुष्व् एवैताभिः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति यत् कॢप्तान् षडहान् उपयन्ति कॢप्त्या एव
text_mt: They do indeed attain a firm standing; the seasons are six, so it is in the seasons that they are firmly established through these. In that they enter upon orderly six-day periods, it is for order.

sanskrit_iast: athaitad vratam annaṃ vai vrataṃ na vā anyatra madhyād annaṃ dhinoti yad vrataṃ madhyata upayanti madhyata eva tad annādyaṃ dhīyate tasmān madhye sad annaṃ dhinoti
meaning: अथैतद् व्रतम् अन्नं वै व्रतं न वा अन्यत्र मध्याद् अन्नं धिनोति यद् व्रतं मध्यत उपयन्ति मध्यत एव तद् अन्नाद्यं धीयते तस्मान् मध्ये सद् अन्नं धिनोति
text_mt: Then as to this Mahāvrata: the Mahāvrata is food. Food does not satisfy anywhere else than in the middle; in that they enter upon the Mahāvrata in the middle, food is placed in the middle; therefore food, being in the middle, satisfies.

sanskrit_iast: yat kḷptau ṣaḍahāv upayanti kḷptyā eva
meaning: यत् कॢप्तौ षडहाव् उपयन्ति कॢप्त्या एव
text_mt: In that they enter upon two orderly six-day periods, it is for order.

sanskrit_iast: athaitāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāyāthaitau prāyaṇīyodayanīyāv atirātrau yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudyanti
meaning: अथैतानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननायाथैतौ प्रायणीयोदयनीयाव् अतिरात्रौ येनैव प्राणेन प्रयन्ति तम् अभ्युद्यन्ति
text_mt: Then as to these ten days of the twelve-day rite: they enter upon speech uninterrupted for the sake of procreation. Then as to these two atirātras, the opening one and the concluding one: with the very breath with which they set out, they rise up to that same [breath].

sanskrit_iast: atirātraḥ ṣaḍabhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś ca
meaning: अतिरात्रः षडभिप्लवाः षडहा द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् च
text_mt: An atirātra, six abhiplava six-day periods, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, the Mahāvrata, and an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: etābhir vā indrāgnī atyanyā devatā abhavatām atyanyāḥ prajā bhavanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: एताभिर् वा इन्द्राग्नी अत्यन्या देवता अभवताम् अत्यन्याः प्रजा भवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: By these, Indra and Agni surpassed the other deities. Those who enter upon these surpass other creatures.

sanskrit_iast: indrāgnī vai devānām ojiṣṭhā ojiṣṭhā bhavanti ya etā upayanti
meaning: इन्द्राग्नी वै देवानाम् ओजिष्ठा ओजिष्ठा भवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
text_mt: Indra and Agni are the most forceful of the gods; those who enter upon these become the most forceful.

sanskrit_iast: yat kḷptān ṣaḍahān upayanti kḷptyā evāthaitāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāyāthaitad vratam athaitau prāyaṇīyodayanīyāv atirātrau yenaiva prāṇena prayanti tam abhyudhanti
meaning: यत् कॢप्तान् षडहान् उपयन्ति कॢप्त्या एवाथैतानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननायाथैतद् व्रतम् अथैतौ प्रायणीयोदयनीयाव् अतिरात्रौ येनैव प्राणेन प्रयन्ति तम् अभ्युधन्ति
text_mt: In that they enter upon orderly six-day periods, it is for order. Then as to these ten days of the twelve-day rite: they enter upon speech uninterrupted for the sake of procreation. Then as to this Mahāvrata. Then as to these two atirātras, the opening one and the concluding one: with the very breath with which they set out, they rise up to that same [breath].

sanskrit_iast: atirātraś caturviṃśaṃ prāyaṇīyam ahas trayo 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahāḥ pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho 'bhijit trayassvarasāmāno divākīrtyam ahas trayaḥ svarasāmāno viśvajit pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastriṃśārambhaṇa eko 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaha āyuś ca gauś ca dve ahanī dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvrataś cātirātraś ca tad etad ekaṣaṣṭirātraṃ daivānāṃ vrātyānām
meaning: अतिरात्रश् चतुर्विंशं प्रायणीयम् अहस् त्रयो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहाः पृष्ठ्यः षडहो ऽभिजित् त्रयस्स्वरसामानो दिवाकीर्त्यम् अहस् त्रयः स्वरसामानो विश्वजित् पृष्ठ्यः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिंशारम्भण एको ऽभिप्लवः षडह आयुश् च गौश् च द्वे अहनी द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि महाव्रतश् चातिरात्रश् च तद् एतद् एकषष्टिरात्रं दैवानां व्रात्यानाम्
text_mt: An atirātra; the twenty-four-fold opening day; three abhiplava six-day periods; a pṛṣṭhya six-day period; the Abhijit; three Svarasāman [days]; the day celebrated in the middle of the day; three Svarasāman [days]; the Viśvajit; a pṛṣṭhya six-day period beginning with the thirty-three-fold stoma; one abhiplava six-day period; the Āyus and the Go, two days; the ten days of the twelve-day rite; the Mahāvrata; and an atirātra. That is this sixty-one-day session of the divine Vrātyas.

sanskrit_iast: daivā vai vrātyāḥ sattram āsata budhena sthapatinā te ha vā aniryācya varuṇaṃ rājānaṃ devayajanaṃ didīkṣus tān ha vā varūṇo rājānu vyājahārāntar emi vo yajñiyād bhāgadheyān na devayānaṃ panthānaṃ prajñāsyatheti tasmāt tebhyo na havir gṛhṇanti na graham
